comments: my stay at Allen's home was wonderful, very warm and cosy both in Allan's kindness and the surounds of the space. The garden was so sweet, the bed was comfy and the space was spotlessly clean, much appreciated. loved it.

Quality - that is the word that first comes to mind to describe not only Allans place but also the thought he has put into hosting. Allans place is very clean, very brightly lit and the layout well planned. Large flatscreen tele, new and matching crockery, new fridge - I felt like I was staying in a brand new place which points to the level of care and maintenance Allan puts into his place. My visitors, two different sets and locals were impressed by the place too. Will not hesitate recommending a stay at Allans.
I couldn't have picked a better place to stay. My mom was in town, all the way from India and she absolutely loved our little home. Thanks Alan for the yummy chocolates, fruit and the gorgeous room!

We stayed a week, but wanted to stay longer. Allan is a pleasant host, and the unit is very comfortable and well appointed. It is also quite well located - close to major shopping centres and even a gym just a block away. Will definitely return on my next stay in Melbourne.

Allen's accommodation was very well set up for our week's stay in Melbourne.  The providing of fruit, chocolates, light breakfast and a frozen meal was most welcome.  The quiet garden was a pleasant  addition.  Allen was very helpful with any of our queries about travel within the city and interesting places to visit.  We would recommend Tranquillity as a base for your Melbourne visit.   If using public transport, purchase a zone 1 & 2 ticket to cover the bus trip to Oakleigh Station.
A complete and nice apartment with everythings you need. Better than staying in a five star hotel. Easy to nearby shopping mall, Monash Uni, etc. Thanks Allan
Allan was an amazing host , nothing was to much trouble for him,  and they were very hospitable. All our needs were meet 100%. Cant wait to stay again was over all fantastic .

Allans studio isbeautifullly set up and he is a delightful host, adding a welcome package that made us feel very welcome and well taken care of. We also had a car and there was good safe parking on the street. We needed a place with access to the city and Dandenong and this was perfect. I would definately recommend hte studio and Allan to anyone looking for a long or shorter stay around Melbourne.

My boyfriend and I had a great stay in Allan's studio. It was very clean, stylish and well set up. Allan himself is a lovely host, although we didn't get to see much of him as he was very busy! Very close to the supermarket as well (almost next door) which was convenient. I would definitely recommend this place to others.

We were very warmly welcomed and shown all the facilities (which were wonderful). Garden area was particularly beautiful. Very convenient to shops. Nice peaceful location. Couldn't have asked for more.

My stay at Allan & Lizy's place was great. I had been travelling for three week prior and had the best two night sleep in their cozy backyard cottage. It was private, quite and well equipped. I will stay there again.

Mark

Allan's "Superhost" rating is well-deserved; the place is immaculate, extremely well-equipped and the welcome was warm and friendly.  Allan and Lizzy are considerate hosts without being intrusive.  The deck is fantastic for entertaining or chilling out with a morning coffee and the garden is peaceful and beautiful. I had a fantastic stay and wouldn't hesitate to stay again or to recommend to friends.
The hosts are very friendly. The house is lovely, especially the garden! We'd love to stay here again and recommend this to our friends.
The place is perfect.clean and very well maintained. The hosts were so hospitable and comforting , we loved it. The garden and all the amenities provided made our stay even better. Thanks a lot Allan

A mini home away from home. Everything was as described and more. From the bowl of fruit upon arrival ( a delightful and appreciated gesture) to the bookcase full of readable novels, I didn't want for anything.
We needed an extra bedroom to host our parents and this place was perfect. It is a very quiet, private, self contained granny flat with everything you need. We'll definitely book again.

A great place to stay, everything as described in the listing and the covered outdoor area and garden are a huge plus. Allan and Lizzie were great hosts. We hope to stay here again next time we're in Melbourne.

We spent a very comfortable 6 nights in Larry's place.  Lissy met us and showed us around.  The studio is at the back of their house with a nice view of their garden.  It is clean, quiet, spacious and very well appointed, with every little need supplied.  The kitchen was well equipped and we appreciated Lissy's invitation to help ourselves to her vegetable garden!  The Wifi was also excellent.  As pointed out in their description, the bed is a double bed.  We used the bus and train several times to get into the city - very convenient to the house.  We thoroughly recommend their place.

We had the best time at Allan's and Lizzie's place. The studio apartment was nice and clean and the hospitality was top notch. The area is a bit far from Melbourne city but it was difficult to take public transport. It was a quiet neighborhood located close to Monash University.
We would definitely recommend staying at Allan and Lizzie's place.
Mathias and Sebastian
I have nothing but good words for the property and its host. Allan is very friendly and open to accommodating requests.

I had this place booked for my mum and her partner to stay over easter break and they told me that the place was beyond expectations! I even went there to see it myself and I must admit this place is perfect and definitely will book again. My first time using air bnb and had a wonderful experience and feedback from my mum and her partner. If you're looking for a quiet suburban area to stay, this place is definitely the one. It is so peaceful and quiet! Thanks alot Allan for being a great host!
I booked this place for my husband.  He spoke highly of his experience and he is very fussy and hard to please!
It was a very good place to stay. Allan and his wife were very nice to me and helpful. I felt like at home immediately. I really recommend

Thank you Allan and Lizzie for accommodating us in your beautiful place. The couple was very accommodating, with extra amenities offered. If given the chance to return, we will definitely choose your place again.

Allan and Lissie were lovely hosts and the studio apartment had everything one needs for a short or longer stay (in my case 1 month).
If you are looking for a great place to stay in the quieter outer suburbs of Melbourne or look for a place close to Monash University, I can most certainly recommend staying with Allan and Lissie.

The studio apartments was perfectly located for my business trip only minutes from Dandenong Road. It’s clean and private, very comfy bed and hot shower. There’s all the basics you’d need, good WiFi and sone breakfast items too. I appreciated the fresh fruit left for me. All in all it’s exactly like the pics. You need a car and need to travel by car to find the restaurants and cafes.

Located at the back of the property this comfortably and well converted studio is perfect for a single traveller or couple.  The studio is quiet, very clean, has all the amenities you would require, with the addition of thoughtful touches such as fruit, chocolate, coffee and some basic supplies. The bed is very comfortable and additional pillows are available to choose from.  The hosts are very hospitable and helpful, and have taken care to make their guests experience a positive one.

Rented for 13 nights for relatives, the unit is good, BUT
A landlord is required to give a tenant 'quiet enjoyment' not hammer outside the window on a Sunday morning. Once is forgivable, not all of a subsequent day, whilst being fully aware that the elderly tenant was resting inside. Add to that unauthorized access by a small boy, and privacy is an issue.

This studio is a truly lovely place to stay! Allan and Lizzie are very warm hosts, were flexible around my check in time and very helpful. The studio feels very much as a 'home', has everything you need and is very comfortable.
This could also be suitable for someone who is looking for longer term stay (like an academic term or a couple of months)

Allan and his wife made us feel very welcomed, the place was very clean and well looked after. It was cosy and felt like home, I will definitely stay there again and recommend them to friends and family.

Highly recommended. Our third stay. Quiet, efficient, private, safe. Immaculately clean. Most comfortable new bed and bedding. We again stayed for over 3 weeks. The description of the accommodations is bang on accurate. A gem. We stay at many other B&B and keep coming back here when we are in Melbourne.
Incredible hosts, incredible apartment. We spend a perfect week in Melbourne thanks to Allan and Lizzie, I recomend !

Allan’s place was wonderful. I have booked his place when my in laws came for a visit to Melbourne. The hosts were very nice and made us feel at home.  The place is clean and very comfortable. The location is great being close to shops and all. Overall, this place is a gem. Try to book it if you can as it seems to fill up quickly.
The best features are the lovely gardens and the sparkling cleanliness. The location is very close to shops, cafes and buses but is very quiet. We wanted to stay next week but they were fully booked.

Arriving at a new country can be extremely daunting, but Allan and Lizzie were both exceptional hosts that naturally lead into a friendship. The place is cozy, clean and interesting. It doesn't feel like just any stay, but one that will be memorable. Due to both the comfortable place and warm hospitality. The hosts went above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need, we highly recommend staying with Allan and Lizzie :)

This place is exactly as shown in the pics. I enjoyed my stay here. Allan responds quickly and is very helpful. IGA at the corner to buy Groceries. Very close bus stop to go to Monash university research way. I wanted to extend my stay but it was already booked. I highly recommend this place.

For one time i stayed in Allan s house and everything was perfect! It feels like home away from home!That s why in a few days i ll be back!The house is exactly as is being shown and the owners are the most sweet people!

A great stay At Allans. Friendly and informative host. Easy to chat to and made us feel extremely welcome. Allan was extremely flexible as our arrival was hampered by delayed flights and a later check in was no trouble.
Thanks Allan - A great place and a great stay. Thank you so much.
Darren
It was a perfect stay. If I need to stay in Melbourne, I will definitely come back.

WOW ! This place is in the heart of the action , Restaurants , Bars, walking to all places in the city and the best way to see and feel Melbourne.  The loft is lots of fun , larger than we expected , a great bathroom and of course the swing in the middle of the room ! The lane way has a great new coffee shop ,meeting place and literally metres away is several great restaurants and coffee houses. Across the road is the GPO building and transport was easy. Don't get stuck in a bland hotel , stay in the heart and soul ,stay in this Loft apartment !!

Could you get a better location in Melbourne? i think not.
such a warm, charismatic, large and complete warehouse apartment you really can not go wrong.

Michelle's place is very well located in the heart of Melbourne. It is closed to everything, good restaurants, public transport, etc. Also, Michelle was very helpful, in terms of having at her place very good information about places to visit, and eat out. Thus, I recommend Michelle's place for future travellers.

We loved Melbourne !
Cafe , food , bar , art and fashioned orientated city !
I felt a bit like in Berlin I must say parks so lush , people so charming and friendly as well helpful ! The place we stayed was a nice open wood characteristic loft/ warehouse which seemed to be a great place to have friends over for dinner or pre drinks before a night out in fitzroy ! Michell was a very helpfull person in each way which we loved . She defiantly is a person to ask what's going on in town in my opinion the way i just read about her . Anyway just check the place out if you are up for culture and food in Melbourne !

Perfect location. Great to have such a large space. The apartment is not quite as nice as it seems from the photos - just a little bit tired. But on the whole a good experience - the location made up for any shortcomings!! Host was very responsive and helpful.

Absolutely loved our stay in Michelle's apartment, so much so we didn't want to leave! All the essential amenities and more. Awesome location just near Hardware Lane, so loads of eateries and bars close by. Would recommend it to anyone :)

A fantastic apartment, in a fantastic location, cared for by a fantastic host. This was our first airbnb experience, which I suspect will be hard to beat. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay, and appreciated the small touches by Michelle such as the public transport cards.

Michelle kindly answered my last minute request for a long-term stay in minutes. She took the time to great me and gave me plenty of recommendations on places to eat, drink and ways to enjoy Melbourne as she is the 'ultimate Melbourne guide' to discover this amazing city.

This is the perfect city loft experience with access from a typical Melbourne lane. Very well situated, with a unique caracter and soul, spacious and peaceful. You wish this was your home!

Many thanks Michelle.

Amazing! This place is unique, and so Melbourne! It really added a special element to our stay in the city. It is in a ridiculously convenient location and the space is great. Michelle was a superb host and 10/10 would recommend.

Michelle 's apartment is great. Location is fabulous- right in the middle of the CBD and close to more bars and restaurants than you could ever need, including the best coffee at Brother Baba's! We used the trams to get around which were v easy.
It's a lovely space and we enjoyed the views over the city, especially at night. Very well equipped with everything you need, including a/c over the bed and fans. A shame the roof space can't really be used but I'm guessing this might happen in the future.
Easy to find and on the second floor with the tattoo parlour below you (they were lovely neighbours!)
Michelle was super helpful and answered all our questions while we were there.
Thank you!

Michelle made us feel super welcome and had some amazing recommendations for places for us to eat and drink while staying in Melbourne. The fact that the only reason we were staying in Melbourne was to eat and drink so we were very happy chappys. Amazing spacious apartment and so close to everything. We could walk anywhere easily and stopped by the cafe just downstairs every morning for a delicious brew. We also may have gotten a cheeky tattoo from the tattoo parlour downstairs. Have recommended the apartment to family and friends and we cannot wait to stay there again on our next trip to Melbourne!

Michelle's spot in Melbourne is not only situated in the heart of the city but is a very unique pad as well.  The ability to stay at places like this is one of the unique pluses of Airbnb, Michelle's spot is highly recommended to anybody looking for a very unique jump off point for their Melbourne travels.  As a host Michelle couldn't have been more accommodating, from arranging an extremely nice and convenient private parking spot to providing a great list of food spots and music venues Michelle's extra touches made a huge difference.

Lovely place, very Melbourne. Great location,  definitely one of a kind! Amazing to find this secret of Melbourne - would absolutely recommend. Michelle also allowed us an early check in which was very much appreciated.

Michelle's place is pretty much my favourite place I have ever stayed in Melbourne. Incredible value for money. Its a big beautiful open loft apartment in a location that can't be beat! Absolutely recommended!

you can't find a better address than this, with machester press downstairs and tipo next door, please let me know if you ever wanna sell !\(^o^)/Michelle is really friendly and helpful, we had a wonderful time.
Absolutely loved it! The place is awesome. A great thanks to the host, hopefully we can do it again sometime. Cheers
Michelle's apartment is in a great, and funky, location. We had an amazing weekend and she has great recommendations of some rad eats around Melbourne!
Great living space central to anywhere you need to be in Melbourne city! Michelle was friendly, accommodating and swift with her responses to emails! Highly recommend!
Michelle's place is everything I expected and more. I loved the space and experience. Many thanks Michelle.
The loft is extremely spacious and wonderfully designed. The shower/bath is beautiful. Its close to everything you could need. Had a lovely time in a lovely home. ♡

Great place in a great location...
Michelle is extremely knowledgeable of the area and helpful with whatever you may need.

This was our first Air BnB experience and we were glad we got Michelle as our host. The location was amazing - walking distance to the great cafes, restaurants and shops, but the actual space of the apartment was what was outstanding, so different and unique. The skyline from the huge windows had a really beautiful view. What you see in the pictures is exactly what you get. We would return again if ever in Melbourne and would recommend this to anyone. Don't think twice :)
PS: The swing adds a really interesting touch to the feel of the apartment!
If I had to have one critique - that would be that the bed was too soft - I perfer a harder bed, but that's just me.
Overall - well worth the money......
By far and away the most superb air bnb experience I've had. Better than the photos - an incredible, serene, expansive and stunning space. I will be back.

Michelle's place is the PERFECT home for a truly 'Melbourne' experience. The apartment is ridiculously spacious, and is the definiton of thr word 'charming'. Stepping out of the apartment puts you into right into the heart of the CBD, just off Elizabeth street & with all the major landmarks and activities Melbourne has to offer, right at your fingertips. I couldn't recommend this place enough, and definitely plan on coming back if the opportunity arises.
Quirky and stylish place in the heart of the city. Really enjoyed our stay here. It was a lot bigger than expected. As long as you don’t have a problem with stairs you’ll love it just like we did.

Michelle was so lovely to deal with and her apartment was absolutely breathtaking. Great views, eclectic, and an all round amazing place.
Would highly recommend to others and would spend another weekend here in the future.

Outstanding location! Wonderfully cool warehouse apartment in the heart of the city. Excellent views! My husband and I had a fabulous stay and Michelle was extremely accomodating. We loved it and would highly recommend.

If Little Bourke Street/Hardware Lane is your part of town, then you can't do better than this.  Groovy, slightly rustic loft style, perfect for single or couple visitor.  It's surprisingly quiet for the location.  The host is very helpful and genuinely accommodating.  Would happily return.

Truly a remarkable find! An Authentic spacious and comfortable loft. Hip and central location. Easy to get everywhere. Michelle was responsive and helpful. We’ve stayed at Airbnbs around the world and this is  among the best.

Michelle‘s warehouse is the ultimate Melbourne city break. Incredible, unique space in a great location - loved living out some delusions of grandeur swanning about that place for a weekend. Michelle is also a great host - great communication and kind enough to accommodate an early check-in. Highly recommended.

Wow what an amazing space and unique apartment right in the heart of the best the city has to offer. So central to top restaurants, great coffee, tucked away bars, and an easy walk to the Yarra too. Michelle was so helpful and accommodating. This warehouse space will take your breath away.
Thanks for a fabulous weekend.
We had to postpone a few times due to COVID and Michelle was always understanding and flexible with changing our dates. She was a great host and quick to respond to messages.

A rare treasure to stay at within Melbourne’s CBD. Having lived myself in Melbourne for many years, I can tell you that this is a unique gem of which you couldn’t find anything remotely similar. Even beyond the brilliance of the space itself is the perfect location, right in the heart of the city. I will definitely be returning!

The photos really understate how cool this place is. That’s the thing about cool I guess. Once you overstate it, you’ve lost it.
Anyway it’s huge; probably bigger than my house, and I live in a four bedroom the suburbs. But the suburbs ain’t cool.
It’s a little distressed in places but make no mistake: you will feel like a goddamned movie star in this joint.

The loft apartment is wonderfully located and a beautiful charming space right in the heart of Melbourne. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and Michelle went above and beyond to assist us. It has a quirky charm and lots of steps and a wild sunken bath tub so not for all but for us it was perfect and we would love to return one day.

Michelle went above and beyond allowing us to check in earlier and leave later to maximise our weekend. She was extremely accomodating and responsive. The place is absolutely beautiful and in a perfect location close to everything. We can’t wait to stay here again!

Great communication, and amazing place. Such a cool building, and an unbelievable location.
Michelle was accomodating of everything we needed, and I can’t speak highly enough of her.
I couldn't recommend this one of a kind airbnb more! Great location, very comfortable and a beautiful space all over.

What a beautiful place - I couldn't believe how nice it was, even better in real life than the photos. Michelle was a perfect host as well, very helpful and extremely easy to communicate with! Would 10/10 recommend and would love to stay again!

Very accommodating for our need of early check-in, and offered a late check out. Huge and gorgeous space and in an amazing location, absolutely centre of everything! Although the spa feature not working was quite a disappointment, and many of the light switches did not work.

This stay was one of the most unique I’ve ever had. Located in a prime location down a stunning alleyway with the most beautiful cosy interior made our trip to Melbourne so amazing. Communication was very clear and messages were answered in a very timely manner. Check in was super smooth and accommodated for a slightly earlier arrival. Will definitely return to this cosy, unique home! Could not recommend this space more

We found the accommodation very pleasant and homely, while still being enjoyable! It was close to amenities, and we would definitely recommend this accommodation! Katie and her husband were very accommodating and helpful.

The accommodation provided everything we needed. The location was great for our girls basketball tournament and shopping facilities were close by. Katie answered all my emails in a very short period of time and welcomed us on arrival.

Hosts were great. They gave us all the information we need.
The place was cozy and it feels like home during the time we spend there.

Stayed with Katie and Tony for 3 weeks. The flat was between two sets of relations which we were able to visit but could retire to Glenmore so as not to impose on either family. We were made very welcome by our hosts who were very helpful without being overbearing. The flat has 3 good size rooms and was a "home from home" for us. Husband Road is quiet and felt safe. If you visit, make sure you go to the 50m indoor swimming pool about 200m away. Its beautiful. My daughter and I miss our visit most mornings to the pool wearing our flip flops!!

My wife and I had an excellent experience. The accommodation was warm and modern, mixed with rustic decor. Michelle generously allowed us to leave our bags for an extended period of time when our flight got delayed. Great place, location and service!

Michelle was a great host, extremely responsive and friendly. The loft was a unique, quirky space that we totally enjoyed. It was heaps of fun living the life of an inner city urbanite, even if it was just for a couple of days! Location is perfect. Highly recommend.

I had an incredible stay at this Airbnb loft with my brother. The loft itself was truly amazing, and I can't wait to come back. Being surrounded by such a creative atmosphere really helped my creative flow, and having access to the rooftop was like a source of spiritual enlightenment. Looking forward to seeing them again soon!
For my family and me it was the beginning and the end of our journey to Australia. We felt very comfortable here. A great home with nice hosts! Thank you for everything! We will be back!
Great accommodation & friendly hosts. Katie was very informative, letting us know about restaurants, shops and activities close by.

I would recommend staying at this accommodation. Katie was fantastic to deal with! Though the property is a little outdated and the kitchen facilities were exceptionally small, so no big meal.... so shopping and cooking for yourself may not occur. But for my needs (watching daughter play at the U14 National Championships in Basketball) it was outstanding. Very comfortable  and located  close to where I need to be. Thanks Katie for a great stay!

Comfy back room suite perfect for winding down in. Accomodating up to 5-6 people was a bonus even though it was only 2 of us staying there. Being connected to this main house was never and issue and neither was washing dishes in the bathroom. We had a great experience here and would recommend these lovely hosts
Katies place was just what we needed during our stay in Melbourne. It was spacious well equipped  private quiet and easily accessible. Good value too.
It is a great place to live, Katie and Tony are very kind and nice. very convenient to buy things.
Katie’s place is comfortable, cosy and spacious. Good value. The only downside was that communication response could have been quicker.

This has to be one of the coolest stays in Melbourne! Michelle was extremely attentive at replying to any messages we sent during our stay. Everything was as described. Lots of stairs though so may not be suitable to all travellers. Will definitely be staying again!

The apartment is a comfortable and unique space to live in for any period of time, with all the essentials and luxuries one could desire. The host is proactive and responds to questions in a timely manner. The property is just a few paces from the action, but retains a private and peaceful environment for sleeping and living. The property, with the former warehouse quirks and styling, enhances your Melbourne stay. Would re-book, and recommend to anyone wanting to experience the Melbourne CBD in a way very few tourists/locals can.

What a special place in the heart of the CBD. Was very cosy, with the Melbourne winter the heating was perfect. Such a comfortable vibe in the loft. The bed was super comfy. Was great getting back from the hustle and bustle of the City to this comfortable home. A great venue to celebrate my husband’s birthday. Highly recommend!! Thanks for sharing this beautiful space with us.
Very tidy and lovely accommodation equipped with everything you need. A good bed and nice bathroom. Katie and Tony are both great hosts. They are very friendly and welcoming. We had a great stay!
It was a great experience, Katie & Tony are very kind, the house is in a quiet street, the surrounding areas are beautiful!
Very accomodating people, a nice and tidy space. No kitchen or sink which can be a bit tricky, but the price is affordable and location is great

Had a lovely stay. Nice, quiet location at rear of house. Close to where we needed to be. Had an issue with the kettle turning off, but owner showed me the nifty trick with screwdriver to get it back on. Happened again on second night with the fridge turning off, but thankfully didn’t have food in there. No frills, but ample room for a few nights stay. Loved that there was recycling and rubbish separate! And loved the gas heater and electric blanket that kept us warm during the chilly weather.

Staying at Lucy's was great. We had everything we needed for our short trip. The outside area was lovely, though we didn't get time to use it. You will have all you need when staying. Read the notes carefully though as there is not a full kitchen, but we had all we needed for our stay.

We had a busy working weekend and Lucy's place was only a short distance from where we needed to be.  Great to have off street parking and very quiet, no traffic noise at night.  It was perfect for us.

I was in need of a short getaway from frantic, noisy Melbourne, and my stay at the cabin did just that. Comfortable, quiet, green and lush, and I was greeted by a big mob of roos as soon as I arrived and drove up the driveway.
Lovely hosts, great location, and if I'm in need of another break from the city, I won't hesitate to stay again. Thanks!
Karen and Michael are lovely! The cabin was clean, comfortable and charming. Breakfast was delicious too!

We were looking for a one night escape from the city, and Karen's cabin was perfect. Its in a great setting, very quiet and fully self contained with everything we needed. Karen kindly provided breakfast and late checkout to make our stay as relaxed as possible. The nearby area is amazing - we went our for dinner at DeBortoli's nearby, and the next day worked it off by going for a bike ride around the Toolangi forest which was stunning.
What a great short break!

Karen and Michael's cabin was my first airBnB stay, and it was a very encouraging start.  The cabin is perfectly modest, solid, and comfortable; containing everything we needed and a little bit more.  Karen provided helpful suggestions in the days before our trip and put us immediately at ease upon arrival. The continental breakfast was a melancholy reminder of how good all those other continental breakfasts you've eaten could have been.  We would go back for sure.

A great cosy place to unwind sitting on the verandah with lovely views reading a book. All amenities provided and close to all the local cafes, shops and tourist spots. We really enjoyed the local market on Sunday morning.
A big thanks to Karen and Michael from maureen and Brian.

We had a lovely time staying in Karen's guest cabin. The supplies provided for breakfast were excellent including fresh strawberries from the garden. We loved sitting on the deck, watching the kangaroos and kookaburras and listening to the birds. Karen was very welcoming and helpful - giving us lots of tips about the best places to eat in the area. We would love to stay again. Thanks Karen!

Karen's cabin in the hills near Healesville is just wonderful.  My partner and I had the perfect getaway for two nights, cycling all day and feasting at the local restaurants in the evening.  The cabin was cosy and comfortable, with everything we needed and plenty of lovely extras, like the home grown fruit and handmade soaps.  I will highly recommend this cabin for my cycling friends, singles or couples, and anyone who is looking for a quiet few days in the bush, without driving half a day to get there.
The Cabin, the host-Karen and the location and closeness to Healsville was great. A pleasure to organise and to come and go freely, will stay again, thanks Karen :)
Karen and Micheal were both very nice and friendly. The cabin was super. It was private, peaceful and relaxing. The wildlife was everywhere with kangaroos, kookaburras, parrots, echidnas, rabbits....

Karen and Michael have a delightful little independent cottage located on their Chum Creek  property. It is well appointed at a reasonable price. We were greated by Karen on our arrival and given a hardy farewell on our departure by Michael and the local kangaroos! Effortless experience. Excellent communication. Highly recommended.

Another fantastic and relaxing stay at Karen's cottage. We always enjoy the peace and quiet. The bed is really confortable, breakfast is delicious with fresh oranges from the garden.
We will definitely be back.

Everything was accurate, Karen had great communication, and everything was easy from start to finish. Cosy little cabin set in a relaxed environment, made to feel like your home away from home. Excellent value.
We did not feel welcomed but we did feel as if we were an inconvenience.   The cabin was good and the location great and convenient.

Karen and Michael are super hosts with lots of local knowledge and can help with anything you need. Their property is gorgeous and we absolutely loved the kangaroos greeting us as we arrived home each day. Forget the sanctuary, stay here. Karen stocked the cabin with everything you could need plus stuff you didn't even know you needed!  The breakfast selections in the cabin were a pleasant surprise. Location is perfect,  close to town, hiking and wineries, yet peaceful with a beautful, relaxing atmosphere.  Karen was great with communication.

It was rather late that day around 8:30pm when we checked in but Karen still welcomed us happily and brought us around her house to see if we can see some wildlife around. She even provide story books for my son which was a very nice gesture. The house was warm and clean, the view out of the house was spectacular especially when we saw the kangaroos hopping across the field in front. Nice place, fantastic host, recommended to go for nature lovers.
The property is lovely and quiet, perfect if you like a bit of backyard wildlife. A small cottage as promised but enough space for two and great location. Looking forward to returning!

Cute, cozy cabin with all the basic necessities! A fantastic combination of seclusion and easy access to town, restaurants, and attractions in the Yarra Valley. We loved staying here and seeing the kangaroos in the yard each day! The heater and heated blanket were much appreciated for the cold winter evenings and we were never chilly inside! Although we never met Karen in person, we meet her husband Michael and she had excellent communication through the app. Would highly recommend booking this cabin for your next stay in Yarra Valley!
It was great staying at Karen's very lovely and quiet. We loved the open spaces and visits from the roos. Also the homegrown fruit was lovely as well. Such a special experience.

A lovely little cottage that is also a bedsit. The kangaroos grazed on the lawn outside our window which was special. Take your own radios, ipod etc if can stay in at night and want some form of entertainment
We loved this cosy cabin with it's peaceful and beautiful surroundings and abundance of kangaroos outside our porch! Karen was a gracious and efficient host. Highly recommended!
Really enjoy our stay .,. Cabin is as described and in a beautiful setting.  Healesville and this area has great wineries and scenery !!  Check in was easy and communication was great.   Thanks Karen
Wonderful clean studio, in a beautiful location. Weather was warm during our stay but the fan did well to cool it at night for sleeping.

Thanks very much Karen and Michael for a lovely stay at Chum Creek cabin. We enjoyed the cosy cottage and surroundings, and it gave us a wonderful getaway with a couple of kangaroos out the front too!  We greatly appreciated the thoughtful touch of breakfast goodies and having the heater on when we arrived as it was a chilly weekend!

Karen's cabin has a beautiful view - it was a great spot to hole up in when the weather got bad and a great base to explore from when it was sunny. The mini hamper provided some good basics for our weekend and we had a lovely time. Thanks Karen!

We had an excellent stay at Karen’s place. The space was cosy and comfortable, and we had everything we needed. The location was excellent - very close the town centre and a great base to explore the Yarra Valley. Karen was quick to communicate and provided us with local tips. A highlight was sitting on the porch watching the kangaroos at dawn and dusk! We will be back!!!

Nice and cosy place with all the basics you need for a weekend away! Karen was a kind welcoming host. The place is a bit far from central Healesville to walk but perfect distance if you have a car! Would recommend!
This farm stay is perfect for a couple’s getaway! Our stay was made extra special by Karen and Michael’s hospitality and kindness. Would highly recommend:)

Wonderfully quiet cosy retreat yet conveniently located close to shops and wineries only a short drive away. Karen and Michael (not to forget Pete the dog ;-) were great hosts: very friendly, accomodating and excellent communicators. Had a lovely time.

Karen was a great host and the place is a wonderful little getaway. Has everything that you need without the bells and whistles. Karen is super friendly, offered us fresh fruit from her orchard, and we had plenty of space and privacy. Would definitely stay again!

Karen was lovely, greeting us for check-in. The cabin itself was compact but contained everything we needed for a quick weekend away. It was comfortable, clean, and warmed up nicely.
Being able to look out onto the grass in the evenings or mornings to watch the kangaroos grazing was a special treat for us suburban folk ;) We would gladly stay again if we visit the area in the future.

It was wonderful staying here. It was our own little piece of Australia that we fell in love with. We hoped we might see some wild life and it didn’t disappoint. So many birds I can name them all but we loved the 2 Kookaburra’s that flew down to the deck in the evenings. There were rabbits and we saw Kangaroos up close and personal every evening and most mornings.
The cabin was wonderful, cosy and very clean. Just the right size. No wifi meant we took more of a break than usual but never bored. We watched DVDs ( a large selection). Both Michael and Karen were lovely and helpful.
Overall a wonderful weekend away from it all
I’m a return visitor and very happy with the location, facilities and cleanliness. Karen is a great host. I look forward to staying again next year.

Karen’s place is in a great location close to Healesville but also to the majority of the Yarra Valley. It was great for a quiet & peaceful weekend away with all the essentials.
The WIFI was unstable for us so if you are needing a stable connection you will need to have an alternative.
I would happily stay there again during our next visit.

The hosts were responsive, friendly, and respectful of guests privacy when entering and exiting the property.
The guest house was cozy, and well set up, with tea & coffee, spare blankets, towels, an electric blanket on the bed, and a tv with dvds available. There was enough provided for a short stay.
The location was lovely and peaceful, with plenty of wildlife and birdsong, while also central to what we needed during our stay.
Beautifully calm place to relax and be super close to all that the Yarra Valley and Healesville have to offer.

This accommodation was even better than we expected - more spacious - and we would definitely recommend it to others. Karen was very friendly and welcoming and provided us with some great local tips. We enjoyed listening to the local birds whilst eating on the deck. It's in a very good location, just over 5 minutes from Healesville.
As Karen states in her description, this is not a fancy place. But on a super hot weekend it was clean and relatively comfortable (maybe some new pillows)
We loved our stay and hope to come back. Karen's place suited us perfectly, and we loved the area.

This charming cottage just outside of Healesville was truly magical. Cozy and quiet. Sit in the front porch having coffee in the morning watching kangaroos hop around and enjoying a beer in the evening on the porch staring at the stars listening to wombats mozy around. Truly amazing spot.
Lovely little spot for a weekend getaway, Karen was super helpful and got to see some local wildlife!

Stay here was amazing! Location was a bit of a surprise at first cause it was in a quiet corner of Healesville, but once you settle you you'll start to realise it's such a convenient location in the middle of nature all around you. Their dog Shea's a wonderful co-host too :) Our stay was wonderful, vineyard recommendations led us to the most amazing boutique wineries!
Would definitely recommend their place as a base for your stay in the Yarra valley region.
Great accommodation and hosts. Healesville is a hip little town with good coffee and food.....sooo many wineries to visit it is a shame we didn’t have more time.
A beautifully equipped cabin that was cosy and very tastefully decorated. All needs were provided for and we wish we had of been able to stay longer.

The stay was wonderful, the accommodation is very well furnished and close to local shops and attractions. Lianne and Paul were wonderful hosts, and Shea was an excellent companion for our puppy Hershel.

We decided at the last minute to book a remote working trip to Healesville and found Lianne and Paul's place. It was exactly what we needed. Lovely studio. Beautiful surrounds. Handy location. Our whippet and Shea were best buds. Can't recommend highly enough.

Super hosts for sure. Beautiful place with a cool art vibe. Super close to main street, with the experience of a quiet country stay. Lianne and Paul are so friendly and welcoming, not to mention their beautiful dog Shea. We will definitely be back.

Highly recommend this place which has a beautiful setting (studio is very well equipped, and the outdoor area is just amazing), wonderful host (and dog!) and great location amidst the wineries of Yarra valley.

- Great studio: Spacious, great kitchen and extremely well furnished with everything you need.
- Outside area with fireplace and easy to use BBQ was great
- Being next to the main house is not an issue at all.
- 5 min drive to town
- Very well natured dog (Shay) providing an extra mate for the stay

We had a very relaxing stay in this beautifully appointed studio with great amenities inside and out i.e. fire pit, barbecue, seating nestled in a tranquil bush garden. The studio was spotlessly clean and very warm and comfortable. Lianne and Paul are wonderful hosts.
We had a beautiful stay, will be recommending to friends and family, can’t wait to come back!

It's a beautiful place. It was raining the whole time we were there, so we didn't make use of the outdoor area, but had fun playing pool and reading in bed with a beautiful view. Spacious kitchen was well set out and everything easy to find. Communication was great.
Thanks Lianne and Paul for a great stay at your little hideaway in nature!! Highly recommended to future guests ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Thank you Lianne and Paul for sharing your home with Baxter and me. We had to most peaceful, relaxing weekend away. It was a pleasure to meet both of you. You had a wonderful way of being there should we need anything but also giving us complete privacy. Baxter would like to thank you for playing with him and the cuddles:) Look forward to meeting you again.
Very comfortable property in great location.  Host very helpful with explaining aspects of the property when we arrived.

Katie was friendly and made sure we had everything we needed for our stay.  The cottage was perfect for our needs - very clean, secure and close to family.  The books and games for the kids was an added bonus.

We had a fantastic stay at Katie's place in Gardenvale.
The location was perfect and Katie attended to any of our needs and requests promptly.
Really great also if you have kids. There is quite a lot of toys and puzzles to entertain them.
We had a BBQ on our last night which was really great to finish the stay with.
5 stars!

The home was comfortable, spacious, well equipped, instructions were clear, and the location was fantastic. I really appreciated the clean spaces and adequate heating for the few very cold days we experienced as well. Great coffee at the end of the street even.

Location superb, plenty of space and all the amenities one could ask for!
Katie is responsive and very helpful. Was sad to be leaving and would definitely return.

Katie's delightful cottage provided us with a wonderful stay while visiting family in Melbourne. Plenty of charm, clean and fresh, and the beds were super comfy. Everything we needed was there, plus off-street parking, a BBQ and books and Lego for our grandkids to enjoy. The area was great for walks, and of the local shops we especially loved "Escargot", the French patisserie on Martin Street. We highly recommend Katie's Gardenvale Cottage, and would like to thank her for her quick and helpful communication with us before and during our stay.

We had a fabulous time staying at Katie’s gorgeous sunflower cottage. For the weary interstate travellers her welcoming touches including Tim tams, coffee, tea and milk was so appreciated too! The beds were comfy and the neighbourhood quiet. We loved that the local restaurants and cafes, supermarket, train station were all in short walking distance.
Highly Recommend!

We stayed at Julia's place for a couple of nights to visit a friend of ours living close by. The location was perfect, not only close to our friend but also to heaps of great bars, cafes and restaurants. The bedrooms and the bathroom felt really clean and were nice and comfortable. The weekend was topped of by breakfast at an EXCELLENT cafe recommended by Julia, just down the road. We would stay again.

Julia was there to meet us when we arrived and was most welcoming and an absolute delight. She showed us what we needed to know, passed on keys and then let us get on with it. She provided the perfect amount of info and guidance; warm, friendly, helpful and then she was unobtrusive.

The house is brilliant, spacious, comfortable and very liveable so you feel like your in a home away from home. The beds are excellent and we all slept like logs.
The whole set up was perfect for us. The cafes, restaurants and shops are in walking distance and the public transport options are excellent. We will definitely be back. Thanks for everything Julia. We hope we see you again soon.

Wonderful and large space, private and close to public transport and shops. Julia was a pleasure to meet, she was very accommodating. The rooms were very spacious and the kitchen was functional enough to cook lunches, dinners and birthday cakes!
Will definitely come back whenever we are in Melbourne next!
We had a really great time in the corner shop house. The location is really convenient and the house is really nice. Julia was a great host and very accommodating for is.

Julia was there to meet us and showed us around her home.Everything was straight forward.Julia lent me her Myki card to use for the trams which was lovely of her.Her home was a great place to stay.Full of character.Way better than any hotel. A great area to stay in too.Close to tram to the city and other suburbs.Fantastic shopping in Sydney and Brunswick streets if you are looking for something different.Also great places and variety to eat locally.

Julia's house is a gorgeous character home in a quiet part of Brunswick but within an easy walk of restaurants, bars & public transport. The home is really cosy & comfortable & Julia is a very considerate host, providing an air cooler on a particularly hot night. Wouldn't hesitate to stay again or recommend Julia's home.

This place is spacious and has tons of amenities. It’s in a great location, just a short walk to Sydney Road and some good coffee, good food, tram stops, etc. There are several really good microbreweries close by as well. There’s a common space right outside the back door with a nice table and chairs under a lemon tree, it’s a good place to sit and have some peaceful time to think. Julia is an excellent host, communicates very well and left no loose ends. We had everything we needed, and she even made sure we had little things like chocolates in the fridge. You’ll have a hard time finding a place that is a better deal than this one.

This was staying in Julia’s home while she was away so it was interesting, a little bit quirky and really wonderful. If you are after something that is different from a ‘styled’ holiday property and feels like a local experience then this place is the go. Stayed here with my 20 yo son who loved it at least as much as I did. Look forward to staying here next time I’m in Melbourne.
Lovely accomodation and great location. Julia made us feel very welcome and at ease. Warmly recommended.

We arrived late evening to Julia's warm, cosy house. Julia provided great local information for the very cool Brunswick neighbourhood. She was easily contactable if we had questions and offered us a later check out which we appreciated. Julia even gave us a signed copy of her mother's book!
The location between Sydney Road and Lygon Street is perfect, as is the nearest coffee shop just down the street! We would stay again.
Our stay at Julia’s was perfect, the house was just as described and lovely and homely. Julia was very responsive to any questions we had and the area was great. Thanks!
We spent 3 nights in this lovely comfortable and perfectly located house. It was everything we expected and more. Will definitely recommend it to anyone we know who is visiting Melbourne.

Katrina was friendly, efficient and helpful with communication and meeting our needs. The home was clean, convenient and comfortable. Everything we needed. Loved the location and we had sown derail time exploring the local area. Arcadia cafe became a staple for breakfast with the welcoming Daniel. Close to the city, Spring Street and the artist driven Rose Markets off Napier street onSaturdays. Love it all. Another great experience with AirB&B for me.

We had a lovely stay at Fitzgeorge.  Check in was smooth and very easy and Katrina touched based with us to make sure we checked in and that everything was ok on arrival.  Fitzroy is a great area to stay as it is less than a 25min walk into the CBD (and Rod Laver arena!) and lots of great restaurants and shops to keep you busy just within walking distance of the Fitzgeorge laneway.  Thanks for a great stay.

Appartment comfortable and clean.
Disappointed that single bed in same bedroom as double,hadn't realized that this was how house set up.
Katrina’s house is stylish and warm. It is very clean and is comfortable staying in her place.
Katrina’s place was perfect in every way. The accommodation met all my expectations plus it was close to a wonderful breakfast and lunch spot.  I could not have asked for more!

Fitzgeorge is a wonderful property, cleverly designed, creatively furnished and delightful to stay in. We loved the location, in the heart of fabulous, fashionable Fitzroy, while being close enough to the city to be able to walk, though it’s well served by tram too. We found the garden dining space to be a great resource. It reminded us too of how quiet and private the space is. A wonderful house that we loved and enjoyed enormously. We’d be back like a shot!
This is very well appointed and cosy place. The host went to a lot of effort to make this stay perfect.

From the moment of first contact, Katrina was an easy, kind and clear person to deal with. She responded quickly and was able to adapt to my needs for an extended stay for my two daughters. They both loved the house, it was in an excellent location and close to everything they needed - shopping and parks in particular. The words they gave me to describe the house were comfortable, easily accessible, well kitted out with everything you need, cosy, a perfect location, clean, light filled and homely. I could not be more thrilled with my choice. Everything was great. Thankyou Katrina from the three of us.

This was a lovely apartment and in a fantastic location. We enjoyed our stay and very pleased with the amenities. The courtyard was lovely and the beds were comfortable. There was even thoughtful mince pies on our arrival. Katrina was very quick to respond to my messages and catered to my check in/check out needs which was a huge help with small children. It felt like a home away from home. With a comfortable cot and great high chair for my baby.

I could live at Katrina’s house. It’s in the BEST location. Great food everywhere, easy access to everything. The house is groovy and well decorated. The beds are comfy and there is everything you could need. I loved the courtyard. It was beautiful to sit out there in the morning and read the paper in the sun. Katrina is friendly and responds quickly to queries. I would definitely recommend this property, and I shall certainly be back!
A lovely property in a fantastic spot. Our host was responsive, accommodating and overall very helpful. I wouldn’t hesitate to return.

Wonderful location for a weekend getaway.  Easy to access cafes, shops and parks in Fitzroy. The place was clean, and comfortable, and loved having the courtyard  Katrina was very easy to communicate with.

Katrinas place was lovely,
we enjoyed the location especially as we could walk into the city in 15 minutes. We enjoyed so many yummy restaurants in Fitzroy.
The location was very peaceful.
Beds were comfortable and kitchen was well equipped.
courtyard was lovely.

We had a wonderful stay at Fitzroy. A lovely home away from home, minutes from all the best shops and eateries Melbourne has to offer. We appreciated off-street parking and parking permit - thanks for a great stay.
We had a great time at Katrina’s place, matched the photos, spacious and comfortable and Katrina was a great host and immediately fixed a small problem for us. We’ll definitely return!

We had a great stay at Fitzgeorge. Well presented, clean and well equipped. Great location with an abundance of cafes/ restaurants/ shopping just around the corner.
Katrina was a brilliant host and went above and beyond to accomodate for our baby and made sure we were as comfortable as possible.
Tight street and garage but doable in a medium size SUV.

Great place for our family of four - comfortable, and enough space to relax in between adventures.
Close to everything we needed (awesome food!)

The place is spacious and clean. Tram stop just down the street. Plenty of restaurant and shops nearby.
Katrina is very friendly, helpful and responsive. Definitely recommended!

Katrina communicated well with us during our reservation and stay.
The residence was wonderful to stay in, clean & warm.
An excellent experience

What a fab place! Hadn't stayed in Fitzroy before and this was the perfect place to explore the area, with its excellent restaurants, cafes and bars. The house is small but has everything you need (excellently provisioned kitchen); beds were very comfortable; cosy and comfortable sitting room looking onto a little backyard. Katrina was a responsive host and it was easy to get in and around from her instructions. All in all a great place to stay in Melbourne and I think we'll definitely return one day.

This is a great little place and Katrina is a very helpful and responsive host. There’s a tram at the end of the lane that goes directly into the CBD and some good restaurants around the corner. We enjoyed our stay there.

Hi Kim,
Thank you very much! My dear friends Dan & Saa really loved their stay in Melbourne. They watched Bruce Springsteen Live. They are so happy with your apartment. The location was ideal. Their words exactly"You walk out the front door of the building and everything is so close. They found the apartment so clean, modern, and just how it is in the picture on the airbnb site. they highly recommend it. As my experience with you as a host you're fantastic. You kept in touch with me all the time and even to all lengths to swing by the apartment to see if my friends got in okay. That's so great. You blew me away on how quick you responded to my emails. Once again, thank you so much.
Ps: Dan & Saa ate and had drinks at "San Telmo". They highly recommend this place.
Regards, Jinky

Wow. We loved the spacious,comfortable apartment. It was home away from home for the next 11 nights. Lots of little surprises, as it was so well equipped. Good TV and wifi available. It was secure,quiet and with a view. The location is perfect, handy to the trains, with the tram stop outside. It made it so easy to get around, with us topping up our Myki card on a regular basis.
It was our first time with airbnb, and it proved to be an easy, professional exercise with Kim, who kept in touch with us all throughout the booking, right to the end of our stay. Nothing was too much trouble. The whole package is generous and reflects Kim's integrity. I would have no hesitation in recommending this apartment, and intend to rebook for next year.
But I do have a hesitation in sharing this information! (In case we miss out!) Cheers

Our stay at Kim's apartment was like a home away from home.  Although we never met Kim she was great host and provided detailed instructions for check-in.  We loved the apartment!  The location was perfect for exploring the city.  The apartment is in the heart of Melbourne, close to all transportation, wonderful shopping and great cafes and restaurants.  The bed was low to the ground but comfortable, the shower hot, and the kitchen contained all necessary equipment; although with all the great restaurants and cafes nearby it was hardly used!!  During our extended stay we did not get a change of bed linens which we think should have been available. The washer/dryer combination unit was very small and one load took a long time to wash and even longer to dry so we had to take our clothes to a laundromat.  Other than that the apartment  was comfortable and quiet.

we have been positively impressed . we had a good communication by phone and text . Kim was there for us !
she even got out of the way to post us a forgotten make up purse !

would like to go back to this place again !

christian ION and family

Beautiful apartment suited for anyone wanting to experience Melbourne city life. Convenient and walking distance to all major attractions. Everything required for the trip was provided for and Kim was a very accomodating host. Highly recommended.

Kim is a great host, she made the access to the apartment very easy and even assisted us with our late arrival. The apartment clean and well appointed. It has a great location in the heart of the CBD, it is just right next to Swanston Street where all the restaurants are. The apartment is cosy and a right size for a family of 3. Moreover, there is free internet too!

Kim was an excellent host, quick to respond and help in any way possible.  The apartment was exactly as described, comfy beds and suitable for our small family. Our young daughters were comfortable on the sofa bed and we had a great holiday! Would definitely recommend this apartment!  Thanks again Kim

The apartment was very well and centrally located which was convenient for exploring the downtown  area. Easy access to everything and Kim was responsive to our enquiries. It was bright, clean and airy and the space works well for a couple. Just a few  suggestions a) installation of more hand/bath towel hooks in the bathroom b) the mailbox/key safe in the lobby is incredibly difficult to operate and too dark to see the numbers (for entering code)....we needed help from the building's maintenance team to open / close it (with a torchlight too) and c) the lock for the sliding window / door to the balcony needs replacing/repairing; there was no apparent lock

Kim was very quick in responding to any messages sent regarding the penthouse prior to our stay. She was very helpful and all instructions were explained clearly. The penthouse on Collins & Elizabeth Street had the perfect location. We were able to walk almost everywhere due to it's central location. The space in the room was enough for two of my friends and I. One suggestion is having another mirror which is not in the bathroom! Overall we had a great stay and would definitely stay again!

The apartment was great. Elegant, comfortable and homey. It was unfortunate though that the air conditioning broke down just before our stay and it was really hot those few nights. Kim did however make the effort to get us an air cooler from another flat of hers. Kim herself was a friendly host who gets back to you and your messages. It would have been the perfect stay if not for the aircon breakdown.
Kim was super friendly and she's super quick with responding, the location is amazing and the apartment was crazy clean!
Absolutely wonderful for my business trip to Melbourne. Comfortable clean and safe. Kim was super easy to work with and made everything so easy. The place had literally everything I needed.

Kim place is the perfect place to stay in the city! Close to all the great shops and cafes you will not be disappointed with your stay at this beautiful penthouse apartment. Kim is very responsive and was able to answer any questions I had since it was my first time in Melbourne. Looking forward to booking this place again on my next holiday here!
Fantastic place to stay in Melbourne CBD. All comforts of home in an amazing location. Would recommend Kim and this place for sure! Great responsive and knowledgeable host!

We loved Wendy's apartment - it is indeed superb and the views over the water, particularly at sunset, are incredible. It is a wonderfully situated apartment, across the road from the beach, within easy walking distance from shops and restaurants and a tram stop outside the door for those wishing to travel further afield. We four adults enjoyed the attention to detail in this light, airy and roomy apartment and were very comfortable and content during our six night stay.
We highly recommend this apartment.

Wendy and team were great hosts. They made us all (2 adults with 2 teenage children ) feel very welcome. They went out of their way to make sure we had a good stay- we really appreciated this. The apartment is amazing. It is beautifully presented with lots of character. It has a modern kitchen and 3 modern bathrooms. The view is spectacular- the photos on the website can't do it justice. If you like St Kilda (as we do), you won't find a better location.

My daughter enjoyed looking after Lucy the cat- we miss her now we are home.

Bottom line- we loved it!!

I cannot speak highly enough of Wendy, the apartment, the location and Lucy the cat! The whole experience was better than I could have imagined. Walking distance to everything, fantastic food nearby, breathtaking view, spotlessly clean, everything was perfect. Wendy was so welcoming and great at communicating. You wont want to go home...we didnt!

Wendy’s penthouse apartment is amazing. Very spacious with all the amenities anyone could need. Location is brilliant right by the seafront and tram to get into town. The balcony offers superb views, particularly for sunset. Communication was excellent. Highly recommend.

Likely the best place I have rented. Beautiful, spacious and bright space. Fully equipped. Wonderful and thoughtful hosts. We felt we were staying at a friend’s. The outdoor patios and views are a huge bonus. Great neighbourhood to walk around and steps from the waterfront. Top floor, so a few stairs to get there but it only adds to your views!

Had a great stay at Wendy’s place! So much space for 4 people, it was great. The view from the balcony is beautiful, so highly recommend being around at sunset. A perfect stay if spending time in St Kilda!

We were so comfortable in this lovely
home and neighborhood.
Besides our private bathroom and bedroom,
we were given access to the kitchen, living
room, laundry, and outdoor patios.
Magda was very thoughtful and gracious.
We completely enjoyed our time there, and
now miss her and her sweet poodle Ike!

The flat was fantastic. Easy to get in even though Nicole (owner) was not around at the time. Perfect location for seeing all of Melbourne, with a tram stop literally outside the door into town and directly opposite the MCG, good for AFL and cricket. Lovely parks around for walking and jogging. The flat was very comfortable and warm, everything you need for a long or short stay.

Nicole's apartment on Wellington Parade is perfect for couples visiting Melbourne for restaurants and bars and any sports fans visiting the MCG and surrounding venues.
The apartment is very stylish and the sliding windows in the living room are amazing and would be perfect for a bottle of wine and a movie over summer! Overall, the apartment is modern and has all the facilities required for any travellers. It also has great little cafes for breakfast literally next door and is also a short walk or even shorter cab to many more great bars and restaurants in the CBD and Southbank area.
Nicole is also extremely friendly, quick to respond and will happily recommend you on any 'must visits' whilst you are in Melbourne.
Would highly recommend Nicole and this property to anyone visiting Melbourne in the future!

Nicole was just a breeze to deal with!! she was just lovely and very helpful and accommodating, the apartment was just what we needed and the location was just fabulous!!! there are great restaurant's on wellington parade so we didn't have to go far for good food!!
I was extremely happy and couldn't of hoped for an easier host with a great apartment and fantastic location!!! thanks so much Nicole!!

Light and airy apartment big enough for our family of four. Perfect location in a quiet neighbourhood but close to everything. Tram or train into CBD and sporting/concert venues within walking distance.
It's a shame we didn't get to meet Nicole but keys were easy to find.

We stayed four nights in Melbourne and absolutely loved the unit! Great location! Two great cafes downstairs for breakfast and lunch. The unit is modern and nicely furnished. Loved having a sauna and a pool! Can highly recommend this place!

Nicole was a lovely host. She was extremely communicative, responsive and helpful. Especially appreciate the tips and notes on the places around the apartment to shop, eat and see. Also, it was great to have a bunch of tourist guides for us to refer to in the apartment.

The apartment was perfectly located for us - we were in Melbourne for a cricket match at the MCG! The area was nice and felt safe. Melbourne CBD is walking distance and there was public transport available literally at the doorstep. Overall a very pleasnt experience and would definately recommend.

All in all a good first-time airbnb experience for us on a weekend when all hotels nearby were full or very expensive. I had quite a few questions leading up to check-in, and Nicole was always prompt and courteous with her communication. The location is brilliant, with good proximity to the CBD and sporting precinct, while also being in a relatively quiet neighbourhood. There were easy public transport options on the doorstep, and we didn't have any issues parking the car with the available permit. The apartment itself is a good size for the price, and having a washer and dryer available also proved very handy when travelling with small children.
Nicole was a friendly, helpful and responsive host. The apartment is in a convenient location next to Fitzroy gardens on the edge of the city and was a great place to stay. Cheers!

Nicole's apartment was perfectly positioned for sports lovers wishing to attend events at the MCG. It is virtually right across the road from the stadium and has easy access to trams and trains. Our family of four found the apartment to be cosy and well equipped. The bi-fold windows in the lounge open to a gorgeous view and let in an abundance of light. There is a Seven 11 nearby, as well restaurants for those who don't wish to cook. Has all the mod cons of a hotel, with a bit more character!

A lovely apartment and really comfortable beds. We were there for Melbourne footy weekend and it is 5 mins walk from MCG. Only 10-15 mins walk to CBD or tram and train station at front door. Nicole was great. Gave us a late checkout to assist us on departure date and good communication prior to stay. All in all a great stay. Highly recommended.

Nicole was a great host! She was readily available to offer us her assistance when we could not locate the apartment. The apartment was located in a convenient location with all amenities within walking distance. Her place was gorgeous with everything we needed! Overall  we love the apartment and would definitely recommend to everyone visiting the area.
The apartment was as described and in a great location. Very new looking apartment with new amenities. Host was very helpful and accommodating and flexible.
Nicole was very easy to deal with and the apartment was well positioned and very comfortable. The view was lovely and the cushions plentiful!

Great apartment in a really convenient location with the tram and train station right across the street. Nicole was an excellent host, very accommodating when we wanted to stay another night with a late checkout. I recommend this apartment to anyone that wants to be close to the city at an affordable price. Would stay here again next time I visit Melbourne.

Nicole contacted us a week out to make sure everything was in order and that all we had organised was correct.  She provided information on the location and other minor enquiries about the region.  Thoroughly organised host, clean well set up apartment in great location transportwise. It meet all our needs for the weekend.

We had a great time at Nicole's. The flat was tidy and very well equipped. Beds were very comfortable and the kitchen very convenient. It is very well located, with a tram stop just in front of the main door. The neighbourhood is very calm, quiet and safe (even too quiet for our taste!). We didn't get to meet Nicole, but she was fast and very responsive messaging, she took good care of us. We had a great stay! Thx Nicole :)

Our stay at Nicole's apartment in Melbourne was great. Firstly the location is very good - a 5-10 minute walk across the road to the MCG, with both tram and train stations outside the apartment enabling easy access to the CBD. Nicole has everything covered - the stay was as we expected (very good) and all the information we needed for the weekend was provided to us in advance. The apartment itself is clean, modern and can accommodate 4 people with ease for an inner city apartment.
Would recommend.
The apartment was neat and tidy and in a fantastic location. Nicole had left a very detailed  information about the apartment and all the places we coukd visit locally to get our everyday items.

The unit is in a quiet location 10 min drive from the CBD.

If you're looking for a place to stay in St Kilda you can't go wrong with this one.

Terrific stay. Interesting and welcoming hosts. A bright, airy room, cleverly designed. Private. Well located for my needs. Others have mentioned the proximity to the train;for my wife and me, that was not a problem in the slightest.

Great facilities, well kept and extremely comfortable on a cold Melbourne night. The hosts (and their children) made me feel welcome. Wonderful attention to detail and the extra's of having fresh milk and tea/coffee and breakfast cereals are fabulous. Definitely worth the visit.

Shane was an excellent host, flexible with check in and check out times, and very friendly and welcoming. His recommendation for the nearby Beach Cafe was greatly appreciated, and I'd highly recommend stopping by if you're looking for brunch with a view!

The room itself was exceptionally clean and well presented. The bed and pillows were very comfortable, and the room was warm and cosy thanks to a great heater.

Our expectations were definitely exceeded, and I would not hesitate to stay here again.

Wonderful to stay with Shane and Nuan once again.  This is a great location for my visits to the area and I feel very at home and cared for as a guest.  The room is fantastic with everything you need and a very comfy bed.  Looking forward to when I stay again.  Booking and communication is first class and easy.

We spent such a lovely time in Seaford in this very cosy room! Everything was lovely prepared, it was very clean and tidy and very practical (microwaven, cattle, plates, fridge, things for breakfast, ...)!!
Shane and his family are VERY friendly and kind! THANK YOU FOR EVERYTHING!!
Janine and Regula

Absolutely breathtaking views of the beach, and everything was just so prefect about this trip. 5 to 6 mins to restaurants and Woolworths 5 mins to seaford station. The best host ever! Showing me the best way to go around, telling me all the useful information. I absolutely recommend this house for everybody.

The room is exactly as pictured. The room was clean and welcoming! The extra touches such as water/breakfast supplies/ shower products were thoughtful.
Shaun and Nuan were easy to contact and very flexible with arrival times (makes life easy when travelling).
We weren't aware of the railway nearby.. If you are a light sleeper, i highly recommend ear plugs.

Have a great stay at Shane & Nuan cosy house even though is only for one night. We booked their place on the day itself and Shane responded very fast. Communication was fast and easy. Upon check in, Shane gave us a tour around the house and introduced the area to us. There's also a guide book where you can get more information on things to see and do. The house is actually what you see in the picture clean and tidy. As for the train, it didn't really disturbed us even though we are light sleeper. I guess the bed is too comfortable;> Will definitely recommend to everyone.
We really enjoyed staying at Shane and Nuans' place. They were very welcoming and the place itself was clean and nicely furnished. We would definitely recommend staying here!

Literally a 5 min stroll to the beach and woollies, train noise did not affect us at all, the fan worked just as fine as an aircon and room was impeccably clean. The hosts were great and their young daughter also! Would definitely come back

What a wonderful use of spare space.This was our best experience yet,We were very happy with the open space,beautiful new bathroom.You walked in and there was everything you would need for a very comfortable stay.Loved the Mini bar idea Faboulos! everything was very thought out,Cereal 3 varieties, milk,juice,coffee, tea,sugar all provided.Bed was so comfortable we slept in,Shane &Nuan were very welcoming friendly Hosts,would absoulty without a doubt recommenced this beautifully presented place to stay.
Shane and Nuan were so easy to communicate with & flexible with the check in time.  If you’re not used to the Melbourne weather don’t worry the lovely heater provides so much warmth 😊
Shane and Nuan are very friendly and welcoming hosts! Handy location for the beach at Seaford or trains in to Melbourne

Lovely room and very comfortable bed. Excellent experience and hospitable hosts.
Would definitely stay again. Thank you.

Comfortable room in Seaford. It was very private, which was what I needed as I was in town for work. Very clean and close to shops and beach. If you’re a light sleeper though, I do recommend earplugs as the train station is close by and quite loud. Thanks for a great stay!

The original purpose of our stay was to bring us closer to my daughters’ dance competition. However, it soon became a girls’ weekend by making the most of our location. We were able to check out Seaford and surrounds and know that when we bunkered down for sleep we were in a secure and cosy spot that had all the comforts of home. Our hosts made sure we settled in and made us feel welcome. We will look to return at the next opportunity.

Shane & Nuan's place was perfect for our one night stay in Seaford. The room is perfect with it's own entrance, a small little kitchenette, and it's own bathroom. Everything you need for a weekend away. Very close to the supermarket. Definitely recommend staying here if in Seaford or Frankston for the weekend.
Nice room, with a great balcony. Very clean. Perfect to stay the night or a couple of days, nice to watch a movie before sleeping. Everything as advertised, and great price.

Great stay! Unfortunately we could only stay 1 night but I’m glad we did. We were greeted as we pulled up and were shown around the rental. We went to the nearby RSL (as recommended) for a great dinner, walked along the beach and got ice cream down the road. Was truly a great night. DVDs available for us to watch at night and cereal and coffee provided for breakfast! Even got us soy milk as requested which was much appreciated. Thanks guys!

We received a warm greeting and introduction to our room which was scrupulously clean. It included lots of thoughtful extras that just made it feel homey and inviting. lovely modern decor and a very comfortable bed. We were on a work trip so a good night's sleep was very important and that's just what we got. Thank you Shane and Nuan
This was a great comfy place to stay woth a very helpful and nice host . All in all a very enjoyable experience...

I had a great stay at Shane & Nuan’s place. It was very quiet- even despite the nearby passing trains which didn’t bother me at all. The room is like an upstairs bungalow with a nice little balcony. Totally private access. It was very clean and I had everything I needed. 5 minute walk to the beach. My only complaint was that I struggle in heat a little, and as it was a hot night above 30 degrees the room became quite warm. The ceiling fan provided some airflow but a little split system air con would make this the perfect place to stay, especially for those that are sensitive to the heat. Still it’s much better value for money than staying at any of the nearby hotels/motels. Thanks for an easy and comfortable stay!
The room had no windows or air con, it got very stuffy with just the fan. It was noisy at night.

Blitz Clean, great location down the coast just 1hr away from Melbourne and with everything close by: beach and supermarket 6min walking distance, quiet and really comfortable this little nook is the perfect get away for just a couple of days away from the city, to clear the mind or for anyone visiting the atea. Shane and Nuan are winderful hosts whom will warmingly welcome you and yet also give you plenty of personal space. I would recommend Nuan’s place to absolutely anyone looking for an affordable but luxurious stay in Seaford. I can’t wait to go back myself. Thank you so much! Xxx
Lovely little room and fantastic location! The beach is a short walk as well as shops and restaurants. Was a great break from the city and Shaun and Nuan were awesome hosts ☺️

A quaint little studio apartment in an excellent position with cute little touches added to make it feel just like home. Shane & Nuan were so accomodating and their place is a delight. Highly recommended should you be looking in the area.

I stayed at Shane & Nuan's place for 3 days and it has been the greatest Airbnb place that I have visited.
