Would definitely stay here again and recommend it to friends - excellent value for such a central location in Melbourne. I found the hosts to be super responsive and the access instructions were very clear and they provided photos to make it completely foolproof.

This property is right in the heart of the city. Great eats and amazing atmosphere at your door. Great space to rest after a big day of tennis and shopping. We love staying at Tom + Susanna's. Will be back again in May.

My family (4 adults) had a brilliant week at Tom and Susanna's quirky, eclectic two bedroom art deco apartment right on Degraves St. We were within easy walking distance to multiple restaurants ranging from street food to high end cuisine and 50m to the tram to take us directly to the tennis. We had a great time and can't wait to go back.

Clean comfortable apartment in a fantastic location within easy walking distance of restaurants and all the popular laneways .
Would definitely recommend and stay there again
Our stay was amazing! The Melinda's place is  wonderful, perfect place to disconnect and be in peace. Everything you need for a quiet weekend you will find in this place. We hope to return soon :)

Great views, plenty of rooms.
Smooth process.
Bring a speaker if you want to play music, old school electric stovetop, and the oven seems to only go to 120c. Lucky the BBQ is great, and in a lovely spot.

Great place for wkend break. Serene and peaceful. Would be perfect if there are more bathroom. One for 5 bedrooms seems underplanned.
Decent value for money, but good for big groups. Views from living deck are green and serene, cannot really view the distant lake and the supposedly unblocked sunrise.
Apartment is near to station. Walking distance to the shopping mall and all. It will be perfect if everything is clean, rubbish are clear. Else everything is good
Everything you need is within walking distance. The Apartment is quite clean, the cereal and milk was very nice touch. Checkin was smooth.

I stayed here on a work trip. Everything was really convenient as the local supermarkets, train station, tram stops are within a few minutes walk. The place was clean and provisions were as described in the profile.
The place was pretty clean and they have provided everything that you would generally need. There is complete privacy and no noisy neighbours. Will definitely recommend this place.

Our stay at this location was great, the host was super responsive and helpful. The location was perfect for people wanting to utilise public transport to get around, close to lots of restaurants. Would recommend to anyone wanting somewhere to stay while exploring the city.

This was an excellent property to stay at. The location is amazing. Right across the road from the station and central to everything you need. Any questions I had were answered quickly by the host and they were very helpful.
Property was very clean and safe and I really could not recommend it enough if you are staying in Melbourne.
UWS is responsif host…good  location, the apartement near the station and many restaurant..thank you UWS for great hospitality

We had a wonderful stay! The host was incredibly friendly and supportive, always ready to help with anything we needed. Check-in was very flexible, which made our trip stress-free. The place was spotless, well-connected to public transport and attractions, and the furniture was comfortable and in great condition. We truly appreciated the warm hospitality and would happily stay again!

The hosts were wonderful and we felt very welcomed at their place. It was a really comfortable stay and it is an exciting experience to stay in the middle of a cherry field and wake up to be surrounded by the stunning view. The rooms were very nicely furnished and the kitchen was fully functional as well. I love the furnishing of the bathroom the most and there is even an oven and microwave (seldom see these in other Airbnb). We'd love to visit again in near future and we are thankful for such a good stay.

Amazing host! Brigitte was more welcoming than any guest can expect. she contacted me prior to the booking with all the details I needed for my bookig and how to find the property. The house was immaculate, and very well presented.  Ot had all the creature comforts you would want, and lovely addition touches such as homemade biscuits. Brigitte also knew we were celebrating birthdays, so made birthday cupcakes for us both. We could not have had a better time. Really looking forward to staying with Brigitte and John again.

A faultless stay at a very beautiful location. Brigette and John warmly welcomed us, and have made this cosy cabin feel like a home away from home. The setting makes for the perfect Yarra Valley experience, surrounded by rolling hills and beautiful orchids and within reach of all the best vineyards. The cabin is well thought out, and is equipped with everything you might need, with beautiful touches throughout. We wished we could have stayed another night and highly recommend this spot if you are looking for a get away in this beautiful part of the world.
Exceeded our expections, went above and beyond for us. A stunning cabin in a fantastic location. So friendly and kind and the home baked treats were wonderful. Thank you so much!
Brigitte's cottage is superb and the extra treats such as scones, cakes, truffles and fruit were delicious. Look forward to returning.

this cabin is in a beautiful, peaceful setting. It is cosy and spotlessly clean. It is exceedingly well equipped and the special treats awaiting when you arrive are delicious and unexpected. The hosts are warm and welcoming, enthusiastic and wonderful - we will visit again

As our first ever airbnb experience  ...our  stay in Brigitte's cottage at Cherry Boys surpassed all expectations . Not only was the location ideal-  but John and Brigitte were the most welcoming hosts . We highly recommend a stay- and we  will certainly be back ! Thank you so much Brigitte and John for such a memorable visit

Brigitte and John, We can't thank you enough for our stay!  Beautiful place, beautiful views and beautiful hosts.  Your amazing hospitality was very much appreciated.  The thoughtful touches - scones, fresh milk and cream, chocolate cake to name only a few - was unexpected, yet also appreciated.  We are already looking forward to our next stay with you.  Thank you again, Deb & Stu

We have stayed in many Air bnb & we would have to say it was the best experiences. From the first messages of hi & welcome, the personalised notes on our arrival, to the final photo of us in the air, you made us feel ever so welcome. You can definitely tell this little gem you have created is your baby. You thought of everything anyone could want  on a night away from home. The place felt clean, fresh & very well appointed. You should be extremely proud of what you can offer others with your slice of heaven up in the hill. We would love to return one day, not only for the peaceful getway but also to see you again. THANK YOU from the bottom our hearts.

This could be the best airbnb stay you'll ever have.
Brigitte and John are excellent hosts, providing everything as described in the listing and going above and beyond - assisting with things to do in the area, baking numerous treats for you, providing fresh fruit and pantry staples and generally being very helpful and attentive hosts. The cabin is nicely set up for families, with games, books and dvd's for the kids. The heater works well and the place is nice and cosy. Exceptionally clean and organised. 5 stars.
We will be back.
Lovely clean modern accomodation, very comfortable bed, nice welcome treats and a spectacular view! Brigitte and John were great hosts, and we would happily recommend the Cherry Orchard Cabin.

The cottage has a tasteful decor, super clean and tidy, generous treat from local produce to very delicious homemade sweets and cake.
Brigitte seems like a person who enjoys fine things and loves sharing it too.
We were at the cottage when the cherry season ended so we could walk around the farm to soak up morning sun or sit outside at sunset with mountain view in the foreground.
Brigitte and her friendly family are very responsive to your request to make our stay as pleasant as possible.
Thank you again for making our stay a memorable one.

Absolutely breathtaking! My girlfriends and I stayed at Brigitte and John’s farm for 2 nights as a girls getaway and we were just blown away, not only by the views and the serenity but by the lovely hosts themselves. The cabin had everything we needed! And with some beautiful little personal touches we felt right at home. Very easy to get around, we ordered Uber’s from the cabin to different wineries and didn’t have any issues, very easy to get to the local Woolies or Aldi. I cannot fault our stay, we didn’t want to leave! We will definitely be making this our annual getaway and won’t stay anywhere else! Thank you again Brigitte & John.

We absolutely loved our stay Cherry Orchard Cabin. Brigitte is an incredible host. Very prompt and smooth communication, such a warm welcome checking in and thoughtful touches all throughout the cabin.
Fresh figs from the farm and homemade cakes for us to enjoy during our stay, were so thoughtful!
The location is great, 5mins from cafes & supermarkets but so peaceful you’d think you were hours from anywhere.
Perfect for our family escape from the city. Really can’t speak more highly of our stay.
We will 100% be back to visit Brigitte & John!

We had a great weekend at Brigitte's cabin, it is in a stunning location with beautiful views and easy access by car to many Yarra Valley attractions. Brigitte made us feel like part of the family with her welcoming presence. The little goodies she made were delicious and we greatly appreciated all the thought she put in to making our stay stellar.

Brigitte puts "super" into super host. Brigitte and John welcomed us on arrival, ensured our stay was perfect, and made sure everything was okay during our stay. The cabin is sparkling clean, and Brigitte and John put in great touches like, eggs, milk, honey, granola, fruit etc. to make your stay special. Communication was quick and easy too.
The cabin is at the southern end of the Yarra Valley, and you will need a car to get places, but nothing is more than 30 minutes away. The cabin is warm and cosy in winter too.
While there is internet, the local internet was pretty slow, but this is beyond Brigitte and John's control.
You won't go wrong staying with Brigitte and John. I highly recommend you do.

We had a really lovely stay at the Cherry Orchard cabin located on the Cherry Boys farm and would recommend it for a quiet, country stay. The beautiful views from the front windows are rolling hills, the location is peaceful and picturesque. The cabin is very well equipt, had everything we needed and more, good heating, comfy beds, and lovely toiletries.
Hosts, Brigitte and Jon were very friendly and welcoming, the cabin was spotless when we arrived, and they even left us a range of home baked treats and fresh produce!
This accommodation is more than I expected.
Thanks Brigitte and Jon, I’ve no doubt we’ll be back!
Brigitte and John are wonderful! The property is surrounded by breathtaking hills and the rooms are beautifully set up so touchingly. We will be definitely coming back.

Wow wow wow, I would give this place 6 stars if that were possible. I regularly stay in Airbnb’s but Brigitte and John’s place has been the best place I have ever stayed in. They have gone above and beyond to provide their guests with an amazing experience. Not only are they the most lovely people, but small touches such as a homemade chocolate cake, fresh milk and oranges from their garden made it so personal. The place was sparkling clean, cozy, bed was super comfy, the kitchen had all amenities. Would 110% recommend staying here. Thanks so much again Brigitte and John!

There is a reason that Brigitte and John have such stellar reviews for their cabin! It was everything you could possibly hope for and then some - a truely gorgeous location, surrounded by great places to eat and visit, two of the most kind and genuine hosts I've had the pleasure of meeting and even a few kangaroos hopping away in the background. We had a wonderful time there and begun planning our next visit before we even left. A truely special place!

Thank you Brigitte and John for your warmth and hospitality. The cottage was pristine, the location spectacular, and excellent communication. We will definitely be recommending the cottage to our friends.

The cherry orchard cabin was amazing, clean, and homely. The fine touches of home-baked cake, snacks/fruits, towels and welcome note added to the warm hospitality that Brigitte and John provided. We felt at home.
When we arrived, the baby cot was already set up! And they were there to welcome and show us around. A real superhost indeed!
All in all, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay there and will definitely stay with them again when we visit Yarra Valley in the future.

This is as good as I can imagine any B & B could be. It had the comfort. It had the views and the magnificent setting and it had the best hosts. The Yarra Valley provided great places to visit, but staying in was just as enjoyable.

I just want to say a huge thank you to Brigitte and John for the unforgettable and authentic farm stay we had at there beautiful Cherry orchard.
I could not of picked a better place and with better people.
Brigitte made my partner the yummiest cake for his 30th birthday! She also made sourdough bread and lots of other delicious home made treats. My 5 year old son love it, and she gifted him a take home art activity. The cabin was so clean and well presented. They thought of everything to make the stay homie and welcoming.
We can’t wait to come visit again.
Lots of love
Juandri, Eugene and Hunter.

Brigitte and John were wonderful hosts and went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Our kids booked in a one night stay here for us and Brigitte made lovely scones and a heart-shaped cake especially personalised for our anniversary.
The views and surroundings are beautiful at the cabin and you are surrounded by nature and native animals.
The space is clean and well maintained and we loved all the personalised touches.
My first stay was great that I returned a second. Super clean, comfy and an exceptional host Brigitte!

Bridgette and John were the most warm and thoughtful hosts we have had the please of meeting in our travels. Bridgette has thought of everything to include to help make your stay special including many special little treats. The cabin is very comfortable and clean and the views are gorgeous. It was exactly what we were looking for to relax and enjoy the beautiful area. We have a 3 year old and a 6 year old and they loved Bridgette and John just as much as we did. If we are lucky enough to get back to the area we would love to stay again.

From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, both John and Brigitte were extremely welcoming! The stunning views, quiet and relaxing space was the perfect home away from home. On top of all this Brigitte and John added in personal touches specific to myself and my guests which really set this bnb aside from all other places I’ve stayed at! We’re extremely happy with our stay at this home 😊🥰

Cherry Orchard Cabin B&B deserves more than 5 stars! Many thanks to Brigitte and John for putting their hearts and souls into making the place so wonderful during our stay. We will be back next winter for another cherry season and be sure to stay at Cherry Orchard Cabin once again!

Dear Brigitte and John,
It was so great to stay at your cabin. The location was amazing, so picturesque, and it was such a serene getaway for us! The cabin was very tidy, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed for our comfortable stay. Our toddler loved the books, toys and mostly wanted to stay outdoors exploring your beautiful farm. You are great hosts, so warm and welcoming, and the homemade goodies were such a surprise treat with the personalized note. You were so approachable, and guided us with all that we needed. We had a great stay, and would love to be back! We would highly recommend this wonderful cabin! And the stop to the Farmers market on the way back was the perfect cherry on the cake to end a fun weekend getaway! Thank you for the recommendations!
Brigitte and John were incredibly friendly hosts. The cabin was comfortable, clean and I would highly recommend staying here.

Cabin is beautifully furnished, super clean & the location is stunning. Set on top of the hill amongst the cherry & fig orchards.
The kitchen is filled with delicious home made goodies that just made you feel so welcome.
Hosts are friendly and go above and beyond expectations to make your stay a memorable one. It’s definitely the place to choose in Wandin. Just gorgeous!!!

We had a delightful stay at the Cherry Boys. The breathtaking surroundings and charming decor made us feel right at home, and the fireplace added to the cozy atmosphere. We spotted wallabies and hot air balloons, which added to the magical experience. Brigitte and John, our hosts, were  warm and accommodating, making our stay even more enjoyable. Highly recommended for a relaxing and memorable getaway.

Lovely place & host. Definitely beyond our expectation. We booked the stay but our plans were disrupted & thought it would be a wasted trip up Wandin. However, just the stay itself saved the trip. The warm hospitality we received was by far the best among all Airbnbs we have came across. We are so glad we met Brigitte & John. They were really nice & friendly. Replies were almost instantaneous. The design of the accommodation was also very thoughtful that even my kids love it. Hope we will be able to come back again! ❤️

Thank you Brigitte and John for a wonderful and relaxing holiday. We truly appreciate your hospitality. Loved the cabin and enjoyed the walk around the property.
We’ll definitely be seeing you again💜

Brigitte and John were very welcoming. Their Cheery Farm is picturesque and the cottage is cosy, quiet and inviting.
We had a lovely stay.

We had such a beautiful stay at cherry cottage, the hosts were beyond lovely. They gave us such a warm welcome that made us instantly feel comfortable and at home for the duration of our stay. The hosts went the extra mile and baked us some fresh goods which were delicious. The cottage smelt absolutely gorgeous and fresh. The linen was beautiful and soft and styled beautifully, it felt Luxurious. The bathroom was clean and neat. The kitchen is well equipped with all the essentials. The tv is easy to use no need to connect your phone or anything fiddly. The heating was perfect and kept us cozy and warm during the cold weather. The farm itself is picturesque, peaceful and tranquil. The location is close to everything you need, a short drive to all of the main attraction of the Yarra valley.
We honestly felt like we were staying with family and will definitely be back again. Thanks again xx
this was our 2nd stay and it did not disappoint.   Lovely greeting from Brigitte and John, very comfortable accommodation    Thoroughly recommend

Exceptional host, memorable experience for our family! Brigitte and John went out of their way for us, from getting us onto the Puffing Billy when our ride got cancelled, to sharing their fresh picked fruits in their beautiful farm, homemade goodiessss and inviting us into their beautiful home to see Kobi. The cabin itself was spotlessly clean, very comfortable beds, kitchen was so well equipped even pampering us with lots of coffee capsules, fresh berries, assortment of tea.
Brigitte and John welcomed us into their farm on Christmas Day, with presents waiting in the cabin! So generous, so thoughtful and it was a trip to remember for our family. We even had cookies and fruitcake to bring home, it was really our good fortune to have met Brigitte and John’s family. Baby Luca was really adorable and the whole family was so friendly ❤️

The perfect base for exploring the Yarra Valley, Dandenong Ranges, and Puffing Billy.
The cabin was spotless, comfortable, and well-equipped, but it was the little touches that made our stay so special—like a delicious home-baked cake, honey cookies (so good!), fresh figs (delicious!), lemons, passionfruit, and even toddler toys for our 2 year old!
Brigitte went above and beyond, helping us secure Puffing Billy tickets when they were sold out online and sharing fantastic local recommendations (We will remember our sons cackles at Seville water park for many years to come!). Her hospitality made our weekend absolutely perfect.
If you're looking for a cozy, welcoming retreat with incredible attention to detail, this is the place!
Thank you Brigitte and John for a perfect weekend. We can’t wait to return.

We had a lovely stay at Brigitte and John’s cabin. The house was warm and clean. I especially appreciate the warm bathroom in this winter. We also saw kangaroos and hot air balloons over the breathtaking Yarra Valley.
Brigitte and John were warm and welcoming. The little touches like the fig roll ups and chocolate cake that she baked made the kids’ day.
The location was quiet but near to everything. Woolworths was 4 mins away by car.
Would love to stay here again if we get the chance.

Mon's place was absolutely perfect, great position near shops and public transport. The decor was beautiful as was the pool and garden area and the view from the large balcony was also great. Mon was great to communicate with, the whole process was completely seamless.

A very smart and well appointed apartment located conveniently close to the Spenser Rd Train Station.  The Sky Bus shuttle from the airport also terminated there making it very easy to get to as we flew in.  The lockers at the station  were convenient also for leaving luggage in when we had to check out on yet last the morning, but still had the day to spend around town.  We took use of the gym and pool, but most of the time was spent walking around the city - as it should be!
It's a very great stay at Le City apartment. It's very easy to communicate with the host. Our whole family like this apartment so much. It's feel so warm and cosy.
Awesome place to stay, have a great time, plenty of space for 4 females too, would definitely recommend and stay again. Thank you....

Enjoyed my stay at Mon's place, which came fully equipped and within walking distance to Spencer Street Outlet Centre and Coles. Would love to stay at Mon's place again.
Located at CBD, very convient to go anywhere.  The apartment is clean and tidy.  I surely consider to stay here next time.

Such a beautiful apartment in a great location! Walking distance from public transport, shops and cafes. The apartment was spotless and spacey even with 8 guests. Mon was always quick to respond in communication and was incredibly accommodating when asked for early check in and late check out.
So pleased with our stay, we hope to visit again :)

Beautiful place just as photo. Mon is a very good host. Very thoughtful and always keeping in touch. The rooms are comfortable and clean. And the public place is also very comfy. The kitchen got everything you need. My family and I really enjoyed staying here. Skybus and tram stations just 5 minutes walk. Very recommend.

I really loved this apartment. It's exactly as described, clean and stylish with a beautiful view. Located very well in the middle of infrastructure and public transport. Mon provided all necessary information and replied fast to all our questions. I can absolutely recommend staying here!
Responsive and accommodating host, fantastic apartment to stay in if you are in the CBD. Highly recommended!
We had a great stay at Mon's place, nice and clean room, and great location, and Mon responsed very quickly. Would definitely come again next time when we in Melbourne.

This is a great apartment to stay! It is in a good location close to trams and trains. It was clean, modern and well equipped, although there was a bit of noise in the mornings from construction sites across the road. Mon was very prompt and helpful with all our communication throughout the booking process and  our time there. Thankyou Mon

Brilliant location, very stylish and everything you would need. The only thing to watch out for is that (due to its central location) it can be a bit busy and noisy in the building. This shouldn't surprise you but is something to consider before booking.

Lovely appartment with a good view. Had everything we needed. Good location, plenty of teams in walking distance as was cbd and very close to Southern Cross train station. Great Outlet mall 2 mins walk away!
Apartment was as per listing. Baby cot and high chair available. Owner was flexible with arrangements.
Best location to stay in. The house is Nice with stylish designed. The Host is great and been very helpful. Patiently giving clear instructions to get to the place and quick response to messages

Amazing abode, we came in a big group of 8, so we had to use the sofa bed in the living room, when we got there everything was all arranged, the sofa bed was made. Excellent communication. Definitely would stay again!

This apartment is excellent! The location is perfect because it's in the middle of city, there are lot of small restaurants and coffee shops, it's near the tram and train station, and there are convenient store nearby. Great apartment, great location, building had great amenities kids loved the pool, very clean & Mon is a great host her communication is great & answers all questions very quickly, I would definitely stay here again and recommend to family & friends.
Great place to stay in Melbourne.  Great location in large multi unit building.  Very clean and exactly as pictured.

Easy access to this great central apartment, with trams, railway station and discount shopping all within 200m.  Fantastic to get 3 bedrooms so our group of 5 could all stay comfortably. Mon was helpful with her directions and communications under such pressure with the coronavirus at the time.

This place is beautiful! The balcony is larger than it seems and has a nice view. The rooms are spacious and there are plenty of amenities in case you forget the essentials. The kitchen is also extremely clean and easy to use. Definitely recommend!
Monika was a great host, really responsive & helpful. Apartment was very clean & today & had everything we needed. - Thankyou

Great location from central station 5 min walk. Bedrooms not air conditioned which mad the room very stuffy.
Monika was excellent replied to my messages straight away we would stay again when in Melbourne.

Fabulous Family weekend away best location, Apartment was absolutely spectacular  met all our needs  and spotless we definitely stay there again. Our host Monika we thank for all your communication on arriving and departure and  organising the extra car park, The Besic Fam
Location is great. Very convenient. Entrance is abit obscure, it is easier to find on foot than driving. House contains everything you need and very comfortable stay.

Monika and Young were great host. Responded very quickly. Check-in instructions were quite detailed and helpful.
The apartment was very clean. Location was great. Overall a wonderful place. We would stay here again easily.

This listing was just as described with all the basics. Brilliant location. A bit cosy for 6 adults but who cares when you are hardly there.  Good communication from the host.  Would happily stay again

Monika and Young are great communicators and host.
They made our our family experience in their apartment very easy and comfortable.
The apartment was nice and clean, beds were cosy and location was very close to Southern Cross Train Station, Trams, Restaurants, Grocery Store and Shopping.
I would highly recommend Monika and Young's apartment to any family visiting the Melbourne CBD... 🙂
Monika was super helpful with allowing us to check in early, the place was a great location and the beds were comfy. All you could ask for in the centre of Melbourne!

The area was very nice. Easy access to train terminal and supermarkets. Lots of local restaurants and all within walking distance. The apartment was very spacious and we were able to spend the evenings comfortably even with a large party.

Good apartment in very convenient location. A little difficult to find initially but instructions were very clear and helpful and hosts responsive. The wifi was patchy throughout making working and streaming impossible. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Great location that is very walkable!  Close to grocery stores and shopping.  Good for groups, but maybe ask for a few extra linens.  Otherwise was well stocked

Great location.
Monika communicated quickly and was always helpful when I had a question
AC remote was not working. Unit was generally grimy and dusty, most glass surfaces had finger prints on them. Shower and toilet had not been cleaned or was only quickly wiped down.

Laura’s place was wonderful! It had everything we needed and more. It was clean and so close to our event at Flemington racecourse. I would 100% recommend this Airbnb and Laura was lovely to communicate with.

Location was perfect and an easy walk to the shops.
The place was super clean and tidy, and exactly how described. It was a wonderful experience for myself. Highly recommend
Laura was also so wonderful with her replies and so quick

Simon and Rue were amazing hosts who greeted our arrival and departure. Their place was truly a home away from home. We enjoyed every moment of our stay as it was very comfortable; we also had a 3 month old bub with us! Little touches such as the breakfast basket, additional linen and a beautiful courtyard made the whole experience even more special. Our own car spot in the driveway made it easy for us to load and unload the bags and baby. Thank you for a wonderful experience and hope to be back in the near future - Shekar, Darsh & Kyren ( Perth, WA)

Beautifully renovated cottage in convenient location, for us was close to the showgrounds, but also just up the road is Aldi and a range of lovely eaterys. Simon and Rue were more than accommodating, Simon was there in a flash when we messaged about being after some vinigar to poach our eggs... Rue also dropped us to the showgrounds on the first day. Lovely interior design, and nicely laid out grounds. Could have asked for better !!
They welcomed us. Genuine and helpful. Very cozy and comfortable for our family of five. Peaceful neighbourhood. Clean and tastefully decorated. Walk to grocery and food places. Loved this place!
Great location, close to public transport and shops and the house had everything we needed. Simon and Rue were great hosts!

The place was amazing. My family and I enjoyed it very much. I really do appreciate the electric blankets that was definitely a plus. I will definitely stay here again when my family visits in the future.

It is our first time in Melbourne and this place makes us feel so much at home. This is a really wonderful and lovely place to stay in for our family of 4 adults and an infant!  The thing that left the deepest impression for me is the beds that are supplied with heating devices. We felt warm and cozy sleeping in those beds even during this cold winter. The other thing we loved about this home is the kitchen is so well equipped with the so many variety of seasonings and cooking essentials that we can easily whipped up a nice meal. Definitely a place I would love to revisit again with my family or friends.

This actually is my first time using airbnb and my friend and I are so lucky to meet Simon. The house is amazing, the host is nice, everything here are fantastic enough for us. This place is not very far from the city and it's the best choice for one or two families with a car. Anyway we are so happy with this experience. Thanks Simon!

A great place for longer family stay. Simon is extremely helpful and responsive. Restaurants and supermarket are just nearby. Strongly recommend anyone, especially with a family for longer term stay. :)

Thank you Simon & Rye for the warm hospitality. Simon was very professional in handling things. We had a great time down there and will definitely stay there again when we are around. Thank you. Wishing you a great Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

We weren’t expecting such a stylish and comfortable place.
Quiet neighbourhood and close to the city, shops and transport.
Definitely stay here if you’re visiting Melbourne.

What a lovely home in a very quiet and easy to get to area.  Great hosts, who were very thoughtful and had a real personal touch during our stay and communicated so quickly.  The house was very clean, the beds are super comfy and it was such a wonderful home to stay in.  Access to the city was very easy via public transport.  Highly recommend this property for anyone wanting to stay in a nice quiet area.
Everything was in order. Great space. Owners live next door so any problems they will be sorting promptly.

We really enjoyed our stay! We enjoyed the open planned layout out and sitting outside in the courtyard and having coffee in the morning. There is a supermarket and shopping centre nearby and so many great restaurants. We would highly recommend this place for families.

Simons place was a pleasure to stay in. It had everything we needed for the whole family. We even had an extended family Christmas Day there and everyone had a thoroughly great time. It's close to shops, public transport and in a lovely quiet street.
A great stay in a great location. Neat and tidy house with everything you need. Close to trams, shops and restaurants.

This home was perfect for our family. We choose the home for its proximity to our family who live nearby and we will look to rebook here for future stays as it is a great location. We had a great time stay in this house. Cleanliness and Comfort. It’s convenient to everything, and there are lots of high reviews restaurants surrounding. We will definitely be back while we come to Melbourne.

We had an amazing time at Simon's beautiful house. We immediately felt at home, with an amazingly stocked kitchen and thoughtful gifts to help us settle in. I would definitely recommend Simon's place for a family looking for a beautiful place to stay in Melbourne.

Our group of 3 came to Melbourne for a conference. This house was only 5 mins from the venue. The local area seems to be a quiet, peaceful area making us feel safe the whole time we were there. The house is perfect for us. Definitely a "Home away from Home". The kitchen is well set out and had everything that we needed. Beds are comfortable, as is the living area. The breakfast provisions were awesome and unexpected. Thanks Simon for providing such a relaxing and comfortable accommodation for us in Maribyrnong.
It really did feel like home away from home. A lovely home in a perfect location. Simon was delightful and easy to deal with. The home immaculate!! Definitely recommend staying here

The apartment is brand new and great location. It has everything you need and Bill our host was very accommodating to our personal needs and made check in and check out effortless. The free tram lines are all a couple mins walk away as is the main southern cross station which made it so simple to get here via Sky bus from the airport. We had a game at Etihad stadium and that was also a stone throws away , quick walk and so convenient.  Everything this spot says it is it delivered and more. Would definitely stay here again in the future.
They were gracious, accommodating & extremely helpful! And the place is just amazing; clean & very comfortable. Would stay again if we ever visit Melbourne again :)
Bills apartment was superbly located and had great amenities. The building and apartment were modern and comfortable and communication was excellent. I would definitely stay again.
All ok .. Check in was over two hours late because the room was still not cleaned from the previous guests, which was very frustrating..

This was a very nice apartment for the price being close to the CBD. Bill and Jay were happy to let us check in and store our luggage at no extra cost and were really flexible since we wanted to spend the day exploring.
Excellent apartment. The only negative was the smoke smell from other apartments is quite strong on level 13 and can be smelt when entering the apartment. This isn't the owner's fault.
Second time in a month that I stayed here and it was spot on again,great location and everything you need at your door step, coming back in February u hope

Great location, close to food, shops and the tram. Host communities fast. Only issue was the toilet makes loud noises when you flush which is annoying at night and the washing machine turned my white clothes grey.
Rose ‘s place is wonderfull  for weekend escapes. The price is reasonable with warm and friendly service.
Great place, great communication nice touches in the home and just as described. Rose was great to deal with, cute place!

Such a beautiful space for families, plenty of room to spread out a little, the pool was great and allowed fantastic fun family time. Rose is very helpful and available at any time. Communication was easy and helpful.
We had a lovey stay at Rose’s property. Very comfortable stay, with everything you need. Really easy to access and close to shops for takeaway and supermarket shopping. A great stay for a family.

Quiet and safe neighborhood.
Walkable distance to shops Woolsworth miller and short drive to shopping mall Altona Gate. Well equipped kitchen and dining area. Great for family meals and conversation. Big family room and TV. Only one bathroom though. Washing machine and dryer were so helpful.
The apartment was amazing for our week long stay in Melbourne. The apartment is beautifully presented. James is a fantastic host. Would definitely stay here again when next in Melbourne.

I had an amazing stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, cozy, and in a great location. The host was very responsive and made sure everything was perfect for my visit. Thank you so much James!

James is friendly and responsive host, and I had a great relaxing stay in his beautiful apartment. He was very flexible with check in and check out, and was very accomodating with my requests. Would love to stay here again as I frequently make trips to Melbourne to see my son. Thanks again James, much appreciated!

David's place is a stylish and beautifully appointed apartment in one of the most attractive, historic neighbourhoods in Melbourne. Great cafe's, restaurants, bars and the much loved South Melbourne market are a stones throw away as are two tram lines that connect through to the city and the south. As a host David cannot be faulted and went out of his way to make our stay in South Melbourne one that we will always remember with a smile.

A lovely place, just like in the photos: modern, clean, and all the necessities you could possibly need. A really well put together apartment for a single or a couple. Right in the heart of South Melbourne and not far from Southbank and the city centre.

Great little place with all mod cons in a great location in South Melbourne, a short walk to bars and restaurants and 10 minutes from the city on the tram. Other than that the artists studio is highly recommended.
This was our second stay and yet again it did not disappoint!  Great little home in a great location!
David’s apartment is immaculate! Excellent location in the heart of South Melbourne. We enjoyed our stay, suited our accommodation requirements perfectly. David is a kind and friendly host. Thank you

David's place was amazing and he gave me some really helpful tips on how to get around the area. I was attending a Swim Meet at MSAC and David's place was perfect walking distance to the pool. South Melbourne is also a hidden gem! So many great restaurants!

A FABULOUS place to sum it up in one word.  From the meet and greet with David through to the sparkling clean apartment and the extras that have been included that I haven’t seen at other AirBnb’s. I can highly recommend.

I give David’s place full stars, it is the second time I have booked it, and I find it is so close to great restaurants and the market, and public transport and for me it is close to my family and I get to stay in a beautifully decorated and appointed apartment that meets all my needs. This absolute pearl is definitely worth getting.

This place is hands down one of the best airbnb's I've been in.

Really enjoyed our stay at David's place great location with plenty of great cafes and restaurants nearby. highly reccomend !!

A very cute cottage set in a beautiful garden.  A seperate kitchen area that is fully stocked with everything you need.  Yolanda provides a great selection of breakfast options.  The bed is super comfy.  I always enjoy my stays here.

The kitchen is extremely well equipped, Yolande having been a professional chef in her previous life. I spent my downtime here watching costume period drama on Netflix and walking of the gorgeous local beach

My wife and I just finished a three night stay at Yolande's property. I have to say that it was exceptional and the beauty and tranquility of the garden flows through to the delightfully quirky nature of the accommodation. The rooms were clean and well appointed and I wish I could have done justice to the professional level kitchen. Yolande was welcoming and hospitable and added to the enjoyment of our stay. Absolutely recommended.

My family stayed here for a week while visiting us and they absolutely loved it - so much that they have booked a few more days! Yolande is the perfect host, the cottage is amazing and the garden is a little paradise! You can walk to Sandringham village and enjoy a coffee before going to the beach. The train station is 10 minutes away by foot and you will be in Melbourne CBD in 40 minutes.

Yolande is a great host, she is responsive, accommodating and her cottage has everything a traveler needs. The cottage is cozy with a very comfy bed, and a lovely garden to enjoy some outdoor time. The kitchen is very well equipped with breakfast items provided. I’ve enjoyed my stay with her.

What a wonderful place to stay! Private  clean and comfortable. I slept so well, the bed was just perfect. It was lovely to look out onto the garden each morning. Yolande treated me to some yummy homemade treats too, very spoilt! I will definitely come again.

Perfect in every way. The accommodation and host exceeded our expectations by far and would recommend to anyone visiting Melbourne as it is only a small drive or train commute to the city but has all the attributes of a quiet cottage getaway.

I am a return guest for a reason. Yolande is a terrific host and the cottage has a great feel. I enjoy sitting on the porch with a view of the gardens. It's also a quick walk to the beach and cafes. I've stayed in many Airbnb's and this is  one of my favourites

I am a repeat guest and there's a reason I keep returning. Yolande is a terrific host, the location is excellent, and it's such a pleasure to wake up surrounded by mature gardens in a quiet neighbourhood.

Great friendly host and very helpful and accommodating. The location is in a lovely quiet street very well positioned in Sandringham. Easy to walk to the shops, station and beach. Property is clean, comfortable and has everything you will need for an enjoyable stay.

This was my first trip to Australia, and what a great way of making memories. Yolande is 100% a great host, with great communication skills, and a lovely attitude towards her guests. I felt at home away from home, walking to the cottage, sitting outside in the patio or just watching the birds in the garden. The cottage is beautiful, with plenty amenities and a fantastic kitchen. Yolande also made sure I had fresh food and toiletries to use during my stay - what a treat. She spoilt it for me forever. I love talking to her and getting to know her more and I would love to come back and stay longer. The best Airbnb experience I have ever had.
Yolande was a really great host. Her place was very nice with stunning cottage gardens. Yolande really made us welcome. Loved her place and hope to return. Many thanks Yolande.

Yolande's peaceful cottage was a home away from home. from the welcoming Persian " grumpy" cat to the fragrant garden , fully equipped but separate kitchen, swarming bees, and incredibly comfy bed it was all a lovely experience . yolande and her neighbors were responsive and helpful all the time.

Everything you could want from an Air b and b
Yolande is extremely friendly and helpful
A comfortable bed and living room the kitchen is great
Sandringham is a lovely place to stay
Excellent host excellent place. Quiet but within walking distance of the train station, cafes, shops and beach.
Christine was very welcoming and considerate. She has a lovely home and we really enjoyed staying there.
Loved the bay window, tall ceilings and calm of the house and the neighbourhood. Christine was a trusting and generous host.

Christine’s place is perfectly located between the airport and the CBD.
We stayed only 1 night before heading off to Great Ocean Road but we really enjoyed our stay.
There is plenty of space in the room and everything was really clean.
Much better than a hotel!
Had a chat with Christine and she's such a lovely lady, wish we had more opportunities to chat during my stay. The place was great too, of course. Would stay again, for sure.

Had a great one-night stay at Christine's place. The house is located in a quiet residential area, about 7 minutes walk from Moonie Ponds train station from which its only 15 minutes to central Melbourne. I could also use the kitchen which was great. Christine is a very pleasant and hospitable person, we had a really nice chat.  Will definitely stay again!
Lovely area, wonderful house and welcoming host who collected us from the train station when we were delayed in our travels.

The room got moved outside of her house into a renovated garage/ self-contained room in the back of her garden. Sadly we didn't have hot water in the shower, she did offer to shower in her house though.
If you’re looking a place to stay in Melbourne then this is it! Christine is great and the place is beautiful and cozy :)

We enjoyed staying in this house and loved its quirkiness and the art. The house was well suited to accommodating the seven of us.The location was brilliant for us, close to our relatives in Altona where we were having a large family reunion, and easy for day trips and the motorways. We enjoyed the ferry ride into Melbourne and walks along the foreshore reserves going into Williamstown and Altona. The kitchen/dining area was good for entertaining.

We enjoyed a Magical Mystical Weekend at the Arthouse! Apart from the eclectic Art, Andy is definitely one for detail.
We found Mood Lighting, Comfy corners to sit in and many treats were found in the Kitchen. If you are a ‘Minimalist’ – Do Not Apply.

A fantastic place for our 25km Covid escape!  Full of surprising touches, and a very comfortable bed in a really welcoming, soothing room. Though it looks a bit wild in the photos it is really very homely. Lots of great books, fantastic bath, loved the sinks too! Sunny outside area a bonus too, and nearby beach and wetland walks full of interest.  Love to go back when we can go out sans mask and actually eat at a restaurant or go to the pub!
Very interesting house in a good location in Williamstown. Very clean with lots of amenities. Highly recommended.

Loved Andrew’s place, was exactly like the pictures. Great art, very quirky feel, rain showers was a nice touch, and we enjoyed the converted sunroom. My girls like staying in the loft bedroom. Went for a great walk along the coastal trail to Williamstown.
What a great, quirky house. A good location, close to shops, ferry and waterfront. Loved main shower off back room. Thanks Andrew for a smooth checkin and communication.
Such a beautiful home, so unique and gave us an experience we will never forget. Felt like living in our personal gallery :)

Andrew was so accommodating. We made a very last minute booking and were not disappointed. Beautifully quirky little house, set in a quiet street, close to parks and shops. The unique elements of the house had the kids entertained for hours. Very comfortable, clean and spacious.
Easy access to the city and 5 minutes from the fabulous grazeland. So well positioned for a great weekend away.

My children and I had a fantastic stay at the Art House. The house is a fun, visual delight for the eyes whilst also being spacious enough for my four children and myself.  The beds and linen were extremely comfortable and the house was wonderfully quiet. The location was perfect as a base to explore Williamstown and the City and Andrew was a friendly host who was quick to respond to any messages. Would definitely recommend!

We really enjoyed our stay at Andrew’s place. It was nice and peaceful at night, spacious enough for the five of us, and had everything we needed including a coffee machine. The plentiful art was an added bonus, providing plenty of things to talk about. Andrew was very quick to respond, and was easy to communicate with. Thanks, Andrew, for hosting us.

My family loved Andy’s place. I unfortunately missed out on the trip as I was unwell, but my husband an three grown up daughters stayed and had a wonderful time. The house is even better than described and full of interesting art, photos and decorative pieces. The house is situated in a quiet street with easy access and only a 5 minute drive to the beach and supermarket. Williamstown is full of historical architecture and plenty of things to do for all ages. My family thoroughly recommend Andy’s place and would definitely stay here again hopefully next time I will be able to join them.

1 double bed, 1 twin bedded, 1 bunk bed and 1 double up the narrow stair at the attic. difficult for the aged to sleep upstair.
lots of antique, pictures in the house.
the BBQ pit is abit rusty, maybe good to change.
otherwise all is good, unique house.
very responsive. thanks

Nice house, Suited our needs. Parking was easy, easy to find. Quiet location.
Extra blankets and pillows. Tea coffee sugar milk for our use. Interesting place to stay.

Andrew was a great host and communicated well. The eclectic furnishings made us feel like we travelled all over the world.
The accommodation was close to the beach and botanical gardens.

We had a fabulous time at Andrew’s place. As a creative family we really appreciated all of the interesting art pieces and unique interior decorating touches around the house. We had all the comforts we needed. Extra blankets, towels and bathroom products were provided which was nice. The kids really enjoyed the wonderful lights and dioramas and attic window looking out to the starry night sky. Fantastic location, close to the main drag and beach. A magical experience!

Lovely home, really cosy and calming. Great location, close to the supermarket and lots of different things to do in Altona. The host (Andy) is the most helpful and lovely man, helped with all questions and really quick to answer. Will definately be back staying at the 'Art house by the Bay' next time I'm in Melbourne.

We had a three-night stay in this unique and beautifully curated house that feels like a home. It looks exactly like the photos and delivered a great experience for our family. Our thoughts are that staying at an Airbnb should be fun, quirky and comfortable and deliver a unique experience, one you don't get at home. This house delivered on all fronts. We are grateful to have had the experience of staying at the house and will definitely look to stay again one day and will recommend to friends.
Andy was helpful and responsive and flexible with checkin. Many thanks

We absolutely loved our stay at Andy's place! Our grandchildren (age 4 & 8) thought it was magical, as did we.  Plenty of room for us all and such a creative and interesting space to be in.  Great to be able to park easily just over the road and really a very short drive to everything we needed in Williamstown.  Highly recommend this special Airbnb and we look forward to returning.
The cabin and property were absolutely stunning and Jules truly is a ‘Super Host’! We had an awesome week at the wineries and can’t wait to come back again soon!

Julie’s place was gorgeous and cosy and her communication made everything very easy. The cabin is in a great location, so close to Healesville but in a beautiful bushy, quiet area. The perfect place to unwind for the weekend.

We had the most relaxing weekend away at Julie and Gabe’s cabin. It’s in a beautiful, quite spot  and the cabin itself is stylish and cosy. The fireplace on the veranda is magical. We will definitely be back next winter.

Such a lovely quiet location away from everything but close enough as well to civilisation if you want it.
We loved the quirks of old and new in the cabins set up. The kids loved the compost toilet of all things!!! Was lovely not having TV and listening to the rain at night on the tin roof.
If you’re after a break away from the the madness of life this is a wonderful place to head to😊

If you are looking to get away from it all, this is the perfect real retreat you could ask for. Such a unique stay that allows you to appreciate the outdoors whilst providing all the comfort you need. The balcony is the absolute standout. We could not get enough of that view. A great stay if you're looking for a quick city getaway!
Beautiful secluded cabin getaway, perfect for completely switching off and getting in touch with nature. Loved our stay!

If you are looking for somewhere secluded, surrounded by greenery and fantastic views then this rustic cabin in the Yarra is the best place to stay! The cabin had everything we could need. Gabe was also very easy to communicate with and provided us all the relevant information prior to our stay.

Our stay at the cabin was just the ticket! Beautiful surroundings, birds galore, and the cabin itself is so charming and well maintained. Everything you need to cook for yourself, comfortable beds, and the verandah was perfect for relaxing, reading and taking in the bush

Thank you Julie. We had a beautiful weekend away, wandering the trails in the bush, bouncing on the enormous trampoline and snuggling by the fire.
Can't wait to go back to your beautiful cabin in the bush. 🙏

Julie's place was an amazing stay. I would definitely come back again, and use this as a base for exploring the wider area. An amazing host too, who put the heater on for us before we arrived.
Lovely apartment and very clean! In the middle of the city center so that you can reach a lot by walking! I definitely would come back :)
We had a lovely time at Tony & Maria's place. The apartment was great. We were met upon arrival by Klaudia who showed us around and made sure we were happy. Would definitely stay here again.
Amazing apartment which was beautifully decorated. The location was extremely convenient and the hosts were lovely! Would definitely recommend this place!!

Really great communication and hospitality from the owners. Cheers

It’s a jungle in there -literally! What an amazing retreat for some tranquil space and time to spend in a stunning environment. From the heavenly bedroom to the divine egg chair that made for a great nap nest we cannot wait to be back! Thank you x
Maria is so nice and try to solve our problems that we have some printing problem. The place was really cool, different style in the house and great location to travel the city!! Very recommended!!

Beautiful place in a fantastic location. The photos are very accurate so you get exactly what you pay for.  Klaudia,  Jonathan,  Maria and Tony were wonderful hosts.

Not only a place for rest, but a unique experience.  The apartment is in the heart of CBD and the kitchen is well-equipped.  I went to 5-6 AirBnb before and this one is undoubtedly the best.
Amazing and stylish unique home, Klaudia, Jonathan, Maria, Tony were excellent hosts and have clearly put in loads of effort to make the stay enjoyable and comfortable!

The team behind the apartment were super efficient, kind and communicative. The place is in a fantastic CBD location and has everything you need for a fantastic stay.

Gorgeous and fun play to stay with thoughtful touches and a cosy, dreamy bed. Loved this one so much.

Apart from the exceptional individuality of the apartment itself, the communication was the big winner. Could not have made the arrival or entry any easier.

Awesome stay.

This place is amazing! What you see on the picture is all true. Location was perfect, rooms were artistically & thoughtfully put together. We loved every details of the home. I would stay here again.

Stepping into this place was a magical experience. The bed was so comfy I asked where they got the mattress, and they were so kind to follow it up for me.

Absolutely fantastic stay; the place looks just like the photos and Klaudia, Jonathan, Maria & Tony are 10 stars for communication and provided just the best time. If you're looking for a unique rainforest and heaven retreat in the heart of the CBD stop searching - you've found it. Book now!

An amazing, whimsical apartment in a fantastic location. Lovely place to stay and decorations were amazing and as described in the photos.

Beautiful and unique. Cloud room is stunning and everything is clean and tidy. Right in the middle of the city so it is easy to get to everything. I’d definitely recommend staying here.

Great central location!

This is just a stunning apartment !! Book it and you will not regret it. It has so much character and space !

The apartment is very comfortable and in a perfect location to get the train into Melbourne as the train station is only 4 minutes walking. Local cafes and restaurants are good and if the weather is good you have your own private balcony/outside seating area.

Carla's apartment is so nice and very clean, we were only there for one night but it would be a great place to spend longer as it's so close to transport, dining options and a supermarket. I would definitely recommend this place to others.
Carla was a great host! Very easy to deal with, got back to us with questions quickly and the apartment was great. Had everything we needed, tidy and very affordable. We would certainly recommend it.

Stayed myself and happy to recommend to anyone looking. So comfortable and a very functional living space. Carla is also a delight to deal with.

when we arrive at this apartment it was as described , we were not disappointed everything we needed for a comfortable stay "great week we will return
