Would highly recommend staying here! Gwyneth was lovely and available for any and all questions we had.
Gwyneth is one of the best hosts I’ve ever experienced. She is very considerate and responsive. The location is very convenient with walking distance to the city center.

I'm a student from Monash college. It was a good corporation with both Valeria and flexi_accommodation. Valeria is nice. And one of the friend Matti I met here said "Valeria will always find you something to live." It was an interesting experience.
As an renter. I'm asking for a favour and also a suggestion: Be nice and polite to people live with you. People can have inappropriate behaviour. We all know things happens. but remember to communicate people with good manners and try to be nice，always. You gonna have a remarkable experience.
All the best
Jacky boi
Nina's place was very clean and in a very good area close to shopping and cafes and restaurant. We loved Smith Street Alimentari for breakfast which is opposite and up a bit from the flat.
Great place in Fitzroy with 3 bedrooms. The garbage bins are located inside the building so it will smell like fermenting garbage in warm days.

Very well located in the center of one of the best street of Fitzroy. The appartment is clean and nice. It is a bit small for 6 adults if you are planning to spend your time in the appartment but you shouldn't!
Nina's place is is great value and in a fantastic location with everything you need within walking distance. It's a great base from which to explore all the delights of Melbourne.
Brilliant location for great food and breweries, transport to anywhere and not noisy at all despite being on the main drag of Fitzroy. The aircon was greatly appreciated on the 40 degree days.

Nina's place was extremely well located in the heart of bustling Smith St, close to lots of amazing shops, bars and restaurants. The accommodation was clean and comfortable and perfect for a weekend away with a small group of friends. Nina was very responsive and friendly in all communication, and check-in and check-out was easy.

Location location location! The location was fantastic, we flew in for a wedding and this gem of a place was literally 100m down the road, there are a lot of restaurants close by and a supermarket almost at your doorstep.

Location, location, location! So many cute bars nearby and no shortage of things to do. Apartment is well cared for and maintained, far exceeding what you would expect in an older building. Thoughtful touches like thick blinds and extra blankets show that the owners put extra thought into ensuring guests were comfortable.
Great place, clean and well kept. I hope Nina is working towards some security improvements as unfortunately we were broken into and had some things stolen.

Excellent location. Very clean, Very fast WiFi. Big TV, Well equipped kitchen - all as advertised. The minor negative is that the living area is very small. Fine for two people but with 4 or more it would be pretty cramped. The couch holds three, but anyone else has to sit at the dining table. So, there is little incentive to stay indoors - but then why would you with so much to do in the area.
The location is fabulous - right on Smith St with cafes, bars and a supermarket in the same block. Clean, excellent value for money, and I would definitely stay here again.

Thank You Huy and Nina for a great stay! The appartment is in a great location. Parking is a little hard to find but Nina directed us to some nearby free parking for the weekend.
Thanks again!

Nina’s place is in an amazing location! We really enjoyed our stay. Unfortunately it was a bit tight for 5 adults, and there really isn’t any street parking (unless you want to move your car every 2 hours).
Very fast response from Nina! Check in and check out were smooth, no downside at all. Great place to stay!

Super happy with this apartment! Great restaurants and shops along the street, easy flat 15min walk to free tram circle, or paid tram stop right outside the door, Woolworths next door and cute little nail salon right downstairs. plenty of room for 4 adults and 1 tween for a 3 night stay.

We had a great stay at Nina's spot! Can't imagine a better location. For a short stay in Melbourne, being right on Smith street meant we could access most areas via walking or the tram. The house was clean and exactly as pictures showed! Nina was responsive and proactive. Great stay!

We had a great stay at Nina's. Great location, lots of local restaurants, cafes, bars and shops, walking distance to city centre. As mentioned stairs to get to the unit and on the tram line which you hear in the front room.
Everything you need inside the unit including Netflix. Very comfortable stay. We'll definitely be back!

Convenient location, tram outside door, size was fine for the three of us wanting three separate bedrooms, had everything we needed except... we all had uncomfortable beds the first thing we wanted was  comfortable beds so we could get a good sleep and feel refreshed in the morning ...front bedroom is noisey which is to be expected so take airplugs.  No lock on bathroom/toilet which can lead to embarrassing moments. We chose this place because of mainly good reviews however when we were staying there we went back through the reviews and did notice that many of the reviews were for the other unit. We suggest replacing with good quality comfortable mattresses. Wifi code written down somewhere would have been good on our arrival I had to get roaming to access the online listing instructions to get the wifi code.
Mon is very great host easy communicate and very friendly. We will be going to Mon house again if we need to stay at Burwood area. Hope we get another chance to stay  there again :)

This was a great place for me and my family , central to shops as well as a park for the kids a few blocks down .
A lot of beds for everyone and great space .
The place is full of modern touches and extras .
Thanks Mon for being a great Host - much easier when someone responses quickly and is super helpful ! Thanks again Mon!

It is my second time staying at Mon's place. We were here at 2017 and now back in 2019, nothing have been changed, still keeping very clean and tidy. My kids just love the park and playing area which is really 2 mins from this house.
Mon is very helpful and she response to questions in a very short time. I'll certainly stay for the 3rd time if we have a chance. No doubt that I would recommend anyone to stay at Mon's place, especially with family & kids.

Mon she is perfect host ever. I really impressed she prepared multi-adapter for international people. I don't really need because I live in Australia by the way it was so useful for my family. House was very clean and cozy. I definitely stay again later.
Mon was a responsive host and the place was great for our family. We'd highly recommend this place as a somewhere to stay whilst in Melbourne.
Ika was a great host and very friendly and responsive.  There house was cozy and warm and within walking distance to public transport.

This is a perfect place to stay in St Kilda. Super close to great eateries, tram, beach and anything else you might like. A lovely home for the able bodied. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would certainly stay again if the opportunity arises. Highly recommend.

Thank you Vincent for an amazing stay. The apartment is enchanted and stunning with high ceilings, spacious rooms and stylish decor. It’s fully self sufficient, clean, tidy and you feel right at home. The apartment is located on a beautiful leafy street and is walking distance to everything in St Kilda.
Would highly recommend staying here x

Such a stylish inner urban pad perfect for mum and daughter visiting St Kilda. Great location for tram rides to the city. Very spacious and comfortable - the front room is fantastic with beautiful light and street vista to take in. Working from home while away from home was made all that better because of it. Perhaps the only limitation is a small bathroom given the rest of the residence is roomy and well-appointed, but this would not stop us from returning. Vincent was a great host too - super attentive and friendly. Thank you.
We found the accommodation to be very comfortable, great location & full of interesting furniture & decor. We’ll happily come back to stay.

Grace's apartment is gorgeous and has everything you could possibly ask for... the bed is so comfy you will never want to get out of it and when you do you don't want to leave the apartment because all your favourite shows will be on foxtel! Would highly recommend.

Grace was a lovely host and communicated with us perfectly. The flat is located in a central place, roughly 10min to the city and other hip neighbourhoods. Amenities were also great and the bed very comfortable. Would be happy to stay again.
Thanks Grace for having us.
Very clean building and nice flat. Exactly what you see in the pics. The pool is amazing.
Great location, 10 min tram ride into the city. Apartment is really nice and comfortable and well maintained. Everything was to the photos. Enjoyed the pool in the roof too.

Grace has been a great host. The accomodation was perfect with all of the facilities needed for a long vacation.
The Moubray/Saint Kilda Tram Stop is located just across the road from the building providing easy access into central Melbourne.
We had two minor issues with the apartment which were resolved promptly.
Highly recommended,the place was wonderful,good location、nice facilities,close to park etc,will booking next time.
Perfect for a couple or a solo traveller. Has everything you’d need, and has a tram stop and bus stops meters away from the entrance. Would gladly stay at this apartment again.

Wow!!!
What’s not to love about this place. A great, private and secure apartment complex which was one of the cleanest air BnB’s I’ve ever stayed in. We loved the ease of access to the city and the local coffee spots, supermarkets and amenities.
The bed and linen were more than comfortable abs my daughter and I enjoyed 11 amazing nights here.

This is lovely apartment with everything you need. Quiet residental house. Swimming pool area is amazing!
Location is perfect to explore Melbourne, close to CBD and St Kilda with trams. Also walking distance to Prahran and Royal Botanic Gardens.

This served our purpose well.  Well equipped. Comfortable bed.  Just needs blackout curtains as noted by other guests.  Elevator not working but that not Grace’s fault…just inconvenient for me with lots of luggage
Nice area, nice enough place with pool and gym area. was an odd smell in the bedroom but other than that it was good

Absolutely loved our stay! Natalia’s space was comfortable and very well kept. The area is quiet and the local tram station made getting around the city very accessible. We would love to stay here again in the future!

Lovely apartment in a central area. Perfect for the trip with our little family - close to convenience stores and restaurants. Tram stop just outside the building so easy to get around.
The apartment is modern, comfortable and had all the amenities we needed.
Definitely recommend!

Nikola’s place was all I expected and more. Great amenities. Very comfortable and clean. Communication was great. I had no issues with the apartment. Very close to public transportation. Parking was also a plus. Very quite neighborhood with many cafe and food options close by. Overall excellent place.

Super modern apartment in a lovely building. Sunny & warm with excellent facilities. Very quiet which is good as Fitzroy noisy on weekends. Nice cafe downstairs too. Nikola was quick to respond to any queries.

My second visit to this lovely apartment. Warm, clean and comfortable.very sunny and quiet.
Could have done with a toaster but apart from that well equipped if you want to cook.
Very close great cafes and shops in Fitzroy.
Nikola was quick to respond to any queries.
I would recommend and would return again.
A nice modern apartment in the heart of Fitzroy- and also walking distance to the CBD. Very spacious. A quiet street despite being close to everything.

The apartment is a great size with modern setup, sunset balcony views, aircon and comfy bed.
Great location near to trendy bars, shops and with a wonderful cafe beneath.
Nicola’s apartment is in a great location, walking distance to shops and restaurants. It is very well appointed and secure. Communication was excellent.

Very comfortable and clean apartment.
Excellent location for cafes, shops , walked everywhere and there was visitor parking when our daughter drove to see us. Felt very secure .
Nikola’s place is a great spot. Close to the bustling Brunswick St and surrounding districts. Beautiful, modern apartment with character, and all the ‘mod cons’. Will be absolutely back!

Bordered by Smith Street, Gertrude Street, Brunswick Street & Johnston Str you have the choice of so many bars, restaurants, wine bars , iconic pubs and an amazing array of independent fashion both for sale & modeled on the street! Nikola is brilliant responsive host , we love Melbourne, we come often and if it’s available we will be staying here but longer next time . PS fabulous bathroom & parking.

Nikola's place is very comfortable with a very well equipped kitchen.  Surrounding area is cool and Melbourne CBD is within easy walking distance, especially after we figured out the central free tram service.  We had a very pleasant 7 nights in Melbourne.

Nikola’s place was great. The apartment is in a newer building and had everything we needed, including a washer and dryer. The apartment is very quiet and we never heard any outside noises. The location is great with many cafes, bars, and restaurants close, as well as many public transportation options. Nikola was always very responsive with his communications. Also, Nikola granted us a late checkout which was very convenient. We would love to stay here again when we return to Melbourne!

This was our second time staying at Nikola’s place. Such a great location with everything we needed for our stay. A very comfortable apartment all round super close to food, shops and entertainment but still peaceful and private.
Really great apartment in the heart of Fitzroy. Nikola was an awesome host, very prompt with communication and just a really nice guy. Will stay again next time I’m down in Melbourne.

It's all been pretty much said before.
Clean , Modern , quiet , great location .
Thank you Nikola .
Hope to stay again

Nikola was a great host, allowing an earlier check in and easily communicating with us whenever we had a question! Amazing location and perfect space for us whilst we settled into Melbourne and found a permanent rental. Also, had the best book selection! 😊

Fantastic location - Fitzroy has a lot to offer and is very central.
The appartment was as desribed and clean.
Nikola was very quick to respond to questions

My family visited Melbourne for the Australian Open and stayed at Simon’s place. The house was clean, beautifully decorated with plenty of room to accommodate the 6 of us. The property is centrally located, walking distance to all the shops and restaurants. You couldn’t have asked for better hosts as they were responsive and attentive to our requests. We did experience some warmer than normal temperatures at night and Claudia arranged for two fans to be delivered. We enjoyed our stay immensely and look forward to returning.

Perfect home-from-home base in Melbourne for our family group of adults. Simon and Claudia were considerate and helpful throughout - thank you. The house is a great example of local architectural transformation that provided spacious, stylish and bright accommodation. The location was ideal for access to cafes, restaurants, shops and activities. Driving out of Melbourne to the East was also really easy. All we needed.
Manik is a lovely host and made us feel most welcome, a very homely unit. We would definitely stay again.
Manik’s a really lovely host and we had a great stay at her place. The place was very clean and modern with complete basic amenities. 100% recommended to those looking for a great accommodation.

Manik was very hospitable, very helpful and knowledgeable.
The place is very well designed and walking distance from Monash University. The rooms are comfy and the aminities are thoughtful and fairly comprehensive.
The unit is connected yet private, with an independent access and there is convenient street parking.
Manik drove us to the car rental agency and helpfully waited while they took their own sweet time processing our request.
We had a great stay, while the place was well appointed and convenient, what made is special was Manik’s warm hospitality.

Great host! Gave us clear instructions to get there from the airport using public transport and also picked us up from the train station and took us to Coles!! Very thoughtful and helpful! Also very comfortable apartment to stay in!

Delightful. Airy, well lit, perfectly clean, 5 minutes drive from anything, as close to the convenience of the trains as possible (without being able to hear them!), and heaps of cookware etc. for the chefs out there. Will not hesitate to return.
Manik, thank you so much for the stay.
Fabulous communication and response to our needs! The space was perfect for the stay. It was clean, accessible and had everything needed. Would definitely stay here again. Thank you for hosting.
Small but nice accommodation. Great location close to Monash Uni. Quiet street and easy parking. Would stay again.

We had a very nice and pleasant stay. Manik was a great host, responding immediately and taking care of us.
Comfortable and well-equipped apartment. Walking distance, less than 30 min to Monash University.
Thank you Manik, with pleasure again!
Best regards
Valentin

We really enjoyed to stay there. The house is nice, clean and comfortable. The bed linen are clean and comfy. Manik has provided a good quality, fragrance (smell beautifully) bath towels.
Manik was an excellent host, friendly and understanding. We appreciated all her assistance.
The house was behind the main house where the host residence. It built high up, you will have good view at night time.

My son and his girlfriend stayed at Maniks place for 3 nights and thoroughly enjoyed their stay.
Manik was very friendly and helpful.
They were impressed with how homely and organised her place was.
A perfect spot for visiting Monash uni (Clayton) campus and for hopping on public transport to explore Melbourne.
Highly recommend.

Unlike many airbnb properties, the property was homey, and most consumables were conveniently available.
The host was an eco warrior and some of her policies were a little inconvenient, but it should be easy to look past those one you get used to them.
The property is close to bus stop and arguably within walking distance to grocery stores as well as Monash.
What else? Hmmm... There dog is really friendly and I swear McGyver lived there at some point. LOL.

Lovely stay at Manik’s ,everything you need for a comfortable stay.
Manik was helpful and a great cook - she treated us a couple of times !
Highly recommend a stay here .
We had a car so travel wasn’t a problem, but we also went into city by train too to see “Moulin Rouge” - fantastic- we were lucky to get tickets at short notice - trains easy from Clayton station.

This place is unmatched...it has everything any family or guests would need...you want to stay home and cook? You've got everything you need to make a gourmet meal. You want to go out to eat? Walk out the front door.  You want a view? Say no more! You want quiet with access to nightlife. Done. If you're still reading, please go book before it's too late....

Excellent communication before and during stay - the apartment was spotlessly clean, very well appointed and in a fantastic location. Highly recommended this place for a stay in Melbourne and with the free tram stop on your door step you can’t go wrong here

We loved the location and the cleanliness of the property, There was nothing missing that you would have needed, every detail was taken care of, we chose the extra linen option, and was pleasantly surprised ever thing was tidied and clean when we came back to the apartment. Great location supermarket across the road, CBD and docklands outside the door. We were in Melbourne working and the apartment certainly made our stay that bit more enjoyable.
we will be back again

Great place. Tram at the foor was very convenient.
I would stay there again. 😊
Great location. The Airbnb looks just like the photos. You get what you see. Eduardo was very responsive when we had questions.

It is a very well-placed accommodation to stay in Melbourne and enjoy the city. Also, I was able to stay comfortable thanks to kind Timothy, who filled in the gaps right away and responded to my questions very quickly.
Mark is a really good host, very hospitable, and quick to respond. The place is easy to get to, accurate descriptions. Small snacks were a great touch too, thanks Mark!

Mark’s apartment was nicely furnished with modern appliances, nice snacks and breakfast items. Close to the Restaurants in Fitzroy St and the Windsor end of Chapel St.
I really enjoyed my stay.
Great value and location. Great amenities. Mark was helpful and speedy with responses. Would highly recommend!
A lovely little apartment with lots of nice touches. Modern furnishings & nice and clean. Mark was a very prompt communicator (when we were arranging our arrival - there were no problems!)

Mark's place is fabulous! Great location, really clean, the bed is super comfy too, lovely little touches like coffee and snacks when you arrive and he was always available for any questions or queries I had. 3 minute walk to the tram in to the city and 15 minute walk in to central St Kilda. Highly reccomend this place! :)
Lovely little apartment in st kilda. Really close to the tram stop which was easy to use to get into the city. The apartment was great, lots of nice touches that made us feel right at home.

Mark responded very promptly. Self check-in was great. The apartment was tucked away in St Kilda. Great value for money. I was very happy with my stay. The apartment had a secure parking space for your car. The other neighbours I ran into were extremely nice.
Great apartment with all amenities. Close to restaurants, cafes and pleasant walk to St Kilda beach. Great to have parking spot. Mark was very quick to respond to our queries. Great value.

This unit is small and suitable for one or two people. It has a lovely outlook and is well placed in St Kilda with access to shops, train, teams etc.
It is probably best suited for short stays ( no oven and stovetop is limited). A number of basic maintenance tasks are in need of doing but we have no doubt the owner will attend to these.
Mark is a very good host with excellent communication and made our stay enjoyable with more than ample supplies of the necessities and a few luxuries.
Nice place for a bit of r&r - living room looks out over trees and great value for money. Mark was very responsive. Thanks for the stay!
This is great unit has all the amenities and is in a good location to explore both Melbourne and St Kilda. Close to transport and has secure parking.
Stylish and spacious apartment in a great location - vicinity to Chapel St was great! Check in process was flexible and easy.
Mark is very generous and accommodating. Instant response for any queries or problem. He is a really reliable household that you can count on.

Everything about staying at Mark's place was wonderful!  The apartment, secure parking, proximity to tram, easy check in and knowing we could contact Mark with anything all made our stay perfect.  Just wonderful!

I have stayed at Mark's property on multiple occasions.
The place is clean, has updated appliances, and the bed is extremely comfortable.
The bathroom is always well stocked and its hard to resist the mentos bowl in the hallway.
Thanks Mark

Mark's place is suuuuuper well equipped! Communication with him was very easy.
The apartment has everything you could need for either a short or long term stay. Also, he leaves lots of things for breakfast such us jam, Vegemite, butter. And chocolates and chilled sodas. Location is very good, close to public transport, but also has a off street parking inside the building.
above average, I really enjoyed my stay, hope to be available next time I want to stay there

Mark is a friendly and helpful host, who communicates and responds quickly. His apartment is convenient for visiting Melbourne and has the advantage of a secure parking space. It is also close to a tram station.

Mark’s place was a great location for our short stay in Melbourne. It was within walking distance of trains, buses and trams,  with the tram being just across the road. It was also a short walk to chapel st, which was loaded with places to eat, vintage stores, and plenty of shopping and transport opportunities. Mark was extremely flexible, letting us check in early and out late and we are extremely grateful. Thanks!

Mark was very responsive to my questions and gave clear instructions.
The only thing was that I was unaware that the room had no aircon but he provided a fan.
The place is not very new but every thing in place and clean.
Overall, good value and good host!
We were very pleased with the stay. very good location,  clean, very good  communication with the host. All profesional, really recommend.

Mark's place is very well located, just 100 mtrs (2-3 mins) away from tram to Melbourne CBD which is a great advantage. The listing was overall very well listed and we liked the gestures (chocolates etc) & amenities in the apartment.
Mark is great communication and responds quickly to all queries, including check-in.
1 thing which was a miss during our stay was the washroom door - its a sliding door which doesn't close, so either you have to close the room door to use washroom or ask someone to hold it from outside. Being with family, that caused us inconvenience and uncomfortableness as we had to work around it.
Overall, its a great place for a shorty stay and explore CBD & could be better if above issued is fixed. Good value for money.

While St Kilda is a bit of a tram ride from downtown, I still enjoyed checking out the local restaurants that were about a 15 minute walk away.
There are multiple tram stations near by (the closest being a minute & a half away), so it’s easy to hop on & get around town.
The apt was exactly as described, if not bigger than I was expecting.
If taking the AirBus there, definitely take the City route & ride the trams to the apt. I took the Peninsula route & ended up having to lug my luggage 20 minutes to the apt.

Better than the photos! Would def stay again. Great car park, such great coffee/breakfast directly across the road. Train station 5 min walk. Mark has thought of all the small things- towel racks, fans etc
The lobby/halls of the building is quite run down and has a strong musty smell but don’t be deterred because Marks resembles nothing of the entry of the building! His place is exactly what you need for a Melb escape!
easy to get in to, responsive host. great area if you're a tourist. it is an older building with scuffs marks and such but nothing crazy and nothing dirty.

I loved my stay at Mark's property. It's quite easy to get to using the SkyBus from Melbourne Airport, and there are lots of lovely cafes within walking distance from the property. It was my first time staying away from the CBD, and St Kilda was peaceful and quiet. Additionally, there are two tram stops  that were easy to get to and made it convenient for commuting across Melbourne. The apartment itself was cosy, lived-in, and Mark has provided a handful of brochures and guides for activities and sights to visit in Melbourne. All in all, it was a comfortable stay for a frequent solo-traveller for myself. I'd recommend Mark's for future stays :)

I think this place is very good value for a short stay. It’s in a good location, has everything you need, and the bed is very comfy. The decor is a little outdated and it needs some TLC. The dryer didn’t work at all and the shower pressure isn’t great. The sofa in the living room is so uncomfortable we didn’t use it at all.

We really unwound during our time here - great weather, nice garden to unwind in, good cooking facilities. The smaller space took some getting used to but made us realize how little one needs to be comfortable. Thanks Sam and April.

We only stayed for one night and wished it could have been longer ! Would definitely recommend for anyone who is looking for a quite space in amongst the birds and the trees. The tiny house was perfect for us and everything was thought of from the beautiful wooden detailing of the house, to the little speakers to play music and other small touches inside like the lovely organic shower gel and soaps. We felt instantly at home and relaxed. We found the bed very comfortable too and lovely to wake up with the kookaburras singing. We took a little walk in amongst the trees from close by the house which was nice and the next day ventured along the big trees walk to visit the ada tree. Lots of nice things around this part of Victoria to see. Thank you for having us!

So highly recommended! This cabin is the most beautiful and charming space I’ve stayed in yet. The handmade details are an absolute marvel, the books are a joy to peruse and the freshly laid chicken eggs were delightful. Everything we needed including cooking oil and utensils was in there. The town is so sweet and quiet, we started the day with a hike starting across the road and slept like babies in the dark serenity at night. So many adorable finishing touches that made this place feel like a home you never want to leave. Can’t wait to be back.
Really comfortable tiny house, Cozy but not cramped. It's in such a beautiful location too, so nice to go exploring during the day.
The tiny house is as expected - a lovely, secluded and relaxing stay and lots of friendly chickens!

This little wooden cabin fulfilled all my tiny house, small living, run away to live in the Forrest Swiss Family Robinson style dreams! Simply the perfect get away: a rustic wooden cabin set amongst a garden complete with a hammock, wicker outdoor furniture and a chicken pen. It was the small touches that really made this house special: essential oils in the bedroom and a kitchen fully stocked with a plethora of health foods. Simply an unmissable getaway, my only regret is that I didn’t stay longer.
What a beautifully crafted space ! We had a wonderful few nights in Sam and April’s cosy, peaceful tiny house nestled amongst the rainforest. They were wonderful hosts, highly recommend.

A very cute little cabin in a rainforest setting. The accomodation was clean & easy to find following the instructions. It stayed surprisingly warm overnight and we didn’t need to use the wood heater. The hosts kindly let us bring our dog which was great for us. It was a shame it rained most of our time there but we still managed to get out for a walk in the rainforest. The one downside we found was the mattress on the bed quite was thin and could feel the wood of the bed through it.
Beautiful tiny home nestled amongst the national park. The place is very thoughtfully put together and wonderfully cosy. We had a fantastic stay.

Such a sweet little place like this hardly seems imaginable that it’s only 2.4 m x 5 m in size. A bit like Doctor Who’s tardis it seems a lot bigger on the inside! Psychologically it seems like your whole world is conveniently on hand when it’s own little kitchen bathroom study and bedroom.
Prior to arriving we were A bit worried because the forecast for the weekend was very hot with high 30s predicted but the little cabin is quite cool. In more ways than one! We used the fan to cool the place down overnight and then during the day keep the doors shut and it was fine. Sam and April suggested some great spots by the river to cool off and were great hosts.
We will definitely come back again

We spent 2 nights in the tiny house.  We loved it! The tiny house has so much character, and we were so impressed with all the quirky branches used as risers on the stairs, and the magnificent timber used around the house.  We spent the two nights drinking wine and listening to music and soaking up the ambience.  The house was clean and had everything we needed.  It was great fun climbing the stairs and sleeping in the loft, listening to the birds and the possum at night.  We loved the geese and chickens.  April was so helpful with tips on walks in the area.  Communication was great, check-in easy.  Would highly recommend The Tiny House for a great, extraordinary experience. Thanks Sam and April!

The tiny cabin was everything I had expected and more! April was very helpful and friendly and the cabin is in such a peaceful and beautiful location, would definitely recommend and will definitely be back!

I loved my cosy weekend away by myself, at this rustic and charming tiny house. April was a great host and so helpful with teaching me how to get the fire going. Communication was so quick and the local tips were extremely helpful. I visited the ada tree and waterfall nearby and did rainforest walks easily from the property. I highly recommend. Thank you so much April!

Just the perfect tiny house. Amazing amenities, beautiful landscape and the comfiest little home you could hope for. We had a wonderful time and appreciated all the little touches April and Sam have put into the space. The hosts are super accommodating. Thanks again April, Aethel and Sam!

My time here was so refreshing! The house itself was charming, rustic, and peaceful, and it was located in such a beautiful place, with really close walks through the forest. Definitely recommend this place!

An incredible experience and beautiful space. The little cabin is a beautiful space that feels close to nature. The animals on site are very friendly and heart melting. The hosts are incredibly kind and welcoming. I would recommend this to anyone keen on seeing the outdoors and wanting a cozy and well-supplied location.

This is a wonderful little cabin surrounded by gorgeous woods, little chickens and a smoochy ginger cat  running around. We had everything we needed in the cabin and there were lots of great things to do in Healesville and the surrounding areas. I’d recommend staying here!

We had a lovely time at the tiny wood cabin.  Sam and April had the cabin well stocked with good quality toiletries, sumptuous towels and well stocked kitchen.  We had access to a large freezer to store  our local goodies before heading home.  It was lovely peaceful tiny house experience.

Special place. Gorgeous cabin in a unique area. The hosts are great people - they have created something special. Really enjoyed my time and the atmosphere - my privacy well and truly respected. Highly recommended.

Felt a little magical to be cosied away in the tiny house, fire on with the quite of the forest around. The place was equipped with everything I needed and loved the thoughtful touches of the flowers, the fact that they have local, sustainable products, and the thick towels and linen bedsheets was a touch of luxury in the cosy rustic setting. The place has great access to forest walks which I took advantage of rather than going further afield.  It ticked all my boxes for a lovely place to unwind and feel grounded again. Thank you both.

I had a wonderful, relaxing stay at Sam & April’s tiny house. The check-in was easy and the grounds are beautiful to relax in. Very comfortable bed and everything you need in the kitchen. Would highly recommend for some relaxation!
Also friendly animals on the property too who come and say hello :)

Lovely little cabin, very cosy. Enjoyed the garden: listening to all the birds and watching the chickens (never gets boring). April and Sam were very easy and quick to communicate with. The cabin is easy to find and check-in was flawless. Kitchen is well equipped to make your own meals and different milks, eggs, tea, granola etc provided. Very generous! Enjoyed a bath with the light of the salt lamp in the evening :) Thanks for all the tips April and Sam! I loved brekkie at Nancy of the Valley in Yarra Junction, went to 7 Acre Rock for sunset and Reid’s Tramline walk (just down the road from the cabin) was a beautiful rainforest experience.
We had a lovely weekend! The tiny home is adorable and in a beautiful location, looking out onto the forest. We had a great time, and would recommend staying.

The little cottage was such a lovely and cozy getaway for the two of us, and the area was peaceful, close to some lovely nature walks and hikes. We brought our own food to cook on the stove for breakfast and dinner, and the kitchen had all the cooking things we needed. There is a Woolies about 20 mins drive if you need to stock up on supplies, so that came in handy. We brought some board games with us, but there are some games and books supplied to keep you busy.
I would definitely recommend the tiny home for a weekend getaway. Be sure to make the most of the local nature walks too.

Gorgeous handmade timber cabin in a quiet but easily reached pocket of the Yarra Ranges. It's a nice combination of rustic and refined, with the rough timber section joinery and exposed plumbing offset by really good quality kitchenware and bed linen. One of the few I'm already eager to return to. Great nook to hide away and mosey about the local wildes, or use as a base for some of the less frequented central vic forest walks.

Sam and April's tiny home is magical. A warm and inviting retreat in the middle of a lush green forest. They gave lots of great local information on things to see and do while providing some delicious essentials on arrival. The space was great for getting some writing done and providing a peaceful vibe to decompress. I'll really hope I can come back soon and stay longer next time around.

Gorgeous place for a relaxing break.
We had a fantastic long weekend in this cosy space. Great fire, kitchen with everything we needed to make dinner, comfy bed and lovely creative touches. We enjoyed the board games and the sounds of nature all around us.
Can’t recommend enough - thank you for creating a very special home away from home!

I absolutely adored the few days I got to spend here. The serenity of the little cabin was something almost indescribable. Such a beautiful place to spend a few days to just exist and, be. Thankyou so much for creating and sharing with us this breathtaking space.

This is such a cute place. I spent a dreamy few nights here. The surrounding forest is stunning. Omg and the fireplace and the bath, so so so lovely. The host/s were super responsive and friendly. I would stay again, for sure!
We had a lovely stay in the beautiful rainforest. The house had everything we needed. Sam was very helpful.
Had a great time in Powelltown. some lovely walks and very cosy sitting with the fire and a book. perfect weekend getaway.
We had a lovely stay at this tiny house. The place was very rustic and you can expect to hear the sound of wildlife around the house, especially in the morning and at night.

A beautiful place in a gorgeous location. Quirky little cabin that made you feel like you’d been transported back in time. Between the kookaburras, the chickens and the other sounds of the forest, it was a serene and peaceful getaway. Thank you!
Had a beautiful stay at the tiny house. Loved the small, thoughtful touches. Thanks for having us.
Absolutely gorgeous cottage. Every little detail is beautiful and it's set in a lovely garden. Had a wonderful stay.

The tiny house was beautiful and cozy
Kara says: 10/10 got visited by a cat, then shortly after by a dog, both friendly.
Ashley says: liked the wooden railings

What an amazing and special place to stay! We were greeted by a lovely cat named Chester and some fresh eggs from the chickens on arrival and the nights we spent at the tiny house were so peaceful. Walking tracks around the area are easy to find as well and it was a great spot to reconnect with nature and enjoy some down time.

My partner and I stayed here for the long weekend and we had a fantastic time.  The little house is full of character and it was perfect for recharging away from the city. We also enjoyed the eco friendly touches. It’s a beautifully charming space and we enjoyed every part of it, would recommend.

Always a pleasure to stay at Sam and Aprils' Tiny House. This is my second return and this visit include their wonderful and friendly animals. The house is rustic but modern and clean, and the surrounding garden/forrest is peaceful and a great nature escape. I love coming here!!
the cottage was an absolute dream, it feels like a little fairy cottage! can highly recommend for a romantic weekend stay :) thanks so much Sam, April, family and pets!

A lovely small property that fits a lot of personality into tiny footprint. It was very comfortable for two people - a reflection of the care and thought that have gone into creating and maintaining the space.
A beautiful area with lots to see and explore - we had a lovely time visiting and hope to return again!

This was such a beautiful place to stay, so cosy and welcoming and has a whimsical feel. April and kids were so welcoming to us and we really enjoyed our weekend.
We will definitely be back ! 💛✨

Lovely stay, feeling ‘off-grid’ in a cute, cosy cabin. We really enjoyed how quiet and secluded it felt, and heating the cabin via wood fire was fun and felt very cosy. Easy to follow instructions and great recommendations - overall we had a fantastic weekend and really enjoyed our experience here :)

Thank you so much to April and her family for an awesome stay.  We particularly loved the visits from her cats, dogs and family.  The tiny house is perfectly located with walking tracks literally behind the property and at the front of the property - just what we needed for a weekend away in the forest.  April was so responsive and was able to help us when we couldn't figure out how to light the fire properly. Thank you again for letting us stay in your lovely house!

The house was accurately described with all the facilities we needed for a family stay during a house move. Eva was quick to respond when I needed help getting in, and left some useful condiments and breakfast foods. The house is located in a pleasant residential area near a small park, and close to trams and train.

Well appointed house great for families with easy access by public transport into Melbourne and by car to the countryside and airport.  Good choice of restaurants in easy walking distance.  We had a great stay and would happily recommend to others.
Loved everything about Evas house. The location was fantastic, it was extremely clean and very comfortable and Eva was a fantastic host! Couldn't recommend this house enough!

Eva's place is beautiful. Clean and emaculately tidy. Lovely and cosy for a quiet night in with friends. Everything we needed was in the house. The beds were very comfy and it was great getting up to all we needed for breakfast and preparing it in the gorgeous kitchen. Eva is quick to respond to messages and check in and out was easy. The house is in the perfect location, slightly suburban but close to everything.

We found Eva's home a special place to stay. Her special touches made us feel as part of the family.  Our family loved the modern feel of the home. A 5 minute walk had us surrounded by cafes restaurants and shops and Melbourne was an enjoyable tram trip away. Eva's place will be top of the list when we next return to Melbourne

This gorgeous home was absolutely perfect for my family of 5 on our recent trip to Melbourne. Conveniently located adjacent to one of Melbourne's tram routes as well as a freeway, it was well-situated for trips into the central business district and the countryside. Eva was a wonderful host and a great communicator, too.
Eva is a first class host and the house is gorgeous. Beautiful thoughtful touches and a wonderful, stylish, comfortable and welcoming home and experience. Highly recommend anyone to stay.
The house is very stylish & clean, close to Flemington Racecourse, near trams, a great place to stay.
Great location, beautiful property.  Had a fabulous stay, very well catered for.  Will definitely be back!

Eva's home is stunning.  The location is fantastic with everything you could need literally at your doorstep.  The extra touches such as milk in the fridge and bread in the pantry are such a welcome sight when you arrive after a long drive and have forgotten to pick up the essentials.  The beds are all cozy and comfortable and the surrounding area is nice and quiet.  Very happy we were able to stay here and would definitely stay again.

We had a lovely stay at Eva’s home. Communication was great and check-in was easy (and early too!). This was a great location for us to visit family in the area but also wonderful to be able to walk to supermarket, great restaurants and also lots of good playgrounds for our toddler.
Gorgeous house - lots of room and beautifully renovated - had everything we needed and Eva was a lovely host - highly recommend Eva’s place 😊

This house was just perfect for a quick getaway with our small group of 5. It is cozy and modern with a spectacular bathroom. The local brewery only a block away was also great fun. Eva left us yummy breakfast supplies which were absolutely perfect for our late evening return following a night on the town! We will be back!
Had a lovely couple of days in Melbourne the house was just beautiful was close to the tram stop so we were able to leave the car and Eva even provided a parking permit which was really great.
I was blown away by the space, it exceeded my expectations. The place was clean and more spacious than I thought. Beautiful house I only wish I could’ve stayed longer

We loved this house, spacious with everything we needed. Perfect for a weekend in the city - close to everything. Beds were comfortable, great courtyard and everything was clean and welcoming.  Thank you.
We stayed at Eva's place for one night. Lovely little terrace house in a quiet location close to shops. Would stay again.
It is a nice place to stay. We have all needed stuff in the house. It’s very clean and quiet.

We really enjoyed out stay at Eva's place. Its well designed and a really cool place, with good size bedrooms and a neat loft which the kids enjoyed sleeping in. Its close to tram stop and restaurants and not too far from the city. We walked to Queen Victoria Markets in about 40 mins. It has easy access from the expressway if you're in a car, its just one or two turns and about 2 mins from the exit. We'd stay again.

Eva was an ideal hostess, proactive in providing all relevant information and leaving some breakfast items to get us started. The house was as advertised and in particular I would note we had a very comfortable bed and the heating coped well with the very cold weather. There is a wood fire which we didn’t have an opportunity to use.

Wonderful property that is obviously new to Airbnb and the thoughtful owners have taken consideration of previous reviews, as our stay was impeccable and problems were addressed immediately. Very friendly neighbors too (our car broke down and they jump started us). Thanks for sharing your inspiring space! Definitely one for the architecture nerds out there. We would love to come back.

We spend three wonderful nights at Kent's lovely home, which is quintessential Warrandyte - peaceful and surrounded by gum trees.  The architecture in this home is incredible, offering glorious views in all directions. Our warm and accomodating host Kent, was available and happy to meet our needs. The highlights of our stay, were that it was a family friendly home, with a trampoline, a great fire place with plenty of firewood, an outside firepit and two tree swings, an enormous backyard backing a state forest with walking trails beside the Yarra River. In the mornings there are friendly cockatoos, rosellas and gallahs in the tall gum trees. We had a relaxing and peaceful stay, the entire property has an amazing energy. Looking forward to coming again soon.

An absolutely beautiful setting to unwind and restore yourself with loved ones! The Yarra river is just at the back of the property... perfect location and surrounds for nature walks! The house is spectacular, clean and well kitted out for a truly relaxing stay. Just 35mins from Melbourne, you won't even need to invest lots of time getting there & home again!
My friends and I had such a wonderful & relaxing weekend here. There's already talk of coming back for another stay!
5 stars, gorgeous location and amazing stylish space! Outdoor bath was a fantastic touch; would stay again.

This is a beautiful house in gorgeous native surrounds however the photos do appear a little better than the state the house was in when we arrived. communication and check-in were both flawless, and the morning visits from the local birds were a highlight!

This property is absolutely beautiful. It gave all our family an opportunity to be together which is quite rare. It is a perfect location where you are not far from the city but feel like you're in another world. The birdlife is exquisite and I could not believe how you can take a short walk and you are swimming or just admiring the amazing Yarra River. I would definitely recommend this property. Its facilities accommodates a large family or just a romantic getaway. Ten out of Ten.
Excellent place. Location is the best. So close to the river and so tranquil. Just the perfect getaway from the rat race. Would definitely book again in summer or winter.
Incredible space, beautifully designed. The kitchen is well stocked with cookware and cutlery and the grounds are amazing. Love sleep in the glass cabin!

Our stay At Casa Warrandyte was absolutely divine. It really is such a beautiful space. We were able to unwind and slow down really quickly. We stayed over an extremely hot weekend which was perfect with the swimming spot so close by.  Waking up surrounded by the bush and birdsong. Such a dream, we hope to stay again soon. Thank you so much!
A lovely, tranquil location and a beautifully styled home. Thank you for the personal recommendations as well. It was a memorable stay.

This home is nestled in the bush so close to the beautiful Yarra River. Truely sacred land. The bird life was so rich, we saw so many different types while there for x2 nights. The home is very unique and well designed with a warm timber 70’s feel. As described it is a retreat vibe, very comfortable laid back space to relax with friends, make your own meals and just admire the sounds and sights of the bush. We had a few notes to share with the host in regards to some general maintenance but otherwise we had a very nice stay. Thankyou for having us!

We absolutely loved this house and would highly recommend staying here. The house was beautiful and exceptionally clean. It had all the comforts of home. It was a beautiful property and very peaceful.

We had a delicious weekend away with friends here. The house we think looks even better in person, is super cosy and fully equipped. It was quiet, surrounded by greenery and wildlife (parrots, Tawny Frogmouths and saw wombat tracks) and a nice walk into town or along the Yarra. A lovely time.

A memorable house in a lovely location. We loved the proximity to the swimming spot, and the peaceful morning walks along the river surrounded by all the native birds. The house was a special place to celebrate my dads birthdays. Very big deck great for bbqs and sitting in the nature. Joshua was very quick to help us when we were missing some things and to also arrange the kayaks for us. Thanks!

We had a wonderful, special stay with our family at this lovely, unique house, and loved it's proximity to our wedding venue. The surrounds were as advertised, beautifully surrounded by the forest and with a special vibe to its architecture. Host was prompt in communication and we had all that we needed provided, great toiletries and a well stocked full kitchen and irons etc. All worked and overall we enjoyed the stay very much. Thanks Kent and team!
Beautiful retreat spot! The whole family had an awesome time. Attentive and responsive hosts. Can't wait to return!

Cannot express enough how magical this place was ! If you’re looking to switch off or for the perfect winter getaway, this is the place. Surrounded by nature and only a short walk to town. Dare I mention the indoor fireplace !! Highly rate and will most definitely be back.

The architecture of the house is lovely and with some attention has big potential to be stunning! Unfortunately we didn’t feel like the photos matched real life and found it to be a more tired version of what is presented in the listing, including the furniture. Basic supplies were minimal and the dishwasher didn’t work (as noted in other reviews).
We definitely made the most of the stay but feel a little more attention to detail and freshening up the guest experience would be valuable!

We had an amazing stay here.
Was so peaceful and relaxing.
Wouldn’t hesitate to come back for another stay.
We left far more relaxed than when we came in.
Such a great clean space and very spacious.
Thank you for accomodating us.

This apartment in South Yarra is located perfectly not only for visitors to Melbourne Park for the Australian Open but also if you want to explore the Botanical Gardens and surrounds. It is very close to the city but it also provides very nice green surroundings to enjoy a stay in Melbourne. We enjoyed our early morning walks. The cafes and restaurants close at hand means you don't need to venture far to enjoy a good coffee, yummy patisseries and delicious meals, saving on transport costs. The air conditioning was a huge welcome in the summer heat.
Locating the actual apartment in the block wasn't straightforward, but we worked it out.
This property is absolutely beautiful! We loved our stay and if we had an event in the South Yarra again would definitely not hesitate to stay here

Cath's space is full of love light and a practical location and space itself, we were so grateful. At this time for us to be in close proximity to our niece. Cath is great and you will be happy with the space, it is clean and everything was perfect:))
Thank you Cath
Just as the description, the apartment has enough appliances for you to cook and is pretty confy and well located.
Nice older apartment in a cool neighborhood. Host was very responsive and accommodating. The washer/dryer unit was difficult to operate and loud, but otherwise a we had a good stay.
I really loved my stay here, it was like a home away from home. I especially loved the kitchen which was equipped with the highest of standard ammenities.

I cannot recommend Cath's place enough. We decided to spend a couple of days working here and absolutely loved it. The house was beautifully styled and spotless, having a desk was also incredibly convenient for work. The location is incredible and Cath was there to help us with any questions we had during our stay. Cannot recommend the place enough, I'll definitely be booking again.
We loved our stay at this apartment. It was such a great location handy to amenities and in a quiet street. The instructions for checking in were so clear, that even arriving in the rain was easy.

Loved our stay in this comfortable and quiet period apartment. Location was top-notch. Really enjoyed being able to walk through the iconic botanic gardens and into the CBD or to Toorak Rd for a great choice of cafes and restaurants.
This is a charming well styled comfortable flat.  Loved the area it was situated in and would definitely return.

Great apartment in a lovely Art Deco building; very comfortable main bed and lovely view of city lights; great location with Domain Rd cafes, bars and botanic gardens around corner, and chapel st, trams and train close by

Cath's  place was a beautiful art deco, sun filled apartment with great proximity to public transport and a short stroll away from cafes and restaurants. The beds were comfortable and the apartment was surprisingly peaceful considering it was literally around the corner from a tram that takes you into the city or buses that take you to the iconic Fitzroy. I would definitely stay again!
Great apartment, super handy location and it felt very homely. Was the perfect spot for two nights at the end of our trip to Melbourne and the hosts were so helpful and accommodating.
Great place close to parks, restaurants,  markets. Very comfortable beds too! A perfect place to stay.

Fabulous place to stay. Comfortable, clean, perfectly located, easy access to public transport, beautiful walks & delicious places to eat. It was a pleasure returning to this peaceful, relaxing & comfortable place to stay at the end of a busy day. Can highly recommend this art deco beauty.
Great location in South Yarra, peaceful but close to everything. Natalia was really responsive and flexible, would stay again!
Location was perfect right by the botanic gardens on the cutest street. The flat was nicely decorated. Shame the balcony wasn’t able to be used, but the natural light was great.

Almost don't want to share this hidden gem - with the Airbnb community.
I'm a melbournian who's lived in Melbourne for 20+ years, the view from the apartment is the best I've seen to date and the photos don't do it justice. Shane's a great guy, very helpful and even allowed us to extend our stay at a discount. Highly recommend

best place ever! such a unique view over melbournes skyline from the huge terrace.. beautiful appartement with more than all you could need or ask for- just loved every single second of our stay!!! shane was great to communicate with and had some great recommendations concerning breaky+dinner (don't miss out on "friends of mine"+ "pasta adagio"- both in easy walking distance).. more than highly recommended- we would just love to come back again+again+again... ;-))) thank you shane for sharing this wonderful place!!!

When my stay is smooth and everything that I need worked out as planned, I tend to forget the price. In this case, Shane’s place was exactly what I needed. I travelled with my mother on wheelchair and having the space that Shane had, it gave us the convenience and freedom to move around without getting into each other’s way. I felt right at home the minute I checked in, and everything else was clockwork.
You don’t really need a car as the tram is just a 5 minutes walk towards the Rising Sun Hotel and there is a lot of conveniences within 5-20 mins walk. A 5-star Airbnb if you don’t need a gym or pool. Plus I’ve learnt a lot here in how to run an Airbnb if ever I had one.
I will definitely come back and stay here whenever available and I’m so appreciative of Shane and Gina’s kindness.

A wonderful 2-br penthouse in Richmond with a fabulous balcony for entertainment and an amazing view of the cityscape. Also appreciated all the cooking equipment. We really enjoyed Shane's place and would gladly stay again in the future!

We had the best time at Shane's apartment! The balcony and views are both amazing. The apartment is spacious, tidy and just as it looks in the images.
The plants throughout are a beautiful touch and the location is nice and peaceful with coffee shops meters from the entrance while only a 10min drive to the city.
Shane was so easy to deal with and I would highly recommend staying in his apartment.

This apartment was absolutely fabulous for my mam, myself, my partner and our toddler. Gorgeous bedrooms and a fantastic outdoor area with a beautiful view. Ideal for sitting out and eating :) we really enjoyed our time here, great restaurants and cafes in walking distance and also close to transport. Hosts were very friendly and responsive, easy check in and out. Would highly recommend. Thank you

Very easy stay - no issues.
A well presented property with two good sized rooms and bathrooms. Perfect for two couples or two friends.
Close to the tram if you are going to any of the sports venues.
A few cafes on the street which makes it easy to grab a quick coffee or breakfast to start the day.
Nice indoor and outdoor space.
Overall a great stay.

For a first time in Melbourne this was such a convenient place to stay with beautiful views of the city and lots of space.  Hosts were very friendly and responsive. Would happily stay here again. Thank you guys!
Lovely stay! Amazing view, place was modern and clean and great location close to plenty of coffee shops and restaurants

i dont think you can get a better view of Melbourne CBD than this place.
nicely decorated, decent size, fantastic terrace.

We were very happy with Kat's apartment! It was cute, cosy and modern. For small apartment it packs a big punch. Great space for a single or a couple. And the bathroom has a bath! The bed is super comfy and the balcony adds a great touch. The location is perfect - right across the road from the Melbourne Museum and Imax, a very short walk from groovy Brunswick St and an easy stroll into the city. Really great spot to base a Melbourne visit. The Cairo apartments themselves are gorgeous - art deco style so really add to the Melbourne ambiance. Kat and Simon supplied everything we needed and were perfect hosts - very helpful and extremely responsive.

Stylish space in great location. Nice towels and bed linen. Great location with beautiful leafy outlook, a lovely place to retreat to from cool Fitzroy. Cafes, bars and shops very close. Lots of lovely touches like the travel cards. The place was spotlessly clean and prettier than it looks in the photos. Everything was easy and I really appreciated the healthy snacks and breakfast options. ( plus the pod coffee) All in all a fabulous stay, I've found my new spot in Melbourne!

We enjoyed our stay at Kat’s place. Instructions to do the self check-in were clear and we didn’t have any issues. The apartment is small but cosy and very comfortable. It is in a fantastic location and easily accessible by public transport. The bed is very comfortable and we slept well. The kitchen is an extra bonus and has everything you need. The bathroom is large and even has a bath! Thanks Kat for having us stay! We will be back!

Kat's place is wonderful. Perfectly located with a tram stop right out front and an easy stroll to all the eateries and bars around Brunswick St. Kat caters for her guests very well with lots of thoughtful touches making it the perfect base to explore Melbourne. We didn't want to leave and will definitely go back.
Great place, close to lots of great cafes and unique shops and easy transport options into the city. Check in was easy the apartment had everything we needed.

We agree with the great comments that others have said about Kat's place - cosy, warm (it's winter!)  and very clean, well equipped with some nice extra touches, a fantastically comfortable bed, well located and she was also great to deal with. Highly recommend. Thanks again Kat.

Kats place was delightful - with a lovely view of a private garden. The aprtment is North facing so it has lovely winter sun beaming in. It is very close to No.96 tram stop and across the road fromt the lovely Carlton Gardens

Apartment is cosy and perfect. Clean, comfortable and well stocked with everything you need. Location is great - really close to the happening areas of Carlton, Collingwood, and Fitzroy, and to the CBD. A bit of noise for a short period of the day from what seemed to be the construction of the Metro rail tunnel that's happening in Melbourne at the moment, but this didn't affect my stay too much. I would choose Kat's place again in the future!

We loved the studio & really enjoyed our stay. Can not fault the cleanliness, quick responses, and lovely little touches that greet you on arrival. Kat also left travel cards for the tram & a local guide book as well as walking tour maps which made a real difference to making the most of our time in Melbourne. The studio is very conveniently located for getting into the city, with great tram links if you are looking to explore further afield. Would highly recommend this studio to anyone looking for a comfortable & cosy stay in Melbourne.

Easily my favorite place I stayed in Australia. The location was PERFECT, the apartment itself was lovely, and Kat was very easy to communicate with. She also provided lots of suggestions for things to do and places to eat in Melbourne.

Kat's place was perfect, as beautiful as the pictures suggested and extremely clean. It is well located and in a wonderful neighborhood. She was flexible with check in and check out and very communicative, which I really appreciated.

Kat’s place was just what we needed. Charming, as in pictures. In a really nice neighbourhood across from a park with the museum. Plenty of eateries, coffee places and bars in the area. Would recommend this to anyone who does not want to be in the CBD but within a few minutes of it by walking.

Great location, cosy but has everything you need for a weekend or longer stay.
Kat was the perfect host, great communication and very helpful.
Kats place is in a terrific location, it’s tiny but well appointed and sparkling clean. I loved it.

Staying at the iconic Cairo apartment building was a pleasure - quiet, beautiful setting in the middle of Melbourne. Perfect location to fully experience Melbourne culture.
Kat has thought of everything for a fun Melbourne visit!
Very clean place in a great location. Directions to get in were clear and host was very flexible and helpful with the process.

Kat's studio is in a great location. Close to cafes and restaurants. it's clean and tidy with big full length glass windows leading to a small balcony sheltered by trees. I hope to make this my regular stop when I have to visit Melbourne for business.
Had a lovely stay at Kats place. Short and sweet. It was so relaxing to wake up to the birds and greenery outside, but still be so close to Fitzroy shops, cafes and more.

Great unit with lots of character. Amazing location as well with most places accessible by foot.
Great communication with Kat, and very useful recommendations for local spots too.
Lovely little cosy studio, perfect for what I needed.  We’ll stocked kitchen and bathroom bits made it really pleasant to stay.

Our stay in Kat's flat was lovely - the space has everything you need for a short stay and the location is unbeatable. The building and gardens are truly special and we enjoyed breakfast on the balcony overlooking the garden each morning. Kat was a great host and we highly recommend her flat for anyone travelling to Melbourne!
Beautiful place with everything you need. It's location is fantastic - the garden is lovely and waking up with singing birds is the best.

Amazing stay. Apartment is clean and comfortable. Kitchen is fully equiped with everything you need to cook in. Bed is comfortable and TV has Netflix. Kat made our stay by offering us a parking pass allowing us to park on the streets around the apartment which was super handy! Would definitely recommend.

Kats place was fantastic. in such a beautiful spot and close to everything we needed, including great cafes and bars, Princess theatre, museum and some great parks.
Host was proactive and gave some great recommendations surrounding the local area.
Would love to stay again some time
Great little Airbnb in Fitzroy. The location was just what we were after. Host was lovely - providing Myki cards to use the tram is really handy.

The location makes this flat - so easy to walk into the city centre, to Melbourne Park or to Fitzroy. There is also a tram stop on the road so you can still get around really easily if you don’t fancy walking. It’s also a bonus to have the little balcony overlooking the communal garden. Would recommend for two people looking for a base to explore the city.
Cosy and comfortable studio in a great location, I had a very good visit to Melbourne. Tram stop is right outside, so it was very easy to explore.  I would recommend.
We loved staying in Kat's studio! Position was fantastic. It was peaceful, private, cute, cosy and warm! Everything we needed with lots of thoughtful extra touches.

Kats place was in a fantastic location so close to the hub of great hotels, wine bars and shops in Fitzroy and a very easy walk into the CBD.
The apartment had everything we needed for our weekend stay and the use of the provided on street parking permit was so helpful.
Facilities were clean and well equipped. Bed was very comfortable.
Clear instructions from Kat re entering and exiting the property on our arrival made it stress free and the visitor information folder provided was relevant and comprehensive.
At all times felt safe and secure there. Would highly recommend.

Kat’s apartment was in the perfect location for exploring Melbourne - great bars, restaurants and cafes close by and super easy access to the tram. Although the space is small, it is clutter free and perfect base for a couple or single and we loved having coffee on the little balcony. Despite being so close to the hustle and bustle it was really quiet and peaceful. We would come back and stay in a heartbeat.

l lucked out finding Kat's place near a conference I was attending. Set in a gorgeous oasis of green in a fantastic location near Brunswick street, the place stood out with its artistry and class. Numerous aspects like beautiful fixtures (the matching door, drawer and cupboard handles), the art, the quality appliances, the comfortable bed, and the general way it was decked out made my stay in Melbourne that much better. I found myself skipping a couple sessions at the conference because I enjoyed hanging out there so much. Thanks Kat for putting in the effort to make the place so lovely.
Great apartment and location. Good light and everything you need. I’d definitely stay again. Highly recommended.

We loved our stay at Kat’s place. This was our second visit and we hope to visit again! Kat is very responsive and helpful, she accommodated our requests professionally and was always prompt with responses. Big thanks to Simon for the recommendation for the best Banh Mi - it did not disappoint! See you again soon!

What an amazing location. A perfect spot from which to ride the free city trams and explore Melbourne. Loved the history of the Cairo apartments.
The apartment is compact but has a lovely balcony. We did miss not having air conditioning, but the fan provided definitely helped.

A+++
We had a wonderful stay. Private, comfortable, and handy location.
Host is amazing. excellent communication and very accomodating. Will remember this place for next time :)

A lovely little place! The apartment block is really pretty and green - a beautiful oasis! The apartment is close to cafes, restaurants, shopping and the city, and the tram stop is right out the front!
Best location in Melbourne. Felt very private with birds singing in the trees outside. Great place to stay 😊
We loved staying at Kats! The apartment was exactly as photographed and described, a really great space for 1 or 2 people. Walkable to good locations too :)

Kat’s place was the most wonderful little base for exploring Melbourne city, Fitzroy, Carlton and Collingwood on foot. Right opposite Melbourne Museum it’s one or two stops out from the free tram zone. Being a studio the apartment is small, but great if you’re planning on spending most of your time outside. Staying in the heritage listed Cairo Flats was also a beautiful treat. The balcony provides the chance to get some fresh air and provides a nice location for a morning tea or coffee.

This little studio is definitely compact but had all the essentials we needed. Finding a legal parking spot was initially challenging but eventually found some reliably available parking for permit holders.

We loved Kat and Simon's place, a light filled room looking out at trees in the middle of the city. It was warm and comfortable and even though it is a small space it was pleasant to be in the room during the day, especially in the morning as it gets the early sun which is wonderful in winter.
I would definitely recommend this place to others.
A serene getaway set amongst a gorgeous cottage garden, strawberry patch and stunning views. Andrea was easy to deal with and the house was clean and comfortable.

A bit expensive, but really nice place. Very clean and modern. It was really nice that it’s located next to a strawberry farm, with beautiful view, but bear in mind that it’s quite secluded and not close to the shops. Overall, would definitely stay here again for a weekend getaway!

I would thoroughly recommend staying at this gorgeous house.  The location was beautiful - surrounded by strawberry fields!  The house was stylish and perfect for our 3 boys.  Plenty of space and lovely country charm.  I would definitely stay here again!
Andrea was so great! The place was amazing! I stayed here for the night before my wedding and it was lovely to get ready in and photographed beautifully!

This is literally the most amazing Air Bnb that I have ever stayed in. The property is insanely beautiful and completely picturesque. The surrounding strawberry fields are so lovely and make you feel totally at peace. The property has a pool/entertaining room, wooden floors, lots of places to have a quiet read, and a bunch of places to gather and have meals and conversations together. My friends and I couldn't stop commenting on how lucky we were to be staying in such a wonderful place. If you are tossing up between this property and another, I would definitely recommend you pick this place. It is exceptionally unique and Andrea the host couldn't have been more useful and hospitable. Will be visiting again for sure!
Very clean and well maintained property with period features. Surrounded by strawberry farm. Excellent views. Lots of outdoor relaxing areas. Excellent and very kind host. Loved it.

11/10!!! Best accommodation ever.
We spent our wedding weekend at this stunning property.
Andrea was warm, friendly and very easy to communicate with (even after all the pandemic uncertainty).
The property was just beautiful and allowed us to use the grounds for my pre-wedding photos.
The house was cosy, very clean, had great amenities and was close by to a range of shops.
We will definitely be coming back, such an incredible and special place to us.
Thanks again Andrea!

Our stay at this property was nothing short of superb! Andrea was welcoming and friendly - this really felt like a home away from home. There were so many amazing, beautiful and luxurious spaces to enjoy both inside and outside; we absolutely fell in love with this home. The children were also really well catered for (toys, games, children's cutlery, cups, plates, etc.), which made them feel welcome and at ease. Rooms were spacious and well-appointed; we had everything we needed when we needed it. The location was great - access to short walks, long walks and amenities. We are already looking forward to our next visit!
We loved our stay. Plenty of space for two couples. Great peaceful location and an easy drive to many wineries in the Yarra Valley.

Our family of four stayed for 3 weeks and absolutely loved it! The house is lovely, with charming vintage details AND modern comforts.  It was winter and cold outside but the house was always perfectly warm. The surrounding gardens, strawberry fields, and views are absolutely stunning. It was peaceful, private, and convenient to the places and people we wanted to visit. The host Andrea is so thoughtful, kind, and responsive. I had assumed strawberry season was finished but she gifted us with the largest and sweetest strawberries we have ever had! We had a wonderful stay and would definitely choose to stay here again!

We were the strawberry farm for a wedding we were involved with elsewhere in the Yarra Valley. The stay was restful and restorative. The whole weekend a welcome break from our complex lives. Andrea really looked after us. Garden & house an inspiration.
Andrea was the perfect host.  so friendly and helpful.  We will be back for another stay as soon as we can.   My family and I found the property exceeded expectations.

This stay was an absolute dream. The house was beautiful, clean and had such lush landscaping and gardens. Andrea was so lovely and welcoming and made sure we knew how to use all the appliances. I would happily recommend this stay to anyone wanting to spend time in the area. Would happily come back!

I suggest this place to every person who is going to spend some time in Victoria. You won’t regret it! I’ll stay here until my girlfriend and I will have found the right house. The place is clean and well presented! Griff is friendly and he has a special soul too. If you can go and buy a Patek Philippe for him so he won’t ask for mines!
DVX.
God bless.

If you are looking for a beautiful, stylish home to relax in and a perfect host, book into Grifield House. Warwick is a humorous, intelligent man who will make you feel very welcomed in his home. His little dog is full of personality and very well behaved. We have stayed at this air BnB several times and have always had a wonderful visit.

Warwick is a kind, welcoming and fun host with a beautiful home. He stayed up until well past midnight to make sure I arrived safely after my flight was delayed from Sydney.
He is passionate about a wide variety of topics and is easy to get along with. Having said that, he is also one to respect your privacy.
I can highly recommend staying here. Plus Griff is a cutie and doesn't mind a cuddle or two! :)
Warwick is knowledgeable and hospitable. He stayed up late to guide us around and was up early also. His place is very comfortable and if you like dogs you will be in for a treat ;)

Warwick is a fantastic host. Everything about his home is amazing. We appreciated our conversations and breakfast including the freshly squeezed orange juice. Griff and his cat were soooo sweet! His home was clean, and he went above and beyond to make our stay really great. Thanks again Warwick! We would recommend his place to anyone

Warwick is a lovely man who likes to host people and make them feel good.
He's offering breakfast if you want one.
We had a very good stay and could only recommend this place.
If you want to visit Melbourne, it's better to have a car, at least to go to the nearest train station.

Thank you for everything
Yenni's family is nice . Room is clean and quiet. It's good to stay a period .

My first time using airbnb to book a place to stay
