The place is near the tram and bus station making it very accessible since we opt not to rent a car. He is also very hospitable since the moment we met him from airport when he picked us up, to allowing us to use Myki card, utensils, laundry essentials and stuff for cooking. He has been very helpful and generous on our stay. Cute kids and great tour recommendations as well. Privacy is good despite the place is part of the whole family house.
We enjoyed our stay!

Lovely family and very kind & helpful. Speedy response and great communications.  5 mins walk to the tram stops and 10 mins walk to the super large shopping mall/food court and etc. Thank you for looking after me. Cheers,Kerry

I had a great stay at Wenley's home. Both Wenley and Yenny were perfect hosts and they were  always willing to help whenever required.  They also provided suggestions about the places to visit in Melbourne. The children were very sweet and friendly. I never felt away from home during my stay there. The stay location is well connected to the city network. On one side the 82 number tram connects the waterford avenue to the footscray station and further to the main city. On the other side the 57 numer tram connects the waterford avenue to the queen victoria market and further to Flinders street.  Wenley picked me up and dropped me at the airport. On the very first day he helped me shop for the basic food items while coming from the airport. Yenny had lended her myki card for use during my stay there. Overall I had a fantastic Melbourne trip and I would be happy to stay at the same place during my further visits.
Very friendly and positive atmosphere in this house! Wenley and his wife were super friendly and helped me with every question i had!
Wenley is a kind and friendly host. The room and the bed are big enough for a solo traveler. The place is close to the city but no direct public transport to the city.
Wenley and Yennie were very accommodating. Always ready to help and lovely to chat with. The room is what was expected. Overall a great stay.

The room is very clean and bright, and the host is very hospitable and thoughtful. They always leave lights on for me when I return late. Thank you very much! Looking forward to seeing you again next time.
Welcoming host and the location is fairly close to the airport and CBD. Worth the price. Sometimes gets noisy and issue with cleanliness

Wenley and his wife were very hospitable my whole stay, and I adored their two kids. His wife showed me around on arrival and let me know of an app (I think called Wilson Parking 😅) to park around the city of Melbourne. I truly felt at home and the location is quiet and safe. I’m thankful to not have so many fire ants back home as their little son says that exist in Australia ❤️. Thank you all for being so kind, caring, and allowing me a place to stay in your comfortable home!

I had a great time staying at Lee's place. It was well set up and they are friendly hosts. They have kids, so there is some noise but it's not too much. Overall I felt very comfortable and at home there. Thank you for a great stay 🙏😊
This place is really splendid and welcoming, close to things that matter but far away enough for some.peace! The addition of small things such as shampoo and spices were surprising.
Good little suite. Blazing fast wifi. Note you are right by a very busy road which can get very loud during rush hour times.

We stayed here for almost 3 months and loved it. The location is fantastic. You can get into the centre of Melbourne in 20 minutes on the tram which is a 2 mins walk. The park is nearby and lovely to walk around. The balcony is great and we used the BBQ a lot. It was just what we needed in a flat and Trent was a great host. Thankyou Trent.
The apartment is well located for access to trams and Albert Park. Walkable to St Kilda and beaches. The apartment complex was great on hot days!

Trent’s apartment is oh so very convenient to the tram line (one block away) and close to great coffee shops. I get at home immediately in the space. Super comfortable bed and crisp fresh linens. Trent had set up a home-like space. Laundry with extra large drying rack (very much appreciated) with detergent so it’s worry free. The building is quiet and easy to access. Safe surroundings. Trent maintained vigilant communication throughout the two week stay. WiFi is strong and consistent. Excellent overall.

Pete was a great host and made the whole booking experience really easy. We absolutely loved his place, so close to Brunswick and Smith St which have a heaps of amazing cafes and restaurants. The apartment was clean, modern and really comfortable. We will definitely stay again when we are next in Melbourne!

Pete’s place is truly one of the most perfect homes we have stayed in and it is so not just because he’s apartment is beautiful, clean and in the most charming neighbourhood; Pete is one of the most thoughtful, sincere and welcoming host.
He’s place is exactly as it is in the photos, if not better. Thoughtful touches like phone chargers, extra towels, blankets and coffee could never be captured in these photos and these are the things that just makes it feel like home.
The cherry on top of everything else: You would be staying in the heart of Fitzroy. You are surrounded by amazing amazing cafes, restaurants, grocers, charming little shops. Fitzroy is exactly where you need to be in Melbourne.

There really aren’t enough superlatives to describe my stay at Pete’s. Although we never met in person he was charming, attentive, responsive, a great host. The apartment is in a great location accessible to CBD and surrounding neighborhoods. Breakfast across the street at Archie’s or Gabriel’s is a must. This was one of my top Airbnb experiences. If you want to something special take a day trip down the Mornington Peninsula. Hire a car and driver and see wineries, the amazing sculpture park at Pt Leo, pick strawberries, hot springs.... Its a fantastic day. It’s reasonable and customized to what you want to do. George was our guide and Driver

Pete and Pete’s Place Great!

Great location within the heart of fitzroy - near many good restaurants and cafes! Perfect accommodation for those that drive and love an apartment with all the creature comforts of home. Fully equipped kitchen for doing lots of cooking, a cosy balcony with sofas and the bed is 100/10, i did not realize such a comfortable bed existed in this world. Overall an unforgettable airbnb, will recommend to anyone and everyone

Pete has seemingly thought of everything for his AirBNB guests.  He is far and away a super-superhost!  He greeted us at the door, introduced us to his well-equipped place (with all its mod con features), provided pre-loaded tram passes, local guide and restaurant recommendations, and apt's location in Fitzroy was perfect for us.  Pete's recharging/docking station was particularly appreciated and very helpful - no need to scramble for voltage adapters, etc.  We could not have asked for better for our Melbourne stay.  We hope to return to Melbourne in the not-too-distant future.  In the meantime, we highly recommend Pete's place as a perfect spot to get anywhere and everywhere in Melbourne.

Pete’s place is a well appointed one bedroom apartment in the heart of Fitzroy. Was comfortable & stylish in a great location, plenty of restaurants in walking distance & the tram out the front to easily get to the city. Pete was very helpful & friendly & was happy to give extra information on the local area. He has the apartment well setup with everything a traveler could need & clear information on everything required for your stay. I would highly recommend his place for anyone wanting to experience Melbourne from such a great central location.

The apartment is in a great location with many great cafes and eateries within walking distance and right by the tram stop. Pete is a super superhost and I loved the amazing decor of the apartment and the high level of comfort!

What a great choice it was to stay at Pete's place!
Quite possibly one of the best locations in Melbourne, everything you need is on the same street - shops, cafes, restaurants, bars, grocers, yoga studio....and so easy to get into the city.
The plants made it feel so homely, the couch and bed were so comfy and so nice to hang out on the balcony.
For a one bedroom apartment it felt really roomy, funky kitchen set up too.
I really enjoyed returning to this place after a big day of catching up with family and friends and the ease of finding a quality morning coffee (in the same building) made my day!
Pete went to the extra trouble of personally meeting me when I arrived, and sending some toiletries I left in the bathroom immediately back to me!!
Would highly recommend this place to anyone wanting an inner city Melbourne experience.
Pete’s place is stunning, comfy and modern with everything you could ever need. Tram noise is not an issue. Pete was lovely and helpful to deal with.

We had an absolutely fabulous stay at Pete's in the heart of Fitzroy. Being right on Gertrude St, you have everything you could possibly want from a Melbourne visit on your doorstep - fantastic coffee, excellent dining options, walkability to everywhere and a tram at the door in case you want to go further afield. We loved the community vibe of Fitzroy, and Pete's apartment really let you immerse yourself in that. The apartment is quirky and fun, super clean and the owner's communication made the entire experience such an easy and enjoyable one. We cant wait to return :) Possibly our best Airbnb experience over many years using the platform.
2nd time at Pete's place - and I'll come back. It's such a lovely space and perfectly located.

Can’t recommend Pete’s place in Fitzroy enough! Pete was very easy to communicate with, responsive and helpful, and truly thought of everything from his apartment instructions to his local recommendations. The apartment itself was clean, had all of the amenities listed and made you feel right at home. It was also very safe and secure (3 fob scans required before getting to the apartment floor) which was great as a solo traveler. I had an extended stay (~1 month) and fell in love with the neighborhood - great location, very walkable, easy public transport, and great restaurants/bars/shops nearby to explore. Would definitely stay again!
Our second time staying at Pete's was as great as the first. Great apartment, great area, great host!

We really enjoyed our stay at Pete’s apartment. Even though we didn’t use it, I feel like we have to mention the beautiful modern kitchen! Very cool minimalist aesthetic with modern built-in appliances that gives a fun contrast to the rest of the space. In general there was a lot of attention to detail when it comes to decor and functional furniture/tech. We felt very much at home.
Location is obviously ideal, especially when you’re on a vegan foodie quest… Smith & Daughters being right around the corner was perfect for us! The whole area is full of great restaurants and bars, and if you happen to have spent less time in Fitzroy/Collingwood than we have, Pete’s suggestions and local guidebook would be all you need!

Martin is a very friendly and accommodating host with great communication. His place is exactly as advertised and fantastic to stay in with great location. I highly recommend staying here. Martins place is stylish private and in a great location to everything you need!
An amazing stay here. Martin’s hospitality was amazing and the House was fully equipped with everything you could need. A bonus of off street parking was great also!

This is a great apartment. It is beautifully situated in Richnomd, near pubs, cafes, shops, the Richmond station, trams, and and easy walk to the MCG. The flat is comfortable, very nicely decorated, and has heat, ac and a very well-equipped kitchen. Martin is a great communicator, a very nice guy, and super helpful. He lives around the corner, and so is readily available if you need him, and he is very responsive.  We recommend this place very highly.

Great place, great location has everything you need for Airbnb stay. We stayed the long weekend for the  Grand Final unfortunately the noise level was  considerable from other tenants in the building and neighbouring properties.

Great location close to lots of places to eat, walking distance to trams and train!
Quiet neighborhood, clean and comfy space. Nice kitchen and great bathroom!
We needed a place to stay while waiting for our new apartment to be ready. Martin was a great host. Met us on arrival to show us the place and he was just a message away should we need anything.
We were able to relax and enjoy the neighborhood and made for an easy commute to work being so close to the train station.
The use of a parking space was wonderful as we had a car as well.
I would recommend friends visiting to stay at Martin’s place!
Thank you so much for a wonderful stay!

really good apartment with easy  communication, exactly as described.- spotlessly clean and really well located. Martin is a thoughtful host and easy to get in touch with etc. highly recommended, we would stay again

Fantastic location in a very quaint neighborhood. Really gave me a great feel for Melbourne, and Richmond is probably my favorite suburb. Close to Richmond station and several trams, so you can get anywhere else very quickly. The semi-private garden adjacent the back door was a real treat to enjoy the lovely weather. And Martin was super supportive during my stay. Would certainly rebook this apartment when I’m back in town.

Great place to explore Richmond.  Beside a pub with good food and facilities. As expected can get loud at night but only happened once during our week long stay. Martin responded to our queries very promptly. A very enjoyable stay.
Awesome location in Richmond. Close to everything you could possibly need. Unit was cozy but was perfect for a week's stay in Melbourne. Martin was communicative and helpful throughout. Recommended!

Very convenient location for 3 of us visiting friends in Richmond. Close to restaurants, pubs and convenience shopping. 5 min walk to Richmond rail station and then 1 stop to Spring St. Close to MCG, AAMI, etc. Surprisingly quiet given Tavern less than 50m away!  All in all very good although the shower was just a trickle (reported to host) and fridge hadn’t been emptied from previous guest. No body wash in shower. Apart from shower all very minor and we had a great time. Would return.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The place was immaculately clean and well-maintained. Its location is fantastic, being very close to numerous food options and convenient tram stops that make getting into the city a breeze. I felt comfortable and at home during my stay and would definitely choose to stay here again in the future. Highly recommended!
We had a lovely stay. Place was neat and tidy. Martin was a great host with clear and timely communication.
Martin was always responsive and made the check in and out instructions very clear. Very nice place, i’ve got nothing bad to say about it.
Nadine and Chris were so helpful with suggestions and communicated so quickly! Apartment was fabulous and highly would recommend to anyone.
We loved our stay at Nadine & Chris’ place. It was immaculate, in a wonderful location and an all round treat. Would highly recommend, very luxurious. Thanks for having us!

Absolutely beautiful and stylish apartment. Everything is thought of and presented with flare.
The thoughtful welcoming hamper was much appreciated.
There were no breakfast provisions (tea and coffee supplied but we don’t drink) but the shops were so close that we walked to a local bakery and supermarket to grab supplies.
Thanks again for such a great place to stay. We will be back.

This is definitely a good and enjoyable place to stay if you travel to Melbourne. House facilities are well prepared and the house is crystal clean! Our family love here and quite enjoyed staying here! We will definitely come back next time when we are in Melbourne!

So many things to say about Nadine&Chris’s place. I’ll start by saying thank you for hosting  us ! The apartment is situated in one of the best areas of the city with all you need being 5 minutes walk, restaurants, supermarkets and so on..  The flat was very clean, provided with everything  we need, having a great view and a beautiful garden! Nadine and Chris are very friends people and I dare to say that they are our friends now ! We will definitely get back and stay with them again !

Our second (& definitely not our last) stay in this lovely stylish property.
The apartment is light filled & comfortable with the added bonus of having 2 balcony’s front & back. Great space with super comfy beds.
Toorak is a lovely location , easy to access all that Melbourne has to offer , or have some peace & quiet.
Nadine & Chris are gracious hosts,. They are kind, responsive, & were accommodating if we needed any help.
This place is terrific. Great location not far from the CBD. Nadine & Chris's attention to detail is great and the view of the city is amazing!

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this fabulous Art Deco
Apartment.

Leaving tonic water and wonderful bread and nibbles.
Everything was quality.
Comfortable ,private,
We felt very at home.Didnt feel like we had entered someone else’s space.
Well decorated.
Our hosts have nailed it.
Overall excellent.

Lovely apartment. Spotlessly clean. Beautiful bread and french butter! Very thoughtful hosts. Quiet top location.
Only tip would be to bring eye mask if light bothers you at night as although blinds in bedroom, outside lights on all night and comes through cracks.
Really worth staying here.
Thank you Chris and Nadine for the perfect oasis in Melbourne! Such a clean, bright and gorgeous apartment we are looking forward to staying at again when we are in Melbourne next!

We stayed here a few times pre-covid and it was better than we remembered.
Lovely peaceful location, with views of city one side and lovely garden on the other side. Great amenities, spacious, treats on check in and super clean and comfy.
What makes this place even more lovely is the hospitality and flexibility of the hosts Nadine and Chris.
Great place in a wonderful residential neighborhood. The furnishings are exceptional, the natural lights is energizing, and the place is immaculate.  You couldn't ask for better hosts.
Such a great spot to stay!! It is a beautiful space and the little touches make you feel right at home. Can’t wait to come back!
Great location in a lovely neighbourhood. The apartment is beautiful with a great view of the city and has everything you need. We could have stayed for weeks!

Lovely & comfortable 2 bedroom apartment. Stylish art deco decor. Great city views in a convenient, quiet location. Sparkling clean and very thoughtfully stocked. One of the best airbnb places we have stayed in. We loved it and would highly recommend.
Fabulous airbnb with good amenities and in a great location. Nadine and Chris are wonderful hosts.
Very friendly and helpful hosts. House was lovely and warm and very clean. They were very considerate when our flight got cancelled due to bad weather. Will definitely be returning.

Renae’s home is beautiful, well appointed, well situated and welcoming.
We have loved our stay and have appreciated all the kindness and hospitality shown to us. The location really is amazing! It’s close to shops, restaurants and less than a two minute stroll to the tram stop.
Renae and Mike responded when needed, gave us space and left lovely gifts often.
We wish we could stay longer! Thank you Renae and Mike for our stay!

Renae has decorated this apartment very stylishly to suit the bright nature of the rooms and city views. All the little things that Renae does regularly makes this comfortable Hawthorn apartment a place you won’t want to leave! 😀
Very nice cosy place, close to the station, and most importantly the hosts were the friendliest people.

I really enjoyed my stay with Dahlia, Sam & Shnooze. I felt very welcome from the moment I arrived and really appreciated the comfort of the suite as well as the semi self-contained aspect and the fact that I was able to have my dog with me.  Thanks Dahlia and Sam for creating such a great space for others to enjoy as well as providing a perfect combination of privacy and hospitality :) I hope I'll be back sometime.

Nothing less than perfect. Lovely Host and beautiful place with much comfort. Highly recommend!!
Thank you very much

Dahlia is very welcoming and we felt comfortable staying.   It was great to be able to open our door and know that our 2 small dogs were safe.    It is one room and an en suite, however, the room is quite large so we didn’t feel cramped.

The room is cozy and clean. You can even cook as oven and microwave are provided. Dahlia and her family are so nice and made me feel so warm. We become friends now and will definitely keep in touch with them.
great place to stay for a short time. Dahlia was a great host, very friendly and responsive but respectful of your space. would 100% stay there again
Excellent location near the airport and great eating places close by.  Place was lovely and clean and comfortable
A very clean and welcoming place very close to airport parking and the airport itself. Perfect for a spot to stay in preparation for early flights out of Melbourne.
The place is exactly as described. Perfect spot to stay, close to the airport. Would definitely stay again

I really enjoy my one-night stay in Serge & Rosie's house. The lving place is quite and comfortable, ten minutes drive way from the airport. Thanks for the coconut water supplied in the fridge, I like it very much. If you want to catch flight the  next day, this is a perfect place.

One of the best places I’ve stayed in and the best experience I’ve had with air bnb. Quick self check in, let us stay with literally an hours notice due to self check in process. Cute touches like water on the bed, and food available in pantry. Would recommend to everyone as a long term stay or layover from airport as we used it. 10 minutes by Uber
Great place to stay, really close to the airport and easy check in. Place was super clean and tidy. Enjoyed my stay!
This is a lovely clean place to stay. It's very convenient if booking an early morning flight from Melbourne airport. Thanks for the info sheet and comfy bed. We would stay again.

We were lucky enough to meet Serge & Rosie and they are both such nice people. The bedroom and bed was really comfortable and we really enjoyed our stay. Location is great for airport convenience! Will definitely be back! Thanks for having us :)

Serge & Rosie’s place is very close to the airport but in a very quiet neighborhood. We had a night flight and this place allows us to rest right away! The room is clean and you will find everything you need. Brilliant stay!
Everything is great, but I’m a little bit uncomfortable bcs there was no lock in the bedroom, bathroom, and toilet.

Serge and Rosie were amazing - confirmed my reservation in under 5 mins. I got to Tullamarine airport in 10 min and the Uber fare was $10ish - that's really reasonable! The bed was so comfortable that you sink into it. Would definitely recommend for travellers with an early flight. Check in was easy and hassle free with clear photos.

Robert was the best host, he couldn’t do enough for you, loved the place so much we stayed 2 weeks! Great bungalow has everything you need and really close to shops/parks/trains etc
Definitely recommend staying here 😊

This is an excellent Airbnb.  A quiet cottage, beautifully decorated and everything you could need for a restful stay. The bed, linen and fluffy pillows are superb. Spotlessly clean. Own private garden aspect. Situated in a leafy Melbourne suburb. Robert was a perfect host.
It's a very clean place and the hosts are lovely and make sure you have no problem during your stay

Serge and Rosie's place was a great place to lay low before heading out on our flight the next day. You can catch up on laundry which is nice to get ahead of while travelling and the kitchen makes it possible to make your own meals/store snacks for the journey home!

Perfect place, all instructions were very clear. Rarely seen such a practical Airbnb, you will not find better in terms of practicality and rental close to the airport :)
Thanks again!

A gem of a place, so clean and comfortable.  Everything we needed and Rob was a perfect host, even turning the outside light on for us when we didn’t get home by dark.  We will definitely be back if we have the need to be in that area again, high recommended.

This is the perfect place to stay if you are in the Ivanhoe / Heidelberg area. Close to the train station, walking to excellent local shops, large garage and plenty of space. Everything in the apartment is very good, comfy bed, good sized bathroom with good hot water and a well equipped kitchen.

Great host. Accomodation is completely private, located in a very nice area.    Walking distance to a train station, as well as shopping strip and cafe’s.   Secure off street parking.  Actual premises are an external , large well appointed Bungalow, home away from home.

I totally recommend staying here, it was so so close to everything the train station, hospital, shops.
It was so peaceful and cosy.
very clean.
Great communication with the host.
I was traveling alone and felt very safe.

This was a comfortable place to relax and spend some time in Melb. Short walk to the train station, easy access to shops. Lovely neighbourhood. Was great being able to park our car in the garage next to the bungalow. Hosts were very prompt with communication prior and during the stay. Would recommend this bungalow for future travellers.

Accurate information in the listing for the property and amenities available. Ideally placed for access to trains to Melbourne city Centre (5 mins walk to station) and hospital. Very clean and host very welcoming.
Perfect spot to stay between flights. Rosie and Serge's place is clean, cosy and super convenient for an overnight stay between flights.
The bungalow is a very nice, clean and quiet space. Robert was a super host and very helpful.

We loved staying in the Garden studio as it is very comfortable, private and peaceful. The garden surrounds are delightful too. The quaint Eaglemont village and railway station are within walking distance and supermarkets are also close by in Burgundy Street. All up most convenient and relaxing.
Quiet, private surroundings. Clean and tidy. Bonus having a lockable garage, especially with a hire car. Thanks for a pleasant stay

Robert went above and beyond by personally meeting me even though it was after midnight due to flight delays. It was much appreciated. Having an attached lock up garage was fabulous and the back lane was so handy for entries and exits. Location was awesome. Water was piping hot and the area very quiet. All in all, perfect for my stay!

The check-in and checkout instructions were crystal clear, and our communication with the host was perfect. The room was exceptionally clean and comfortable. The house is beautifully decorated, which immediately made us feel at home. I highly recommend this place to anyone needing accommodation near the airport for a night or two. It's a great choice!

Some kitchenware was not left properly clean, and shower base has some obvious mould areas, but overall we were pleased with the presentation and facilities in the apartment.  The outdoor deck is delightful on a fine day. People who are not tall will have trouble reaching the wardrobe hanging rails, and the kitchen shelving for glassware etc.  Our mid-size SUV only just fitted into the garage but longer or higher vehicles would not, and no alternative convenient parking is available.  It seems a very safe area but having our car garaged was a bonus, especially in wet weather.  It's a very private and quiet place to stay, with pleasant surrounds, and nearby Ivanhoe shopping is now a real restaurant centre.

Thanks Rob
You were very helpful
and the accommodation was perfect for our need - close to the hospital.
We would definitely stay there again.

The garden studio was very comfortable and in a great spot. Really quiet street and within ( hilly) walking distance to shops, eating places and hospitals. It’s also close to bike tracks along the river. Great to have the option of secure off-street parking for car ( or bikes), but also close to public transport. Thank you for a lovely stay.

Great location, close to shops. The bungalow was cozy, well appointed and Rob was very responsive. I enjoyed the peaceful location and being able to garage my car with a remote-controlled door. The internet went down once and Rob had it sorted in minutes. Very much appreciated.
One issue I had was very poor mobile reception. I even tried wifi calling but didn't seem to help. Not a reflection on Roby or the bungalow, but just wanted to note it.
Quiet with a secure garage. 15 minute drive to La Trobe sports grounds. 15 minute walk to Burgandy Street shops and restaurants.

Great stay, Serge & Rosie’s place was perfect for a late night/early morning check in with self-check in, detailed instructions and rooms with locks and a welcoming message. Neat and tidy, a 10min from airport and would recommend for anyone needing a spot for a few nights between flights.
Great place and well kept. Close to the airport. Great communication from the host and good value.

Great home away from home set up in quiet neighbourhood that is super close to the airport .
Clear instructions for self check in and unless a last minute booking like mine, you’ll find your name on the door to welcone you which is a sweet touch!
I booked quickly so didn’t realise the hosts don’t live in the house, rather it’s set up as sharehouse with 3 independent rooms.
I didn’t plan to cook as I arrived late, but one guest had left the kitchen in a mess that evening. I’ve no doubt if I reached out to Sergio and Rosie, they would have contacted the other guest if I d needed too as the rest of the house was immaculately clean.
So they get 5 stars from me and I would definitely stay again as the house has all you need to be comfortable and feel at home.
Great hosts!
Great location near the airport. House was very clean and hosts gave good instructions for easy check in!
Very confortable and nice place to stay. Really close to the airport and perfect for a night before an early flight

Great place to stay overnight. Accessible to shopping centre for something to eat. Very clean living area and kitchen. Instructions given were clear and precise. Would use again and recommend to friends

Felt at home at Serge & Rosie's place! They are very responsive to queries. There are helpful instructions and reminders printed in laminated paper, placed strategically in particular places in the house. I love it that they have food and drinks available in the kitchen. :) I like the house too because it is clean and well-lit. There are useful magazine-guides for Melbourne/Victoria in the bookshelf near the dining table. The cleaner is also kind and helpful. Thanks for having me!
such a good location for late/early flights at Tullamarine. Always clean and tidy! Thanks so much :)

The location of this accommodation is great, lots of shops, foods are around with walking distance to Southern Cross Station and free tram stops. The apartment itself is clean and suits for basic living needs. Would recommends to others.
This property by far is the best Airbnb place I’ve ever stayed at, everything is accurate and easy to use

The place is amazing, got 2 bathrooms and spacious living room. Easy check in process and complete guide to reach the place until check in. Located in the city and very close with Southern Cross Station, bus stop, and also Coles supermarket. Worth the price!
We had a very comfortable stay at Julia's place, and were very happy with the facilities and extras that were provided. Lovely bushland location.

Tibor&Julia are great hosts! Thank u for gave us a good time at the place. The house is clean and cozy, especially the beddings and bathroom is very impressive. We enjoy the time stay there, highly recommend!
The house provides all the necessary amenities for a comfortable short stay. It is clean and very liveable with a large yard and perfectly positioned front porch for the afternoon sun.

A cost, peaceful and charming house beautifully adjacent to the Blackburn creek lands. A great spot for parks, birdlife and nature walks. The owners were also very good with communication. We had a lovely time and extended our stay for three more weeks.

Loved the location with kids. Great bush area we could walk and ride bikes along. Easy to get into the city when needed (we did both car and train). Also close to puffing billy. Easy access to groceries too! House was warm and spacious a true to pictures. Would stay again!
Really enjoyed our stay at this cozy house, ample space for our family of 5. We love the location of the house, beautiful backyard and heating was perfect.
What was a cold and wet week in Melbourne it was lovely to return to an always warm and cosy place thanks to the central gas/oil heaters. Plenty of space for our family of 5
The place is nice with all necessary  amenities.  The host are responsive. They  replace a new hair dryer very quick after I found out there was not hair dryer at the place.

The property is in a lovely quiet location. You can take a walk down through parklands at the end of the street. Plenty of space for parking.
The property does require a little maintenance however. One light switch loose from the wall, broken aircon in the bedroom and some windows weren’t able to be opened. The range hood has been melted in the past, still works but could be replaced. The gas heating was on automatically and couldn’t be turned off without contacting the owner.
The place is good value, nice large bathroom and fairly neat. Just a little hot in summer and needs some tlc. The location is lovely and quiet though.

We had a wonderful stay at Kerry's place.
Truly a beautiful house, and Kerry is just amazing to deal with - always available to contact and so helpful with everything. Thanks for everything Kerry

We loved our stay at Kerrys place.
Greeted on arrival, shown around the property and provided a continental breakfast that met our dietary requirements!
Stunning property in a great location.
Thx Kerry.

This was our second stay at Rosebery Cottage and it was everything we remembered it to be!  Kerry is such a great host. The cottage was spotless, cosy and has everything you could need for a weekend getaway!

We loved our weekend at the Oaks ….beautiful homely accomodation perfect for our family and the additional room with the walk-in shower was perfect for my 87 year old Mum .
Loved the electric blankets too.
We will recommend the accomodation to family and friends .
Thank you Kerry .

Great townhouse in a very convenient St Kilda location - just a short walk to great coffee and excellent Vietnamese!  Comfortably furnished, very clean and everything we needed for a family was on hand.

Great location in a stylish well furnished house.  Tara was more than willing to help, and went the extra mile to arrange all kinds of additional items to make our stay comfortable.  Thoroughly recommended!
Nice house for a family to live in and Tara is very helpful. Would recommend to friends if they come to St. Kilda.

Tara's place was great - good location and nicely decorated. It is PERFECT for families with little ones, as we had - as there were heaps of toys, a travel cot, books, plastic utensils, etc etc. Would definitely recommend!

This home is coming even more special than the photos show, it’s a truly wonderful home that feels warm, comfortable and incredible easy to spot yourself into. The location can’t be beat with great cafes 10-15 minutes walk in either direction and the beach a short walk too.
Our little family had the most wonderful time here and would highly recommend this home to anyone. Tara and Claire are great hosts, everything was very easy.

Great locations and stunning house. Everything within walking distance.
Communication was great with the hosts. They even let us check in a little earlier. Would highly recommend.

Tara’s place in St Kilda was perfect for our family over Christmas.  Clean, and had everything we needed. Great location close to everything, but at the same time private and nice and quiet. Tara is a great host, very easy to communicate with.

This was our first time using Air B&B so we were unsure of what to expect. It was so wonderful to have a homely and quiet place to base ourselves, Tara and Claire’s home was a short walk away from the supermarket, restaurants, bars, the beach etc.
The stay was extremely quiet day and night and it was very private. The home was clean and comfortable and had everything you could possibly need. Would definitely recommend.

We had a fantastic stay! The location is excellent, the house was spotless, and Tara and Claire were incredibly responsive and accommodating hosts. We especially appreciated the pet-friendly aspect, as we were travelling with our two dogs, and the courtyard was perfect for them.
It’s worth noting, as mentioned in the listing, that the house is their family home, which is reflected in the children’s bedrooms and some personal items throughout. This didn’t affect our stay at all, but it’s good to keep in mind.
Thank you for hosting us!
Great location, amazing view, lovely touches, so clean and tidy. We enjoyed our stay even though it was brief we will defiantly stay again when we are in Melbourne.
Loved the apartment and loved the location. Good value for money,  quick responses from Nick and Harriet. Couldn't have asked for more.
Nick was such a lovely host.. so quick to meet us to show us to our carpark and room and also showed us where to eat! Location was perfect 👌

Nick received us warmly near the entrance to the car park and even guided us all the way to the parking lot and showed us around his apartment. He is a dedicated and friendly host, v approachable and helpful. The apartment is clean and beautifully decorated. Kitchen is well equipped, there's even a rice cooker! There's a huge coles supermarket and a Spencer outlet mall with branded stores just across the street. We also patronised a small cafe that serves great coffee and chai latte beside Coles. The overall experience is awesome for our family of 6 (with the youngest just 21 month old). Thanks Nick!

Good location.There is a supermarket and many restaurants around here.It’s close to the bus station,but we prefer to walk.I recommend.By the way,Nick is very helpful and friendly.He gave us many information about Melbourne.

Fantastic location, close to Southern Cross station where you can catch a train or tram to almost anywhere else in Melbourne. And nearby is Spencer Outlet Centre where you can do some shopping and there’s a Coles too which opens late into the night.
Great location and very helpful hosts. Unfortunately bathroom has mould and shower screen leaks a lot. Once that'sfixed it will bean excellentplace to stay.

Fantastic experience at Harriet’s place and both Harriet and Nick were extremely helpful. It was a clean apartment with everything we needed, from baby highchair to cot to even books for the little one, shower was warm, the washer was fully equipped for what we needed, 4 stoves to cook simple means and all the kitchen cutleries we need.
Location was fantastic right in the middle of Melb CBD so that meant we could reach almost anything on foot in a short time. Coles was just opposite so essentials was also a stone’s throw away anytime. Tram stop as well!
No complains at all. Would stay again if we come by next time!
Awsome stay and very helpful instructions to access apartment. Very centralblocation with easy access to all Melbourne
Perfect place for our Melbourne break. Suited our family well. We enjoyed the common areas and the local eateries. Nick made checking in super easy.
Great location, parking space included a huge plus for us, bed was a little firm for my liking but overall pretty good. I would stay here again!

Great place to stay with comfortable beds.  Ideal for us as there is parking too! Good sized kitchen. Some items of furniture are getting a little old,  but the place was very clean and we'd stay again.

Nick was very responsive with our needs and was proactive in making us feel comfortable in his home.
Thanks again for allowing us to stay in your apartment

This place was super lovely, cute decor and the location itself was very private, quiet and beautiful surroundings. There was so many native birds around, the host had left seeds to put out which was awesome. The kitchen was very well equipt so made cooking meals a breeze. Perfect place for a relaxing holiday in the lush forest

Viv’s place is exceptional in terms of location, views and privacy to the point that we found ourselves lounging around there rather than exploring the area. Warburton of course is a great place for that too of course. The verandah & decks provide many different nooks to enjoy the sun, shade and truly magnificent views. Both house and garden are full of quirky details but are practical in function.
We’d love to stay again next year for our annual special family holiday.
Thanks again Viv!

We thoroughly enjoyed our relaxing stay in this charming, well located and very comfortable cottage. Beautiful views from within and from the deck. Just a short stroll to the river walk and shops. We recommend this property if peace, nature and tranquility are your thing.

Viv’s place was wonderful - really well stocked for meals at home and super close drive or walk to bakery / coffee / pub / IGA.
Comfortable beds, lovely fire - and such a beautiful view out to greenery to wake up to.
Such a beautiful, cosy home to spend the weekend. So close to the river and a lovely walk into town. Stunning views from every window.

A excellent location and cosy spot. Was a perfect getaway from the city to get some fresh country air. The fire was cosy and beds very comfortable. Stunning view from the balcony and it was great to be visited by cockatoos, kookaburras, parrots and lorikeets!

It was such a special weekend in this beautiful house.It is nicer than the pictures show. The property is gorgeous and you are situated with a good amount of privacy.
The fireplace keeps the house very cosy, and we loved spending an evening sitting on the coach and enjoying the night.
I would have loved to have stayed a week!

If you are after a peaceful, secluded forrest retreat then you must stay at Vivicas beautiful property. Words can not describe how amazing this place is, from lush green gardens that surround the whole property, to a gorgeous 3 bedroom house with everything you could imagine inside.
Vivica has thought of everything to make your stay as easy as possible and non stressful. The kitchen is well stocked, bedrooms are clean and cosy with comfortable mattress's and the house just makes you feel at home when you enter.

The property is in a fantastic location, I strongly recommend this property for your next stay in Warburton.
5min walk to the river, 15min walk to the shops/restaurants and 20min walk to the water park!
Vivica will definitely make your stay one to remember.
Thank you for having us, will definitely be back again soon 🥰

Thank you for letting us stay in your beautiful home. It was a relaxing and safe space to come back to each night after a gruelling conference schedule. The place was clean and comfortable, a great location, and a pleasure to stay in. Truly a wonderful and important part of our visit to Melbourne.

We stayed at Deb's place and it was really good. Very central to all of the great South Melbourne spots like the market and Bridport Street. Easy to get a park nearby, check-in was a breeze. Narrow spiral stairs were the only tricky thing about the place! Overall a great stay.

This was a great place for my wife and I plus our 16yo daughter to call home for over a week. It is conveniently located to explore the Melbourne CBD through to St Kilda by a 20min tram ride, walk to Albert Park, local supermarkets, restaurants, pubs and coffee houses. The residence provided all facilities described but it also enabled us to relax in an intimate atmosphere when we sought it.  The spiral stair to the bedrooms was considered a feature, and only when negotiating luggage did it become a 2-person adventure.  A great little getaway in the middle of greater Melbourne.  Thoroughly recommended!
The location is great and the apartment is a nice size in the heart of South Melbourne. We were however disappointed with the cleanliness and the bathroom roof was covered in mould.

This little gem far surpassed our expectations. The studio flat is freshly renovated with stylish fittings and has lots of personal touches like a beach towel and sun block sitting on the table outside. The bed was super comfortable, the linen clean and presentable. The backyard is private and full of beautiful plant life - passion fruit vines, and a bush the the butterflies seem to absolutely love. The back yard and studio are very private but we did bump into Lyndal and her partner on the way home one night and shared a quick wine together which was lovely.
Would highly recommend this little oasis to anyone looking for a local Brunswick espace.

Lyndall’s studio was perfect for our long weekend in Melbourne. Communication was quick and easy and the hosts went above and beyond with a late checkout and organising parking. The designer studio is true to the pics with lots of thoughtful touches. Location is great for East Brunswick living, close to Lygon street and close to a tram stop heading into the city.

Lyndall’s bungalow was an awesome cosy spot in Melbourne. There were so many great spots to eat at within walking distance. We particularly liked lataverna just on the next block. There were also a bunch of cool bars within walking distance.
Federation square was about $20 Uber away but the tram line is a couple minute walk if you want to do the tram instead.
Lyndall was an awesome host and makes a mean banana bread. She was really quick with responses and let us check in early and loaned a phone charger.
The space is really cute, great for a couple days and had an awesome outdoor space to use that was totally private. There isn’t a tv but we bought our Mac and knew this ahead of time.
Would definitely stay again and would recommend.

Lyndall’s place is gorgeous, I highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a Brunswick pad. It’s small, bright and cosy, immaculate and full of sweet touches. We felt very welcome. I hope to be back.

Lyndall's place is so cosy and clean, not to mention the thoughtful touches. Its right next to Lygon st in a great location. Lyndall and her family are very welcoming and friendly. I strongly recommend it to all.
The studio was perfect for a short stay. Stylish, comfortable and great location near restaurants, bars and shops. Checking in and out was a breeze and Lyndall was easily contactable and friendly

Thanks Lyndall & Delaney for the stay. Everything was perfect. Cosy flat & clean! Good connection to the Tram, City & Restaurants.
All the Best!

We loved staying at Lyndall’s studio! It is cute, cozy and comfortable, with an amazing garden to soak up the rays on a sunny day. The studio is located in  a lovely area with many shops, cafes and restaurants within walking distance. Lyndall was very warm and welcoming and quick with responses. Thanks for having us Lyndall, we had a great time! :)

Perfectly appointed private studio with all the comforts of home, situated in one of Melbourne’s iconic graffitied laneways right off of vibrant Lygon Street. Lovely hosts, very responsive, and a pleasure to deal with. Would definitely stay again and already recommending to all my friends.

Really lovely tiny place to stay. Their put a lot of love in there and the outside area is amazing. Really private and just war we where looking for. Loved all the good products they offered all the shampoo and conditioners ( good brand ) all vegan friendly and good collection of tees.
Really good experience. Loved it
What a great stay! Communication was great, place is accurate to pics, the location is in close proximity of everything you need. I'll definitely be back!
A great place to stay! The hosts are so accomodating and communicative. Highly recommend.

Wonderful cosy and warm space to lay our heads for a few nights and Lyndall was very accommodating and we were able to check out an extra hour later which helped as it was raining.  Access is via a laneway.  Bathroom amenities lovely, toilet space very tight, but everything else was great :)
Such a beautiful stay in Lyndall's studio. It's a perfect space, a great spot and Lyndall communicated so well. Absolutely will stay here everytime we go to Melbourne now. Brilliant x
Lovely host and a perfect spot to stay, it was clean, well furnished and so accessible. Would definitely stay here again.

Lyndall is an amazing, kind, and receptive host.
The bungalow is great value. It is clean, quiet, get's a lot of light, and the amneties such as the bathroom and the room itself are beautifully designed; special mention for the bed which is really comfortable. On top of that you have a wonderful outdoor area to enjoy on sunny days.
The location is fantastic. Brunswick East is a nice area with lots of cafes and restaurants nearby. You also have the tram very close by which will take you the city.
I highly recommend that you stay here if you plan on staying in Melbourne.

Lyndall is a great host, who looks after visitors as much as possible.
Room and space is lovely 👌🏻

This is the second time I have stayed here, it is such a central location and I could walk everywhere I needed to go. Close to trams, coffee shops and restaurants. The room is very comfortable and the quiet courtyard is lovely in the afternoon when the sun hits it.  Lyndall is very accommodating and responsive with any queries.  I will definitely be back.

Lyndall was fantastic, the cottage was amazing and the location was great. Lots of places to eat and easy access to the City. We loved having private access to come and go and Lyndall was great at communicating and helping us throughout our stay. 10/10 Would love to stay again.
We had a lovely stay, location was great close to Main Street with many restaurants and bars, Lyndall was very responsive and helpful!

Lyndall is a very lovely, kind and accommodating host! She let us check in early when we were feeling under the weather, which was very nice & considerate of her! She was very responsive and helpful if my partner and I needed something!
The studio had a cute and cozy vibe that helped us settle in when we weren’t feeling well. The amenities such the hand wash, shampoo and conditioner etc are good quality!
My partner and I will definitely go back to stay with Lyndall in our next visit to Melb! :))

We loved our stay! The studio had everything we needed and was super close to amazing restaurants/bars and tram stops. We were able to walk everywhere really easily and could explore so much nearby. The studio was beautifully styled and I loved the outdoor area. Lyndall was super helpful and even let us have a late check out when our flight wasn't until late in the afternoon. Thank you so much for having us and we will definitely be back.

We had a great stay at Lyndall’s sweet studio. It is in a bustling area with lots of great restaurants an easy walk away, but was still very private and quiet. The studio itself was super clean and very comfortable. Lyndall was a great host - highly recommend!

Lovely base with nice cafes and restaurants a short walk or tram away. Lyndall is a very friendly host and gave some great recommendations. Despite being in a lively area the little courtyard was very quiet and peaceful. Bed was very clean and comfortable :)

A great place for a short stay in Brunswick!
The place is small, but in a cosy, rather than cramped fashion.
It's close to cafes, restaurants and transport, while also being a little bit tucked away from the main drag so it's peaceful at night.
Lyndall was very communicative and helpful

Lyndall truly is a fantastic host! Her responsiveness was exceptional, making us feel well taken care of throughout our stay. The apartment offered a wonderfully peaceful and quiet retreat, exactly the tranquility we were seeking. The convenience of having the number 1 and 6 trams a couple of steps away made exploring the city an absolute breeze. We thoroughly enjoyed our time and will absolutely be booking again.

Lovely spot that is very handy to the Lygon Street trams. Perfect if you don't want to be in the city centre, and don't need cooking facilities.
Comfortable and lots of thoughtful touches.

We had 7 adults and 4 kids staying at the farmhouse, and not once did feel on top of each other. The kitchen facilities were great, and the pianola was so much fun. Set in a beautiful setting, we were able to love the outdoors even in the middle of winter. Such a great spot.

We expected a wonderful holiday but we got so much more! Stunning property with incredible gardens, wildlife and super cute farm friends! The farmhouse was cozy, comfortable and spacious and even though most of our stay was drizzling rain and chilly, we were perfectly entertained and warm inside and the kids still played outside in the drizzle with gumboots and all the farm animals and couldn't have been more in their element. We would recommend Barbara and Lindsay's property to anyone wanting a magical place to get away from it all. Barbara and Lindsay are wonderful and lovely and always there if you need anything at all! We hope to be back again soon!! Thanks again :)

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Barbara’s place! It is a stunning property with beautiful, peaceful views and a short drive into Warburton’s conveniences. We loved our stay and hope to come back!
Amazing gardens, incredible trees. Polite and nice hosts . Clean. Important to note that Optus network is not active at the house, but is active down the hill where the driveway meets the road.
Great place and lovely location. Thank you for the warm welcome and allowing us to stay. Will definitely come back soon.

Barbara was a fabulous host, who made us feel at home. The house has an amazing amount of amenities from the incredibly equipped kitchen, to the living areas, bathroom & toilet facilites. It was great exploring the house and the beautiful established gardens (well maintained). We were thinking of how easy it was spending time in the gardens, pathways exploring and relaxing, enjoying the scenery. There is plenty to do on the property without going into town. Thanks so much Barbara for your welcome and warm hospitality.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Barbara & Lindsey’s Airbnb, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The property itself was immaculate and exactly as described in the listing. Every detail, from the cozy decor to the comfortable bedding, made it feel like a home away from home.
The location was perfect—situated in a quiet neighborhood, yet close to all the attractions and amenities I wanted to explore. It was the ideal base for my trip.
What truly set this stay apart was theirs hospitality. They were incredibly welcoming and responsive, always available to answer any questions and offer great local recommendations. It was clear that Barbara & Lindsey genuinely cared about making my stay as enjoyable as possible.
Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I highly recommend staying here to anyone looking for a comfortable and memorable Airbnb stay.

This place is on a beautiful property. We loved being able to explore the whole 30 acres and had no reason to leave. Perfect for a large family gathering.
Barbara was a great host!

I stayed at Barbara’s place for a girls birthday weekend & it was perfect, especially being in May with all the stunning autumn trees! The house was clean & cozy with lots of rooms & beds to accommodate everyone. the renovated kitchen is spacious & very well equipped for cooking for lots of people in terms of crockery, etc. We had a little trouble with communication, but got everything resolved eventually. Would definitely recommend this venue for a comfortable & peaceful stay for a large group.
Great place to stay, easy access to the city, clean tidy, fantastic views, couldn't have asked for more.
We stayed 3 nights at Paul’s place. It was amazing ! Really clean, beautiful view, nice pool and gym. We kept in touch with Paul by message and he was such a delightful host! Highly recommend !

Wonderful place with gorgeous views of the city and water beyond. Great location with a wine shop and small grocery around the corner. Easy to get to central area, museums, and parks!  Would certainly stay here again!
Loved this apartment, clean, quiet, wonderful location and excellent security.  Second time we have stayed here, will definitely be back!!!!

A well equipped, clean apartment with a great view and in a good location for exploring town and the South Bank. Close to transport. Traffic and construction noise during our stay made sleeping a tad hard so earplugs and eye shades are a good idea.

Have stayed here before and will definitely stay here again. Highly recommended for space, comfort and stunning views. Location is brilliant with restaurants, cafes, performing arts, galleries and shops.
Thanks again Paul 🤩
Amazing apartment in a fabulous location. Lovely large size living space and bedrooms. Would love to stay again

WHAT A VIEW! Very clean. Great shower. Quick easy walk to CBD, NGV and trams. Parked in apartment spot and Uber-ed city. Central location meant all Ubers there within 3 minutes (over five days). Any questions to Paul were promptly replied too.

Paul was great, sohelpful and always replied very promptly!
Apartment was lovely and spacious and perfect location to everything. Will be back

We had such a wonderful stay at this beautiful apartment. The views are stunning, the space is homely and the location is fantastic! We can't wait to stay here again in the near future. Thanks again Paul and Dan!

Absolutely perfect apartment for a Melbourne getaway. Ventured down from Queensland and was pleasantly suprised how close all the big ticks were at walking distance i.e MCG, Casino, restaurants...
It was excellent having our own carpark on-site. The apartment was warm, cosy and great, however the view was SPECTACULAR!
Will definitely consider staying again in the future, especially noting that Paul & Dan were great hosts with amazing communication and went far and beyond to ensure we arrived safely and had everything we needed during our stay.
Do not hesitate, this is a gem....

Paul & Dan is very responsive and very easy to communicate with. Booking, information on check-in, actual check-in, etc., have been very smooth and as documented. Great location on the Southbank, great view. Have added this to my list of preferred accommodations options next time I visit the beautiful city again. Thanks for the hospitality.
Great place to stay for the tennis… a short walk, or even shorter scooter ride.  Lovely views, central location for all that Melbourne offers

Loved this place - the views from the apartment are second to none! Absolutely incredible views from every room.
Great hosts as well, very helpful.
Will definitely stay here again!
Myself and the mates thought the place was in pristine condition, good area in South Bank aswell. Paul & Dan were elite in getting us sorted and replied very quickly to any questions we had.
Excellent location, close to restaurants & 5 minute walk to the CBD. Will definitely stay here again

A great place with an amazing view!
The place was clean and spacious, the hosts were responsive and gracious, and the entire flat is just drenched in sunlight.
Located just across the river from the city centre, it’s a short walk away from a tram into the city. Great location, would stay again.

Paul and Dan were very good to communicate with, the apartment was in the perfect location and very spacious. The only issue was the Venetian blinds as the bedrooms were very bright making it hard to sleep but apart from that the apartment was good.

Perfect location, within walking distance to everything you need. The hosts were friendly and very responsive.
Would definitely stay again and recommend on to others.
Thank you for such a pleasant experience!!

It was a place to call home, very neat and had almost everything. My family loved the view, though CBD is very confusing to navigate but it was lovely to walk around. The living room was spacious and not tight. The unit was neat and access to all suburb.

This was a great location for us, it is a nice spacious apartment and overall it’s a very decent price. The location, amenities and the price stood out, which helped us see past the uncomfortable bed and pillows. Paul & Dan were also open to the feedback about the pillows, explaining they would change them for future guests. An awesome choice for a city stay on a budget.
I would defiantly recommend this property.  Great hosts. Very responsive. Great location and facility's.

The apartment was so beautiful, extremely clean, spacious and perfect for our staycation.
I could not recommend this more to anyone, the location is central whilst being far out enough that it’s not too loud.

Excellent location, suited us on foot in all directions with a young child able to walk the distances and access train/trams/river/botanical gardens.
Fantastic views, spacious, fun indoor pool and urban rock playground downstairs for kids. New woolworths very handy for stocking up with snacks.
Plenty of eateries and coffee shops to suit everyone as well, especially at Southbank. We really loved our stay albeit the blind awnings wrestle!
Plenty mentioned about this from previous guests. Nice to have full views with blinds fully up though!
Thank you

We had a pleasant stay at this apartment. The location was fantastic, close to many amenities and attractions. The apartment itself was clean, spacious, and well-equipped with everything we needed for our stay. The host was very responsive and accommodating.
However, one minor issue we encountered was that the blinds were not blackout blinds, which made it difficult to completely darken the room. This was a bit challenging for us as we were traveling with a baby who needed a darker room to sleep.

Lovely spacious lounge with amazing views looking out toward the bay. Nice bedroom and extreme clean bathroom. Enjoyed that it was close to South wharf and an easy 20 minute walk into Melbourne Central. Great host very quick to respond to questions. Will stay here again.

Excellent location in Melbourne with a range of cafes, bars and restaurants to choose from. The apartment was clean, comfortable and perfect for a weekend away. Check in was smooth and Sarah was very easy to get in touch with.

Exactly as described and perfectly situated in the inner city, only moments from the theatres and surrounded by so many delicious food options. Cannot rate this stay highly enough. Sarah’s excellent communication (and the added bonus of a last minute late check out) were just the icing on the cake.
Sarah was a very hospitable host and was kind enough to allow a late check out the next day so we could explore Melbourne a bit more before heading home. Great location and a very comfortable stay!

This is a great apartment in a very central location. It was easy to transit across the city to see friends and there are many quality food and entertainment options. Sarah is also a generous host and we appreciated her letting us in after a late flight

This was my second time staying at Sarah's. Great location and price, has all the amenities you need and Sarah is very accomodating when it comes to checking in. The apartment is very comfortable and homely, I couldn't ask for anything more!

We stayed at Sarah’s place for the best part of a week. It’s well located - close to theatres, shopping, groceries, good coffee, great restaurants and public transport. The apartment is tastefully decorated, bigger than it looks in the photos, and has a nice view of the city skyline. Sarah provided a dedicated workspace with a fast internet connection, more than enough to productively ‘work from home’ for the week. Sarah was warm and friendly and we felt welcome in her apartment. It’s a good corner of the city to stay in and we certainly hope to be back!

Sarah is an exemplary host who was very accomodating to us during our stay at her place. Her responses were very fast and she even came over last minute when we were unable to get inside the airbnb right before our return flight. The bnb was clean and had all the essentials for a comfortable stay, including extra blankets and a hair straightener which was a great surprise. The location is extremely convenient and within walking distance to the main CBD area. Thank you Sarah for the most amazing experience! :)

A comfortable , well-lit apartment in an ideal location. So close to The Comedy Club, The Princess Theatre, and Her Majesty's Theatre. It was larger than we expected. Friendly host. Would happily stay here again.
This apartment is perfect in size for a solo traveller or couple, in a good location, well appointed and public transport is easy. Sarah is a kind and communicative host - would definitely stay again
Great stay in Melbourne CBD. Great location near Chinatown and the centre of town. Sarah was incredibly easy to communicate with and we had a fantastic stay.
Great apartment in great location , Sarah is super-easy to deal with, will certainly be using again when in Melbourne

Sarah' s apartment was perfect for my conference stay; 5 star in all respects, especially the tea selection! I also forgot my phone charger, and Sarah was kind enough to post it to me; thank you Sarah!
Great place to stay to explore Melbourne. Very central and can easily walk to most things. Would recommend.
As described and shown in the advertisement, proactive in responding in messages and was genuinely nice to talk to.
I recommend Sarah 's apartment to anyone, extremely clean and well provisioned with mind blowing views and Sarah is delightful to communicate with. I will book there for my next trip to Melbourne.
Sarah's place is right in the heart of cbd. The house is exactly as described. The tram station is just a 2 min walk from the place. All in all, a value for money stay.

Second time staying at Sarah's! It's a fabulous place, great location, has everything you need for a city getaway. Sarah is lovely and always responds to messages very promptly. Would absolutely recommend to anyone and I'm sure we'll be back again. :)
Perfect location with everything you need, or a tram to it, within walking distance, and the flat contained everything you might need for your stay - thanks Sarah!

I would highly recommend Sarah's accommodation. Sarah met us at the address and gave us information regarding the unit, access to transport and restaurants. It was a perfect spot for eateries etc.  Would definitely stay there again. Susanne
Thank you Sarah for a wonderful stay. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend it for others to stay.

The apartment is located on a high floor and sunny with clear views of the neighborhood. It has a very nice terrace. The apartment is quiet in the otherwise bustling CBD. Endless eating choices and centrally located to the CBD attractions. We didn’t even take the free tram (we like to walk).
We had a great couple of nights in Sarah's apartment. It has lots of amenities to make you feel at home. Fabulous location & very convenient access to food/shopping.
Lovely apartment in a great location. Close to tram and surrounded by great restaurants. Would love to stay again.

A very nice apartment in an excellent location.  Quiet and peaceful despite being in the middle of lots of bars and restaurants.  Very bright and comfortable.  Sarah was friendly and flexible.  Only downside was that we were only provided with one set of keys.  For a couple who want to do some independent activities this is a problem.

Very nice place ! Close to everything.
Clean and cozy.
Very recommended.
A well serviced apartment, conveniently located. Our host, Sarah was friendly, helpful and considerate to our needs. Thank you.

Had a great stay at Sarah’s place. It’s really accessible to lots of different parts of the city while also being very quiet. Perfect space for 3 friends to stay for a few nights in the city or a couple with / without a kid. Cute little balcony that gets great sun too!

Sarah’s place was perfect for my first visit to Melbourne. Getting there was easy with only one tram required when I got off SkyBus at Southern Cross Station. It is a very comfortable and well appointed apartment and is very quiet being located on the 8th floor. Access is secure and easy thanks to the lift. I would happily stay again.

We were very happy staying at Sarah’s nice and neat apartment. It’s very quiet even though it’s located in the city centre, next to the famous Chinatown.  Easy access to bus-/ tram station as well as train station. Bright day light rooms, appliances all worked without problems, kitchen and kitchenware were spotless. Will stay again next time!
had a mini staycation here for two nights of musicals—location is fantastic and HMT is literally down the road; the other theatres are within a 15 min walking distance

This place was perfect for the weekend. Sarah was there when we arrived, check in and out like clockwork. The neighbourhood is in the middle of everything, with loads of bars and restaurants etc. (and MCG is walkable), but the apartment (comfortable and clean) is on the 8th floor so pretty quiet. Would thoroughly recommend.
We had another great stay at Sarah's lovely apartment - its the perfect location, with lots of natural light and everything you need. Thanks for having us - we hope to be back soon!

The apartment was very clean and had everything you wanted and more. Lots of bright light shining through the apartment which made the place inviting. Location is great with being right in the city. Plenty of transport around , trams, trains and most things are walking distance. The sofa bed came in handy with the kids. Would stay here again.

Really enjoyed this stay, we have stayed in alot of Airbnb’s and this has to be one of our favourites, so so close to everything and especially Spencer Street, definitely stay here if you get a chance, Kash was also really down to earth and easy to deal with
Thanks Keza & Carmz

We’ve had a brilliant stay. Small but cosy Appartement with everything you need. With the bonus of a swimming pool and small gym on the 25th floor.
Very convenient location for travelling around the city center and to/from the airport. Kash was very helpful and was quite flexible about an early check in. Thanks again! We definitely recommend the place!

Had a great time at Kash’s place. Beautiful garden view from the balcony and plenty of sunlight. Location is perfect -Skybus, Coles and free trams are just nearby. Kash is responsive and friendly throughout our stay ( thank you).
Such a lovely apartment in a really convenient location. Everything was really clean and cozy. Thanks Kash!
Kash was very thoughtful and replies fast. The place was well equipped for travellers to adapt. Clean and cozy. Would definitely stay again!

An excellent location convenient for trains, trams, car hire and shopping - all within walking distance. The apartment is well equipped with stove, fridge, microwave, etc., good views and plenty of light but is very compact. The bed is a futon so low to the ground.

Close to southern Cross station and outlet. this room has everything you need.you can swim workout and cook. Kash is nice and respond to you quickly. This time my husband and I did not have enough time to enjoy the city. so we only stayed in here for 3days. next time I will stay in this city longer and will definitely choose Kash again.

Four of us stayed for a week and were quite pleased with every aspect of the lodging.  Marie was quite responsive with our one request which turned out to be a silly mistake by me (didn't spot the kitchen towel even though it was there).  The house is spacious and nicely appointed; quite comfortable.  We had a bit of chilly weather ( 1 Deg C) and the heat worked well.  The very short walk to Watsonia Station makes movement about town a snap.  Close proximity to shops and parks allows for easy procurement and diversions.

My family and I had a fantastic time here. The accommodation was comfortable and clean. It was closely located to a shopping centre, public transport and wasn't far from the city.
The host was very quick with her responses and very helpful.
Would definitely recommend.

Marie's place was fresh, bright and airy, with both heating and air conditioning......we made grateful use of both both during our stay as the weather was up and down. The unit is a short walk to a train station and off the main highway for driving, so extremely convenient for getting about. We look forward to returning on our next trip to Melbourne! Thank you for hosting us Marie.
A beautiful renovated unit and excellent prompt responses from owner. A great location for nearby public transport and shops a short drive away. Would happily stay here again.

Marie was amazing to communicate with and quick to respond to everything! Great location but getting of the main road into the driveway can be tricky and the usual city noises that you would expect. Would definitely stay again!

Great place to stay
Was very clean and tidy…
Close to shops, transport and Simpson barracks
Will definitely stay again
Marie was very caring and a great host. The unit is lovely.  Would stay again.

Small studio very close to southern cross station. Clean and great comms from Kash. Good for if you’re a party of 1 or 2 who is visiting with a jam packed schedule. Would come back again and recommend. Thanks for the stay!
Very good location (free tram zone), loads of good cafe‘s around! Clean and comfy apartment for a few days in Melbourne! Highly recommend
Marie was a wonderful host. She had great initiative dealing with problems out of our control before we knew they existed. Thankyou for taking such good care of us.

We booked for two adults and our toddler thinking we would get the entire house as described but missed the finer additional house rules stating it would only be one room (with plans of our daughter being in the other room).
Marie was very accommodating and helped us beautifully to accommodate our daughter and we used the house as a wonderful home for almost a week. It was easily accessible, we loved the courtyard space and how close it was to everything we needed. Well equipped kitchen we put to good use and laundry facilities. Highly recommend.
Note: make sure you don’t lock yourself outside in the courtyard. Luckily my partner had the keys in his pocket when the self locking door in the laundry closed behind us. Whoops!
Stayed here several times over a month, place was fantastic every time and Marie was a nice and friendly host

Fantastic place. Very clean, spacious and well thought out. We had everything we needed. Marie was a great host. Her instructions were clear and she was flexible. We highly recommend her place to anyone looking for a place to stay in or around Watsonia.

Marie’s check-in instructions is clear, since we drove there so had no problem to find the place. The house is cozy, spacious, clean and has furnished all we want. We found it as at our home. Thanks very much for the wonderful hosting.
Great location but only suitable for one person and short period of stay. The bedding smell like old people and the shower area was dirty.

We stayed for two weeks as a couple, and the room was just the right size. It had everything we needed for daily life, including a hair iron, which was very helpful. Also, whenever we had any issues and contacted the host, we received a quick response, which was great.
The location was excellent, with easy access to both trams and trains. It was also very convenient as we could reach the accommodation directly from the airport with just one SkyBus ride.
There were many cafes and restaurants nearby, making our stay enjoyable. We could see the night view from the room, and in the morning, the sunlight was beautiful.
Thank you very much for this wonderful stay!

Stayed at Marie's place for 4nights,
the house was spacious and clean!
Had few happenings with the booking prior to check in, due to my mistake.
And still Marie responded very kindly and friendly which I was very thankful for me! The house feels private and had a nice time with the family. Thank you!
This has become our home away from home. Our 4th time at this place. Very comfortable place to stay. Has all the amenities you would need. Marie has never disappointed

The tiny house is beautiful and even better than expected. The photos do not do it justice. The clean and modern amentities, the beautiful scenery, cows and donkeys and most of all the great hospitality are all winners. The fresh produce and extra treats were delicious. Highly recommend to anyone. We even decided to get engaged at this wonderful location. Thanks Katherine.

Wow what an incredible stay! Katherine is the perfect host and left us lovely treats, eggs and milk for breakfast and even a hand written note! The kitchen was fully equipped with everything we could possibly want and the bed was soo comfortable. Photos don't do the tiny house justice - it is a gorgeous, bright, airy spot with amazing views from every window. Very private and so peaceful and relaxing - our only regret was having plans for the night we stayed - as we both agreed we would have much rather stayed and watched the sunset from the amazing deck! Thank you Katherine for a great weekend away!

My partner and I really enjoyed our weekend away at Little Yarra Tiny House. The perfect place to get away from the hustle and bustle of Melbourne and only an hour away. Secluded and private, the property boasts beautiful views and only a short drive into some beautiful towns. It rained the whole night our first stay and the sound on the tin roof in the mezzanine bedroom was gorgeous. We loved the personal touches ie. fresh eggs, flowers and blood oranges. Bright, airy and clean - Oh and the shower was fab too - hot continuous water! Thanks again Katherine
Jess & Luke

Katherine’s tiny house was an wonderful little sanctuary away from the bustle of the city - beautiful landscape and so much natural light all day long. We had everything we could possibly need for a few days away - would highly recommend to anybody.
The cottage is very tiny but quaint and just what we were looking for.. Katherine was the perfect host and the added extra charms made the stay feel like home :)
Nicely built. Cute and cosy. Beautiful outlook. Needs a little refining on a few details.

Awesome tiny house and in a great location! Wonderful for a weekend away, just out of Melbourne. The property is well kept, light and airy. Katherine was a fantastic host, really easy to talk to and contact, and the little extras were a great touch.
