I phoned after hours from the telephone many times which didn’t work, and when i did get ahold of the after hours management it was very much a “deal with it” attitude. Overall I’ve lost more money than I spent for the night in this hotel and likely won’t be back because of this fact.

Was a nice hotel experience on the awesome Johnston Street. The reception was very helpful with my requests, after the check-in. For communication before meeting them in-person, email is a better option to communicate.

Great location but very uncomfortable accomodation. The walls are so thin that you can hear everything that guests in the room next door are doing. We were woken up multiple times by noises from other guests going to the bathroom and closing doors.
Staff were super friendly and the room was spacious and it felt homely. Comfy beds and the apartment complex was super close to everything in the city.

We had a great time staying here. They looked after our bags at reception for day the morning before check in and the afternoon after check out. Very close to MCG which is an easy walk. Lots of cafes around!! Thank you!
Wonderful apartment at a great price. Clean, central, and homely. Eduardo is a fantastic host who is very responsive and helpful. So glad we could stay in his air bnb.
Wonderful unit and very responsive host. Great location for public transport and close to Spencer street station, however no issue with traffic noise. Very good
We’ve a lovely stay here, you got everything you need. The location is superb and with a on premise car park which is very convenient.

Great location, nice clean apartment, good sized pool, clean bedding and linen, however the windows are not soundproof from the noise from nearby bars and pubs but still a great apartment to stay in. Would definitely rebook.

Enjoyed our stay, owner was extremely helpful and patient with our concerns and problems. Getting right on top of them and fixing them, great communication went a long way. The place was very nice and clean.

This is the second time we have stayed in this unit. It is not a large unit but is a fantastic base for exploring Melbourne with frequent 86 and 96 trams to Bourke St Mall, South Melbourne Markets, DFO, St Kilda, Fitzroy and more. My children enjoyed using the pool and gym each day and having a parking spot for our car was great. Edwardo is really responsive and helpful as a host.
A really great short stay, location is convenient and close to public transport, restaurants and Melbournes sporting event locations. Grant was extremely helpful and friendly. Highly recommend to all
David was very communicative and made the stay very easy. I look forward to having David host again!

Wow! What a beautiful home and setting. The views were spectacular! Penny was a fabulous host and very easy to talk to.   Penny gave a tour through the home on arrival which was very helpful. All the fires had plenty of kindling and wood available for a cosy night in. A lovely basket of treats and fresh flowers in the rooms was another lovely touch. A very homely, stylish and comfortable home. This special place has lots of little extras and lots of room. You can even help feed the goats :) It is a perfect getaway for couples, groups and families.  We had wonderful stay and will return one day.  Thanks Penny :)

Beautiful home and Penelope was so easy to communicate with. The surrounding gardens are lovely. Very picturesque. All of our needs and ammenities were cared for with extra personal touches. Would definitely stay again!
Amazing property. Very spacious, spotless and couldn’t ask for a better place to stay. Beautiful and peaceful surroundings. Penelope was so responsive and helpful and I would highly recommend

This place was absolutely beautiful. We really enjoyed our stay, Penny had the place looking incredible, and it was everything we didn’t know we needed leading up to our wedding and the day after. I would recommend anyone staying here. It is super kid friendly, they had an absolute ball as well.

We stayed at Misty Hill the night before and of our wedding. We felt right at home as soon as we arrived, penny was amazing and very kind from the get go.
We also did our first look around the property and I can’t even explain how amazing g the house is and how many beautiful areas there are for photos.
Thankyou so much penny, I highly recommended misty hill to everyone !!

We had a lovely stay with our bridal party for our wedding. The house was super spacious, great for photos and located nice and close to our venue. Penny was very helpful and friendly and left a lovely basket of goodies for us to enjoy. Thank you!

Firstly, the apartment was wonderful with an amazing view, amazing facilities and very useful Woolworths downstairs :)
Then, all the support team was AMAZING, they always answered fast, try to find a solution, be understanding..
many many thanks for everything!

We had a great stay and the location was wonderful and made life easy having a Woolworths metro in the lobby and tram stop just down the street. Unfortunately there was a very strong mothball scent that permeated through the apartment even with all doors and windows open (which was a challenge since we have an infant and a 4 year old and it got down to 6 degrees).

The host was very responsive to our inquiries. Easy to check-in and out, clear instructions. Location is superb, near the city, DFO, tram/bus access, groceries store at the lobby. Clean and comfy, great view especially for us staying over the new year's night. Complete amenities by the time we checked in, host also provided the power adapters for our devices from Indonesia :)
Great experience, definitely will choose this place again when in Melbourne.

Amanda was the epitome of good hospitality. Could not have asked for a better, more helpful, more responsive host. Place was as described, nice and close to the gem that is Lygon Street. We loved our stay! Thanks so much.

We had a peaceful stay at Cosmo Carlton, really enjoyed the cafe's and restaurants nearby, super easy to get the tram service. Look forward to using this groovy little apartment again.
Many thanks Greg and Maureen.
Was great to find a place that is child friendly with cot, high chair and toys. Location was close to shops and restaurants. Apartment was also well equiped for cooking. We enjoyed our stay.
Amanda’s place is fantastic. Great location, clean, cosy, stylish and just as described in listing. Amanda was great at communicating & provided very clear, detailed instructions and house rules.

Amanda’s place was perfect for what we needed, and easily met my expectations.. the apartment was spotless and cosy.. I loved the little extra touches and thought that has gone into making it really easy to be there.. Amanda also communicated really well and checking in and out was a breeze.. thank you for this space Amanda, we will come again 🙏😃

Excellent place, close to restaurants and has a car park,
Will stay there again for sure

This Carlton apartment spacious & easily fit the four of us. Clean with amenities, nice beds, nice couch,  & very close to Lygon Street. Came with a parking space.  Also has a balcony to sit outside. Really enjoyable.
3 / 4 min walk to Lygon st + secured parking in a quiet Neighbour hood this was the perfect location for us
Beautiful apartment with great amenities and close to lots of restaurants and things to see and do. Can absolutely recommend this place, great value for the money.
Good little apartment in a great location. Beds were comfortable and Amanda was very friendly, would recommend 😊

Room is comfortable, and house is well-quipped and clean. Shops and groceries within 10 mins walk. Room doesn’t have a lock though and there are indoor cats. If you love cats, this is the place to be. 👍

David was a great host! Very responsive with messaging and flexible with check in and out. The apartment had everything we needed and was a lovely place to stay. Very clean and tidy and enough space for 3 people, never felt too small or crowded. Overall 10/10!
Was all great- no problems, great place, and David super helpful and thoughtful. Thank you!

Excellent stay right in the heart of Fitzroy, and literally across from Lune 🥐🙌🏻 Nice layout with bedrooms on the ground floor and top floor with living in the middle. Kitchen was pretty welll stocked ✅
Maybe not the best place to lounge around in with just the sofa in the living room (although there are the the dining area chairs and a foot stool poof thing), but really in this location you’re probably not going to spending too much time inside!).
Overall a quiet, nice place.

Great place to stay in Melbourne if you want to feel like a local. Close to great cafes, shops and transport if you want to get to the city. Looking forward to book this place again when i come back to Melbourne.

If you like fancy croissants in bed this is the place for you! Ruth was a friendly and responsive host. Only tip would be to be aware the house is over three levels so if you need bedrooms closer together this might not be the best place for you.

This place is centrally located and makes accessing Fitzroy so easy!! It’s an amazing space for two singles, two couples or if you have teenage children as the bedrooms are separate with separate bathrooms. I wouldn’t choose this place if I had young children as the rooms would be too far away apart for me.  Considering it’s so central it was super quiet. It wasn’t gorgeously decorated but that’s reflected in the price which I thought was awesome! It worked really well for us!

Great location, right next to Brunswick St, tram stop and plenty of restaurants/hotels/cafes to choose from. A very buzzy neighbourhood which we enjoyed exploring. Public transport to Flemington worked well. Nice layout for 2 couples and Ruth was super efficient. Thanks Ruth and we loved our stay.
Check in and check out went very smoothly. We really enjoyed our stayed in Fitzroy and the apartment was located so close to the main drag. Ruth was very easy to communicate with.

Great location in Collingwood - shops, restaurants, cafes and public transport on your doorstep.
Apartment was clean, stylish, beds were super comfy, fully equip kitchen with everything you need to cook and great balcony.
Thanks so much for our stay Ruth!

Great location and very peaceful. Shops and cafes all around.
The apartment suited our short stay.
We’ll return again one day.
Thanks Ruth
The place was just lovely and exactly as described and the hosts were extremely helpful and responsive :) would definitely recommend!

The apartment was the perfect spot for our week spent in Melbourne visiting family and friends. The neighborhood where the apartment is located is a convenient residential area walking distance to cafes and shops. We were also close to two tram lines and a cycling path. Pretty much great access to everything. The apartment was quiet and modern. We would recommend this apartment for stays in Melbourne.
Great location. Small,  but very comfortable apartment set up with lap pool and gym in great Brunswick location.

Had a good stay, the place was great for what I needed for the few nights - secure parking, close to shops, coffee and restaurants. South Yarra station is just a short walk up the road for trams and trains to the city. Very good communication from  the hosts.

A tidy and lovely home equipped with everything you need. A good bed and a nice clean own private bathroom. Sam and Annie is a great host and patiently took care of my parents who had come from India , made them comfortable scarified and kept them warm with heaters. Sam shared all he knows about the area and made my parents very comfortable. They had a great stay!
Our circumstances changed and we had to leave early, proactively Sam followed up and refunded (when it was a non-refundable booking) - even if he dint do it, I would still be grateful for the lovely stay and the way they took care of my parents.
Once again thank you Sam and Annie and not to miss the tiny tot !
Sam's place was in a  very convenient location and place was clean and tidy.Will go again.
I had a great stay at the property, very clean and pristine with great furniture and appliances. The Host was very friendly and responsive!

Absolutely loved staying at this apartment and didn’t want to leave! The location was great, tramline right outside and everything’s within walking distance so it’s a great place to start in Melbourne. The apartment has a lovely cosy feel to it and it felt like home for the duration! The view from the balcony is lovely especially in the evening.
The included access to the buildings services were a massive bonus, the gym, swimming pool and spa areas were all at an incredibly high standard and we made the most of them during our stay.
Lastly, the host was incredibly helpful and continues to be helpful even after we’ve checked out, very efficient with replies and doesn’t make requests feel like an inconvenience! Lovely guy to talk to as well😊
All in all we absolutely loved staying here, would 100% recommend!
Sunny was a very helpful host. He helped us  with our bags to the room. He catered our car spot. Very nice person.
Decent value, room had a bit of a smell. owners did supply air freshener on request.

We didn't end up staying in this specific apartment, there was some mixup and they moved us to a different apartment not far away. This different apartment was spacious and modern, but definitely needed a bit of work (fixing lightbulbs, replacing door handles, cleaning marks off walls etc).

We stayed for a few nights during the Melbourne F1 Grand Prix.  Kieran was easy to deal with and very helpful when we asked for a late checkout. The place was fantastic and very close to central Melbourne. Overall a great place to stay. Would highly recommend
The apartment is in a great location, only minutes walk from the Arts centre and then into the city.   Mark and Kiran were very responsive and the apartment was as described.

I had a great stay at Sarah's apartment.  Fantastic location between Elwood beach and cafes, restaurants and groceries. Highly recommend. Apartment is spotless and very inviting. Sarah is a great host, very responsive and went out of her way to seek a few specific recommendations!

Such a little gem in the heart of Elwood. The apartment was quiet and private, yet just a few steps from local cafes, sweet shops, groceries and public transport. We loved how close it was to the beach and free parking. We extended our stay because we just didn’t want to leave!
Sarah was so easy to communicate with, met our every need and super responsive. Amazing value for money.
We hope to visit Melbourne and stay again sometime soon!

Juliet's place is easy to find, it's clean and located in a peaceful neighbourhood. Within walking distance to a Coles Local, and some cafes. Communication with Juliet was smooth too. Thank you for everything, Juliet!

great location , close to CBD , 10 minute walk to crown. Lovely clean, beds were great, could do with some wine glasses. Not for people with knee issues , 3 levels stairs.
We really enjoyed our stay
Overall our stay was very pleasant! It was close to the tram and was easy to find. Very good communication and fixed any problems we encountered.
Loved our stay! Perfect for our family. Was a super convenient walk to get where we needed to be
Access instructions were initially unclear but Aaron was quickly able to sort out questions that arose. Future guests will benefit from this effort.
Needs to be cleaned, would’ve been good to know the car space is half the size of the average  car space

Apartment stinks like BO! I’m talking the couch, beds, linen and blankets. Apartment needs a deep clean.
Shower has black mould.
Great location but apartment definitely needs some attention.
Great accommodation in the CBD. Easy walking to every thing we needed. Great views of the city at night. We will stay again with family.
This apartment is amazingly located, we really enjoyed our stay. Kevin was extremely responsive to the few small things we needed.

Kevin’s place was a lovely stay for me and my friends! There was enough room for everyone to not feel crowded. Everything was a 10 - 15 minute walk away. The apartment was easy to get in and out of. The place was modern and clean the view of the city was great! Would definitely stay again 😊🛬
We had a great stay at Kevin’s apartment. Great location and very spacious space. Would be happy to return.

Kevin could not have been more helpful. As we were coming in from an overseas holiday late at night I asked if we could get check in details before we left Australia in case there were internet problems etc. Kevin obliged gracefully. The rest of the unit and stay matched that great experience
Couldn’t be happier, thank you

Thanks so much for a wonderful stay in your beautiful home 🤍 you guys were just so warm and welcoming. The space is clean and so well equipped. Simon even offered me a lift to my work place down the road so I wouldn’t have to walk! Just the best airbnb experience, thank you guys!

Very highly recommend staying here if you need accomodation in the area. Simon and his partner were very friendly, the place was very homely and clean, all the amenities you could ask for and Rocco was a sweetheart. Overall a very great experience, A++. Would definitely stay again!

Thank you very much for the host's welcome and tolerance. The owner has a very cute dog. It is also close to the bus stop and easy to get around. The environment is very comfortable. The rooms are very clean.

Couldn’t recommend this apartment more.
What an incredible 8 day stay we had at James’s warehouse apartment. It’s in a great location with a lock up carport, which was a bonus as we had a car.
Lots of excellent bars and cafes near by.
Will definitely be staying again, if it’s available on our next Melbourne visit!

Book with confidence an easy 5 stars! Our family stay here was outstanding! Walk to everything, supermarket and liquor store next door - the iconic Melbourne markets steps away. The apartment was impeccably clean and extremely comfortable. The views to Melbourne Airport to The Docklands and Port Philip Bay pure magic! On our return list for Melbourne, thanks so much for hosting us!

It was a great space, great view, everything we needed was there.
Very responsive host.
Top location as stated. Thanks so much.
Amazing views and a super handy location for everything we wanted to do. Place was super tidy and easy to get in and out of. Thanks for having us!
Super helpful and easy to communicate with. Quick and responsive with questions and questions. House was spotless and easy to find things.

We absolutely loved staying in this beautiful apartment! The views are just incredible, and location was perfect.
The hosts were also nothing short of amazing and we can’t wait to come back!
The property is well maintained and comfy. The host also responsive to our requests. Great place to stay
Great stay with an amazing skyline view, located right above a Woolworths to do grocery shopping.

The host was very prompt. The unit was clean and had all that was required by our family of 4. The views from the unit were amazing. The location was very  central with a Wooly's at the ground floor. Highly recommended.

This place is absolutely worth it. I stayed as a group of 5 and the place is more than enough. The location in Melbourne is closed to everything.
The apartment it self is so clean. All the beds are comfy even the one on the living room.
Renlei as a host is very responsive and attended to our needs.
Definitely recommended!!

The apartment offered an unobstructed view of South Melbourne city, making it a delightful sight to wake up to each morning. Additionally, its prime location provided the convenience of being just a few minutes' walk away from the renowned Queen Victoria Market.
One particular aspect that stood out was the availability of a convenient car park in the basement. This made it hassle-free to come and go, especially for those with vehicles.
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at this apartment and would definitely consider visiting again in the future, particularly to indulge in the delectable food offerings at Queen Victoria Market.
Great apartment, very fast internet (unusual in these types of apartment in Melbourne CBD), fantastic views, very responsive and accommodating host. Would book again 👌🏼

Renlei is a very friendly and responsive host. The place looks the same like the picture. The location is central and the place is clean.
I would certainly recommend renlei to anyone.

Great location! Walkable distance to everything in the cbd and easy access to public transport if you want to venture further than that. Amazing views from our floor! Would definitely stay here again.

Pleasant stay at this comfy unit with beautiful unblock city view; superb location too- walking distance to subway and Queen Victoria market!
Recommended place to stay 🏡
Shuang had a beautiful apartment very clean and wonderful balconey views the only issue we had was we only had 1 key and fob to share to the whole group
Shuang’s hospitality was second-to-none, extremely accomodating and friendly. Apartment matched description and more, great location with beautiful views.
Great place to stay, felt homely and kids loved it. Host Shuang also provided lots of amenities for us to use in the bathroom. Good value!

Host was proactive and gave clear instruction on check-in and flexible to allow slightly early check-in.  Location is within walking distance to CBD and free tram zone.  Woolie is right opposite apartment.  Apartment was clean and everything we needed was available.  One area to improve is the beds -which sink into the center, hence 4 stars instead of 5.
Good location, lovely apartment with lovely views, comfy, warm, clean.  very responsive host when asked questions.

Great Location, easy to get into the city.
Hosts were kind enough to send a forgotten item home for us.
This house was perfect for what we needed and the hosts were super accommodating when we needed to extend out stay.
I am really happy about this place and the host Jin is very helpful and very nice to the guest.
Jin was super lovely host, was very accommodating and gave me the privacy too. Communication was very prompt.  Beautiful room with the most comfortable bed. A wonderful stay.

This was the perfect place to stay - so peaceful and relaxing. Jin was warm and welcoming, and such a generous host. I have some health issues at the moment, and Jin made everything so easy with my special needs. It's a really beautiful place, too. I hadn't fully realised from the photos. 5/5 would stay again. Thanks Jin!
Guoyun was very responsive and lovely to deal with.  The apartment was modern , spacious and very clean. Plenty of room for 6 adults in the city for a night to see a show. Highly recommend.
Guoyun was extremely helpful and made the stay easy. Amazing views, extremely clean. Great location. Will definitely stay again.

Guoyun’s place was fab-clean, modern, central and has great views of the city. The apt is spacious, we were a family of 7 and there was plenty of room. Guoyun was very responsive and replied to messages quickly. Flexible with check in and very accommodating letting us park up for the day before check in. Wonderful stay, thank you Guoyun 🥰
we liked the place and it was fun staying over guoyun's place and everything was clean and tidy and very clear instructions.

Our stay was extremely wonderful, the Apartment was clean and tidy and positioned perfectly for our function on Saturday night. Our host Guoyun was extremely professional answered all Our requests promptly and was able to
Accommodate us with an early check in. All check in instructions were clear and made for an easy check in. Highly recommend staying at this apartment
Had the most perfect stay, details and direction were amazing very helpful for us! We loved our stay
We had a great stay. Beautiful view and great amenities etc. very convenient location and easy check in if you follow the photos and instructions provided.

Perfect location for a city getaway.  Literally minutes walk from southern cross.  Luggage storage facilities were located close by - highly recommend dropping luggage here until checkin.  Communication was great and easy to follow.  Apartment very good size.  Would definitely stay again.
Thanks so much to Guoyun the most responsive and helpful host. place was perfect. word of advice, watch out for the grumpy neighbour when shutting the front door too loudly
This is in a great location. We had no issues, and it was very easy to communicate with the host.

Host was very responsive. Apartment was clean tidy and as pictured. Some of the photos are from shared common spaces rather than in the actual apartment so a little misleading but the apartment was still large enough for our needs. With that aside, we had a lovely time. Great location.

The highlights were the gym, pool and sauna + the location is excellent. The pool is very cold but that was fine for me as I did hot & cold therapy from the pool to sauna. The cons were, it was noisy at night, bed was short and the accommodation itself is very basic. You get what you pay for in this instance. Communication with the host was very prompt. Overall it was an average stay.
Loved this place, the view alone from the front deck in the morning at night is gorgeous. The folded toilet paper was a nice touch. Very warm and cozy home. Would come back.

We really enjoyed staying at Sujatha's home.
As we had family members also staying, there was a problem with where the key safe was located though I found it easy enough - the family members had difficulty.
otherwise everything went really well.

Our host was so easy to deal with. We enjoyed staying here and seeing the sights of the Yarra valley. The pool was very welcome on the hot day (despite not being heated). The beds were comfortable and there was everything we needed in the home.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Sujatha’s place. There was plenty of room for 7 of us. The beds were very comfortable & the place was lovely & warm with its underfloor heating.
The kitchen was very well appointed & had everything we needed.
The house is extremely cozy, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay there and we will certainly return to this place.
Beautiful accommodation and looks exactly like the photos. Stunning views. Ye was super helpful and quick to reply. Worth the stay!

Thank you Ye!! the apartment was just as pictured and kept absolutely pristine for us when we arrived. After a mix up with our flight time, Ye was incredibly quick to answer our message and further accommodating in allowing us to check in an hour earlier than planned while still ensuring everything was clean and ready. The location has a lovely view and felt quiet and private while still being within walking distance of the city centre. Thank you again for the perfect stay!

Had a great stay, the only issue was the aircon didn’t work and the temperature inside got over 30 degrees! Contacted the host and she said she would check it before the next guests. Asides from that everything went well

Incredible spot! Courtyard was huge and bathed in sun, almost the size of the whole apartment. 1-2 minute walk from restaurants and bars on Fitzroy Street, and super close to the beach. Everything was spotless, beautiful and comfortable furniture and Lee was very easy to deal with. Will be back again next time I stay in St Kilda 1000%.
Had the best stay at Julie and Lees! Such a cute little place, super clean and in an amazing location. 10/10. They were perfect hosts. Thanks guys!

First time in Melbourne and couldn’t have had a better place and location to use as a base.
The apartment is well stocked with modern appliances and a fresh renovation; it is open and naturally lit.
The courtyard was perfect to have a friend over with a four year old, and the festoon lights make it a nice place to entertain in the evening.
I’ll be visiting again and hope to be able to stay and Julie and Lee’s excellent little St. Kilda oasis.

We have just had a wonderful stay at Julie and Lee’s Airbnb - it is a gorgeous place to stay and we loved every minute of our time both at the property and in Melbourne. Exceptionally comfy bed, fantastic shower (both v important to us!), immaculately clean and had everything we needed and more. The welcome treats were very welcome after our long flight from the UK. Although the property is on a main road it is completely tucked away and very quiet and the outdoor space is like a little oasis. Julie and Lee were perfect hosts too - always responsive, helpful and friendly. Thank you again - we’ll be back!

My husband and I love St Kilda and we wanted to stay somewhere nice and close to the tramline. We loved staying at Julie and Lee’s as it was a gorgeous Airbnb. It was very comfortable and easy to get in and out of. Catching the tram into the city was easy as the tram station was just outside their place. Many different types of restaurants were available within a short walking distance. We didn’t need a car as everything we wanted to go to was easy to reach by walking or by tram. Highly recommend staying at this lovely Airbnb.

I loved my six weeks in Julie and Lee's apartment! It's spacious and comfortable, with a lovely bed and everything you could possibly need for a long-term stay. The location is perfect - just a short stroll to the beach, and surrounded by cafes and restaurants. The tram stop is right outside, making it easy to get to the city center. Lee was a very helpful and responsive host. I highly recommend this place and hope to stay here again someday!

This is such a great place! Beautiful space and really conveniently located right across from a tram stop. That said, the place is to the back of the property and feels private and calm.
10 minute walk to the pier/St Kilda Beach and lots of great food around, as well as a Woolworths Metro.
Would definitely stay again!

My boyfriend and I are spending a year in Australia to work and travel. We arrived at the accommodation and immediately felt very comfortable. The location is great and the train is very close by. We would love to stay here again.

Our stay at this apartment was fantastic! From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the modern design of the space. The location was ideal, with easy access to public transportation and within walking distance to Melbourne CBD. The apartment was well-equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Communication with Audrey & Willem was seamless, and they were very responsive to our queries we had about the area. We couldn't have asked for a better experience and would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Melbourne.
Audrey and Willem’s place is lovely. Stylish and tidy, in a convenient location for travel in and around Melbourne.

The unit is extremely well located and in good clean condition. The beds were very comfortable and it was great to have 2 bathrooms. The parking is tight - best suited to small cars. There are ten stairs into the property.
Centrally located in South Yarra. Apartment is clean and well equipped. Only downsides are a very small parking space and it being cold when returning to the apartment.
Definitely stay again, private and not too noisy.  Close to many amenities on Toorak Road AA++

The rooms are clean and tidy. Responses from the owner was always prompt and generous.
We enjoyed a nice and quiet stay. Thank you.

The unit was clean and comfortable with great amenities. Although one reason we selected it was because it is a ground floor unit assuming it would have easy access for my 76 year old Mum with bad knees - beware the stairs.
Thanks for hosting us, a great place if you are in the area. House was clean and had all the listed amenities. Would book again if in the area!

Away with children, the wifi did not work and I contacted the owner he stated that it must of been a network problem, we restarted it and still no change. TV antenna wasn’t good could t get any channels but only had channel 7 on free tv, which also wasn’t great with kids. The house was clean and everything else was great.
Furniture a bit dated but everyone slept fine

The place was bigger and nicer than the photos showed.
Lots of space and good for families.
The bedding needs an update. There was a black substance on one of the bed sheets and also stains on bedding which was old and bally and not warm enough.
Toilets were not clean.
Pool cues were mostly missing bits and there was no chalk.
Also the wifi was cutting in and out when trying to watch football and Netflix

Great location had everything we needed. Clean right through house. Was great with the pool table kept family amused. The heating was great comfortable. Wifi was easy to access etc. besides all was great my family and I would recommend this accommodation.
Had a great stay with family, would definitely recommend for big families & long stays! Lyaqat was very nice and considerate on meeting our needs with check in & out

Great place to stay, clean, very comfortable bed, would stay again. The pool table does have a couple of rips, only 1 que had a tip and no chalk, couldn't find the switch to turn on lights above pool table.
great value.  everything you could ask for in a family home. the kids loved the pool table

On the day we were booked in for we were held up and didn't know if we would make it to the accomodation. Our host said he could be flexible, based on other bookings of course  and he was very considerate. We left our home a lot later. When we finally arrived the house provided what we needed which was a place to relax, recharge and sleep in to be ready for the next day.  It was clean, warm and peaceful.

Lyaqat’s accomodation was excellent value, the house was very large and had plenty of room.  Clean, all necessary amenities and appliances etc.  The beds were extremely comfortable. I”m not usually one to frequent this area of Melbourne but if I do, will happily stay here again with no hesitation.

Was as described very family friendly quiet neighbourhood
2 Lots of shops Both could be within walking distance depending your level of fitness.
The design and furniture layer was good as not overclauded.
Many appliances and items in the kitchen
the in door and semi out door lounge is a big plus

Great place and good service, nice quiet area, free parking all along the street and a driveway for one. Backyard is smaller than depicted but the entertainment area definitely made up for it. Would book again.

We really enjoyed our stay.
We walked all around Melbourne CBD area for Restaurants, shopping, exploring the area and totally Loved our short walk back to our unit. The surrounds of the unit is filled with garden, treelined walkways that are very beautiful and inviting. The train lines are right beside the unit and did not bother us at all, it was very quiet in the unit. A nice 5 min walk to the FREE tram and a yummy cafe was open most days for a coffee on this walk.

Located in walking distance from the MCG and Federation Sq meant I could park the bike securely in the building and walk or tram to wherever needed.
Also so quiet dispite being next to the railway.

Nice place, very clean and in a very quiet and beautiful suburb close to the centre.
I would defenitely recommend this place for two people, not so much for 3.
Communication was great and the hosts were very quick and effective in responding.
Thank you!!

Overall a great stay, in the heart of Melbourne, close to everything.
Great communication with the hosts as well.

We feel at home staying at the apartment. Love the layout, very comfortable for husband and me. Though unit is near to railway tracks, but was hardly disturbed by it. Surrounding is beautiful (full of greeneries), safe and classy! It’s close to CBD, walkable or short 10-15min drive to heart of city and nearby attractions. This unit is an excellent choice if you drive as carpark is covered and easily accessible. Will definitely come back to stay! 😍👍🏻
Great spot in a great location. First time in Melbourne and felt that this Airbnb was the perfect landing spot. Would definitely return. Loved the personal touches like slippers and welcome sign 😊

Absolutely prime location to stay if attending events at the MCG, 5 minute safe walk to the stadium. Apartment was beautiful and in a quiet location. Great communication from our hosts!  They went out of their way to make our stay comfortable. We will definitely be returning, thank you Marc & MJ for our first Air BnB experience!  Andrea & Kayla
Great apartment in a good location very close to MCG and easy walk to trams and the centre . Had everything we needed and we really enjoyed our stay.

Home away from home! Close to the city! Walking distance to trams! Beautiful space! Comfortable bedding, great amenities! Marc & MJ were always super responsive to messages and asked us how we were doing throughout the entire trip! Very nice hosts! Can’t wait to come back and stay again!!
We had a perfect stay, it was exactly what we needed to attend a conference close by. Very comfortable and quiet, thank you so much!

My folks recently stayed at Marc & MJ's place in East Melbourne for a week during their visit, and they thoroughly enjoyed their time there. The hosts were incredibly welcoming and accommodating, and always responsive.
The apartment itself was lovely—clean, cozy, and equipped with all the necessary amenities. The location was also fantastic, with easy access to everywhere.
Overall, my parents had a wonderful experience at Marc & MJ's place and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a convenient and comfortable stay in Melbourne.
Nice personal touch, good communication and good access to nearby facilities. Trains nearby but no noise during the night. Parking was great.

Loved this place and wish we could have stayed longer. Clear and concise check-in instructions (rare for places in the city!), safe neighbourhood, easy secure parking, comfortable and cosy apartment with all the essentials.
We stayed to attend a show at Hamer Hall which was a 15 minute walk away. I'll definitely try to book this place again during our next visit to the city. Thanks Marc & MJ :)
Great location, close to everything. Although it’s near the station, there is no noise from trains. I will definitely stay with them again. Thank you!
Everything is great. If we have a chance to be back, we shall book here again. It just feels right. Thank you very much.

Great location! Have made a few suggestions to Marc & MJ about certain aspects of our stay. I thank them for being so receptive to that. They were always quick to respond with any help we needed. Thanks for having us!

We had a great stay for the most part. We found a couple of minor things (cat hair) and water damage that may cause potential mould. So just a caution to anyone that is hypersensitive to either.
But honestly, was such a great time and we were blown away by the location and how perfect it suited what we were looking for.

My partner and I really enjoyed our stay in Melbourne and Marc and Mjs place was a great addition to it. It is located conveniently near the MCG and about a 10 - 15 easy walk to the CBD. We had our car with us but did not feel the need to use it.
We had access to all streaming services provided we had our own log in on their tv which made the rainy days a cosy and inviting space to hang out in.
The bed was comfortable, the towels were clean and we were given a big bottle of soap for the week. If I were to come to Melbourne again, I’d definitely stay at their Airbnb again! Thanks guys 👍🏼

Overall was a comfortable stay.
Easy walk to Melbourne Park for tennis. The aircon did leak onto the sofa for the entire time we were there. We reported to managers but did not request a fix until after we left. Other than that, place and location was good
As claimed, the place was very convenient as it was in the CBD area, close to a shopping centre and a lot of food options.  The place was clean when I arrived, and had the listed amenities.
The bathroom can't lock. Which is very uncomfortable. No hair dryer. No tissues paper. Wifi not working. No connection. Good location very close to Chinatown.
Awesome place. Generally clean with good Wi-Fi and smart TV for the kids. Good location as well. Would definitely come here again.
The team at MadeComfy were very responsive and helpful, check in instructions were clear and the property is super valuable. Would highly recommend

We had an extended stay at Kookaburra Hideaway Haven and  it was very clean, comfortable and private with spectacular views of the surrounding hills and beautiful sunrises. The house was well furnished and equipped. Evelin & Rob were friendly and  responsive if you needed anything.  We enjoyed our stay Thank you.

Great view overlooking the valleys and mountains. Inside has spacious living and dining areas and s lovely old world feel as per the photos which suits the property. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

We truly cannot put into words how grateful we are for our experience at this Airbnb. Not only was the property absolutely perfect for our wedding – peaceful and full of charm – but what made our stay truly unforgettable was our host.
From the moment we arrived, they went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and supported. Their thoughtfulness and generosity during such a meaningful time in our lives meant the world to us. They made everything so easy and stress-free, allowing us to focus on our wedding and truly enjoy the experience.
Their kindness, flexibility, and extra touches did not go unnoticed — it’s rare to meet someone who cares so deeply about their guests’ experience.
We will be forever grateful and would give more than five stars if we could. We highly, highly recommend this Airbnb and it’s even pet friendly!!!
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts!

This is a lovely, comfortable and clean unit, very close to great cafes and pubs, all the amenities  and shops you need, and a few steps from the beachfront. Once key is located entry and exit is easy. We did experience problems with the heating and as it was mid-winter and very cold this was no fun. Otherwise, I highly recommend this unit if you want to be in this part of Melbourne - very good value for money and a lovely spot.

Great stay. The only item missing was instructions for the air conditioning at it uses a Universal Remote and needed to be paired. A quick message via Airbnb got the correct code.
Hopefully this gets added to the instructions, but do test the remote as soon as possible and reach out if you need help.

Yudo was a fantastic host, the place was amazing! Very well kept and so close to the beach and Main Street.
Yudo was great at communicating
We had a great stay.
Would recommend A++

This place was wonderful and was able to fit the 6 of us comfortably. It also had amazing views of the city and comes with a free parking spot!
It is in more of an industrial area but there were a few coffee shops within walking distance.
The hosts always responded within an hour to any of our questions.
I would definitely recommend it to anyone staying in Melbourne!
Nice place with 3 bedrooms and good views. Would prefer it to be slightly cleaner though, plus 1 of the beds has sunken in so it is not very comfortable. Other than that, all is great.
Beautiful view of the city and in walking distance to venues in the Port Melbourne area. A clean and well maintained space, quality living quarters, well worth the price.
The place was as good as it looked on the photo. And the host was really responsive. Also, he helped us extend the stay bu one day. He was really helpful.
Great place to stay in the Cbd. The apartment and building is brand new. Couple of minor issues that the host rectified straight away. Overall would recommend if visiting melbourne
Location is fantastic. Highly recommend staying here. Swimming pool and sauna are fantastic. Bed very comfortable.
It was a pleasant stay at Lily’s apartment. It’s located very close to southern cross station and lots of good restaurants nearby. Lily were a great host. Thanks again
Amazing accommodation experience in Lily's place. she's nice and helpful. Looking forward to have another stay in the future!
Awesome apartment in the city, apartment was clean and the view was great, hosts were great very fast at replying to any questions I had, would highly recommend👍
Lily was very accommodating, very luxurious place in the CBD, I will be definitely booking again. Thank you

Roomy modern home with all the amenities you'll need for your stay. Only 12 minutes drive from the Pacific Werribee mall, and the nearest supermarket is only 5 minutes drive away. Being a new suburb, there's also heaps of playgrounds within walking distance for plenty of free entertainment for the children.
Stayed here for 9 nights and it has been a pleasant one. Truly feels like home. Definitely recommending it to family and friends.
Cosy 4 bedroom home with good amenities. Helped us live out of the family home for the period of stay and it was a breeze.

Beautiful home with comfortable beds and spacious rooms! Very minimalistic - which me and mum loved. Also very close to the local mall thankfully.
Annie and Linh were very responsive, easy-going and very kind during our stay.
It would have been good if we could have arranged a longer stay but no problem we were happy with the level of understanding I think price was a bit too much

Clean and exactly as advertised in the photos. I enjoyed the complimentary tea & coffee. Driveway only fits one car and street gets full so keep that in mind if you're a multi-car family. Great location near the shops and the station. Would stay again 👍

Had a wonderful stay at Angel’s Airbnb! Incredibly convenient location with a Coles a 2 minute walk away from you & the train station just 5-10 mins on foot too.
The home was tidy and very well presented, it’s a beautiful modern space. Having space for vehicles was so helpful, and we loved the key pad security system - so easy!
We were very comfortable for the duration of our visit, as a whole it was absolutely fantastic.
Thanks so much Angel for having us! We’d absolutely stay again.
Perfect place just as advertised, great location across the road from the shops and a park. Super clean and very practical place. Would recommend.

We loved our stay at Angel’s home. It’s in a brilliant location, walking distance from everything you might need. The house was so well set up and equiped for a small group getaway, we had everything we needed.
Thank you, Angel 🥰
I can't rate this place highly enough.  Beautifully presented accommodation, exceptionally clean, and great service from our host Angel. Highly recommended!

The House was spotless
Very good location
Very easily accessible
Off street secure parking
Close to shops
Our only negative was the road noise from the front bedrooms
And some beds were extremely firm
Lovely place as photos show. On a busy and noisy road. Very quiet in the back of the house.
Was very beautiful and calming space, very spacious and bigger than I thought, upstairs was gorgeous. Big bedrooms and lovely bathrooms
Angel was so responsive and helpful! The home was beautiful and spacious. I would highly recommend a stay here!

Stayed here with 8 others for a Coldplay concert.
Great place for a family or group of friends. Really clean, modern and well furnished.
Good public transport but well outside of the CBD.
Host was responsive, helpful and pleasant.
No problems
Excellent value

We had an amazing stay, the home was beautiful and clean. The bedrooms were decent size and it was amazing having sitcoms in them especially with how hot Melbourne was during our stay.
It was great being so close to coles where there was an amazing coffee shop next to and Yarraville is very central.
Overall we loved our stay and would highly recommend to future guests.

This place was excellent! Very modern and updated, exactly as described in the listing. Very very clean and many extra special touches like fresh milk in the fridge, extra towels, high end shampoo/conditioner/soap, laundry and dish soap, and even an adorable crib set up for my youngest. The location was great, steps from groceries and a park and a short drive into central Melbourne.

Amazing beautiful house. Very clean, roomy bedrooms excellent location. Coles was a minute walk. Restaurants and train station 10 mins walk. 20mins car ride to Melbourne CBD. Absolutely loved the place. Will be back again.

We really enjoyed our stay. Great location with a supermarket, liquor store and deli/cafe across the road. Super clean, spacious and up to date decor. If you are a light sleeper I wouldn’t recommend sleeping towards the front of the house due to traffic.
Perfect town house for our overnight stay, easily accommodated all guests in beautifully decorated and spacious bedrooms. Light and airy in the house and very comfortable.

The house was clean, modern and had all the amenities that we needed. The location is great with coles and shops just couple of mins walk away. There is also a childrens play area just outside the house. Great place for families.
We were only there for a night- it suited our needs perfectly. Very clean  and as described. It’s a noisy road but nothing can be done about that! We would stay again if we needed to
I was blown away, beautiful and exceptionally comfortable.  Accommodated 4 adults with no problems. Excellent off street parking.  Without doubt will stay here every time we are in town.
Had a great stay at Angel’s place. It’s so convenient! Coles literally across the road and Yarraville restaurants a 3-5 min drive. Would be very happy to stay again.

I organised the stay at Amandas place for cousins who were visiting Melbourne. They loved it! Amanda communicated really well so checking in and out was seemless. It is a lovely apartment in pristine condition.

Amanda’s place was immaculately clean. The towels were fluffy and fresh with plenty of soap, toothpaste, mouthwash, Band-Aid, enough toilet paper.
The little extras and special touches is what stood out.
The WiFi was good too :)

Thanks for a great stay. The apartment was bigger than expected from photos and very well equipped and laid out. Amanda was a generous and helpful host.  It was the perfect place for us, in Melbourne for a family wedding.  We hope to stay again.
Amanda is an amazing host. Extremely thoughtful and responsive and made sure we were well looked after.

Having stayed there a few months ago it was super easy & felt familiar.
Two bedrooms & two bathrooms was important to me & both were of comfortable size & well stocked. Having the extra blankets & good heating made it all very comfortable.
Amanda leaves lovely treats & arriving to fresh milk in the fridge is always good as a cuppa is my first stop.
Thanks for another lovely stay.
This is our second stay with Amanda. It’s perfect for our family and well priced. The kids love having their own beds and all the extra touches make it special. Thanks for having us again!
Very clean & well-appointed apartment, was perfect for our needs. Bit of street noise in the bedrooms so would recommend bringing earplugs :)

Great location with Darebin Train station nearby for trips into the city, and also a short walk up to Ivanhoe main street and shops/cafes with everything you need. The accommodation was as listed and was very neat, tidy and clean with easy check in instructions. Amanda was very accommodating and easy to communicate with. Bed was very comfy, better than at home! Added bits and pieces to make the stay easier such as milk and snacks were great!
I was aware of reports of street noise when I booked. It didn't bother us too much as it does get quieter throughout the evening, but for light sleepers who are not used to it, it may be bothersome.
Amanda organised a car park for us. We have a mid size family station wagon, no worries with size in the underground car park.
I would definitely book again!
Amanda’s space was cosy and comfortable. The location is very convenient and near to shops. Thank you!

The location was great as close to tram and train line.
The place was lovely but it could be less furnished in the living area.
The lighting could be improved as too bright, perhaps a few lamps so soften the ambiance of the place.
Overall we love our stay!!

Irene and Ronald’s place was almost new, very comfortable, and safe for kids. The location is right above the QV with access to great restaurants, shops, Woolworths, Officeworks, and BigW.  It has a great view of Melbourne, especially during sunset and night time. We had access to pool (kids need supervision), and gym. Beds were very comfortable. It is very quiet as well! We would love to come back.
Loved this place. The vibe was surreal and was perfect for a romantic getaway out in the ranges
Great location right near the town! The house was very cute and well set up. Enjoyed our stay very much.
Danny’s place is very cute, in a wonderful location - car not needed. We were warm and comfortable, thank you so much!
Gorgeous little cottage in a very beautiful and peaceful area. Place has everything you’d need a few nights. Recommended!

Bedspoke provided a lovely place that felt very homely and provided everything I needed for my stay. I felt very safe and comfortable and the apartment was within walking distance to shops and public transport. Overall, incredibly satisfied, lovely stay.

I stayed 3 day long weekend my stay was great
It’s a very nice place and very good host

I needed accomodation whilst I had a week at La Trobe University and this location was PERFECT! I could walk to the shops, the univeristy and restaurants nearby. The hosts were extremely helpful and checked in often to make sure that everything was ok. They did their best to get us in our accomodation earlier as well. Well worth the price, location and ease of booking.

This apartment is very clean, modern and well appointed, safe, well located, has beautiful surrounds within walking distance, and the host is very responsive. We enjoyed our stay there and would recommend it to others.

Location was absolutely brilliant. We were going to game at Marvel stadium, so was fabulous. Place was clean, great shower and comfy beds.
Only problem was we needed to use sofa bed; which Peter knew, but there was no extra linen or pillows or blanket. We made do, but not ideal given 260 per night.

Peter was lovely to deal with and was super quick with his responses. The apartment was clean and easy to get to. Peter's apartment had everything we needed to have a beautiful weekend away in Melbourne with 2 teenage girls.

Peter went above and beyond for our stay. He was always super responsive, helpful and kind. He was very respectful of our privacy and also wanting to ensure we enjoyed our stay. Would 100% recommend this as a place to stay and Peter as the host. Thank you for making my sons birthday great!

Apartment was clean and well located within the cbd. Peter was very responsive, can be a little confusing at first parking the car in the car park, but shouldn't be an issue thereafter. Overall good place in a good location.

Great location near to the Southern Cross
Peter is so responsive and solves the problems so quickly if necessary .
Peter was very nice to answer all the problems I had asked, which made me feel comforted and secured about the place he provided.

Stayed at Peter’s place for the Coldplay concert. Location was perfect and everything we wanted was within walking distance. Peter responded very promptly even on last minute bookings! Very clean and tidy place also. Even better has free parking

It is on a very nice location - very accessible to everything especially to the main transport hub — Southern Cross Station (where you also take the SkyBus to the airport). The place is also really well kept and tidy, and has all the main amenities and equipment. Peter was also very responsive (even past 11pm which I felt real sorry about) and provided very clear instructions. Will come back next time when I'm in Melbourne!

This is a fabulous place! Kids and adults loved the pool and were disappointed that the other amenities ( cinema, library, vr golf) were not available to renters. Location is great-Coles, trams, right nearby and we felt safe-we’ll return!
bad experience with Host as well as stay, the whole apartment filled with noticeable smell, noises and got blamed for losing throw. Ensure you video each room before leaving the apartment.
Thanks Peter for letting us stay. However the room without the central control is a bit cold at night, need more blanket. Btw, if there is tissue box in the house will be better too. Thanks!
Peter was a very welcoming host, great communication, we enjoyed our stay, perfect location. Thank you.

Addison is pretty kind as we can’t find the carpark, he went down and bring us to the correct enter. His house is big and clean, the location was convenience, within free tram zone and can access to the tourist location in a very short time. Free parking is a bonus of this stay. Definitely will return here again when I visit Melbourne next time.
Great unit as a spot for a weekend in Melbourne. Right near all transport options and across the road from Marvel Stadium. 10/10
Clean and tidy apartment conveniently located close to Marvel Stadium. Easy walk to DFO and Southern Cross Station. Host communicated clearly with us.

This apartment suited our needs close 5 min walk over the road to marvel stadium, we only needed a place to sleep as we were out most of the time. Clean well maintained. Little noisy but that was the trucks going into marvel stadium removing the soil from the superx track which was the event we attended. Would stay there again if we attended anything at marvel stadium. Thanks for a good overnight stay .

Addison’s communication was fantastic, helped us out with everything that was asked, gave us a few tips of local transport options and directions on where to find things, the unit was clean and tidy and looked as the pictures showed. The unit is in a very central location and within walking distance to southern cross station and the trams.
Would recommend this to anyone looking to stay in the Dockland area.
Thank you Addison for your hospitality it was greatly appreciated. Will be back for sure in the future.

Highly recommend Addison’s place… easy to get to self driving without so much Melbourne traffic, excellent location with ease of walking or free trams. Clean and lovely appartment with everything we needed and more. Will definitely make this our first choice when next in Melbourne

Conveniently located near the heart of the CBD, this Airbnb was perfect for accessing public transportation. The tram stop was just a short walk away, making it easy to get around. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking to experience the city.

Excellent option in Melbourne. The apartment is very comfortable and has everything you need for a perfecr stay.
It was a bit difficult to find the place as the instructions weren't very clear.
my 2nd time in this bnb and it's great place great amenities  and easy  to communicate  with the host
Small, cute and comfortable. The accommodation was conveniently close to Marvel stadium, Spencer Outlet Centre, train station and pubs / restaurants.

A great location for getting around the CBD. Secure apartment building. Beautiful views. The apartment itself is a little tired, with stains on the carpets and marks on the walls. And the kitchen utensils/cookware are very limited.
We had a great stay. Trent was easy to communicate with. Great apartment and great location. Would recommend staying here if you want a place in the CBD.

Host Anna is very kind and considerate of the guests.
For me, who is not good at English, she chose easy words and talked to me,
she recommended things to enjoy around me,
Also, there is a station nearby, so the transportation is very good.
And she is with a very shy dog, so I hope you can approach she slowly!
Thanks: )

My family and I enjoyed our stay at Caroline's place for 4 nights. She was friendly and welcoming on our first day at Melbourne.
Her place is modern, spacious, comfortable, well maintained and close to many shops. The double garage was a plus for us as we had a large rental car 😁
It's a great place to stay ,a good location and very peaceful with a beautiful garden...It's such a beautiful place and it was highly recommend..thank you so much!!!

Hampton’s place ticked the boxes for me. I just needed an economic solution for the night. It was warm, cosy quiet and clean. Comfy bed and a nice room. Best of all simple access and car parked on the street right outside. I slept like a log.
Hampton catered for my late arrival too.
Living in this house makes me feel like going back to my grandma's house. It is very warm. The color of the whole room is also very comfortable. Will come again next time!!
great environment and location. Only complaint would be that the room was very hot and the fan provided wasn't affective. staff were kind and check in was easy.

Great location. Walking distance to the CBD and a stone throw from Southbank. Lily was a very responsive host. The building of tis apartment is really well kept. The apartment was clean, easy to access and perfect for 3 couples. We would stay here again if we had something to do in the area.

Great location and lovely apartment.
Was a bit of hassle trying to pick up and drop off key to a different location when we had a lot of luggage and a baby.
Also aircon was only in the living room. No fan or aircon in bedrooms.
Other than that enjoyed our stay.

We booked Lily’s place to celebrate my Mum’s 81st birthday. The apartment was really comfortable and had easy access to Southbank, Flinders Street and the city, and access within the property was wonderful. To check in and collect the keys you have to walk a couple of blocks from the apartment, which I preplanned and collected the keys in advance as the walk there and back would have been too much for my elderly mother. The heating is really good in the apartment, but a couple of extra blankets would be good as my Mum got cold both nights. Or, for future guests, use this as a heads up to bring extra layers for older guests or people who feel the cold more.
Had a great stay. Loved the apartment and the view.  Dealing with owners was very easy. Check in was available until 10pm, very good when your plane is late coming in.

It was my fist AirBNB experience but hence had some issues finding the keybox but instructions were clear, i was new to the area. Loved the apartment, very homely. Loved my stay there.
On the whole, had a very pleasant stay. Host was very helpful and responsive and I would definitely stay again.
The owner was very nice and super quick with responses, very accommodating and the view of the city was perfect
Nice apartment in a great location. The shower floods which isn’t ideal. A vacuum cleaner would be great for a longer stay like ours. Close to lots of shops and eateries - would recommend.

The wifi was not availabe, need the host to come to repair. The check out time was not the same as the Airbnb described.
Location was perfect

Great location and room.
The host didn’t prepare the parking lot for us didn’t answer the chat for about 10 hour on the check in date. We tried to call by telephone number, the host tell us to use the paid parking nearby, although we have confirmed that we want the parking in advance.
The oven buttons are freely unadjustable. The dishwasher was leak during the night.
But the overall is good, I still recommended staying here when the host give it a more maintenance.
Nice place to stay. Very good view and good location. It’s close to everywhere you want to go.

Great place and ideal location, the access of the swimming pool, sauna and hot baths was amazing after a long trip.
Very responsive on check in and also following up on everything.
5 Stars
Great place really close to the CBD, right on the Tram route is really helpful. Really good amount of spice comfy bed overall I’ll stay there again.
Super close to a good cafe, place was tidy and we felt at home. The host provided clear instructions for our check in and check out. Thanks for hosting us!

Great apartment in a great location for visit to Melbourne. Well managed building. Easy to tour around Melbourne as public transport close by. We enjoyed our visit with a group of four, using the two bedrooms and the fold out couch.

The place was fine and the host was helpful but there were a few simple things that could have made our stay better. The shower stall and the bathroom sink needed cleaning and the toilet leaked. The toilet lid was loose. The door to the balcony was very dusty and dirty. The towels needed replacing. These weren't big problems but small things like this could have made for a better stay.

Lovely apartment in an ideal location in Melbourne. Responsive host with very clear instructions. Apartment was largely clean with only a few minor things that could be improved if I was being picky such as the loose toilet lid, a few stains on the bed sheets, and some hair on the sofa cushions. Nevertheless, definitely a great property to stay in.

Very good stay in this place.
It was very clean.
Beds are very comfortable.
Very good location.
Very satisfied
Great place, great location and the host was very helpful and responsive!  I look forward to booking this again!!
Nice city living view from 26th floor.  Walking distance to river. Tram to city across the road. Parking on street across the road. We had an enjoyable stay thank you
Good location, the wifi password they gave me was not correct but my stay was short so it is alright. Kitchenware needs to be better cleaned.

Peter's place was a great place to stay on our first trip to Melbourne. The 3 bedroom was perfect for us 5 adults and 2 kids. Location is great as it was walking distance to main shopping streets, Chinatown, theatre, convenience stores, and lots of great restaurants. It's also near parks where we had morning runs.
The place had full kitchen, washer, dryer, 2 large bathrooms, enough supply for basic needs, and the sheets and beds were very comfy.
Peter was responsive all throughout from booking to end of our stay. It was just a fantastic trip overall! Will definitely consider booking again when we decide to go back to Melbourne for another holiday!
Great place, great location. The only reason for a 4 star is because they couldn’t accommodate with holding our luggage after checking out
Excellent location.  The apartment is clean and cozy, and it is value for money.  Peter and his team are very friendly and helpful. we have enjoyed very much our stay!
The apartment was clean, has great view, right in the city center, and the stay was amazing. Definitely recommended.

The apartment had an awesome view! Peter’s communication was excellent and his response to any questions was very fast. Finding the apartment was very easy and locating the keys nearby was found with very clear instructions - we were lucky that we were able to drop our bags off downstairs at the apartment complex with our daughter while we went to get the keys.
The apartment itself was very clean! As it was only our second airbnb we weren’t aware of some amenities to look for such as block out curtains in the bedroom. This was easy to overcome with a sleeping mask though. And didn’t detract from the apartment. Peter was also quick to replace the toaster when we found it wasn’t working!
Overall it was a wonderful stay and was so close to everything we had planned and booked. Peter was a wonderful host and I very much appreciated his responses to all questions.

For anyone (one or two people) looking for a short or long term (gor my case 2 weeks), I would highly recommend Hannah's place. It has all the necessaries you would need or haven'texpected (washing, dryer, iron, cooking utensils, coffee machine, electric blanket was handy in Melbourne's October, etc) within the rental place.
two thumbs up.

Shared kitchen and bathroom but kept very clean and tidy! A bean to cup coffee machine for your morning coffee and we’ll equipped kitchen.
The room is as described - a little dark, but comfortable.
Some nice restaurants and bars in Preston and area is quiet and feels safe. Had a great time here.
Check in was super easy and host was very friendly, polite and always really responsive. Allowed us a flexible check out time which really helped us out.
Good value for money overall and would recommend if you are on a budget!

Everyone has their own preferences, but for me and my daughter, it was an ideal option for an overnight stay in terms of price and quality. Considering that we checked in quite late and planned to leave early, it was particularly convenient. We might come back again.

I was attending an event locally & Helen's listing seemed to tick all the boxes. I wasn't disappointed, finding a clean & well laid out room awaiting my arrival, bathroom & other shared facilities were all in excellent condition. I highly recommend this listing.

It was very comfortable stay at Helen place. Felt like home.
Highly recommended.

Great little studio with easy access. Train or bus connections are close the Airbnb which is helpful.
Helen had the rooms very clean and well set up.
Bathrooms were shared which we didn’t realise but made sense and wasn’t an issue.
Place is nice and tidy, private and easy access. Had no problems with checking in, everything clean and organised and Helen is very friendly and responsive. I’d definitely recommend the place!

The home is well set up and user friendly to accommodate a busy family . We were impressed the first time hence rebooking again. This will be our first preference everytime when we are visiting again . Thanks

Good stay at the accommodation.
Great location, 2mins drive to The Glen shopping mall.
Provided everything we needed for the stay.
Fantastic location, great hostess, stylish apartment with all needs catered and more.  Extremely clean and very comfortable bedding.  Will definitely be returning.  Thank you for your hospitality.

We were three and the apartment was absolutely perfect, we had a great stay!
Perfect location, clean, has all you need to make you feel at home.
Kylie is a great host, very helpful and proactive, always answers very quickly.
I definitely recommend and I would stay there again.

Stayed here for two days with family and my infant, it was beautiful place to stay! Everything was clean, accomodating to small children and very spacious! Kylie was very easy to communicate with and was super friendly! Can’t recommend more! It was more than worth the price! Will stay there again! Thank you!
Perfect stay for small families and couples. Nothing was forgotten to make it feel like your just at home. Reliable hosts. We will be back!!!

Absolutely fantastic location.
The apartment is awesome with everything to make our stay perfect.
Kylie is the perfect host with great communication.
I would highly recommend this gem apartment. Close to everything that is needed for a great stay in Melbourne.

Everything was just wonderful! Kylie was amazing, responsive and helpful. Kylie thought of  everything for the apartment to make it practical. It was just like staying at our own home. The property is a credit to Kylie. Thank you to Kylie for such an amazing stay. Apartment was just fantastic, clean, comfy, close to everywhere we wanted, smelled amazing! The kids loved the snacks and breakfast items left for us to use.
We will make your place our place of stay for anymore more Melb visits.
kind Regards
The Boldt Family

Very comfortable, convenient and well equipped place to stay, just like at home.

Thanks Kelly and Gordon for providing such a great accommodation.
We do really enjoy our stay and have a great time in Melbourne.

It’s the best AirBnb we have so far in my years of experience staying with Airbnb!  Kylie’s apartment is so clean and plenty of supplies tea coffee and snacks. I had an absolutely fantastic stay at this Airbnb!!! The place was sparkling clean and had the best smell that made me feel right at home. Thanks Kylie for the lovely stay

Kylie and Gordons apartment is beautifuly furnished,  its  exceptionally clean, they  supplied so much more than we expected, Kylie was so easy to communicate with, she was there to meet us with the keys as soon as we arrived and quickly responded to all my messages, apartment is only 5 minute walk to supermarket and a shopping centre, the car park is an added bonus as I'm not a fan of driving I'm Melbourne.  we had a concert at Margaret Court Arena and easily walked there in about half hour. checking out was just as quick and easy as check in as when we were leaving we just messaged Kylie and she met us in the same place to return keys.  I will definitely book ahead and stay there when I'm next in Melbourne.
Kyliw was a very informative host . Loved all the special little extras  especially the Tim tams . Highly recommend staying at Kylie's for an inner city experience .

Absolutely loved our stay at this apartment! From the moment we arrived, we were blown away by how spotless and beautifully styled it was. The beds were incredibly comfortable and the linen, fresh! The location couldn’t have been more perfect, so convenient for everything we wanted to do. The photos are great, but they honestly don't do justice to just how amazing this place truly is. Kylie was a wonderful host, so welcoming. Highly recommend this apartment!
Beautiful place with so many extra special touches. Beautifully decorated and very comfortable. Kylie was an excellent host. We loved our stay. Thank you.

Absolutely great place. Amazing apartment a with amazing host! There are even snacks in the apartment makes one feel like home. Kylie is absolutely amazing as well. I would recommend strongly to stay here!

This was like a home away from home. Kylie has gone to great lengths to ensure that guests have everything they need and more. She was lovely to deal with, making sure we knew she was there to help in any way she could. Beautiful accommodation and a fabulous location!
Kylie's apartment was very comfortable, had a well-equiped kitchen and bathroom and was centrally located for our stay in Melbourne.

We had an amazing experience staying at this apartment. Everything was spotless and beautifully arranged — it’s clear the host puts a lot of thought into every detail. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a top-notch Airbnb experience. Thank you Kylie
we have  lovely stay in the apartment .   Kylie is very helpful  . Thank you for making the stay so enjoyable !!

Great location, and the host was friendly and accommodating, offering us a discount due to the property's condition. This place has potential if the cleaning and internet issues are addressed.
Michael is a lovely host , very respectful very helpful and gave me lifts when needed highly recommend such a lovely house and goes out of his way to ensure your stay is perfect

Good unit and set up well. There's only one shower but the toilet is in another room so that makes it easier when another guest is in the bathroom or toilet. I'd certainly stay again, but far from city but public transport is excellent
Great location and very clean. Lydia and Peter were very responsive and answered all questions very quickly. Would definitely stay again.

The staff were very friendly and however the quality of the room and the amenities were really poor. I could have had better value for money. My room wasn't cleaned properly, toilet was not cleaned properly amd also the tables in the room had food stains on them.

nice for a last min booking, fast response and friendly service but the room was underwhelming, theres was no doona for the bed, no cutlery, the TV was very poor quality and the parking is a bit dodgy
Such a beautiful location…perfect for our family catch up. The house is gorgeous and the pool table was a real highlight.

From the moment we entered we felt at home.  We arrived late as flights were delayed and the welcome goodies were truly appreciated.  Such a nice place, well appointed and well kept. We really enjoyed the area, tree lined streets along with great cafe & restaurants close by.
Beautifully presented home. Newly renovated and very stylish. Great location near beach and middle park shops. Very comfortable with lovely treats on arrival.  We loved our stay!

Fabulous location, a few minutes walk to the station. We were a group of 3 adults and 5 children. Used the studio at the back plus the house. Studio bed is double size, house beds all queen size.
