We highly recommend the “2BR Large Balcony facing Flinders Street Station” property to anyone seeking a central and hospitable place to stay in Melbourne. We look forward to returning in the future.
Phenomenal hospitality and excellent location for those wishing to be in the heart of the city action. Light sleepers will definitely want to use the provided ear plugs though 🙂.
Great place, perfect for a family or large group. Steps from the beach. Couldn’t ask for more. Thank you!

Beautiful apartment with everything you need for your stay. Amazing views!
Close to trains, trams and shops, great location to get around the city.
Hosts were great to deal with and very responsive with our questions.
Loved our stay and would come back again.

We had a beautiful stay within Rita’s place. Location was perfect, super close to the supermarket, walking distance to majority of attractions. Rita had amazing communication, answering every question within a good time period.
Had a fantastic stay! The property was clean, well-equipped, and in a great location. The host was responsive and made everything easy. Highly recommend

I stayed here for 9 nights for a work trip and it was exactly what I needed. Had a kitchen with enough basics to cook. Bed was extremely comfortable and the place had everything I needed. Angela was a great host and very flexible throughout my stay. Very homely air bnb.

Absolutely love this place and the amazing view. It was nice having a good balcony to relax and watch the sunrise on mornings. The great views extend to the bedroom as well. I got great workouts at the gym and was close to restaurants and the bus to and from the airport. Convenient location with the amenities. I washed my clothes and dried them prior to departure! Don’t put too many clothes to dry at once or else you will have to run it again for an additional hour. I would definitely stay here again!

Sparsely furnished with cheap basics. Huge heavy main bed. No space to move around . We stubbed our shins and toes several times!
Mismatched Crockery was mostly cracked and well worn. Eg only 3 mugs of which 2 were cracked. No juice glasses or tumblers. It reminded us of Backpacker hostels.
I washed 2 entire pillows (took 3 days to dry out) and pillow protectors.

The apartment is as pictured and described . Key collection was easy. Very convenient to Southern Cross Station and everything around this part of Melbourne. Free tram makes all the CBD accessible if you don't want to walk it !  Enjoyed the pool, gym and sauna. Great for a weekend getaway.

The place was so beautiful to stay in. We had a little trouble with the TV not working
But the host was so kind a quick to help us. This place is so close to everything too!
We had a fantastic stay at Joanna’s lovely apartment. It was close to the action of the city, but quiet. Good communication when I couldn’t figure out how to open the sofa bed! A great place to stay.
Joanna is such an amazing, helpful host! High recommend staying here, it was such a convenient location with everything in walking distance!

Katie was a fabulous host who went above and beyond for me and my two sons. Her penthouse is one of the nicest I have stayed at and made us feel like we were at home (besides that incredible view)
We will be back on the regular (availability depending)

Amazing view and Katie was a great host.
Very accurate description of the apartment.
Will be back.

Stunning location and the view is breathtaking and very relaxing. The location made it easy to access all the city restaurants and transport is within easy walking distance if you wanted a quiet night in and cook at home. Katie was very responsive if we had any questions which helped make it a such a stress free week. We really enjoyed our time at the apartment and can’t wait to visit again.

Katie’s apartment is amazing, with 270 degrees panoramic view of Melbourne, and living on 76th floor truly makes you feel like you are at the top of the world. The apartment is walking distance to crown and flinders station! We will definitely be back!

The views from the apartment are amazing.
Easy walking distance to the convention centre and all that Southbank has to offer.
Would definitely stay here again when in Melbourne.

The apartment is what you see and get. Fabulous views and easy walking to restaurants and cafe's. The kitchen wasn't as well stocked with utensils for a party of five people and our fridge ice maker failed. Also we understand a complex like this has a focus on safety and why an induction was necessary.... but only two evenings in the week to do this?  when you are most likely to be out and about enjoying Melbourne, definitely disappointing. Suggest to enjoy the facilities that we didn't, pool, movie theater etc, make sure you book to allow for the one hour induction and the two available days of the week they happen. Otherwise you will be pleasantly surprised with the location and views.

I had a great stay at Alex's place!  it was clean,  tidy and met my expectations accurately.   The location was perfect for attending a conference in the same area and communication with Alex was great throughout my stay.

Hosts were friendly, easy check in and check out. The location was great and the views were beautiful. Apartment was clean and tidy, and had everything we needed. Walkable distance from the city centre and train station. I would recommend this place.

Stayed with my girlfriend for just under a week.
We chose to stay here as we’d stayed in the complex before and knew the area
Hosts were very responsive and apologetic when necessary.
Location is perfect, early access to the city via a tram, close to river with restaurants, close to a Woolworths as well as a nice view of the city.
Heating was amazing, didn’t quite reach the bedroom fully but you could tell it was on.
Facilities were perfect, lots of things to cook with!
Only thing we would have loved was a rug for the bed/couch at night time, otherwise everything was fab.
Would recommend this place!
Great location. Easy access. Clean and tidy with all the essentials for a city stay! Thanks Alex

It was a nice apartment in a good location that was near restaurants and a shopping centre. The only thing I’d say is it did have a bit of wear and tear that could’ve been to attended to more (the blinds, the walls, balcony floors ect) 😊

Nice stay in Southbank that is very close to the Melbourne Exhibition Centre and Crown. Highly recommend a stay here if you’re planning a trip into Melbourne and are looking at attending an event at one of these venues! Hosts were great and place was super neat and cozy!
In a pretty good area, very close to tram stop, good view of the city. Easy to check in and out. Was a good stay!

Wonderful spot, and the host Bethany was very helpful, super quick communication, and accurate listing.
The apartment was spotless, new and modern, with all amenities you would need.
Thank you for a great stay, highly recommended 😄

We really appreciated the effort Bethany had put into making the apartment comfortable, clean and how well provided it was.  She was very friendly and helpful and we would definitely recommend this place!
Everything was perfect the place was in beautiful shape and beautifully decorated. So central to shops and the city. Would stay again!

Absolutely amazing place to stay. Close to everything and in such an amzing area.
Would defenitely book here again
Beautiful place, close to public transport and very quiet  surroundings. Thoroughly enjoyed the stay.

Great little place to stay! Beth was amazing, helped us every step of the way and was more than accomodating as they had to meet us for late check in! The place was so clean - it was crazy clean!! Great view of the race course in the back ground! Everything was comfortable, great kitchen! Would stay again for sure.

This apartment was immaculate! It felt like stepping into a brand new apartment. The amenities were great and it was only a few minutes walk to the bus stop that takes you straight to the city. Bethany was a gracious and helpful host.
Would definitely recommend this if you’re planning to stay a tiny bit out of the CBD.

Absolutely amazing apartment. It was everything we could have wanted and more. Beautifully designed and furnished, the accomodation was equiped with everything you may possibly need from an iron to pots and pans. The facilities (pool, gym, outdoor area/running track) were a perfect touch to our getaway. The host, Bethany, was so lovely and her communication was second to none.
A great little apartment that's close to Footscray's restaurants, bars and public transport. The apartment itself was quiet, comfortable had all the nessecities needed. We had a wonderful stay.
beautiful apartment, with amazing hosts very friendly and helpful 11/10 would recommend and will definitely be back

If you have things in Footscray, Melb Cuo, or  the city and don’t want to stay in the CBD this is a great spot. Relaxing walks along the river, great little bars all within walking distance and a pristine place to come back to.

The property face is maintained for good reason and in keeping with historical buildings. The inside I fabulous. A cnsistent look and feel from a recent major renovation.
location to Lygon Street, Carlton, Collingwood and transport is great. close enough to walk, far enough for quiet.
Why book 4 hotel rooms when you can book this great place for less and have all the benefits of shared spaces and services.
Thanks Aaron and Young.

Aaron's apartment was in a fabulous location.  An easy 4 min walk to Lygon St with all the best restaurants and shopping. Aaron was a great host who was so quick to respond to any queries that I had. Would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone.
A really beautiful and cosy place to stay! And I will definitely book it again, but maybe during a less windy period.

The house was in a fantastic location and was in close proximity to public transport. The house was very clean, tidy and well equipped.
From the front the place looks tiny but it had plenty of space, with 4 bedrooms and indoor/outdoor living spaces.

Jade's place is wonderful! A short walk to the heart of Lygon street, trams to the city and just about anything else you could possibly need.
The apartment itself is quiet and well equipped. Would definitely start there again next time I'm in Melbourne

The house was very conveniently located for us (no killer Warburton hills!) and was very clean. Yarra Valley Rentals were very responsive during our stay bringing extra linen and tea towels when requested. They also called us to let us know we'd forgotten something - great service. It does have a bit of a corporate airbnb feel, so if you're looking for a cute and charming place with character this is not it. But it was very comfortable, clean and convenient. Worth noting that the kitchen supplies are fairly basic (no large bowls, platters, coffee plunger etc) so if you're planning to cook much it's possibly worth bringing a few things like that. It is right on the main road so can be a bit noisy on the outdoor deck if you're sensitive to that kind of thing.

Great location, close to shops, cafes and restaurants. Close to transport and venues.
Older building but well presented with security gate and front door lock.
Maree was very helpful and responsive to my questions.
We really enjoyed our stay and thank you to Marc and MJ for all their help. We would definitely stay again.
Plenty of space for us to spread out, well appointed and comfortable beds. In a quiet street and yet very close walk to supermarket, cafes and public transport. We will definitely stay here again.

So close to the Hawthorn Tram and Train Stop [Burwood/Hawthorn] made getting downtown easy.  House had a marvellous art deco/Victorian charm from the exterior features,  to the interior finishes.  Really loved the covered parking!  Security system helped with peace of mind, but the neighbourhood felt safe and friendly.   Barton Mllk Bar down the street is marvelous!    Thanks Marc and MJ!

It was a great home base for us. We wanted a place near to city yet able to experience a quieter residential area. The house was very well set and had everything we need.
While we didn't meet Marc or MJ, it was clear they are excellent and responsive host and fielded our queries without delay. Thank you for having us!

With 4 adults and one baby Marc and MJ's house was perfect for us.  Very well equipped with a cot, highchair, changing mat, full kitchen etc.  Super comfortable, very warm, clean, we felt right at home with all of the books and art.  Very handy to both the tram and the train and plenty of options at the local shops.  Marc and MJ were very responsive.  Highly recommend.
Great view great stay everything was perfect from the seamless check in to the clean room and quiet surroundings. Really enjoyed the multiple balconies and nice tv

Unmatched location - apartment is easily located within walking distance of several great attractions including Queen Victoria Market and is also located in the Free Tram Zone which means you can get to lots of great places in the CBD for free. The host is very communicative and responsive. Apartment includes a dedicated parking spot which is rare to find! Comfy beds and lots of natural light. There are some quirks which one would expect with city living and with having a corporate property manager (eg early check-in includes an additional charge; check-in is with a concierge rather than a property host) but overall the company tries to make your stay comfortable and easy and it’s a great find if you’re looking for the Melbourne city experience.
Great place to stay right in the middle of the city.  Beautiful views and lovely to sit out on the deck overlooking the city.  Walkable to the mall and train station.

Great little apartment in Richmond. We chose to walk into Melbourne and to Carlton and Fitzroy, (all about 40 mins walk) but there is plenty of nearby public transport and Uber was around $12 into the city. The Inner suburbs of Melbourne offer a unique and quieter experience than staying in the city, with countless cafes, restaurants, pubs and shops all within close walking distance.
The apartment was clean and well appointed with a lovely little balcony, the bed was comfortable and the bathroom well stocked.
Great for a stopover if you want to be out of the city centre, or for longer stays.

Other than some difficulties connecting to the WiFi (which was quickly resolved) and no tea towel in the kitchen,  the space was perfect for my young families needs. The location is a quiet area, close to the train station. Bed was comfy and the apartment suited our needs perfectly.

Rate was near to $246 / nite.
Probably expected more “tech”such as Smart TV & internet.

This stay was exactly what we needed for a weekend getaway. The pictures don’t do the property justice - we were absolutely blown away by how gorgeous it was. Eliza was also a great host - she had left us some complimentary cupcakes and champagne as well. The game room was one of the best highlights for us as well! Definitely worth the money and will look forward to return someday.

Yarradene is an amazing luxury house, in a quiet location with amazing natural surroundings. The house itself is beautiful and well equipped, we could not ask for anything more. Shane is a super host who is responsive, helpful and has lots of great recommendations! Would love to come back again next time we are in Healesville!

The property is simply breathtaking! We stayed here for our wedding weekend and had everything we needed, it was peaceful and watching the sunset from the hill is incredible. Highly recommend the property for a bridal party or a simple get away with friends and/or family

Place is a good size, location and good value for money. Had comfortable beds, nice linen and choice of pillows. Unfortunately it had an odour of dog, they did note it was pet friendly so maybe should be expected, but we did need to leave the balcony door open when in lounge. We had trouble finding it as unit # not part of address, only found when looking up 'how to get there. Easy and polite to communicate with though.
Internet was not strong.  Problems streaming 9now so we missed watching the Olympics. Don’t understand why there is no free to air channels.

Thanks Luke for a great 3 night stay. So close to everything and around the corner from my sons place. Loved that you had a little shaver kit in the bathroom. Beds super comfy, great pillows. Amazing view to the city from
Laying in bed with the curtains up of a morning. Super comfy unit with everything we needed. Loved the park next door and how handy was for trains and trams. Sorry I didn’t put the glasses back where they were, I couldn’t reach the shelf😁

Me and my friend stayed for two nights at Luke’s place with my dog. Place was so clean and spacious. Nice cafes and restaurants are near by, easy to catch tram and cute little park to take dog for a quick walk.
I would definitely recommend this place:)
Thank you.
Luke’s home was exactly what we were after. Close to family, clean and well worth the money. Thank you for an enjoyable stay.

This accomodation was perfect for us: comfortable and right on the doorstep of Sydney Rd, so exploring cafes, bars, restaurants and shops was very easy. Nice little neighbourhood park next door. Luke was an awesome host. Offered fantastic local recommendations upon request, sorted a Myki card for us to use whilst there for public transport which was very generous, and accommodated a request for a late checkout. Super easy and friendly to deal with, couldn’t recommend more.

We had such a great stay at Luke’s! The location was amazing and the place was really great, super clean and comfortable. Luke was very responsive to everything we needed and let us check in early. Would not hesitate to stay here again!

The apartment was great - it had everything we needed. Awesome location overlooking a park, with lots of food options nearby. The bedrooms were bigger than they looked on the photos. Note that there are 3 flights of stairs to get to the apartment, but once there, getting in was super easy. Thanks Luke for a lovely stay!

Lovely little space walking distance from St Kilda centre and directly next to tram and bus links. Property was very clean and provided all the amenities we needed for a relaxing and comfortable stay in St Kilda! Would recommend
Cute little flat in an easy-to-navigate area of St Kilda. Easily sleeps 2 people; the sofa bed is comfy. Was so lovely to bring my dog, he loved Melbourne!
Our first time at Australia, picked this apt through airbnb. It’s worth it. Kate is very responsive when we need her

A quiet little place but still so close to the hustle and bustle of St Kilda. Was a good base for our two night stay. The shower had amazing water pressure and we found both beds pretty comfy.
Do be aware if you're using the sofa bed in the lounge though that the blinds in that room don't block out much light at all so you will need an eye mask if you want to sleep past 6am during daylight savings.

We loved staying at Kate's place in vibey St Kilda - very central location. Bedding and beds were great, even the pull-out couch. With the air conditioning it was a cool, bright and light haven in the midst of a heatwave.

Kate Apartmetn description and pictures were all accurate We booked late during the busier school holiday period as we decided to detour on the way to the snow.   Four of us in total , If we were going g to stay longer we may have opted for a non sofa bed stay , But the size and configuration suited us perfectly at this trip. We did not feel crowded at all, using the sofa  bed in the living room / kitchen area

It's the second time we have stayed in one of Nick's apartments and it was as good as always.
Communication was excellent and the place was immaculate.
I highly recommend Nick's places.

Amazing apartment in a great location. The apartment itself was very clean, handy parking and lovely views from the balcony.
Would absolute return and highly recommend!
Thank you, Hugo.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

One of the best Airbnbs I've ever stayed in. The place is absolutely stunning, in the most perfect location and the finishing touches are simply gorgeous. Hugo was a great host and made the whole check-in/check-out process so easy with clear instructions. My favourite part of the apartment is the bathroom with the incredible chrome detailing!
We had a great stay at this Collingwood - amazing apartment and building - everything was excellent!!!

Katrina's apartment was really spacious, clean and nicely decorated. It was close to public transport and perfect for attending an event at the Malvern Town Hall, with lots of nearby eateries. Katrina was very responsive and generously allowed an early check-in. I would highly recommend and will likely stay again. Thanks Katrina!
This place was so Cody and comfy felt safe and at home very clean and easy communication for any questions I had with the stay.
We had a wonderful stay at Anna’s apartment - gorgeous and thoughtful interior design, super cosy, comfortable bed, and great location! Would stay again
I love this lovely house and really enjoyed staying there. Anna is so kind and always respond so quickly. The house looks exactly the same as the photos she taken!

Had an awesome stay at Anna’s place. It was a cool, comfortable and peaceful apartment in a nice area. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to stay in Melbourne but doesn’t want to be in the CBD. Would 100% stay again!

Anna’s place was incredibly cosy, clean and comfortable having all essentials necessary for a relaxing stay. She was also very responsive and had some great recommendations for restaurants and bars nearby. Would highly recommend!

Beautiful , aesthetically pleasing well appointed apartment. Quality linen , utensils in kitchen and other amenities.Close to public transport and short drive to CBD.loved our stay . Would love to stay again . Anna’ s communication was excellent .

Wow! One of my favourite Airbnb’s I’ve stayed in - the place is beautifully set up and decorated. Anna has put a lot of thought into the apartment down to the smallest details & every time I needed something it was already set up in the apartment for me to use during my stay.
Would highly reccomend staying here! Thanks Anna 😊
We are very happy with our stay in the apartment with beautiful views of the Southbank skyline, river and bay.  The only downside is the noise from the busy train line.

The apartment was clean, comfortable, and everything was in great shape.  Beds were comfy. Showers were great. There was plenty in the kitchen for breakfast and snacks, but cooking a full meal might be a little challenging. The apartment is in a fantastic location.  But, one  of the reasons that the location is great is that two tram lines run right next to the building.  As the apartment is on the 13th floor, we didn’t find this to be a problem. If you are a light sleeper, it might be an issue.

Great little apartment and perfect for couples . The only thing I would suggest if you want to sleep in there is a fair bit of noise pollution as it’s directly over the railway line
Other then that highly recommended

Teah's apartment was very clean, well presented and comfortable with an amazing view of the city. Perfectly located in the CBD with river views, trams at the door and an easy stroll across the river to Crown and the Yarra Promenade. If you love trains, this place is perfect. On- site car parking is a big bonus too.
We had a great stay.
Thank you Teah & Matthew

Wonderful stay at Teah and Matt's place! Beautiful apartment with amazing views! Close to all the sights, restaurants and trams to explore the city. The trains can be noisy but we were tired so fell into background for sleeping.  Thanks again for a lovely stay!
Very convenient for us as we were exhibiting at the Good Food & Wine Show at the Convention Centre. Also plenty of places to eat close by and easy parking.

Great communication with the owners . Great location and the view at night was so lovely .
The owners even let us have a late checkout when we asked . Very kind . I would definitely stay again .
A lovely modern spacious flat close to all the action in melbourne. Above the railway line so at times a little noisy. But oversll a great place and i would use it again

This was a really nice place - clean and fresh with a great view. Excellent location, walking distance to Southbank and a tram stop right out the front. It was a great place and would highly recommend. Thank you for having us ☺️

This is a great little place to stay in Melbourne. It's in a lovely leafy street away from the noise of Acland Street, yet still so close to it all. The tram is a 5 minute walk and eateries within 10 minutes. The house was clean and inviting and provided us everything we needed for a brief stay in St Kilda.

Had a great time at Justin’s place. Lovely big home with great amenities! Very cosy rooms and big kitchen! Enjoyed my stay although if there was parking available on the lot that would’ve made it so perfect! But no complaints, had a great time there!
Perfect spot for a Melbourne weekend.  Super roomy for the three of us. Loved it!
Great neighbourhood. Close to some great cafes and parks. We had a great time and would stay there again

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Wonderful stay at Justin's place!
The three of us had a comfortable stay at Justin's place. The two double bedrooms were spacious and clean, and the kitchen and living space was very clean and comfortable. The place was kitted out with all the things you'd need for a comfortable stay using the kitchen as much as you'd like. Right by the beach, and close to multiple transport links into the city centre.
Helpful and very responsive hosts!
Would definitely stay again!

Daniel's apartment is amazing! Sparkling clean and so inviting, it really was an absolute pleasure to stay there. The views are incredible, both day and night and we found everything we need close by. Great food nearby

Very convenient location in the heart of CBD, walkable streets and with the train/coach station right in front which it was very convenient to commute from and to the airport. View is stunning and the apartment is fully equipped for short or even longer stays. Daniel communicates very promptly and the instructions to get to the apartment are extremely helpful and easy to follow! Definitely I recommend this place!

Daniel’s place is exactly what’s described in the listing. Can never get a better location than this place, everywhere’s so accessible! Though it can get a lil noisy with the train tracks nearby, it doesn’t bother me at all. In fact, it reminded me of why i fell in love with Melb with the hustle and bustlin’. Daniel’s also very hospitable. He gave me local food recommendations and made me felt right at home. I’ll definitely book with Daniel again!
Peter’s place was great! The hotel staff were super nice, parking to a massive plus, and its right in the thick of lygon street !

The location was fantastic, just a short walk to Melbourne Central, tram stop right out the front and IGA 2 minutes away. The accommodation itself definitely needed some love and a deep clean but for the price, it wasn’t the worst. Check in was super easy, our host was great to communicate with and left very clear instructions.

I loved staying here! I understand some of the other reviews that said it was a bit smaller than expected from the photos, but it was perfect for my needs. Amazing location, lovely view, unique space, very comfortable bed, super responsive and friendly host. I would definitely recommend it for a shorter stay, especially if you’re looking for somewhere peaceful to return to after a big day of exploring the CBD. Would happily stay here again

My partner and I are staying in Melbourne for 10 days, we had booked this location as it appeared to have sufficient space for the both of us. Immediately on arrival we noticed the loft was much smaller than advertised, with our two large suitcases it was difficult to manoeuvre through the bottom floor, with no space to open our suitcases. The bed area on the top floor had no room to get changed. Apart from the spacing there was a large build up of dust on the lighting and air conditioning and the aircon did not work. While this spacing may be appropriate for a solo traveller or a couple staying for a short amount of time, it would need a thorough clean to be suitable for anyone to stay.

We loved our stay at this property. It was located close to tram stops, train stations and restaurants. Also within walking distance of Bourke St Mall, museums and many tourist attractions. The unit was furnished well and included all the amenties you need for a home away from home. I would definitely stay here again.
James was a great proactive host, he was always helpful and answered any messages promptly.
James is an awesome host. Very responsive and even allowed us to check in a little bit earlier. I would stay here again next time im in Melbourne

This is a great room for the price. Great location. Very comfortable beds and everything you need for a comfortable city stay.
The pool was a lot better than I expected.
Would stay again
Enjoyed my stay, host very responsive. Aircon needs fixing (works just noisy) Otherwise, would stay again. Had everything I needed. Thank you for having me
Had a lovely stay, very clean and quiet, had everything we needed and also parking. Jia Xu is very helpful and very responsive should you need help with anything, I recommend his place to everyone

Overall, it’s quite okay for a 10-night stay, but not worth the price paid. The location is easily accessible and convenient, close to the tram. The accommodation is private, spacious, and nicely decorated, but there are several things do not meet the worth the cost.
This place was really relaxing and quiet. It was a great and memorable addition to my holiday. Would stay again.

Room was not as photographed but was very clean. The whole facility was very clean.
Couch was quite old and springs broken so not super comfy to sit on.
No dishwashing liquid or tea towel to clean used dishes.
Great location and fantastic to have parking included.
What a beautiful place to stay. The actual experience was even better than what the pictures in the ad suggested. The place exceeded our expectations in every way.
Great place exactly as described. Cleaner than most hotels I've stayed at. The location is perfect if you need to be close to the airport. Very pet friendly.

From the moment we booked this property, we knew we were in good hands. The hosts were amazing, with communication that remained excellent from initial booking all the way through to our arrival. They were responsive, helpful, and made the entire process seamless.
Upon arrival, we were immediately impressed by the cleanliness of the house. Everything was spotless and well-maintained. The furniture throughout the home was thoughtfully arranged and of high quality, creating both comfort and functionality in every room.
The sleeping arrangements deserve special mention - the beds were exceptionally comfortable, complemented by great pillows and cozy blankets that ensured restful nights after our days of exploration.
The kitchen was fully equipped with an abundance of pots, pans, plates, and cutlery, making meal preparation a breeze rather than a chore. This attention to detail truly allowed us to feel at home despite being on holiday.
I cannot recommend this property highly enough!

What a wonderful host Sachin is, his property was very comfortable and clean.
Felt very at home and would recommend to all.
This was our second stay here and most likely not our last. Perfect location with great amenities and well presented. Thanks Sachin!
Jo’s gorgeous apartment was such a lovely stay! From booking to checking out our overall experience was amazing. Jo went above and beyond to ensure our stay was clean and comfortable. Thanks so much!

We had a lovely weekend at Jo’s beautiful apartment.  It was perfectly set up and had everything we needed.  Having the on site parking was fabulous.  While close to everything the apartment is peaceful and relaxing.   Great amenities with access to the gym and pool.  Just perfect!

Without mentioning the great location of the apt and the thoughtful placement of all the amenities, being met and shown around the building made it easy to settle in and just enjoy our vacation!
I would recommend Jo and Matt's place to any prospective guest wanting to visit Melbourne cbd and the docklands area.

Absolutely beautiful unit with a lovely view. Just like the photos. Very clear checkin instructions & Matt was lovely enough to show us in & help us out with any questions we had.  He even had the heater on for us which being Qlders we were very grateful! The unit is absolutely spotless, with beautiful linens and furnishings. The trams are right out the front of the building, so it is very easy to get to wherever you need if you're not wanting to walk. The gym in the building is also very good with a variety of cable machines, squat rack & free weights. Would totally recommend Jo & Matt's place. 10/10

Thank you for hosting us! Angela was great and helpful! She is definitely one of the most friendly hosts I’ve met. She even picked us up at the station. We appreciate it a lot! Her house was so beautiful and clean. Perfect kitchen with everything u need! There’s also a lovely and friendly cat in the house. Thank you for everything once again🥹🥹 Hope to meet you again and take care!!!
Booked my stay before flying out to the airport in the morning. The room was great, the staff friendly and if the price is as great next time I fly I would happily stay there again.

Good, solid accommodation that is close to the airport.
A little dates but the linen was good quality & bed comfortable & the staff were great - super helpful & friendly.

Stayed for 2 weeks. Will return! Great place for longer term stay, felt like a homely share-house with roommates. All pleasant, mature-age working professionals during my stay. Room was spacious. Good wifi if you’re working from home. Good kitchen, which is the only common area (no dining or Lounge room). One bathroom shared. Adam was friendly and accommodating and always responsive. Quiet street off main roads. One off-street parking spot in driveway or ample street parking. Walking distance to tram stop and shops. Will be my go to stay in Melbourne.
Wonderful place to stay for a few weeks. Very good location for my needs, a few cafes and restaurants close by. Everything was always clean and available. Highly recommend!

It was reassuring to be welcomed so warmly as we had not used airbnb prior to this holiday.  We felt secure and at a time when it was very cold, the gas heater was turned on for us without having to ask.  Also everything was very clean - this being very important for us.
Really good place and convenient location. Sandy and Peter were very helpful. They even put up a fence now in the back deck for more privacy

We had the unique opportunity to live in the apartment for two months. The apartment is well furnished for such a long stay, including a kitchen with a gas stove and oven. The internet is super fast and available throughout the apartment. But the best thing is the view. The view alone makes the stay worthwhile. Whether it's the fireworks and concert in Flagstaff Garden for New Year or the hot air balloons that take off over the city early in the morning. And the magnificent sunsets. The location is ideal for Melbourne. Everything is within walking distance. We went to Victoria Market a lot to buy market-fresh food. If you don't feel like walking, you can take the tram. There are two tram stops right outside.
David answered our questions promptly and was very flexible when we checked in late.
Thanks again for the wonderful stay. Hopefully we'll be back in Melbourne another time. Best regards, Christof and Laleh

Me and my family stayed in the house for 13 days and think it was fantastic! We can easily access to all public transportation and the Queen Victoria Market. The view was fabulous too. You can see the beautiful subset when you're back home from your activities and see hot air balloons in the morning which was very relaxing. It was a comfortable stay and we will book again if we have the chance :)
The place was spotless when we arrived with gorgeous view of Melbourne city. I personally love the location since it was directly in front of a large park. Highly recommend. Friendly host as well.
Host is great guy. Very polite, always helpful & supportive. Easy to communicate & approachable. Overall, stay was really good.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this wonderful place and it exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with beautifully maintained space. The decor was stylish and cozy, making it feel like a home away from home. The location was perfect, offering easy access to all the sights while still providing a peaceful retreat. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and memorable stay. Five stars!
Fabulous place to stay. Excellent comfortable beds and bed linen. Safe area and surroundings. Easy walk to local train station and bus services near by.
Gorgeous apartment with spectacular views and amenities. Great location. Easy check in process with great communication and instructions.
Had a lovely stay with my family of 3 kids. They were very responsive and accommodative to our needs. We will stay again in future when we are here.

My boyfriend and I had a lovely stay here. It’s quiet and clean and a huge bonus is having the shops just across the street!
Amenities are great, check in and out was a breeze, would definitely stay here again. :-)

We thoroughly enjoyed staying here. It was warm and cosy in a very cold Melbourne winter. This home is so close to every amenity you could want and with a tram just around the corner, you could get to the city so easily. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again!
This is a really great Airbnb. It’s super well organised, supplied, spacious, clean, central to northside exploration, and the heating is excellent. Highly recommend
I stayed for three weeks, and everything I needed for that stay was in place and in any easy to find location.

This is a spacious house in a great location, being within walking distance to Coles and the newly established East Brunswick Village with bars, restaurants and cinema. The tram stop for the 96 tram is just around the corner, with fast and frequent trams to the city and on to St Kilda Beach. The 506 bus stop is almost outside, taking you to Moonee Ponds or Westgarth. Clean, quiet and centrally located apartment that had everything we needed. We would happily stay again.

Phillip was a great host. Responded quickly and helped with flexibile check in.
The apartment was clean and had a great scent. The apartment felt like home.

Highly recommend Charlie’s place for your visit to Melbourne.

Charlie is a great host - friendly, responsive, flexible check in and gave great recommendations in the area.
I’ve stayed in many BNBs and this one really ticks all the important boxes. Thanks Charlie!

Michele's compact studio with peaceful garden was a great base for a few days to decompress after an intense period of family responsibilities. I used the sauna and had some appointments with Michele.

The house was spotlessly clean, linen clean and fresh. Every detail was perfect, It felt like home, peaceful environment, plenty of space, looked exactly like the photos. we loved every bit of it. Well worth every cent and will definitely book again.

Very clean, comfortable, modern and stylish home.
Great hot water and heater for entire house as it was cold weather.

Beds and couches were clean and comfortable.
Lovely house and would love to stay again
Really nice place to stay, so handy with places to eat within walking distance too, nice view too.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Michelle and Jay’s Airbnb!
It reflected the photos perfectly and everything was clean and in great condition.

it was a very cozy & comfortable stay at Michelle & jay accommodation as it feel like home but very quiet neighbourhood ! transportation to footscary station was easy peasy!

Few wrinkles at checkin, but Young was an attentive host and all resolved. Good place, great location. Thank you.

A  spacious granny flat with a comfortable bed and pillows. Felt well rested and safe in Deanne’s place. Perfect for our overnight stay 🙏

Thank you for being helpful by setting up the sofa bed and Mike for the lovely chat ..

Deanne & Mike were very friendly & helpful.

My stay was amazing! Great amenities and the outside spa and pool was amazing! Timeless i would describe it 🫡 the owner was so accommodating and was super helpful during our stay. I would 100% stay again 🙏🏽 Thank you!

My partner and I had a wonderful stay at Gianna’s! It was a cutely furnished apartment with amenities that were of high quality and everything was well maintained! I had an amazing stay! It was really safe and loved having Tram so close to the apartment. It was easy to get around the city.

Kanu was lovely and her home and the room was very clean and comfortable. Would stay again if needing to be close to La Trobe University.

We had an amazing stay at Sam’s place! Everything was exactly as described, clean, and incredibly comfortable. Clean and with a great view of the City. Location is superb as it’s close to Crown.
The place is absolutely amazing! The location is very convenient, the place is super clean and the view is simply lovely. Would 100% return. Wilsa was also a great and very helpful host for our stay!

The airbnb is lovely, the location is quiet and safe. We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The space was beautiful, spotless and perfectly located – we discovered some fantastic cafes nearby as well.
Ming was a great host, always prompt and helpful in responding to our queries. The private carpark was a huge bonus since we drove in from Adelaide and the parking instructions were very clear and easy to follow.

We’d highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!

Our host was responsive and very easy to communicate with. The property was perfect for our needs with an awesome view.  Very central to the CBD we were only ever a short walk to all our activities with lots to do in between.  Most certainly would stay at this property again.

Such a beautiful spot overlooking Southern Cross Station and Marvel Stadium. The view at night was absolutely stunning! The place was nice and felt like home. The hosts were very responsive to my questions, and very helpful in returning an item I had left behind. I will definitely stay here again when I need to stay in the city!

Vshine was great to deal with all along the process which made it easier for us.

Good location for access to many areas including transport, shopping and the CBD of Melbourne.
Would look to stay there again if the opportunity arose.
My family enjoyed being there. We had a peaceful stay and felt safe and comfortable. Loved it. Would love to come again.
Great location and a very comfortable stay! Well catered for families or big groups with all possible amenities you may require. Instructions are super clear as well. Loved it :)

Jake's place was a home away from home.  It was sparkling clean, well furnished and had all the creature comforts. Jake was always quick to reply to messages, friendly and helpful. The appartment is a short stroll to North Melb Station, getting you to the city in 5 mins. The neighbourhood felt safe and quiet. My partner and I loved staying here :)

We had such a lovely stay at Jake’s place. Everything was perfect, super clean, responsive host. It is a gorgeous, comfortable and practical apartment. Jake went above and beyond to make our stay five star. Absolutely nothing to fault and looking forward to staying again. Thanks so much!
Lovely spot to get abit away from the city, apartment was very clean and nicely furnished.

Absolutely an amazing place, beautiful and comfortable felt at home. worth the money.

Beautiful home with all the comforts! I stayed here with my family for a week. The home is beautifully decorated, very comfortable with large bedrooms for the 6 of us staying there. I would recommend Matthew’s apartment to anyone. The apartment looked exactly like the photos; however, it was even more beautiful in person. Additionally, it was a 20-minute tram ride to the Central Business District, which made exploring Melbourne convenient.

A really great stay, so easy with the Tram stop right outside, awesome wine bar & restaurant right across the road. Very quiet and super light, warm and airy apartment with great energy & flow out to the view.

Our stay was fantastic. The apartment was very clean and super cozy. Check in and check out was easy and clear. Great location and great communication from Anna.

Very clean and cosy place. We felt safe and comfortable during the stay. Anna was a super friendly and kind host. Loved the location as well since it is very close to South Melbourne market. Would love to visit again!
Awesome place, cosy and perfect for the occasion. Certainly would stay at this pal e again.. a very responsive host which always makes it smooth check in and check outs.

The location was very nice and could get everywhere by tram. Would definitely stay again!

We really enjoyed our stay, very spacious house and the hosts were extremely responsive with any queries we had. Thanks again!

The place was nice with a great view. It was clean and as described with easy instructions to follow for check in/out.

We had a great stay for a long weekend at Esha's place! The location is great if you want to explore the city center and Esha was super friendly and always responsive.

Great location, and the unit was clean, and quiet, perfect for our stay. Building was also clean and tidy, included onsite secure parking, plenty of supplies, and it was on the free tram line for a quick ride into town. I’ll stay there again.

Perfect home, fully worth it and close to everything. Home was very clean and tidy, check in was very efficient and easy no hassle, and owners left us complimentary snacks. The apartment was very well maintained and furnished, and also equipped well, with all the necessities. Quite comfortable and a very good location, along with prioritising the security and safety of the residents.

my stay at Allen's home was wonderful, very warm and cosy both in Allan's kindness and the surounds of the space. The garden was so sweet, the bed was comfy and the space was spotlessly clean, much appreciated. loved it.

Quality - that is the word that first comes to mind to describe not only Allans place but also the thought he has put into hosting. Allans place is very clean, very brightly lit and the layout well planned. My visitors, two different sets and locals were impressed by the place too. Will not hesitate recommending a stay at Allans.
I couldn't have picked a better place to stay. My mom was in town, all the way from India and she absolutely loved our little home. Thanks Alan for the yummy chocolates, fruit and the gorgeous room!

We stayed a week, but wanted to stay longer. Allan is a pleasant host, and the unit is very comfortable and well appointed. It is also quite well located - close to major shopping centres and even a gym just a block away. Will definitely return on my next stay in Melbourne.

Allen's accommodation was very well set up for our week's stay in Melbourne.  The providing of fruit, chocolates, light breakfast and a frozen meal was most welcome. We would recommend Tranquillity as a base for your Melbourne visit.   If using public transport, purchase a zone 1 & 2 ticket to cover the bus trip to Oakleigh Station.
A complete and nice apartment with everythings you need. Better than staying in a five star hotel. Easy to nearby shopping mall, Monash Uni, etc. Thanks Allan
Allan was an amazing host , nothing was to much trouble for him,  and they were very hospitable. All our needs were meet 100%. Cant wait to stay again was over all fantastic .

Allans studio isbeautifullly set up and he is a delightful host, adding a welcome package that made us feel very welcome and well taken care of. I would definately recommend hte studio and Allan to anyone looking for a long or shorter stay around Melbourne.

My boyfriend and I had a great stay in Allan's studio. It was very clean, stylish and well set up. Allan himself is a lovely host, although we didn't get to see much of him as he was very busy! We were very warmly welcomed and shown all the facilities (which were wonderful). Garden area was particularly beautiful. Very convenient to shops. Nice peaceful location. Couldn't have asked for more.

My stay at Allan & Lizy's place was great. I had been travelling for three week prior and had the best two night sleep in their cozy backyard cottage. It was private, quite and well equipped. I will stay there again.

Mark

Allan's "Superhost" rating is well-deserved; the place is immaculate, extremely well-equipped and the welcome was warm and friendly.  Allan and Lizzy are considerate hosts without being intrusive. I had a fantastic stay and wouldn't hesitate to stay again or to recommend to friends.
The hosts are very friendly. The house is lovely, especially the garden! We'd love to stay here again and recommend this to our friends.
The place is perfect.clean and very well maintained. The hosts were so hospitable and comforting , we loved it. The garden and all the amenities provided made our stay even better. Thanks a lot Allan

A mini home away from home. Everything was as described and more. From the bowl of fruit upon arrival ( a delightful and appreciated gesture) to the bookcase full of readable novels, I didn't want for anything.

A great place to stay, everything as described in the listing and the covered outdoor area and garden are a huge plus. Allan and Lizzie were great hosts. We hope to stay here again next time we're in Melbourne.

We thoroughly recommend their place.

We had the best time at Allan's and Lizzie's place. The studio apartment was nice and clean and the hospitality was top notch. The area is a bit far from Melbourne city but it was difficult to take public transport. It was a quiet neighborhood located close to Monash University.
We would definitely recommend staying at Allan and Lizzie's place.
Mathias and Sebastian
I have nothing but good words for the property and its host. Allan is very friendly and open to accommodating requests.

It was a very good place to stay. Allan and his wife were very nice to me and helpful. I felt like at home immediately. I really recommend

Thank you Allan and Lizzie for accommodating us in your beautiful place. The couple was very accommodating, with extra amenities offered. If given the chance to return, we will definitely choose your place again.

Allan and Lissie were lovely hosts and the studio apartment had everything one needs for a short or longer stay (in my case 1 month).
If you are looking for a great place to stay in the quieter outer suburbs of Melbourne or look for a place close to Monash University, I can most certainly recommend staying with Allan and Lissie.

The studio apartments was perfectly located for my business trip only minutes from Dandenong Road. It’s clean and private, very comfy bed and hot shower. There’s all the basics you’d need, good WiFi and sone breakfast items too. I appreciated the fresh fruit left for me. All in all it’s exactly like the pics. You need a car and need to travel by car to find the restaurants and cafes.

Located at the back of the property this comfortably and well converted studio is perfect for a single traveller or couple.  The studio is quiet, very clean, has all the amenities you would require, with the addition of thoughtful touches such as fruit, chocolate, coffee and some basic supplies. The bed is very comfortable and additional pillows are available to choose from.  The hosts are very hospitable and helpful, and have taken care to make their guests experience a positive one.

Rented for 13 nights for relatives, the unit is good, BUT
A landlord is required to give a tenant 'quiet enjoyment' not hammer outside the window on a Sunday morning. This studio is a truly lovely place to stay! Allan and Lizzie are very warm hosts, were flexible around my check in time and very helpful. The studio feels very much as a 'home', has everything you need and is very comfortable.
This could also be suitable for someone who is looking for longer term stay (like an academic term or a couple of months)

Allan and his wife made us feel very welcomed, the place was very clean and well looked after. It was cosy and felt like home, I will definitely stay there again and recommend them to friends and family.

Highly recommended. Our third stay. Quiet, efficient, private, safe. Immaculately clean. Most comfortable new bed and bedding. We again stayed for over 3 weeks. The description of the accommodations is bang on accurate. A gem. We stay at many other B&B and keep coming back here when we are in Melbourne.
Incredible hosts, incredible apartment. We spend a perfect week in Melbourne thanks to Allan and Lizzie, I recomend !

Allan’s place was wonderful. I have booked his place when my in laws came for a visit to Melbourne. The hosts were very nice and made us feel at home.  The place is clean and very comfortable. The location is great being close to shops and all. Overall, this place is a gem. Try to book it if you can as it seems to fill up quickly.
The best features are the lovely gardens and the sparkling cleanliness. The location is very close to shops, cafes and buses but is very quiet. We wanted to stay next week but they were fully booked.

Arriving at a new country can be extremely daunting, but Allan and Lizzie were both exceptional hosts that naturally lead into a friendship. The place is cozy, clean and interesting. It doesn't feel like just any stay, but one that will be memorable. Due to both the comfortable place and warm hospitality. The hosts went above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need, we highly recommend staying with Allan and Lizzie :)

This place is exactly as shown in the pics. I enjoyed my stay here. Allan responds quickly and is very helpful. IGA at the corner to buy Groceries. Very close bus stop to go to Monash university research way. I wanted to extend my stay but it was already booked. I highly recommend this place.

For one time i stayed in Allan s house and everything was perfect! It feels like home away from home!That s why in a few days i ll be back!The house is exactly as is being shown and the owners are the most sweet people!

A great stay At Allans. Friendly and informative host. Easy to chat to and made us feel extremely welcome. Allan was extremely flexible as our arrival was hampered by delayed flights and a later check in was no trouble.
Thanks Allan - A great place and a great stay. Thank you so much.
Darren
It was a perfect stay. If I need to stay in Melbourne, I will definitely come back.

WOW ! This place is in the heart of the action , Restaurants , Bars, walking to all places in the city and the best way to see and feel Melbourne. Don't get stuck in a bland hotel , stay in the heart and soul ,stay in this Loft apartment !!

Could you get a better location in Melbourne? i think not.
such a warm, charismatic, large and complete warehouse apartment you really can not go wrong.

Michelle's place is very well located in the heart of Melbourne. We loved Melbourne !
Cafe , food , bar , art and fashioned orientated city !
I felt a bit like in Berlin I must say parks so lush , people so charming and friendly as well helpful ! The place we stayed was a nice open wood characteristic loft/ warehouse which seemed to be a great place to have friends over for dinner or pre drinks before a night out in fitzroy ! Michell was a very helpfull person in each way which we loved . She defiantly is a person to ask what's going on in town in my opinion the way i just read about her . Anyway just check the place out if you are up for culture and food in Melbourne !

Perfect location. Great to have such a large space. The apartment is not quite as nice as it seems from the photos - just a little bit tired. But on the whole a good experience - the location made up for any shortcomings!! Host was very responsive and helpful.

Absolutely loved our stay in Michelle's apartment, so much so we didn't want to leave! All the essential amenities and more. Awesome location just near Hardware Lane, so loads of eateries and bars close by. Would recommend it to anyone :)

A fantastic apartment, in a fantastic location, cared for by a fantastic host. This was our first airbnb experience, which I suspect will be hard to beat. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay, and appreciated the small touches by Michelle such as the public transport cards.

Michelle kindly answered my last minute request for a long-term stay in minutes. She took the time to great me and gave me plenty of recommendations on places to eat, drink and ways to enjoy Melbourne as she is the 'ultimate Melbourne guide' to discover this amazing city.

This is the perfect city loft experience with access from a typical Melbourne lane. Very well situated, with a unique caracter and soul, spacious and peaceful. You wish this was your home!

Many thanks Michelle.

Amazing! This place is unique, and so Melbourne! It really added a special element to our stay in the city. It is in a ridiculously convenient location and the space is great. Michelle was a superb host and 10/10 would recommend.

Michelle 's apartment is great. Location is fabulous- right in the middle of the CBD and close to more bars and restaurants than you could ever need, including the best coffee at Brother Baba's! We used the trams to get around which were v easy.

Easy to find and on the second floor with the tattoo parlour below you (they were lovely neighbours!)
Michelle was super helpful and answered all our questions while we were there.
Thank you!

Lovely place, very Melbourne. Great location,  definitely one of a kind! Amazing to find this secret of Melbourne - would absolutely recommend. Michelle also allowed us an early check in which was very much appreciated.

Michelle's place is pretty much my favourite place I have ever stayed in Melbourne. Incredible value for money. Its a big beautiful open loft apartment in a location that can't be beat! Absolutely recommended!

you can't find a better address than this, with machester press downstairs and tipo next door, please let me know if you ever wanna sell !\(^o^)/Michelle is really friendly and helpful, we had a wonderful time.

Michelle's apartment is in a great, and funky, location. We had an amazing weekend and she has great recommendations of some rad eats around Melbourne!
Great living space central to anywhere you need to be in Melbourne city! Michelle was friendly, accommodating and swift with her responses to emails! Highly recommend!
Michelle's place is everything I expected and more. I loved the space and experience. Many thanks Michelle.
The loft is extremely spacious and wonderfully designed. The shower/bath is beautiful. Its close to everything you could need. Had a lovely time in a lovely home. ♡

Great place in a great location...
Michelle is extremely knowledgeable of the area and helpful with whatever you may need.

By far and away the most superb air bnb experience I've had. Better than the photos - an incredible, serene, expansive and stunning space. I will be back.

Michelle's place is the PERFECT home for a truly 'Melbourne' experience. The apartment is ridiculously spacious, and is the definiton of thr word 'charming'. I couldn't recommend this place enough, and definitely plan on coming back if the opportunity arises.
Quirky and stylish place in the heart of the city. Really enjoyed our stay here. It was a lot bigger than expected. As long as you don’t have a problem with stairs you’ll love it just like we did.

Michelle was so lovely to deal with and her apartment was absolutely breathtaking. Great views, eclectic, and an all round amazing place.
Would highly recommend to others and would spend another weekend here in the future.

Outstanding location! Wonderfully cool warehouse apartment in the heart of the city. Excellent views! My husband and I had a fabulous stay and Michelle was extremely accomodating. We loved it and would highly recommend.

If Little Bourke Street/Hardware Lane is your part of town, then you can't do better than this.  Groovy, slightly rustic loft style, perfect for single or couple visitor.  It's surprisingly quiet for the location.  The host is very helpful and genuinely accommodating.  Would happily return.

Truly a remarkable find! An Authentic spacious and comfortable loft. Hip and central location. Easy to get everywhere. Michelle was responsive and helpful. We’ve stayed at Airbnbs around the world and this is  among the best.

Michelle‘s warehouse is the ultimate Melbourne city break. Incredible, unique space in a great location - loved living out some delusions of grandeur swanning about that place for a weekend. Michelle is also a great host - great communication and kind enough to accommodate an early check-in. Highly recommended.

Wow what an amazing space and unique apartment right in the heart of the best the city has to offer. So central to top restaurants, great coffee, tucked away bars, and an easy walk to the Yarra too. Michelle was so helpful and accommodating. This warehouse space will take your breath away.
Thanks for a fabulous weekend.
We had to postpone a few times due to COVID and Michelle was always understanding and flexible with changing our dates. She was a great host and quick to respond to messages.

A rare treasure to stay at within Melbourne’s CBD. Having lived myself in Melbourne for many years, I can tell you that this is a unique gem of which you couldn’t find anything remotely similar. The photos really understate how cool this place is. That’s the thing about cool I guess. Once you overstate it, you’ve lost it.

It’s a little distressed in places but make no mistake: you will feel like a goddamned movie star in this joint.

The loft apartment is wonderfully located and a beautiful charming space right in the heart of Melbourne. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and Michelle went above and beyond to assist us. Michelle went above and beyond allowing us to check in earlier and leave later to maximise our weekend. She was extremely accomodating and responsive. The place is absolutely beautiful and in a perfect location close to everything. We can’t wait to stay here again!

Great communication, and amazing place. Such a cool building, and an unbelievable location.
Michelle was accomodating of everything we needed, and I can’t speak highly enough of her.
I couldn't recommend this one of a kind airbnb more! Great location, very comfortable and a beautiful space all over.

What a beautiful place - I couldn't believe how nice it was, even better in real life than the photos. Michelle was a perfect host as well, very helpful and extremely easy to communicate with! Would 10/10 recommend and would love to stay again!

Very accommodating for our need of early check-in, and offered a late check out. Huge and gorgeous space and in an amazing location, absolutely centre of everything! Although the spa feature not working was quite a disappointment, and many of the light switches did not work.

This stay was one of the most unique I’ve ever had. Located in a prime location down a stunning alleyway with the most beautiful cosy interior made our trip to Melbourne so amazing. Will definitely return to this cosy, unique home! Could not recommend this space more

My wife and I had an excellent experience. The accommodation was warm and modern, mixed with rustic decor. Michelle generously allowed us to leave our bags for an extended period of time when our flight got delayed. Great place, location and service!

Michelle was a great host, extremely responsive and friendly. The loft was a unique, quirky space that we totally enjoyed. It was heaps of fun living the life of an inner city urbanite, even if it was just for a couple of days! Location is perfect. Highly recommend.

I had an incredible stay at this Airbnb loft with my brother. The loft itself was truly amazing, and I can't wait to come back. Being surrounded by such a creative atmosphere really helped my creative flow, and having access to the rooftop was like a source of spiritual enlightenment. Looking forward to seeing them again soon!

This has to be one of the coolest stays in Melbourne! Michelle was extremely attentive at replying to any messages we sent during our stay. Everything was as described. Lots of stairs though so may not be suitable to all travellers. Will definitely be staying again!

The apartment is a comfortable and unique space to live in for any period of time, with all the essentials and luxuries one could desire. The host is proactive and responds to questions in a timely manner. The property is just a few paces from the action, but retains a private and peaceful environment for sleeping and living. The property, with the former warehouse quirks and styling, enhances your Melbourne stay. Would re-book, and recommend to anyone wanting to experience the Melbourne CBD in a way very few tourists/locals can.

What a special place in the heart of the CBD. Was very cosy, with the Melbourne winter the heating was perfect. Such a comfortable vibe in the loft. The bed was super comfy. Was great getting back from the hustle and bustle of the City to this comfortable home. A great venue to celebrate my husband’s birthday. Highly recommend!! Thanks for sharing this beautiful space with us.

I was in need of a short getaway from frantic, noisy Melbourne, and my stay at the cabin did just that. Comfortable, quiet, green and lush, and I was greeted by a big mob of roos as soon as I arrived and drove up the driveway.
Lovely hosts, great location, and if I'm in need of another break from the city, I won't hesitate to stay again. Thanks!
Karen and Michael are lovely! The cabin was clean, comfortable and charming. Breakfast was delicious too!

We were looking for a one night escape from the city, and Karen's cabin was perfect. Its in a great setting, very quiet and fully self contained with everything we needed. Karen kindly provided breakfast and late checkout to make our stay as relaxed as possible. The nearby area is amazing - we went our for dinner at DeBortoli's nearby, and the next day worked it off by going for a bike ride around the Toolangi forest which was stunning.
What a great short break!

Karen and Michael's cabin was my first airBnB stay, and it was a very encouraging start.  The cabin is perfectly modest, solid, and comfortable; containing everything we needed and a little bit more.  Karen provided helpful suggestions in the days before our trip and put us immediately at ease upon arrival. The continental breakfast was a melancholy reminder of how good all those other continental breakfasts you've eaten could have been.  We would go back for sure.

A great cosy place to unwind sitting on the verandah with lovely views reading a book. All amenities provided and close to all the local cafes, shops and tourist spots. We really enjoyed the local market on Sunday morning.
A big thanks to Karen and Michael from maureen and Brian.

We had a lovely time staying in Karen's guest cabin. The supplies provided for breakfast were excellent including fresh strawberries from the garden. We loved sitting on the deck, watching the kangaroos and kookaburras and listening to the birds. Karen was very welcoming and helpful - giving us lots of tips about the best places to eat in the area. We would love to stay again. Thanks Karen!

Karen's cabin in the hills near Healesville is just wonderful.  My partner and I had the perfect getaway for two nights, cycling all day and feasting at the local restaurants in the evening.  The cabin was cosy and comfortable, with everything we needed and plenty of lovely extras, like the home grown fruit and handmade soaps.  I will highly recommend this cabin for my cycling friends, singles or couples, and anyone who is looking for a quiet few days in the bush, without driving half a day to get there.
The Cabin, the host-Karen and the location and closeness to Healsville was great. A pleasure to organise and to come and go freely, will stay again, thanks Karen :)
Karen and Micheal were both very nice and friendly. The cabin was super. It was private, peaceful and relaxing. The wildlife was everywhere with kangaroos, kookaburras, parrots, echidnas, rabbits....

Karen and Michael have a delightful little independent cottage located on their Chum Creek  property. It is well appointed at a reasonable price. We were greated by Karen on our arrival and given a hardy farewell on our departure by Michael and the local kangaroos! Effortless experience. Excellent communication. Highly recommended.

Another fantastic and relaxing stay at Karen's cottage. We always enjoy the peace and quiet. The bed is really confortable, breakfast is delicious with fresh oranges from the garden.
We will definitely be back.

Everything was accurate, Karen had great communication, and everything was easy from start to finish. Cosy little cabin set in a relaxed environment, made to feel like your home away from home. Excellent value.
We did not feel welcomed but we did feel as if we were an inconvenience.   The cabin was good and the location great and convenient.

Karen and Michael are super hosts with lots of local knowledge and can help with anything you need. Their property is gorgeous and we absolutely loved the kangaroos greeting us as we arrived home each day. Forget the sanctuary, stay here. Karen stocked the cabin with everything you could need plus stuff you didn't even know you needed!  The breakfast selections in the cabin were a pleasant surprise. Location is perfect,  close to town, hiking and wineries, yet peaceful with a beautful, relaxing atmosphere.  Karen was great with communication.

It was rather late that day around 8:30pm when we checked in but Karen still welcomed us happily and brought us around her house to see if we can see some wildlife around. She even provide story books for my son which was a very nice gesture. The house was warm and clean, the view out of the house was spectacular especially when we saw the kangaroos hopping across the field in front. Nice place, fantastic host, recommended to go for nature lovers.
The property is lovely and quiet, perfect if you like a bit of backyard wildlife. A small cottage as promised but enough space for two and great location. Looking forward to returning!

Cute, cozy cabin with all the basic necessities! A fantastic combination of seclusion and easy access to town, restaurants, and attractions in the Yarra Valley. We loved staying here and seeing the kangaroos in the yard each day! The heater and heated blanket were much appreciated for the cold winter evenings and we were never chilly inside! Although we never met Karen in person, we meet her husband Michael and she had excellent communication through the app. Would highly recommend booking this cabin for your next stay in Yarra Valley!
It was great staying at Karen's very lovely and quiet. We loved the open spaces and visits from the roos. Also the homegrown fruit was lovely as well. Such a special experience.

A lovely little cottage that is also a bedsit. The kangaroos grazed on the lawn outside our window which was special. Take your own radios, ipod etc if can stay in at night and want some form of entertainment
We loved this cosy cabin with it's peaceful and beautiful surroundings and abundance of kangaroos outside our porch! Karen was a gracious and efficient host. Highly recommended!
Really enjoy our stay .,. Cabin is as described and in a beautiful setting.  Healesville and this area has great wineries and scenery !!  Check in was easy and communication was great.   Thanks Karen
Wonderful clean studio, in a beautiful location. Weather was warm during our stay but the fan did well to cool it at night for sleeping.

Thanks very much Karen and Michael for a lovely stay at Chum Creek cabin. We enjoyed the cosy cottage and surroundings, and it gave us a wonderful getaway with a couple of kangaroos out the front too!  We greatly appreciated the thoughtful touch of breakfast goodies and having the heater on when we arrived as it was a chilly weekend!

Karen's cabin has a beautiful view - it was a great spot to hole up in when the weather got bad and a great base to explore from when it was sunny. The mini hamper provided some good basics for our weekend and we had a lovely time. Thanks Karen!

We had an excellent stay at Karen’s place. The space was cosy and comfortable, and we had everything we needed. The location was excellent - very close the town centre and a great base to explore the Yarra Valley. Karen was quick to communicate and provided us with local tips. A highlight was sitting on the porch watching the kangaroos at dawn and dusk! We will be back!!!

Nice and cosy place with all the basics you need for a weekend away! Karen was a kind welcoming host. The place is a bit far from central Healesville to walk but perfect distance if you have a car! Would recommend!
This farm stay is perfect for a couple’s getaway! Our stay was made extra special by Karen and Michael’s hospitality and kindness. Would highly recommend:)

Wonderfully quiet cosy retreat yet conveniently located close to shops and wineries only a short drive away. Karen and Michael (not to forget Pete the dog ;-) were great hosts: very friendly, accomodating and excellent communicators. Had a lovely time.

Karen was a great host and the place is a wonderful little getaway. Has everything that you need without the bells and whistles. Karen is super friendly, offered us fresh fruit from her orchard, and we had plenty of space and privacy. Would definitely stay again!

Karen was lovely, greeting us for check-in. The cabin itself was compact but contained everything we needed for a quick weekend away. It was comfortable, clean, and warmed up nicely.
Being able to look out onto the grass in the evenings or mornings to watch the kangaroos grazing was a special treat for us suburban folk ;) We would gladly stay again if we visit the area in the future.

It was wonderful staying here. It was our own little piece of Australia that we fell in love with. We hoped we might see some wild life and it didn’t disappoint. So many birds I can name them all but we loved the 2 Kookaburra’s that flew down to the deck in the evenings. There were rabbits and we saw Kangaroos up close and personal every evening and most mornings.
The cabin was wonderful, cosy and very clean. Just the right size. No wifi meant we took more of a break than usual but never bored. We watched DVDs ( a large selection). Both Michael and Karen were lovely and helpful.
Overall a wonderful weekend away from it all
I’m a return visitor and very happy with the location, facilities and cleanliness. Karen is a great host. I look forward to staying again next year.
We spent 3 nights in this lovely comfortable and perfectly located house. It was everything we expected and more. Will definitely recommend it to anyone we know who is visiting Melbourne.

Katrina was friendly, efficient and helpful with communication and meeting our needs. The home was clean, convenient and comfortable. Everything we needed. Close to the city, Spring Street and the artist driven Rose Markets off Napier street onSaturdays. Love it all. Another great experience with AirB&B for me.

We had a lovely stay at Fitzgeorge.  Check in was smooth and very easy and Katrina touched based with us to make sure we checked in and that everything was ok on arrival.  Fitzroy is a great area to stay as it is less than a 25min walk into the CBD (and Rod Laver arena!) and lots of great restaurants and shops to keep you busy just within walking distance of the Fitzgeorge laneway.  Thanks for a great stay.

Appartment comfortable and clean.
Disappointed that single bed in same bedroom as double,hadn't realized that this was how house set up.

Karen’s place is in a great location close to Healesville but also to the majority of the Yarra Valley. It was great for a quiet & peaceful weekend away with all the essentials.

I would happily stay there again during our next visit.

The hosts were responsive, friendly, and respectful of guests privacy when entering and exiting the property.
The guest house was cozy, and well set up, with tea & coffee, spare blankets, towels, an electric blanket on the bed, and a tv with dvds available. There was enough provided for a short stay.
The location was lovely and peaceful, with plenty of wildlife and birdsong, while also central to what we needed during our stay.
Beautifully calm place to relax and be super close to all that the Yarra Valley and Healesville have to offer.

This accommodation was even better than we expected - more spacious - and we would definitely recommend it to others. Karen was very friendly and welcoming and provided us with some great local tips. We enjoyed listening to the local birds whilst eating on the deck. It's in a very good location, just over 5 minutes from Healesville.
As Karen states in her description, this is not a fancy place. But on a super hot weekend it was clean and relatively comfortable (maybe some new pillows)
We loved our stay and hope to come back. Karen's place suited us perfectly, and we loved the area.

This charming cottage just outside of Healesville was truly magical. Cozy and quiet. Sit in the front porch having coffee in the morning watching kangaroos hop around and enjoying a beer in the evening on the porch staring at the stars listening to wombats mozy around. Truly amazing spot.
Lovely little spot for a weekend getaway, Karen was super helpful and got to see some local wildlife!
Katrina’s house is stylish and warm. It is very clean and is comfortable staying in her place.
Katrina’s place was perfect in every way. The accommodation met all my expectations plus it was close to a wonderful breakfast and lunch spot.  I could not have asked for more!

Fitzgeorge is a wonderful property, cleverly designed, creatively furnished and delightful to stay in.
