Situated in the heart of South Melbourne, it's just a short walk to some of the city's best cafes, restaurants and the south Melbourne markets. The neighborhood is safe, friendly and has a great vibe, making it the perfect base for exploring Melbourne.
The apartment itself is equipped with everything you need for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
We will absolutely be back again!

Our stay at My City Hideaway was wonderful. The perfect escape right in the heart of South Melbourne. It was a beautiful place to stay the night for the weekend of our wedding. Fiona has created a home where you immediately feel relaxed and ready to unwind. Her thoughtful and curated interiors are a dream to stay in.

Fiona's terrace home made our stay in Melbourne and provided a great alternative to a luxury hotel experience. We loved the decor and design throughout the home and would recommend this property to anyone wishing to have more of an authentic stay from a local's perspective. This hideaway on the South bank truly delivered a sense of place and a quintessential taste of Aussie hospitality.
Fiona's place was absolutely stunning and cosy. She was so easy to communicate with and her house was exactly as described. It was a home away from home!

Fiona was great to deal, very responsive and made everything easy and straight forward.
Thank you.

Fiona’s property makes a fantastic place for a relaxing getaway! The property was modern, beautifully designed, and felt like home. It was  very cosy and spacious and had everything that we needed. We would highly recommend this place for anyone who is looking to stay in South Melbourne!

I stay here regularly when in Melbourne on business and just love it. Ticks all my boxes and a great place to plug in my laptop and do a little work whilst knowing I can just unplug and enjoy all that the area offers.
Will be back!

My city hideaway is one of the best airbnb I have ever stayed in - I actually never wanted to leave! Beautifully curated, amazing location, comfy beds. Fiona is an excellent host! Would highly recommend.

Thanks for another great stay.
My go to place to stay when in Melbourne for work-
Beautifully decorated and really comfortable bed.
All my favourite restaurants close by.
See you again soon.

Easily the most beautifully curated and luxurious home I have stayed in. The home is absolutely stunning and the art is fabulous. Beautiful bed linen and towels and Aesop bathroom products.
The kitchen had everything you needed and again, beautiful crockery and cutlery and glass wear. This stay was really good value for money and I will definitely be staying every time I visit Melbourne.
Thanks for a fabulous trip!

Beautiful home.  Walkable to many coffee shops and restaurants.  Love the South Melbourne Market a block away.  Fiona was a wonderful host.  The home was very comfortable.  We were there when 2 days got over 100F but the AC upstairs kept the entire house cool.  The Japanese stairs took a little getting use to but definitely not for young children.
We really enjoyed staying at Fiona‘s place. Close to the Buzzy shops and market but quiet at night. Nicely decorated with a brilliant art collection.

We loved staying at My City Hideaway. It is a lovely home, very tasteful and comfortable. It is very well equipped and a wonderful place to relax in after a tiring day. Fiona is an excellent host - and little extras like an excellent coffee machine with a generous supply of beans make a real difference.
My City Hideaway is superbly located: round the corner from South Melbourne Market (highly recommended) and a short tram ride from the City centre. St Kilda beach is also nearby.
We can wholeheartedly recommend My City Hideaway.
The apartment was very well located, clean and very comfortable. Everything was beautifully laid out and Belinda is an excellent host. I would highly recommend.

This was my first airbnb stay when I touched down in melbourne and I came back to stay again after returning from great ocean road. This will also be my ideal home interior design as it is super comfortable. The host is friendly as well and accommodative.

This was our second stay at Belinda’s great place and we’ve just booked the third. Belinda is very helpful and the apartment is very clean and very quiet. It’s peaceful yet an easy walk to loads of restaurants, shops and local transport. Highly recommended.

Leon was an exceptional host! This place was an absolute gem! if your looking for peace, and quiet with a great view whilst having breakfast, having cooked it with either the BBQ or in the Kitchen! There is so many wineries, restaurants, shopping centres and other variety of stores! If your seeking tranquillity then this is the ideal location for a weekend away💯💯💯

Beautiful couple of nights, the view from the deck was amazing. Bed was really comfortable and dealing with chronic pain this can make or break a getaway for me! Close to shops too if anything is needed.

Brand new feel at Shiya's place, and it was exactly as we saw on the Airbnb. Spacious, well-appointed and quiet. Comfy beds, super-efficient fridge, massive dining room table and lovely outdoor setting. Shiya was super quick with communication and we experienced no problems at all. Highly recommnded.

The best thing about the accommodation that it was comfortable, the beds, lounge, dining chairs and the check process, everything was so easy it made the trip a much more pleasant experience, each we were very happy once we got back to the house and were eager to get back to the house, it was that nice of a place to be

We recently stayed at Shiya's place and it was a delightful experience! The house is wonderfully airy, creating a sense of space and comfort. The layout is thoughtfully designed, making our stay both cozy and efficient. Additionally, the neighborhood is peaceful and quiet, which was perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. Highly recommend this lovely home for anyone looking for a serene and comfortable getaway.
Excellent stay that I would recommend to anyone travelling to Melbourne. Extremely clean, modern and comfortable. Thank you so much Shiya!

Newly renovated, highly spacious, and very clean! The house is also located within 10 minutes of a metro stop and a small grocery store. Shiya is a kind and responsive host. Thanks for having us, Shiya.
Shiya's place was very spacious and clean. close to restaurants and public transport. Shiya was very helpful and friendly. Highly recommend this place.
Nice apartment in the city centre, extremely clean and professional, all amenities that you could need for a short stay

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Liz's beautiful studio located near the lively neighbourhood of Fitzroy. The warehouse's unique and architecturally stimulating design made for an unforgettable experience. Not only was the location very convenient, but the interior was the real star of the show - thoughtfully designed and furnished. I highly recommend this listing for anyone looking for a memorable and enjoyable stay in Melbourne.
if you are looking for a nice accommodation in Melbourne, you found it! beautiful house, verry nice hoste, I recommend!

Wow, what an amazing Airbnb! the apartment was beautiful and full of everything you could possibly need for your stay. Liz was so helpful in answering our questions and the area was nice and quiet. It was a short walk to the lovely neighbourhood of Collingwood with lots of pubs and restaurants on your doorstep. One of the best Airbnbs we have ever stayed in!

Divine stay in this stunning warehouse. Clean and minimal made for a calm space to unwind. Wonderful location and close to what we needed for our weekend away.
Liz was accomodating with our check in and check out requests. Highly recommend.
Liz was an absolute dream host and so accomdating, the place was beautiful. had a lovely stay
Had a great stay. Liz was very helpful with arranging access & the place was well priced and plenty of space. Would highly recommend
Sweeping, beautiful views. Gorgeous house perfect for our family. Stunning sunrises. We loved hand feeding parrots. Deep was an amazing host and we will be back.

Deepika is an excellent host and we 💯 would love to come back here. The views are phenomenal, the lounge very cosy, and there were some wonderful little extra touches in the pantry and fridge.
We had access to everything we needed, and loved being able to unwind and warm up with the hot tub.
Looking forward to coming back here one day.

Wonderful views and a very relaxing stay.
It was raining heavily during our stay but with multiple living areas and games there was plenty to occupy our children.
Everyone enjoyed the spa, even in the rain.
A well thought out guide book of local attractions and property information answered most of our questions and our host was very responsive to questions.
Wonderful apartment, location and facilities. The area is great, with a really good cafe down stairs. It’s a rarity to have character and interest in apartments. This one is a gem.

Nice place in a fab location! Cute decor and spacious.
Eduardo was an absolute pleasure to deal with - quick to respond, helpful and he kindly arranged an early check-in for us.
One suggestion - would bs good if pool towels were supplied. They are not something you generally pack for a city break! :)
This unit is in a wonderful location for walking to public transport, nearby attractions and places to eat.  We loved the styling decor and architecture of the unit.
Great location with a car park. Little coffee shop below which was handy. Walking distance to everything and super fast communication with host.

We thoroughly enjoyed are long weekend in Melbourne.  Eduardo’s  apartment is conveniently located close to Ybarro river in Southbank.   Even on game night the noise was minimal for city living.   Eduardo was very responsive to our questions.    I would recommend his apartment for city living.

We had a great two night stay.  The apartment is exactly like it looks in the photos and description and is close to all that you would want.  We travel by public transport when we come to Melbourne and don’t bring our car and we found this apartment to be in a great location walkable to the city close by and to great restaurants and attractions.  Thankyou Eduardo

This was a great little hideaway right on southbank within easy reach of the Crown and all the cafes and restaurants. The building is a sandstone treasure with plenty of character and the host decked his apartment out in a retro themed style which suited the residence very well. Will be back.

Eduardo's place is in a fantastic location on the Southbank and made getting around central Melbourne easy. The cafe at the bottom of the building makes great coffee and food. The host communicated proactively, with detailed instructions and ensured this was maintained before and during my stay. Needing to go to a local convenience store to obtain the keys before being able to park my car at the Airbnb was not the best  experience given the lack of parking around the Airbnb and around the convenience store. I was also at the apartment on a hot weekend and there is no air con. Both of these things were communicated before my stay. Overall the location is the best thing about the apartment.

The apartment was well located and clean but definitely on the dark side with no balcony or outside area. The bedroom has a ceiling fan but doesn’t have A/c and when we opened the window you could often smell the smoking of people on adjacent balconies. Not the owner’s fault, but definitely something to consider if the weather is warm. For a winter stay it would be ideal.

Great location! Walking distance to many key points, plenty of places to eat (super breakfast place downstairs), transportation nearby. Place has charm and attitude. Only caveat is that the windows don’t block the outside noise that much so if you are a light sleeper it might not be that good. Otherwise, great find!

Firstly Eduardo is an incredible host!
So kind, responsive, helpful and accommodating!
The accommodation was as gorgeous as the photos! We absolutely loved the eclectic vibe!
It had everything we needed - we didn’t cook in the apartment but easily could have!
The location was incredible. Short walk to flinders street station, cafes and restaurants at our doorstep!
Highly recommend:)
Trapero was an excellent host. The hospitality was friendly, attentive and welcoming. The place has a great view and was easy to find. Close to Southbank promenade and train stations.

Such a cozy apartment, loved all the plants and decor. The view was incredible, watching the sunrise on the balcony was one of our favourite parts of our holiday. Trapero was so helpful with everything and responded quickly with any queries/questions. 5/5 stars 😊

Trapero was friendly and very helpful host.
He gave us not only detailed accomodation instructions but also good sightseeing spot recommendations. The apartment was clean and had a great night view, near to evening.
Overall, we had a great experience!
Trapero was very easy to communicate with and very responsive. The place was perfect and had everything we needed for our short stay. Would definitely stay here again.

Loved the proximity to Southbank & Melbourne CBD and also walkable distance to great bars and restaurants.  The views were great and being on the 36th floor the traffic noise was barely noticeable. I felt safe walking around the Southbank area on my own.

Beautiful space, very convenient location around the corner from the Crown and other restaurants & bars. Close to the botanical Gardens & Rod Laver Arena. The view from the 36th floor was great. Recommend to anyone wanting to stay in Melbourne.

The apartment has a stunning view of the city. Grocery store across the street and several great coffee shops. Great location and uber and tram easily accessed to go everywhere from museums, parks, beaches, restaurants and more. Would love to return here. Spent a week and loved our stay.
Great location. Easy walk into city and free tram area and also close to tram stops if you require them. Supermarket across the road. Excellent place to stay.

Location was perfect for the reason why I went over to Melbourne. Close to a small playground, supermarket and coffee shop. The heatpump system was really great at heating the place up nice and quickly. The shower head was secured to the wall too high and on an odd angle. I was unable to figure out how to use the dryer function of the washing machine and was unable to find a clothes line but found a dry cleaners down the road to dry clothes. The view was beautiful and everything was within a fairly good walking distance. Communication with the host was great! Would definitely book again if I ever return to Melbourne.

Its a very cosy and clean house. Kitchen equipment are complete, clean and useful.
Nice stay, strongly recommend this beautiful house to stay in victoria.
Bertie is very friendly and helpful.
Its a wonderful 10 days in Melbourne.

An absolutely beautiful home ❤️ lots of entertainment and activities to do, nice surroundings and great views. We all had a great time, I’ll highly recommend this place for families, friends and anyone looking to have a peaceful getaway.
Jess was very responsive and friendly in all her communication, thank you for hosting us!

Great stay! The location was perfect — right near Melbourne’s CBD, making it super convenient to get around. The price was very reasonable for such a central spot. There are tons of restaurants nearby, and having a supermarket just downstairs was a huge plus. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a comfortable and well-located place in the city!

3 bedroom apartment opposite Melbourne Baths - brilliant location, great amenities and spacious apartment.  Perfect for a mini break in Melbourne when you want to explore the city.  Easy to walk if that is your thing or the free trams are almost on the doorstep.  Comfortable and warm with plenty of space to cater for 5 adults.

Really nice-looking studio, I really appreciated all the little design elements that made it very trendy! There was an aircon/heater and lots of light, a little noise from the street but good and easy location just a few metres away from a tram stop that goes straight to the city and to Fitzroy and Brunswick. Paolo was always very responsive and friendly.
Such a great spot! Paolo was so accommodating and was very helpful. A very cute stay and would recommend again
The place was clean and matched the description. The location was okay but the surrounding was not that great.

We really loved our stay. The location was very ideal, super close to the beach. Check in was very easy too. The aircon was very much appreciated and the general space was really nice.
Additionally, comms with Paolo was a breeze. Highly recommended stay!

Tom and Gus’s place is very well set out, and a step over the road to the beach. The areas were spacious, clean, thoughtfully set out and very comfortable. The beds and pillows were so comfortable. The st kilda shops and restaurants are all within five minute walk as is the excellent tram service directly into the city. Definitely recommend and 5 stars.
Tidy 3 bed beachfront unit located in walking distance to Luna Park and Acland St cafes. Host was responsive when needed. Would definitely stay again during the warmer months.

Beautiful apartment across the street from the beach - very comfortable for a family of four and walking distance to dozens of restaurants. Also close to the tram so getting into Melbourne on public transport is super easy.

We stayed at this place for my daughters wedding, and for the bridal party to get ready at the property. There was plenty of room. It was extremely clean and could not have asked for a nicer place for the bridal party to get ready. Communication from the property was first class and would highly recommend staying at this venue.

Great house in a great location with the beach at our doorstep, Luna Park around the corner and amazing restaurants and cafes at walking distance.
The beds were very comfortable so after big fun filled days we all slept well.

Samantha was terrific to deal with and usually ahead of the game with her communication .
Fabulous apartment compact but fabulous fittings and spotlessly clean .
I will definitely stay again....very good value
Beautiful little apartment in a  quiet building. Great location, close to shops, beach, transport and coffee!

This is a real gem of an apartment great access to local Hampton area and surroundings suburbs near the beach.   Fantastic parking very secure and I felt safe.  Awesome location and  all the amenities you need to have a short stay.

Perfect stay!
I can't say enough good things and highly recommend. I can't wait to return. The apartment is in a great area, close to the high street and directly across from a bustling cafe. It's easy walking distance from the train station as well as from the beachfront path. It's also quiet - great soundproofing between apartments - I never heard anything from any neighbor in this modern building.
Inside the apartment is cozy, warm (with separate controls for bedroom and lounge - I love that!), stylish and oh so comfortable - I slept very well. The kitchen is well equipped and it's great to have a good coffee machine. Sam's place is immaculate (and I am super picky about cleanliness.) And Sam herself is the icing on the cake - an amazing communicator, so helpful (can you believe she figured out train connections for me?) and friendly as can be.

A beautiful compact apartment tastefully furnished and equipped with everything you need. Everything worked flawlessly making for a stress free enjoyable stay. I really appreciated how much effort this host had put into

We loved our stay at this apartment, so close to the beach but quiet and peaceful still. The apartment had everything you'd need, including laundry supplies, all the basic kitchen needs and bathroom essentials too. Sam was a responsive and helpful host. We'd recommend the cafe opposite for breakfast/coffee too. Some lovely little restaurants within walking distance in Hampton or a short taxi ride away in Brighton. Would highly recommend staying here!

A great location and good at communicating with prompt replies.
Had some issues with the heating and other small issues but would still recommend the place

Couldn’t recommend staying with Anastasia enough, beautiful space, wonderfully decorated, fairly central and host was amazingly thorough with instructions and super responsive.
thanks again for having me, Anastasia!
Anastasia's place was the perfect place for our week's get away in Melbourne. It's in a great location and you can access all public transport. We were very happy here, and really enjoyed  our stay.

The written descriptions were great but then there are pictures showing every detail. That was awesome!  The place was great and convenient to everything we were doing. Would absolutely use again. Thanks!

Fantastic location. Close to all the restaurants and shopping you could want without being in the chaos of the CBD. Fantastic having a small balcony to get some air and be able to sit and take in the view. We loved it,
Awesome apartment, well fitted out and very comfortable. Perfect location, no noise from outside but still right in the heart of South Yarra.

Wonderful Air BnB in a perfect location. Stone throw from Chapel St with endless choices of restaurants, cafes & bars all within walking distance. Well appointed apartment with comfortable beds, lovely linen and everything else in between. Host was very responsive and made the whole experience feel easy.
Great apartment in excellent location. Anastasia’s team were helpful and responsive. Everything was as described and good value for money. Would be happy to return.

Russell was great to communicate with, location was great, children loved the pool and the fact Russell supplied pool towels was great.
The view was amazing and the beds were comfortable.

Wonderful apartment, amazing views, clean, well equipped, perfect location for getting to the tennis. Russell was brilliant, super-responsive and helpful, saving us very late in the evening after an opposite-end-of-the-spectrum airbnb failed us; a nightmare turned into a great few days! Couldn't recommend more highly (6 stars).

Great location, spectacular views of Melbourne with  easy access to public transport and apartment was clean & better than the pictures.  So close to restaurants, cafes & retail with lots to choose from.   Accommodation was value for money.  Communication with Russell and instructions was easy.  Made our weekend at F1 so good.  Would come again.

Amazing experience.
Russell is always very friendly and supportive, and his property is amazing, even better than what you see in the ad.
I feel really grateful for the experience.
If you’re considering staying in south yarra, definitely a choice you want to make.
Thanks

This gem was in the perfect spot to the train, Toorak Rd and Chapel St. The view was amazing and the host Russell was incredible answering all of my questions and getting us in early and out late! Thank you so much for the best stay - we will be back! 🙂🙏

we asked Russell for an early Check-in and could enter his Flat at lunch time.
Russell is a great host.
The appartement is well situated with an astonished view.
We also enjoyed the fitness, the pool etc.
We will come back for sure.
4 very happy guests from Switzerland.

We loved the apartment. It was super cozy and every single thing that you can think of was available in the house. The location is full of life with restaurants and public transport very close by. The view from the house blew us away - beautiful sunsets, skyline view, MCG view , hot air baloons and the new year fireworks all from the balcony. Russell is am amazing host and provided all instructions clearly and proactively. He was extremely kind and helpful. If I come back to Melbourne, I won't think twice before staying here and will recommend the house to anyone I know. Thank you Russell for everything.
Great location for the station. Wonderful view from the balcony. One of our favourite stays. Russell was very helpful. Recommended!
Jack was a great host nothing was a problem allowed early check-in, and just easy to deal with

We happened to stay just when storms cut all the power, not just in the local area but across the state. Despite this, the stay was romantic, cosy and the view from the large windows out into the forest was just beautiful.  The hosts came down to check on us and brought candles which was nice. Hope to be back, next time when theres no huge storms!
Great house, we stayed with our 7 week old baby and it has all the necessary amenities.

We had such a wonderful stay at Jenny's house over the weekend.
The location was perfect for what we needed. The house is wonderfully set out, there is ample amount of amenities. The house is very clean and tidy.
Jenny was very helpful and flexible to our late changes, we will definitely be booking this accommodation again.
We stayed in the home for a work trip. Nice, clean and modern home. Host is very responsive and easy to communicate with. Would recommend as a nice place to stay.

The property was perfect for our night away in Melbourne especially as it included parking and we had a standard height car. we used both beds and the pull out couch and all 4 adults were very comfortable. we loved the little balcony and instantly felt at home in this beautiful property. Spotless clean and all linen and towels were in great condition. Clear instructions on how to check in and late the property. the underground car park was going through construction when we visited so it was a bit of a search to find the spot without signage visible on the walls but we got there eventually (not the hosts fault in any way).
Amazing setup and views. had all the basics needed in the bathrooms and kitchen. would definitely recommend this property to others. Cheers Trev
great location with the beautiful city view and the host fasr respone.overall nice place to stay near to everywhere.

Stayed 3 days. We needed to be near Southern Cross Station.
Beds were comfortable. Bathroom facilities were great. Good to have access to washing machine and drier - because our 3 night stay in Melbourne was part of a much longer trip to Australia.
It was a very clean and beautiful place to stay for a few days. It was close to the city centre and we could do everything within walking distance.

This air bnb was in a great location with great facilities available. Great to have parking included and although finding the parking spot was daunting at first we quickly got it. A comfortable, very modern and clean apartment with all basic needs supplied.  The pool, gym and recreational facilities were great too although we didn’t have time to use them this time. Would stay again. Thanks Vincent!  😊
needed someplace to stay between flights and it is such a cute and sweet apartment with everything you need :)
We enjoyed our stay here.  The place was nice and clean, easy to access for everything. We'll definitely stay here again. Thank you Vincent😊

We absolutely loved our stay. The property was beautiful and had stunning views 100, 100% would recommend this to anyone absolutely beautiful property and so nice for a special occasion or we can get away

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! The building was easy to find and my 2 year old son loved waking up to seeing (thankfully not hearing) the trains each morning. The room was clean and spacious and the amenities were great. The instructions given for the parking spot were fantastic too - no way we would’ve found it without them! Thank you again for having us ❤️
Catherine & Rods place is so cute and cozy and in a fantastic location. I would highly recommend staying here.

Catherine’s AirBnB is beautiful. It is more spacious than the photos make it look 💕
Catherine was there to greet me and show me around - so lovely and helpful.
The home is very well equipped and has all you can need and more!
Thank you Catherine for being so helpful and responsive.
Would highly recommend staying here!
Will stay again if I’m back in Melbourne!

Wow ! What a find , beautiful home from home, stunning location, steps from the beach.
A wonderful warm welcome, stunning furnishing, decor, best quality linen, towels, beach towels and bag, infant Catherine has considered everything, making it perfect.
Sit outside for a coffee in the morning, listen to the sea.

Oh Transport cards, places to visit, excellent communication and all together fabulous host x

Loved our stay here! Beautifuly decorated, full of classical charm . Spotlessly clean. You arrive to the aroma of scents from candles. Lots of effort has been put in to make this feel comfortable and homely. I really enjoyed all the wonderful books and magazines. Catherine was such friendly and accommodating fellow Scot. We were very grateful for the yummy treats basket and wine left for our stay plus an extended check out time. We enjoyed it so much we are looking to return as soon as we can. The communication was quick and helpful and would highly recommend. We will be returning.
Thank you for the hospitality shown and sharing your home.
Sage & Terry

An absolutely stunning apartment in the best location- across from the beach and literally around the corner from St Kilda nightlife. The apartment was gorgeous- very Vogue Living, but also warm and comfortable. Red wine and cheese awaited us, fire on and beautifully lit with lamps and candles. Highly recommend 11/10. Thank you Catherine :)
We enjoyed our stay in Catherine’s comfortable apartment. It is tastefully decorated and well located. The basket of snacks made us feel very welcome.
We had a great stay at Catherine's place. Amazing location and a beautiful home. communication was great. highly recommend!

I definitely recommend this flat. A fantastic flat with beautiful touches. You can see the care put in and great linen, towels and a hamper! Catherine was a perfect host with brilliant communication. I loved my stay in st Kilda and would love to return some time….

We had an absolutely fantastic stay at Catherine’s place. The location is amazing and the space was beautifully presented and had everything we needed.
Catherine was a great host and communicated well throughout the stay.
We would highly recommend!
Lovely place to stay, the fire on in the evening was awesome. Comfortable and cosy, walkable to the sea baths and Main Street in st kilda.

Hazel's place was amazing! A great location, close to public transport, restaurants, and shops. The apartment was clean and tidy, with plenty of space for two couples. It had great amenities, with fantastic views.

The air bnb was a perfect place for our weekend Melbourne getaway. It’s an extremely nice 2 bed 2 bath and I would definitely recommend to others looking for accommodation in the CBD. Everything is within walking distance, which is so great for people like me not wanting to Uber everywhere.
Superb location in Chelsea close to shops, beaches and walking trails. Beautiful bedroom with bathroom draws with thoughtful extras so very welcoming.

Excellent location, most places are very close by. Very close to all sorts of public transport too. Really clean modern apartment, with some really good views. Great location within walking distance to Southern Cross station and most amenities. Tidy apartment..........highly recommended.

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in Melbourne! The location is unbeatable, with easy access to attractions, cafes, and shops just a short walk away. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and the host was welcoming and provided great recommendations. I highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Melbourne!
Great location! Hazel was very proactive with communication and would recommend this place to friends staying in the CBD :)

Great views at night, only negative was the hassle to walk into 2 seperate towers to collect keys from locker boxes for the apartment room and the carpark area. So took some time to collect the keys to check in and go back to 2 different towers to return keys.
The host was unable to hand over on arrival and the reception wasn’t able to help with any issues. Also hard to find parking next to apartment to collect the keys for the parking area as it takes time to get it all.
Communication was good with the host, helped me on the day.
I enjoyed my stay at the place, only one problem is no parking but public carpark is not too far

Great view over the city and convenient location, close to Southern Cross station/SkyBus stop, tram lines, shops and restaurants. Comfortable bed. The host was very friendly and provided clear instructions for check-in.
Great location with great views. Overall the apartment was clean and the bed was comfortable. The kitchen was well equipped for cooking. Communication was prompt and very friendly.

The overall experience was fine, was going to give a satisfactory review. We absolutely enjoyed our stay and would not hesitate to book again in the future! The apartment was just as expected and the host was very helpful and responsive to answer any questions!
Location is close to everything and has easy access to the trams.
Would definitely recommend 😊

Our stay at Bedspoke's apartment was comfortable and ideal for our needs. The view from the bedrooms where amazing and everything that we needed was available close by. All communication and instructions provided where clear and any issues where promptly taken care. We would recommend Bedspoke's apartment to anyone looking for a place to stay in Melbourne.
Great stay for a girls weekend, perfect location. Beds super comfortable. Cara was super responsive and great to have flexibility on check in and check out time

Great place in a fabulous neighbourhood! Cara was an amazing responsive host. But narrow stairs were clearly stated in the description, just didn't pay attention. Lovely lounge room on the 2nd floor!
Good host, made us feel very welcome. Place a little smaller than expected from photos but lovely place and very clean and tidy.

Place was very clean and tidy and also secure. Very close to the train station and shops. We travelled with our 4mo bubba and Marios was very accomodating, having set up the cot, baby towel, tub and baby towel for our little one. Definitely recommend the place and the hosts.

Mario'splace was great. we stayed the week and found it convenient as we were close to family and shopping centres. To have the train station so close by was great and made getting into the city such a breeze. We have already recommended it to other family members for future stays.
We would happily stay again on the future.

Really satisfied with the living arrangements.
We had visited from ACT and spent 2 nights on this property.
No complains
Recommend to other people
Situated few minutes from station to enjoy city trains
Peaceful and easy access

Thank you Marios and family for your hospitality and for taking care of us so well! Marios place was clean and had the basic necessities available for us to use during our stay. He was also responsive and replied quick when we encountered issues during our stay. A drive away from the city, suitable for families with a car. Quiet neighbourhood with supermarkets just a few mins drive away. Thanks for having us :)

Thank you for hosting us.
When we are next in town, we will book again. :)
John was a great host, he couldn’t do enough for us. Even gave us a late check out!

An outstanding place to stay in Fitzroy. Close to some amazing cafés and restaurants. It's really peaceful around the immediate area, given how much there is to do around the neighbourhood.
There were 9 of us, which was quite cosy, but we just used the place as a base, and we were happy to sleep on bunks.
It has the charm you would expect from an inner Melbourne home. Would recommend.
Lydia was an awesome host, would highly recommend and will definitely look to stay at Lydia’s property again. The property, location, information & communication were all perfect!
Lailah was very responsive to any questions we had.  Apartment was very clean and exactly as in photos.  Would stay here again.

We stayed there for a couple of weeks while our house was being renovated. The house was clean and tidy and very well presented for its age. Location is central and walking distance to high street and station street cafes and restaurants.

The location was great for us, close to family in Northcote. Loved the coffee shop outside, easy access to transport, lovely comfy beds. More general maintenance is required.

This apartment was exactly what we needed for our family of five for a base from which to visit relatives in Melbourne. The apartment is quirky and a little dated but had super comfortable beds and pillows, huge bedrooms each with a desk, and handy kitchen with dishwasher. Lots of room to spread out. The location is just 22 minutes from the airport, and close to the eastern freeway and Hoddle street, meaning getting around is easy. The host was very friendly and responsive.

Stayed here for 2 nights with family, amazing place . Loved the location. House had everything you need. Perfect for a little family getaway. Loved the outdoors . Well advertised . Would definitely book again in future

A fantastic stay in a brilliant location. An easy stroll into the city, close to everything you need and very responsive and proactive hosts! Gave local recommendations, and a smooth check-in process. Very clean and comfortable bed. Can’t wait to get back!
Great view. Near QV market. Loads of restaurants to eat. Great place to stay very comfy. Highly recommend.

We have a wonderful stay at this apartment. It is in a great location with a lovely view. The host was very responsive, and the instructions for finding the key were clear. The apartment has a modern look, is clean, and offers a fantastic view. Highly recommended!

Fantastic location right in the City and walking distance to all main spots like the Melbourne Central Shops.  The views from both bedrooms and living area were so amazing especially at night time!  Lift is so smooth and quick being on the 36th Floor.  The host, Renlei, was so helpful answering my questions quickly and very accommodating in having a later checkout.  Much appreciated!  All instructions were very clear and easy.  The whole apartment was very clean and looked just like the photos and having the 2 bathrooms was a plus!  We will definitely stay here again on our next visit :)!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our short stay athe apartment. Pleasantly surprised how nice the apartment was and it literally had everything you needed. We will definitely come back and highly recommend it. Its very reasonable price and perfect location was also a bonus.

This place is so convenient for my work so I stayed a second time! Lovely hosts - very responsive. Easy to drive in and park. I had some nice walks along the yarra river. I really got to know Melbourne. Thank you for having me!

Thank you for opening up your home to my girlfriend and I. We had a relaxing and stress free time in your home, during what has been a hectic week's stay in Melbourne for a wedding.
Beata's place is a home; warm, clean with a beautiful scent and very cozy. the kitchen and amenities were in amazing shape and everything was extremely neat and organised. Thank you for the early check in and hospitality.

Excellent stay right in the heart of Fitzroy, and literally across from Lune 🥐🙌🏻 Nice layout with bedrooms on the ground floor and top floor with living in the middle. Kitchen was pretty welll stocked ✅
Maybe not the best place to lounge around in with just the sofa in the living room (although there are the the dining area chairs and a foot stool poof thing), but really in this location you’re probably not going to spending too much time inside!).
Overall a quiet, nice place.

Great place to stay in Melbourne if you want to feel like a local. Close to great cafes, shops and transport if you want to get to the city. Looking forward to book this place again when i come back to Melbourne.

If you like fancy croissants in bed this is the place for you! Ruth was a friendly and responsive host. Only tip would be to be aware the house is over three levels so if you need bedrooms closer together this might not be the best place for you.

This place is centrally located and makes accessing Fitzroy so easy!! It’s an amazing space for two singles, two couples or if you have teenage children as the bedrooms are separate with separate bathrooms. I wouldn’t choose this place if I had young children as the rooms would be too far away apart for me.  Considering it’s so central it was super quiet. It wasn’t gorgeously decorated but that’s reflected in the price which I thought was awesome! It worked really well for us!

Great location, right next to Brunswick St, tram stop and plenty of restaurants/hotels/cafes to choose from. A very buzzy neighbourhood which we enjoyed exploring. Public transport to Flemington worked well. Nice layout for 2 couples and Ruth was super efficient. Thanks Ruth and we loved our stay.
Check in and check out went very smoothly. We really enjoyed our stayed in Fitzroy and the apartment was located so close to the main drag. Ruth was very easy to communicate with.

Great location in Collingwood - shops, restaurants, cafes and public transport on your doorstep.
Apartment was clean, stylish, beds were super comfy, fully equip kitchen with everything you need to cook and great balcony.
Thanks so much for our stay Ruth!

Great location and very peaceful. Shops and cafes all around.
The apartment suited our short stay.
We’ll return again one day.
Thanks Ruth
Very comfortable and clean bedrooms. Enjoyed our visit even though it was for one night. Very friendly cat was a bonus.

Quiet and green but the air con is portable so no cold air and the fan made a loud clicking sound on all settings through the night….rough night sleep in a hot room. Would be lovely on cool days but we arrived when it was 30deg.

I met Steve and Kaye on arrival and immediately felt at home in their beautiful house and garden. The bedroom and bathroom were spotless. I didn't go to the extensive looking kitchen of the same high standard. I didn't see them again as I went out for dinner and left early the next morning. A really pleasant stay with outstanding facilities and lovely home. I would be more than happy to stay again. Many thanks, Mark.

We had a wonderful stay at Kaye’s! Both her and her husband are lovely. The house is extremely clean and private and in a beautiful part of Diamond Creek. We loved how Kaye provided some delicious  home made goodies and feel that it was exceptional value for money and would definitely stay again! Thanks Kaye and Steve

Amanda was the epitome of good hospitality. Could not have asked for a better, more helpful, more responsive host. Place was as described, nice and close to the gem that is Lygon Street. We loved our stay! Thanks so much.

We had a peaceful stay at Cosmo Carlton, really enjoyed the cafe's and restaurants nearby, super easy to get the tram service. Look forward to using this groovy little apartment again.
Many thanks Greg and Maureen.
Was great to find a place that is child friendly with cot, high chair and toys. Location was close to shops and restaurants. Apartment was also well equiped for cooking. We enjoyed our stay.
Amanda’s place is fantastic. Great location, clean, cosy, stylish and just as described in listing. Amanda was great at communicating & provided very clear, detailed instructions and house rules.

Amanda’s place was perfect for what we needed, and easily met my expectations.. the apartment was spotless and cosy.. I loved the little extra touches and thought that has gone into making it really easy to be there.. Amanda also communicated really well and checking in and out was a breeze.. thank you for this space Amanda, we will come again 🙏😃

Aaron’s place was perfect for the one night layover. It had a great bed and comfortable couches and an awesome massage chair!!
Check in was super easy and the place was very close to Uni Hill DFO.
Would definitely stay again! Thanks Aaron!!

A beautiful place to stay .
the hosts are very friendly and helpful .
we felt like staying at our home ..
love ❤️ the massage chair ..
very clean and fully services accomadation ..
we highly recommend this place for a comfortable & peaceful stay
Aaron and Alisha were fantastic hosts. Very responsive and accommodating. The accommodation exceeded our expectations, it was spotless, warm, comfortable and very welcoming. We had a lovely stay.

It was definitely a good stay. The housing area was peaceful and quiet which was what I needed for this holiday. Aaron and Alicia was very responsive via chat and they have a lovely cat too! The place really feels home!

Unfortunately I fell ill with a bout of food poisoning and so all plans went out the window as I was up all night vomiting (Sorry Aaron + family), however despite this it was still a magical little retreat that made the ordeal much more pleasant than it otherwise could've been. 5/5 would recommend, comes with a cute cat.

We loved our stay very happy with everything specially having a garage that we could put a trailer in with motorcycles in so we could go to a event ..
Place was lovely and clean couldn’t fault it, and very easy to find and easy instructions to enter ..
Thank you very much we enjoyed our stay, would stay here again ..
Sara 😊

As we were visiting friends in the area Aaron's place perfectly suited our needs: there is easy access to a a good walk which we managed to so. Would recommend the accommodation.

We had a comfortable stay at Aaron’s property.
Place was so clean and had everything we needed. There were some toys which my daughter enjoyed playing with very much and hubby enjoyed the massage chair - especially after the long drive from Sydney. Garage was good to have as well, specially during rainy days.
Aaron and Alisha were very nice and friendly. Thank you for sharing your home with us.

Really great, spacious apartment with separate living room, bedroom, bathroom and kitchen. Tastefully decorated and very comfortable and private. Couldn't ask for more for much the same price as one room.
Very clean, comfortable accommodation in great spot near Plenty Gorge walking tracks.  Aaron and Alisha were great hosts who were very quick to respond to any queries

Basement flat (as described in listing) accesed via the garage but once you were in the flat was very comfortable. Quite steep drive, we parked on the road rather than in the garage. Very pleasant for the couple of nights we stayed. Thanks to our hosts.

Had a cosy stay with a toddler and Bub.The place was clean,free of clutter and felt just like home.Close to the shops  and places to eat out.We worried about the low garage on arrival ,but it all turned out ok as our big SUV  fit in there just fine. The  place had everything we needed. Thoughtful host who put out some toys for the kiddos which was a nice touch.Definitely recommend and will stay here again.

Perfect place for us during our short stay, very clean and had all the amenities we needed . Aaron and Alicia were very responsive to our messages . Great location for us close to Bundoora and the Greensborough Plaza . Will stay again if we come back to Melbourne.

Excellent place, close to restaurants and has a car park,
Will stay there again for sure

This Carlton apartment spacious & easily fit the four of us. Clean with amenities, nice beds, nice couch,  & very close to Lygon Street. Came with a parking space.  Also has a balcony to sit outside. Really enjoyable.
3 / 4 min walk to Lygon st + secured parking in a quiet Neighbour hood this was the perfect location for us
Beautiful apartment with great amenities and close to lots of restaurants and things to see and do. Can absolutely recommend this place, great value for the money.
Good little apartment in a great location. Beds were comfortable and Amanda was very friendly, would recommend 😊

David was a great host! Very responsive with messaging and flexible with check in and out. The apartment had everything we needed and was a lovely place to stay. Very clean and tidy and enough space for 3 people, never felt too small or crowded. Overall 10/10!
Was all great- no problems, great place, and David super helpful and thoughtful. Thank you!
The place was just lovely and exactly as described and the hosts were extremely helpful and responsive :) would definitely recommend!

The apartment was the perfect spot for our week spent in Melbourne visiting family and friends. The neighborhood where the apartment is located is a convenient residential area walking distance to cafes and shops. We were also close to two tram lines and a cycling path. Pretty much great access to everything. The apartment was quiet and modern. We would recommend this apartment for stays in Melbourne.
Great location. Small,  but very comfortable apartment set up with lap pool and gym in great Brunswick location.

Place & the view was amazing but the mattress were really uncomfortable, we were 5 friends who stayed over here for 2 nights & we all have sore back because of the cheap mattress & quilt cover & sheets were really low quality, we couldn’t sleep on it. Amazing view! Furnishings and linens/beds/towels quality do not match the place. The access to get the key should be improved. They really need to leave you with a few more things to get started. strategic location, easy access to shops and attractions, and an awesome host who’s easy to chat with. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Melbourne — we’d definitely stay again!

The location was perfect – close to city, and very easy to get around. Communication with the Host was smooth and friendly; they were always quick to respond and super helpful with local tips and recommendations.
I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Melbourne, Australia!

A tidy and lovely home equipped with everything you need. A good bed and a nice clean own private bathroom. Sam's place was in a  very convenient location and place was clean and tidy.Will go again.

Very responsive host however a few details were not advised until questioned. Kitchen was not well cleaned and one of the beds was very uncomfortable with a quilt that was not warm enough for the cold temperatures.

We really enjoyed our stay.
The house was very close to my niece's place.
A comfortable and warm place to stay.

The host is very helpful and quick to respond.
Close to the shops, and it was so close to my niece's house, which was the main reason why we were in Melbourne .
I would go back and stay in this house anytime I visit Melbourne again.
Thank you.

Maha was a great host! Responded very quickly, and was very accommodating to our needs/requests. Check-in instructions were super detailed and helpful.  The property is absolutely clean and stylish.
It is exactly the same as shown in the pictures. We could not have asked for a better location. Overall a wonderful place; we would stay here again easily! We were delighted to find such a modern and clean space right near where we wanted to be.
It was the perfect place for us to stay and such a great value. Thank you so much Maha.
Nice place to stay for a small family, only queen beds so have to be whiling to share beds.

Great house and great host! Really enjoy our 40-day stay with my family in Dandenong. Maha is a friendly host and always responsible in time. This is a fantastic and beautiful property in a great area. We love the indoor and outdoor areas especially the patio on the top floor. Highly recommend this place and I will definitely come back again in the future. I love everything about this Airbnb

Beautiful home exactly how it looks in the photos! Audrey & Willem we’re amazing to deal with and super accommodating!
Will defiantly be back!

The moment I booked, Audrey and Willem were very proactive in positive communication. The place was pristine and beautiful, it was very modern and fells like a home the moment you enter. Exactly like the pictures and description. The area was peaceful but close enough to the city that everything was easily accessible. Check in and check out was extremely easy. I would highly recommend booking this Airbnb, you won’t be let down!! :)
Audrey and Willem went above and beyond to accommodate us. A beautiful space to call home for a couple of weeks. We'd gladly book again.
We felt very at home with the place at North Melbourne. It was such a great relief every day to return here after visiting Melbourne. Highly recommend and we will be back again!

Perfect location for shopping, restaurants and access to the city.
Street parking was no problem. Cafe/bakery across the road for morning coffee. Lots of parks nearby for exercise.
All in all, it exceeded our expectations and we will would stay there again.

The home was absolutely beautiful. Very clean, well equipped & lots of tasteful touches. We enjoyed cooking breakfast in the morning & enjoying it on the balcony. The cafe across the road had great coffee & the supermarket was just 5min walk away. Auction Room & Mork Chocolate was a 15min walk away. We enjoyed these cafes a lot. We stayed during winter but the heating was fine. Thank you for such a comfortable stay!

Audrey and Willem's place in North Melbourne was a visual delight. Beautifully furnished and very spacious, it definitely met our expectations. It was close to a bus stop and within reasonable walking distance to tram and train. A very quiet neighbourhood and across the road from a coffee shop, a pizza place, and an IGA. Woolworths close by. We loved the ambience, the dining and lounge areas downstairs. Upstairs, the main bedroom was comfortable and airy with a very attractive outside patio.
Audrey and Willem were very caring and thoughtful hosts, checking every now and then to see if everything was going smoothly. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend it to others as an attractive alternative to inner city accommodation.

Audrey and Willem’s home felt like you stepped into an architecturally designed masterpiece! The space is beautifully designed and very practical. The kitchen was fully appointed, and cupboards stocked with plenty of cooking essentials. The Aesop hand wash was a nice touch. We especially appreciated the doggy door for our puppy! We stayed for 6 nights over Christmas, and we honestly could’ve stayed longer! Thank you for providing a home away from home!

Clean, comfortable and light. This property has been stylishly furnished and has an abundance of real indoor plants creating a homely feel. Across the road from a delicious cafe and a number of takeaway/convenience shops. An easy walk to the Queen Victoria Markets and close to public transport. We would definitely stay again.

This is such an amazing house, everything was high quality and very clean. It had all the things you would need in a house - very stocked up which made it easy!
Absolutely would stay here again, such a cosy and beautiful house with lots of space.

Had a good stay, the place was great for what I needed for the few nights - secure parking, close to shops, coffee and restaurants. South Yarra station is just a short walk up the road for trams and trains to the city. Very good communication from  the hosts.

Family friendly place to stay. Well equipped unit. Drove into MEL from ADL so it was nice having an undercover carport without parking on the street. Close by from Main Street with lots of cafes, restaurants and shops. Highly recommend & will definitely book again.

We had a lovely stay at Kylie’s place. She was flexible with our check-in and check-out times, and the unit was very comfortable and welcoming. Would recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay in the area! 😊

We really loved this apartment it’s cute an cozy. Letitia is such a nice host too! She even brought us some useful things during our stay an was every time available for us if we had any questions etc.. We would definitely come back!

We had an incredible stay at Jacqueline's home, a very warm welcome with little attentions (peanuts, transport card, bottle of water…) waiting for us. Perfect communication, very well located accommodation 2min from the streetcar which takes us into Melbourne CBD. The apartment is very clean and well decorated, with a lovely balcony overlooking the sunrise ☀️ and the city. We recommend it 100%.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Jacqueline’s place, and I can’t recommend them enough!
The space itself was spotless and beautifully decorated, with all the amenities one could ask for. I particularly loved the cozy living area and the balcony.
The location was perfect, making it easy to explore Melbourne City.
Jacqueline is a really great host, so friendly and the space is very nice and clean. Will probably come back again
thanks Jacqui for a wonderful visit. your place is amazing and we're very glad we stayed with you. the apartment is pristine and in a wonderful location.

Jackie’s place is clean and quiet. The mattress is just what we needed - not too soft not too hard. Though we only had a short stay in Melbourne, she was nice to greet us at late check-in and early check-out. We also got a chance to had a nice chat with her one afternoon. She shared a lot of travel tips and restaurant recommendations nearby.

The place is conveniently located near Vic Market, Melb Central, and even has food around that opens till late to keep you from going hungry.
The place was clean, and had all the basic items needed for your stay. I'll gladly book the place again as it was worth the value. Communication with the host was super responsive and helpful.

A decent unit in a prime location, if you just need a space to sleep this could be a great choice. The apartment does have some facilities but we did not try those, but everything else in the unit worked fine, such as the refrigerator, washer / dryer and the heating unit. If I had to nitpick is that the water temperature for shower can be inconsistent at times, but the water pressure was good. Overall I'm still happy with the value given considering the location

Very clean and central! The checkout instructions are a bit extensive and the place is not safe in the case of a fire just as an fyi

Well located apartment with a very hotel-like feel. Very functional for a short stay. I wasn't too impressed with the cleanliness with evidence of the prior guests throughout the space. So first impressions, loved it! However noticed that from my room it was a black hole for telephone signal. I phoned after hours from the telephone many times which didn’t work, and when i did get ahold of the after hours management it was very much a “deal with it” attitude. Overall I’ve lost more money than I spent for the night in this hotel and likely won’t be back because of this fact.

Was a nice hotel experience on the awesome Johnston Street. The reception was very helpful with my requests, after the check-in. For communication before meeting them in-person, email is a better option to communicate.

Great location but very uncomfortable accomodation. The walls are so thin that you can hear everything that guests in the room next door are doing. We were woken up multiple times by noises from other guests going to the bathroom and closing doors.
Staff were super friendly and the room was spacious and it felt homely. Comfy beds and the apartment complex was super close to everything in the city.

We had a great time staying here. They looked after our bags at reception for day the morning before check in and the afternoon after check out. Very close to MCG which is an easy walk. Lots of cafes around!! Thank you!

Wonderful weekend!! We had x6 stay & felt there was plenty of room for everyone. The house was so beautiful and better than the pictures! Lovely place and we enjoyed the stay very much. Will certainly book this place again when travelling to MSAC
Wonderful apartment at a great price. Clean, central, and homely. Eduardo is a fantastic host who is very responsive and helpful. So glad we could stay in his air bnb.
Wonderful unit and very responsive host. Great location for public transport and close to Spencer street station, however no issue with traffic noise. Very good
We’ve a lovely stay here, you got everything you need. The location is superb and with a on premise car park which is very convenient.

Great location, nice clean apartment, good sized pool, clean bedding and linen, however the windows are not soundproof from the noise from nearby bars and pubs but still a great apartment to stay in. Would definitely rebook.

Enjoyed our stay, owner was extremely helpful and patient with our concerns and problems. Getting right on top of them and fixing them, great communication went a long way. The place was very nice and clean.

This is the second time we have stayed in this unit. A really great short stay, location is convenient and close to public transport, restaurants and Melbournes sporting event locations. Grant was extremely helpful and friendly. Highly recommend to all
David was very communicative and made the stay very easy. I look forward to having David host again!

Wow! What a beautiful home and setting. The views were spectacular! Penny was a fabulous host and very easy to talk to.   Penny gave a tour through the home on arrival which was very helpful. A very homely, stylish and comfortable home. This special place has lots of little extras and lots of room. Beautiful home and Penelope was so easy to communicate with. The surrounding gardens are lovely. Very picturesque. All of our needs and ammenities were cared for with extra personal touches. Would definitely stay again!
Amazing property. Very spacious, spotless and couldn’t ask for a better place to stay. Beautiful and peaceful surroundings. Penelope was so responsive and helpful and I would highly recommend

This place was absolutely beautiful. We really enjoyed our stay, Penny had the place looking incredible, and it was everything we didn’t know we needed leading up to our wedding and the day after. I would recommend anyone staying here. It is super kid friendly, they had an absolute ball as well.

We stayed at Misty Hill the night before and of our wedding. We felt right at home as soon as we arrived, penny was amazing and very kind from the get go.

Thankyou so much penny, I highly recommended misty hill to everyone !!

Firstly, the apartment was wonderful with an amazing view, amazing facilities and very useful Woolworths downstairs :)

many many thanks for everything!

Great experience, definitely will choose this place again when in Melbourne.

Very clean, quiet apartment - comfortable bed and all the facilities you might need. Paul and Fan were great communicators Highly recommended.

Paul and Dan’s apartment had everything you could need. It was clean and they always got back to me asap if I had any questions which I greatly appreciated. Would definitely stay again if it was available!

Nice, fresh and convenient. Host easy to deal with. Enjoyed our stay and will stay again.
it was a lovely property, very clean and convenient. the only problem was limited supply of things.  although they had mentioned in the description about it.
very comfortable bed and mattress ( I always have back issue sleeping on bad mattress) and had a very good rest.
