wonderful stay in a cosy and private area very close to the center of Olinda. Sharon was a lovely host, very helpful and it was a beautiful little cottage

My family and I had the pleasure of staying at Guoyun's apartment.
Guoyun, was very proactive with messaging and anytime we were unsure or needed help, we received a response within minutes.
The apartment was as described, clean, beds were comfortable, walking distance to eateries and Coles.
I would highly recommend staying at Guoyun's apartment.
Guoyun was very helpful and very responsive to questions and messages. Lovely apartment close to Southern Cross Station

Was really great, amazing view and location! Only issue is the long wait for the elevators..But one was broken i guess...
Thanks for a great time!

Thank you for making our girls trip enjoyable. Guoyun is a very responsive host, friendly and flexible.
The location is so accessible for eateries and shopping. The sunset from the Balcony is beautiful and majestic, hopefully this will be able to enjoy for sometime as there are lots of high rise buildings in surrounding areas.
Thank you ☺️
We were unable to enjoy fresh air from the bed rooms mostly due to constant cooking / food smells from balcony units below. It’s not something the host could do anything about it as the normality of living in an apartment.
Otherwise, highly recommended and we will book again in near future.
We had a fantastic weekend away at Sharon’s place. Super cozy atmosphere and loved having the fire going. The cabin was super clean and we highly recommend staying at Sharon’s.

An absolutely wonderful stay! The property was surrounded by beautiful greenery, creating a peaceful and private environment. It was the perfect place to relax, and everything was well-maintained and welcoming. We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a serene getaway. Would definitely book again.

We had a lovely restorative night away at Sharon's guesthouse.
The place was nice and private and well equipped with log fire and sauna- perfect for a cosy winter night.
Sharon’s place was perfect for a weekend getaway! The cabin is very cozy and private. Thank you for having us.

Fabulous location, a few minutes walk to the station. We were a group of 3 adults and 5 children. Used the studio at the back plus the house. Studio bed is double size, house beds all queen size.
Going from one building to the other a bit tricky at time due to electronic locks. Kitchen lacked some cutlery and chairs for our group.
Overall though we enjoyed our stay very much. The area is stunning.

It was our worst experience in Airbnb. We could not sleep at all. They have started making noise around 12 clock and continue whole night. We have been provided single blanket for 2 persons. But it is true the host was very friendly.
Nikhil was a very nice host who was great to talk to. The house is very clean and the many plants make you feel right at home.
The place was perfect. It was close to the airport and Nikhil was a great host. The water and chocolate was a lovely touch too. Thanks again 🙂

Nikhil is a fantastic host. He keeps his place very clean and cozy, and communicates well with guests.
We really enjoyed our stay. It was quiet and peaceful, which made us feel right at home.

Nikhil was extremely reactive, always answered very fast and have me perfect instructions. My plane was delayed, so I arrived late and haven't had the chance to meet him but everything was organised so I could arrived easily. He was also very nice and let us leave a bit later than the usual checkout as my 2yr old was sleeping with the late arrival and jet lag. All in all, it was very good. Coming from France, I found the room a bit cold, but an electrical heater was provided and it heated up quickly.
I would definitely recommend

Nikhil is a great guy who both My friend and I found easy to get along with, had great travel recommendations for our upcoming trip and overall was very welcoming and helpful. His house is clean and full of plants (which I loved being a plant fanatic), we found it easy to get to the airport and there is a shopping mall a short drive away, there is a supermarket and 7/11 a short walk away.

Wonderful place and amazing value for money.
Perfect if you're looking for a place not too far away from the airport. It's a 30 minute and 3 AUD bus ride to Nikhils place, much better than the overpriced Skybus for 20 AUD to the city centre.
Besides of that place, the place is super comfy, large living room, cute private room and Nikhil is a wonderful host. The house is perfectly clean (incl. the kitchen) and well-maintained.
Highly recommended for short- and long-term stays. The walk to the metro station is 10 minutes, from there it's a 30-minute ride to the centre.
We'd love to come back one day.

Although our stay was short Nikhils home was perfect for us. Conventionally close to the airport so that we could get to the airport nice and early. House was nice and neat no issues with anything whatsoever which was great.
Nikhil had good communication in terms of the instructions of how to get here, how to get inside the home etc. Just overall a perfect experience and we 100% recommend !
Brilliant stay - just as described and so easy when coming from the airport ☺️ the place was spotless and the amenities exceeded expectations! Thank you

This was a lovely little apartment with everything I needed for my short stay. The views were spectacular both during the day and the night. I especially loved the floor to celling windows in the living room and bedroom.
I would stay here again!

A good and comfortable stay right near Melbourne central, walkable distance to basically everything! There’s everything I needed at the bnb and overall really clean.
Efficient communication with the host and no fuss. I had a great time in Melbourne :)
The apartment is very new and comfortable,Adji’s team is very helpful and kind,this is my third time choose Adji’s airbnb.
Amazing apartment that is within walking distance to many places and right in front of a tram stop. Would recommend this apartment!

The place was in an amazing location, within walking distance to everything. The accommodation was accurately described.
Nerms was very responsive and very helpful, although there were no issues at all.
The accommodation was very neat and clean and very well appointed, would recommend.

Nerms’s place was the perfect solution; exactly what we were looking and hoping for. Central and easy walking distance to the rest of the CBD, South Bank and its cultural and entertainment precinct, and a short tram ride to the MCG and surrounding inner suburbs; what more could you ask for? Very well appointed unit with thoughtful amenities, we felt instantly at home. Best of all was Nerms’s communication beforehand, and during our stay. We’ll be recommending this listing to all our friends and colleagues and will be crossing our fingers that it’ll be again available when we have something on in the city.
Excellent apartment in very central location. Nice decor and well presented. Host met us there with the keys (offered to meet at airport if we were flying in). Would stay again.

Nerms and Gino's apartment is tidy and equipped with everything you may need for a short stay. Located conveniently right outside a tram stop, everything is either a short walk or tram ride away. The owners are super communicative and friendly.
I did have to deduct a star in my review as we often saw small bugs/roaches inside the apartment even when the doors were closed. Understandably this is expected living in an apartment and nothing occupants can't handle with a shoe or tissue, but I'd recommend the owners do some pest control just to put their mind at ease.
I would definitely consider staying at this apartment again if I am in town.

Highly recommend this AirBNB if you are looking for somewhere very central and convenient to stay. It's a small apartment but has everything you need and is pretty quiet at night. The apartment is well appointed and very clean.

-Great location
-Everything as advertised
-Firmish but comfortable bed
-Great value
-Very helpful with an early check in and getting the keys to us at the airport
-would stay here again

Had a great time in Melbourne. The apartment was comfortable and spotless. Fantastic location and walkable to so many of Melbournes best eateries and shopping. Nerms made a late check in available which was a breeze. Will definitely stay again.
Michael is a lovely host , very respectful very helpful and gave me lifts when needed highly recommend such a lovely house and goes out of his way to ensure your stay is perfect
Great apartment in a super convenient location. Sally and Ronnie were great hosts- super responsive, friendly and great to deal with. Would stay again in a heartbeat!

Sally n Ronnie's house was very comfortable. Especially, the bedding was so comfortable that I was able to sleep very comfortably.
The tableware was also kept so clean that it was good to make food. The mart and shopping center are a 1minute walk away, so it was very convenient. I recommend Sally n Ronnie's house to many travelers.

We really enjoyed our stay in Sally and Ronnie’s AirBnB! It was the perfect space and we settled in well during our visit. The location was great, easy to access places to visit. It had everything we needed and they even offered to have the sofa bed prepared. We were allowed to check in one hour early which we were appreciative of. It was lovely of them to wait at the building to meet us in person on arrival. Sally and Ronnie were friendly, helpful and responsive to messages and sent us a check in message to offer any ideas or answer any questions which was lovely. They were great hosts and would definitely recommend them.
We look forward to returning to Melbourne and booking to stay here again.

Sally and Ronnie were great hosts. Very responsive and Ronnie met us in person to let us into the apartment and show us around. Very walkable from Southern Cross station. Very clean and well equipped apartment.
Nice space with beautiful scenery, good location with walking tracks nearby. However, lacks kitchen equipment and privacy - loud dogs next to parking.

The host was very kind and helpful, the house warmed up quickly as soon as we arrived. The view from the accommodation was also beautiful. It was enjoyable to watch TV upstairs while the children were asleep. However, the bed and pillow were too soft, making it difficult to sleep comfortably. Throughout the night, we could hear dogs barking, and in the middle of the night, we heard noises on the roof that seemed to be from possums.  If you are a light sleeper, it might be hard to get a good night's sleep. Overall, we still have good experience. Thank you :)
Great place with Australian outback views. The top floor balcony was cool place to chill. Overall nice and homy place for an overnight stay.
Just the 1 night stay and it was perfect for our needs. Host is very responsive and our dog loved her short holiday! Great value and a real find.

Great accommodation in beautiful surrounding.
Kitchen could have been a bit better equipped, but enough for a few days.
We had a wonderful stay! The place was spotless, tranquil, and offered stunning views. The host was incredibly responsive, and we look forward to visiting again.
Nice big living space and beautiful peaceful surroundings. Haoyang was very helpful and responsive. Spotted our first kangaroos in the wild, which as a foreigner was very special to us.

It was a very very nice stay at Kishani’s place! She’s very lovely and friendly and communication was great. Their place has a very beautiful garden and it was just lovely even to just spend the day sitting outside! The house was also very tidy and clean. Everything is also very new;) definitely would come back again!

Oasis in the heart of Brunswick is a beautifully set up unit . The deco throughout the place is amazing. The place is very clean and very well equipped with everything.  Thomas is very responsive and took the time to make sure we were ok throughout our stay. I can't wait to return and stay in Thomas's place again.  It was an absolute pleasure.
The home is a charming retreat – impeccably clean with a clear and consistent theme throughout. Thomas is a great host, super friendly and responsive.  Highly recommended!

My sister and I booked Thomas' place for 3 nights. It actually was even nicer than the photos as more spacious. He contacted me with clear instructions about access to the place. The kitchen is well supplied and organised. It is a pleasant walk to Sydney road for a tram to Melbourne. We really enjoyed Sydney road cafes and shops in Brunswick. Our beds were very comforatble and my son, wife and toddler fitted in with us for 1 night. Enough room to eat a meal together at the good sized dining table. The backyard space was nice and private and the toddler enjoyed it. It is one of the best Airbnb's I have been to on 3 continents actually. I hope to stay again and another family member who saw it plans to recommend it to others. Thank you so much Thomas for sharing your lovely place with us. Sincerely, Gina.

Has a fantastic few days. The accomodation has everything you need, it is clean and cosy.
Great location, just off Sydney Road.
Thomas was a great host, as the accomodation was not booked the day before we checked he let us check in early which we really appreciated.
Flexible and friendly host and the accomodation is perfect!!!
Can't wait to stay again, thanks Thomas
Absolutely great place to stay. I will look for this apartments specifically the next time I’m in town.
Excellent spot, quiet and centrally located to walk into the city. The flat is clean, spacious and well equipped.

Great location.
Heating struggled on cold nights.
Had to get some grubby old rug out of a cupboard to avoid freezing
(with the a/c on in the bedroom!)
Insulation problem I expect.

Despite some inconveniences related to the key lock system, for example I was locked out one day with my keys inside ans simply had to spend extra $400 on a hotel room and a locksmith to sort it out.
I hope a less stressful and more secure human loving support for the future clients in a similar situation. Good for people to know also that the building is safe and sound, with lovely people. It is neighbor to a Hospital.
It felt for me a bit distant and more secluded.
All in all, felt blessed and grateful for the experience and the choice I made in the first place.
My partner and I had a lovely stay in the unit. It is a short walk away from wonderful restaurants and vibrant neighborhoods. We would certainly come back for another visit in the future!
Great place to stay if you're on a business trip. Parking is easy, and the Prince Patrick hotel is a must!
Lovely house in a gorgeous neighbourhood - close enough to the city and surrounding neighbourhoods while still being nice and quiet.

A fantastic apartment in a perfect St Kilda spot, close to it all at the calm end of the street. The comfy lounge and huge TV was awesome and made for a fantastic movie night, after a day luxuriating at the pool deck. The pool is worth it in itself with stunning Melbourne and bay views.
Even though I live locally, I'm keen to come back just for a day of pool! Excellent kitchen facilities at the pool deck too. Formula One time would be a bit special here. Andre was flexible, responsive and a pleasure to deal with.

Andres place was perfect for what we needed for the weekend! Easy to access and desciption was exactly as described. Getting in contact with Andre was also very easy and great communication!
We were lucky enough to get some great weather and enjoy the rooftop pool and view also! What a bonus it was!
Thanks for a great stay Andre!

Andres Airbnb was immaculate, perfect spot just out of the city with an amazing view from the rooftop pool.
We will definitely stay again if we are in Melbourne

Stunning view and great location!
We enjoyed our stay. so close to Victoria Market and lots of restaurants are just downstairs, will definitely come back again.

The host is very responsive
The view is amazing , especially in the master bedroom and living room
Thanks CMB for hosting us

Andre was an excellent host he always responded quickly with clear communication to all my inquiries.
The apartment is in an amazing location making it easy to get around Melbourne using public transport, Accommodation was extremely comfortable, warm with everything you need for an awesome easy stay, super comfortable beds :)
The most spectacular views from the roof top area with the most beautiful heated roof top pool. Great place to stay..
Andre’s apartment is lovely and as a host he’s second to none! He went out of his way to ensure our stay was as pleasant as possible.  Highly recommend

We really enjoyed our weekend in Andre’s apartment on Fitzroy Street. Communication with him was very good.
The apartment was clean, modern, uncluttered and comfortable. The swimming pool was beautiful with incredible views. The location was perfect for exploring the city, with easy access to public transport. Thanks for having us!
Lovely apartment, great location, and has a great city view. Check in instructions were clear.

Victoria’s place had a unbelievable view of Melbourne. The apartment and building amenities were an AWESOME bonus (rock climbing wall, pool, laundry machine). We appreciated the teas, fixings, kettle, mugs, dishwasher, and fridge. We had a great experience in Victoria’s quiet apartment above lively Melbourne CBD. Thank you!

Our stay at Victoria’s place was great. She was so helpful and quick to respond to messages and made our trip so easy from check in to check out. The apartment was clean and as described. Thank you for allowing us to stay and have a wonderful weekend making memories for my daughter’s birthday.

The accommodation was clean and well looked after. The photos were exactly what it looked like, close to the shops and the bus terminal they got us to and from the airport. The view of Marvel Stadium was absolutely amazing. Was super quick to reply and helpful.
Would recommend.

Fantastic location to head to the city sights and get around Melbourne with Southern Cross at your door step. The place matched the photos and was super easy to find.
Whilst surfaces were clean, the place was in need of a deep clean (wipe down walls/ behind bedside tables etc.)
Had an enjoyable stay! I would definitely recommend to other guests looking for a central accommodation in Melbourne.

We had a great time staying here over the weekend! The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. Check-in was smooth and straightforward, which made arriving and settling in really easy.
David was very professional and helpful throughout our stay—quick to respond and always polite. You can tell he takes pride in making sure guests have a good experience. His communication was clear and timely, and he made sure we had everything we needed.
The location was convenient, and the space had all the basics covered, which made it a great base for exploring the area. We genuinely enjoyed our stay and wouldn’t hesitate to return in the future.
Highly recommend!

The stay at Juliet was beyond expectation. We stay in many places but this host was incredible with instructions and kindness. The little thing matter, like heaps of coffee and tea, milk in fridge, beautiful furniture, aqesome booklet with waht to see do and where to eat, comfortable bed and a truely amazing location. We will be back for sure. Highly highly recommended for a unique and memorable Melbourne rxperience.

One of my best AirBNB experiences to date. Sharon met up with me personally to walk me through everything during checkin and she even recommended a bunch of restaurants and bars for my partner and I. The location was walkable to almost everything good in the Melbourne CBD and the place looks like it was designed in Paris with slight Asian decor elements - it was a vibe. We will definitely be back - thanks again for everything Sharon!

Sharon’s place “Juliet” was all we wanted at the heart of Melbourne: a calm, squeaky clean, well furnished, private apartment. Sharon thought of absolutely everything for meals in (gorgeous crockery and more) and out (in-depth guide and lovely in person, tailored recommendations ), for laundry duties mid-trip and for a tranquility and confortable stay. It looks even better than the photos. We will be back for sure!

Sharon has a great host! Very responsive and communicative. Was open and able to offer early check in and late check out which came in handy having arrived at 9am. Sharon met us in the apartment and showed us around the lovely place, had some Tim Tams and even cooled bottles of water for the 35 degree day!
Apartment looks exactly like the pictures, beautiful and very comfortable. The apartment was clean and tidy and came with everything you need.
Location was excellent, great eateries, restaurants and bars right at the doorstep or within a short walk. Also short walk to the tram.
Can’t fault this place, definitely felt like a home away from home. Will stay here again next time we are in Melbourne!
Thanks Sharon for the wonderful hospitality!!

I and my family are having a good time at this house. The decoration is pretty, the house is so spacious and the location is convenient. We will recommend my friends to stay in your Airbnb. Thanks for the perfect house ❤️
It is a quite and nice place for a family to stay . A big TV and good location.

Had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location. The host was incredibly friendly and responsive, which made the whole experience even better. Would definitely stay here again!
Great place to stay, very close to lots of nice restaurants and public transport. Most places also easily walkable. Sharon was a great host, easy to communicate with and has lots of helpful advice!

We were very happy with the lane way apartment. It was easy to find, very secure and extremely clean, tidy and quiet. It had everything we needed and very cosy and comfortable. Thanks to Sharon our host. Can definitely recommend. Adriana and Mary.

I had such a great stay at this apartment. Everything was super clean, stylish, and really well thought out, you can tell a lot of love went into setting it up. I appreciated all the little touches around the place.
Shannon was such a lovely host, really kind, responsive, and genuinely cared that I felt comfortable. She checked in to see if I needed anything and gave me some amazing local tips that made my stay even better.
There was nothing missing, and I especially loved the welcome guide she put together. The location was also perfect. I could walk to everything I needed. I’d definitely love to come back!
The apartment is very well located. We felt right at home as the amenities are almost the same as what we have at home. The host was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommended.

Would definitely stay here again, super clean and welcoming space, had everything we needed so definitely worth the price, especially with the view you get and the access to the pool and gym area. Lulu was very responsive and friendly, no issues whatsoever. 😊
This apartment had an awesome view, was clean, quiet and comfortable- exactly what we needed for a quick work trip!

Great place for a stay in Melbourne! The apartment is clean,  cozy and quiet. The bed is super comfortable, kitchen well equipped. It is well located in west Melbourne enabling you to be quickly in CBD. The inside parking, pool and gym are amazing bonuses. Communication was Lulu and Collin was great and the check in / check out indications were super clear! Highly recommend.

Lulu and Colin place is as per description. All the amenities in good condition so its easy for us to do cooking and washing. There’s a dryer as well so it is easy to do laundry. Bed is comfy enough but the pillow is a bit too soft for me. We chose this place because it has a free parking which is a great plus. Need to read through the instructions and step by step in order to check in and finding the parking. Thanks to Colin as he is always responsive. All in all it is a great place to stay.
A great place with a nice view located within walking distance of Marvel stadium, Southern Cross station, many great restaurants etc. Would definitely stay here again.

Small, private and has basic amenities with the addition of air conditioning and use of the front garden.
Charlotte was very approachable and friendly and the property was easy enough to locate. You do need someone tall to get the key out of the lockbox though.
The location is in a quiet street with ample parking and there is a nice park with a lake, running track and playground nearby which we took our dog to.
Thank you for having us is Charlotte! I stayed for just over 2 weeks is with my pet and she was so very accommodating. So pleased I stayed with Charlotte, thank you again!
We had a great stay. Our dog loved the place as much as we did. Charlotte was a great host.
Good place to stay. Away from the street noise. Do agree that the place sure has a bit of a character. Very flexible and responsive host as well.

Charlottes place was a great base for us for our few weeks in Melbourne. The location is quiet and next to a nice park. We were also easily able to commute into the city in around an hour!
The apartment is spacious with everything you need and great value for money. Charlotte was a great host, always responsive and helpful when we needed assistance.

We appreciated the pet-friendly home away from home within proximity to the local reserve and off-lead dog park. Grateful for the washer/dryer after spending some time on the road. An older property space reimagined through modern interior design features.
What a great stay 😍 1000% recommend and will be coming back for sure! Perfect location. Cozy apartment! It had everything we needed, even more! Emma is a great host :)

The apartment was cosy and convenient in the middle of Melbourne. Next door to a supermarket and the South Melbourne market. Having the kitchen utensils etc meant I could find local produce and cook my own tasty dinners. Just remember to open the windows before you start!

My family and I had a great time at this location. The host was very helpful and flexible. The space was very clean, modern and nice aesthetically. It is a convenient location to restaurants and the mall. The train station is barely a five minute walk away. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Great place to stay. We enjoyed ourselves and found it convenient. There was a small issue with the 3hr parking at the Glen, but once you figure it out, it can be worked around or just ring the person through the boom gate. The apartment was great and the garden was a big bonus. A portable heater in the second bedroom would have been nice, but we're from Canberra so we're used to a bit of cold. Hosts were very accommodating and friendly. The video on how to get into the car park was very helpful. The dining space was a tad small, albeit we ate out a lot. It would be good to have a small foldable table and chairs. Overall we enjoyed our stay. Thank you.

Adji's place was the perfect choice for our 18-night stay. The spacious apartment comfortably accommodated our family of three, and the fast, reliable internet made working from home a breeze. The kitchen was well-equipped, the bathrooms were always clean, and the in-unit washer and dryer were a convenient addition.
The apartment complex offered excellent amenities, including a garden, playground, swimming pool, and the added convenience of being located above a shopping mall and numerous dining options. Adji and his team were incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay, making the check-in and check-out processes seamless.
Overall, Adji's Skygarden apartment provided a comfortable and convenient home away from home, making our transition to Australia a breeze.

Had an excellent stay at Shaun’s. The location was perfect and within the amenities of Kensington & Flemington. Shaun’s place was directly opposite the racecourse which would be perfect for the Melbourne Cup.
Shaun was also easy going and flexible with our needs. Communication was always great and fast. I would not hesitate to stay at his place again. Thank you so much for your hospitality Shaun!
We really enjoyed our stay at Shaun’s accommodation. The view is priceless and in a really good location. Great to have parking too! We had a really comfortable stay here.

really nice place, only thing is definitely needs a better couch its super cute but it's not great to hangout on or have a nap.
the bedroom has no ac only a small fan so it does get pretty warm. but overall it was a nice stay with fast wifi, amazing views and good location.

location was perfect for reason for travel,   great views,  parking options great,  possibly a photo of the car space would help the instructions provided.   Shaun was extremely good with communication and getting back when questions were asked.  Definitely will look to stay again.
It was a really enjoyable stay at Emma’s apartment, easy check-in and the place is at really convenient location, highly recommended.

We had a fantastic stay at Emma’s apartment! The location was perfect—right in the heart of everything, making it easy to explore. The apartment was spotless, well-maintained, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Emma was a wonderful host—friendly, responsive, and attentive, ensuring we had everything we needed. We truly enjoyed our time here and appreciate her hospitality. Highly recommend and would definitely stay again!

We had a fantastic stay at Sky Garden, Glen Waverley! The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was perfect, with easy access to shops, restaurants, and public transport, making our trip incredibly convenient.
A special thanks to Tony, who was an excellent host responsive, friendly, and thoughtful. He ensured we had everything we needed for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
We highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Melbourne and would love to stay here again on our next trip!

I had an incredible stay at the Nest apartment! The space was beautifully designed with a modern touch, yet had a cozy, homey vibe that made it hard to leave. The apartment was sparkling clean and equipped with everything we needed – from a fully stocked kitchen to thoughtful amenities like extra towels and toiletries.
The location was fantastic, right in the heart of the city, yet the apartment felt quiet and peaceful. I also appreciated the small touches, like the personalized welcome note and local recommendations provided by the host. The host was always quick to respond to any questions and went out of their way to ensure we had a comfortable stay.
I highly recommend the Nest apartment to anyone looking for a perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience.

great place to stay great location walk to southbank in just 10mins. place was big enough for 2 people no problems. clean tidy. would definitely stay again
the view was amazing

had an amazing time staying at David's Airbnb. The apartment was super cozy, clean and felt like home. Didnt want to leave to be honest.
David was super quick to respond to any questions I asked and was as helpful as needed.
The location is fantastic and is close to so much. only about a 20 minute walk into the CBD.
will definitely be going back again if possible when I visit Melbourne again!
Great apartment with awesome view. Big thank you to David for the washing soap provided in his apartment!
David communicates well and is very responsive. The apartment is a great place to stay with everything we needed, a short walk to the CBD, and amazing views. Thanks for hosting us.

Cozy and peaceful place. Charming neighbours, loved hearing them call for Maggie (their dog) in the mornings. Short walk to a great breakfast nook (Local Folk) and to lovely river parkway. Amy & Jea were proactive about checking in to make sure everything was all right. Felt like home for two months!
We had a nice stay. Some areas were impeccably clean but some were dustier than we would have hoped. Overall it is clear that a lot of care in taken by the hosts.
very nice little place, very clean and organised, had every amenity needed. overall very pleased with the place and host
Nice cozy place to stay. Garage was tad small for rental suv. Luckily outside have a lot of space to park.

Amy’s place was perfect for staying in Kensington, close to walks, shops and transport. It had a lot of nice touches and I really enjoyed using the rice cooker! Highly recommend staying at Amy’s place.

The place is absolutely dreamy and would say it’s a very safe building. It was very close to all the major cafes and restaurants as well. I would say that the instructions to the rubbish wasn’t super helpful, as the rubbish was deep within the garage facility. The bed was a little on the hard side so would say you’d need to be prepared for a harder bed. Additionally there is no dryer so you can easily go down to the laundromats near by and dry your clothes. Overall, really nice apartment and would definitely book again! They also presented chocolates and a sweet note on arrival.

We loved our break in Melbourne at Audrey and Willem's place, and would definitely stay here again. The apartment was very comfortable and we felt at home straight away. We were close to a tram stop, some great pubs and green spaces. Very relaxing, well appointed.

Great location, secure, clean and very comfortable. There were a few glitches with communication as there was no house manual, I had problems using the fob on doors/garage etc  and I find having to message a host for clarity and answers annoying but thats me! Otherwise the place was excellent and is cozy and warm in the afternoon with the sun and the heating works very well.

We were in town for 9 days work , perfect set up for 2 of us , great work space , lovely unit in a great location
Parking underground excellent
Will be back

This is a great spot for a working holiday. The apartment is just as described. It is very comfortable and the kitchen is well-equipped. The location is very convenient – close to shops, restaurants, the Brunswick Baths pools and a short tram ride into town.

We enjoyed the location of our apartment . The balcony was lovely facing the greenery across the road and the kitchen was a great size with lots of space to move around . We would thoroughly recommend this apartment for your stay .

Gorgeous space in the heart of Richmond.
I was particularly mesmerised by the bathroom and it’s stunning sky light.
Very comfortable and the parking permit was a nice touch 🩵

What a lovely space that has been created.
In a perfect location for exploring Richmond & beyond.
Cosy, stylish & comfortable we had a lovely time & would recommend to anyone.
It had everything we needed to relax & enjoy.
The bath was beautiful & the skylight in the bathroom was such a nice touch.
"We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The host was incredibly welcoming, the space was clean and cozy, and the location was perfect for exploring the city."

What can I say, this gorgeous Air BnB is truly unique & a total experience. If you’re looking for a stylish stay look no further.
Close to all amenities, beautifully styled & very peaceful. A total sanctuary in the city.
I would highly recommend this place to anyone needing a special escape!
Is a lovely and well furnished home, located in a quite street central to the city. Would highly recommend to any guest looking for accommodations.
Great stay in Richmond! Close to everything and the perfect location if you plan to go to the MCG. The property was described perfectly and was exactly as per the photos. Thanks for a great stay!
Stunning property, in a great location.  Perfect pied-à-terre for a short stay.  Thanks for hosting me!

Thank you for having us Adam!
The entire space felt like an art piece, cosy but not too small and immaculate. Perfect place to escape responsibilities for a night or two :)
Adam was a responsive and friendly host. The terrace was as described, clean, ornate and in a great location.

Having stayed in or around the Frankston area several times before we knew what we were looking for & this place fitted the bill perfectly. Very peaceful and spacious with comfy beds & we felt at home straight away. The added bonus of a garage was useful as we had loaned a car.
I had trouble with one of the blinds but Yanina was very responsive and helpful about it.
TV, dishwasher, washing machine & A/C all easy to use.
There’s a supermarket about a 20 minute walk or 3 minute drive so super handy.
We will certainly reach out to Yanina for our next trip to Oz.

wonderful place to stay, I can highly recommend and Inwoukd happily stay again or book for family and friends.
Yanina is a wonderful host who communicate well and was clear and detailed with any instructions.
the location was nice private and quiet neighbourhood.
it was so lovely for the yard to have real grass and some beautiful indoor plants. the back yard feel very homely with a beautiful passion fruit that goes all along the bavk fence table chair BBQ hammock fantastic to do morning or afternoon yoga
there where a lot of little things that had been thought about like the home being set up with kitchen items for Easter and western cooking, a mix of board games, cleaning and laundry items, extra blanks , pillows towels, there was a place for everything and everything in its place.
I really enjoyed my stay and look forward to staying again.
Thank you Yanina
Great tiny house to chill and relax. Perfect if you want to get out and just enjoy the serenity.

An absolutely beautiful place, definitely returning the next chance we get. The space was homey and well planned out, having everything we needed without feeling crowded at all. Clean bathroom, comfortable bedrooms. Hosts are very responsive and helpful, and extremely kind in person too. Place is on their property but you don’t feel intrusive, especially having your own area to park your car and so much land. Awesome views of kangaroos, chickens, birds, etc. And their honey is amazing!!!!!!
Amazing setting. Kangaroos everywhere. Clean and cosy with everything you need to enjoy the area. Thank you.

We had such a lovely stay at Duncan & Hana's property. The space was cosy, warm and over looked this beautiful lush bushland scenery. It was perfect for a bit of getaway staycation with my girlfriends.
There are plenty of Yara Valley wineries in close proximity. There are also some nice bushland walks nearby but unfortunately due to the wet weather we didn't get to explore too far.
Hana was so kind to light the outdoor fire for us on the second night. We really enjoyed sitting by the fire, sipping wine and chatting away. A beautiful end to our 2 night stay. Hana also gave us some fresh eggs for our breakfast which was so nice!
We would 100% recommend this spot for anyone looking for a quick getaway from Melbourne without needing to drive too far. I think I would love to come back here also.
Great tranquil location. Nice to relax on the balcony with drinks and take in the views or use the BBQ. Nice to also use the fire pit and toast some marshmallows.

Duncan and Hana continue to be outstanding hosts. This is my second stay with them and they always maintain an exceptional level of communication, presentation and comfortability for all guests. Thank you Duncan and Hana!
Great place, perfect for a family or large group. Steps from the beach. Couldn’t ask for more. Thank you!

I stayed with my mum and 2 daughters for 2 nights and we all loved the accommodation!
To start the hosts communication was fast, friendly and very accommodating!
The unit was exactly as described, plus very clean and the location AMAZING!
It is so close to all the action that you want to go to, yet once back in the room it is so quiet and relaxing with all the great facilities included.
We would highly recommend this accommodation!! And hopefully get to come back soon!
We had a great time in this apartment. It's the perfect location and the host is very accomodating. I highly recommend staying here.

We had a fantastic stay a wonderful stay. We are family of 4 (2 adults and 2 kids) and  the apartment is well equiped and comfortable, amenities were great, we enjoyed being able to relax in the pool/spa area after a long day overlooking the city skyline. Location was fantastic with Melbourne CBD at your doorstep, lots of good restaurants and attractions within walking distance and access to public transport. The host was very friendly and responsive, with an easy check in and check out process. Would recommend.

My husband and I came and celebrated our 10 year wedding anniversary at this property and it was incredible. The location was amazing, but more so our amazing Host Philip could not be more accommodating and responsive.
We will 100% be back to this location and other properties he has listed. An amazing time

Good location. Host responsive and flexible with check in/out where possible.
Very nice facilities in building - pool, spa, sauna, steam room.

Great location to Southbank, CBD & Convention Centre. Apartment was as described, clean, spacious and had everything we needed. Philip was a great host, meeting us in the early morning due to our flight arrival, with no issues. Would definitely recommend staying here. Thank you
Brilliant location and the perfect sized space for four. We loved our stay here, Phillip was a fantastic host and responded quickly to all messages. Thank you

Responsive host
Great location next to crown, near city, and supermarket
Excellent flat for small family
Magical,  romantic location with spacious rooms. Beautifully appointed and had everything you could need.

I stayed here for 9 nights for a work trip and it was exactly what I needed. Had a kitchen with enough basics to cook. Bed was extremely comfortable and the place had everything I needed. Angela was a great host and very flexible throughout my stay. Very homely air bnb.

Absolutely love this place and the amazing view. It was nice having a good balcony to relax and watch the sunrise on mornings. The great views extend to the bedroom as well. I got great workouts at the gym and was close to restaurants and the bus to and from the airport. Convenient location with the amenities. I washed my clothes and dried them prior to departure! Don’t put too many clothes to dry at once or else you will have to run it again for an additional hour. I would definitely stay here again!

Sparsely furnished with cheap basics. Huge heavy main bed. No space to move around . We stubbed our shins and toes several times!
Mismatched Crockery was mostly cracked and well worn. Eg only 3 mugs of which 2 were cracked. No juice glasses or tumblers. It reminded us of Backpacker hostels.
I washed 2 entire pillows (took 3 days to dry out) and pillow protectors.
The host was really great, and I had a fantastic time in Melbourne. The room was spotless and super cozy. I hope to come back one day.

The hosts were friendly upon arrival. Very responsive. Place was very clean. Good location, walkable to everything. Only downfall was wifi was slow/not great.
I would recommend this stay.

The apartment is as pictured and described . Key collection was easy. Very convenient to Southern Cross Station and everything around this part of Melbourne. Free tram makes all the CBD accessible if you don't want to walk it !  Enjoyed the pool, gym and sauna. Great for a weekend getaway.
It’s very tidy and ideal location and the room has everything you need. Would definitely come back if it’s available.

The host Grayce was very responsive and reached out to make sure we had everything we needed. The location was quiet and convenient as public transport was a 5 minute walk away. Nearby is also a 7-11, which means you can easily top up on anything you need without having to travel far. Overall a great stay and I have no complaints.

It was terrific to find such a well appointed, private airbnb so close to the city. Everything needed for a comfortable stay is supplied, and Grayce was a gracious host.
Just some of the features that come to mind: super easy checkin, private, quiet, brilliant location, private outdoor area, private bathroom, able to self-cater, cosy heater with comfy carpet, comfy bed, indoor footwear supplied.... I could go on.
Big ✅✅
Very happy. Would stay again.

My wife and I stayed in Grayce's airbnb for 4d/3n. I must say that I love how walkable it is in 7 eleven and in the free trams. Its just a few stops away for the tourist spots.  Thanks for the extra hand and request gracey. Will definitely stay again.
The landlord is very communicative and can help solve any problems. The room was very clean and there was no noise when sleeping at night. It was a great experience for traveling!

A great host, and frequently kept the place clean and respectful for everyone staying.
Thank you for letting me stay!

I had a great stay at Cozy Nest Getaway’s.
The place was exactly as described, very clean and cosy and great location near Flinders station and southern cross. Skye was very friendly and gave me great local recommendations :)
Great comfortable stay and hosts accommodated every need and more. One of those stays that goes out of their way to  provide extra for their guests

I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others as Skye and Melody were lovely hosts. They always clean and maintain their place in the best condition. They also helped me whenever I needed something. Their place was close to everything in the CBD and very close to the free trams. Thanks Skye and Melody for a lovely stay ☺️

Comfy well located place in the heart of South Melbourne. Close to the market and tram.
House was as described, a little on the cool side, no heating in the bedrooms, but it has been unseasonably cold in Melbourne, and the bedding was cosy and warm.
Jo’s place was so lovely, warm and welcoming! If you plan to stay a while in Melbourne I suggest this place 100% great space, great amenities and close to everything you need!

It's very good to experience the traditional structure of the Australian houses in the city center.
This property is very close to the sourth Melbourne market and we love the market so much and definitely recommend to everyone. The location is also very convenient to access the supermarket and just 10-15mins to the city center by uber.
One more thing will be perfect that is the laundry. If we could finish the laundry at home that would be more convenient.

A very nice apartment with everything clean and working.
Car parking was a problem and there was no washing machine.

Emerald Hill Cottage is excellent pet friendly accommodation if looking to stay close to Melbourne CBD.
Jo provided everything needed to make our stay comfortable.
My wife and I were particularly impressed by how clean and relaxing the accommodation is presented.
Excellently located within walking distance to the South Melbourne Markets (less than 5 minute walk) along with many cafes, and we also managed a walk to Southbank.
Jo has made Emerald Hill Cottage an attractive and homely place to stay, and we would highly recommend if looking for pet friendly accommodation.
Alan & Sue
Felt right at Home at Jo's place in Cosy Emerald Cottage. Great location. Beautiful old Victorian cottage and Jo was an incredibly welcoming and helpful host. I recommend staying with Jo. Thank you.

Great location , such a cute little cottage and the fact I could have my 13 year golden retriever with me was delightful.
Lovely and clean will definitely recommend. Thanks Jo

Jo's accommodation was just as described. Very stylish with comfy beds, (hard to get out of - longer sleeps called), a lounge and a chair. A beautiful tasteful renovation. Lots of natural light which is a real asset.
The kitchen was a dream to cook our meals in, with ingredients from the South Melbourne Market (a few minutes away). Lighting the oven required a phone call to Jo, who quickly advised us what to do. Thanks Jo. Great having a dining table and lovely cutlery and crockery, plus a desk in the main bedroom was very handy.

Even on a busy road, the traffic did not bother us. Parking restrictions were tricky, but we found longer parking not too far away. Public transport was nearby, with Jo's helpful advice, we had no trouble in a new district to us. Next time we will most likely leave our car at home in Central Victoria and travel by public transport.

Friend and I had a lovely easy stay at the Jo's place. Cute and cosy with really comfortable bed and quality linen. Check-in and communications was simple. Appreciated the easy walking distance to different areas. Thank you!
We found the place comfortable except for the bathroom shower difficult to access. Limited light in the bathroom broken light fitting.

Loved Jo’s place! She was friendly, and proactive, without being overbearing. The space was clean and well maintained. The heaters in the bedrooms were also much appreciated. Easy check-in, easy stay.
I enjoyed my overnight stay at Jo’s place. Close to everything, very clean and comfortable. Would definitely recommend and stay again. Only issue, parking was a little tricky.

My husband and I stayed in Amanda’s beautiful apartment for four nights. Amanda was a brilliant host and right from our first contact she was responsive and helpful and really easy to deal with.
The apartment has been refurbished to an exceptional standard and beautifully designed and dressed to feel authentic yet highly contemporary. The apartment had everything we needed for our stay with everything considered.
We loved our stay and the location was perfect. Very quiet and peaceful yet on the doorstep of Gertrude Street, Brunswick Street and Smith Street as well as walking distance to the CBD.
I’d highly recommend the apartment and will definitely stay again next time I visit Melbourne.
Great location close to bars and restaurants and not far from city centre. Accommodation was renovated very nicely with quality fixtures and it was very homey for a couple. Really enjoyed our stay

Perfect Rendezvous !
Great place to meet up with friends for a night out in the city whether it be for dinner in one of Melbourne's finest restaurants, a special event or a theatre show.
You can leave your car at home coz this apartment is right in front of Flinders Street Station.
Crown Casino and Entertainment Centre is within walking distance. Federation Square and the famous Yarra River is also a stone's throw away.
So many choices of restaurants all within walking distance but if you are not into walking, the free trams are just at your doorsteps.
Rusty and Rove are great hosts and have paid attention to every detail. They surely know what guests needs.
Will definitely stay again

Beautiful and comfortable place. The property was well-maintained and beautifully designed, creating a welcoming atmosphere from the moment we arrived. The room was spacious, clean, and equipped with all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay.
Rusty and Rove were exceptionally friendly and attentive, always ready to assist with any requests or recommendations. The location was superb, offering easy access to local attractions and conveniences.
Overall, our stay was memorable, and I would highly recommend to anyone looking for quality accommodation in Melbourne CBD. I look forward to returning in the future!

•Central location with everything at your doorstep. Grocery, restaurants, and even Maccas just steps away.
•The apartment matched the online description, offering a stunning view of Flinders Street Station and a cozy living space with aircon/heater.
• Hosts were welcoming. Can hear some city sounds, but it didn’t bother us. Parking isn't in the building, but nearby options are available. Highly recommend!

We recently enjoyed a two-night stay over New Year’s Eve at “2BR Large Balcony facing Flinders Street Station” property, and it exceeded our expectations. The apartment was immaculate, well-appointed, and provided a comfortable retreat amidst the holiday festivities. Its prime location directly opposite Flinders Street Station made exploring Melbourne incredibly convenient, with numerous attractions, dining options, and cultural sites within easy walking distance.
A standout feature was the thoughtful welcome package awaiting us—complimentary wine and a selection of nibbles—which added a special touch to our celebration. The host’s attention to detail and commitment to guest satisfaction were evident throughout our stay.
We highly recommend the “2BR Large Balcony facing Flinders Street Station” property to anyone seeking a central and hospitable place to stay in Melbourne. We look forward to returning in the future.

The stable is a new and a fantastic air b n b. Amanda has created a beautifully presented place to stay. It feels very comfortable and the attention to detail makes it stand out amongst a lot of air b n b’s that we have stayed in. The amenities are new, spotless and it’s incredibly well equipped. The stable feels very homely and we were immediately comfortable.
Fitzroy is an amazing place to stay, absolutely full of amazing food and drink spots, which it would take me an age to list. Discover these for yourself but honestly we found it hard to even leave East Melbourne.
Finally Amanda is a lovely host so communicative friendly and helpful! Absolutely how air b n b should be done and made our stay so easy. We’ll be back for sure!

This is such a beautifully renovated property one of the best I’ve stayed in. The attention to detail is outstanding it’s welcoming and cosy with everything you need to have a super comfortable stay. Amanda was a great host providing lots of information about the local area to help decide where to go and what to do close by.  Can’t recommend this enough to those looking for a short or long term getaway it’s definitely value for money. I can’t wait to stay again.

Lovely accomodation and a  nice size. Fully equipped with quality appliances and very clean. Loved, the Jasmine fragrance next to outside seating space and the roll top bath after a long day's walking in Melbourne. Comfortable and quiet in fabulous Fitzroy, full of shops, bars and restaurants. Amanda welcomed us with a few essentials and treats. Perfect stay!

You are lucky, if you get the chance to stay at this beautiful AirBnB.
Loving host, warm and detailed place with high quality appliances and all the amenities you need. On top, you are in a calm side street of one of the best areas of Melbourne. Absolute gem.
Phenomenal hospitality and excellent location for those wishing to be in the heart of the city action. Light sleepers will definitely want to use the provided ear plugs though 🙂.
We throughly enjoyed our stay at Amanda’s. Everything worked, it was  very private, all amenities provided, towels and linen brilliant and Amanda an excellent host
Had a great stay at the stable for a week.  Amanda's hospitality and details made it great. Clean & comfortable. Nice spot to work from, cook a meal or relax for a movie. Would be happy to stay again

The stable has been thoughtfully  renovated & beautifully decorated. The neighborhood was perfect with plenty of amazing places to eat close by and it’s very handy to the city. We loved the Aesop toiletries, magnificent bath & gorgeous kitchen!

The location is quiet, private and a short walk from everything I love in Melbourne. The place is the perfect blend of cozy (but not in a small way), functional and charming with beautiful, thoughtfully designed materials, joinery, artwork, books and tasty treats. The bath in the loft is such a luxury and we loved all the copper fittings. The whole experience as 10/10 for us. Thank you soo much!

Staying at Amanda’s place was heavenly! Such a great location close to Gertrude st shops, cafes, restaurants, and a half hour walk to the NGV! The space is as beautiful as the photos are, lots of natural light, lovely linen, and art work. I loved the interior lighting too, cosy and warm. The bathtub was perfect after big days … I hope I get to stay again as I’ve told so many people to book!
Amanda was lovely to communicate with too.

Beautiful apartment with everything you need for your stay. Amazing views!
Close to trains, trams and shops, great location to get around the city.
Hosts were great to deal with and very responsive with our questions.
Loved our stay and would come back again.

We had a beautiful stay within Rita’s place. Location was perfect, super close to the supermarket, walking distance to majority of attractions. Rita had amazing communication, answering every question within a good time period.
Had a fantastic stay! The property was clean, well-equipped, and in a great location. The host was responsive and made everything easy. Highly recommend
Excellent communication, very accomodating, even let us check in early for convenience. Pengkim was friendly and helpful when we arrived. Apartment very clean and had everything we needed.

My family and I loved our time at Nancy’s apartment, the views of Melbourne were spectacular. The apartment was as described, clean and I enjoyed the complimentary sparkling water. Would definitely recommend it.
We loved our long weekend in Melbourne. This apartment was in the perfect location,  it had a superb view, great amenities and we would definitely stay here again.

The place was so beautiful to stay in. We had a little trouble with the TV not working
But the host was so kind a quick to help us. This place is so close to everything too!
We had a fantastic stay at Joanna’s lovely apartment. It was close to the action of the city, but quiet. Good communication when I couldn’t figure out how to open the sofa bed! A great place to stay.
Joanna is such an amazing, helpful host! High recommend staying here, it was such a convenient location with everything in walking distance!

I had a great stay at Alex's place!  it was clean,  tidy and met my expectations accurately.   The location was perfect for attending a conference in the same area and communication with Alex was great throughout my stay.

Hosts were friendly, easy check in and check out. The location was great and the views were beautiful. Apartment was clean and tidy, and had everything we needed. Walkable distance from the city centre and train station. I would recommend this place.

Stayed with my girlfriend for just under a week.
We chose to stay here as we’d stayed in the complex before and knew the area
Hosts were very responsive and apologetic when necessary.
Location is perfect, early access to the city via a tram, close to river with restaurants, close to a Woolworths as well as a nice view of the city.
Heating was amazing, didn’t quite reach the bedroom fully but you could tell it was on.
Facilities were perfect, lots of things to cook with!
Only thing we would have loved was a rug for the bed/couch at night time, otherwise everything was fab.
Would recommend this place!
Great location. Easy access. Clean and tidy with all the essentials for a city stay! Thanks Alex

It was a nice apartment in a good location that was near restaurants and a shopping centre. The only thing I’d say is it did have a bit of wear and tear that could’ve been to attended to more (the blinds, the walls, balcony floors ect) 😊

Nice stay in Southbank that is very close to the Melbourne Exhibition Centre and Crown. Highly recommend a stay here if you’re planning a trip into Melbourne and are looking at attending an event at one of these venues! Hosts were great and place was super neat and cozy!
In a pretty good area, very close to tram stop, good view of the city. Easy to check in and out. Was a good stay!

Rate was near to $246 / nite.
Probably expected more “tech”such as Smart TV & internet.

The property face is maintained for good reason and in keeping with historical buildings. The inside I fabulous. A cnsistent look and feel from a recent major renovation.
location to Lygon Street, Carlton, Collingwood and transport is great. close enough to walk, far enough for quiet.
Why book 4 hotel rooms when you can book this great place for less and have all the benefits of shared spaces and services.
Thanks Aaron and Young.

Aaron's apartment was in a fabulous location.  An easy 4 min walk to Lygon St with all the best restaurants and shopping. Aaron was a great host who was so quick to respond to any queries that I had. Would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone.
A really beautiful and cosy place to stay! And I will definitely book it again, but maybe during a less windy period.

The house was in a fantastic location and was in close proximity to public transport. The house was very clean, tidy and well equipped.
From the front the place looks tiny but it had plenty of space, with 4 bedrooms and indoor/outdoor living spaces.

This stay was exactly what we needed for a weekend getaway. The pictures don’t do the property justice - we were absolutely blown away by how gorgeous it was. Eliza was also a great host - she had left us some complimentary cupcakes and champagne as well. The game room was one of the best highlights for us as well! Definitely worth the money and will look forward to return someday.

Yarradene is an amazing luxury house, in a quiet location with amazing natural surroundings. The house itself is beautiful and well equipped, we could not ask for anything more. Shane is a super host who is responsive, helpful and has lots of great recommendations! Would love to come back again next time we are in Healesville!

The property is simply breathtaking! We stayed here for our wedding weekend and had everything we needed, it was peaceful and watching the sunset from the hill is incredible. Highly recommend the property for a bridal party or a simple get away with friends and/or family

Place is a good size, location and good value for money. Had comfortable beds, nice linen and choice of pillows. Unfortunately it had an odour of dog, they did note it was pet friendly so maybe should be expected, but we did need to leave the balcony door open when in lounge. We had trouble finding it as unit # not part of address, only found when looking up 'how to get there. Easy and polite to communicate with though.
Internet was not strong.  Problems streaming 9now so we missed watching the Olympics. Don’t understand why there is no free to air channels.

Thanks Luke for a great 3 night stay. So close to everything and around the corner from my sons place. Loved that you had a little shaver kit in the bathroom. Beds super comfy, great pillows. Amazing view to the city from
Laying in bed with the curtains up of a morning. Super comfy unit with everything we needed. Loved the park next door and how handy was for trains and trams. Sorry I didn’t put the glasses back where they were, I couldn’t reach the shelf😁

Me and my friend stayed for two nights at Luke’s place with my dog. Place was so clean and spacious. Nice cafes and restaurants are near by, easy to catch tram and cute little park to take dog for a quick walk.
I would definitely recommend this place:)
Thank you.
Luke’s home was exactly what we were after. Close to family, clean and well worth the money. Thank you for an enjoyable stay.

This accomodation was perfect for us: comfortable and right on the doorstep of Sydney Rd, so exploring cafes, bars, restaurants and shops was very easy. Nice little neighbourhood park next door. Luke was an awesome host. Offered fantastic local recommendations upon request, sorted a Myki card for us to use whilst there for public transport which was very generous, and accommodated a request for a late checkout. Super easy and friendly to deal with, couldn’t recommend more.

We had such a great stay at Luke’s! The location was amazing and the place was really great, super clean and comfortable. Luke was very responsive to everything we needed and let us check in early. Would not hesitate to stay here again!

The apartment was great - it had everything we needed. Awesome location overlooking a park, with lots of food options nearby. The bedrooms were bigger than they looked on the photos. Note that there are 3 flights of stairs to get to the apartment, but once there, getting in was super easy. Thanks Luke for a lovely stay!

The house was very conveniently located for us (no killer Warburton hills!) and was very clean. Yarra Valley Rentals were very responsive during our stay bringing extra linen and tea towels when requested. They also called us to let us know we'd forgotten something - great service. It does have a bit of a corporate airbnb feel, so if you're looking for a cute and charming place with character this is not it. But it was very comfortable, clean and convenient. Worth noting that the kitchen supplies are fairly basic (no large bowls, platters, coffee plunger etc) so if you're planning to cook much it's possibly worth bringing a few things like that. It is right on the main road so can be a bit noisy on the outdoor deck if you're sensitive to that kind of thing.

Great location, close to shops, cafes and restaurants. Close to transport and venues.
Older building but well presented with security gate and front door lock.
Maree was very helpful and responsive to my questions.

Katie was a fabulous host who went above and beyond for me and my two sons. Her penthouse is one of the nicest I have stayed at and made us feel like we were at home (besides that incredible view)
We will be back on the regular (availability depending)

Amazing view and Katie was a great host.
Very accurate description of the apartment.
Will be back.

Stunning location and the view is breathtaking and very relaxing. The location made it easy to access all the city restaurants and transport is within easy walking distance if you wanted a quiet night in and cook at home. Katie was very responsive if we had any questions which helped make it a such a stress free week. We really enjoyed our time at the apartment and can’t wait to visit again.

Katie’s apartment is amazing, with 270 degrees panoramic view of Melbourne, and living on 76th floor truly makes you feel like you are at the top of the world. The apartment is walking distance to crown and flinders station! We will definitely be back!

The views from the apartment are amazing.
Easy walking distance to the convention centre and all that Southbank has to offer.
Would definitely stay here again when in Melbourne.

The apartment is what you see and get. Fabulous views and easy walking to restaurants and cafe's. The kitchen wasn't as well stocked with utensils for a party of five people and our fridge ice maker failed. Also we understand a complex like this has a focus on safety and why an induction was necessary.... but only two evenings in the week to do this?  when you are most likely to be out and about enjoying Melbourne, definitely disappointing. Suggest to enjoy the facilities that we didn't, pool, movie theater etc, make sure you book to allow for the one hour induction and the two available days of the week they happen. Otherwise you will be pleasantly surprised with the location and views.

Lovely little space walking distance from St Kilda centre and directly next to tram and bus links. Property was very clean and provided all the amenities we needed for a relaxing and comfortable stay in St Kilda! Would recommend
Cute little flat in an easy-to-navigate area of St Kilda. Easily sleeps 2 people; the sofa bed is comfy. Was so lovely to bring my dog, he loved Melbourne!
Our first time at Australia, picked this apt through airbnb. It’s worth it. Kate is very responsive when we need her

A quiet little place but still so close to the hustle and bustle of St Kilda. Was a good base for our two night stay. The shower had amazing water pressure and we found both beds pretty comfy.
Do be aware if you're using the sofa bed in the lounge though that the blinds in that room don't block out much light at all so you will need an eye mask if you want to sleep past 6am during daylight savings.

We loved staying at Kate's place in vibey St Kilda - very central location. Bedding and beds were great, even the pull-out couch. With the air conditioning it was a cool, bright and light haven in the midst of a heatwave.

Kate Apartmetn description and pictures were all accurate We booked late during the busier school holiday period as we decided to detour on the way to the snow.   Four of us in total , If we were going g to stay longer we may have opted for a non sofa bed stay , But the size and configuration suited us perfectly at this trip. We did not feel crowded at all, using the sofa  bed in the living room / kitchen area

It's the second time we have stayed in one of Nick's apartments and it was as good as always.
Communication was excellent and the place was immaculate.
I highly recommend Nick's places.
We really enjoyed our stay and thank you to Marc and MJ for all their help. We would definitely stay again.
Plenty of space for us to spread out, well appointed and comfortable beds. In a quiet street and yet very close walk to supermarket, cafes and public transport. We will definitely stay here again.

So close to the Hawthorn Tram and Train Stop [Burwood/Hawthorn] made getting downtown easy.  House had a marvellous art deco/Victorian charm from the exterior features,  to the interior finishes.  Really loved the covered parking!  Security system helped with peace of mind, but the neighbourhood felt safe and friendly.   Barton Mllk Bar down the street is marvelous!    Thanks Marc and MJ!

It was a great home base for us. We wanted a place near to city yet able to experience a quieter residential area. The house was very well set and had everything we need.
While we didn't meet Marc or MJ, it was clear they are excellent and responsive host and fielded our queries without delay. Thank you for having us!

With 4 adults and one baby Marc and MJ's house was perfect for us.  Very well equipped with a cot, highchair, changing mat, full kitchen etc.  Super comfortable, very warm, clean, we felt right at home with all of the books and art.  Very handy to both the tram and the train and plenty of options at the local shops.  Marc and MJ were very responsive.  Highly recommend.

Thank you Zippi for being an amazing host. Highly recommended.They are very flexible and try to make us feel at home. Zippi helped me even with my sightseeing plans. The best I have ever stayed in Australia ❤️

They truly exceeded my expectations! The rooms are spotless and Aesthetically maintained, making every dollar spent well worth it. Stay was good and clean.

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment! The place was exactly as described—clean, stylish, and well-equipped with everything I needed.
Clean and nice, forgot my shampoo and conditioner and their they supply was very nice and smelled good, do recommend and front desk staff is very friendly and welcoming

Thanks Sanjay for having my family and I. Was a pleasant stay and definitely was a home away from home. Thanks for communicating the parking expectations before accepting my booking. Would love to stay here again.

Charlotte & Rowena are great host!
Very responsive since our booking stage and caring. Follow up thoroughly prior check-in, stay through and even after my family check out.

This is a truly exceptionable Airbnb. It has been artfully decorated and has every (high-quality) appliance you could possibly need. The location is incredibly central. Giang is a very responsive and helpful host. Staying here made our trip a joy. We look forward to returning. Thank you.

This is one of the finest Airbnb’s I’ve had the pleasure of staying. Check in and check out was seamless, great host, and top notch place with everything you need for a short or extended stay. Thanks Giang for providing such an incredible Airbnb experience!

This was the second time we stayed at Giang’s place in Melbourne, and it was worth returning.
Close to restaurants for when you want to relax, and has everything you need for basic food prep.
A great place to stay.

Giang’s place truly encompasses the French vibe and it is so adorable. A very responsive host and helped me when there was anything that came up. I loved the location because everything in the CBD was walking distance. I would highly recommend this place!

Gian’s property would have to be one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed at in Melbourne. Exquisite apartment with everything you need for a very comfortable stay with top of the range appliances and superb fit out. Great location with Flinders Lane eateries and entertainment venues at your door step with Flinders Street Station a few hundred metres away for Tram & Train transport.
Contact and response was second to none, and the Car Lift reminded me so much of Europe where they are very common!!
I can so highly recommend this property for that SPECIAL stay with your loved one.
Thank you Gian for making my girlfriend’s birthday weekend an amazing one. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Fantastic spot and beautiful accommodation - and much larger than it looks online.  Also do make use of the car park - it is very easy to access and secure.

A perfect spot for a few days in Melbourne! The apartment decor is gorgeous! Felt like we were in Paris.
Would definitely like to stay there again.
What a beautiful place right in the city. We had a wonderful time. Everything was perfect. We will come back. Thank you

Great location (very central) and it’s a bit off the main streets, so noise wasn’t much of an issue. Great apartment in the heart of the CBD. Easy walking distance to theatres, attractions, shops etc. and within the free tram zone. Very convenient location with a Woolworths, food court + more just seconds away. Check in and check out was seamless. Would definitely book again!

Beautiful apartment with great views. Fantastic communication and easy instructions to check in and out.
Look forward to staying again!

We had a great time staying at Donna’s! The apartment is super close to a supermarket and train station. Donna was very friendly, even kindly allowing us to extend our checkout time. The place looks just like the photos too.
For any future guests, you will need to bring all your own food for health/safety reasons. Thank you Donna!
I’ve had an amazing stay! Location cannot be better! Place is very clean, very spacious. Host is easy to talk to. Instructions are simple and clear. Would definitely come back.

The listing was wonderful. Everything was a pretty short walk away with great scenery as you walk into the CBD. Everything was clean and tidy when we arrived. Would definitely try to get this place again when i visit Melbourne in the future
The place looked exactly like the photos. Beautiful view from the windows with lots of stores and restaurants nearby. Spencer’s Outlet and huge Coles store right across the street!

Great location as initially was hesitant to stay so central. Now really happy we did. Easy to find things close by and getting further out because of the tram. Comfy bed, bathroom essentials provided so didn’t need to pack any. Had a cosy feel to it and everything we needed :)

Alice’s property is good value for money - it’s not fancy, the bed and furniture isn’t super comfy, but the apartment is clean, has all the amenities you need and is in a fantastic location - super convenient for travel around and out of Melbourne. A good solid place to stay.

Location was great! Super convenient and walkable to everything we needed. The unit is located in a high rise with a secured entrance so we felt safe and were away from most of the noise of the city. We really appreciated the in unit washer.

Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!”
Very convenient place and everything was as described. Host was really friendly and communication was fantastic. Would 100% recommend to anyone.

Sam is good and very responsive host,  he reply my message only within minutes, i got an early check in and late check out without any extras fee, The place is clean and just across the southern cross,  there”s so many restaurant downstair near the apartemen. Sam”s place is a top notch ❤️

Great location in the heart of Melbourne :)
We stay only for a night. Sam the host was very responsive and helpful. I would say some amenities could be add to the place maybe nice shampoo/ bossy wash and a coffee machine would make the place feel a bit better. :)

Amazing place to stay. Very clean, plenty of room. Great hosts, very responsive and nothing was too difficult for them.
10/10 would recommend to everyone.

I had a fantastic stay! The place was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything super easy from check-in to check-out. I really
appreciated the thoughtful touches and attention to detail. Highly recommend this listing and would definitely stay again. Thanks for a great experience!

Really enjoyed our stay here! The place is neat, cozy, and super convenient—Southern Cross Station is just around the corner, so getting to and from the airport was stress-free. Lots of food nearby, and Higher Ground café is just a short walk. Check-in was straightforward and easy.

The experience was very well-organized, with an excellent check-in process. The space was impeccably clean and featured high-quality appliances. The host was exceptional—very responsive and accommodating. The location was fantastic, with easy access to public transportation and a wide range of dining options nearby. The parking was also a great convenience. I highly recommend this place!

Bedspoke's description of the property was accurate. It was uncluttered and simple.

I like the area, though I'd never stayed there before. We were very close to about 30 restaurants and a Woolworths and Aldi.
The amenities in the apartment with very clean and easy to work.
Communication with the owner was excellent and timely.

Beautiful place to stay, with a very easy going, responsive host. Great location with many restaurants, bars, and pubs within walking distance. Also very easy to get public transport into the city. Definitely recommend.

Thank you Pemmy for sharing your beautiful terrace house with us.
We had a great time and loved the bespoke nature of your property.
The locationis second to none. We loved being able to walk downstairs to an amazing bakery. Cafe Jabelle would be close the best meal we have had in Melbourne which is in front of this propert and you are within walking distance to Lygon St.
The property has everything you need or could want and has been meticulously updated and styled.
The space feels luxurious and opulent with an abundant of natural light with modern kitchen and bathrooms. We really enjoyed the eat in kitchen and built in seating. The highchair was very useful and was like brand new.
