Chic balcony studio near beach is place to be. Absolutely recommend.
We had a great stay! Thanks legend.
Had a lovely few days at Shane & Nuan’s place. Conveniently located close to the beach and shops around Seaford. They were very accommodating and communication was a breeze.

Shane and Nuan's place was fantastic - great location within a short walk of the beach and short drive of most spots we were keen to visit. It was clean and well equipped. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Shane was very quick and kind to communicate with. Great location and even better studio room to stay. My partner and I were very happy and grateful for having us, and enjoyed our stay. Felt right at home and comfortable, safe and would definitely stay again. Beautiful place and was amazed upon arrival of how tidy and clean. Very well worth it
Excellent host. We have stayed at Shane & Nuan's place before and everytime we arrive, it's clean, cosy and the host go above and beyond. Thank you guys for welcoming us into your home!

Shane was a great host. Great utilities and felt very private, accessible from the side on the house. Shane was always accomodating and explained everything very well!
Very much enjoyed my stay!
Great cozy place to stay. East walk or drive to the local beach and shops. While I didn’t get to meet Shane & Nuan, they were great in giving us detailed instructions for check in and out.

Nice cozy little place for a couple. Shane and Nuan were very friendly and gave us great recommendations on what to do around there too. The place was well maintained and clean, they provided all the essentials and more.
Highly recommended to stay at Shane and Nuan’s for a quiet, relaxing get away. Absolutely loved the little balcony.! Thanks Shane and Nuan, will definitely visit again.
A perfect place to stay. Great location with a nice walk to the local restaurants. would stay here again next time I am in town.

This was my second time staying at Shane and Nuan’s place. It’s comfortable, clean, has everything I need and the space has a really nice feel. They’re also really welcoming. Thanks for having me again!

My husband and I were looking for an accommodation for a couple night getaway with beach access.  This ticked the box perfectly.  The location was fantastic with easy walking access to the beach, Woolies and places to eat. Very nice walking trail nearby and public transport if needed.  Had everything we needed and friendly and responsive host.

Very clean and tidy and small inside.
Woolworths, McDonalds and Liquor store close & convenient.
Garden at entrance very untidy.

Car parked in driveway undercover was inconvenient for guests.

We spent 3 nights in this lovely comfortable and perfectly located house. It was everything we expected and more. Will definitely recommend it to anyone we know who is visiting Melbourne.

Katrina was friendly, efficient and helpful with communication and meeting our needs. The home was clean, convenient and comfortable. Everything we needed. Loved the location and we had sown derail time exploring the local area. Arcadia cafe became a staple for breakfast with the welcoming Daniel. Close to the city, Spring Street and the artist driven Rose Markets off Napier street onSaturdays. Love it all. Another great experience with AirB&B for me.

We had a lovely stay at Fitzgeorge.  Check in was smooth and very easy and Katrina touched based with us to make sure we checked in and that everything was ok on arrival.  Fitzroy is a great area to stay as it is less than a 25min walk into the CBD (and Rod Laver arena!) and lots of great restaurants and shops to keep you busy just within walking distance of the Fitzgeorge laneway.  Thanks for a great stay.

Appartment comfortable and clean.
Disappointed that single bed in same bedroom as double,hadn't realized that this was how house set up.
Katrina’s house is stylish and warm. It is very clean and is comfortable staying in her place.
Katrina’s place was perfect in every way. The accommodation met all my expectations plus it was close to a wonderful breakfast and lunch spot.  I could not have asked for more!

Fitzgeorge is a wonderful property, cleverly designed, creatively furnished and delightful to stay in. We loved the location, in the heart of fabulous, fashionable Fitzroy, while being close enough to the city to be able to walk, though it’s well served by tram too. We found the garden dining space to be a great resource. It reminded us too of how quiet and private the space is. A wonderful house that we loved and enjoyed enormously. We’d be back like a shot!
This is very well appointed and cosy place. The host went to a lot of effort to make this stay perfect.

From the moment of first contact, Katrina was an easy, kind and clear person to deal with. She responded quickly and was able to adapt to my needs for an extended stay for my two daughters. They both loved the house, it was in an excellent location and close to everything they needed - shopping and parks in particular. The words they gave me to describe the house were comfortable, easily accessible, well kitted out with everything you need, cosy, a perfect location, clean, light filled and homely. I could not be more thrilled with my choice. Everything was great. Thankyou Katrina from the three of us.

This was a lovely apartment and in a fantastic location. We enjoyed our stay and very pleased with the amenities. The courtyard was lovely and the beds were comfortable. There was even thoughtful mince pies on our arrival. Katrina was very quick to respond to my messages and catered to my check in/check out needs which was a huge help with small children. It felt like a home away from home. With a comfortable cot and great high chair for my baby.

I could live at Katrina’s house. It’s in the BEST location. Great food everywhere, easy access to everything. The house is groovy and well decorated. The beds are comfy and there is everything you could need. I loved the courtyard. It was beautiful to sit out there in the morning and read the paper in the sun. Katrina is friendly and responds quickly to queries. I would definitely recommend this property, and I shall certainly be back!
A lovely property in a fantastic spot. Our host was responsive, accommodating and overall very helpful. I wouldn’t hesitate to return.

Wonderful location for a weekend getaway.  Easy to access cafes, shops and parks in Fitzroy. The place was clean, and comfortable, and loved having the courtyard  Katrina was very easy to communicate with.

Katrinas place was lovely,
we enjoyed the location especially as we could walk into the city in 15 minutes. We enjoyed so many yummy restaurants in Fitzroy.
The location was very peaceful.
Beds were comfortable and kitchen was well equipped.
courtyard was lovely.

We had a wonderful stay at Fitzroy. A lovely home away from home, minutes from all the best shops and eateries Melbourne has to offer. We appreciated off-street parking and parking permit - thanks for a great stay.
We had a great time at Katrina’s place, matched the photos, spacious and comfortable and Katrina was a great host and immediately fixed a small problem for us. We’ll definitely return!

We had a great stay at Fitzgeorge. Well presented, clean and well equipped. Great location with an abundance of cafes/ restaurants/ shopping just around the corner.
Katrina was a brilliant host and went above and beyond to accomodate for our baby and made sure we were as comfortable as possible.
Tight street and garage but doable in a medium size SUV.

Great place for our family of four - comfortable, and enough space to relax in between adventures.
Close to everything we needed (awesome food!)

The place is spacious and clean. Tram stop just down the street. Plenty of restaurant and shops nearby.
Katrina is very friendly, helpful and responsive. Definitely recommended!

Katrina communicated well with us during our reservation and stay.
The residence was wonderful to stay in, clean & warm.
An excellent experience

What a fab place! Hadn't stayed in Fitzroy before and this was the perfect place to explore the area, with its excellent restaurants, cafes and bars. The house is small but has everything you need (excellently provisioned kitchen); beds were very comfortable; cosy and comfortable sitting room looking onto a little backyard. Katrina was a responsive host and it was easy to get in and around from her instructions. All in all a great place to stay in Melbourne and I think we'll definitely return one day.

This is a great little place and Katrina is a very helpful and responsive host. There’s a tram at the end of the lane that goes directly into the CBD and some good restaurants around the corner. We enjoyed our stay there.

Hi Kim,
Thank you very much! My dear friends Dan & Saa really loved their stay in Melbourne. They watched Bruce Springsteen Live. They are so happy with your apartment. The location was ideal. Their words exactly"You walk out the front door of the building and everything is so close. They found the apartment so clean, modern, and just how it is in the picture on the airbnb site. they highly recommend it. As my experience with you as a host you're fantastic. Wow. We loved the spacious,comfortable apartment. It was home away from home for the next 11 nights. Lots of little surprises, as it was so well equipped. Good TV and wifi available. Nothing was too much trouble. The whole package is generous and reflects Kim's integrity. I would have no hesitation in recommending this apartment, and intend to rebook for next year.
But I do have a hesitation in sharing this information! (In case we miss out!) Cheers

Our stay at Kim's apartment was like a home away from home.  Although we never met Kim she was great host and provided detailed instructions for check-in.  We loved the apartment!  The location was perfect for exploring the city.  The apartment is in the heart of Melbourne, close to all transportation, wonderful shopping and great cafes and restaurants.  The bed was low to the ground but comfortable, the shower hot, and the kitchen contained all necessary equipment; although with all the great restaurants and cafes nearby it was hardly used!!  During our extended stay we did not get a change of bed linens which we think should have been available. The washer/dryer combination unit was very small and one load took a long time to wash and even longer to dry so we had to take our clothes to a laundromat.  Other than that the apartment  was comfortable and quiet.

we have been positively impressed . we had a good communication by phone and text . Kim was there for us !
she even got out of the way to post us a forgotten make up purse !

would like to go back to this place again !

christian ION and family

Beautiful apartment suited for anyone wanting to experience Melbourne city life. Convenient and walking distance to all major attractions. Everything required for the trip was provided for and Kim was a very accomodating host. Highly recommended.

Kim is a great host, she made the access to the apartment very easy and even assisted us with our late arrival. The apartment clean and well appointed. It has a great location in the heart of the CBD, it is just right next to Swanston Street where all the restaurants are. The apartment is cosy and a right size for a family of 3. Moreover, there is free internet too!

Kim was an excellent host, quick to respond and help in any way possible.  The apartment was exactly as described, comfy beds and suitable for our small family. Our young daughters were comfortable on the sofa bed and we had a great holiday! Would definitely recommend this apartment!  Thanks again Kim

The apartment was very well and centrally located which was convenient for exploring the downtown  area. Easy access to everything and Kim was responsive to our enquiries. It was bright, clean and airy and the space works well for a couple. Just a few  suggestions a) installation of more hand/bath towel hooks in the bathroom b) the mailbox/key safe in the lobby is incredibly difficult to operate and too dark to see the numbers (for entering code)....we needed help from the building's maintenance team to open / close it (with a torchlight too) and c) the lock for the sliding window / door to the balcony needs replacing/repairing; there was no apparent lock

Kim was very quick in responding to any messages sent regarding the penthouse prior to our stay. She was very helpful and all instructions were explained clearly. The penthouse on Collins & Elizabeth Street had the perfect location. We were able to walk almost everywhere due to it's central location. The space in the room was enough for two of my friends and I. One suggestion is having another mirror which is not in the bathroom! Overall we had a great stay and would definitely stay again!

The apartment was great. Elegant, comfortable and homey. It was unfortunate though that the air conditioning broke down just before our stay and it was really hot those few nights. Kim did however make the effort to get us an air cooler from another flat of hers. Kim herself was a friendly host who gets back to you and your messages. It would have been the perfect stay if not for the aircon breakdown.
Kim was super friendly and she's super quick with responding, the location is amazing and the apartment was crazy clean!
Gabs is a nice host, who will provide homely environment. She is an accommodating and friendly person. I do enjoy her meals and dinner parties.

When we arrived at Gabi's place after a long trip from home we felt very welcomed. So thankful to have met such a great person as Gabi, she was always there to give us advice, wise words, or tell us amazing and inspiring stories. It's crazy how a place so far from home can feel like home itself. Thanks to you Gabi!
Always enjoyed her perfected cooking and baking, dinner parties and simply having a talk over a glass of wine. Her house is one of the cosiest places we have ever been to, starts with the heavenly bathroom, continues with the very comfortable bedroom and ends with the great kitchen connected to the living room. Our stay was a great mixture of living together and having our privacy. Totally looking forward to coming back!

I was with Gabi for a month. She is the most kind, loving and thoughtful host! Her place is beautiful with sweeping high ceiling and everything one can need for a comfortable stay in the beautiful old Victorian house. Gabi gave me very helpful tips for local shopping and places to go. She kindly invited me to dinners and a party! Above and beyond any Airbnb host would go. I can recommend her and her place enough. If you're in Melbourne, it's a must place to stay at.
Absolutely wonderful for my business trip to Melbourne. Comfortable clean and safe. Kim was super easy to work with and made everything so easy. The place had literally everything I needed.

Kim place is the perfect place to stay in the city! Close to all the great shops and cafes you will not be disappointed with your stay at this beautiful penthouse apartment. Kim is very responsive and was able to answer any questions I had since it was my first time in Melbourne. Looking forward to booking this place again on my next holiday here!
Fantastic place to stay in Melbourne CBD. All comforts of home in an amazing location. Would recommend Kim and this place for sure! Great responsive and knowledgeable host!

Staying at Gabi's was an absolute treat. The house is historic, the area is safe and fun, and Gabi is warm and welcoming.
If you truly want to be less of surface level tourist and get a real experience of visiting Melbourne/AU - I'd highly recommend renting her room.

It was just great staying with Gabi! I stayed with her for 3 months and she was always lovely, kind and helpful! She indeed loves to cook and to bake, which was for example great when I came home from work and there was already dinner prepared! We also had many interesting and funny talks and I will miss staying with her.
As a response to other reviews regarding the temperatures inside the house during winter: Her house can be cold but there are enough options to make yourself warm and comfortable. Anyway, I think most buildings in Australia tend to be rather cold inside during winter.
Maybe something "negative": That cat wants cuddles and he snarls! Unfortunately, he can be very cute as well.
We loved staying with Gabi . We were in Kensington for a dinner and loved the location of Gabi’s beautiful house .
Cosy, comfortable room in Gabi’s welcoming home. We went to a concert at Flemington racecourse and we’re able to walk there and back which was fantastic.
A must stay if you have been away from home for a while and craving the home feeling of nurture and ease.  Gabi and her place are the best combination of recharge. would definitely stay again 🙂
A great return stay at Gabi’s, so accommodating. Such a great spot. Comfy bed and lovely linen made for a great sleep after our late arrival. This could be our new Melbourne base!

I would totally recommend staying at Gabi’s place. This was our first Airbnb sharing the space with the host and we enjoyed the experience.
Gabi is very friendly and we had a lovely time at the cottage.

Gabi’s place was great. Kensington is a wonderful neighborhood, with cafes, restos, and the train to the city just steps from the house. Gabi is a wonderful, gracious host who really made us feel at home, and sweet Socks the Cat added to the homey ambience. We very much enjoyed our stay at Gabi’s!

We travel and use air bnbs a lot but I can honestly say this is one of the loveliest trips we’ve ever had. The space is fantastic, and made only better by the truly stunning surrounding views & garden. Robyn was kind enough to let us stay for an additional night after we decided that three nights just wasn’t enough & i’m so glad that we did, this air bnb is in prime location near to local shops and some great hiking trails. If you’re looking for sparkling clean accommodation with a great host  and some lovely furry friends, this is definitely the place stay.

Lovely place, vera beautiful tree filled and green area, a perfect place to calm down, relax, enjoy  the awesome creation around. Olinda is a pretty  quiet little village whrer you find everything you need for daily  living, some nice cafes around - esp. the Ranges, very good fihn chips at the Fish cafe. Greater supermarkets ins Monbulk. Robyns and Ken#s house is a lovely place, they are very kind and considered guests and made sure that I felt at home, offering pick up at my arrival in Olinda and on my way back Barbare even took me down to the next train station. Everything is available that you might need for cooking, just bare in mind that a kitchenette does not replace a  fully equipped kitchen. You do have one hot plate, a microwave and a ricecooker to your disposal.

A little piece of heaven!
Completely private gorgeous unit with little hideaway kitchen and large modern bathroom. Super spacious and surrounded by beautiful trees and greenery. Stunning garden and lovely sun-drenched terrace.
The surrounding forests and villages are simply wonderful.
Hosts, Robyn and Ken, are lovely and happy to help out if you need anything.
Highly recommend!

Great location with feeling like the Dakota House in NYC overseeing Central Park.
Big rooms and high ceilings give a grand vibe.
Only compromise is Fitzroy Street can be noisy at times.

We found the accommodation very pleasant and homely, while still being enjoyable! It was close to amenities, and we would definitely recommend this accommodation! Katie and her husband were very accommodating and helpful.

The accommodation provided everything we needed. The location was great for our girls basketball tournament and shopping facilities were close by. Katie answered all my emails in a very short period of time and welcomed us on arrival.

Hosts were great. They gave us all the information we need.
The place was cozy and it feels like home during the time we spend there.

Stayed with Katie and Tony for 3 weeks. The flat was between two sets of relations which we were able to visit but could retire to Glenmore so as not to impose on either family. We were made very welcome by our hosts who were very helpful without being overbearing. The flat has 3 good size rooms and was a "home from home" for us. Husband Road is quiet and felt safe. If you visit, make sure you go to the 50m indoor swimming pool about 200m away. Its beautiful. My daughter and I miss our visit most mornings to the pool wearing our flip flops!!
For my family and me it was the beginning and the end of our journey to Australia. We felt very comfortable here. A great home with nice hosts! Thank you for everything! We will be back!
Great accommodation & friendly hosts. Katie was very informative, letting us know about restaurants, shops and activities close by.

I would recommend staying at this accommodation. Katie was fantastic to deal with! Though the property is a little outdated and the kitchen facilities were exceptionally small, so no big meal.... so shopping and cooking for yourself may not occur. But for my needs (watching daughter play at the U14 National Championships in Basketball) it was outstanding. Very comfortable  and located  close to where I need to be. Thanks Katie for a great stay!

Comfy back room suite perfect for winding down in. Accomodating up to 5-6 people was a bonus even though it was only 2 of us staying there. Being connected to this main house was never and issue and neither was washing dishes in the bathroom. We had a great experience here and would recommend these lovely hosts
Katies place was just what we needed during our stay in Melbourne. It was spacious well equipped  private quiet and easily accessible. Good value too.
It is a great place to live, Katie and Tony are very kind and nice. very convenient to buy things.
Katie’s place is comfortable, cosy and spacious. Good value. The only downside was that communication response could have been quicker.
Very tidy and lovely accommodation equipped with everything you need. A good bed and nice bathroom. Katie and Tony are both great hosts. They are very friendly and welcoming. We had a great stay!
It was a great experience, Katie & Tony are very kind, the house is in a quiet street, the surrounding areas are beautiful!
Very accomodating people, a nice and tidy space. No kitchen or sink which can be a bit tricky, but the price is affordable and location is great

Had a lovely stay. Nice, quiet location at rear of house. Close to where we needed to be. Had an issue with the kettle turning off, but owner showed me the nifty trick with screwdriver to get it back on. Happened again on second night with the fridge turning off, but thankfully didn’t have food in there. No frills, but ample room for a few nights stay. Loved that there was recycling and rubbish separate! And loved the gas heater and electric blanket that kept us warm during the chilly weather.

Staying at Lucy's was great. We had everything we needed for our short trip. The outside area was lovely, though we didn't get time to use it. You will have all you need when staying. Read the notes carefully though as there is not a full kitchen, but we had all we needed for our stay.

We had a busy working weekend and Lucy's place was only a short distance from where we needed to be.  Great to have off street parking and very quiet, no traffic noise at night.  It was perfect for us.

Stay here was amazing! Location was a bit of a surprise at first cause it was in a quiet corner of Healesville, but once you settle you you'll start to realise it's such a convenient location in the middle of nature all around you. Their dog Shea's a wonderful co-host too :) Our stay was wonderful, vineyard recommendations led us to the most amazing boutique wineries!
Would definitely recommend their place as a base for your stay in the Yarra valley region.
Great accommodation and hosts. Healesville is a hip little town with good coffee and food.....sooo many wineries to visit it is a shame we didn’t have more time.
A beautifully equipped cabin that was cosy and very tastefully decorated. All needs were provided for and we wish we had of been able to stay longer.

The stay was wonderful, the accommodation is very well furnished and close to local shops and attractions. Lianne and Paul were wonderful hosts, and Shea was an excellent companion for our puppy Hershel.

We decided at the last minute to book a remote working trip to Healesville and found Lianne and Paul's place. It was exactly what we needed. Lovely studio. Beautiful surrounds. Handy location. Our whippet and Shea were best buds. Can't recommend highly enough.

Super hosts for sure. Beautiful place with a cool art vibe. Super close to main street, with the experience of a quiet country stay. Lianne and Paul are so friendly and welcoming, not to mention their beautiful dog Shea. We will definitely be back.

Highly recommend this place which has a beautiful setting (studio is very well equipped, and the outdoor area is just amazing), wonderful host (and dog!) and great location amidst the wineries of Yarra valley.

- Great studio: Spacious, great kitchen and extremely well furnished with everything you need.
- Outside area with fireplace and easy to use BBQ was great
- Being next to the main house is not an issue at all.
- 5 min drive to town
- Very well natured dog (Shay) providing an extra mate for the stay

We had a very relaxing stay in this beautifully appointed studio with great amenities inside and out i.e. fire pit, barbecue, seating nestled in a tranquil bush garden. The studio was spotlessly clean and very warm and comfortable. Lianne and Paul are wonderful hosts.
We had a beautiful stay, will be recommending to friends and family, can’t wait to come back!

It's a beautiful place. It was raining the whole time we were there, so we didn't make use of the outdoor area, but had fun playing pool and reading in bed with a beautiful view. Spacious kitchen was well set out and everything easy to find. Communication was great.
Thanks Lianne and Paul for a great stay at your little hideaway in nature!! Highly recommended to future guests ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Thank you Lianne and Paul for sharing your home with Baxter and me. We had to most peaceful, relaxing weekend away. It was a pleasure to meet both of you. You had a wonderful way of being there should we need anything but also giving us complete privacy. Baxter would like to thank you for playing with him and the cuddles:) Look forward to meeting you again.
Very comfortable property in great location.  Host very helpful with explaining aspects of the property when we arrived.

Katie was friendly and made sure we had everything we needed for our stay.  The cottage was perfect for our needs - very clean, secure and close to family.  The books and games for the kids was an added bonus.

We had a fantastic stay at Katie's place in Gardenvale.
The location was perfect and Katie attended to any of our needs and requests promptly.
Really great also if you have kids. There is quite a lot of toys and puzzles to entertain them.
We had a BBQ on our last night which was really great to finish the stay with.
5 stars!

The home was comfortable, spacious, well equipped, instructions were clear, and the location was fantastic. I really appreciated the clean spaces and adequate heating for the few very cold days we experienced as well. Great coffee at the end of the street even.

Location superb, plenty of space and all the amenities one could ask for!
Katie is responsive and very helpful. Was sad to be leaving and would definitely return.

Katie's delightful cottage provided us with a wonderful stay while visiting family in Melbourne. Plenty of charm, clean and fresh, and the beds were super comfy. Everything we needed was there, plus off-street parking, a BBQ and books and Lego for our grandkids to enjoy. The area was great for walks, and of the local shops we especially loved "Escargot", the French patisserie on Martin Street. We highly recommend Katie's Gardenvale Cottage, and would like to thank her for her quick and helpful communication with us before and during our stay.

We had a fabulous time staying at Katie’s gorgeous sunflower cottage. For the weary interstate travellers her welcoming touches including Tim tams, coffee, tea and milk was so appreciated too! The beds were comfy and the neighbourhood quiet. We loved that the local restaurants and cafes, supermarket, train station were all in short walking distance.
Highly Recommend!

We stayed at Julia's place for a couple of nights to visit a friend of ours living close by. The location was perfect, not only close to our friend but also to heaps of great bars, cafes and restaurants. The bedrooms and the bathroom felt really clean and were nice and comfortable. The weekend was topped of by breakfast at an EXCELLENT cafe recommended by Julia, just down the road. We would stay again.

Julia was there to meet us when we arrived and was most welcoming and an absolute delight. She showed us what we needed to know, passed on keys and then let us get on with it. She provided the perfect amount of info and guidance; warm, friendly, helpful and then she was unobtrusive.

The house is brilliant, spacious, comfortable and very liveable so you feel like your in a home away from home. The beds are excellent and we all slept like logs.
The whole set up was perfect for us. The cafes, restaurants and shops are in walking distance and the public transport options are excellent. We will definitely be back. Thanks for everything Julia. We hope we see you again soon.

Wonderful and large space, private and close to public transport and shops. Julia was a pleasure to meet, she was very accommodating. The rooms were very spacious and the kitchen was functional enough to cook lunches, dinners and birthday cakes!
Will definitely come back whenever we are in Melbourne next!
We had a really great time in the corner shop house. The location is really convenient and the house is really nice. Julia was a great host and very accommodating for is.

Julia was there to meet us and showed us around her home.Everything was straight forward.Julia lent me her Myki card to use for the trams which was lovely of her.Her home was a great place to stay.Full of character.Way better than any hotel. A great area to stay in too.Close to tram to the city and other suburbs.Fantastic shopping in Sydney and Brunswick streets if you are looking for something different.Also great places and variety to eat locally.

Julia's house is a gorgeous character home in a quiet part of Brunswick but within an easy walk of restaurants, bars & public transport. The home is really cosy & comfortable & Julia is a very considerate host, providing an air cooler on a particularly hot night. Wouldn't hesitate to stay again or recommend Julia's home.

This place is spacious and has tons of amenities. It’s in a great location, just a short walk to Sydney Road and some good coffee, good food, tram stops, etc. There are several really good microbreweries close by as well. There’s a common space right outside the back door with a nice table and chairs under a lemon tree, it’s a good place to sit and have some peaceful time to think. Julia is an excellent host, communicates very well and left no loose ends. We had everything we needed, and she even made sure we had little things like chocolates in the fridge. You’ll have a hard time finding a place that is a better deal than this one.

This was staying in Julia’s home while she was away so it was interesting, a little bit quirky and really wonderful. If you are after something that is different from a ‘styled’ holiday property and feels like a local experience then this place is the go. Stayed here with my 20 yo son who loved it at least as much as I did. Look forward to staying here next time I’m in Melbourne.
Lovely accomodation and great location. Julia made us feel very welcome and at ease. Warmly recommended.

We arrived late evening to Julia's warm, cosy house. Julia provided great local information for the very cool Brunswick neighbourhood. She was easily contactable if we had questions and offered us a later check out which we appreciated. Julia even gave us a signed copy of her mother's book!
The location between Sydney Road and Lygon Street is perfect, as is the nearest coffee shop just down the street! We would stay again.
Our stay at Julia’s was perfect, the house was just as described and lovely and homely. Julia was very responsive to any questions we had and the area was great. Thanks!

I had the best time in Melbourne. Liz was very welcoming and friendly, she met me at the apartment the morning I arrived to show me everything and was very hospitable throughout the stay. The apartment was lovely and very homely, the Internet worked well and the location is perfect for the beach or for getting into the cbd. I would go back again very soon if I could! She has good suggestions of things to do and is very helpful should you need anything during your stay. I would rate a 10/10!

It is often the small touches that make a trip the most memorable, homemade hommus and almonds, super friendly and efficient correspondence, a host that is willing to give up her hair dryer for the weekend and a perfectly positioned apartment.
We are beyond impressed with our first air bnb experience, we couldn't recommend Elizabeth's lovely apartment any higher for a beachside getaway that is walking distance from Luna Park, Acland Street, the beach, parks and public transport options. Book! You won't regret it!

Elizabeth's apartment in St Kilda was an excellent place to stay; full of character and charm, and cosy and warm.  It was close to transport with lots of great cafes and restaurants nearby, as well as some interesting clothing and decor boutiques.

My boyfriend and I had such a fantastic stay at Liz appartment. It is perfectly located, close to the beach and to a lot of nice bars and restaurants. We couldn't have picked a better place for our trip to Melbourne. The appartment is just beautiful, and tastefully decorated. Elizabeth was a great host with helpful recommendations. Thank you Liz for this lovely stay.

Lisa's apartment is described accurately in the description and she really went above and beyond to assist us as travellers. Plenty of maps, info and tid bits to make getting in out and around Melbourne easy.
A nice little apartment, ample room for 4 people sharing 2 double beds and even a few board games to relax the first night in after travelling.
Lisa's apartment was fantastic and comfortable. Close to a number of public transport options and the CBD.
We had a lovely stay at Lisa's place in Brunswick in early Feb. The location was great for what we needed and the house was clean, tidy and homely.

The unit was extremely clean and tidy and also very homey and welcoming. We really appreciated the thoughtfulness that had been put into details that made our stay easier and more comfortable- the Myki (transport) card, lots of Melbourne maps and city guides, DVDs, CDs & books, shampoo in the bathroom, etc. Lisa gave very clear instructions for reaching public transport and finding the place, and was always helpful and quick to reply to messages.

The house was really nice and the price was very affordable. Location is also great - near two train stations. A little walk further and you'd be in Sydney Road, with many restaurants and supermarkets. Every part of the house was very clean, and there is also wifi. The only bad thing is that the house was colder than i would like, since i stayed here in the middle of winter and the heater didn't do much to the bedrooms. Overall, i had a really nice stay with a welcoming host who is very communicative, and also great location. Everything is true to pictures. Would recommend!
We stayed at Lisa's place for seven days and found that it had everything we needed, and even more. It was very comfortable and convenient.

Lisa's place is comfortable and clean. We were visiting with our two little children and we found it convenient.
You will definitely need a car to move around though and Lisa's place has parking in premises.
Correspondence with Lisa is very fluid. While you might not see her, she's quick to reply.
Sydney street, close by, has very good restaurants. Tiba's Lebanese restaurant was one of our favourites.
Lisa is a great host with fantastic communication. Check in was super easy. Lisa’s place is comfortable, cosy and a typical Brunswick experience
A great flat with all the amenities you could possibly need. Close to public transport, which makes travelling around the city nice and simple.
Lisa was so easy to talk to and organise our stay with. The unit was very clean and had everything we needed.

Thank you Lisa for the nice experience we had at your place. We enjoyed how clean every room was, how complete the facilities were, and how close the location is to Victoria and all these trendy hipster cafes around Brunswik. It was so worth it than staying at a hotel! Cheers
Nice and quiet , good location, easy for car parking , a little complaint is that the host replies not that quickly.

Lisa's unit was exactly as described - small, convenient and cozy. There are lots of thoughtful little personal touches that made our stay very enjoyable, plus plenty of information about public transport, things to see and do in the area. I hope to come back again. Thanks Lisa!

This unit is in a convenient position and was clean. Lisa was always prompt in replying.
Thank you!
We had a lovely time at Lisa’s place.  It is ideally placed for public transport and had everything we needed for our stay. Very happy to stay again.

Great little space with everything you need for a home visit: kitchen has all you need, fridge and freezer is great: lots of easy places to get deliveries from for food if you want. Quiet neighbourhood
Lisa’s place was very nice. Everything that she posted is accurate and I really enjoyed my time at her place :)

Lisa is a great host, who always gets back to you quickly. The flat is in a great spot and within a short walk to the train station and Sydney road. It is as advertised, basic but clean and has everything you would need when on holiday.  There is a small garden out the back with fantastic plants and a spot to sit and enjoy a red. It was hot whilst we were there and there is a new A/C which is great. Thanks Lisa !

I highly recommend Lisa’s unit, it’s very cosy, close to amenities and is in a great quiet block. Lisa’s communication is superb and she makes sure you are doing fine whilst at the residency. Will define a use Lisa again when back in Melbourne 10 out of 10 from me!!
Thanks Lisa for all your communication.  The AirBnb was as advertised and homely... just what we needed.  Thank you.

Such a beautiful cosy home. Great communication all the way through!
Can definitely recommend Lisa and her accommodation
Perfect for our needs for a nearby wedding & close to Sydney St restaurants and shops. Highly recommended if you’re looking for something away from the hussle and bustle of traffic noise.
Lisa is a wonderful host with effective communication and flexibility . Her place is quite and match the description. Had wonderful stay.

We had a fantastic  stay at Lisa’s place. She was very helpful when I had an issue making the booking, and she even accommodated a late check out. The place was clean and heated up nicely. Any of our questions were answered by the house manual on the counter.
Great unit, parking at the door. Supplied with everything you could need.  Very clean, comfortable bed.

Lisa had a beautiful flat, fully equipped kitchen and an extensive dvd collection! the bathroom was beautiful and everything was exactly as pictured and descibed prior to my arrival. Thanks lisa! this was easily one of the best stays ive had on airbnb!

Lisa's place is a very cosy 2 bedrooms unit, in a very quiet suburb of Melbourne. The nights were really peaceful.
Halfway between the airport and the CBD, every Melbourne's places are a short distance from it.

Excellent little two bedroom unit with everything we needed. It was perfect for our needs and Lisa was a superb host. I would definitely recommend and stay again. Brunswick is a lovely neighbourhood and there was good food, coffee and transport links. Lisa was a brilliant host and instructions were clear and easy to follow. The only minor thing was the distance to the train and trams (1.2km) which wasn’t an issue for us but depending on what you’re doing is worth considering.

Cozy place and met our needs for the three nights. Lisa communicates well and gave me clear instructions for check-in and checkout and even checked up on our stay. Happy and would return if convenient.
Such a great apartment and  location Loved the collection of movies and music! Will 100% stay here again ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Well appointed, great location near the city and Sydney Road. Perfect for the short stay and to our location during the day in Parkville.

I had a lovely two weeks at Claire & Allan’s place. They’re very nice, like to share with host and taking time with them. Nice house, quiet, surrounded by a nice garden. Nor far from Melbourne center with tram or train. Very convenient ! I recommend it.

Claire and Allen are the most wonderful hosts you could ask for! They are more than happy to have a chat, or to leave you to yourself if that is what you wish. The house comes with a gorgeous garden and Satchi is such a friendly dog! The room is well equipped with everything you could hope for and makes you feel right at home. I had just moved to Melbourne when staying here and Claire and Allen provided a great home away from home.
If you are looking for that extra something during your stay then this is the place for you!

Claire and Allan are truly wonderful hosts, their hospitality will make you feel like in your own home. Tram and train stations are within walking distance. Claire lent me the myki card to get around. The room was cozy and equipped with refrigerator, microwave, heater, electric kettle and toaster and to go with those Claire also prepared, a bowl of fruits, muesli, (my fave) bread, jam, peanut butter, vegemite, honey, butter, sugar, milk, soy milk and selections of teas and coffees. After exploring the city for the whole day you’d just want to go back to this lovely room to chill. Thank you so much, Claire and Allan, I’m absolutely grateful for you kindness.

Claire's place is in a great location close to the top of Sydney Road and trains/trams. The room is very nice with everything you need, and lots of extra little touches that make for a good stay. The house is a nice old villa with lots of character, and the outside back garden is a great place to relax. The hosts are very welcoming and friendly - a great place to stay.
A welcome into a homely space by lovely hosts. Lush garden space with BBQ. Room perfect for good resting.

My partner and I had an amazing stay at Claire's 'forest' house. Every detail had been thought out to make our stay as enjoyable as possible. A beautiful house with a very tranquil garden, I would definitely recommend this to anyone else.
We enjoyed our stay at Claire's beautiful home. The room is spacious and comfortable, and the shared bathroom and toilet are in front of the room, very convenient.

A dream of a stay! Claire and Alan are so kind, welcoming, generous and respectful. I had the greatest stay; room is MUCH bigger than the pictures suggest and the house has a warm, homey, light feel to it.
Claire stay is a lovely spacious bedroom, well furnished with a comfortable bed. The unexpected breakfast was just what we were looking for and check in was a breeze. The garden is delightful!

Claire is the epitome of a warm and welcoming host. Her place was so quiet and serene which is just what I needed. The room was very clean, had everything necessary and even food and snacks. It’s easily accessible by public transport and close to supermarkets and general shopping.  Would definitely recommend to anyone.

If you like a garden full of beautiful fauna and you feel like you need to visit your 'grandparents', I'd highly recommend booking their place. Really responsive and acceptive. Even pushed the check-out further because I politely asked them.
Claire’s house was great! I loved the greenery out the front! It was a shame I only stayed for one night. ☺️

Claire is a very thoughtful host and her place is comfortable, plant-filled and inviting.  We had a delightful, peaceful stay with everything needed for a restful night. Claire's communication was warm and responsive. Highly recommend!

Claire's home is warm and welcoming, with an enchanting garden and expansive bedroom/bathroom. you'll feel right at home, as she is a gracious host, who has everything you should need ready for you. would love to come back!
Claire and Allan are treasures. It was a privilege to stay in a loved original family home. As much privacy as you prefer. Would stay again.

Thank you to Claire and Alan for such a lovely stay. We were weary from travelling and it was the perfect place to rest, reset and then see the city from. The location was close to amenities on Sydney Road and public transport to CBD and beyond. We loved our time at this peaceful, relaxing home.

Claire has a lovely home and we were very comfortable there. The bed was comfortable with nice bedding and pillows and the toiletries were very nice.  Normally we never have a shared bathroom but it wasn’t a problem at all. Tea, coffee, milk and bread and butter were provided along with fruit and muesli.

Jun was a great host, he was very friendly on welcome and he had gone to the effort to get us some food basics and a six pack of beer which was much appreciated! The apartment was perfect for me and my 3 friends to nest for the weekend and was in a great location easily accessible to the city. Would definitely rebook here on another visit to Melbourne

Loved the location of the apartment, the insence that was put out was a little bit too strong, but other than that this was an idea place to stay😍 super clean and friendly host, everything matched the photos, lovely neighbours !
Will definitely be coming here each time I decide to stay in Melbourne

Jun was an absolute fantastic host.
we needed an early check in and a baby high chair and Jun was very responsive and flexible with everything.
The apartment was good with everything as seen in the photos and shower was great (constant hot water). the beds had a variety of pillows to choose from and bed was comfy as well.
having a little one it's great to know that there's a park with a decent playground within walking distance to let them run around and play.
Great food places are also nearby (recommend Paik's Bibim)
would stay again!
My stay at this Airbnb was excellent. The location was great, the apartment was clean and comfortable, and the host was very responsive. I highly recommend it!

Jun’s place was exactly as pictured online. It was in the best location and had everything we needed. Jun was also really easy to communicate with. Super quick responses and she even offered us late check out. The stay was amazing!

Central location in a large apartment building with security doors. The flat is simple and sparsely decorated with plastic flowers and fluffy toys.  It's basic and good value, but not ideal for someone looking for a homely space needing cooking amenities. The fridge was full of coke, but couldn't find any tea. Jun is very proactive and communicative, so any issues are quickly dealt with. It was great to have parking in the building.
Jun is a very nice and reactive host. The apartment is right in the CBD with a garage, very important if you are travelling with a car!

Really good place to stay at the center of Melbourne which is in the Free tram zone and easy to reach CBD area. Highly recommend this place. The host is really proactive and responsive. Very happy to stay at Jun's airbnb.
Looking forward to staying next time!

Excellent place for families! We were two adults, a 3 year old and an 11 week old and Jun's place worked perfectly for us. The setup of two bedrooms worked great and Jun put up a porticot for the baby. It was a very quiet and private place and easy to find, helped even more so by Jun's mum meeting us downstairs to help us check in. The location was good for us as we walk everywhere; we took trams when we needed to. Easy access with a pram by the way - sometimes it's hard to know from an Airbnb listing how that will work but was extremely accessible and also plenty of room in the apartment for the pram with no need to collapse the pram. Jun was highly responsive to any messages and the instructions to get there, even from the airport, were clear and precise. Thanks so much Jun for our stay, we would stay again.

Jun was a great host; who communicated in a timely way with clear and helpful instructions, even checking to see if we needed a later check out - which we did and arranging that for us. The welcome pack of tea, milk and other goodies was very helpful. Very comfortable beds! We had a great stay.

convenient location and great that it has a free car parking spot that is large and lots of space to open the car doors and pop a baby into the car seat. we really appreciate the extra touches such as the chocolate for Easter as well as the children's cutlery and toys. the apartment is in some need of repairs and freshening up. please be aware that the bedrooms do not have aircon but if you leave the doors open, the aircon from the living room are able to reach the rooms, had a good stay overall
It was beautiful. Jun made check in and out so easy. Will 100% go back.

Joanna was a fantastic host and her apartment was a great place to stay with loads of things to do within walking distance and easy access all around the city. Would recommend her apartment to anyone coming to Melbourne.

Denise was a great host. She was there on arrival with a key and showed me through the space. It was clean and very cute. Accurate to the pictures posted. It's in a great area, close to shops and pubs and walking distance to North Fitzroy area. You also have a private entrance with own key and it's tucked away behind the main house with a little outdoor shared space. I highly recommend staying here. Can't beat the price either!!

This is a very friendly and light-filled little flat with a charming view to trees and chimneys.  It's in a nice, leafy area with an excellent cafe and flower shop just around the corner and city train stops only five minutes away. The flat has all you need for a short stay and I have already recommended it to a friend. I hope Denise's flat will be vacant next time I go to Melbourne.

The room is very cute and comfortable. just around the corner, there is a casual bar and you can drink many Australian craft beer. also there is very nice an organic café! Tram stop is near and convenient more than train :)

Denise's loft was perfect for my two day stay in Melbourne. It is walking distance from my son's house and had everything I needed for my visit. It is immaculately clean and very cosy. Unfortunately due to the commitments I had, we didn't interact other than at key handover time but everything went like clockwork and Denise was very friendly. I look forward to staying there sometime in the future

I stayed in Denise's loft for 4 nights. It is a cosy space with lots of natural light and a lovely outlook over the tree lined street. The loft is small but well equipped  for one person. Close to public transport and lots of great coffee shops and restaurants nearby. I found the washing machine very useful. Communication with Denise was very easy, she was around all during my stay. It was nice to have a chat. There have been comments about the trains. I noticed them a little on the first night but not after that.  I really enjoyed staying there and hope to go back again.

Denise made me feel very welcome and I had a lovely stay.  The loft is a comfortable, welcoming, cosy space with great facilities. It is well situated on a lovely tree-lined street, close to public transport - 86 tram and Rushall train station - and cafes, bars and restaurants. I recommend it as a great place to stay and I'd love to stay again.

Lovely spot for one. Right in between stops for the tram and train into the city. Nice pub and cafe just around the corner yet the loft is in a pretty, tree lined, quiet street. Super clean and really nicely decorated with a very comfy bed. Was really nice to meet the host Denise.

Perfect place to stay in Melbourne's northern suburbs.  Denise's loft is clean and had everything I needed.    Closest tram is just a five minute walk up High Street (Walker Street Stop 26).  Be sure to check out Mixed Business Cafe around the corner, and my favorites in Westgarth: Il Melograno, Palace Westgarth Cinemas, and Terra Madre.
The loft was very convenient for my brief visit to Melbourne with great local cafes & bars all within walking distance. A great host ensuring that your visit to Melbourne would be enjoyable.

Lovely loft, great location near public transport and a nice pub and cafe. Cosy wee loft, slightly close to railway tracks but they are a distant pleasant rumble when they do sound. Beautiful aromas from the garden when walking in, and Denise was most hospitable. Great value!

A great place for one or two people. Close to trains and trams in a quiet and pretty area. Denise was very helpful and friendly, with lots of advice re public transport, shopping etc. There’s a set of spiral stairs up to the loft but they’re well lit with automatic lights. I’d stay again for sure!
Great stay in cozy little apartment in quite neighborhood close to public transport and shops. Very lovely host and a nice green garden setting

One of the best Airbnb's I've stayed in. Immaculate, in an ideal location right next to public transport; nothing I could think of that could be better about this place. Stay here if you want to have a wonderful experience.

Denise's loft is such a great home base for exploring Melbourne! I stayed there for almost two weeks and my partner joined me for a few nights. The location couldn't be better - you're within skipping distance of train, tram and bus, and a short walk from a couple of interesting neighbourhoods, AND right on the bike track that goes along the river. The loft itself is gorgeous and cosy, and had everything I needed for my stay (I had breakfast at home and other meals out). Heater and electric blanket kept me cosy in the big comfy bed, nice hot showers and even a washing machine. It was great having my own side entrance to the loft, so I could come and go without disturbing Denise. She is a generous and welcoming host who was always happy to help.

Lovely little air-conditioned studio close to public transit, with everything you need! Very accurate pictures - a sweet sanctuary in an unfamiliar place. Greatly enjoyed my visit, would definitely stay here again!
Beautiful and cozy place which is walking distance to restaurants and cafes. Tram station is very near.

Great spot in the perfect location. Denise was kind enough to let me check in early and check out late; which is always very much appreciated when you are jumping from bnb to bnb.
The only thing I would note is that the toilet is inside the bedroom, there is no door to separate the bedroom and bathroom. This is okay by yourself but if I was staying with a friend or partner this would be deal breaker for me.
Perfect for a solo traveler.
Great little spot in the middle of Clifton Hill. Close to tram and train, and I was able to work from home with the wifi. It was super handy having a shower and heater in the place. Would stay again
Second time, feels a bit like home already! Super nice place and location - super easy and smooth communication with Denise! I‘ll be back!
Such a lovely place , Denise was great and the loft is relaxing . Lots of natural light and beautiful sunrises. Thank you Denise.

I am sooo impressed with my host. The stay was lovely, she helped me with a large screen for the work I was doing, and even gave me some soup and cake. When I left Denise went way beyond and helped me with my luggage and got me on to my train with instructions on how to get to my next destination. The train station is close by so we did not have to go far. Denise should really be considered a super-duper-host.

What a find! Great for a solo traveller. Private space looking out onto shared garden, loved the sun streaming in through all the windows each morning.
Everything you need and easy access to public transport. Also close to parks and nice cafes and shops, good pub on the corner.
Denise was friendly and helpful. Will definitely stay again. Thankyou

I really enjoyed staying at Denise's place. It's a very cute second floor space in the back of her courtyard separate from the house. It was very cozy and comfortable. I was able to do laundry and hang them on the laundry line in the backyard. Great windows out front that welcomed the morning sun.  And very easy to get to the local train station which was under a five minute walk away. Lots to do in the area in very safe. Thank you Denise!

This was a fantastic stay. The house was perfect with massive soft towels, large rooms, the best shower I've had in ages and just a really homely, comfortable feel. Although the weather wasn't entirely in our favour there is a great outdoor area with BBQ and the option to dine inside or out. Central heating and cooling and all the mod cons of a modern home with a real country feel. Thanks Vikki.

What a lovely experience it was to stay at Enda Cottage. My mum was visiting from the UK and she loved the quaint character. It is ideally located close to all of Healsville's attraction. A perfect place to explore the local area. Vikki, the host, was extremely helpful and very easy to deal with. We'd definitely be back next time!

All 6 of our party attending a wedding in the Yarra Valley agreed Enda Cottage was a fantastic place to stay. The house was very homely, clean, spacious and well equipped for our needs. Vikki also was very prompt with all of our communications and even suggested a cheap and friendly private bus service that we used to get around town. A simple breakfast and plenty of information for things to do in the surrounding area were also provided.

We only spent the one night here for a friends wedding. Edna cottage was so beautiful that it was hard to leave. Vikki was a great host and I couldn't recommend this property or dealing with Vikki more. The cottage had fantastic amenities. Thanks again Vikki.

Where do I start! Let's just wrap it up in one word... Exceptional! Vicki was very responsive & communicated in a timely manner. The cottage was a dream! Spotless, charming, warming & welcoming. Would be stay again? Absolutely!

Vikki contacted us with details of how to get access to key  -  worked well.  The nieghbourhood was very good, I enjoyed walking around it and admiring views out to the surrounding hills. Also an easy walk to shops.

The house is amazing, the rooms and the bathroom are beautiful. We had a lovely stay and the house was perfect for 8 people. It was a perfect location for a weekend in the beautiful Yarra Valley and I would recommend staying here in a heart beat!
Had an absolutely lovely experience. The place was amazing! Vikki had pretty much thought of everything possible to make our stay enjoyable.

My stay at Enda Cottage couldn't have been more delightful! The house is clean, spacious, warm and cozy, with lovely personal touches by Vikki, such as fresh fruit and breakfast supplies, and lots of info for those new to the area. Everything you could need has been thought of and so much space, in and out, to enjoy. I also have to say that the showers were fabulous! Check in and out couldn't have been easier, and Vikki is just a wonderful host and communicator. I will be back!

We just loved our stay at Enda cottage. It is a gorgeous, stylish place and set up for a very comfortable stay for the 8 of us. There was a bowl of chocolates waiting for us on arrival, and fruit/breakfast supplies provided. There is also a piano, and we had a fun sing a long session on the Saturday evening. It was the perfect location from which to begin and end our yarra valley winery tour by bike. Thanks Vikki, we would definitely come back!
The cottage was lovely - perfect for our Yarra Valley stay to attend a concert. Vikki was the perfect host, and assisted with great local info. Highly recommended.

This is the second time we have stayed at one of Vikki's properties and we were made to feel as special and welcomed the second time around as the first.
Cute little welcome greeting on the kitchen chalkboard.
Way more inclusions than your regular continental breakfast provisions.
The cottage is gorgeous and full of character. Clean throughout with comfortable bedding and lounges.
We happened to stay for a child free weekend with friends, however I couldn't help but notice the child friendly ammenities including high hair and pram. Lots of games and books which is great for families with children.
We love Vikki's properties and hospitality and look forward to staying again next time we are in the Yarra Valley.
So much love is felt throughout the cottage making it such a beautiful place to unwind. Very close to the heart f Healesville too.
Great experience. Thank you Vicky. Highly recommended. Beautiful house in a great spot! Definitely be back
If you are looking at staying in Healesville look no further -great character and great host

Vikki’s house has all the amenities you need for a relaxing weekend away. The house was perfect for our family and Vikki added some very thoughtful touches like a porta cot and high chair for our son, as well and books, toys and full breakfast for the morning. The house is very close to some great sights including Healsville Sanctuary, Hedgend Maze, fantastic restaurants like Innocent Bystander and Four Pillars and all of the wineries of the Yarra Valley. We would stay again!

Vikki's cottage was amazing! Perfect size for a group of us who were in the area for a wedding. Photos don't do it justice it was very well presented with added touches that made it even more special and felt like home. I will definitely recommend to others and stay here again next time we visit. Thanks Vikki for being a great host!
We had an amazing trip! The house was very charming and beautiful. Vikki was a great host : )
We had a great stay at Vikki's place. She was very lovely, and easy to communicate with. She also gave us some good local tips - would definitely recommend staying here!
It is just a brilliant Cottage. clean, plenty of room, no noise and little extras that will be enjoyed and appreciated by all.

Vikki’s home was absolutely beautiful! The photos really don’t do justice with how spacious it is.
It’s so comfortable and homey and had all the amenities and more that you would ever expect or think of. Very thoughtful!
Such a lovely variety for breakfast, and we felt right at home.
We loved all the info and tips of where to go, and we even made the most of the great kitchen and cooked a great meal and relaxed in the back yard.
Highly recommended!! Perfect for families and groups of friends.
This cottage is like walking into a warm hug! It’s just lovely. The pictures don’t do it justice. If I ever come back to Healesville I will definitely be staying here again.
Such a cute place to stay! We had a group of 5 ladies and we had the best time. Amazing location to explore the Yarra Valley. Thanks Vikki
Gorgeous house, close to town, thoughtful touches. Really cozy and great for my young family.

We loved Wendy's apartment - it is indeed superb and the views over the water, particularly at sunset, are incredible. It is a wonderfully situated apartment, across the road from the beach, within easy walking distance from shops and restaurants and a tram stop outside the door for those wishing to travel further afield. We four adults enjoyed the attention to detail in this light, airy and roomy apartment and were very comfortable and content during our six night stay.
We highly recommend this apartment.

Wendy and team were great hosts. They made us all (2 adults with 2 teenage children ) feel very welcome. They went out of their way to make sure we had a good stay- we really appreciated this. The apartment is amazing. It is beautifully presented with lots of character. It has a modern kitchen and 3 modern bathrooms. The view is spectacular- the photos on the website can't do it justice. If you like St Kilda (as we do), you won't find a better location.

My daughter enjoyed looking after Lucy the cat- we miss her now we are home.

Bottom line- we loved it!!

I cannot speak highly enough of Wendy, the apartment, the location and Lucy the cat! The whole experience was better than I could have imagined. Walking distance to everything, fantastic food nearby, breathtaking view, spotlessly clean, everything was perfect. Wendy was so welcoming and great at communicating. You wont want to go home...we didnt!

Wendy’s penthouse apartment is amazing. Very spacious with all the amenities anyone could need. Location is brilliant right by the seafront and tram to get into town. The balcony offers superb views, particularly for sunset. Communication was excellent. Highly recommend.

Likely the best place I have rented. Beautiful, spacious and bright space. Fully equipped. Wonderful and thoughtful hosts. We felt we were staying at a friend’s. The outdoor patios and views are a huge bonus. Great neighbourhood to walk around and steps from the waterfront. Top floor, so a few stairs to get there but it only adds to your views!

Wonderful space.
Vikki was an exceptional host.
Went above and beyond to help us.
Her communication was excellent and quick.
The place was so lovely. A gorgeous clean cottage with character.
Vikki left personal little touches and make up wipes for the ladies!
Brekky was lovely too.
Thanks for having us Vikki and being an amazing host.

If you’re looking for a place to stay in Healesville for 6 of you.  This house is ideal. The small touches and quirkiness of Enda Cottage were lovely. Two bathrooms  and the outdoor area were fabulous for us. Highly recommend this property.
Our stay at Enda Cottage was amazing! The warm and welcoming cottage style house was perfect for our family of six and one toddler, would highly recommend to all!

Had a great stay at Wendy’s place! So much space for 4 people, it was great. The view from the balcony is beautiful, so highly recommend being around at sunset. A perfect stay if spending time in St Kilda!
This is a great place to relax and unwind. So cool and peaceful in Summer. And a gorgeous old house with lots of personal touches to make it homely.

This cottage is stunning.  The photos don’t do justice to this gorgeous home away from home.  It has everything you could ever need and a beautiful private lush garden.  Vikki provided us with lots of little extras that made us feel so warmly loved and welcomed.    Every room was bliss to be in.  Everything was in easy walking distance and it was the perfect stay while we attended an important family wedding.  Thank you Vikki for the opportunity to stay at your magnificent home
Vicki is a great host and offers a cute cottage in a great location. Vicki is very accommodating and communication was great. The cottage is very family friendly with lots of little nice touches

Edna's cottage was absolutely fantastic. Clean, great location, warm with lots of extras like bread, milk, juice and plenty of coffee and tea.  Would highly recommend staying and would definitely stay again.  Definitely a five star experience

We had a great stay in Healesville, Vicki’s house was the perfect location within a few minutes of all the great things the area has to offer.
The house has lovely charm and even on a cold and wet weekend like we had during our stay, we were toasty warm and had plenty to do.
We would recommend a stay here for anyone coming to the Healesville area.

Absolutely amazing from the moment we booked the accomodation. Vikki is a wonderful kind host with prompt communication and ready to help any time. We pulled up in the drive way and felt relaxed the moment we arrived. The cottage has everything you need for a country escape. Comfortable and warm, perfect layout for a group friends or family with kids. We went out and about, but found ourselves just wanting to come home and just settle back in and sit out on the back decking chatting or cosied up on the big comfy lounges.
It was just what we needed. Thanks again for having us Vikki! Hope to be back again soon.

Vikki’s cottage was a lovely place to stay for our family :) Our daughter especially loved all the cute decorations, books and furniture.
Super close to the town centre and within walking distance to Four Pillars Distillery.
Great recommendations and easy checkin/out.
Thanks for having us!
Second time we have stayed in this adorable cottage! Vikki was amazing to deal with and nothing was too much to ask x
What an awesome place!!!  Very cute and cosy, and the location was awesome. We had a very enjoyable time. Thankyou

Vikki was outstanding.
The cottage was beautiful and very cozy. We will surely be coming back!

I booked Vikki’s lovely cottage for my dad and his partner as they were attending a wedding very close by, they raved to everyone about their lovely air bnb! They very much enjoyed their stay and it exceeded their expectations. Vikki was a wonderful host and communicated kindly and thoroughly throughout the process. Would definitely stay again and highly recommend!

Vicki’s place was very comfortable and spacious. It had everything we needed and was in a good location within walking distance of the Main Street. We were a group of 4 women attending a concert in the area so it was a perfect place for us.

Vicki's place is just perfect for some time away. It is extremely well equipped, beautifully furnished with super comfortable beds. Loved all her handmade quilts on display too. From the moment we arrived if felt just like being in your own home.
Would love to visit again.

I booked for my parents stayed for 4 weeks and they loved the place. It is very neatly set up, with all utilities needed for living. The outside of the building seems a little worn down by the sea wind, but the inside is newly renovated and very comfortable. The best part is the stunning ocean view right from the bed and living area, and you will never be bored staying at this place as the ocean looks different all day long. The shopping centre is about 15 min walk, which you can get to via the beach. Lenna is a very friendly and helpful host. She responds to questions quickly and checks in via email from time to time. Would be happily stay again!

If the Aspendale location (approx 15 min walk to the closest train station) works for you, I don't think it gets better than this! Breathtaking view, super nice host, all the amenities I needed, comfortable bed. The studio even seemed larger in real life than in the photos.  Mordialloc (where the closest train station is located) has supermarkets and a range of nice restaurants and cafes. If the need ever comes, I will definitely book the place again!!

The apartment was a breath of fresh air. We had to walk just through a little gate onto the beach, which was terrific. Apartment had everything required for a self catering holiday or was a perfect spot to local restaurants. Lenna had left a lovely message with a welcome bottle of wine and sweets. The apartment itself was immaculate. Plenty of towels and clean bed linen if you were staying longer than a few days. 5* Perfect
Beautiful spot for a relaxing getaway. The view is spectacular, the apartment is lovely and to top it off Lenna was a wonderful host. I would highly recommend.

Lenna is so amazing her responses to any queries you have are quick , and her beautiful apartment is  a slice of paradise . Loved all the extra touches Lenna supplied , and thank you for my beautiful bottle of wine and box of chocolates which I received on check in.
Bute spot. You cannot get any closer to a wonderful beach. The sea is quiet so very easy to get in for a swim. Beautiful sunsets as well. Comfy bed, big kitchen and nice rain shower.

This is a great family home with everything you need for a Melbourne vacation.  We enjoyed the welcoming living and dining space, barbecues in the sheltered backyard and restful bedrooms that kept a comfortable temperature whatever the weather outside.  All the appliances you need to keep a family fed and in clean clothes are modern and easy to use. There’s a park at the end of the street and the house is within easy walking distance of trams to key destinations. We appreciated the care over the little things too - bottles of milk in the fridge, Myki cards and maps had we needed them, the computer set up with guest wifi access and a handy “guide to the home” to refer to. Just what we needed. Thanks Melissa!

Such a tranquil, natural setting. The perfect spot to unwind while on holiday.
Sue made everything about my stay so easy. She was warm and friendly and added a number of personal touches to make my stay even more enjoyable.
I hope to have the opportunity to stay here again in the future.

A friend and I stayed at Anthony's place for four nights. The location of the place is great, but if you're looking for privacy you won't find a lot of it - since the studio and Anthony's own place face each other with big window panels and Anthony works from home. The studio space is functional, though the kitchen is quite ill-equiped. Anthony provides two well-functioning bikes, which is absolutely wonderful! We had a misunderstanding regarding our departuretime which was quite frustrating to us, but Anthony of course can't alone be blamed for this.
Good advice: keep doors and windows shut after sun down - we we're invaded by mosquitos. Nevertheless, they are no problem during daytime!
Nice apartment, tidy, everything as described, good accessibility to transit. Linton and the management company he works with are great communicators.

This lovely little apartment is situated in an excellent location and provides a great spot from which to enjoy all the best that Melbourne has to offer. It is fitted out in a tasteful, creative way and has a lovely ambience. The communication from the host was top class and we had a trouble-free and most enjoyable stay. Thanks Linton.
A clean and comfortable apartment. Communications with the host were very good, ideally situated for PT to the city or elsewhere, Enjoyed my stay there ,       Les

The place was quite nice although heating not very good, I expected more for the price, but it is an expensive area I guess. We were comfortable. The location was good for trams and train into the city. Nice pub, Chinese dumpling cafe and awesome breakfast spot on the doorstep, but 15 min walk to nearest shop. Kitchen not well equipped.
Linton was a great host and due to my error in bookings he was able to allow us to check in a day early. Communication was good, prompt with easy check in details.
Pleasant enough place for a stay not far from the Melbourne CBD. Close to transfer and bus and a good pub next door. Drawback is that the apartment is on the second floor and no lift.

Amazing place, exactly as described, perfect location close to the three type of public transport. Check-in process and communication impeccable.  Definitely a place to discover one of the coolest suburbs of Melbourne and also close enough to the city. 100% recommended.
Cosy little one bedroom. Beautiful location. Right by the train station but no noise from it.

The flat offers affordable and conveniently located accommodation. For a single traveller, it offers a secure and comfortable retreat at the end of day time activities. While close to Rushall Station, Queens Parade and a childcare centre, the flat is quiet inside offering a place for good night's rest. I did like having the small balcony off the lounge for the fresh air and outlook.  A bonus is the off-street car parking space.
Lovely, tidy and clean. Very comfy bed and great location, just next to a train station and tram stop. Quiet except for the occasional train sounds
We enjoyed our 2 night stay, the apartment was compact but everything we needed, comfy bed, nice linens a few pantry essentials. Communication with host was excellent.

Me and my sister stayed here for a few weeks for her summer holiday as she wanted to explore Melbourne as a potential destination for uni. We found the place very convenient to travel around Melbourne as all forms of public transport are nearby. Overall, a good place to stay.

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed staying at Andrew's place in North Carlton. Being able to use the two bikes that come with his place was just fantastic. We never used any other means of transportation other than traveling to and from the airport. The Studio is spacious and equipped with everything we needed for our long weekend stay. Andrew was there when needed but did not invade our space. We will be back for next time we visit Melbourne.

I appreciated Anthony's flexibility and willingness to accommodate our check in time. It was great to have separate, private entrance and the studio was basically comfortable and provided what we needed. The location was good, although not as close to family as we had hoped.

Such an epic place to stay in an awesome neighborhood!!! The studio is great - large table for working, epic shower, really comfy bed, and awesome local hosts who are very very very nice and helpful. There's great public transport connections to everywhere, and the best food is nearby too. It's clean and quiet and really charming. Highly recommended!

This is a really well located studio which would suit a couple, (and possibly one extra). Close to local shops for all you need and tram into the city. It has everything required; comfy bed, nice shower, good kitchen space, and it feels safe and secure with the owners across the courtyard. It's private and quiet, and an interesting space to live in.
Fantastic place with great set up. Perfect location for biking to city or along bike path. Nice coffee spots nearby. Andrew and family are great hosts.
Fantastic place to stay, we loved it! Great accommodation, great location and friendly hosts. We'd love to go back
We love Studio 3054. It's the third time we've stayed. It's a great space, great location, friendly hosts. Everything we need in Melbourne.

The apartment was exactly what we needed at that time. Eduardo was very responsive and friendly. The apartment is not one of the modern style ones, could use an upgrade, but it was equipped with everything one needs. We really enjoyed our stay and definitely would book it a second time.

Thank you to our host. The place truly is a great little bolt hole to experience inner city living in Melbourne. Transport, bike tracks, park lands, cafes, bars, galleries, shopping and the CBD are all so close. The style and amenity set up in the studio, especially the audio visual equipment is an added bonus. I real hidden gem. We hope to come and stay again.

We stayed at Anthony and Cinthya's beautiful studio for a week of sightseeing and dance workshops in Melbourne. It was a great home base and we hope to be back!
