The space is furnished in fun and original style, the outdoor courtyard spaces are lovely, and the location convenient for walking and trams, plus there are free cycles! The hosts (including fluffy cat) were friendly and easy to communicate with, and provided lots of good local tips too!

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Anthony's place. It was a roomy space with good kitchen and lounge areas. It was attractively furnished with an excellent atmosphere. We found the bed to be very comfortable. There was limited shelving space in the bathroom and storage space for bags and clothes. However these were generally minor issues and we enjoyed our stay thoroughly.
we loved the location being within a very short stroll to Nicholson St and with a couple of really good cafes and the tram route to the city.
Anthony provided an excellent level of communication making sure everything was ok and responding quickly and clearly to any questions we had.
We would happily stay here again.
Fantastic stylish space in a great location. Anthony and Cinthya are great hosts, very accommodating and easy to get in touch with. This was my second stay at their place, which I highly recommend.

Absolutely loved this place. Great space, great location and a fabulous Melbourne inner city vibe. Especially loved that it had a very big dining space and table. Easy check in and out. Parking on  the street right outside was very handy (parking permit provided by hosts)  Very highly recommend.
Great central place to stay whilst visiting family. Anthony’s communication was great and extremely helpful with tips for the local ‘bests’ . Will look to stay again when we return!
Great studio close to teams. We have stayed a number of times. Well appointed including thoughtful supplies. Very clean and comfortable bed. Clear and quick communication. Highly recommended.
Always good to stay here as it’s very convenient to trams, bike tracks and walks. Tried the cafe over the road this time which was great.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Charming accommodation in a great location with really hospitable hosts. We look forward to returning on our next visit to Melbourne. Thanks Anthony and Cinthya.

Anthony's place was a great place to stay. Very funky vibe, easy tramride into town, the local shops were varied & accessible. The neighbourhood is very cool. Over the road is a cycleway that runs around the city so the bikes are a great idea. The place was quiet & had everything we may have needed & more. Anthony was a great host. Very much recommended.

We had a great week here, loved the place and location. Close to parks, great local cafes and restaurants, easy to get into town. The studio itself is large, lots of vibe, everything we needed, and the courtyard was perfect for morning coffee.

This is our 2nd stay here & as before it met all our expectations. Walking distance to hotels , cafes & shops. Short walk to tram stop which goes right into the city. Great communication from hosts. Looking to stay again. Recommended.

Rob and Libby were very welcoming. The cottage is set in a beautiful part of the Dandenongs and when I woke up I was in another world. My hosts cooked me a dinner of organic chicken and breakfast with fresh orange juice was particularly welcome. They encouraged me to use the many walking trails in the vicinity to make the most of the location.

The accommodation was fresh, clean, spacious and very comfortable with its own ensuite attached.

Wow this charming little cottage in The Patch was just perfect for taking respite from the city. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will book again without hesitation. Heartfelt thanks to Rob & Libby for spoiling us with awesome accommodation, beautiful food, friendship & generosity. We will definitely return :)
Kindest regards Michele & Steve

A beautiful drive through the Dandenong ranges took us to this lovely accommodation.  Rob and Libby are awesome hosts.  We felt so spoiled !  From Libby's yummy muffins to Rob's delicious cooked breakfasts, and a very comfortable bed.  We were very well looked after.  Our little boy had an awesome time exploring the garden, and plinking on the piano!  Inside and outside there is so much character to this place.  Definitely bring your camera!  A big thank you to Rob and Libby.  See you next time we are in Victoria!

Great host!
Nice and clean house.
Generous and tasty breakfast was provided.

Rob and Libby welcomed us with tea and water melon (it was a hot day). The front yard looked picture perfect with a family dining table under the shady trees. The house wing we had the use of was as described, with original features and lovely decorator touches. The entry and dining room were fairly dark, but the sunroom /lounge and bedrooms were lovely and light.  Breakfast was provided and plenty of food supplied on arrival. Such a great treat to find fresh bread, milk, fruit and dips. And more!

My partner Hugh, his elderly father David (90) and I spent 3 nights in the Pioneer Cottage.  Rob & Libby were wonderful hosts; even cooking us pumpkin soup to eat on arrival (to help make the day a little easier for David after our long travel) .  The accommodation was beautiful; just as the photos show.  The beds were comfy and warm.  Both Rob and Libby were very generous with their time; Libby even picking us up after our one-way trip on the Puffing Billy (which we highly recommend) and Rob cooking us a beautiful breakfast of bacon and eggs on two of the mornings we were there.  There were plenty of other healthy goodies to nibble on throughout the day; fruit, yogurt, cereal and even a lovely loaf of fresh sour dough bread.  Rob and Libby are fantastic hosts with generous spirits!  Thank you both so very much.

Rob and Libby were very helpful organizing our arrival and details in getting to The Patch. The house is lovely, and Rob had organized a great spread of breakfast options and fruit. It was a great cozy place to stay for the family, and The Patch is beautiful area of the Dandanongs.

Rob and Libby are great hosts. They have a lovely relaxing home that we made our own for the weekend. The beds and linen are so comfortable and we had wonderful night sleeps. There is so many great walks in the area and lots of places to eat locally.  We would love to come back and highly recommend staying here.  Thank you again.
It was the second time we stayed at Rob and Libby's. Once again, we had a very pleasurable time. I definitely recommend this place.

I stayed with my partner and child , rob was a great host. Although this is a shared house and not so much a private cottage we still felt like we got our own space and robs cottage is really scenic and beautiful and it was great having rob set up the fire for us. I would stay here again if rob was to place locks on the door between the guests residence and he's own so I can relax with my partner without knowing someone can walk in any time .

An absolutely magical stay - the kind of place you wouldn’t be surprised to find fairies playing in the garden.
Beautiful hosts!
Rob and Libby are great hosts.  We felt welcome and Rob and Libby were very accommodating and thoughtful.  The house is charming and cosy.  We had a great time.
Rob and Libby are fantastic hosts - super friendly and kind. The place is very homely and perfect for a little getaway. The place was also very clean, especially the bathroom.

Rob and Libby were the perfect hosts, welcoming and helpful. We received lovely treats upon arrival and had a warm and relaxing stay.
Thanks again
Warm regards
Tamara

Charming accomodation in a tranquil setting. Rob and Libby were outstanding hosts. Rob is full of local tips and knowledge about the area and went out of his way to ensure our family had wonderful holiday.
Mystical, semi-rural accommodation in the hills amongst genuine, hospitable mountain people. Recommended for families and those looking to get away from the banalities of every day life.

Fireplace was so gorgeous and relaxing and the flowers around the place a special touch. Breakfast selection and nibblies were great.
Lots of books and board games.
Peaceful haven

This is a charming cottage with Libby and Rob living alongside in the extension. There is no kitchen but microwave and fridge available and plenty of breakfast items provided, and your kind hosts will wash the dishes! Unfortunately we arrived during a heatwave but Rob and Libby looked after us so well with cold drinks and fruit. My kids also loved visiting the sheep at the end of the garden. Thanks!

We had a great stay at Rob and Libby's. We were kindly greeted and given thoughtful tips about where to eat / visit. Rob and Libby were quick to communicate and graciously allowed us a last minute late check out after our flight was changed. A really lovely place amongst a beautiful garden, great as a base for exploring the Dandenongs.

The best hospitality ever experienced. Rob & Libby are just all round fantastic people, wonderful in every way. I highly rrecommend you plan to visit to their very special cottage in the stunning Dandenong ranges.

A great place to stay for a getaway to the Dandenong Ranges as it was cosy, comfy and just a short drive to everything in the area . My family loved Rob and Libby's hospitality and my kids loved checking for eggs from the chickens. Would recommend a stay here for many many reasons.

Rob and Libby’s home was just as sweet and warm as they were. The house is absolutely beautiful, and they are the most delightful hosts. Not only were they super flexible and accomodating when I made an error communicating check in times, Libby baked us some muffins and we had personal tour of the home. We also had a visit from a wombat on arrival! The only thing to note is that Rob and Libby also live on the property. As they are such lovely people this shouldn’t be an issue, but as we were all attending a wedding we were a bit worried we’d wake them up when we arrived home late after a big night. Thank you so much for welcoming us into your home Rob and Libby :)

They are very kind, friendly and generous hosts. The accommodation is comfortable and in a great location for sightseeing.
They have chickens!
It is a beautiful and authentic place. Rob and Libby made us feel at home right from the start and are very helpful regarding suggestions for things to do in the neighborhood.

We absolutely loved our stay in this beautiful cottage. Set in an idyllic location and hosted by the most lovely people, we had a great few days and hope
To come back.

Thank you for a lovely stay in your beautiful cottage with all the old world charm combined with all modern comforts. The cottage had everything we needed to feel at home. The home baked fruit scones and blackberry muffins by Libby(Owner) were very awesome. We got a very warm reception and Rob was very polite and helpful. Enjoyed our stay. Highly recommend.

My daughter and I enjoyed our stay at Rob and Libby’s cottage. The location of the property was close to everything and the surroundings were lovely.
The beds were comfortable, there were some board games we enjoyed playing and the delicious scones were very much appreciated as well!! Thanks again!! 😊
Fantastic place. I would definitely recommend. Libby and Rob are very thoughtful.  The beds are very comfortable and the blankets cozy. The baked goodies were a welcome treat.

A beautiful unit. Much roomier than it looks in the photos. Splendid period furnishings and decor. The continental breakfast was generous with lots of choices. The kids loved the beautiful and spacious gardens. Would definitely stay again.

Rob and Libby were incredible hosts, going far and beyond what they had to, to accommodate our specific needs and ensure our stay was as good as it could be.
Their communication was quick, and Libby even called me to assist where needed.
Gorgeous cottage too. Like stepping back in time.
Thanks for a great stay!

We enjoyed our four night stay at Rob and Libby’s accomodation. We were visiting our son and daughter-in-law and granddaughter who were close by. It was very comfortable and suited our needs.
Rob and Libby were very welcoming and we appreciated their kindness in providing a light supper for us on our late arrival.

We loved our stay at Libby and Rob’s place! Their hospitality was truly wonderful — from the warm fire and the beautiful handmade cakes waiting for us on arrival, to all the thoughtful touches for our 5-year-old daughter. The house itself is beautiful, very clean, and incredibly comfortable. Our daughter especially enjoyed playing the piano — such a lovely bonus! Thank you again for making our stay so special. Highly recommended!

We had the most relaxing and peaceful stay at this beautiful cottage. It is full of period features and was so comfortable and cosy warm in the middle of winter with heaters in every room. The open fire place was a real bonus. Libby and Rob were wonderful hosts full of recommendations for local places to eat and wonderful walks. We will definitely be back.
Amazing location, beautiful apartment! The new decor is fab. Nicole was very helpful, I would definitely stay in this place again.

Stayed at Nicole's apartment over the weekend with a couple friends for an event at the Hisense arena. The location was great, just a few minutes walk from the event and a short taxi ride to the city. The apartment itself was gorgeous, clean, spacious, modern and well furnished. Nicole was great to deal with, prompt replies and accommodating. Would definitely recommend staying with her, and will be back for future trips to Melbourne.

Nicole's place was perfect in every way. Super clean and comfortable apartment, beautiful view of the city, excellent location and a wonderful host who made sure that we didn't have to worry about a single thing while there.

The listing was accurate in every tiny detail, starting from acquiring the keys to the apartment, to accessing the parking spot under the building, to the various amenities within the place, to the super helpful list of places around the apartment that we could enjoy during our stay there.

I would highly recommend this listing to anyone who wants a super comfortable and headache free trip to Melbourne.

We were lucky enough to stay here for two nights whilst we enjoyed a fantastic weekend. The location is absolutely perfect! Especially if you're going to the MCG. There are plenty of places to eat as well, and there's a 7-Eleven just a one minute walk away, to stock up on the necessities. There was a big couch for all 5 of us to easily fit on comfortably and relax, whilst having a drink together or watching tv.
The apartment was stocked with everything you need, such as washing machine, dishwasher, dishes and cutlery. The beds were very comfortable as well, and towels and extra bedding was there if needed.
Communication with Nicole was easy, and she was very quick to respond, with helpful and detailed responses.
Overall, a wonderful experience, and we can't wait to return.
A fantastic little house with an amazing view. Everything was communicated extremely well and I thank you for making our stay so great!

Great apartment in lovely location of Melbourne. Nice and quiet in the evening with easy access to City & Richmond. Furnishings etc all well maintained which add to the enjoyment and ability to enjoy any downtime you have. Nicole ensured arrival was well supported and no issues experienced. Recommend staying with her and hope to return another time soon.
Great location & clean. Bit smaller than I thought but fine for 2 adults & 2 kids. Nicole was great & really helpful

Great little city pad with wonderful evening sunset views over the inner North. And only a few stops down from Flinders. In the evenings we walked back along the river and past the stadium. Very relaxed and comfortable with we everything we needed.

Overall was good. Location was great as the tram station is just right in front of the building. However the wifi was really bad. Good for cooking and the dryer is really convenient as we do our laundry almost everyday. Place is clean and the beds are comfortable.

This apartment was in a fantastic location. We would stay again just based on that. Being at the back of the building it still had great views but was nice and quiet.
We had a small parking issue which Nicole sorted straight away. Nicole was quick to reply to messages. The apartment could have been cleaner but overall we enjoyed our stay here.

This place was awesome and the views were great.. would most definitely recommend this place..especially if you are going for a sporting event at AAMI park or MCG..its just walking distance..thankyou Nicole

Nicole was very easy to deal with. All communication was replied to quickly, and any requests were taken care of straight away. We have a great stay! Accommodation is within walking distance of the Australian Open and the MCG. Very convenient!
Unfortunately we were a bit disappointed about the cleanliness of this apartment. The location to the MCG was fantastic though.

Great location, close to CBD, but also able to easily go for a 5-10k run completely in parkland from doorstep.  Apartment was very clean, light and airy, lovely views as in photos, and for our family of four worked very well with us in the master bedroom and kids with bunks.  Would recommend.

Awesome location so convenient to the city.  I will definitely be staying again.  Very responsive when there is an issue.  Awesome view and nice and quiet being up high and off the street a good place to recharge from the city.
Perfect space for small groups! Stayed here as a group of 5 and there was plenty of space. Excellent communication too, 10/10. :)
Nicole was very responsive and provided lots of local information.  Tram and train directly outside and walking distance to many cafe's restaurants, wine shop etc so this is a very easy location.
place was lovely to stay at, location was perfect and very central to everything we wanted. communication with nicole was super easy.

The way Nicole handled a check-in dilemma was absolutely 10/10 and went above and beyond what many other hosts do. The rest of our stay was magnificent and the apartment was amazing. Will definitely keep in mind to return next time I'm in Melbourne.

Nicole was very nice and prompted response to our booking.
She arranged to meet us on check-in for a Verry pleasant and stressles transaction.
Thank you 😊

Nicole's stay has a great location, located just a short walk from the MCG and is easily accessible by public transport. The views are extremely nice and we really loved the theme of the apartment. Highly recommend!

Absolutely perfect in every way.
Kind hosts.
Comfy bed (appreciate being able to watch TV from main bedroom)
Street permit was also given for my use as my FWD is over 2m high.
Amazing location for the footy season being so close to the MCG

Perfect for a family weekend at the footy! Nicole was available to answer any questions we had to ensure it was a comfortable stay.
Beautiful view and blinds kept the room dark so even the kids slept in!
Location couldn’t get any better.

We had a great time at Nicole’s apartment. Extremely clean and comfortable. Superb host. Communication was super easy and quick. Check in was a breeze. Nicole was so thoughtful; went above to make us all feel special. Apartment looks exactly like on pictures. Very convenient to the MCG, walking distance 5 minutes and to CBD. Highly recommend.

The apartment was very welcoming with a nice feel and sweet decor.
The pool was fantastic and the parking was incredibly helpful.
A great location with so much in very easy walking distance.
Nicole was incredibly responsive to messages as well as helpful and supportive of our whole stay.
Thank you !!!!
Excellent host, very helpful and a great location. Close to tram stop and Rod Laver Arena.
Nicole went out of her way to help us and was so friendly to communicate with.  We’d stay again
This apartment was perfect for me and 3 friends for a  weekend getaway in Melbourne. Everything you need is right on your door step.
Very good place to stay! Had some problems with a key and Nicole was there to help within 5 minutes. Very helpful and great location to stay at.

The property is in a good location, easy access to transport and great restaurants nearby. Apartment is well equipped with everything you need. Nicole is easy to communicate with and access instructions are simple.

I am so extremely grateful that the stars aligned and I was able to stay at Nicole’s East Melbourne apartment over the past week - it was the prime location for everything I had planned over the weekend and it was the perfect size for the 3 of us!

We were fortunate to get a booking here at short notice after our holiday plans changed. The location was so convenient with the tram and train both very very close. The apartment was clean and quiet and had everything we expected. Parking was tight as mentioned by other guests but our Tarago fitted fine in the space. Nicole was a responsive and helpful host and promptly organised for a top up of the coffee since it was running low. We all loved the view including of hot air balloons on each morning of our stay.

To visit and work in Melbourne this was great location. Tram, train, walk plus with car park too I was able to go everywhere easily.
This sunny aspect apartment has all the key goods and service you might need.
I had an extended stay and it felt like a second home.
Nicole and Chris were very helpful with my requests and generous with the new equipment

Everything was exactly as we were expecting. Nicole was absolutely fabulous. Always checking we had everything we needed and also responding to questions quickly.
Great place to stay.
THANKS FOR EVERYTHING NICOLE 🙂🙂
Nicole was very lovely and helpful and made me feel right at home...Would be glad to stay there again and it was a great location also....Thank you..

There are beautiful views through the apartment windows.  Sometimes, you can see balloons in the sky. The car park is very convenient for us. There is a bakery and a restaurant nearby, and public transport is convenient. Nicole provides clean check-in instructions. Thanks for hosting us.

Jayne's house is by far the nicest house I've ever stepped foot in.  It is conveniently located close to tram lines but still tucked away from any traffic,  perfect for a light sleeper.  Jayne was very helpful and accommodating and made my stay in Melbourne enjoyable.  I would definitely come back to stay here again and would highly recommend her place to anyone looking for a nice relaxing holiday.
Jayne’s home is very stylishly designed in a stunning and a very well maintained Victorian house. We enjoyed our time spent in her home.

Our stay at Jayne’s home was better than we could have imagined! She is such a thoughtful, kind, and responsive host. Her house was very clean and comfortable. Sharing a house with Jayne was a joy and her home was easily accessible by tram. Highly recommend!!

Jayne and her listing were lovely. Her home is beautiful and has absolutely everything you need for a comfortable stay and more. Jayne gave us recommendations for food and things to do in the area and made us feel right at home. There are plenty of local restaurants/stores within walking distance and tram/bus stops very close by to get the the city. Overall, would highly recommend staying with Jayne and we look forward to returning!

Maja is absolutely lovely, and was very helpful with directions, check in time and checking out.

The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed. It was close to transport and in a very pretty area with nice walking and many places to eat.

Thanks very much!
Excellent small flat that is ideal for 2 persons. We stayed here now for the second time and all was as described.

Maja made contact with us and ensured that we had arrived safely and were happy with everything. The apartment is gorgeous and we felt right at home, it was just a shame that we were out and about so much - it would have been nice to spend more time there. The location is fantastic and the apartment complex is very quiet and safe. There are so many amazing cafes and restaurants in the area and Brunswick St and Smith St are only 10 mins away. The neighbours were all friendly in passing. We accidentally left something in the fridge and Maja went out of her way to make sure we got it back. We can't recommend this apartment enough and would love to come back again sometime.
Maja's home is cute and homey, she provided us with loads of information about the area. We had a great stay thanks Maja!
Really amazing location, overall fantastic place to stay and Maja is a diligent host. I would only say that tall folks may find it uncomfortable due to smaller furnishings.
Cute place. Great location. Really great service. Maja is super quick to respond and available if you need anything, without being at all instrusive. Thank you!

Great location and so quiet just out of the city. Close to public transport or easy parking. Very comfortable for a single or a couple and fully equipped, otherwise plenty of variety of places to eat and/or drink close by. Safe and good security. Really enjoyed my stay and despite a 40 degree day / 30 degree night the AC managed.

We loved Maja's place for its fab location and sweet decor. Maja is an excellent host helping out with public transport instructions and a tip for a great breakfast spot. The apartment is very comfortable and has all you need. You can walk to public transport, shops, cafes and restaurants and take a short tram ride to the city or nightlife options in the funky Fitzroy area. Maja was a great communicator too. Would recommend this lovely spot in quiet, leafy North Fitzroy
Very sweet and neat place in the one of the best locations in Melbourne. Perfect for one or two people.
Greatly recommend the place. Good location. Lovely little townhouse with all amenities. Maja is also very nice host and gives very clear instructions. Definitely 5 ⭐️
Maja's place will not disappoint. Nice and close to everything you need and it's very homely feel makes it welcoming. Highly recommend this lovely townhouse.

Loved this place! Standard block of units from the outside, but walking into Maja’s was like walking into a sweet & quirky country cottage. It was the perfect size for us & had everything we needed. Such a cute & thoughtful layout. Awesome location near the park, & lots of cafes. Easy access to the city. Self serve check-in was quick & easy. Maja was super accommodating of all our requests & really responsive. We go to Melbourne quite a bit & would love to stay here again! Highly recommend :)
Maja’s town house is beautiful with a very traditional layout and period furniture. The home feels warm and cozy and is so close to some amazing cafes and bakeries. Would stay again!
Maja was a great host and was super flexible with checking in and out. The house is very stylish and was perfect for our weekend away.
Great location, a bath to soak in, quirky little details in this cottage with lots of floral decorations! Cute teacups. Really quiet and handy as here was a car space. Communication was fantastic.
Great place, spacious and clean, just needs a couple of small bits and bobs outside and in the kitchen, would stay again. Pleasant break with lots of swimming.
Great space but part of house in need of repair with plumbing and carpets. Mildew and terrible mold issues.
This place is in a good location, and is very homely. Maja is very helpful and it had everything I needed for a short stay.
My partner and I had a wonderful stay at Maja's place. It was just an overnight stay in the city but we thoroughly enjoyed it. Cozy space, perfect location and we had an amazing nights sleep!
Loved my stay at Maja’s place. Walking distance to many charming parts of Melbourne, and a beautifully clean and comfortable base to keep coming back to.

A great spot especially for solo travellers with a easy access car park and public transport nearby. Maja was really easy to communicate with and provided really good instructions and directions. Will definitely be back for my next work trip.

The place is perfect for a short stay in the City. Great local shops, bars and cafes, very close public transport and a quiet residential street. So much to do within a 15 minute walk. The place was cosy, clean today and well appointed
Lovely, cosy spot with good heating and a bath tub. Great location and checking in/out was simple.

Maja is absolutely lovely - facilitated an easy check in, check out and provided plenty of information prior to and during my stay.
The townhouse is as described and pictured, but it’s worth noting that the living area is very dimly lit.
The walls between the neighbours are quite thin, and you can hear everything in the townhouses next door.
This Air BnB seems to be someone’s home, likely living in this house between guests.
I found the bedding was visually clean, but the doona smelled quite dated and slept in - and the whole apartment smelled like it could use a good air out. The towels provided also had a strong odour.
The apartment looked clean (in relation to vacuuming, clean bench tops etc) however it’s quite an old property and that shows.
The location is great; in walking distance of many great cafes and public transport.
Great location, tidy and clean, very fun decor! Maja was very communicative, made everything very easy.

Thanks Maja for a lovely stay. Everything was as expected and apartment is just like the pictures. Maja was incredibly prompt and helpful with her replies to any communication sent. Nice quiet and convenient location.

Quaint townhouse in the best spot in Melbourne. Very close to lots of cafes, restaurants and boutique shopping. The apartment was clean and well equipped, and the water pressure in the shower was amazing. The only thing I’d note to future guests is that the double bed has both a head and end, so if you are tall (like my boyfriend is) you may find it a bit cramped. Overall a lovely stay.
The place felt homey, which was really nice (especially when it was cold and rainy out). Communication was easy, quick and friendly. Would definitely book again!

Our stay was great! Maja is a lovely host, very helpful and easy to get hold on when needed. The place is in a nice and quiet location with some great restaurants and cute cafes. Buses, train and tram close by and walking distance to more lively areas. The only downside is that there was no wifi.

A cute comfortable little townhouse in the heart of the inner northern suburbs.
We loved the convenience of the location and thought it was reasonably priced. Maja was very helpful and proactive with her communication.
Quiet place for a home base for a few days in Melbourne. Central to transport and eateries. Easy to find. Leafy area.

This is the second time that I have been able to stay in Maja's home and I love it here.  The atmosphere is warm and welcoming and feels like home, unlike a hotel room.  The area is leafy green, quiet and safe with a mix of lovely and friendly neighbours.  Walking distance to Clifton Hill and North Fitzroy shopping strips as well as Smith and Brunswick Streets for an eclectic mix of stores and restaurants.  Tram close by for a quick trip in to the CBD, museums and the art centre.  Perfect for me.  Thank you Maja.
A lovely stay at Maja’s. Great location in a beautiful neighbourhood. Maja is a great host, would highly recommend!
Maja was super accommodating and helpful. The house is gorgeous and comfortable, well located to public transport. Would definitely recommend.

Thank you for a lovely stay- the house is so lovely and cosy. It is such a nice size for two people to stay, lots of space! Maja was also so good with communicating and sending us messages☺️ We really had such a nice time and enjoyed staying in a place that really felt like a home away from home.

Ideal location for easy access to train/tram/grocery while also quiet and relaxing.  Maja was super responsive and readily answered any questions we had during our 3-week stay.  When back in Melbourne, if available, we will definitely stay here again.

Great location - close to restaurants, supermarket, a beautiful park, tram and train station, cafes, and gyms. A short walk away from Smith and Brunswick Street. The accommodation was exactly as pictured and described!
Amazing little place, which is a perfect base to explore Fitzroy and greater Melbourne. Such a warm and relaxing space to come home to after a long day on foot.

The white room felt like a little haven we could escape too after long days spent exploring the city. The bed was very comfortable. The temperature of the room just right and apart from the disturbance of a possum on the roof for two nights, we slept well. The location is excellent. We were close to fantastic eateries on Brunswick and Smith Street. We would happily recommend this place and stay here again.

it was a great experience to stay at the white house. the north fitzroy was a great place to go out. I found a lot of nice places to enjoy. the studio was sunny and cozy and very photogenic. thanks for everything Lynda!
This place is awesome. Very tastefully and thoughtfully decorated. In fact, the place is pretty much perfect in every respect. Highly recommended!!!

My third stay at Lynda's, and each time I am more excited than the last to enter her little oasis, yet be so close to all the buzz and activity that makes Melbourne wonderful. Can't imagine staying anywhere else, thank you
We stayed here on our wedding night and it was fantastic! Such a cute place hidden in the ally way.
Excellent place for a relaxing weekend in Melbourne enhanced by eclectic space and great location. Tested out a lot of the tips provided by Lynda and they were spot on. Highly recommend.

Loved our stay at Lynda's place. We didn't want to leave. Loved the greenery which made it feel like a serene retreat, despite being located close to the action. Very convenient location,  comfortable beds and great communication. Thank you!

It's quite simply the most special treat to stay here... all your senses will be tickled... such a beautiful, whimsical style everywhere you look; the most scrumptious smelling hand soaps and moisturisers; a yummy healthy breaky provided; the most comfortable bed and sheets imaginable; and a quiet serene little space where you'll sleep like a baby,forgetting you were in such a busy city. I can't recommend it highly enough. Looking forward to my trip back in March already!
The White Room is a lovely escape from the bustling city yet close enough to everything. Lynda provided everything I needed as well as wonderful ideas about what to do in the area.

Lynda’s apartment is such a stylish and one of a kind experience! Check in was a breeze with clear instructions. The place was also clean and located conveniently just next to the tram to get into the city. Lynda is such a kind and accommodating host, it was a pleasure staying at The White Room!
Cosy yet not enclosed, stylish yet understated, clean, great shower, great location, would highly recommend.

A beautiful space to relax, with that extra touch to make it feel special such as great bedlinen and towels to some breakfast staples. And within walking distance to so many amazing places to eat and drink. We will definitely be back.
The White Room nurtured me during a solo 5 day lockdown. It was a beautiful, restive home and Lynda’s correspondence made me feel connected while in isolation. And that courtyard!

Lynda’s properties are always a standout for me. It’s the attention to detail that sets The White Room apart - French linen sheets, freshly squeezed orange juice in the fridge, quality bathroom products, detailed recommendations of nearby haunts. I rate my stays in her spaces higher than a lot of the five star hotels I’ve been to. No doubt I’ll be back!

We loved our stay at the White Room, it’s an experience in itself. The space is expertly styled, cosy, comfortable and private.
The location is fantastic with trams close by and many great little wine bars, pubs and outdoor dining areas within walking distance.
We really appreciated your recommendations and worked through quite a number on your list.

An absolutely dreamy little hideaway in the middle of the inner Fitzroy North. We loved it. Quiet but very convenient walk just about anywhere location, comfy bed, filled with character, it was gorgeous. The White Room has that special something that is often sort but rarely found.
Such a lovely space in the best area of Melbourne. Lynda is eager to please with suggestions or whatever you need. Would stay again!

Lynda’s studio was a delight to stay in. The decor was a treat for the eyes and the general feeling was one of sophisticated opulence yet cozy simplicity. The bed was very comfortable and the location was excellent, close to lovely bars and cute restaurants. I highly recommend this little oasis.

We had the most beautiful stay in the White Room. Ive been a long time fan of Lynda's, she has a real gift at curating the most stunning spaces. Every inch of the space is well thought out and presented. She has compiled such a comprehensive list of all the amazing restaurants and paces to visit around the area, although we really didn't feel like leaving the space at all.
My favourite parts of the stay, besides the obviously incredible interior, were the heated floor (disguised the fact that we had just entered the first few days of winer), The gorgeous little courtyard and vines growing all over the windows and house (turning the red and orange hues of autumn) and the comfiest and cosiest cloud bed (that i wanted to stay in forever).
Thank you for having us <3 Cant wait to come back as well as stay in your other properties some day xx

Lynda's airbnb is in a central location and easy to walk to everything.  The styling is so interesting and I loved the special touches such as the teas, coffee, breakfast and the books and magazines.  The bed was super comfortable and the under floor heating is so perfect for a cold winter stay in Melbourne.
This is a gorgeous stay. It’s small but has everything, and perfect for couples. Lovely styling as the pictures suggest :)
Honestly, a big WOW walking in, warm, cosy, thought i was in Paris.. everything and more exceeded my expectation’s. So many extra touches and a brilliant romantic weekend.. what a find.

The White Room is very special. I just loved it. Filled with charm and delightful quirky finds. Lynda is a warm and gracious hostess. It will become my home away from home every time I am in Melbourne. Can’t recommend it enough.

Kim was a great host. She was easy to talk to and organise our stay with. The place was very clean when we arrived and had everything we needed for our stay. The location was perfect for us and was close to everything we needed (eg. cafes, bars, grocery store, tram line, etc). I would definitely book this place again.

Kim's apartment was fantastic. Open, airy and beautifully styled. The location is unbeatable and perfectly positioned between cafes , transport and the Fitzroy Pool. Kim approved our stay the morning of our travel and was incredibly kind and communicative. We will definitely stay again! Thanks Kim!
Cozy place with comfy bed. Great location nearby many shops and cafes. 3 min walk to the tram stop that takes you the CBD so very convenient.
We had a lovely stay at Kim and Deans place, we really got more than what we payed for such a nice space and a great location would highly recommend

Kim and Dean's place is a great place to stay if you're looking at immersing yourself in the shops and restaurants near by (walking distance). The home was very clean and check in was easy. I corresponded with Dean who was super quick and helpful with his replies. Overall, I highly recommend staying here.
This apartment is conveniently located and tastefully furnished. It is quite nice. My only concern was a shower with poor drainage resulting in overflow into the bedroom.

This is a great place in an awesome location. However, one may want to know about the construction and that the door opens out onto Cecil street, not Napier.
Overall, I really enjoyed staying here and Fitzroy is a superb part of Melbourne.

Kim and Dean's place is so nice.The location is in a hip neighborhood with great restaurants , stores and amazing vibe. It is right across from the dog park and pool. Spotlessly clean, simple yet cool decor. Only complaint ,if any ,was the bathroom sink was really small. I would stay again in a heart beat .

Kim and Deans place was great. Amazing location right off Brunswick st, easy public transport, great cafes, bars and restaurants super close. Close proximity to some of Melbournes best parks. Super quick and helpful responses every time. The only negative was the other people that lived in the building have a shared veggie garden right outside the main window. So is pretty awkward if you’re just relaxing on the couch or getting in and out of the shower and forget to close the blinds as they are right there. Otherwise, great place

Kim and Dean's place is situated in a perfect, convenient location with lots to do and eat! Slightly small toilet (which is understandable for an apartment in a prime location) but overall we had a lovely stay. Our requests were accommodated by Dean to the best of his ability.
Lovely clean tidy apartment. Loved the light airy feel of the place. Really close to Brunswick St and delicious restaurants. Thanks for a enjoyable stay.
Super convenient location, loved going for a swim at the pools across the road! Place was super clean and cozy.

We had a wonderful stay at Kim & Dean’s place. The location is just amazing, in a quiet street but right in the heart of Fitzroy. We enjoyed our morning swim across the street. The apartment is well taken care of and bright, and we enjoyed the recommendations by Dean. Once again, a great stay!

Great place for visiting inner city Melbourne but without the hassle of noise, parking, driving in the heart of the city. Great value and plenty of room for a one-bedder. Very well appointed and supplied with some extra goodies

Kim and Dean were great hosts. Super quick responses and really easy check in and out. Very convenient location and close to all the shops. They left us fresh eggs, milk and sparkling water in the fridge, which was a lovely touch. Would definitely stay again.

Kim and Dean’s is brilliantly situated and was perfect for our long weekend visiting our daughter and Melbourne friends. Close to great pubs cafes and parks. Dean was very helpful and accomodating. Highly recommended!

Beautiful stay at Kim & Deans apartment. It was very clean, light filled & modern. Fully equipped kitchen with everything I needed to cook some meals. Perfect quiet area a short stroll to Brunswick St or Smith St. Kim & Dean were easily contactable & extremely helpful with any queries I had. Would definitely stay again.

There’s no better location if you want to be in the trendiest part of Melbourne - bordering Brunswick St in Fitzroy and Smith St in Collingwood, you will not want to leave these place and will fall completely in love with the charm surrounding you. Super neat cleverly put together space with lots of charming touches - cannot recommend enough!

Kim and Dean's place is really lovely and the decor is stunning. The place was far more spacious than the photos show and perfect for a single occupant or couple. we stayed 3 nights and wished we could have stayed longer. The location is incredible, with some of the best restaurants and bars just around the corner. The only thing that I'd mention is that the street light shines into the bedroom window at night and there is a bit of light that enters the room, nothing that stopped us sleeping but if you need total darkness this might be an issue. However, we absolutely loved our stay and would definitely recommend it.

A great Airbnb for our short stay in Fitzroy.
It’s in a great location just out of the city with plenty of pubs & cafes in easy walking distance.
Would definitely stay here again.

The place is in a great location. I only gave 3 stars because it lacked some thing that make a stay great. The TV was small (they're so cheap now), no access to Netflix or any streaming services, no information about the local area, recommendations etc. But, you know, maybe I'm being too fussy.

We had a wonderful stay in Fitzroy. The apartment was in a great location, very clean and had everything you would need. We were also surprised how quiet is was for being in the heart of Fitzroy and in an apartment block. Will definitely be staying again. Cheers Max & Calypso :)
We were attending a wedding and functions in Fitzroy and Carlton so it was the perfect location for our needs. Also easy access to public transport and great cafes and restaurants.

The apartment is in a satisfactory location, but the advertising photos do not reflect the current reality of the decor or fit the declaration of a bright, sparkling clean, recently renovated, vacation or work place oasis.
I am currently being treated for cancer and the advertising photos carried with them the promise of a relaxing, comfortable stay where attention to detail made it special. The apartment does provide a light filled space, but that’s due to large windows with broken, ineffective window coverings. The bed was comfortable, but the linen was far from hotel quality. It was not crisp and white, as the Airbnb pictures would have you believe. The doona cover was brown floral and well worn. The pillows were not fluffy and cosy and they were well used. The decor cushions were a tired looking disappointment, instead of an inviting enhancement. Kitchen doors were broken and the fridge made a constant noise, all night. We relocated after one night, feeling bitterly disappointed.

Kim and Dean’s place was in the perfect location in Fitzroy, a couple blocks back from the main streets so it felt nice and secluded while only being a minute or two walk to many great pubs and restaurants. The price I paid over a weekend was exceptional.

Had a great time.
Easy to find and check-in and so close to Brunswick St without the noise.
Would visit again!

Would absolutely stay here over and over. Kim and Dean's spot was super conveniently located, peaceful at night and perfectly sized for a solo (or duo) traveler.
Cosy, but spacious enough to both relax and, for those who can work from anywhere, get some work done. Will most definitely be back, if they'll have me :)
Thank you!

Kim & Dean's apartment is lovely and bright, beautifully renovated, and has everything you need in a great location. it's surprisingly quiet given the location. Easy walk to Fitzroy's greatest hits and the 11 & 86 trams. Dean was super responsive when I had an issue with one of the blinds and came to fix it as soon as he could. I'd happily stay here again
Great stay in Fitzroy, had some very minor issues which dean mentioned before we’d arrived which he was able to fix within a few hours - great host

We had a fabulous couple of nights, the apartment is a great size, excellent amenities.  Location perfect, 5 mins walk from supermarket, heaps of funky shops and restaurants.  Would go back, recommended!
Had a great time at Kim and Dean's place. They are very communicative and provided a great, clean place to stay. A really good location and I would highly recommend them and their location

Kim and Dean‘s apartment is in an excellent location, close to Brunswick and Smith Sts, with cafes, restaurants, supermarkets etc nearby. It’s in a side street so is nice and quiet. Nicely decorated and a very comfortable stay. Thank you for sharing your place, Kim and Dean!

I really enjoyed my stay here. The location of this studio flat is really perfect for a Melbourne trip: I was mainly there for a conference at the University of Melbourne so it was an easy walk. I loved being able to pop over the road for a swim at the Fitzroy pool at the end of the day, and it was easy to find things to eat nearby. Surprisingly quiet and peaceful for such an inner city spot. I was travelling by myself this time and it felt very safe.

A very comfortable stay. We appreciated the little extras ( milk, water, chocolates)!
The apartment is in a great location near to cafes, supermarket, pubs and the tram. Very clean and tidy!
Lovely stay! The jazz playing on entry was such an enjoyable and welcomed touch. Beautiful lighting and energy in this space. Thankyou for having me!

This is a really nice little apartment, right down the street from a grocery store and Fitzroy's main street. AND and excellent laundromat, if you need it! Although Fitzroy can be lively and rough around the edges at times, this stay was a great retreat when I needed it. Just the right amount of space, modern, and clean. Always felt safe and refreshed there! And it was nice to have so many restaurants just a walk away.

Great value! Great location and exactly what we needed. Fitzroy was not what we expected, very arty with lots of places to eat so we enjoyed the changed from staying right in the CBD. Hosts were excellent and prompt with communication and check out.

Meticulously thought out in terms of nurturing their guests, design, ambience, beauty. You can tell just how much love has gone into every single detail of this beautiful property. A great selection of books to get stuck into on the comfy bean bag, amazing bath for soaking in, well appointed kitchen with all you need to cook up a feast (plenty of good cook books also for inspiration. Enjoyed the separate studio, for writing and playing music in... Was nice to have a dedicated spot designed for creating. Comfy bed, heating great, very very clean but a warm homely vibe. Close to some of the most beautiful nature trails Melbourne has to offer.
The art decorated throughout the home, makes it even more special.
Host was a pleasure to deal with, everything ran very smoothly. Will be returning.... For longer this time. :)

I would highly recommend anyone considering a visit to the Jacky Winter Gardens residence to do so. The environment created by Jeremy and his team is absolutely incredible!

From the abundance of fine art, to the quality soft furnishings and the integrated smart home components. There has been no expense spared to create this luxurious stay minutes out of the main street of Belgrave.

Thanks for having us Jeremy and Lorelei!

Second time here and still absolutely charmed by this space. Beautiful in summer and beautiful in winter. I recommend this little spot to anyone who’s thinking of getting away from the city and having a little peace and quiet. You’ll feel super refreshed and recharged with the lush trees surrounding this cute house and please just get in that bath and come out feeling like a brand new person!!

It was an absolute dream to stay at the Jacky Winter Gardens. Jeremy and Lorelei were incredibly helpful and shared a detailed guide for the house and surrounding area. It was a special touch to receive their message when we arrived, asking if we were settling in well.
The house is beautiful and we loved the Sonos sound system, every thoughtful design detail, the glorious comfy bed, the soothing calm of the surrounding canopy of trees and the sound of the creek. This is a haven - we would very much recommend staying!

It’s a well positioned and decorated accommodation. We are lucky to stay here while we plan to take the puffing billy. Our kids enjoy the garden and the entertainment equipment a lot. We will come back someday.

Stylish, quite, clean and beautifully presented!
All the mod cons and more, a must see!
A very comfy bed too! We will be back.
Thanks so much for having us 😊

What to say!
Staying here was a dream, a perfect oasis and just want we needed.
It was warm and welcoming, the design and curation was inspiring.
We will be reminiscing about Jacky Winter Gardens for some time to come.
Thank you Jeremy and Lorelei, I am sure we will be back!

Thanks for our second beautiful stay at Jacky Winter Gardens!
We felt so inspired surrounded by so much art, great literature and nature. The house is such a stunning piece of design. Every feature of the house from the skirting boards to the cupboard handles have been put together in such an artful way.
The perfect birthday getaway. Can’t wait to visit again.

Oh my days. Hands down the best Airbnb we’ve ever stayed in. Inspiration in every corner. Thoughtfulness in every nook.
Great communication.
Amazing surrounds.
Their recommendation list was bang on!
I started looking at dates available for my next visit - and the first night wasn’t even over.
Special shout out to: Sonos surround sound, the fire place, the creek and wild life, the bed, the bath with Epsom salts and ALL.THE.ART.
Ps also! My kids loved it. Win.
Lorelei & Jeremy, thank you so very much.

Outstanding accommodation, very tastefully decorated, with high quality appliances and fittings, and thoughts of thoughtful touches to make our stay feel very special. The location was tranquil and calming. Exactly what we needed. Thank you!

Highly recommend a getaway to the JWG cabin. It was an incredibly relaxing stay, where we were initially greeted with the soft babbling of the creek, and immense greenery. Inside the cabin everything is well appointed, cosy, and the bath is just incredible. We will definitely be back!

What a beautiful place to escape to! Thoughtful touches like a stacked fireplace on arrival, beautiful teas and the comfiest bed. Lorelei also messaged me before arriving to let us know about the lantern festival that was on that evening and sent directions on how to avoid road closures on our way in.
The space is inspiring, clean and full of warmth, close to good food and beautiful bush walks, it was the perfect 30th birthday surprise for my partner.
Thanks so much to Lorelei and Jeremy!

This place was better than we could have hoped for. It felt like a home away from home and all the little details made the experience very enjoyable. Extremely comfy with all the amenities you could want for a weekend away.

What a wonderful time we had at this amazing place. Everything is well thought out and super comfortable, there’s a great selection of graphic novels and other books (and games), a fire, a lovely open kitchen. The outside (garden & creek) is amazing. We loved the print of the garden! We’ll be back, we had a wonderful stay with our dog and 5-year old.
Excellent location. Beautiful home. Perfect for a short stay in the hills. Thanks Jeremy and Lorelei!

A truly lovely and peaceful location and beautiful house. Our hosts were very attentive and so helpful in the lead up the check in and helped us trouble shoot a few last minute issues. They also provided a fabulous list of recommendations of places to go, things to see, food etc.

Honestly this place is like a soothing balm. Inspiration everywhere, everything is so beautiful and the house envelops you and snuggles you in as soon as you arrive. The house is super comfortable and has everything you need (I even baked!) with some added bonuses (that bath, I never wanted to leave it…) It’s within walking distance to Belgrave town & railway station, but you could just as easily keep yourself rested and entertained and never leave the house. Waking up to the sounds of birdsong and the babbling creek is just the best. Jeremy & Lorelei were so helpful, and the pack of information provided covers everything from how to use the amazing sound system in the house to where to get the best coffee. I will absolutely be back and have told everyone I know to go too - I loved this place so much. Thank you for creating this place, it’s magic ❤️

We spent a relaxing new years at Jacky Winter Gardens, it was the perfect place to escape the city and enjoy a peaceful country getaway. The location is great, close enough to Belgrave to grab a coffee or get to the Tavern for a decent pub lunch for but still secluded enough to unwind. We loved waking up to the sound of the creek! Jeremy is a great host, very responsive and provides a comprehensive guide to the property. The place has everything you need for a short stay, kitchen utensils to bathroom amenities along with a very comfortable bed.

Absolutely beautiful place, can’t put my finger on it what exactly but it all just felt right! The styling was very cool, Sonos sound system throughout the home was a cool feature and the fireplace was perfect for the chilly nights on the couch. So peaceful out the back with the ferns and sound of the creek, felt so private even though you are just 2 minutes from Belgrave. Definitely would recommend and will be coming back again and again.

This is my third time staying at Jacky Winter Gardens but it won't be the last! Impeccable interiors, superb local recommendations and 10/10 overall vibes. Lorelei & Jeremy have put a lot of love and care into sharing this special part of Melbourne with their guests and it really shows.
Such a privilege to visit and stay at JWG. Quiet and peaceful, beautiful cottage and attentive hosts. Beautiful surrounds - I recommend the Coles Ridge walk to the cafe at Grants Picnic Ground.

James is a great host and was very quick to communicate his responses and provide any answers to my questions.   Accessing the key and entry to the apartment was easy with the instructions given.  There was a welcome pack of tea, coffee, milk and biscuits when we arrived.  We had an issue with the bathroom but that will soon be improved as James is renovating it in the coming weeks.

Great place to stay at. Everything was just as advertised. Never met James, but he was always quick to reply and i was even able to check in early. Only a short walk away from shops, beach  and train station. Trams into the city just outside the building. Had a lovely time. Thanks James & Cassie!

Sheets and pillow cases not clean, we had to buy a clean sheet to sleep on.
Towels were dirty and bathroom did not look like photo.
There was old food left in the fridge like bacon.
We had noisy neighbours every night partyying at 3am.

Quite good location. This is a clean but messy apartment on a very noisy Rd.
Bed not great and no ironing board.
Don't expect too much. You get what you pay for.
Absolutely value for money, a great location and incredible host. A little loud at times but nothing you aren’t used to within a day.

James's place is in an excellent location in St. Kilda. A short walk to Balaclava, Acland Street, or St. Kilda Beach. The tram is outside the door and 20mins to the CBD.  Really clean, comfortable, and had everything you would need. James was great to deal with and I would highly recommend his place.
My boyfriend and I stayed here for 6 months and it was perfect. It's much more spacious than most apartments and the location is great. James is really helpful also.
James was a great communicator, which was super helpful! The accomodation was a short walk/drive to everywhere we wanted to go to!
Was a really nice place - parking is easy to find outside the property. Very clean apartment with a modern bathroom.
The place was great - clean and cozy. Great location and is close to everything - beach, botanical garden, coffee shops and trams. Will definitely pick this again when I’m down here. Highly recommend
James’ apartment was great. The location was very convenient in terms of tram access and there’s a few great restaurants on St Kilda road.

The apartment is really comfortable and the location is pretty convenient. There are trams nearby which brings you directly into the city, and it’s just walking distance away from st Kilda beach and the st kilda botanical gardens. The apartment is also equipped with many kitchenwares which is great. James was also quick to respond to our messages/ queries. Would recommend!
Excellent location and very good value. Layout and equipment was excellent.  The bed was the most comfortable I have slept in for a long time.

James' place is comfortable and nicely decorated, and quite bright. Bed was comfortable, and kitchen was well kitted out. There's a bit of sound transfer from the hallway and neighbouring apartment, which I would say is just good to bear in mind if you're very sensitive to noise. Overall a good base for a few nights, walking distance to St Kilda beach and several streets with cafes and restaurants.

James' Apartment is as described and on a main road, so it will be a bit loud, it is a very nice and cozy apartment. the checking was not so clear it to us 20 minutes to enter the apartment.
other than that, we didn't have issues,

Great apartment. Tidy and cosy. The kitchen had enough appliances. Very comfortable bed. Good sofa bed for the kids. 15 minutes walking from St Kilda beach. 3 minutes by car. Tram line available in front of the building. I only recommend asking the building  management for refurbishment of the carpeted common areas.

James was a great host. Plenty of helpful tips for travel and local recommendations! He was also available if we had any questions.
Apartment was very cute and clean. No issues with access or the neighbours. Street parking available if you need it, unmetered and no time restrictions outside on Brighton Rd which was great. Bed was comfy. Shower pressure was great. Great location, close to chapel st, heart of St Kilda, the beach etc.
Would stay again!
Super lovely and clean flat, we were pleasantly surprised to arrive to fresh milk tea and coffee stocked in the fridge, easy to find and great location highly recommend!

Easy to find location, but had to park the car a fair way away.
Apartment presented nicely, clean and comfortable. Had everything we needed.
Fold out bed was not very comfortable, but we loved that we could use portacot for our baby.
Stayed a couple of nights on a work trip with my colleague. Was a great home away from home for the weekend. Very clean, cosy and the host was very friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay again.
Really nice hosts. Accommodation was perfect and well equipped. Would defo recommend staying. Great location too.

Gresilda is the best host we have ever seen, kind, enthiusiastic, with quick response to any request. the housie is big and tidy with evrything we need tohave a relax and comfortabl stay. we will definitely come back in our next trip to melbourne.
Gresilda is the perfekt host. She always reacted immedeately when we had a question or needed any help. My colleagues  and me enjoyed our stay and will return  soon for another long time.

Please don't judge this place by photos, she's a nurse not photographer. Booked 2 nights stay at the beginning for two of my guests, then we added 3 nights for extra 2 guests. They  loved this hommy place. Basically everything has been provided, large living area, large backyard, the most delicate kitchen and home appliance , Gresilda will taking care of everything upon your stay and we really feel this is a home.
we had a lovely stay. Gresilda has thought of everything to make your stay comfortable. Great ambiance, close to everything. Very good value. We will stay again.

Gresilda’s place was as a relaxing place.  Her home was very clean, tidy and tastefully furnished. I'd highly recommend it for families, couples or business travelers due to its relative proximity to Tullamarine airport.

Ambient was a wonderful 4-bedroom house conveniently close to the Melbourne airport.  Lots of living and dining space.  Gresilda was a fabulous host - extremely helpful.  The breakfast and tea/coffee supplies included in the price were greatly appreciated.
Gresilda is a great host! She really made us feel welcome and feel at home! She has almost everything in the house you could possibly think and need of. Would love to stay there again!

Great place to stay with a lot to offer, great entertaining space outside, very peaceful neighbourhood to get away.
Gresilda also catered for food and drink to help stay more welcome.

Griselda was amazing! She was attentive and thoughtful ensuring we were able to conduct business while we were staying at ambient. We felt comfortable in her spotless home and she took any worries we could have away by being available at any given time. Griselda was honest and reliable and we couldn’t be more grateful for the accommodations! We look forward to coming back to Australia again and staying at ambient!

We stayed 3 months at this beautiful home while our house underwent renovation. During our stay we absolutely fell in love with it and were sad to leave. Gresilda is lovely to deal with and was very helpful when needed. Definitely a Home away from home.

Trust me when I tell you this, you have stumbled upon an absolute dime of a listing if you’re looking for a quieter place a little outside of Melbourne.
I had the most wonderful stay at Gresilda’s place over the long weekend and would wholeheartedly recommend this place to any larger family or group. Gresilda was also the most lovely and hospitable host, genuinely blowing me away with the level of care!
Would absolutely take the chance to stay here again next time I am down in Melbourne.
Thank you so much for everything again, Gresilda.

Ambient is a wonderful house. The rooms are even better than as described. There are enough facilities for the holidays of a whole family. The TV has Netflix and some other channels. There is also a piano in the living room.  The neighborhood of the house is very peaceful and beautiful. There is a small park 100-200 meters away where children can play. There are Coles and other stores just 5-6 minutes drive. It takes around 35 minutes to Melbourne downtown via toll highway, and only 10 minutes to the airport. The hostess is very friendly and responsive to me. Besides, the price is very good considering the house’ conditions. I recommend it to any family who need spend holidays in Melbourne.

Grace's Ambient was amazing..   Beautifully decorated, perfectly equipped, close to the airport and public transport... In other words, flawless.... If you're looking for a place in Melbourne,, seriously consider this one.
Property was very felt homely. Mostly we  enjoyed playing piano. Griselda has been very flexible with check in and check out times which was very helpful.

Julienne's place is great if you love the beach and the Mediterranean style her home offers. It looks just as it does in the pictures and there's plenty of space for a couple or a few friends. She responds promptly to queries and is very helpful. If you cook, she has cooking utensils available for you to use with a few sizes to choose from.
For those staying during the colder months in Australia, be prepared to bundle up! A tip would be to use provided fleece blankets in between the sheets. The heater can only be found in the common area and is not that great at heating up the entire place.

Lovely place in a great location. Beach practically on the doorstep and town with numerous places to eat and drink 10 minutes walk away. Easy to get into Melbourne on the train within an hour. Would highly recommend to those wanting to stay in the area.
Excellent location for the beach, well appointed apartment with a very nice welcome pack and everything we needed.  Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will be bearing in mind for future visits.

Julienne’s place was perfect for our week long stay while we caught up with family nearby. Check in was quick and easy, the place was spotless and she provided all the essentials that we needed for our stay. Communication with Julienne was 10/10. Plenty of room for two adults and two kids under four years old. Can’t recommend her place highly enough. Thanks Julienne!
The apartment is beautiful and well maintained. The spot is perfect for people that like the beach. Really recommended. We had a really good end of the year there.

I had the privilege of staying with my son. We had walks along the beach, home cooked meals, watched storms across the bay and felt so relaxed and at home. Lovely home and would go back again if i was in the area
Lovely home away from home for a few weeks. Very responsive host, all the required amenities and a view of the water from the balcony.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Julienne's place and loved the convenience of being right on the beach and near the shops. Julienne was a great communicator and very responsive. We would certainly go back again!

Adam went out of his way to accommodate my partner and I on our trip to Melbourne. We felt so at home that we did not want to leave what we call our 'Love Loft'. It is perfect for performers who need to get away from the hustle and bustle of the world to prepare for auditions and or performances.

Well presented little loft perfect for a couple and within about a 5 minute walk to nice cafes and restaurants in Prahran, 10 minute drive to the war memorial and botanical gardens and 5 minute walk to the train station with train taking around 15 minutes to the crown casino.
Adam was a warm and friendly host providing plenty of advice on places to eat and instructions to get the keys and access the loft were easy and quick.
There were plenty of options for parking on the street in front of the loft also.

We stayed in Adams studio for one night before heading out to pick our camper up to travel the great ocean road. We managed to get in the studio as soon as we arrived around 6pm and were greeted by Adam. The studio was exactly as pictured and had everything we needed for our short stay, including tea making facilities and skimmed milk. Yay! The studio is filled with natural light which is beautiful but if you're looking forward to a lie in I'd recommend bringing an eye mask to block out the morning sun.
Loft exactly as described - very relaxing and quiet - everything you need and close to cafes and public transport. A brief but very please stay for us.
Lovely space, well set up, exactly as described. Great bed and quiet location. Thank you Adam for being flexible with check in and out times.  Would recommend Adams Loft to anyone.
Room was clean and perfect for what we needed. The area was a little noisy at times but that's inner city living for you. I would totally stay here again and recommend it without hesitation.
Spent a very cold weekend at the loft and found it to be very comfortable, quiet and convenintly close to shops, restaurants, transport etc. Adams tips on where to eat were great too.
Great place. Very clean and tidy. Could not ask for a more helpful host.  Thank you.

The apartment was perfect for what we needed. Amazing location right in the middle of CBD. Very clean. Great price for what you're getting. Yong was very prompt with responding and did not bother us during our stay. Overall, one of the best properties I've stayed in from Airbnb across the world.
Adam’s apartment is a compact and efficient unit in a great location. Extremely quiet and clean, we’d be happy to stay again anytime.
The place is great, with amenities exceeded those usually provided in a hotel. We felt independent in our stay, yet attended to.
A well designed private loft at the rear of the property with good use of space for a bedroom, bathroom and sink.  Not far from a tram line.  A convenient place to stay.

Adam and Helen were both very responsive hosts. While I didn’t get a chance to meet them, they were very pleasant and quick to respond to my enquiries.
The space itself was great and bigger than the impression I got from the pictures. It was in a very private location with its own entrance and check in was easily facilitated by the secure lockbox facility.
I found the place was close to public transport and only a short walk from Aldi and nearby cafes.
I would definitely recommend this to any travelers looking for a weekend in St Kilda. Thank you both!
This is our 3rd stay and Helen and Adam were very accomodating of our very last minute booking. Always a comfortable place for a sleepover when we’re in Melbourne. It was just lovely.

We had everything we needed for a one night stay at Helen's apartment. It was well laid out and provided for although the bed is very hard and not comfortable for a multi-night stay. Everything else was good though.

The loft is such a cosy little place to stay and in a nice little quiet street, tucked away from the main road.
Helen was such a great host, friendly and hospitable.
Helen’s place had everything you needed, cosy & clean, walking distance to shops, private entry and easy communication with Helen. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend her place to others.
Amazing location and an incredibly kind host. Street parking is always available with stores and restaurants only a short drive away. We had a great time and would stay here again!
Met me in the lobby to let me in. Everything in apt is as described. Very nice place. Great location.

This was a fantastic apartment in a great location in the CBD with a brilliant view over the city. It has a lovely balcony where we enjoyed sitting of an evening watching the sunset. The apartment was spotlessly clean and well equipped for our stay. Having access to the rooftop pool was fantastic and gave other great views of the city. Yong responded promptly to all our correspondence and was a great host. We would thoroughly recommend this apartment and would love to stay here again when we next visit Melbourne.

Yong has provided a first-class city-based Air BnB experience. Communication was good, the apartment was as described and the photographs were an accurate reflection of the accommodation.
The bed was very comfortable and the apartment was very quiet. Overall, the accommodation is nicely furnished and decorated. It's in a great location - close to trams, the sky bus terminal and we could walk to most of the main sites of interest in the city. We would definitely stay here again if ever back in Melbourne.
lovely apartment, very clean and just enough space for two people to stay! thanks yong for being so kind to us ! :)
We had a very nice stay at the apartment. It was clean and comfortable and had a wonderful location.

Cozy and clean apartment, with all amenities to enjoy your stay. Fantastic location in the CBD, easily can walk to restaurants, bars, shops.
Yong is a great host, and easy to communicate with at any time. Thank you Yong!

Great stay! Perfect location. Short walk from the skybus which was perfect and great central location for shopping and restaurants. Place was very clean and tidy and had everything we needed.
The best part was the process was so smooth with checking in and out. Definitely would stay here again !
A neat and tidy space close to public transport into the city. Helen is a friendly and responsive host - easy communication and great local recommendations.

Helen’s place was perfect for what I needed. Clean and private. Bed was very comfy!
Thank you for having me. I’ll be sure to stay again if I’m ever in the area again.
It is a very nice and lovely loft. Helen is so helpful and she always responses us really quick. We got some recommendations about local cafes. A really warm experience in Melb.

Very central, new, modern, clean and great view are the key words.
We had a great stay

Yong was great in communication and meeting us on arrival- even though we didn't arrive until after 11pm! The place was super tidy and well presented. Provision of basic toiletries was a nice touch. The apartment was like a home away from home. Unfortunately it was too cold for the pool during our stay but it is a wonderful amentity to have. Highly recommend.
The apartment was just as advertised. After a long flight it was very restful but later when we went out it was near plenty of amenities etc.  The free bus area was an added bonus!

Yong's apartment is fantastic. Great location close to everything. Yong was a fabulous host and let us check in early which was most appreciated. Definitely recommend this apartment to anyone wanting a convenient apartment in the CBD.
Yong's place is in a great location. It is easy to get to, comfortable and very clean. There were super fresh towels, shampoo and lovely soaps at his place as well. We would stay here again.
Highly recommend this apartment- great location, right near the free trams and very close to restaurants and bars
Perfect place in the city. Really clean, easy check-in, great view. Little kitchenette is great.

What a terrific space!   Close to everything and a very functional and comfortable up-market apartment.   Public transport nearby makes a hire car redundant.   Don't forget to bring your bathers for the heated roof top pool.   Highly recommended for anyone visiting Melbourne CBD.
Excellent location!!! The home was very clean and has a breath taking view of the city. Would definitely stay there again when I come back. 🙂
Very new, central and up high so not noisy. Self check in was very easy and communication from the host was clear and prompt. Nice balcony also.
Really convenient location. The host greeted us at the lobby and talked through the facilities. Modern and clean apartment, highly recommended!

Yong’s place is convenient to Bourke St trams and was spotlessly clean.  The heating was a welcome benefit and I’m sure the balcony would be great during warmer months. Great bathroom and all the basics included including shampoo/conditioner and shower gel.  The unit is very quiet and I had a great stay!

Yong's apartment not only offers an exceptional view, but offers everything that is to expected in a luxury room from cleanliness to pantry necessities. Check-in was simple and and navigating around the area was easy. Exceptional airbnb, definitely recommended!
Great spot to stay, really clean though the bed was rock hard, pillows worn out and the sofa very uncomfortable
Had a lovely stay at Yong’s place for one night. Clean and elegant, our check in was very easy. Would definitely stay again!

Perfect location for exploring the city, compact but lovely apartment for couple. Very clean, quite new, everything you need. Easy self checkin with clear instructions. Only comment- sleep could benefit from better pillows!

Yong’s home is a perfect choice for a trip to Melbourne. The location is 10 minutes walk to the city centre. The apartment is spacious and modern with amazing views of the city. The rooftop pool on the same floor of the apartment is a nice bonus!

This room is located on the top floor and the view is amazing.
The location of this apartment is also great.
Thank you very much.

Great apartment for two, clean, awesome location as easy access to trams/Southern Cross Station and CBD 10 min walk. Great hidden coffee roasters across the street in laneway. Awesome rooftop pool area. We had a wonderful time here. Would definitely recommend.
Perfect location, had everything we needed for a few nights, lovely view, Yong was a great communicator and very responsive. Definitely recommend and would love to stay here again!

We stayed here for a week and had a great time. Yong accommodated us to check in early as our flight arrived early hours of the morning. The apartment was exactly as shown in pictures. It is situated in the city and near a tram stop so we had accessible routes to everywhere we wanted to go. There were also cooking utensils, a washer dryer and free WiFi
This is a convenient, excellent apartment in clean condition. I think it’s excellent value and you certainly get what you pay for.
Great flat with everything I needed, in a great location in the CBD.  Would stay again.

Thank you Roslyn for the most relaxing stay.
