The beautifully styled cottage is set amongst the most manicured gardens, looking onto the paddock with Buddy the gorgeous pony and Barry and his fellow sheep. We felt so relaxed exploring the garden, enjoying our BBQ watching the sunset and Sunny our Golden Retriever absolutely loved his visits from Albert. Roslyn was a fantastic and welcoming host and we're heading home feeling very refreshed! Thank you again, Luke, Courtney & Sunny

I booked this gorgeous cottage only 3 weeks before my wedding after a hellious experience with our previously booked accomodation. Which I am now so happy it did fell through as I feel i found a 4 leaf cover. I had the most wonderful 2 nights and the most beautiful wedding photos there. Very relaxing. Roslyn went above and beyond and replied to all my messages within minutes. Thanks for saving my wedding!

Absolutely stunning property and the views are lovely! The location is the perfect combination between easy to get to and secluded. We spent the night before our wedding here and the day of the wedding getting ready and having our pre wedding photos done.
Everyone loved the wildlife and the stunning building. Roslyn was a warm and gracious host.

What you see on the airbnb page is what you get, it was perfect lovely escape and great space. Next time we’re visiting family we’ll stay for three weeks here we loved it.
Thank you so much Roslyn

Absolutely spectacular!
We had a very relaxing babymoon here. The place had everything you needed to stay indoors, fully equipped kitchen and laundry.
We even spent some time by the pool on hot days and Bailey our dog loved it.
Highly recommend staying here as the gardens are well manicured and beautiful and only a stones throw away from yarra valley.
Thanks again Rosyln!

From the fresh loaf of bread and orange juice left to the comfy beds and gorgeous wood fire this was an excellent place to stay for the weekend. Just a hop skip and jump away from the Vineyards, local shops a quick 5mins away we couldn’t believe the absolute serenity of this place. Roslyn is a great host and has thought of everything. A most enjoyable weekend!
Great place to stay near the wineries, dairy place and chocolaterie. Loved the bath and fireplace particularly! Roslyn was a great host too. Highly recommend! :)

Nice cozy cottage with good range of supplies for breakfast. Albert is really friendly & my black lab loved playing with him! Communication was prompt & Roslyn came to say hello to see if there was anything we needed. Highly recommended place!
Lovely stay in rustic cottage. Beautiful, serene escape from the bustle of city life. Loved it.
A beautiful cottage,  so many added thoughtful touches.  Suited our needs beautifully 😃😃 Thank you
We had a lovely break - felt like we were deep in the country but had so many urban amenities at the doorstep!

I stayed at this beautiful cottage with my husband and dog during a weekend Summer getaway. We loved the location and it’s proximity to lots of lovely walks and wineries! The property and grounds were stunning and we really appreciated all of the little touches :)
We felt very welcome and highly rate accommodation and loved that it was both dog friendly and exceptionally clean.
We are already working out when we can return.
Thanks Roslyn for a very relaxing break.
Jen, Jake & Jojo x

This is an amazing place to stay we where made to feel so welcome and nothing was too much which made our special day better that I could have imagined. I recommend you go have some time there it is so peaceful and relaxing and the cottage is stunning and so comfortable we loved our stay and will be back maybe for our anniversary xxx

Believe the hype! We went for a weekend trip & thought it was one of the coolest, most comfortable and relaxing AirBnB’s we have experienced. Surrounded by rolling hills, you feel completely secluded in your own private cottage. While sitting on the patio, you’ll hear the calming and peaceful sounds of the forest. On a sunny Sat arvo, we had a dip in the pool and then drove into Healesville, only 20 mins away. Beds were comfortable, space was clean, a beautiful cottage filled with small, charming touches throughout. A friendly dog who came to say hi and bye. Roslyn was such a great host, providing a delicious fruit bowl, bread, chocolates & OJ in the fridge. We’re hoping to come back soon! Thanks Roslyn!

Couldn’t recommend enough. Place was as described, awesome backyard for my small dog (totally secure). Something to consider is there’s no WIFI and service isn’t the best, didn’t really bother us though. Easy to get around and a whole heap to do in the area

Roslyn is a wonderful host. This cottage is absolutely beautiful, perfect for a wedding party to get ready and have some amazing photos.
I would highly recommend this cottage. Thanks Roslyn

Roslyn is a great host. She made us feel very welcome and came up for a nice chat with her lovely dog, Albert.
It is such a nice and cosy house and well decorated, perfect for photo opportunities.

I had a lovely last minute weekend away and was so happy Roslyn's place became available. I felt like I was in the English countryside. What a gorgeous place. Roslyn was a kind and generous host. The fireplace was all set up, breakfast provisions supplied, and even a couple of little self care items.  The cottage has everything you need.  Location is great, close to the Yarra Valley as well as the Dandenong Ranges. Would highly recommend!

Tanglewood was the perfect getaway. it's a charming cottage amidst picturesque scenery. Perfect for a recharge and super close to all your shopping needs at Chirnside. I loved the place and would definitely go back.

What an amazing find this cozy cottage was for our family! We had a fantastic time cozying up together by the fire, watching the sheep in the paddock, and enjoying down time soaking in the tub! Roslyn was fantastic and the cottage was beautiful!

Roslyn was so helpful, always responsive and provided the perfect place to get ready with my bridesmaids before our wedding. Was very welcoming and allowed us to use her gorgeous property to have our first look and get some photos. Thank you for having us, Roslyn.
Loved our stay! The cottage is exactly what we were after and was a relaxing, comfortable time. Roslyn was very helpful and friendly and made us feel right at home!

My now-husband and I stayed at the cottage the night before and night of our wedding, and the girls and I got ready there the morning of. We all had an absolute blast! It was so beautiful and peaceful and we really didn’t want to leave. Roslyn was so lovely, and I absolutely fell in love with Albert, the doggy. 10/10 recommend staying here if you are considering it

Thanks so much Roslyn. Your cottage and property was the perfect place to get ready on the morning of our wedding and then have our first look and photos. Our families and vendors were in awe of the cottage and beautiful grounds also. Breakfast foods were supplied which was very kind. Thanks so much Roslyn it was perfect.

Roslyn the host was lovely and communication was clear and helpful. Cottage is gorgeous and has a lot of character. Host provided us with some breakfast items which was very thoughtful. Was a shame we weren’t staying longer. The area is beautiful. Beds were incredibly comfortable and soft like clouds.

Roslyn is one of the best airbnb hosts we've ever had the pleasure to stay with. She was very hospitable, and extremely responsive. She and her family live right next door, and whenever we needed anything, we usually got a response within minutes. Our dog is a lagotto and was quite naughty in finding ways to escape the fenced backyard — and Roslyn was extremely understanding, and she and her son even helped us find Harry and bring him back to the house once when we were out running errands. The home is beautiful, and very healing. The grounds are private, and the drive up to the property is a nice one. The cottage is just nice for a family of four like ours, and very cosy and homely. The home was very nice to stay at, and Roslyn, as I said, was such an amazing host, we would certainly highly recommend staying at Tanglewood Cottage if you have the chance.

My partner and I along with our 2 dogs stayed at the cottage and were extremely happy with the whole experience.
The house is gorgeous and is surrounded by stunning gardens that were very quiet and felt very secluded.
There is a fully enclosed and secure garden area around the cottage so our two little doggies were able to play and explore whilst safely contained which was fantastic.
The house was clean, spacious and had all of the amenities for a comfortable, relaxing stay.
Roslyn was an amazing host, extremely friendly, quick to respond and helpful with recommendations for local places to visit and things to do (there was also an extensive brochure collection for us to peruse on the coffee table).
Highly recommend this stay to everyone and we’ll definitely be back! :)

This is my second stay at Roslyns beautiful cottage. The setting is tranquil, the scenery stunning amd we were even blessed with a visit from some kangaroos in the garden.
We will definitely be back next year. I can’t recommend this place highly enough. Thank you Roslyn ( and Albert the gorgeous Labrador for helping me to get over missing my own dogs back home)

We enjoyed a lovely, peaceful weekend in beautiful surroundings. Roslyn went out of her way to make us comfortable, and she responded quickly to our requests and questions.
Our cat settled in quickly too, and enjoyed looking out the window.
We are looking forward to staying at TanglewoodCottage again in the future.

We absolutely loved our stay at Roslyn’s Airbnb. We were shooting a magazine cover and story  and Roslyn was very accommodating and kind. She allowed us to do whatever we needed to do to get the right shots and we really appreciated that! The gardens were just incredible and we couldn’t believe it when we arrived – spring blossoms, gorgeous gardens, rolling hills, stunning home – it was just perfect! We all stayed overnight and there was plenty of space to plan our shoot the next day, have a meal together and get plenty of sleep for the next day. Thank you so much Roslyn, we will be telling everyone about your space!

Tanglewood cottage was a fantastic and beautiful stay.
I stayed with my Groomsmen night one and then my beautiful bride on night 2 after our wedding.
beautiful surrounds and brilliant spaces for photos.
Roslyn the host was very accommodating and quick to respond to any questions. We will certainly revisit in future!!

Roslyn went above and beyond to make my husband and I feel comfortable. She was super responsive and even helped me research dog friendly cafes in the area! The photos of the cottage do not do it justice - it is absolutely stunning and you immediately feel comfortable the second you step inside.

We had a great stay at Tanglewood, we were visiting family on the area. Lovely place well kitted out very peaceful and tranquil and a good size. Roslyn is lovely and a great host. We would definitely recommend and return

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay- the location is perfect with just a 5 minute walk to the beach, trams on your doorstep and shops around the corner!
The flat was compact but was nice and cosy for the 3 of us.
Melissa was very welcoming and organised. There was a booklet which she'd left informing us of the best places to go in the area and any additional information we needed regarding appliances within the flat.
My friends and I stayed in the flat for just over and month. Overall it was a brilliant base for our Melbourne experience !

Wonderful apartment, the location made it for us though..across the road and you’ve got an amazing garden and then onto the beach. Melissa is also fab. It can be noisy with neighbours and roads etc. 20 mins on the tram and you’re in the centre. Ideal :)

Literally cannot fault a single thing. Melissa was incredibly helpful with everything from check in to providing a wealth of info about the local area etc. The apartment is wonderful and the ceiling fans a welcome relief in the recent hot weather. The location is just perfect for the beaches and the teams so it was a dream location for my stay in Melbourne. Would recommend to anyone and would love to come back!

Great apartment and location. Very close to the beach and public transportation. I didn't spend that much time at the apartment but the bed was super comfortable and exactly what I needed after 2weeks of hostels.
Compact flat with all mod cons, great location for beach and really easy access to city. Lots of great bars food places walking distance. Beach and penguins stroll away
We had a lovely month's stay. The apartment suited all of our needs, the location was great and Melissa was always on hand when needed.
This place is in a great location, everything you would need is close by.  Comfortable and warm in the middle of a cold winter in Melbourne. Great communication with the host.

This is a hidden gem!  Located directly across from the water, this is a fantastic place to call home for a long weekend or long term stay in Melbourne.  Melissa is a fantastic host, very communicative and super helpful.  She aims to ensure your stay is an enjoyable one.  The space is quaint, nicely decorated and clean.  The bed is very comfortable. Highly recommend for a single person or a couple.

Amazing stay. Everything is exactly as it is on the airbnb page. Melissa is on the call and she does take good care of small details like a handmade book full of restaurant recommendations and toiletries. She was very flexible with check in and out, which is amazing for people travelling early or late. In general, it is a really nice cozy place.

Melissa is a fantastic host and her apartment is exactly as described. We loved our stay here for 3 weeks. It’s in a great location ,right next to the tram and the beach. Very comfortable bed and apartment was very clean on arrival. Couldn’t reccomend more highly !
Great place to stay, right near the beach and lots of restaurants around. The place was just like advertised and Melissa was a great host checking in to make sure everything was going well.

Melissa is a great host. She prepared early check in at our request. Her place is a great stay. It’s very close to the beach. The neighborhood is calm and peaceful. The place was very clean and had everything for comfortable stay. The check in was smooth. Definitely gonna stay again if I visit Melbourne again.

Great stay! Close to main road in St Kilda with lots of cafes and restaurants, as well as right on the beach. Right next to tram stop for easy commute to the city! Melissa was super helpful and always responsive. Super cute place, would come here again!

Beautiful little apartment in such a good location. Melissa was more then helpful and made our stay really easy. Also she let us check in early as our flight was super early and we were going to the Melbourne cup.
Perfect place to stay with the half Ironman across the street! We’ll equipped and very comfortable beds. Melissa was exceptionally accommodating and helpful. Thank you!

Melissa’s place was perfect walking distance of everything beach and park across the street .. very easy check in and check out with very clear instructions.
Melissa is was very contactable from start to finish
Thank you Melissa we had a wonderful time 😀
Noreen

This place was perfect. It’s right next to the beach and walkway to go for a dip or run/walk and the tram is a very short walk away (like 100m away) which meant it was easy to get into the CBD. The apartment was central to lots of amenities, restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacy and takeaway places if we wanted to chill. I would highly recommend this place to anyone who doesn’t want to be in the CBD but still wants to be close to everything.
Clean, tidy and great location. Melissa was great at communicating with us. Thanks for the stay!
Great stay and great location, neighbours are a bit noise during the night but for the price definitely worth it, clean space also. Very close to the beach and close to all the restaurants and shops
Great little apartment in an ideal location in st Kilda - near beach, cafes, restaurants and trams. Very responsive and friendly host.

Stuart thank you so much for your hospitality! My family and I loved the place and had a great time. The house is so clean and beautiful! Loved the views of the city skyline on the balcony. It's also in such a great location so close to transport and Moonee Ponds shops. Couldn't have found a better place to stay! Sure to be back on our next visit!

Stuart was an amazing host, very accommodating and easy to deal with.
The house was very clean and had absolutely everything that we needed!
A perfect host for a perfect stay!
Thanks!

Very good place , quiet and comfortable.
Good idea to have the bedrooms downstairs and kitchen upstairs as the food smells did not affect your bedrooms.
Hot water showers were very good but towels need a softer touch .
Stuart is a fantastic host. He is very responsive and went out of his way to ensure everything was perfect. His house was exactly as described and spotless. Highly recommended!

I was very uncomfortable staying at his place. At first day he was nice, but gradually setting up some invisible rules like me as a guest should stay in the guest TV Room if I want to watch movie, rather than staying in public Sofa area, because “it’s my house” as he said.
He often raised voice when I couldn’t follow his English as he speaks super fast even after I required him to slow down.
I feel fearful about my safety at the end of my stay because of his temper issue, he is easy to get irritated, talked dirty words all of a sudden, I don’t recommend his place.
Stuarts a really nice guy, great place, really keen and tidy. Even though he's there we never felt intruded upon at all. I would highly recommend,

Stuart was a really prompt responder and opened his home to us with the warmest hospitality from the get go. Even though he wasn’t around a lot of the time we were there, we never felt shy to ask questions. The place itself is so clean with gorgeous breezy Melbourne winds that sweep past the balcony and gorgeous natural lighting that fills the home. The location of the house is so convenient for quick transport to the city and local shops and restaurants. This is the ideal location for couples or a group of friends looking for adventures in Melbourne!

Bright, clean space in a great location, close to all the action of Moonee Ponds but far enough away to be quiet.
Good secure courtyard for our dog and to relax on the outdoor lounge (weather permitting).
Stuart was great at communicating and very friendly. We really enjoyed our stay!

Stuart was a great host and responded immediately to requests. The house was pet friendly which suited our needs perfectly. Although its opposite a school, you could barely hear noise and parking was good.

View from the apartment is absolutely insane - my partner and I were seriously blown away! Great central location, comfy bed, clean modern design and included all the necessities we needed. Linton and his team were beyond helpful, we were even recommended some great places in Melbourne to check out during our stay which we truly appreciated as we weren't very familiar with the city. I have already recommended the apartment to family and friends, and would definitely stay again during my next Melbourne trip. Thank you!

Amazing views (the photos online do not do it justice), clean apartment, located in a very central location, easy to walk to major tourist attractions, only downside is the massive queue for the elevators. Would stay again!
Apartment was centrally located which made transportation very easy. Place was not the cleanest but was comfortable enough. Of note it's quite noisy as the apt is in the city.
Amazing views, very clean and had the all the necessities. Had an issue with the key not working but it was resolved.

Great apartment for a little getaway for 2. Location was excellent right in front of Southern cross station where the airport bus goes to and from. Also easy to walk around the cbd from there or take trams anywhere.
I didn’t hear from the host in the 8 days I was there but didn’t really need much as everything was pretty straight forward.
A bit disappointing that the pool was super cold but everything else in the apartment block was great, especially the uninterrupted views.
Thank you Beyond A Room. We really enjoyed our one week stay in your apartment. Really convenient location, comfy bed and other facilities including sauna. Thank you.

Good cleanliness and location, great reply speed from the host and very helpful. Bedsheets were 3 layers of separate sheets instead of a cover which we found uncomfortable and didn't stay put. Lift can take awhile

Best AirBnbB I have stayed in in a long time.
Good and responsive communication, personal key hand-over, a full kitchen with good/non-scratchy pots and pans, everything very clean and great view!
A little issue with the internet was fixed in no time on the weekend, through a friendly staff member. I wish every AirBnB stay would be so smooth.
I would not recommend the property we stayed in it was dirty a filthy mattress no bathroom essentials and no communication from the manager in relation to cleanliness of the property

Apartment exactly as described. Seamless check in/out. Great location and views. The only trade off for the high floor is waiting for elevators can be long with social distancing, and one to the upper floors being under maintenance for my entire stay.  Plenty of amenities and basics were in the unit.  Would stay again.

Simply amazing, views were amazing. Utilities were provided and the building was easy to access and was in a very good standard, had my best weekend getaway for my birthday thanks to our stay here! 10/10 !!

Great location, fantastic view - just as per the pictures, if not better!
Can tell it has been a well used AirBnb, but everything was as expected and has everything you need for a Melbourne city stay! Eduardo was also great with all communication and always replied very promptly.

Great location and beautiful view. Walking distance to the city and many public transport options. The apartment was clean and tidy! We enjoyed our stay very much. Thank you Eduardo for the wonderful hospitality!

Stayed at this beautiful apartment facing Southern Cross Station. Very convenient and easy to move around the city from this place. Eduardo was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay there. Thank you! 10/10 would recommend!
A great stay in a super convenient location with a beautiful view. I'd be very happy to stay here again!

This Airbnb was acceptable. Unfortunately the walls are quite thin and I was kept up by neighbours closing doors and their doorbells ringing, perhaps my fault for not bringing earplugs. The standard of cleanliness also left something to be desired, especially in the bathroom and the checkin and checkout instructions are extensive compared to other Airbnbs I’ve stayed at. However, I will say that the host is very responsive and helpful. Just make sure you ask for clear directions as to how to take out the rubbish before you leave the apartment to do it as there is no reception in the halls of the building.
great responsive host and nice apartment. the area was a little noisy but as it is the CBD this is to be expected! thanks eduardo!

We had a terrific stay at Julia's apartment. The location was fantastic, so close to the train station and a supermarket nearby for self-catering. The apartment was immaculate and Julia was super helpful. We'd love to stay again.
This apartment was a wonderful place to stop by. My family has enjoy such a good time during our stay in Mel.. Im pretty sure next Mel. trip i would take Julia's place at the first choice!

Beautifully appointed apartment where we totally enjoyed our stay.
Julia was very responsive and ensured we were extremely comfortable with some unique touches.
Will totally stay with her again.
Julia was great in communicating with us. The apartment is very convenient with public transport, a small supermarket and cafed and restaurants close by. Also great to able to book for 1 night.
This was our second stay at this lovely apartment. Close to transport and located in a nice neighbourhood. Would definitely recommend to other travellers.

Julia is very very nice and friendly! The apartment is absolutely exquisite, gorgeous and comfortable and really close to the beach. It has everything we need, whether in kitchen or bathroom. and the place is really clean and tidy.Julia had everything ready and really thoughtful! Best Airbnb experience ever!
The unit is very clean with a great location close to Gardenvale Station, shops, wine bar, restaurants and walking distance to Elwood or Brighton Beach.

Julia’s place is lovely, just as described. It was spotlessly clean and check in was straightforward. It was the perfect location for my parents to stay for a week while visiting from the UK. It was a little noisy first thing in the morning due to the very popular St Martin cafe downstairs but it didn’t bother them. Thanks for being a great host Julia.

This is a lovely, modern and comfortable apartment situated in a small shopping village. The local cafes & restaurants are inviting and it is easy to access transport. Julia is a thoughtful host and made checking in and car-parking a breeze. We enjoyed our stay at Julia’s place.

Julia's place is great. The street the apartment on is one of the best in Melbourne, def in Bayside. Has all you would need, shops, close to train station, and a beach at the end of the street! The apartment itself is new, clean, and really cosy and was perfect for my family and I. We were very glad we chose to stay there.

Julia was exceptional. We booked the house last minute for check in the same day, with check in happening about 11pm that now. Julia was accomodating and easy to deal with. Professional and fast communication. Great space to stay with all the needed amenities! Thanks Julia!
Julia and her husband Matt were fabulous hosts. Very accommodating and helpful on check in and during our short stay. I gorgeous space in a great location. Highly recommended.
A comfortable place to stay, clean and warm, but the noise factor from the busy street below was an issue for us

Apartment is bigger than I expected and in a fantastic location. The beach is a short walk away and very close to the train station into the city. We stayed with our toddler and two cats and had a great stay. Also super handy having a secure car park available. Apartment is clean throughout. 10/10 would stay again

Great place, close to train station to the city. Place was clean and tidy and just as expected from the photos. Easy check-in with key collection from hosts. The only difficult thing I could think of for solo travellers with cars is that you would need to exit the carpark and  walk to drop off the keys. But plenty of parking around so it'll be a breeze! Thanks Julia and Matt we really enjoyed our stay!! Will definitely be back!
Fantastic apartment right in the heart of gardenvale, great location, this was a fantastic stay for our family of four
Excellent place -stylish and cute! Julia and Matt were very helpful with the checking in and out process. Thank you so much for having us on short notice.

The apartment is located centrally near shops, coffee bars etc and not far to the beach. Sadly the unit was not looking too good, with many things dirty or broken. There was a dog barking and loud music from another unit, but I understand that's out of the owners control.

Spent 2 nights and 3 days in Ken's trust and apartment. It was a lovely stay. It was also the first time I've used airbnb. The apartment was exactly what you would expect of it from the description and pictures. Fell in love as soon as I entered the room. The buliding itself is all very well kept and in a safe and friendly location. The location itself is more opportune than other places I have stayed in Melbourne. I was so happy with the service and my stay I plan to always book with Ken. He was a super helpful host and whom simplified everything, I cant wait for my next visit back to Melbourne.

Awesome stayed! Nice view, the house is very clean and neat. Everything is well prepare. Easy access for public transport. The apartment is just opposite one of the biggest train station southern cross which is also direct bus to the Melbourne airport.

This apartment is breath-taking! We spent most evenings on the balcony taking in the view of Melbourne then fell asleep with the curtains open watching the lights of the city. It is a perfect location to get the free tram around Melbourne and there is a large supermarket just across the road. Ken's instructions for parking and getting access passes was very simple, and his communication is nearly an instant response. I would love to stay here again and would recommend this place to friends.

I had a stay with a family of 8 persons (7 adults + 1 baby) for 7 days. What I got from the stay is a superb experience.
The host is just great! Timely communication, flexible arrangement, caring down to details.
The location is super good if you are travelling from airport by skybus. Also very close to tram stations, shops, supermart and restaurants.
The place comfortably hosted 8 of us with plenty of space. Supplies are well enough (esp I have stayed for 7 days). The place including washrooms are clean and tidy. The night view and sunset view are just perfect.
A very central location but we were disturbed at night by noise from Southern Cross station. If you want peace and quiet this is not the apartment for you.
Such a great place to stay, it was perfect for us with our toddler as well. Close to shops and cafes and the train is 2 mins walk away and you can’t hear it at all. Really good location.

The place was very clean and nice, host did however not help at all with helping me collect a forgotten jacket, she has told me she had it at her house and when I tried to organise someone to collect it she didn’t respond. Not the end of the world however worth noting if that if you stay here while it is very nice be sure to make sure you have no issues as the host may not be very accommodating.
Lovely apartment, within driving distance to shops and the beach. There is a bit of street noise but otherwise perfect for a short stay.
super easy check in, very clean and a nice view which we didn't realise from the pictures. comfiest bed ever! Very quiet and in an ideal location!
Great location and great clean place. Really friendly host dropped off the keys with family locally as we were delayed on our flight. 10/10

Title: A Perfect Stay!
I had an amazing experience at this Airbnb! The space was beautifully decorated and super cozy, with a comfy bed that made for restful nights. The location was ideal—close to local shops and attractions—making it easy to explore.
The host was incredibly welcoming and provided great recommendations. I truly felt at home and can't wait to return. Highly recommend this hidden gem!
Great location,  easy little rest stop before travelling again. Photos are exactly as the apartment is. The host was very accommodating and communicative.  Thank you for a lovely stay.😊
Julia is a great host. We enjoyed our stay in her lovely flat. Location is just perfect and very close to public transportation. Underground parking is a big plus. We would love to come back one day.
Lovely urban oasis in ideal location, close to great cafes, shops and public transport. We enjoyed our stay very much & will definitely come back!

Unbeleivable view from the apartment over the city and out to the harbour and ocean. Location was perfect for everything we wanted. Delicious Vietnamese restaurant downstairs which is perfect for familes. Outlet shopping across the road and Art Gallery and Theatres a short Uber ride away. Would definitely recommend.

This apartment is on the 38th floor, a corner unit, so had amazing views from almost all floor to ceiling windows. It is right opposite Southern Cross Station and a tram stop in front of the building. 2km to Docklands if you want to walk there (which we did in just over 20mins) or take tram 86. View the sunset over the Docklands from the balcony.
There is some wear and tear as mentioned in the apartment furnishings but that's to be expected. We found it clean enough for us.
I made the mistake of leaving a window open while sleeping... don't do that. Close it and you'll hardly hear the trains at night.
Sure, there could be extra little finishing touches but I wasn't looking for that. Good location, amazing views, comfortable & clean.
Thanks again for hosting us, Ken. We would come back again.
Great place to stay! Location and views cannot be faulted! Ken replies in a very timely manner making check in and parking a breeze.
Location is great and views were amazing, cleanliness was not great, the whole apartment could do with a thorough clean.
Great stay. Apartment was in a great location adjacent Southern across Station and heart of cbd. Thoroughly enjoyed.
Very  polite and welcoming  couple the amenities  were large and the bed very comfortable  the surroundings  were peaceful would happily stay there again and highly recommend

Simon and Rue were amazing hosts who greeted our arrival and departure. Their place was truly a home away from home. We enjoyed every moment of our stay as it was very comfortable; we also had a 3 month old bub with us! Little touches such as the breakfast basket, additional linen and a beautiful courtyard made the whole experience even more special. Our own car spot in the driveway made it easy for us to load and unload the bags and baby. Thank you for a wonderful experience and hope to be back in the near future - Shekar, Darsh & Kyren ( Perth, WA)

Beautifully renovated cottage in convenient location, for us was close to the showgrounds, but also just up the road is Aldi and a range of lovely eaterys. Simon and Rue were more than accommodating, Simon was there in a flash when we messaged about being after some vinigar to poach our eggs... Rue also dropped us to the showgrounds on the first day. Lovely interior design, and nicely laid out grounds. Could have asked for better !!
They welcomed us. Genuine and helpful. Very cozy and comfortable for our family of five. Peaceful neighbourhood. Clean and tastefully decorated. Walk to grocery and food places. Loved this place!
Great location, close to public transport and shops and the house had everything we needed. Simon and Rue were great hosts!

The place was amazing. My family and I enjoyed it very much. I really do appreciate the electric blankets that was definitely a plus. I will definitely stay here again when my family visits in the future.

It is our first time in Melbourne and this place makes us feel so much at home. This is a really wonderful and lovely place to stay in for our family of 4 adults and an infant!  The thing that left the deepest impression for me is the beds that are supplied with heating devices. We felt warm and cozy sleeping in those beds even during this cold winter. The other thing we loved about this home is the kitchen is so well equipped with the so many variety of seasonings and cooking essentials that we can easily whipped up a nice meal. Definitely a place I would love to revisit again with my family or friends.

Roomy, comfortable apartment in an unbeatable location! You can't get much more centrally located in Melbourne than this. Great cafes and restaurants literally at the doorstep. Shopping, sights, and transport all within 5 minutes walk. Will definitely stay here again.
Our stay at Tom & Susanna's was lovely. Tom was very helpful with any questions we had, the apartment was well kept and the location was excellent.
Tom was a very welcoming host and the apartment was perfect for our needs. It is such a centrally located apartment in close proximity to everything we did!

This actually is my first time using airbnb and my friend and I are so lucky to meet Simon. The house is amazing, the host is nice, everything here are fantastic enough for us. This place is not very far from the city and it's the best choice for one or two families with a car. Anyway we are so happy with this experience. Thanks Simon!

A great place for longer family stay. Simon is extremely helpful and responsive. Restaurants and supermarket are just nearby. Strongly recommend anyone, especially with a family for longer term stay. :)

Thank you Simon & Rye for the warm hospitality. Simon was very professional in handling things. We had a great time down there and will definitely stay there again when we are around. Thank you. Wishing you a great Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

We weren’t expecting such a stylish and comfortable place.
Quiet neighbourhood and close to the city, shops and transport.
Definitely stay here if you’re visiting Melbourne.

What a lovely home in a very quiet and easy to get to area.  Great hosts, who were very thoughtful and had a real personal touch during our stay and communicated so quickly.  The house was very clean, the beds are super comfy and it was such a wonderful home to stay in.  Access to the city was very easy via public transport.  Highly recommend this property for anyone wanting to stay in a nice quiet area.
Really excellent location, one of the best in Melbourne. Right on Degraves St and surrounded by cool cafes and laneways. Can't go wrong here.
Fantastic location. So close to coffe shops, delicious food & bars. Despite being in the centre of Melbourne the apartment was quite & the beds were so comfortable. I'd definitely stay again
Surprisely spacious appartment in a very convenient location. Would definitely recommend for either a short or extended stay in Melbourne!

This place was awesome, and Tom was very helpful. We were running an hour late for check in and he greeted us with the keys and a smile. Nothing was too much trouble. There was an issue with being charged twice for cleaning fees, and air bnb were making it very difficult to resolve . Tom very kindly refunded it to us.
I would thoroughly recommend this apartment on many counts.
Cheers Rita

Great place beautiful building with amazing eating places out side the front door.
Highly recommended

Could not fault this apartment and stay! Such a central location and next to the main train station in Melbourne, variety of restaurants downstairs, next to a supermarket and right in the heart of the CBD. Check in was easy, I was met with the keys within minutes of arrival. The 2 bed apartment was big with high ceilings which made it look almost like an old style New York apartment! Very clean and stylish. They had thought of literally everything you could need in an apartment and for this week it actually felt like home to me. Loved my stay and would 100% recommend. Also great value for money!! Thank you!

Location, location, location! This apt was perfect for our family of 4 to stay in and enjoy all the sites to see in Melbourne, while being able to walk to shops, markets, restaurants & bars right at our doorstep! Loved it.
Great place as pictured clean great location near cafes, convenience store, secure apartment they even looked after our bags for us . I would recommend

Wow! Location, location, location!! (That being said, this is also a very well equipped apartment.) This is one of the coolest lanes in Melbourne and is close to all of the central attractions. You are a stones throw away from the free tram routes, the best restaurants (be prepared to queue!) and the best shopping. We have 2 young girls, the apartment is really well equipped, 2 excellent sized bedrooms, well appointed and nice and clean.  This is a really popular tourist area, there is a small amount of background noise, but to be honest, it didn't bother us. We loved our stay. Thanks Tom and Susanna 😀

Tom and Susanna's place is absolutely amazing! Right in the centre of the city, my friends and I stayed three nights and didn't even have to get a Myki card since everything was so close that we could walk or take the free trams. The apartment is beautiful, easily sleeps six, has a nice kitchen and we also watched a few movies while we were there by hooking up a laptop to the TV. Additionally, Tom was super accessible the whole time. Would definitely stay here again!
Great 2 bedroom apartment in a fantastic location. Everything you need is within minutes of the apartment.

"Excellent location, plenty of bedding and clean towels, well equipped with all necessities. Outstanding property manager who went out of her way to make sure everything was as convenient as possible for us"
Everything was in order. Great space. Owners live next door so any problems they will be sorting promptly.

We really enjoyed our stay! We enjoyed the open planned layout out and sitting outside in the courtyard and having coffee in the morning. There is a supermarket and shopping centre nearby and so many great restaurants. We would highly recommend this place for families.

Simons place was a pleasure to stay in. It had everything we needed for the whole family. We even had an extended family Christmas Day there and everyone had a thoroughly great time. It's close to shops, public transport and in a lovely quiet street.
A great stay in a great location. Neat and tidy house with everything you need. Close to trams, shops and restaurants.

This home was perfect for our family. We choose the home for its proximity to our family who live nearby and we will look to rebook here for future stays as it is a great location. Also easy to get into the city plus Highpoint is just up the road. Simon and Rue were wonderful hosts and communicated exceptionally well.

Great location. The living space is much bigger than it looks in the pictures. If you are a light sleeper take some ear plugs as the lane can be noisy early in the morning (didn’t bother us though). Would stay here again.

Excellent location to explore Melbourne CBD, very much felt that we were in the centre of things. Very comfortable for a family of 4 and location meant we could return there in the day. Some local airbnb issues in Melbourne meant check in probably wasn't as smooth as it would have been previously.
A fabulous apartment - and such an amazing location in Degraves Lane.  If you want to be right in the city action - which we did - it is perfect.

Amazing location and apartment had everything we needed as a family! We enjoyed the stay so much I would definitely stay there again! The hosts were really easy to communicate with and really friendly!
A great location in the heart of Melbourne, good value for a family and options to sleep 4 individuals and so easy to make your way to any of  the Melbourne sights from here.

Our stay at this address was great. We found the location provided awesome access to transport and eateries. The communication with the hosts was super fast and the place was as described.  Good assortment of tea and coffee options provided and comfortable living  spaces.

We had a great time stay in this house. Cleanliness and Comfort. It’s convenient to everything, and there are lots of high reviews restaurants surrounding. We will definitely be back while we come to Melbourne.

We had an amazing time at Simon's beautiful house. We immediately felt at home, with an amazingly stocked kitchen and thoughtful gifts to help us settle in. The house is a great size and really comfortable. Location-wise it is easy walking distance to shops and great restaurants, as well as parks and walking trails along the river. I would definitely recommend Simon's place for a family looking for a beautiful place to stay in Melbourne.

Our group of 3 came to Melbourne for a conference. This house was only 5 mins from the venue. The local area seems to be a quiet, peaceful area making us feel safe the whole time we were there. The house is perfect for us. Definitely a "Home away from Home". The kitchen is well set out and had everything that we needed. Beds are comfortable, as is the living area. The breakfast provisions were awesome and unexpected. Thanks Simon for providing such a relaxing and comfortable accommodation for us in Maribyrnong.

Fabulous location, beautiful apartment and not as noisy as we thought it might be in such a bustling part of the city.
Thanks for a great stay!
It really did feel like home away from home. A lovely home in a perfect location. Simon was delightful and easy to deal with. The home immaculate!! Definitely recommend staying here

The apartment is well situated for easy access to transport, cafes, shops and galleries. The apartment is well appointed and comfortable. The outside noises were quite intrusive in the early morning as major building works are going on nearby - for light sleepers we would recommend ear-plugs. Tom and Susanna are very approachable and obliging with any issues arising.
- Col and Merran

A spectacular location, attentive and responsive hosts, comfortable, clean and with all the amenities you could need for a quick city getaway.
We absolutely loved our stay.

This was a gift for my parents who loved their time at this property. The location is outstanding, the building historic and beautiful, the apartment updated, stylish and homey. Thanks to our hosts for their ready communication and friendly and easy-going manner - we've already booked the next stay!

The apartment is very nice and comfortable! Location is 10/10 - very convenient, near shops, public transport and the Yarra. The hosts were very helpful and friendly with any of our questions.
There were minor maintenance issues existing from previous guests that weren’t able to be fixed before our stay (dryer broken, damaged light switch and minor smoke smell), but these were not an issue for our stay. Overall it was an amazing experience.

If you are looking for an apartment stay in the city then look no further. This apartment is in arguably one of the best locations within the laneway district. Literally outside your apartment door you are spoiled for choice for quirky cafes, famous and hidden gem restaurants, wine bars-cocktail bars-oyster bars and shopping options beyond comprehension. Whether you are from and Melbourne wanting to rediscover the city or from out of town wanting to explore all of what Melbourne has to offers this place ticks all the boxes. Enjoy!

This location of this place is awesome and check in is very simple/well described by the hosts. Unfortunately we encountered a few issues, including dirty linen, a broken dishwasher and toilet seat, and no microwave (though this is indicated as a provided amenity). The location is well worth it though!
Very well located. Appartement is clean and spacious, perfect for a short stay in Melbourne.

Couldn’t get a better location. Everything is on your doorstep, though it doesn’t feel too busy or noisy at all. The apartment is well stocked with everything you need, and the hosts were great to deal with.
Thank you. We thoroughly enjoyed staying in your apartment. We wish we had more time in Melbourne to enjoy it more. Location is perfect.
Great location & all you need for a base to explore Melbourne CBD. Scolded to multiple cafes and shops. Wonderful.

We had an excellent stay at Tom + Susanna's. The location is amazing and so close to mini supermarkets, restaurants and anything else you might need. It was quiet at night too so a very comfortable stay! Tom + Susanna were very prompt in replying to any issues I had - we will be looking to book again one day!
Located in a very cosmopolitan part of Melbourne, it was easy to access all aspects of the CBD. The accommodation itself was comfortable, clean, and inviting. Would highly recommend to others”
Visited Melbourne to watch the tennis and this Airbnb did the job. We did experience a lot of screaming and yelling downstairs at night but to be expected in a city.

Fabulous location on Degraves Street, lovely bright apartment with everything you could need.
Main bedroom mattress a little firm for me, but I realise this is personal preference.
Overall, made our stay very pleasant.

Location location location! We encountered a problem on arrival that was rectified fully by the host within 15 minutes. We're very happy with the outcome, the speed of response and the action taken. This is a compact and character apartment with the city and its many offerings at your doorstep. Thanks Tom and Susanna!

Tom and Susanna have a nice apartment in the heart of the city. Degraves Street and Place were bustling with activity with plenty of cafes and restaurants. There was a minor hiccup with the apartment not cleaned in time for check-in, but Tom was very proactive in getting in touch, communicating when it would be ready, and even refunding the cleaning fee. Thank you, Tom and Susanna, for a memorable ANZAC day weekend for our family and I. Mike

Absolutely terrific. Couldn’t have picked a better location – right in the middle of Melbourne surrounded by cafes and restaurants. If you don’t mind sharing a bathroom it would be a great place for a family of 4. Plenty of seating in the lounge area. We all agreed we would happily stay here again.

Great location, very central to everything and really close to Flinders Station. Loved that there were some cafes downstairs! Place was also as described. It was a bit noisy at night and early in the morning though, the windows don't really block out sound.

Location, location, location. Clean, as described and in a brilliant location. Other reviews mentioned noise but we didn't notice any. Everything is right on your doorstep and the place feels secure.
If you are a tea drinker and/or take milk in your coffee you will need to go to the nearby supermarket for supplies, only a few coffee capsules provided.
Would definitely stay here again and recommend it to friends - excellent value for such a central location in Melbourne. I found the hosts to be super responsive and the access instructions were very clear and they provided photos to make it completely foolproof.

This property is right in the heart of the city. Great eats and amazing atmosphere at your door. Great space to rest after a big day of tennis and shopping. We love staying at Tom + Susanna's. Will be back again in May.

My family (4 adults) had a brilliant week at Tom and Susanna's quirky, eclectic two bedroom art deco apartment right on Degraves St. We were within easy walking distance to multiple restaurants ranging from street food to high end cuisine and 50m to the tram to take us directly to the tennis. We had a great time and can't wait to go back.

Clean comfortable apartment in a fantastic location within easy walking distance of restaurants and all the popular laneways .
Would definitely recommend and stay there again
Our stay was amazing! The Melinda's place is  wonderful, perfect place to disconnect and be in peace. Everything you need for a quiet weekend you will find in this place. We hope to return soon :)

Great views, plenty of rooms.
Smooth process.
Bring a speaker if you want to play music, old school electric stovetop, and the oven seems to only go to 120c. Lucky the BBQ is great, and in a lovely spot.

Great place for wkend break. Serene and peaceful. Would be perfect if there are more bathroom. One for 5 bedrooms seems underplanned.
Decent value for money, but good for big groups. Views from living deck are green and serene, cannot really view the distant lake and the supposedly unblocked sunrise.

My organisation booked the home and apartments for a two night stay.  We were a group of 11 people and the space and bedrooms where just perfect for our needs.  The bedrooms are very comfortable and there are very adequate dining and kitchen facilities.  The property is centrally located and we walked to the main street on several occasions for dinner and lunch.  We would love to come back and stay again.  A wonderful experience.

Right in the centre of Healesville, the place was a fantastic space for entertaining a large group. Whilst a lot of places can sleep a big group, it’s rare to find such beautiful accommodation that also allows everybody to eat and drink in one space comfortably.

We had a great stay at Michelle's place - it was the perfect size for a big group. It has an enormous kitchen for cooking meals, and lots of seating areas that could fit all of us inside & out. Having the split apartments meant people could go to bed while others stayed awake. I'd definitely recommend this getaway for group gatherings in the Yarra Valley.

We booked this house for a large group of 18 people as it offered 10 bedrooms. It’s a lovely place although the garden is nothing to write home about. What we didn’t know at booking is that it’s 3 separate apartments with 3 separate entrances. Also 9 of the bedrooms are excellent but the double- bunk room is tiny and only suitable for children really, which was an embarrassment to us when we arrived.
Nevertheless it’s comfortable and appealing place to stay, especially the main house, and in a great location.

Great place. We were very impressed with all the facilities.
Family of 18 ranging in ages from 9 months to 63 years.

Loved our stay at Michelle’s Airbnb. She was very easy to communicate with. There was also a local agent Richard who was available via text during our stay for any issues. The house itself easily fit 16 adults during our stay. The 2 apartments (on the side and bottom of the house) have seperate entrances to the main house. Overall this was a great location for our family reunion.

The apartment is brand new and great location. It has everything you need and Bill our host was very accommodating to our personal needs and made check in and check out effortless. The free tram lines are all a couple mins walk away as is the main southern cross station which made it so simple to get here via Sky bus from the airport. We had a game at Etihad stadium and that was also a stone throws away , quick walk and so convenient.  Everything this spot says it is it delivered and more. Would definitely stay here again in the future.
They were gracious, accommodating & extremely helpful! And the place is just amazing; clean & very comfortable. Would stay again if we ever visit Melbourne again :)
Bills apartment was superbly located and had great amenities. The building and apartment were modern and comfortable and communication was excellent. I would definitely stay again.
All ok .. Check in was over two hours late because the room was still not cleaned from the previous guests, which was very frustrating..

This was a very nice apartment for the price being close to the CBD. Bill and Jay were happy to let us check in and store our luggage at no extra cost and were really flexible since we wanted to spend the day exploring.
Excellent apartment. The only negative was the smoke smell from other apartments is quite strong on level 13 and can be smelt when entering the apartment. This isn't the owner's fault.
Second time in a month that I stayed here and it was spot on again,great location and everything you need at your door step, coming back in February u hope

Great location, close to food, shops and the tram. Host communities fast. Only issue was the toilet makes loud noises when you flush which is annoying at night and the washing machine turned my white clothes grey.
Rose ‘s place is wonderfull  for weekend escapes. The price is reasonable with warm and friendly service.
Great place, great communication nice touches in the home and just as described. Rose was great to deal with, cute place!

Such a beautiful space for families, plenty of room to spread out a little, the pool was great and allowed fantastic fun family time. Rose is very helpful and available at any time. Communication was easy and helpful.
We had a lovey stay at Rose’s property. Very comfortable stay, with everything you need. Really easy to access and close to shops for takeaway and supermarket shopping. A great stay for a family.

Quiet and safe neighborhood.
Walkable distance to shops Woolsworth miller and short drive to shopping mall Altona Gate. Well equipped kitchen and dining area. Great for family meals and conversation. Big family room and TV. Only one bathroom though. Washing machine and dryer were so helpful.
The apartment was amazing for our week long stay in Melbourne. The apartment is beautifully presented. James is a fantastic host. Would definitely stay here again when next in Melbourne.

I had an amazing stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, cozy, and in a great location. The host was very responsive and made sure everything was perfect for my visit. The check-in process was seamless, and I felt right at home. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay. Would definitely come back!
Thank you so much James!

James is friendly and responsive host, and I had a great relaxing stay in his beautiful apartment. He was very flexible with check in and check out, and was very accomodating with my requests. Would love to stay here again as I frequently make trips to Melbourne to see my son. Thanks again James, much appreciated!

Yolande is a warm, friendly host and her lovely garden and comfortable attractive little cottage made our stay very easy and enjoyable. Beautiful healthy and fresh produce dor breakfast on the deck overlooking the garden and Netflix was an added bonus. Quiet safe and peaceful location walking distance to shops and the train.

Yolande was a wonderful and generous host - she was very hospitable and even provided us with some food for cooking breakfast and snacks. She is very friendly and we had some great chats with her. We really enjoyed our time staying at her cottage - it is very clean, comfortable, and has everything you need. Loved the veggie patch and her beautiful garden - looking forward to come visit again - Thank you Yolande!

Yolande has created a very special place to stay.  It has everything to make a stay very memorable.  Well equipped and comfortable.  It's quiet with a delightful garden.  It's a little oasis with just the birds and bees to keep you company.  You will enjoy every moment. Highly recommended.

A very cute cottage set in a beautiful garden.  A seperate kitchen area that is fully stocked with everything you need.  Yolanda provides a great selection of breakfast options.  The bed is super comfy.  I always enjoy my stays here.

This is a pink and fluffy girly escape pad, with flowers, cookbooks and heart-shaped cushions galore. The kitchen is extremely well equipped, Yolande having been a professional chef in her previous life. I spent my downtime here watching costume period drama on Netflix and walking of the gorgeous local beach

My wife and I just finished a three night stay at Yolande's property. I have to say that it was exceptional and the beauty and tranquility of the garden flows through to the delightfully quirky nature of the accommodation. The rooms were clean and well appointed and I wish I could have done justice to the professional level kitchen. Yolande was welcoming and hospitable and added to the enjoyment of our stay. Absolutely recommended.

My family stayed here for a week while visiting us and they absolutely loved it - so much that they have booked a few more days! Yolande is the perfect host, the cottage is amazing and the garden is a little paradise! You can walk to Sandringham village and enjoy a coffee before going to the beach. The train station is 10 minutes away by foot and you will be in Melbourne CBD in 40 minutes.

Yolande is a great host, she is responsive, accommodating and her cottage has everything a traveler needs. The cottage is cozy with a very comfy bed, and a lovely garden to enjoy some outdoor time. The kitchen is very well equipped with breakfast items provided. I’ve enjoyed my stay with her.

What a wonderful place to stay! Private  clean and comfortable. I slept so well, the bed was just perfect. It was lovely to look out onto the garden each morning. Yolande treated me to some yummy homemade treats too, very spoilt! I will definitely come again.

Perfect in every way. The accommodation and host exceeded our expectations by far and would recommend to anyone visiting Melbourne as it is only a small drive or train commute to the city but has all the attributes of a quiet cottage getaway.

I am a return guest for a reason. Yolande is a terrific host and the cottage has a great feel. I enjoy sitting on the porch with a view of the gardens. It's also a quick walk to the beach and cafes. I've stayed in many Airbnb's and this is  one of my favourites

I am a repeat guest and there's a reason I keep returning. Yolande is a terrific host, the location is excellent, and it's such a pleasure to wake up surrounded by mature gardens in a quiet neighbourhood.

Great friendly host and very helpful and accommodating. The location is in a lovely quiet street very well positioned in Sandringham. Easy to walk to the shops, station and beach. Property is clean, comfortable and has everything you will need for an enjoyable stay.

This was my first trip to Australia, and what a great way of making memories. Yolande is 100% a great host, with great communication skills, and a lovely attitude towards her guests. I felt at home away from home, walking to the cottage, sitting outside in the patio or just watching the birds in the garden. The cottage is beautiful, with plenty amenities and a fantastic kitchen. Yolande also made sure I had fresh food and toiletries to use during my stay - what a treat. She spoilt it for me forever. I love talking to her and getting to know her more and I would love to come back and stay longer. The best Airbnb experience I have ever had.
Yolande was a really great host. Her place was very nice with stunning cottage gardens. Yolande really made us welcome. Loved her place and hope to return. Many thanks Yolande.

Yolande's peaceful cottage was a home away from home. from the welcoming Persian " grumpy" cat to the fragrant garden , fully equipped but separate kitchen, swarming bees, and incredibly comfy bed it was all a lovely experience . yolande and her neighbors were responsive and helpful all the time.

Everything you could want from an Air b and b
Yolande is extremely friendly and helpful
A comfortable bed and living room the kitchen is great
Sandringham is a lovely place to stay
Excellent host excellent place. Quiet but within walking distance of the train station, cafes, shops and beach.
Apartment is near to station. Walking distance to the shopping mall and all. It will be perfect if everything is clean, rubbish are clear. Else everything is good
Everything you need is within walking distance. The Apartment is quite clean, the cereal and milk was very nice touch. Checkin was smooth.

I stayed here on a work trip. Everything was really convenient as the local supermarkets, train station, tram stops are within a few minutes walk. The place was clean and provisions were as described in the profile.
The place was pretty clean and they have provided everything that you would generally need. There is complete privacy and no noisy neighbours. Will definitely recommend this place.

Our stay at this location was great, the host was super responsive and helpful. The location was perfect for people wanting to utilise public transport to get around, close to lots of restaurants. Would recommend to anyone wanting somewhere to stay while exploring the city.

This was an excellent property to stay at. The location is amazing. Right across the road from the station and central to everything you need. Any questions I had were answered quickly by the host and they were very helpful.
Property was very clean and safe and I really could not recommend it enough if you are staying in Melbourne.
UWS is responsif host…good  location, the apartement near the station and many restaurant..thank you UWS for great hospitality

We had a wonderful stay! The host was incredibly friendly and supportive, always ready to help with anything we needed. Check-in was very flexible, which made our trip stress-free. The place was spotless, well-connected to public transport and attractions, and the furniture was comfortable and in great condition. We truly appreciated the warm hospitality and would happily stay again!

The hosts were wonderful and we felt very welcomed at their place. It was a really comfortable stay and it is an exciting experience to stay in the middle of a cherry field and wake up to be surrounded by the stunning view. The rooms were very nicely furnished and the kitchen was fully functional as well. I love the furnishing of the bathroom the most and there is even an oven and microwave (seldom see these in other Airbnb). We'd love to visit again in near future and we are thankful for such a good stay.

Amazing host! Brigitte was more welcoming than any guest can expect. she contacted me prior to the booking with all the details I needed for my bookig and how to find the property. The house was immaculate, and very well presented.  Ot had all the creature comforts you would want, and lovely addition touches such as homemade biscuits. Brigitte also knew we were celebrating birthdays, so made birthday cupcakes for us both. We could not have had a better time. Really looking forward to staying with Brigitte and John again.

A faultless stay at a very beautiful location. Brigette and John warmly welcomed us, and have made this cosy cabin feel like a home away from home. The setting makes for the perfect Yarra Valley experience, surrounded by rolling hills and beautiful orchids and within reach of all the best vineyards. The cabin is well thought out, and is equipped with everything you might need, with beautiful touches throughout. We wished we could have stayed another night and highly recommend this spot if you are looking for a get away in this beautiful part of the world.
Exceeded our expections, went above and beyond for us. A stunning cabin in a fantastic location. So friendly and kind and the home baked treats were wonderful. Thank you so much!
Brigitte's cottage is superb and the extra treats such as scones, cakes, truffles and fruit were delicious. Look forward to returning.

this cabin is in a beautiful, peaceful setting. It is cosy and spotlessly clean. It is exceedingly well equipped and the special treats awaiting when you arrive are delicious and unexpected. The hosts are warm and welcoming, enthusiastic and wonderful - we will visit again

As our first ever airbnb experience  ...our  stay in Brigitte's cottage at Cherry Boys surpassed all expectations . Not only was the location ideal-  but John and Brigitte were the most welcoming hosts . We highly recommend a stay- and we  will certainly be back ! Thank you so much Brigitte and John for such a memorable visit

Brigitte and John, We can't thank you enough for our stay!  Beautiful place, beautiful views and beautiful hosts.  Your amazing hospitality was very much appreciated.  The thoughtful touches - scones, fresh milk and cream, chocolate cake to name only a few - was unexpected, yet also appreciated.  We are already looking forward to our next stay with you.  Thank you again, Deb & Stu

We have stayed in many Air bnb & we would have to say it was the best experiences. From the first messages of hi & welcome, the personalised notes on our arrival, to the final photo of us in the air, you made us feel ever so welcome. You can definitely tell this little gem you have created is your baby. You thought of everything anyone could want  on a night away from home. The place felt clean, fresh & very well appointed. You should be extremely proud of what you can offer others with your slice of heaven up in the hill. We would love to return one day, not only for the peaceful getway but also to see you again. THANK YOU from the bottom our hearts.

This could be the best airbnb stay you'll ever have.
Brigitte and John are excellent hosts, providing everything as described in the listing and going above and beyond - assisting with things to do in the area, baking numerous treats for you, providing fresh fruit and pantry staples and generally being very helpful and attentive hosts. The cabin is nicely set up for families, with games, books and dvd's for the kids. The heater works well and the place is nice and cosy. Exceptionally clean and organised. 5 stars.
We will be back.
Lovely clean modern accomodation, very comfortable bed, nice welcome treats and a spectacular view! Brigitte and John were great hosts, and we would happily recommend the Cherry Orchard Cabin.

The cottage has a tasteful decor, super clean and tidy, generous treat from local produce to very delicious homemade sweets and cake.
Brigitte seems like a person who enjoys fine things and loves sharing it too.
We were at the cottage when the cherry season ended so we could walk around the farm to soak up morning sun or sit outside at sunset with mountain view in the foreground.
Brigitte and her friendly family are very responsive to your request to make our stay as pleasant as possible.
Thank you again for making our stay a memorable one.

Absolutely breathtaking! My girlfriends and I stayed at Brigitte and John’s farm for 2 nights as a girls getaway and we were just blown away, not only by the views and the serenity but by the lovely hosts themselves. The cabin had everything we needed! And with some beautiful little personal touches we felt right at home. Very easy to get around, we ordered Uber’s from the cabin to different wineries and didn’t have any issues, very easy to get to the local Woolies or Aldi. I cannot fault our stay, we didn’t want to leave! We will definitely be making this our annual getaway and won’t stay anywhere else! Thank you again Brigitte & John.

We absolutely loved our stay Cherry Orchard Cabin. Brigitte is an incredible host. Very prompt and smooth communication, such a warm welcome checking in and thoughtful touches all throughout the cabin.
Fresh figs from the farm and homemade cakes for us to enjoy during our stay, were so thoughtful!
The location is great, 5mins from cafes & supermarkets but so peaceful you’d think you were hours from anywhere.
Perfect for our family escape from the city. Really can’t speak more highly of our stay.
We will 100% be back to visit Brigitte & John!

We had a great weekend at Brigitte's cabin, it is in a stunning location with beautiful views and easy access by car to many Yarra Valley attractions. Brigitte made us feel like part of the family with her welcoming presence. The little goodies she made were delicious and we greatly appreciated all the thought she put in to making our stay stellar.

Brigitte puts "super" into super host. Brigitte and John welcomed us on arrival, ensured our stay was perfect, and made sure everything was okay during our stay. The cabin is sparkling clean, and Brigitte and John put in great touches like, eggs, milk, honey, granola, fruit etc. to make your stay special. Communication was quick and easy too.
The cabin is at the southern end of the Yarra Valley, and you will need a car to get places, but nothing is more than 30 minutes away. The cabin is warm and cosy in winter too.
While there is internet, the local internet was pretty slow, but this is beyond Brigitte and John's control.
You won't go wrong staying with Brigitte and John. I highly recommend you do.

We had a really lovely stay at the Cherry Orchard cabin located on the Cherry Boys farm and would recommend it for a quiet, country stay. The beautiful views from the front windows are rolling hills, the location is peaceful and picturesque. The cabin is very well equipt, had everything we needed and more, good heating, comfy beds, and lovely toiletries.
Hosts, Brigitte and Jon were very friendly and welcoming, the cabin was spotless when we arrived, and they even left us a range of home baked treats and fresh produce!
This accommodation is more than I expected.
Thanks Brigitte and Jon, I’ve no doubt we’ll be back!
Brigitte and John are wonderful! The property is surrounded by breathtaking hills and the rooms are beautifully set up so touchingly. We will be definitely coming back.

Wow wow wow, I would give this place 6 stars if that were possible. I regularly stay in Airbnb’s but Brigitte and John’s place has been the best place I have ever stayed in. Not only are they the most lovely people, but small touches such as a homemade chocolate cake, fresh milk and oranges from their garden made it so personal. The place was sparkling clean, cozy, bed was super comfy, the kitchen had all amenities. Would 110% recommend staying here. Thanks so much again Brigitte and John!

There is a reason that Brigitte and John have such stellar reviews for their cabin! It was everything you could possibly hope for and then some - a truely gorgeous location, surrounded by great places to eat and visit, two of the most kind and genuine hosts I've had the pleasure of meeting and even a few kangaroos hopping away in the background. We had a wonderful time there and begun planning our next visit before we even left. A truely special place!

Thank you Brigitte and John for your warmth and hospitality. The cottage was pristine, the location spectacular, and excellent communication. We will definitely be recommending the cottage to our friends.

The cherry orchard cabin was amazing, clean, and homely. The fine touches of home-baked cake, snacks/fruits, towels and welcome note added to the warm hospitality that Brigitte and John provided. We felt at home.
When we arrived, the baby cot was already set up! And they were there to welcome and show us around. A real superhost indeed!
All in all, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay there and will definitely stay with them again when we visit Yarra Valley in the future.

This is as good as I can imagine any B & B could be. It had the comfort. It had the views and the magnificent setting and it had the best hosts. The Yarra Valley provided great places to visit, but staying in was just as enjoyable.

I just want to say a huge thank you to Brigitte and John for the unforgettable and authentic farm stay we had at there beautiful Cherry orchard.
I could not of picked a better place and with better people.
Brigitte made my partner the yummiest cake for his 30th birthday! She also made sourdough bread and lots of other delicious home made treats. My 5 year old son love it, and she gifted him a take home art activity. The cabin was so clean and well presented. They thought of everything to make the stay homie and welcoming.
We can’t wait to come visit again.
Lots of love
Juandri, Eugene and Hunter.

Brigitte and John were wonderful hosts and went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Our kids booked in a one night stay here for us and Brigitte made lovely scones and a heart-shaped cake especially personalised for our anniversary.
The views and surroundings are beautiful at the cabin and you are surrounded by nature and native animals.
The space is clean and well maintained and we loved all the personalised touches.
My first stay was great that I returned a second. Super clean, comfy and an exceptional host Brigitte!

Bridgette and John were the most warm and thoughtful hosts we have had the please of meeting in our travels. Bridgette has thought of everything to include to help make your stay special including many special little treats. The cabin is very comfortable and clean and the views are gorgeous. It was exactly what we were looking for to relax and enjoy the beautiful area. We have a 3 year old and a 6 year old and they loved Bridgette and John just as much as we did. If we are lucky enough to get back to the area we would love to stay again.

From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, both John and Brigitte were extremely welcoming! The stunning views, quiet and relaxing space was the perfect home away from home. On top of all this Brigitte and John added in personal touches specific to myself and my guests which really set this bnb aside from all other places I’ve stayed at! We’re extremely happy with our stay at this home 😊🥰

Cherry Orchard Cabin B&B deserves more than 5 stars! Many thanks to Brigitte and John for putting their hearts and souls into making the place so wonderful during our stay. We will be back next winter for another cherry season and be sure to stay at Cherry Orchard Cabin once again!

Dear Brigitte and John,
It was so great to stay at your cabin. The location was amazing, so picturesque, and it was such a serene getaway for us! The cabin was very tidy, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed for our comfortable stay. Our toddler loved the books, toys and mostly wanted to stay outdoors exploring your beautiful farm. Brigitte and John were incredibly friendly hosts. The cabin was comfortable, clean and I would highly recommend staying here.

Cabin is beautifully furnished, super clean & the location is stunning. Set on top of the hill amongst the cherry & fig orchards.
The kitchen is filled with delicious home made goodies that just made you feel so welcome.
Hosts are friendly and go above and beyond expectations to make your stay a memorable one. It’s definitely the place to choose in Wandin. Just gorgeous!!!

We had a delightful stay at the Cherry Boys. The breathtaking surroundings and charming decor made us feel right at home, and the fireplace added to the cozy atmosphere. Highly recommended for a relaxing and memorable getaway.

Lovely place & host. Definitely beyond our expectation. We booked the stay but our plans were disrupted & thought it would be a wasted trip up Wandin. However, just the stay itself saved the trip. Thank you Brigitte and John for a wonderful and relaxing holiday. We truly appreciate your hospitality. Loved the cabin and enjoyed the walk around the property.
We’ll definitely be seeing you again💜

Brigitte and John were very welcoming. Their Cheery Farm is picturesque and the cottage is cosy, quiet and inviting.

We had such a beautiful stay at cherry cottage, the hosts were beyond lovely. They gave us such a warm welcome that made us instantly feel comfortable and at home for the duration of our stay. We honestly felt like we were staying with family and will definitely be back again. Thanks again xx
this was our 2nd stay and it did not disappoint.   Lovely greeting from Brigitte and John, very comfortable accommodation    Thoroughly recommend

Exceptional host, memorable experience for our family! Brigitte and John went out of their way for us, from getting us onto the Puffing Billy when our ride got cancelled, to sharing their fresh picked fruits in their beautiful farm, homemade goodiessss and inviting us into their beautiful home to see Kobi. The perfect base for exploring the Yarra Valley, Dandenong Ranges, and Puffing Billy.
