If you're looking for a cozy, welcoming retreat with incredible attention to detail, this is the place!
Thank you Brigitte and John for a perfect weekend. We can’t wait to return.

We had a lovely stay at Brigitte and John’s cabin. The house was warm and clean. I especially appreciate the warm bathroom in this winter. We also saw kangaroos and hot air balloons over the breathtaking Yarra Valley.
Brigitte and John were warm and welcoming. The little touches like the fig roll ups and chocolate cake that she baked made the kids’ day.
The location was quiet but near to everything. Woolworths was 4 mins away by car.
Would love to stay here again if we get the chance.

Mon's place was absolutely perfect, great position near shops and public transport. The decor was beautiful as was the pool and garden area and the view from the large balcony was also great. Mon was great to communicate with, the whole process was completely seamless.

A very smart and well appointed apartment located conveniently close to the Spenser Rd Train Station. The lockers at the station  were convenient also for leaving luggage in when we had to check out on yet last the morning, but still had the day to spend around town.  We took use of the gym and pool, but most of the time was spent walking around the city - as it should be!
It's a very great stay at Le City apartment. It's very easy to communicate with the host. Our whole family like this apartment so much. It's feel so warm and cosy.
Awesome place to stay, have a great time, plenty of space for 4 females too, would definitely recommend and stay again. Thank you....

Enjoyed my stay at Mon's place, which came fully equipped and within walking distance to Spencer Street Outlet Centre and Coles. The only hassle of staying in this apartment is obtaining the carpark swipe and keys to access the building before check in, which needs to have a fair bit of facilitation between host and traveller prior to reaching. Would love to stay at Mon's place again.
Located at CBD, very convient to go anywhere.  The apartment is clean and tidy.  I surely consider to stay here next time.

Such a beautiful apartment in a great location! Walking distance from public transport, shops and cafes. The apartment was spotless and spacey even with 8 guests. Mon was always quick to respond in communication and was incredibly accommodating when asked for early check in and late check out.
So pleased with our stay, we hope to visit again :)

Beautiful place just as photo. Mon is a very good host. Very thoughtful and always keeping in touch. The rooms are comfortable and clean. And the public place is also very comfy. The kitchen got everything you need. My family and I really enjoyed staying here. Skybus and tram stations just 5 minutes walk. Very recommend.

I really loved this apartment. It's exactly as described, clean and stylish with a beautiful view. Located very well in the middle of infrastructure and public transport. Mon provided all necessary information and replied fast to all our questions. I can absolutely recommend staying here!
Responsive and accommodating host, fantastic apartment to stay in if you are in the CBD. Highly recommended!
We had a great stay at Mon's place, nice and clean room, and great location, and Mon responsed very quickly. Would definitely come again next time when we in Melbourne.

This is a great apartment to stay! It is in a good location close to trams and trains. It was clean, modern and well equipped, although there was a bit of noise in the mornings from construction sites across the road. Mon was very prompt and helpful with all our communication throughout the booking process and  our time there. Thankyou Mon

Brilliant location, very stylish and everything you would need. The only thing to watch out for is that (due to its central location) it can be a bit busy and noisy in the building. This shouldn't surprise you but is something to consider before booking.

Lovely appartment with a good view. Had everything we needed. Good location, plenty of teams in walking distance as was cbd and very close to Southern Cross train station. Great Outlet mall 2 mins walk away!
Apartment was as per listing. Baby cot and high chair available. Owner was flexible with arrangements.
Best location to stay in. The house is Nice with stylish designed. The Host is great and been very helpful. Patiently giving clear instructions to get to the place and quick response to messages

Amazing abode, we came in a big group of 8, so we had to use the sofa bed in the living room, when we got there everything was all arranged, the sofa bed was made. Excellent communication. Definitely would stay again!

This apartment is excellent! The location is perfect because it's in the middle of city, there are lot of small restaurants and coffee shops, it's near the tram and train station, and there are convenient store nearby. The whole apartment is spotless. And all our necessities are provided (kitchen utensils, washing and drying machine, bathroom amenities). We had a very enjoyable stay here. Thank you!

Great apartment, great location, building had great amenities kids loved the pool, very clean & Mon is a great host her communication is great & answers all questions very quickly, I would definitely stay here again and recommend to family & friends.
Great place to stay in Melbourne.  Great location in large multi unit building.  Very clean and exactly as pictured.

Easy access to this great central apartment, with trams, railway station and discount shopping all within 200m.  Fantastic to get 3 bedrooms so our group of 5 could all stay comfortably. Mon was helpful with her directions and communications under such pressure with the coronavirus at the time.

This place is beautiful! The balcony is larger than it seems and has a nice view. The rooms are spacious and there are plenty of amenities in case you forget the essentials. The kitchen is also extremely clean and easy to use. Definitely recommend!
Monika was a great host, really responsive & helpful. Apartment was very clean & today & had everything we needed. - Thankyou

Great location from central station 5 min walk. Bedrooms not air conditioned which mad the room very stuffy.
Monika was excellent replied to my messages straight away we would stay again when in Melbourne.

Fabulous Family weekend away best location, Apartment was absolutely spectacular  met all our needs  and spotless we definitely stay there again. Our host Monika we thank for all your communication on arriving and departure and  organising the extra car park, The Besic Fam
Location is great. Very convenient. Entrance is abit obscure, it is easier to find on foot than driving. House contains everything you need and very comfortable stay.

Monika and Young were great host. Responded very quickly. Check-in instructions were quite detailed and helpful.
The apartment was very clean. Location was great. Overall a wonderful place. We would stay here again easily.

This listing was just as described with all the basics. Brilliant location. A bit cosy for 6 adults but who cares when you are hardly there.  Good communication from the host.  Would happily stay again

Monika and Young are great communicators and host.
They made our our family experience in their apartment very easy and comfortable.
The apartment was nice and clean, beds were cosy and location was very close to Southern Cross Train Station, Trams, Restaurants, Grocery Store and Shopping.
I would highly recommend Monika and Young's apartment to any family visiting the Melbourne CBD... 🙂
Monika was super helpful with allowing us to check in early, the place was a great location and the beds were comfy. All you could ask for in the centre of Melbourne!

The area was very nice. Easy access to train terminal and supermarkets. Lots of local restaurants and all within walking distance. The apartment was very spacious and we were able to spend the evenings comfortably even with a large party.

Good apartment in very convenient location. A little difficult to find initially but instructions were very clear and helpful and hosts responsive. The wifi was patchy throughout making working and streaming impossible. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Great location that is very walkable!  Close to grocery stores and shopping.  Good for groups, but maybe ask for a few extra linens.  Otherwise was well stocked

Great location.
Monika communicated quickly and was always helpful when I had a question
AC remote was not working. Unit was generally grimy and dusty, most glass surfaces had finger prints on them. Shower and toilet had not been cleaned or was only quickly wiped down.

We enjoyed staying in this house and loved its quirkiness and the art. The house was well suited to accommodating the seven of us.The location was brilliant for us, close to our relatives in Altona where we were having a large family reunion, and easy for day trips and the motorways. We enjoyed the ferry ride into Melbourne and walks along the foreshore reserves going into Williamstown and Altona. The kitchen/dining area was good for entertaining.

We enjoyed a Magical Mystical Weekend at the Arthouse! Apart from the eclectic Art, Andy is definitely one for detail.
We found Mood Lighting, Comfy corners to sit in and many treats were found in the Kitchen. If you are a ‘Minimalist’ – Do Not Apply.

A fantastic place for our 25km Covid escape!  Full of surprising touches, and a very comfortable bed in a really welcoming, soothing room. Though it looks a bit wild in the photos it is really very homely. Lots of great books, fantastic bath, loved the sinks too! Sunny outside area a bonus too, and nearby beach and wetland walks full of interest.  Love to go back when we can go out sans mask and actually eat at a restaurant or go to the pub!
Very interesting house in a good location in Williamstown. Very clean with lots of amenities. Highly recommended.

Loved Andrew’s place, was exactly like the pictures. Great art, very quirky feel, rain showers was a nice touch, and we enjoyed the converted sunroom. My girls like staying in the loft bedroom. Went for a great walk along the coastal trail to Williamstown.
What a great, quirky house. A good location, close to shops, ferry and waterfront. Loved main shower off back room. Thanks Andrew for a smooth checkin and communication.
Such a beautiful home, so unique and gave us an experience we will never forget. Felt like living in our personal gallery :)

Andrew was so accommodating. We made a very last minute booking and were not disappointed. Beautifully quirky little house, set in a quiet street, close to parks and shops. The unique elements of the house had the kids entertained for hours. Very comfortable, clean and spacious.
Easy access to the city and 5 minutes from the fabulous grazeland. So well positioned for a great weekend away.

My children and I had a fantastic stay at the Art House. The house is a fun, visual delight for the eyes whilst also being spacious enough for my four children and myself.  The beds and linen were extremely comfortable and the house was wonderfully quiet. The location was perfect as a base to explore Williamstown and the City and Andrew was a friendly host who was quick to respond to any messages. Would definitely recommend!

We really enjoyed our stay at Andrew’s place. It was nice and peaceful at night, spacious enough for the five of us, and had everything we needed including a coffee machine. The plentiful art was an added bonus, providing plenty of things to talk about. Andrew was very quick to respond, and was easy to communicate with. Thanks, Andrew, for hosting us.

My family loved Andy’s place. I unfortunately missed out on the trip as I was unwell, but my husband an three grown up daughters stayed and had a wonderful time. The house is even better than described and full of interesting art, photos and decorative pieces. The house is situated in a quiet street with easy access and only a 5 minute drive to the beach and supermarket. Williamstown is full of historical architecture and plenty of things to do for all ages. My family thoroughly recommend Andy’s place and would definitely stay here again hopefully next time I will be able to join them.

1 double bed, 1 twin bedded, 1 bunk bed and 1 double up the narrow stair at the attic. difficult for the aged to sleep upstair.
lots of antique, pictures in the house.
the BBQ pit is abit rusty, maybe good to change.
otherwise all is good, unique house.
very responsive. thanks

Nice house, Suited our needs. Parking was easy, easy to find. Quiet location.
Extra blankets and pillows. Tea coffee sugar milk for our use. Interesting place to stay.

Andrew was a great host and communicated well. The eclectic furnishings made us feel like we travelled all over the world.
The accommodation was close to the beach and botanical gardens.

We had a fabulous time at Andrew’s place. As a creative family we really appreciated all of the interesting art pieces and unique interior decorating touches around the house. We had all the comforts we needed. Extra blankets, towels and bathroom products were provided which was nice. The kids really enjoyed the wonderful lights and dioramas and attic window looking out to the starry night sky. Fantastic location, close to the main drag and beach. A magical experience!

Lovely home, really cosy and calming. Great location, close to the supermarket and lots of different things to do in Altona. The host (Andy) is the most helpful and lovely man, helped with all questions and really quick to answer. Will definately be back staying at the 'Art house by the Bay' next time I'm in Melbourne.

We had a three-night stay in this unique and beautifully curated house that feels like a home. It looks exactly like the photos and delivered a great experience for our family. The range of artwork and well curated travel memorabilia was awesome. We spent a number of hours just looking at bookshelves and at the models built into boxes and tables. All with LED lighting. Our thoughts are that staying at an Airbnb should be fun, quirky and comfortable and deliver a unique experience, one you don't get at home. This house delivered on all fronts. We are grateful to have had the experience of staying at the house and will definitely look to stay again one day and will recommend to friends.
Andy was helpful and responsive and flexible with checkin. Many thanks

We absolutely loved our stay at Andy's place! Our grandchildren (age 4 & 8) thought it was magical, as did we.  Plenty of room for us all and such a creative and interesting space to be in.  Great to be able to park easily just over the road and really a very short drive to everything we needed in Williamstown.  Highly recommend this special Airbnb and we look forward to returning.

Laura’s place was wonderful! It had everything we needed and more. It was clean and so close to our event at Flemington racecourse. I would 100% recommend this Airbnb and Laura was lovely to communicate with.

Location was perfect and an easy walk to the shops.
The place was super clean and tidy, and exactly how described. It was a wonderful experience for myself. Highly recommend
Laura was also so wonderful with her replies and so quick

David's place is a stylish and beautifully appointed apartment in one of the most attractive, historic neighbourhoods in Melbourne. We stayed here for 6 weeks while moving from Sydney and cannot fault  this apartment. A modern interior design blends beautifully with David's original art, the bed is super comfortable and the  neighbourhood is quiet. David is about to install a laundry which will make the apartment ideal for long term stays. Great cafe's, restaurants, bars and the much loved South Melbourne market are a stones throw away as are two tram lines that connect through to the city and the south. As a host David cannot be faulted and went out of his way to make our stay in South Melbourne one that we will always remember with a smile.

A lovely place, just like in the photos: modern, clean, and all the necessities you could possibly need. A really well put together apartment for a single or a couple. Right in the heart of South Melbourne and not far from Southbank and the city centre.

Great little place with all mod cons in a great location in South Melbourne, a short walk to bars and restaurants and 10 minutes from the city on the tram. Had a relaxing stay here and it has one of the best showers. It's clean and very well presented. Only caveat is that it might be a little on the snug side for two people for an extended stay. Other than that the artists studio is highly recommended.
This was our second stay and yet again it did not disappoint!  Great little home in a great location!
David’s apartment is immaculate! Excellent location in the heart of South Melbourne. We enjoyed our stay, suited our accommodation requirements perfectly. David is a kind and friendly host. Thank you

David's place was amazing and he gave me some really helpful tips on how to get around the area. I was attending a Swim Meet at MSAC and David's place was perfect walking distance to the pool. South Melbourne is also a hidden gem! So many great restaurants!

A FABULOUS place to sum it up in one word.  From the meet and greet with David through to the sparkling clean apartment and the extras that have been included that I haven’t seen at other AirBnb’s. Location is also great for those who like to be close to the city and all it has to offer.  We will definitely come again. Thanks David
Great location, terrific host and the flat is fabulous for 2 people. Parking is easy, access to public transportation a 5 minute walk. Shops and restaurants nearby. What's not to like?

This studio is situated in a great location. It was spotlessly clean and in immaculate condition. We had no issues with car parking. It is only metres from two tram stops and shopping precinct in Clarendon Street.
We felt very comfortable and safe and secure.
I can highly recommend.

I give David’s place full stars, it is the second time I have booked it, and I find it is so close to great restaurants and the market, and public transport and for me it is close to my family and I get to stay in a beautifully decorated and appointed apartment that meets all my needs.  I have no doubt I will book it again in the future, I fully recommend it to travellers and feel it will meet all high expectations.

This absolute pearl is definitely worth getting.
It's in a quiet part of the city, close to the tran and other transports.
The appartement is clean, fresh and well maintained.
David's art really enhances the rooms and makes it all the more interesting.
This place is hands down one of the best airbnb's I've been in.
Definitely on my list of first places to look into if I'm back in Melbourne again one day

Amazing listing! The location is excellent, walkable distance of almost everything. The studio itself is very spacious, even better than on photos. It is well equipped, and everything is brand new and operational. David is a wonderful host, very flexible, accommodating and responsive.
It was a perfect stay, I definitely recommend.

Really enjoyed our stay at David's place great location with plenty of great cafes and restaurants nearby. highly reccomend !!
thanks David

The house is very bright and spacious; every morning we enjoyed the sunlight in the bedroom and the living room 🤩.
The design and the decoration are awesome 😍
The location is perfect for all activities.
We enjoyed our journey; it is our best Airbnb stay !!!!

Clean, lovely flat, great neighborhood, gracious host. It was what I hoped it would be - a great place from which to launch and regroup. Really enjoyed the vibrant neighborhood and found it easy to navigate from/to without feeling too full of bustle. So many fantastic cafes but it was South Melbourne Market that captivated me, and the park. Highly recommend David’s Artists Studio.

I had a wonderful stay at this place. The place was not only clean and cozy but also conveniently located, making it easy to access everything I needed. The host was incredibly warmhearted and made me feel right at home. With amazing artwork that added to the charm of the place.
I would highly recommend this artist studio to anyone looking for a unique and comfortable stay.
This is a really nice space for a business trip or a couple.  Nicely furnished, quiet and very comfortable.  Highly recommended.
Though we didn't actually make it to check in due to family commitments, Carla was  incredibly helpful! Looking forward to staying in future.

Such a lovely little place that is an easy walk to a variety of cafe's and restaurant's. The supermarket is nearby and it's a quick drive to the beach. Awesome location! Would definitely recommend staying here if you're up for a relaxing getaway. Carla is super responsive and amazing help!

this lovely compact cosy eyrie is exactly as described! everything works, and it's pretty and tasteful to boot. great location, so handy to train (and buses); local eateries, watering holes and provisioners all good. plants and fleurs an added treat. Carla has clearly held her guests in mind.

Carla's apartment is beautiful and even better than the pictures! The living area is spacious and my only regret is that we didn't spend more time just relaxing there while on our trip - the courtyard would be perfect in summer. Carla gave great recommendations for nearby coffee shops and restaurants - we visited one place three times in three days! The apartment is located 30 seconds from a supermarket and a 2 minute walk from the train so the location is perfect. Carla was so easy to reach and got back to me within minutes whenever I had a query, both in the lead up to the trip and over the stay itself. The only difficulty we had was getting our (small!) car into the garage so be warned if you have anything bigger than a compact car. I would definitely consider staying here again when visiting Melbourne.

The apartment is very comfortable and in a perfect location to get the train into Melbourne as the train station is only 4 minutes walking. Local cafes and restaurants are good and if the weather is good you have your own private balcony/outside seating area.

Carla's apartment is so nice and very clean, we were only there for one night but it would be a great place to spend longer as it's so close to transport, dining options and a supermarket. I would definitely recommend this place to others.
Carla was a great host! Very easy to deal with, got back to us with questions quickly and the apartment was great. Had everything we needed, tidy and very affordable. We would certainly recommend it.

Visiting for the week for work, Carla’s Place was so great it felt like home right away. I loved the kitchen which had everything I needed to cook and not have to rely on eating out al the time while away. Good proximity to the sea, a great fitness first and an awesome yoga/float studio, Liquid, which I took full advantage of before/after work. Very comfortable, spacious modern unit that was quit with everything I needed. I would def stay there again should I find myself working out of Melbourne again.
Stayed myself and happy to recommend to anyone looking. So comfortable and a very functional living space. Carla is also a delight to deal with.

I booked Carla’s apartment for my parents when they came to visit from the UK. They really enjoyed their stay. The apartment is like a little oasis, full of natural light and a lovely outdoor space. The apartment was very clean. The location was fantastic, very close to the station and cafes, supermarket and restaurants/bars. Carla was a great host with super quick responses and also went out of her way to search the apartment for an item after we had left that we had lost. We would definitely book again.
when we arrive at this apartment it was as described , we were not disappointed everything we needed for a comfortable stay "great week we will return

Carla was so easy to communicate with. Wonderfully easy gaining. access to the home.
The place was better than expected
and wonderful cook in.
awesome outdoor area to enjoy.
Thank you for such a beautiful home.

Carla’s place was in a close proximity to the Highett station, walking distance to local cafes and local restaurants.
She was also prompt in responding and extremely hospitable.
Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a short or long term stay.
Carla's apartment suited my needs for a course I was attending last weekend. Lovely apartment.  Very convenient to the trains and Woolworth. Not far from the beach either. Good for couples stay.

Very nice apartment in the suburb of Highett. Apartment and kitchen was nicely appointed with everything we needed for our stay. Adjacent to Woolworths and near many small, local restaurants.
I was geographically challenged and did not realize it was so far from Melbourne when we booked this accommodation. It took about 2 hours to get into and out of the city every day. Great place if you want a nice stay in the suburbs.
Great location for us. Thank you for a great stay. The only problem was the garage was too small for our hired car. 🚗
Good location as it is near to train station and is within free tram zone. Surrounded with food choices.

Such a neat and cosy apartment perfect for the two of us! Great location, close to all public transport and literally a two minute walk to the awesome Queen Victoria Markets. Gwyneth is such a great host and extremely helpful, very speedy response time and check in / out couldn't have been easier. Unit is self contained - by why cook at home with all those glorious restaurants so close by!! Can confidently recommend this unit and Gwyneth as your host.
Host was really friendly and gave clear instructions on how to check-in/check-out. The place was close to everything and was really clean. Will definitely visit again the next time I'm in Melb!
Great location right next to malls, Chinatown, and Queen Vic Markets. All we could need for our week long stay. Recommended to all

Gwyneth's apartment is exactly as described: Clean, modern and centrally located in Melbourne's CBD. We appreciated Gwyneth's local recommendations on cafes and restaurants, which we made use of throughout our stay and were never stuck for great places eat. The check-in process was also smooth and easy, which helped us get our vacation started without stress or anxiety.

The location was perfect and Gwyneth’s place offered everything that you’d need for a short/medium stay or visit to Melbourne. The place was clean and stylish; comfortably accommodating for one or two people.
Gwyneth was great to communicate with. Would recommend Gwyneth’s place to other guests.

The apartment was comfortable and convenient for our stay in Melbourne, with plenty of grocery shopping options nearby.  It was close to the Victoria Market, which was a fun place to visit for lunch.  We enjoyed our stay. Thank you, Gwyneth, for your hospitality.

Marnie was such a sweetheart checking us in! We got there a little too early, but she said we could leave our luggage while we checked in. She even texted us to come back when she was done cleaning! Gwyneth’s place was super clean and the perfect location for us first timers in Melbourne. So many restaurants and shops were within walking distance. The building itself is pretty new and there was a security guard there at the front desk at all times (so we felt really safe). Lovely balcony and awesome views. For being in the city, it wasn’t loud at all so we got a good nights rest. I had trouble finding the living room light switch and texted Marnie. She texted back straight away and was super helpful (it’s behind the front door and wall between the gap). We would definitely come back and stay here again!
Would highly recommend staying here! Gwyneth was lovely and available for any and all questions we had.
Gwyneth is one of the best hosts I’ve ever experienced. She is very considerate and responsive. The location is very convenient with walking distance to the city center.
Christine was very welcoming and considerate. She has a lovely home and we really enjoyed staying there.
Loved the bay window, tall ceilings and calm of the house and the neighbourhood. Christine was a trusting and generous host.

Christine’s place is perfectly located between the airport and the CBD.
We stayed only 1 night before heading off to Great Ocean Road but we really enjoyed our stay.
There is plenty of space in the room and everything was really clean.
Much better than a hotel!
Had a chat with Christine and she's such a lovely lady, wish we had more opportunities to chat during my stay. The place was great too, of course. Would stay again, for sure.

Had a great one-night stay at Christine's place. The house is located in a quiet residential area, about 7 minutes walk from Moonie Ponds train station from which its only 15 minutes to central Melbourne. Self check-in was really easy and the instructions were clear. The room is spacious and very quiet. The bathroom is just around the corner, very clean and I had it all to myself. I could also use the kitchen which was great. Christine is a very pleasant and hospitable person, we had a really nice chat.  Will definitely stay again!
Lovely area, wonderful house and welcoming host who collected us from the train station when we were delayed in our travels.

The room got moved outside of her house into a renovated garage/ self-contained room in the back of her garden. Sadly we didn't have hot water in the shower, she did offer to shower in her house though.
If you’re looking a place to stay in Melbourne then this is it! Christine is great and the place is beautiful and cozy :)

I'm a student from Monash college. It was a good corporation with both Valeria and flexi_accommodation. Valeria is nice. And one of the friend Matti I met here said "Valeria will always find you something to live." It was an interesting experience.
As an renter. I'm asking for a favour and also a suggestion: Be nice and polite to people live with you. People can have inappropriate behaviour. We all know things happens. but remember to communicate people with good manners and try to be nice，always. You gonna have a remarkable experience.

Nina's place was very clean and in a very good area close to shopping and cafes and restaurant. We loved Smith Street Alimentari for breakfast which is opposite and up a bit from the flat.
Great place in Fitzroy with 3 bedrooms. The garbage bins are located inside the building so it will smell like fermenting garbage in warm days.

Very well located in the center of one of the best street of Fitzroy. The appartment is clean and nice. It is a bit small for 6 adults if you are planning to spend your time in the appartment but you shouldn't!
Nina's place is is great value and in a fantastic location with everything you need within walking distance. It's a great base from which to explore all the delights of Melbourne.
Brilliant location for great food and breweries, transport to anywhere and not noisy at all despite being on the main drag of Fitzroy. The aircon was greatly appreciated on the 40 degree days.

Nina's place was extremely well located in the heart of bustling Smith St, close to lots of amazing shops, bars and restaurants. The accommodation was clean and comfortable and perfect for a weekend away with a small group of friends. Nina was very responsive and friendly in all communication, and check-in and check-out was easy.

Location location location! The location was fantastic, we flew in for a wedding and this gem of a place was literally 100m down the road, there are a lot of restaurants close by and a supermarket almost at your doorstep.

Location, location, location! So many cute bars nearby and no shortage of things to do. Apartment is well cared for and maintained, far exceeding what you would expect in an older building. Thoughtful touches like thick blinds and extra blankets show that the owners put extra thought into ensuring guests were comfortable.
Great place, clean and well kept. I hope Nina is working towards some security improvements as unfortunately we were broken into and had some things stolen.

Excellent location. Very clean, Very fast WiFi. Big TV, Well equipped kitchen - all as advertised. The minor negative is that the living area is very small. Fine for two people but with 4 or more it would be pretty cramped. The couch holds three, but anyone else has to sit at the dining table. So, there is little incentive to stay indoors - but then why would you with so much to do in the area.
The location is fabulous - right on Smith St with cafes, bars and a supermarket in the same block. Clean, excellent value for money, and I would definitely stay here again.

Thank You Huy and Nina for a great stay! The appartment is in a great location. Parking is a little hard to find but Nina directed us to some nearby free parking for the weekend.
Thanks again!

Nina’s place is in an amazing location! We really enjoyed our stay. Unfortunately it was a bit tight for 5 adults, and there really isn’t any street parking (unless you want to move your car every 2 hours).
Very fast response from Nina! Check in and check out were smooth, no downside at all. Great place to stay!

Super happy with this apartment! Great restaurants and shops along the street, easy flat 15min walk to free tram circle, or paid tram stop right outside the door, Woolworths next door and cute little nail salon right downstairs. plenty of room for 4 adults and 1 tween for a 3 night stay.

We had a great stay at Nina's spot! Can't imagine a better location. For a short stay in Melbourne, being right on Smith street meant we could access most areas via walking or the tram. The house was clean and exactly as pictures showed! Nina was responsive and proactive. Great stay!

We had a great stay at Nina's. Great location, lots of local restaurants, cafes, bars and shops, walking distance to city centre. As mentioned stairs to get to the unit and on the tram line which you hear in the front room.
Everything you need inside the unit including Netflix. Very comfortable stay. We'll definitely be back!

Convenient location, tram outside door, size was fine for the three of us wanting three separate bedrooms, had everything we needed except... we all had uncomfortable beds the first thing we wanted was  comfortable beds so we could get a good sleep and feel refreshed in the morning ...front bedroom is noisey which is to be expected so take airplugs.  No lock on bathroom/toilet which can lead to embarrassing moments. We chose this place because of mainly good reviews however when we were staying there we went back through the reviews and did notice that many of the reviews were for the other unit. We suggest replacing with good quality comfortable mattresses. Wifi code written down somewhere would have been good on our arrival I had to get roaming to access the online listing instructions to get the wifi code.
Mon is very great host easy communicate and very friendly. We will be going to Mon house again if we need to stay at Burwood area. Hope we get another chance to stay  there again :)

This was a great place for me and my family , central to shops as well as a park for the kids a few blocks down .
A lot of beds for everyone and great space .
The place is full of modern touches and extras .
Thanks Mon for being a great Host - much easier when someone responses quickly and is super helpful ! Thanks again Mon!

It is my second time staying at Mon's place. We were here at 2017 and now back in 2019, nothing have been changed, still keeping very clean and tidy. My kids just love the park and playing area which is really 2 mins from this house.
Mon is very helpful and she response to questions in a very short time. I'll certainly stay for the 3rd time if we have a chance. No doubt that I would recommend anyone to stay at Mon's place, especially with family & kids.

Mon she is perfect host ever. I really impressed she prepared multi-adapter for international people. I don't really need because I live in Australia by the way it was so useful for my family. House was very clean and cozy. I definitely stay again later.
Mon was a responsive host and the place was great for our family. We'd highly recommend this place as a somewhere to stay whilst in Melbourne.
Ika was a great host and very friendly and responsive.  There house was cozy and warm and within walking distance to public transport.

The apartment itself was cosy, lived-in, and Mark has provided a handful of brochures and guides for activities and sights to visit in Melbourne. All in all, it was a comfortable stay for a frequent solo-traveller for myself. I'd recommend Mark's for future stays :)

I think this place is very good value for a short stay. It’s in a good location, has everything you need, and the bed is very comfy. The decor is a little outdated and it needs some TLC. The dryer didn’t work at all and the shower pressure isn’t great. The sofa in the living room is so uncomfortable we didn’t use it at all.

My family visited Melbourne for the Australian Open and stayed at Simon’s place. The house was clean, beautifully decorated with plenty of room to accommodate the 6 of us. The property is centrally located, walking distance to all the shops and restaurants. You couldn’t have asked for better hosts as they were responsive and attentive to our requests. We did experience some warmer than normal temperatures at night and Claudia arranged for two fans to be delivered. We enjoyed our stay immensely and look forward to returning.

Perfect home-from-home base in Melbourne for our family group of adults. Simon and Claudia were considerate and helpful throughout - thank you. The house is a great example of local architectural transformation that provided spacious, stylish and bright accommodation. The location was ideal for access to cafes, restaurants, shops and activities. Driving out of Melbourne to the East was also really easy. All we needed.
Excellent location near the airport and great eating places close by.  Place was lovely and clean and comfortable
A very clean and welcoming place very close to airport parking and the airport itself. Perfect for a spot to stay in preparation for early flights out of Melbourne.
The place is exactly as described. Perfect spot to stay, close to the airport. Would definitely stay again

I really enjoy my one-night stay in Serge & Rosie's house. The lving place is quite and comfortable, ten minutes drive way from the airport. Thanks for the coconut water supplied in the fridge, I like it very much. If you want to catch flight the  next day, this is a perfect place.

One of the best places I’ve stayed in and the best experience I’ve had with air bnb. Quick self check in, let us stay with literally an hours notice due to self check in process. Cute touches like water on the bed, and food available in pantry. Would recommend to everyone as a long term stay or layover from airport as we used it. 10 minutes by Uber
Great place to stay, really close to the airport and easy check in. Place was super clean and tidy. Enjoyed my stay!
This is a lovely clean place to stay. It's very convenient if booking an early morning flight from Melbourne airport. Thanks for the info sheet and comfy bed. We would stay again.

We were lucky enough to meet Serge & Rosie and they are both such nice people. The bedroom and bed was really comfortable and we really enjoyed our stay. Location is great for airport convenience! Will definitely be back! Thanks for having us :)

Serge & Rosie’s place is very close to the airport but in a very quiet neighborhood. We had a night flight and this place allows us to rest right away! The room is clean and you will find everything you need. Brilliant stay!
Everything is great, but I’m a little bit uncomfortable bcs there was no lock in the bedroom, bathroom, and toilet.

Serge and Rosie were amazing - confirmed my reservation in under 5 mins. I got to Tullamarine airport in 10 min and the Uber fare was $10ish - that's really reasonable! The bed was so comfortable that you sink into it. Would definitely recommend for travellers with an early flight. Check in was easy and hassle free with clear photos.
It's a very clean place and the hosts are lovely and make sure you have no problem during your stay

Serge and Rosie's place was a great place to lay low before heading out on our flight the next day. You can catch up on laundry which is nice to get ahead of while travelling and the kitchen makes it possible to make your own meals/store snacks for the journey home!

Perfect place, all instructions were very clear. Rarely seen such a practical Airbnb, you will not find better in terms of practicality and rental close to the airport :)
Thanks again!
Perfect spot to stay between flights. Rosie and Serge's place is clean, cosy and super convenient for an overnight stay between flights.

The check-in and checkout instructions were crystal clear, and our communication with the host was perfect. The room was exceptionally clean and comfortable. The house is beautifully decorated, which immediately made us feel at home. I highly recommend this place to anyone needing accommodation near the airport for a night or two. It's a great choice!

Great stay, Serge & Rosie’s place was perfect for a late night/early morning check in with self-check in, detailed instructions and rooms with locks and a welcoming message. Neat and tidy, a 10min from airport and would recommend for anyone needing a spot for a few nights between flights.
Great place and well kept. Close to the airport. Great communication from the host and good value.

Great home away from home set up in quiet neighbourhood that is super close to the airport .
Clear instructions for self check in and unless a last minute booking like mine, you’ll find your name on the door to welcone you which is a sweet touch!
I booked quickly so didn’t realise the hosts don’t live in the house, rather it’s set up as sharehouse with 3 independent rooms.
I didn’t plan to cook as I arrived late, but one guest had left the kitchen in a mess that evening. I’ve no doubt if I reached out to Sergio and Rosie, they would have contacted the other guest if I d needed too as the rest of the house was immaculately clean.
So they get 5 stars from me and I would definitely stay again as the house has all you need to be comfortable and feel at home.
Great hosts!
Great location near the airport. House was very clean and hosts gave good instructions for easy check in!
Very confortable and nice place to stay. Really close to the airport and perfect for a night before an early flight

Great place to stay overnight. Accessible to shopping centre for something to eat. Very clean living area and kitchen. Instructions given were clear and precise. Would use again and recommend to friends

Felt at home at Serge & Rosie's place! They are very responsive to queries. There are helpful instructions and reminders printed in laminated paper, placed strategically in particular places in the house. I love it that they have food and drinks available in the kitchen. :) I like the house too because it is clean and well-lit. There are useful magazine-guides for Melbourne/Victoria in the bookshelf near the dining table. The cleaner is also kind and helpful. Thanks for having me!
such a good location for late/early flights at Tullamarine. Always clean and tidy! Thanks so much :)

The location of this accommodation is great, lots of shops, foods are around with walking distance to Southern Cross Station and free tram stops. The apartment itself is clean and suits for basic living needs. Would recommends to others.
This property by far is the best Airbnb place I’ve ever stayed at, everything is accurate and easy to use

The place is amazing, got 2 bathrooms and spacious living room. Easy check in process and complete guide to reach the place until check in. Located in the city and very close with Southern Cross Station, bus stop, and also Coles supermarket. Worth the price!

Robert was the best host, he couldn’t do enough for you, loved the place so much we stayed 2 weeks! Great bungalow has everything you need and really close to shops/parks/trains etc
Definitely recommend staying here 😊

This is an excellent Airbnb.  A quiet cottage, beautifully decorated and everything you could need for a restful stay. The bed, linen and fluffy pillows are superb. Spotlessly clean. Own private garden aspect. Situated in a leafy Melbourne suburb. Robert was a perfect host.

A gem of a place, so clean and comfortable.  Everything we needed and Rob was a perfect host, even turning the outside light on for us when we didn’t get home by dark.  We will definitely be back if we have the need to be in that area again, high recommended.

This is the perfect place to stay if you are in the Ivanhoe / Heidelberg area. Close to the train station, walking to excellent local shops, large garage and plenty of space. Everything in the apartment is very good, comfy bed, good sized bathroom with good hot water and a well equipped kitchen.

Great host. Accomodation is completely private, located in a very nice area.    Walking distance to a train station, as well as shopping strip and cafe’s.   Secure off street parking.  Actual premises are an external , large well appointed Bungalow, home away from home.

I totally recommend staying here, it was so so close to everything the train station, hospital, shops.
It was so peaceful and cosy.
very clean.
Great communication with the host.
I was traveling alone and felt very safe.

This was a comfortable place to relax and spend some time in Melb. Short walk to the train station, easy access to shops. Lovely neighbourhood. Was great being able to park our car in the garage next to the bungalow. Hosts were very prompt with communication prior and during the stay. Would recommend this bungalow for future travellers.

Accurate information in the listing for the property and amenities available. Ideally placed for access to trains to Melbourne city Centre (5 mins walk to station) and hospital. Very clean and host very welcoming.
The bungalow is a very nice, clean and quiet space. Robert was a super host and very helpful.

We loved staying in the Garden studio as it is very comfortable, private and peaceful. The garden surrounds are delightful too. There is also a garage for your car and the studio is totally self contained with everything you need for your stay, apart from a washing machine should you need one. The quaint Eaglemont village and railway station are within walking distance and supermarkets are also close by in Burgundy Street. All up most convenient and relaxing.
Quiet, private surroundings. Clean and tidy. Bonus having a lockable garage, especially with a hire car. Thanks for a pleasant stay

Robert went above and beyond by personally meeting me even though it was after midnight due to flight delays. It was much appreciated. Having an attached lock up garage was fabulous and the back lane was so handy for entries and exits. Location was awesome. Water was piping hot and the area very quiet. All in all, perfect for my stay!

Some kitchenware was not left properly clean, and shower base has some obvious mould areas, but overall we were pleased with the presentation and facilities in the apartment.  The outdoor deck is delightful on a fine day. People who are not tall will have trouble reaching the wardrobe hanging rails, and the kitchen shelving for glassware etc.  Our mid-size SUV only just fitted into the garage but longer or higher vehicles would not, and no alternative convenient parking is available.  It seems a very safe area but having our car garaged was a bonus, especially in wet weather.  It's a very private and quiet place to stay, with pleasant surrounds, and nearby Ivanhoe shopping is now a real restaurant centre.

Thanks Rob
You were very helpful
and the accommodation was perfect for our need - close to the hospital.
We would definitely stay there again.

The garden studio was very comfortable and in a great spot. Really quiet street and within ( hilly) walking distance to shops, eating places and hospitals. It’s also close to bike tracks along the river. Great to have the option of secure off-street parking for car ( or bikes), but also close to public transport. Thank you for a lovely stay.

Great location, close to shops. The bungalow was cozy, well appointed and Rob was very responsive. I enjoyed the peaceful location and being able to garage my car with a remote-controlled door. The internet went down once and Rob had it sorted in minutes. Very much appreciated.
One issue I had was very poor mobile reception. I even tried wifi calling but didn't seem to help. Not a reflection on Roby or the bungalow, but just wanted to note it.
Quiet with a secure garage. 15 minute drive to La Trobe sports grounds. 15 minute walk to Burgandy Street shops and restaurants.

I suggest this place to every person who is going to spend some time in Victoria. You won’t regret it! I’ll stay here until my girlfriend and I will have found the right house. The place is clean and well presented! Griff is friendly and he has a special soul too. If you can go and buy a Patek Philippe for him so he won’t ask for mines!
DVX.
God bless.

If you are looking for a beautiful, stylish home to relax in and a perfect host, book into Grifield House. Warwick is a humorous, intelligent man who will make you feel very welcomed in his home. His little dog is full of personality and very well behaved. We have stayed at this air BnB several times and have always had a wonderful visit.

Warwick is a kind, welcoming and fun host with a beautiful home. He stayed up until well past midnight to make sure I arrived safely after my flight was delayed from Sydney.
He is passionate about a wide variety of topics and is easy to get along with. Having said that, he is also one to respect your privacy.
I can highly recommend staying here. Plus Griff is a cutie and doesn't mind a cuddle or two! :)
Warwick is knowledgeable and hospitable. He stayed up late to guide us around and was up early also. His place is very comfortable and if you like dogs you will be in for a treat ;)

Warwick is a fantastic host. Everything about his home is amazing. We appreciated our conversations and breakfast including the freshly squeezed orange juice. Griff and his cat were soooo sweet! His home was clean, and he went above and beyond to make our stay really great. Thanks again Warwick! We would recommend his place to anyone

Warwick is a lovely man who likes to host people and make them feel good.
He's offering breakfast if you want one.
We had a very good stay and could only recommend this place.
If you want to visit Melbourne, it's better to have a car, at least to go to the nearest train station.
Gus is the cutest doggy we've ever seen 😍
Thank you for everything
We had a very comfortable stay at Julia's place, and were very happy with the facilities and extras that were provided. Lovely bushland location.

Tibor&Julia are great hosts! Thank u for gave us a good time at the place. The house is clean and cozy, especially the beddings and bathroom is very impressive. We enjoy the time stay there, highly recommend!
The house provides all the necessary amenities for a comfortable short stay. It is clean and very liveable with a large yard and perfectly positioned front porch for the afternoon sun.

A cost, peaceful and charming house beautifully adjacent to the Blackburn creek lands. A great spot for parks, birdlife and nature walks. The owners were also very good with communication. We had a lovely time and extended our stay for three more weeks.

Loved the location with kids. Great bush area we could walk and ride bikes along. Easy to get into the city when needed (we did both car and train). Also close to puffing billy. Easy access to groceries too! House was warm and spacious a true to pictures. Would stay again!
Really enjoyed our stay at this cozy house, ample space for our family of 5. We love the location of the house, beautiful backyard and heating was perfect.
What was a cold and wet week in Melbourne it was lovely to return to an always warm and cosy place thanks to the central gas/oil heaters. Plenty of space for our family of 5
The place is nice with all necessary  amenities.  The host are responsive. They  replace a new hair dryer very quick after I found out there was not hair dryer at the place.

The property is in a lovely quiet location. You can take a walk down through parklands at the end of the street. Plenty of space for parking.
The property does require a little maintenance however. One light switch loose from the wall, broken aircon in the bedroom and some windows weren’t able to be opened. The range hood has been melted in the past, still works but could be replaced. The gas heating was on automatically and couldn’t be turned off without contacting the owner.
The place is good value, nice large bathroom and fairly neat. Just a little hot in summer and needs some tlc. The location is lovely and quiet though.

Pete was a great host and made the whole booking experience really easy. We absolutely loved his place, so close to Brunswick and Smith St which have a heaps of amazing cafes and restaurants. The apartment was clean, modern and really comfortable. We will definitely stay again when we are next in Melbourne!

Pete’s place is truly one of the most perfect homes we have stayed in and it is so not just because he’s apartment is beautiful, clean and in the most charming neighbourhood; Pete is one of the most thoughtful, sincere and welcoming host.
He’s place is exactly as it is in the photos, if not better. Thoughtful touches like phone chargers, extra towels, blankets and coffee could never be captured in these photos and these are the things that just makes it feel like home.
The cherry on top of everything else: You would be staying in the heart of Fitzroy. You are surrounded by amazing amazing cafes, restaurants, grocers, charming little shops. Fitzroy is exactly where you need to be in Melbourne.

There really aren’t enough superlatives to describe my stay at Pete’s. Although we never met in person he was charming, attentive, responsive, a great host. The apartment is in a great location accessible to CBD and surrounding neighborhoods. Breakfast across the street at Archie’s or Gabriel’s is a must. This was one of my top Airbnb experiences. If you want to something special take a day trip down the Mornington Peninsula. Hire a car and driver and see wineries, the amazing sculpture park at Pt Leo, pick strawberries, hot springs.... Its a fantastic day. It’s reasonable and customized to what you want to do. George was our guide and Driver
‭+61 468 929 013‬.
Pete and Pete’s Place Great!

Great location within the heart of fitzroy - near many good restaurants and cafes! Perfect accommodation for those that drive and love an apartment with all the creature comforts of home. Fully equipped kitchen for doing lots of cooking, a cosy balcony with sofas and the bed is 100/10, i did not realize such a comfortable bed existed in this world. Overall an unforgettable airbnb, will recommend to anyone and everyone

Pete has seemingly thought of everything for his AirBNB guests.  He is far and away a super-superhost!  He greeted us at the door, introduced us to his well-equipped place (with all its mod con features), provided pre-loaded tram passes, local guide and restaurant recommendations, and apt's location in Fitzroy was perfect for us.  Pete's recharging/docking station was particularly appreciated and very helpful - no need to scramble for voltage adapters, etc.  We could not have asked for better for our Melbourne stay.  We hope to return to Melbourne in the not-too-distant future.  In the meantime, we highly recommend Pete's place as a perfect spot to get anywhere and everywhere in Melbourne.

Pete’s place is a well appointed one bedroom apartment in the heart of Fitzroy. Was comfortable & stylish in a great location, plenty of restaurants in walking distance & the tram out the front to easily get to the city. Pete was very helpful & friendly & was happy to give extra information on the local area. He has the apartment well setup with everything a traveler could need & clear information on everything required for your stay. I would highly recommend his place for anyone wanting to experience Melbourne from such a great central location.

The apartment is in a great location with many great cafes and eateries within walking distance and right by the tram stop. Pete is a super superhost and I loved the amazing decor of the apartment and the high level of comfort!

What a great choice it was to stay at Pete's place!
Quite possibly one of the best locations in Melbourne, everything you need is on the same street - shops, cafes, restaurants, bars, grocers, yoga studio....and so easy to get into the city.
The plants made it feel so homely, the couch and bed were so comfy and so nice to hang out on the balcony.
For a one bedroom apartment it felt really roomy, funky kitchen set up too.
I really enjoyed returning to this place after a big day of catching up with family and friends and the ease of finding a quality morning coffee (in the same building) made my day!
Pete went to the extra trouble of personally meeting me when I arrived, and sending some toiletries I left in the bathroom immediately back to me!!
Would highly recommend this place to anyone wanting an inner city Melbourne experience.
Pete’s place is stunning, comfy and modern with everything you could ever need. Tram noise is not an issue. Pete was lovely and helpful to deal with.

We had an absolutely fabulous stay at Pete's in the heart of Fitzroy. Being right on Gertrude St, you have everything you could possibly want from a Melbourne visit on your doorstep - fantastic coffee, excellent dining options, walkability to everywhere and a tram at the door in case you want to go further afield. We loved the community vibe of Fitzroy, and Pete's apartment really let you immerse yourself in that. The apartment is quirky and fun, super clean and the owner's communication made the entire experience such an easy and enjoyable one. We cant wait to return :) Possibly our best Airbnb experience over many years using the platform.
2nd time at Pete's place - and I'll come back. It's such a lovely space and perfectly located.

Can’t recommend Pete’s place in Fitzroy enough! Pete was very easy to communicate with, responsive and helpful, and truly thought of everything from his apartment instructions to his local recommendations. The apartment itself was clean, had all of the amenities listed and made you feel right at home. It was also very safe and secure (3 fob scans required before getting to the apartment floor) which was great as a solo traveler. I had an extended stay (~1 month) and fell in love with the neighborhood - great location, very walkable, easy public transport, and great restaurants/bars/shops nearby to explore. Would definitely stay again!
Our second time staying at Pete's was as great as the first. Great apartment, great area, great host!

We really enjoyed our stay at Pete’s apartment. Even though we didn’t use it, I feel like we have to mention the beautiful modern kitchen! Very cool minimalist aesthetic with modern built-in appliances that gives a fun contrast to the rest of the space. In general there was a lot of attention to detail when it comes to decor and functional furniture/tech. We felt very much at home.
Location is obviously ideal, especially when you’re on a vegan foodie quest… Smith & Daughters being right around the corner was perfect for us! The whole area is full of great restaurants and bars, and if you happen to have spent less time in Fitzroy/Collingwood than we have, Pete’s suggestions and local guidebook would be all you need!
A serene getaway set amongst a gorgeous cottage garden, strawberry patch and stunning views. Andrea was easy to deal with and the house was clean and comfortable.

A bit expensive, but really nice place. Very clean and modern. It was really nice that it’s located next to a strawberry farm, with beautiful view, but bear in mind that it’s quite secluded and not close to the shops. Overall, would definitely stay here again for a weekend getaway!

I would thoroughly recommend staying at this gorgeous house.  The location was beautiful - surrounded by strawberry fields!  The house was stylish and perfect for our 3 boys.  Plenty of space and lovely country charm.  I would definitely stay here again!
Andrea was so great! The place was amazing! I stayed here for the night before my wedding and it was lovely to get ready in and photographed beautifully!

This is literally the most amazing Air Bnb that I have ever stayed in. The property is insanely beautiful and completely picturesque. The surrounding strawberry fields are so lovely and make you feel totally at peace. The property has a pool/entertaining room, wooden floors, lots of places to have a quiet read, and a bunch of places to gather and have meals and conversations together. My friends and I couldn't stop commenting on how lucky we were to be staying in such a wonderful place. If you are tossing up between this property and another, I would definitely recommend you pick this place. It is exceptionally unique and Andrea the host couldn't have been more useful and hospitable. Will be visiting again for sure!
Very clean and well maintained property with period features. Surrounded by strawberry farm. Excellent views. Lots of outdoor relaxing areas. Excellent and very kind host. Loved it.

11/10!!! Best accommodation ever.
We spent our wedding weekend at this stunning property.
Andrea was warm, friendly and very easy to communicate with (even after all the pandemic uncertainty).
The property was just beautiful and allowed us to use the grounds for my pre-wedding photos.
The house was cosy, very clean, had great amenities and was close by to a range of shops.
We will definitely be coming back, such an incredible and special place to us.
Thanks again Andrea!

Our stay at this property was nothing short of superb! Andrea was welcoming and friendly - this really felt like a home away from home. There were so many amazing, beautiful and luxurious spaces to enjoy both inside and outside; we absolutely fell in love with this home. The children were also really well catered for (toys, games, children's cutlery, cups, plates, etc.), which made them feel welcome and at ease. Rooms were spacious and well-appointed; we had everything we needed when we needed it. The location was great - access to short walks, long walks and amenities. We are already looking forward to our next visit!
We loved our stay. Plenty of space for two couples. Great peaceful location and an easy drive to many wineries in the Yarra Valley.

Our family of four stayed for 3 weeks and absolutely loved it! The house is lovely, with charming vintage details AND modern comforts.  It was winter and cold outside but the house was always perfectly warm. The surrounding gardens, strawberry fields, and views are absolutely stunning. It was peaceful, private, and convenient to the places and people we wanted to visit. The host Andrea is so thoughtful, kind, and responsive. I had assumed strawberry season was finished but she gifted us with the largest and sweetest strawberries we have ever had! We had a wonderful stay and would definitely choose to stay here again!

We were the strawberry farm for a wedding we were involved with elsewhere in the Yarra Valley. The stay was restful and restorative. The whole weekend a welcome break from our complex lives. Andrea really looked after us. Garden & house an inspiration.
Andrea was the perfect host.  so friendly and helpful.  We will be back for another stay as soon as we can.   My family and I found the property exceeded expectations.

This stay was an absolute dream. The house was beautiful, clean and had such lush landscaping and gardens. Andrea was so lovely and welcoming and made sure we knew how to use all the appliances. I would happily recommend this stay to anyone wanting to spend time in the area. Would happily come back!

We had a wonderful stay at Kerry's place.
Truly a beautiful house, and Kerry is just amazing to deal with - always available to contact and so helpful with everything. Thanks for everything Kerry

We loved our stay at Kerrys place.
Greeted on arrival, shown around the property and provided a continental breakfast that met our dietary requirements!
Stunning property in a great location.
Thx Kerry.

This was our second stay at Rosebery Cottage and it was everything we remembered it to be!  Kerry is such a great host. The cottage was spotless, cosy and has everything you could need for a weekend getaway!

We loved our weekend at the Oaks ….beautiful homely accomodation perfect for our family and the additional room with the walk-in shower was perfect for my 87 year old Mum .
Loved the electric blankets too.
We will recommend the accomodation to family and friends .
Thank you Kerry .
Yenni's family is nice . Room is clean and quiet. It's good to stay a period .

My first time using airbnb to book a place to stay
It was all i need for my trip
*they have a cute lil kid as well :3 *

The place is near the tram and bus station making it very accessible since we opt not to rent a car. He is also very hospitable since the moment we met him from airport when he picked us up, to allowing us to use Myki card, utensils, laundry essentials and stuff for cooking. He has been very helpful and generous on our stay. Cute kids and great tour recommendations as well. Privacy is good despite the place is part of the whole family house.
We enjoyed our stay!

Lovely family and very kind & helpful. Speedy response and great communications.  5 mins walk to the tram stops and 10 mins walk to the super large shopping mall/food court and etc. Thank you for looking after me. Cheers,Kerry

I had a great stay at Wenley's home. Both Wenley and Yenny were perfect hosts and they were  always willing to help whenever required.  They also provided suggestions about the places to visit in Melbourne. The children were very sweet and friendly. I never felt away from home during my stay there. The stay location is well connected to the city network. On one side the 82 number tram connects the waterford avenue to the footscray station and further to the main city. On the other side the 57 numer tram connects the waterford avenue to the queen victoria market and further to Flinders street.  Wenley picked me up and dropped me at the airport. On the very first day he helped me shop for the basic food items while coming from the airport. Yenny had lended her myki card for use during my stay there. Overall I had a fantastic Melbourne trip and I would be happy to stay at the same place during my further visits.
Very friendly and positive atmosphere in this house! Wenley and his wife were super friendly and helped me with every question i had!
Wenley is a kind and friendly host. The room and the bed are big enough for a solo traveler. The place is close to the city but no direct public transport to the city.
Wenley and Yennie were very accommodating. Always ready to help and lovely to chat with. The room is what was expected. Overall a great stay.

The room is very clean and bright, and the host is very hospitable and thoughtful. They always leave lights on for me when I return late. Thank you very much! Looking forward to seeing you again next time.
Welcoming host and the location is fairly close to the airport and CBD. Worth the price. Sometimes gets noisy and issue with cleanliness

Wenley and his wife were very hospitable my whole stay, and I adored their two kids. His wife showed me around on arrival and let me know of an app (I think called Wilson Parking 😅) to park around the city of Melbourne. I truly felt at home and the location is quiet and safe. I’m thankful to not have so many fire ants back home as their little son says that exist in Australia ❤️. Thank you all for being so kind, caring, and allowing me a place to stay in your comfortable home!

I had a great time staying at Lee's place. It was well set up and they are friendly hosts. They have kids, so there is some noise but it's not too much. Overall I felt very comfortable and at home there. Thank you for a great stay 🙏😊
This place is really splendid and welcoming, close to things that matter but far away enough for some.peace! The addition of small things such as shampoo and spices were surprising.
Good little suite. Blazing fast wifi. Note you are right by a very busy road which can get very loud during rush hour times.

We stayed here for almost 3 months and loved it. The location is fantastic. You can get into the centre of Melbourne in 20 minutes on the tram which is a 2 mins walk. The park is nearby and lovely to walk around. The balcony is great and we used the BBQ a lot. It was just what we needed in a flat and Trent was a great host. Thankyou Trent.
The apartment is well located for access to trams and Albert Park. Walkable to St Kilda and beaches. The apartment complex was great on hot days!

Trent’s apartment is oh so very convenient to the tram line (one block away) and close to great coffee shops. I get at home immediately in the space. Super comfortable bed and crisp fresh linens. Trent had set up a home-like space. Laundry with extra large drying rack (very much appreciated) with detergent so it’s worry free. The building is quiet and easy to access. Safe surroundings. Trent maintained vigilant communication throughout the two week stay. WiFi is strong and consistent. Excellent overall.

We really unwound during our time here - great weather, nice garden to unwind in, good cooking facilities. The smaller space took some getting used to but made us realize how little one needs to be comfortable. Thanks Sam and April.

We only stayed for one night and wished it could have been longer ! Would definitely recommend for anyone who is looking for a quite space in amongst the birds and the trees. The tiny house was perfect for us and everything was thought of from the beautiful wooden detailing of the house, to the little speakers to play music and other small touches inside like the lovely organic shower gel and soaps. We felt instantly at home and relaxed. We found the bed very comfortable too and lovely to wake up with the kookaburras singing. We took a little walk in amongst the trees from close by the house which was nice and the next day ventured along the big trees walk to visit the ada tree. Lots of nice things around this part of Victoria to see. Thank you for having us!

So highly recommended! This cabin is the most beautiful and charming space I’ve stayed in yet. The handmade details are an absolute marvel, the books are a joy to peruse and the freshly laid chicken eggs were delightful. Everything we needed including cooking oil and utensils was in there. The town is so sweet and quiet, we started the day with a hike starting across the road and slept like babies in the dark serenity at night. So many adorable finishing touches that made this place feel like a home you never want to leave. Can’t wait to be back.
Really comfortable tiny house, Cozy but not cramped. It's in such a beautiful location too, so nice to go exploring during the day.
The tiny house is as expected - a lovely, secluded and relaxing stay and lots of friendly chickens!

This little wooden cabin fulfilled all my tiny house, small living, run away to live in the Forrest Swiss Family Robinson style dreams! Simply the perfect get away: a rustic wooden cabin set amongst a garden complete with a hammock, wicker outdoor furniture and a chicken pen. It was the small touches that really made this house special: essential oils in the bedroom and a kitchen fully stocked with a plethora of health foods. Simply an unmissable getaway, my only regret is that I didn’t stay longer.
What a beautifully crafted space ! We had a wonderful few nights in Sam and April’s cosy, peaceful tiny house nestled amongst the rainforest. They were wonderful hosts, highly recommend.

A very cute little cabin in a rainforest setting. The accomodation was clean & easy to find following the instructions. It stayed surprisingly warm overnight and we didn’t need to use the wood heater. The hosts kindly let us bring our dog which was great for us. It was a shame it rained most of our time there but we still managed to get out for a walk in the rainforest. The one downside we found was the mattress on the bed quite was thin and could feel the wood of the bed through it.
Beautiful tiny home nestled amongst the national park. The place is very thoughtfully put together and wonderfully cosy. We had a fantastic stay.

Such a sweet little place like this hardly seems imaginable that it’s only 2.4 m x 5 m in size. A bit like Doctor Who’s tardis it seems a lot bigger on the inside! Psychologically it seems like your whole world is conveniently on hand when it’s own little kitchen bathroom study and bedroom.
Prior to arriving we were A bit worried because the forecast for the weekend was very hot with high 30s predicted but the little cabin is quite cool. In more ways than one! We used the fan to cool the place down overnight and then during the day keep the doors shut and it was fine. Sam and April suggested some great spots by the river to cool off and were great hosts.
We will definitely come back again

We spent 2 nights in the tiny house.  We loved it! The tiny house has so much character, and we were so impressed with all the quirky branches used as risers on the stairs, and the magnificent timber used around the house.  We spent the two nights drinking wine and listening to music and soaking up the ambience.  The house was clean and had everything we needed.  It was great fun climbing the stairs and sleeping in the loft, listening to the birds and the possum at night.  We loved the geese and chickens.  April was so helpful with tips on walks in the area.  Communication was great, check-in easy.  Would highly recommend The Tiny House for a great, extraordinary experience. Thanks Sam and April!

The tiny cabin was everything I had expected and more! April was very helpful and friendly and the cabin is in such a peaceful and beautiful location, would definitely recommend and will definitely be back!

I loved my cosy weekend away by myself, at this rustic and charming tiny house. April was a great host and so helpful with teaching me how to get the fire going. Communication was so quick and the local tips were extremely helpful. I visited the ada tree and waterfall nearby and did rainforest walks easily from the property. I highly recommend. Thank you so much April!

Just the perfect tiny house. Amazing amenities, beautiful landscape and the comfiest little home you could hope for. We had a wonderful time and appreciated all the little touches April and Sam have put into the space. The hosts are super accommodating. Thanks again April, Aethel and Sam!

My time here was so refreshing! The house itself was charming, rustic, and peaceful, and it was located in such a beautiful place, with really close walks through the forest. Definitely recommend this place!

Great townhouse in a very convenient St Kilda location - just a short walk to great coffee and excellent Vietnamese!  Comfortably furnished, very clean and everything we needed for a family was on hand.

Great location in a stylish well furnished house.  Tara was more than willing to help, and went the extra mile to arrange all kinds of additional items to make our stay comfortable.  Thoroughly recommended!
Nice house for a family to live in and Tara is very helpful. Would recommend to friends if they come to St. Kilda.

Tara's place was great - good location and nicely decorated. It is PERFECT for families with little ones, as we had - as there were heaps of toys, a travel cot, books, plastic utensils, etc etc. Would definitely recommend!

This home is coming even more special than the photos show, it’s a truly wonderful home that feels warm, comfortable and incredible easy to spot yourself into. The location can’t be beat with great cafes 10-15 minutes walk in either direction and the beach a short walk too.
Our little family had the most wonderful time here and would highly recommend this home to anyone. Tara and Claire are great hosts, everything was very easy.

Great locations and stunning house. Everything within walking distance.
Communication was great with the hosts. They even let us check in a little earlier. Would highly recommend.

Tara’s place in St Kilda was perfect for our family over Christmas.  Clean, and had everything we needed. Great location close to everything, but at the same time private and nice and quiet. Tara is a great host, very easy to communicate with.

This was our first time using Air B&B so we were unsure of what to expect. It was so wonderful to have a homely and quiet place to base ourselves, Tara and Claire’s home was a short walk away from the supermarket, restaurants, bars, the beach etc.
The stay was extremely quiet day and night and it was very private. The home was clean and comfortable and had everything you could possibly need. Would definitely recommend.

We had a fantastic stay! The location is excellent, the house was spotless, and Tara and Claire were incredibly responsive and accommodating hosts. We especially appreciated the pet-friendly aspect, as we were travelling with our two dogs, and the courtyard was perfect for them.
It’s worth noting, as mentioned in the listing, that the house is their family home, which is reflected in the children’s bedrooms and some personal items throughout. This didn’t affect our stay at all, but it’s good to keep in mind.
Thank you for hosting us!

An incredible experience and beautiful space. The little cabin is a beautiful space that feels close to nature. The animals on site are very friendly and heart melting. The hosts are incredibly kind and welcoming. I would recommend this to anyone keen on seeing the outdoors and wanting a cozy and well-supplied location.

This is a wonderful little cabin surrounded by gorgeous woods, little chickens and a smoochy ginger cat  running around. We had everything we needed in the cabin and there were lots of great things to do in Healesville and the surrounding areas. I’d recommend staying here!

We had a lovely time at the tiny wood cabin.  Sam and April had the cabin well stocked with good quality toiletries, sumptuous towels and well stocked kitchen.  We had access to a large freezer to store  our local goodies before heading home.  It was lovely peaceful tiny house experience.

Special place. Gorgeous cabin in a unique area. The hosts are great people - they have created something special. Really enjoyed my time and the atmosphere - my privacy well and truly respected. Highly recommended.

Felt a little magical to be cosied away in the tiny house, fire on with the quite of the forest around. The place was equipped with everything I needed and loved the thoughtful touches of the flowers, the fact that they have local, sustainable products, and the thick towels and linen bedsheets was a touch of luxury in the cosy rustic setting. The place has great access to forest walks which I took advantage of rather than going further afield.  It ticked all my boxes for a lovely place to unwind and feel grounded again. Thank you both.
