Thank you Margaret & Carl for a lovely stay! It was all about those extra little touches for us, having the fridge stocked so that we didn’t have to rush out to the supermarket was so greatly appreciated. We’ll be back
Margaret & Carl were fantastic hosts. The communication was terrific. The bed was super comfy and the setting gorgeous. The attention to detail was an added bonus!

Immaculate property with amazing views and generous hospitality. Two gorgeous verandahs with two different aspects to take in the vista and enjoy a meal or glass of wine. Cute little kitchenette with snacks and breakfast ingredients. Beautiful bathroom with great shower and very comfortable bed. Attentive hosts and great location. Highly recommend this lovely property.

We had a lovely stay at the cottage, the location is beautiful and the cottage itself was exactly as described. It came stocked with a great assortment of food, unfortunately we didn’t get to eat the fresh eggs - maybe next time! Would love to visit again and would highly recommend.

The cottage is beautiful with views that are breathtaking.  Situated in a quiet and peaceful area.  Presentation and cleanliness was exceptional.  Overall a beautifully presented property that made us feel right at home.   Thanks Margaret and Carl.

This is out second visit to Figleaf Cottage. It is our go to place in the Yarra Valley because it is so well located to surrounding wineries and towns. The house itself if well laid out, very clean, a super comfortable bed and a fantastic deck to sit out on and just chill out. We will be back!

A very comfortable, exceptionally clean and lovely place to stay. Margaret and Carl were outstanding hosts with every request accommodated. Food supplies and the figs were a highlight. Loved out stay.

Perfect location for a wedding at a local winery
Found Margaret to be extremely obliging and willing to help in anyway she could
Well stocked fridge and snacks were enjoyed by the family
Thank you Margaret you were a great host
We will definitely return for another stay
Several family members are planning a visit as well

Fig Leaf Cottage was a little slice of paradise. Carl and Margaret were wonderful and communicative hosts who provided a lovely cottage that was immaculately clean with lots of amenities including breakfast and snacks and comfortable lodgings. Very private and peaceful whilst being in a great location in the Yarra Valley. We would absolutely stay at Fig Leaf Cottage again.
Fantastic spot to explore the wineries. The view from the living room is great and a great little back deck for dinner on a clear still night. Nice and quiet too.

This is the most amazing house! It is absolutely beautiful inside, the garden is amazing, and it’s extremely clean and has everything you could need. We had an absolutely beautiful time here. Thank you!

It was such a pleasure staying at Healesville Country Villa. The house is cosy, comfortable and supplied with all mod cons in the kitchen.
We stayed in the master bedroom and I think this was the most comfortable bed we have ever slept in!
The house is situated in beautiful peaceful surroundings, very easy to find and in close proximity to the village.
Ray is a great host and communicating with him was very easy. Also the welcome's basket was a very nice touch.

Definitely not our last visit!

Checked in without any difficulty. The host is very hospitable and friendly. If you need any help, you can find her. The room was clean, comfortable and safe. If I can live again, I will continue to choose this room.
The room is quite large, has many closets and drawers. Feel comfortable with big couch and bed, also TV

This small unit is as pictured.  The lounge, kitchen and dining area are functional.  The bedrooms are very small, there is no shelving space for clothes so we just had to put them on the floor of the wardrobe.  The beds were very uncomfortable as the mattresses appeared very springy, saggy and cheap which led to many uncomfortable  nights.

Will definitely be staying here again. David was very helpful and responsive and the space was absolutely perfect. Beautiful inside and out with a gorgeous outdoor area that comfortably sat us spaciously.

Excellent flat with everything we needed. We were only two people in Melbourne for the weekend, but the flat could easily fit four. There was a lot of space and the kitchen is great. We felt very comfortable.
David is an excellent communicator and was always available for anything we needed.

We had a wonderful stay at David's apartment! The place was spotlessly clean, equipped with everything we needed and in a great location. David is an amazing host and really looks after his guests, especially with his communication :) Highly recommended!

David is a fantastic host.
He sent clear instructions for finding key & photos of the front of the building(this made it easier to find). Inside looked the same as the ad pictures, very clean & beds are comfy.
Location is perfect for going to the zoo, aquarium and DFO. Will definitely stay there again.

Smart, sleek and perfect for a recreational or business stay. Located right opposite the Bay.Robert was a welcoming host at Quest apartments and looked after our needs . Liked the generous size of secure parking bays, comfy bed and compact kitchenette and clean mod fit out of apartments. Be aware you need to gain access via a side street not the main road address.  Close walking distance to great Church street shopping and restaurants . We have decided to return another time.
Great place, straight across from the beach & boardwalks. Room had everything you needed for an overnight stay
Great place to spend a few nights. It was peaceful and quiet, no issues, clean and tidy. Very friendly staff
The decoration of the apartment is nice and the place very modern. The location next to the beach is perfect. The carpet is a bit dirty but apart from this I would totally recommend.

We thoroughly enjoyed staying in this spacious and well-appointed apartment.
Being close to the beach meant we had access for walks and enjoying the environs.

We stayed here for 5 days and it was a great stay. Lovely apartment equipped with everything you need. Location is superb and it was very convenient to have your own secure parking space inside the building. The apartment could not be better located as we had to visit the LCI often. Extremely happy with Katie's quick responses as well.
A lovely apartment in an excellent location within Collingwood. Katie offered me an early check-in without me having to ask which saved me 2 hours.

Great little apartment in perfect location. Super responsive host with some nice personal touches. Was just what we needed and would definitely stay again.
Euan & Daniela

I really enjoyed my stay in this apartment. Being a first time user of Airbnb the host, Katie, was very attentive and answered all my queries promptly in relation to my booking. I would highly recommend this apartment and found the location to be excellent. Thanks so much Katie.
Great communication and great location, Katie did a great job and I will certainly look to book again!
This place is in such a fantastic location, close to food, shops, bars and transport. You have everything you need in this unit, very clean and comfortable. Great communication with host too.

Katie was a great host, offering easy communication and support when needed. Thank you!
The location of the apartment is excellent for those wanting to enjoy everything Collingwood has to offer.
Future guests should be aware that there are 2 very similar buildings located side by side and confusion between the 2 is possible late at night or after a glass of wine or 2! 😉

The place was perfect! we had a wedding just up the road so it was the ideal location. great cafes nearby. easy to walk around.
we came in late due to delayed flight and the key box was easy to find to check in. Would definitely stay again!
Thanks for having us.

I found Katie's place perfect as a single business traveller on a long stay, having everything that was needed. Wifi was solid, the bed very comfortable, and all the amenities expected.
The combo patio/dining area was really nice, especially on mornings when the tourist balloons floated by (some quite close!). Also a nice touch was having tea/coffee as well as fresh milk in the fridge.
Several grocery stores, a pharmacy and several really nice restaurants/coffee shops were all within a block or two.

Katie's automated messages were very friendly and helpful. Location is fantastic. Verandah is really a sunroom. Dishwasher needs servicing and isn't securely fixed. Bathroom has smell of mould/mildew. Spare blanket in wardrobe wasn't clean. All other linens good quality and very clean. Very comfy bed. Cute little rooftop pool to dangle your feet or sit in to cool down.

I was over with my mom for my sister’s wedding in Collingwood.  It was the perfect location, 5 minutes to the venue and perfect for us to get ready in.  The flat has everything you’d need (cooking amenities etc), but we used it primarily for makeup and dressing.  I really appreciated the walk in robe, with ample hanging space for clothes.   Wow and the bed was realllllyyy comfortable!  We had a deep and peaceful sleep.  I just wish it wasn’t so expensive, but I’ve been told it’s standard for Melbourne.
Had a lovely stay here! Very helpful staff and in a great location close to tram lines and cafes/restaurants. Would recommend staying here.
Katie's place was idea for our stay as our daughter lives in Collingwood. Nice cafe straight across the road with good coffee and easy walking to pubs and restaurants. Overall we enjoyed our stay.

Staying in Katie's apartment was good as it has a very homely feel to it; it felt more like I was staying in somewhere that's been lived in, as oppose to somewhere that is used just for renting out. The building itself is lovely, with a nice green area out the back, as well as a nice pool/chill out area on the roof. The apartment is in a lively area with lots of restaurants, bars, and shops, but also being on a side street meant that it's also peaceful at night if you want to just stay in. Very affordable for what you get, and would highly recommend to anyone who's just arrived in Melbourne and wants to get a good feel for the city.

Perfect location in the free tram zone, easy to go anywhere and lots of shops around. Beautiful view from the common area and bedroom. The place is spotless, towels and shampoos are replaced everyday. The TV actually works. Will definitely come back
Not a bad spot. Just be aware that the photos might not reflect the room you end up staying in
Great place, amazing view and walking distance to anything in the CBD. Check in experience was extremely easy. Could not fault it, would book again :)

Conveniently located and in the free tram zone! Phoenix was very informative and extremely responsive to requests/queries. There is an option for secure parking also! Perfect for your trip to Melbourne without breaking the bank.

Location is excellent as it is very central and in close proximity to everything. Communication was prompt and effective. Unfortunately, there were dirty dishes in the dishwasher and the blanket had yellow stains. Towels were provided but there were no face towels which would have been a nice addition. The aircon vent was broken and would only point down making it difficult to warm up the room. The couch's armrest is broken and needs replacing/fixing.

Pretty smooth process.  Clean overall but if I had to nitpick - the gaps between the couch seats were not cleaned. I saw quite a bit of mosquitos on the ceiling but other than that, good experience overall.
An excellently appointed private room, with en-suite and mini kitchen.  What a great bed.
Beautiful property and studio!! Amazing bed, sooooo comfy. I had the best sleep. Stylish and extremely clean. Highly recommend to stay and Virginia was very friendly and hospitable. Thank you 😃

Virginia and Mark we're amazing hosts. The place was spotless, with an amazingly comfortable bed, a huge television, black out blinds, and a great shower.
The water is literally just outside which made for a beautiful stay with sunset swims.
The price for what we got was amazing. Better than any hotel anywhere! We will be back
We enjoyed our stay at Virginia's place. Was as expected and had all that we required. Great hosts.
Sensational place to stay. Hospitable hosts and pristine and stylish room. Extremely clean and highly recommend. You won’t be disappointed.

This place is so comfortable and clean. The hosts are fantastic and full of knowledge of the local area.
I definitely recommend staying here.

A well appointed, spacious room with kitchenette and space to relax. The property in on the water, pleasant to walk around or to just sit and watch the ducks, seagulls and odd heron. Virginia communicates clearly and we would certainly stay again when next in the area.
Virginia was very easy and pleasant to communicate with. The accomodation is beautiful and in a great location. Will definitely be back!

Virginia and Marks place was prefect for me and my daughter, everything we needed was there. The location was great we walked to the shops a few times. Great value too, I look forward to staying again.

Thank you so much to Virginia and Mark for hosting, both so welcoming. Loved the accommodation it was more than I expected which is great, felt at home. Would highly recommend staying and would stay again for my next trip :)

We have stayed at Virginia’s Airbnb a number of times and have been so impressed every time. The unit is spacious and so comfortable. Absolutely love the comfy occasional chairs to sit and enjoy reading my book after a busy day with the grandchildren who live locally! The unit is well equipped with a kitchenette, which is so useful, and the comfiest bed with beautiful linen. Thank you Virginia for being such a wonderful host we hope to be back very soon.

I can just see a large family or a couple of families spending their holidays here, playing cricket in the huge backyard, after a day at the beach.  Room and space for everyone, including Fido.  Would highly recommend if you are looking for somewhere near the beach that can accommodate a large group.  Very close to Acland Street and other restaurants.  The tram to the city from Brighton Road, really convenient.  Communication is top notch; easy to check in and out.
Spacious old house. Lots of room and character. Easy walk to shops, transportation and the beach.

Have a very nice stay at the apartment.
The location is very good and clean. Its close to tram station, coles and skybus terminal. Highly recommended.

Beds were extremely uncomfortable woke up with a sore back every morning. Apartment was not clean when we arrived with stains over the sheets and pieces of glass on the floor. Very small apartment. Kitchen utensils were dirty. Wouldn’t stay here again!!!
Only good thing was the location of the apartment.

We enjoyed our stay at this property, appreciating the splendid city views. However, the mattresses in both rooms were very uncomfortable, with noticeable stains on the linen. I rate the property 3 stars primarily for its exceptional views.
Amazing place! Great location in Melbourne and view was  absolutely incredible. Clean and easy to collect keys and communicate. Would recommend :)
The location of this place is superb, close to QV mall and many other places. Rooms were really cozy. Really fast response to messages.
Lovely home, true to its description. My friends and I stayed here for 4 nights and still could not get over the view!
Great location, great host. Yes, the stain on the carpet a bit annoying, but the place was clean. Near to everything

The rooms are clean and nice. Location-wise, it's also near to tram stops, restaurants, and supermarkets. Even though it's situated in a busy area, you can barely hear the noise since the place is rather high up. Had a very enjoyable stay here with my friends!
Great location, right in the heart of some great restaurants and near Queen Victoria markets. Has just what you need for a few nights in the city, very spacious.

Rebecca's place was absolutely fantastic. The location was perfect with quiet streets and only a short walk away from the Waverley Road. The house was comfortable, warm, and homely. Rebecca and her colleague were responsive to our messages and any questions that came up throughout our stay. By far the best AirBnB we have stayed in!

We absolutely loved our stay here! The home has been decorated so beautifully and gives you such a feeling of warmth and home! It’s in a brilliant location, hidden in some very pretty and quiet streets. Cannot recommend this home more!

The house was exactly as advertised - spacious, clean and neat. It is well located - close to shops and transport. There was ample room for our two dogs. The kitchen is well appointed and the rooms are enormous.

This is a great family home in a lovely, peaceful green suburb.  The house is very comfortable and homely.  The area has lots of nice green spaces, with a big park less than 5 minute walk away.  It's a really quiet and friendly neighbourhood.  Would recommend, especially for long stays.  Out toddler slept so well in this house, it's great for families.
Spacious, stylish and clean home in a lovely family area. Hosts were wonderful. Would definitely recommend.
The house was perfect for a family of 5. It was very homely and provided an excellent location for us during our stay in Malvern

The whole house was very clean, very comfortable, offering relaxed easy living. The neighborhood is a self contained area of mainly pretty wooden houses. The railway is ten minutes walk away, the tram is about five and it's a twenty or so minute drive to the center of Melbourne but the train would be quicker and less hassle. Three really good restaurants within six or seven minutes plus a McDonalds.
All good!
very strategic location easy access to the tram , the hosts are very friendly and helpful, the rental prices are very affordable

Perfect location, amazing view of the Melbourne city from the 38th floor. People were asking, whether we were on a plane seeing the pictures of the view from the apartment. The place looked exactly the same as it portrayed. Just one thing, the red sofas were quite old, just my opinion if you could replace them. Overall 100 stars, thank you. 🙏

Nice location with great view.
Overall, the place were a-bit run down, the whole unit was filthy and all the furnitures were in bad or unstable conditions. The red sofa should be replaced (cracked & sinking). Kitchen cupboard were smelly & the floor was sticky. All bed rooms don’t have aircon, is impossible to sleep after 7am. There was only a shaking standing fan provided for one of the bedroom. Only one aircon in the living room.

The apartment is clean, spacious and in a brilliant location. L’occitanne bathroom products were a nice touch. Well appointed with everything required.
Our two bedroom apartment however, backed on to the train line which is very close, the trains are frequent (which is convenient), but closed windows and air conditioning don’t block out the pedestrian gate alarm, the train and the trains horn.
Such a nice and tidy place, and walking distance to many places to eat and drink. Would definitely recommend and stay again for a night away

We stayed in a two bed two bath apartment, it was very spacious, great kitchen, comfy beds, big bathrooms. We went shopping on Church St, went to the beach. The underground parking was great. I would definitely stay again, great value for money- modern, large, great location

Great place to stay. I would stay again.
No response to my questions though.
Perfect modern one bedder in Middle Park. Gary is an enthusiastic friendly knowledgeable host.  We enjoyed our stay & would recommend his property.

Great location
A lovely light filled apartment with a comfortable bed & couch.
Well located to public transport.
An easy walk to the Beaconsfield Parade path beside the beach.
Close to cafes & shops.
Wonderfully presented apartment in convenient location to the CBD, beach and local shops. Great range of appliances and a well stocked kitchen made cooking easy. A great place to stay for the week.

Gary is a really good host, easy to communicate. The place is lovely, clean and comfortable. It takes you just a couple of minutes to go to the beach. Definitely worth and price and I will choose again if I get back to Melbourne next time.

We have stayed in Gary's homes before and have found him to be helpful and prompt. The home was comfortable, we'll appointed and spotlessly clean.  The position is top notch and an easy walk to beach and some fantastic eateries.

The house is amazing! We really spent 3 wonderful nights. It is a nice choice if you want to find a place to relax and celebrate special occasion with your love, friends or family. The swimming pool and spa are cool too! We would like to come back again next holiday. Thanks for giving us an unforgettable memory in 2020. We are really appreciate for that! Happy new year!

If you are looking for a country side getaway close to the city to chill out then this is exactly what you are looking for. You won’t even want to leave the whole time you are there! What an amazing place, the shed was so cool with a pool table and table tennis, my partner wants one now haha. The pool was so nice and warm (really appreciate a heated pool as I love swimming) with a great view along with the hot tub. I love how everything is so well thought out, plastic wine glasses and plastic cups for the pool along with all the little extras that make it feel like a hotel. We will definitely book again!

What a magical place hidden away from the hustle and bustle of Melbourne, but still close enough to venture out if you wanted to. Narelle kindly showed us around the property explaining how we can use everything in the property to it’s full potential.
She even set up a nice cheese board, welcome gift box, bottle of wine and some personalized stubby holders for our girls weekend. Nice extra touches we did not expect but made it that much more welcoming.
The photos of this property are beautiful but they do not do it justice, it is stunning!
The barn is a dream hang out spot and we wish we booked an extra day to spend more time in the pool and spa. The spa was a hit so I hope they never get rid of it!
The beds were comfy and the kitchen fully stocked with utensils and simple condiments for cooking.
Thanks for a weekend to remember and we’ll definitely be back!

Do yourself a favour and stay at this property you will
Not regret it.
Narelle is a super host and goes well out of her way to make sure you extremely welcome.
The property has to many wonderful features to mention them all but it truly caters for everyone age group.
The Barn is absolutely amazing, the spa sensational, the view from the spa even better.
With over 110 different types of seating (the kids counted the different types of seating options 😝) you will be sure to find just the right spot to rest relax unwind and enjoy.
Beds are very comfortable,
Even got an eye mask for extra sound sleep.
Lots of 1% that make this a must stay holiday trust me you won’t want to leave. I know none of my family wanted to go home.
Thanks
The place is very great and a lot of amenities. Perfect for relaxing. Narielle is very responsive and accomodating. Highly recommended. We will surely be back in the future.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Julieanne's light filled apartment. The surrounds are wonderful for outside walks. We were able to walk to shops and the fabulous Prahran Market.  The apartment is comfortable and had everything we needed. Communication was excellent and we highly recommend staying here.

The apartment is amazing! It’s very neat, spacious and extremely close to chapel street. Julieanne was a great host - she made check-in and check out super easy and was very warm and easy to deal with. I would highly recommend staying here and can’t wait to return :)
Really enjoyed our stay, beautiful apartment in a great location, on a quiet street yet close to the Chapel St shops/restaurants. Super comfy beds too!

Julianne's place was both close to everything and quiet. Julianne and Jenny were super helpful hosts and went above and beyond to help with local recommendation snd any queries I had. I would highly recommend staying here for a weekend away in Melbourne with  the city being a short train ride away.

Julieanne's home was the perfect space for our getaway - on a peaceful street, with an easy walk to cafes, shops and restaurants. The home is very spacious and beautifully decorated - each area of her home is welcoming. We felt right at home! We enjoyed our stay and would love to visit again.
Overall well equipped, spacious, and great location. Unfortunately I had to leave early due to noise from residential building construction from across the road.

What an amazing place! So much to do (pool, spa, pool table, table tennis, basketball) and in such a beautiful secluded location. Narrelle was a lovely host and made sure our stay was really comfortable. Highly recommend staying here!

Was the perfect place for our whole family to be together to celebrate my parents 60th wedding anniversary. We all enjoyed ourselves immensely. The kids got tired out playing in the pool all day and the big kids got tired out playing pool all night.

Narelle is a fantastic host, very quick to respond to messages, went an extra step with welcome packs & I even received a birthday gift!
The view is beautiful , peaceful & private location with lots of space. Abundance of games & activities to keep any age guest happy & entertained. Even relaxing by the pool & taking in the view was great.

Amazing house and perfect for the kids. Lots of activities to do to keep the kids distracted. Narelle was an amazing host and a pleasure to deal with. We would love to come back again. Thank you for having us!!

It was an absolute pleasure exploring this beautiful place with my family and loved ones.
Made my 40th celebration so special
Thank you for letting me create new memories in your place ❤️

Beautiful farm stay, our dogs throughly loved the freedom of running through the paddocks. As it was a wet weekend we were limited to the house and barn - would be fantastic to come back in summer and enjoy the pool

Stayed here for a week for the tennis and it was very nice. Location was perfect, could walk to the tennis in 20-25 minutes. Only a 10-15 minute walk to the main areas in Richmond. Room was nice and comfy and clean. Would stay again!

The host was very helpful and communicative, and the apartment had what we needed (except from a big mirror, there’s only a small one in the bathroom). However, the apartment’s location is right next to a big road, so be aware that it can be noisy.

Great little studio apartment in Richmond. Perfect location and super clean- bed is a little hard and minimal amenities, but pretty much had everything we needed. Ruki was extremely helpful and accomodating with regards to finding us a hairdryer and mattress protector. Overall great spot!

What a lovely spot! Was spacious and central, great proximity to station. the building itself had lots of character and was private.
Great to stay for a few days - may be difficult for longer period as it lacks substantial kitchen materials. There is however a laundromat a few meters away which is helpful. Overall a great and easy stay.

Cheap and cheerful little (yet surprisingly spacious) studio room,. Close enough to the city, North Melb / Fitzroy / Collingwood etc. We had a short 2 day stop over, perfect place to drop your bags and head out again. Only thing to note is the studio(s) are part of a larger converted house, so walls are thin and you often hear other guest coming and going, but wasn't something that bothered us during the stay.
The room was clean and worth the cost. Walking distance to the train station. One drawback was there is no sink to wash dishes. We had to wash then in the bathroom vanity.

The apartment is well appointed in a super fun neighbourhood, however I had to cut my stay short due to an overwhelming smell of cigarette smoke. It smelled like I was in a 70's Vegas hotel after a bender. Additionally, several details were missing and essential to a comfortable stay. The washer had run over soaking the carpeted floors, the windows were left open leaving mosquitos flying around, and none of the bedroom lamps had lightbulbs. If the host's can verify that the place has been deeply, professionally cleaned I could recommend it, but only then (and only maybe, depending on how sensitive you are.)
This is the second time we've stayed in this apartment, and it does not disappoint. So close to everything and a beautiful space!

Great location and pretty easy check in. Kitchen was dirty, messy cupboards, pretty gross looking pantry amenities, nothing in fridge, and toaster absolutely covered in crumbles. Bedrooms seemed fairly clean. Bathroom was okay, some stains. Building elevator and hallway had funny smell… good powerful air conditioner. Overall okay for a short stay if you just need somewhere to lay your head. Dont recommend for anything longer than a 3-4 days. Also didn’t respond our partial refund request when we had to change dates.
Only 1 key for 3 people was inconvienent. The pillows where old and need replacing,bath towels where thin. On the good side ,its in a good location.

Great long term stay here! We felt right at home , Justin and the team were always responsive and helpful! Location was great , short walk down to a high street full of restaurants, shops and cafes! Accommodation was comfortable, spacious and clean! Would definitely stay here again!

Our stay at Toorak Luxury was a highlight of our trip to Australia and gets top marks from us. Well-maintained, spacious, comfortable.
It is well described in the listing, our host was extremely accommodating and responsive and there is nothing I can fault the place on.
We loved the leafy streets, the pool, the place.... and were sad to move on.
Warmly recommended!

lovely house in a awesome neighbourhood. despite the previous tenant left Peter with some difficulties, he tried to solve it right away within his reach. thanks for a lovely stay! would definitely recommend the place for large families!

Wow! Wow! Wow! Generous sized bedrooms, large lounge, dining, even 2 studies. The kitchen had everything and great appliances. Plenty of bathrooms. Easy safe parking.
Everything you’d want for a relaxed family holiday and a great pool on top! All within an easy walk to shops , coffee and cafes. Thanks Peter.

Stayed here with my family and found its a very old property which needs maintenance. linens were not washed properly, there were stains and hair on it felt uneasy to sleep. bedroom floor was not clean and all looked very old.
on first day there was no enough hot water for bathing which kept us feel bad. when reported we were told its all fine and reason not known.

Exactly what was expected and no mucking around. Easy and clear instructions for checking in and checking out, and was exactly what we needed. House was clean and tidy and beds were comfy. Thanks Peter!

Had a great time staying with Peter. Location is second to none for all thing’s Melbourne. Market, shops and transport all within 250m. His place is quirky and has so much character! Would fully recommend.
Peter is a great host! The room itself is great, was just what I needed! Comfy bed, great location right next to Queen Vic Markets and amazing value!

I have stayed 3 nights in Peter’s beautiful condo. The room was neat and full of lovely decorative wall paintings. Sometimes it feels like you’re living in a museum, not a bedroom that I loved the most. The heater in the room was very helpful, restroom was clean, well maintained and most importantly eco friendly. Peter himself is an excellent human being and we have shared our stories. Whenever I will return to Melbourne, I’d love to visit him and possibly stay at his condo again. Thank you Peter, have a great one.

Peter is truly an artist and I’m honored to have witnessed his art collections.
He’s a kind host and you will be rewarded with much more than what you have paid for.
Great location. Right by Queen Victoria market and mins by foot to city.
Highly recommend this!

Great location. Ideal if you're on a budget and just need a shower and bed for the night. Room is comfortable and quiet. Peter is also very friendly host.
Showering in a tub to conserve water was a little tricky but I appreciate Peter's concern for the environment.
Peter is a friendly host, cute artsy apartment that's very walkable to downtown Melbourne and right across from bustling Victoria market.

What a deal! Peter is also very nice, has artistic taste, and respects his tenants! Safy & peaceful corner. I really appreciate the location. Convenient transportation and smooth communication! Great value for money. Already book another two nights！ Recommended☺️☺️
Perfect location. Central to Melbourne and Vic Markets. Quietly tucked away from noise. Easy access/check in. Comfortable and secure. Would stay again. Priced right
The location is just perfect. A good place to stay in Melbourne and know the city. Peter always was helpful.
Peter was ill when I stayed so I didn't get to meet him but his place was lovely. Very cosy and full of character. very close to the city centre with lots of bars and restaurants nearby.

Very close to Queen's markets, easy to find and beautiful cozy little room. Peter was quick in answering me and let me check-in early despite having booked the place the same very day. Also he's very nice and friendly!
Fantastic location without any doubt! Peter is Peter - he’s accurate in his description. Love the art gallery aspect of the bedroom. It’s comfy.

Peter's stay is very central to the busy city but good and quiet. The room has fascinating a beautiful decor with many interesting books and guides to Melbourne.
Peter is an intelligent tasteful and interesting host. He's warm and friendly with excellent suggestions and local information.
His room was a great location to find.

Clean well kept room
Bed were amazingly comfortable
Check In and out was very easy and communication was great
The apartment was exactly like the pictures. Everything kept in place and was tidy. The staff was super helpful.
Great accommodation for a family of 4 we can more , very spacious. Very clean and comfortable. Lady at reception was very friendly and helpful , would definitely stay again

From booking through to check out, Shannon and team have been really accommodating with various requests and have welcomed us into their apartment with everything we could need.
The apartment has been immaculate and homely with super comfortable beds!
We had to check in early and leave late due to changing timings during COVID and Shannon was very accommodating
All in all, a perfect stay - thank you!

As others have mentioned, this flat does smell of cigarette smoke. We left the doors open as much as poss. The main carpet, too, is well past its sell by date and the door is not easy. However, the rest of the flat is fine and in a good possition near the station and a good location, within (quite long) walking distance from the city.

Nice apartment.
Smelled a bit Smokey but that went away once doors were opened.
Quite a few stains on carpet and on duvet but nothing that affected the stay.
Great location.
Would happily return when back in Aus.
We had a wonderful stay in South Yarra. The 2 bed apartment was so central. All our needs were met.  It was perfect for us.

Great location and well stocked unit. Would recommend!
The unit was a good size and a well stocked kitchen helped with our stay for the week. Loved the location within South Yarra and perfectly placed to catch the train/ tram into the city.

We enjoyed our stay at Nicky's place. She was very helpful as we only booked the day before we arrived. The space was clean and comfy and great that it was close to the city to suit our needs. We'd definitely stay again as it was good value too for 3 of us. Thanks for having us!

This is the second time that I've stayed at this apartment and I'll come again!  Everything you'd need in terms of amenities, great layout with an outside patio area, and the location can't be beat.  It was clear that there has been a lot of thought put into the amenities and comfort of guests.  In the top 5% of spaces I've stayed and I've gone to over 76.  Highly recommended.  You couldn't do better.  I will come back again.  And...you're a block from Acland street, the heart of St. Kilda's restaurant and shop scene. Luna Park, the beach, and the St. Kilda Pier are all within easy walking distance.  The tram and bus system is right outside the door.  Nicky and Jon were responsive and went beyond what you would expect from hosts.  Look no further!

A wonderful place with responsive and kind hosts. Exceptionally clean, well decorated and thoughtful touches (like fresh bread and fruit for our arrival!). Would recommend this place to anyone who wants to be in the heart of St Kilda and experience Melbourne's famous esplanade!

We stayed at Nicky’s place for our wedding weekend since it was so close to everything in St Kilda. It is a lovely spacious apartment, full of natural light and with everything you need. Nicky was a fantastic communicator and great host.

Thank you Nicky and Jon for making your apartment such a comfortable place to stay.
We booked the accommodation due to extended renovations at our own house and was very impressed with the fast response to our queries prior to booking.
The apartment was very clean, well equipped, warm, comfortable and great for our two little doggies with the courtyard.
The check in process was very clear and we really enjoyed having lots of coffee options for working from home!
Thank you ! Highly recommended!

The place was great - perfect for what I needed. Nicky was such an accomodating host providing all the bits you need when you’re fresh from travelling - tea, coffee, milk and breakie, as well as fruit and chocolate :) she was also flexible and understanding when plans needed to change slightly. Thank you Nicky!

My girlfriend and I had a terrific stay here. The apartment is in a great location and you’ll be close to all the transport and shops you’ll need during your stay. Whilst still being close to the city to enjoy dinner out.
The apartment itself has really friendly neighbours and extremely clean upon check-in. We will be back.
This accomodation is exactly as described! Easily accessible, clean and comfy! Couldn’t recommend more
Great, little apartment close to the beach and bars and restaurant in St Kilda- would definitely recommend!
I had a great week at Nicky’s. Perfect central location, super clean and quiet. Great building in the heart of St Kilda. Walked to coffee shops and restaurants. Highly recommend and would come back.
A great place to stay, Nicki was a great host and very easy to deal with. The unit was cute and tidy and in a great location... Highly recommend.

Nicky's place is a great 'home away from home'' for us.  Very close to amazing restaurants and two tram stops and the beach which we used quite frequently.  In saying that the Apartment was very quiet and couldn't hear the trams at all.  We used the trams to go to South Melbourne markets and got some great supplies to set us up for the week.  Also, Nicky was very responsive and had a few supplies ready for us eg milk, tea bags, fruit and some chocolate as we were very late arrival in to the Apartment on the first night.  We would highly recommend Nicky's place and are very much looking forward to booking another holiday in the near future.

Just back after a 16 night stay in Nicky and Jon’s apartment. I couldn’t fault the apartment. Super location, clean, and comfortable. Just a 2 minute walk to Acland St which is full of restaurants and cafes and a 5 minute walk to beach. I would have no hesitation is booking this lovely apartment again. Thanks Nicky and Jon

Wonderful unit in a great location, Nicky left great instructions for tram stops (which was just outside door) close to Acland St shops and restaurants.   Had a great mini break away from the city but only a 15 min tram ride away.   Hopefully we will be back.
A very comfortable and bright apartment. Handy to everything. Very easy to communicate with owners.  Great facilities

Appreciated Nicky’s super quick responses about questions I had, despite the time zone difference (I’m from the US).  I have tobacco and dust mite allergies so having a super clean place is a top priority for me, and their spacious flat did not disappoint.  Great location, easy walking to shops, restaurants, and the beach.

The apartment is in a prime location—convenient and within walking distance from all amenities. The apartment is cosy, with a decent-sized backyard. We were travelling with our two dogs, and they had a lot of fun in the backyard. Highly recommend this place on your visit to Melbourne.

I booked Nicky’s apartment for my parents while they were visiting Melbourne. Nicky’s apartment is just a few minutes walk away from the heart of  St kilda ! Her apartment had absolutely everything and more you could think you need for a stay. The apartment was absolutely spotless and Nicky provided plenty of towels and extra blankets especially since it had gotten cold in Melbourne. Nicky left very clear instructions to gain access and responded straight away whenever I had a query. I couldn’t recommend Nicky’s apartment more it truly made my parents stay in Melbourne a fantastic one !!

We loved our stay here. We could cook the meals we love but also duck out for beautiful restaurant experiences on our doorstep. The place was completely functional and so easy. Communicating with hosts was simple and inviting.

Nicky’s place is as described.  In a bohemian neighbourhood, a five minute walk from the beach.  It takes roughly 30 minutes to get to the centre of Melbourne.  Public transport is on the doorstep.  For us, it was a good choice.

Great location. Very responsive hosts. Apartment had everything I needed for my stay. Back yard felt very private. Aircon was great. Comfortable bed. Although near lots of shops and bars was very quiet and peaceful.

Laurent provided a smooth check-in and check-out, and organised our very own private parking spot. The apartment was very clean, quiet and homely, perfect for when you've had a busy day in the city and want to relax and watch Netflix or go for a swim in the pool. Location was perfect! Walking distance from all the activities we had planned to do. Laurent was always easy to reach and eager to provide assistance before we arrived in Melbourne and throughout our stay. Thanks for being such a great host, Laurent! ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️

A very comfortable and homey space… had a blast staying at this place especially with everything so close by it’s very easy to buy food and your needs around… also very close to transportation services…. Ammenities are also very nice…. Everything are very well prepared by the time of check in….. checkin out is easier than ever!

Great location in the Melbourne CBD, in a nearly-new building with good security and a concierge. The place is clean and well-appointed for a single person or a couple who want to make the most of what Melbourne has to offer. Laurent was helpful and responsive.
Note that like many high-rise buildings of this era, the wind will whistle when the windows are shut. The easy fix to this is to crack the windows slightly, and if it's chilly, just put a towel around the gap. Whistle fixed!

The location was great. Located opposite the State Library of Victoria on Russel Street right in Melbourne's CBD. It's within walking distance to the tram stops and the Melbourne Central Station.
It is a great place for a long stay as the kitchen is well equipped for home cooking.
The place was generally clean and immaculate. The availability of a washing machine with a dryer and a heater in the bedroom were very helpful.
The host Laurent was readily available to resolve any issues.
Definitely a choice for accommodation in Melbourne's CBD for 2 adults !
Laurent was great to deal with, very quick to reply to messages. The place was easy to find, nice and clean and felt very safe with the security of the complex. Would stay here again!

I stayed here for one and a half months and absolutely loved it! The apartment was spotless, fully equipped, and everything worked perfectly. The location couldn’t be better – right across from QV and the State Library, and just a 5-minute walk to Melbourne Central Station. Super convenient for daily life. The host was incredibly warm, responsive, and thoughtful throughout my stay. I’d happily stay here again and will definitely recommend it to my friends!
Beautiful and lovely place to stay while in Melbourne! Can highly recommend it and also super nice and easy host Laurent is :-)
Had an amazing stay, facilities were amazing and the location was ideal. Right in the middle of the CBD. Would 100% stay here again if I was visiting Melbourne.
Very tidy apartment, good amount of space for a one bedroom and a very nice location, easy to get around

Got told it was a bit of a wait at check-in time (45mins) when we arrived due to capacity and housekeepers not keeping up in time. Even told them that our ETA was at 2pm.
But we were able to get another room and work around that.
Nice place for a weekend :)
perfect location, comfortable bed and pillows good amenities and fhe cafe down stairs is incredible for coffee and pastries! parking was easy

Perfect for a city getaway.
Two good size rooms with two bathrooms, spacious lounge area and a lovely balcony which would be amazing in summer!
Would definitely stay again.
Good location , beds were comfortable . Balcony view was a concrete wall (unlike photo !) . Reception staff were great as was communication .

I had a wonderful experience at this Airbnb! The place was lovely, and the host was incredibly friendly. Its convenient location made it easy to explore Melbourne. My family and I truly enjoyed our stay, and we only wish we could have stayed longer. The house had everything we needed, and the well-equipped kitchen, with a wide array of sauces and cooking tools, was a pleasant surprise. Highly recommended!

I only needed to stay a night as I had a meeting in Box Hill with another colleague. It was the perfect place for someone who didn’t have car. Very convenient to walk to all the nearby shops and restaurants (and public transport too).
The apartment was beautiful and well kept. Clean and comfortable. Felt at home right away with a nice view of the cbd (a bit further away but can see it - especially at night).

Kaikai’s place was beautifully decorated. The place was just as described and exactly the same as the pictures. It was sparkling clean and we really liked Kaikai’s choice of decorations. Thanks to Kaikai, we managed to watch the New Year’s firework from the balcony (from afar but still!), which was amazing.
Kaikai was responsive and friendly, he made sure the check-in process was smooth and gave us tips for our stay.
I highly recommend Kaikai’s place to anyone visiting Melbourne!

home was lovely, spotless and well equipped.
right next to a mall filled with Asian restaurants and had a woolies.
only recommendation is to maybe have a way to self collect keys from the mail box or something
Kaikai was a fantastic host, great communication and easy to follow instructions that helped make check in quick and problem free. thank you Kaikai!!
Kaikai is a great host. Always responsive within 10mins. The place was very beautiful, has a beautiful city view. The place was clean. We will come back to stay there again.
Kai’s place was inviting and cosy, with a warm and comfortable feel that made it perfect for an overnight stay. The location was also spot on—close to everything we needed.
Ali was a great host. He was kind and friendly, and he recommended a lovely restaurant. We both really enjoyed staying here as a little getaway.
Ali is a very nice guy when my colleague checked in. He is also response in a very short time period, I am appreciated that he helped us a lot.
I have been here for about half a month. The host is friendly, helped me a lot, the space is quiet and clean. If I have a chance, I will come back here again.
Nice and sparkling house, right opposite to flinders st station. Tom is a great host and is very quick to respond.
Clean comfortable and very convenient location. Only a bit noisy, but good response from host. A good place to stay

We had a great stay in Melbourne and Tom's place was ideal for us. It's in the heart of the city, plenty of room for two people and not too loud considering the location. I would highly recommend staying at Tom's.

Great location. Right near the art galleries and laneways of Melbourne. Cafes everywhere you look and public transport to everywhere right on your doorstep. The city is noisy, especially with construction going on, but keeping the windows closed keeps it pretty quiet in the flat. It's a good size. Nothing fancy but comfortable and very reasonably priced.
It's a good place, amazing view to Flinders Station and Federation square,  very cosy atmosphere
Very cosy apartment with the perfect location to get to anywhere in the CBD! Tom was also very swift with responses and very helpful throughout our trip.

Such a great little place! Super convenient location. The bed is a bit soft but very comfortable. If you're a light sleeper, you might here some street noise, but nothing that the pedestal fan can't drown out. Overall, a great spot. Tom was super easy to contact, and was very fast at responding.

The listing was in a fine place, clean enough and comfortable enough for one, maybe two people. Water went out while in the shower though, and I was forced to use a cup from the kitchen and the bathroom sink, until water quickly ran out from that faucet as well as the one in the kitchen. Highly inconvenient.
very noisy street with construction project going on outside , very hot no air-conditioner , needs a ceiling fan in the bedroom

Tom's place was in a perfect location for a few days away.
public transport easy access to every where you needed to go or walking distance to pubs and restaurants. would stay again
Great location and felt very secure.  Our first experience with an Airbnb and it didn’t disappoint.

The unit was in an excellent location that is walking distance to pretty much anything you would need (trams, trains, restaurants, shops, etc). Tom was extremely responsive too. One night I accidentally locked the unit key inside the unit and when I messaged Tom he responded straight away to help me get back inside, even though it was late.
One thing to note is that there was some noise from construction work going on outside the apartment. This didn't bother us though as we were up and awake around the time they got started (usually around 7 in the morning).
Overall, the apartment was great and we had an excellent stay!

Tom's apartment was in a great location opposite Flinders St. The only down-side to being so central was that it was a little noisy on Friday night. The apartment looked identical to the photos and was quite clean. The check in instructions were easy and Tom was a good communicator

The location is amazing. Super close to everything and easy walking distance from most attractions. Melbourne always has construction and we found the noise wasn’t an issue at all. Tom was very responsive. The place was definitely furnished and decorated on a budget, which we can appreciate, but unfortunately during our stay there were quite a few bugs in the bathroom.

We loved staying here!! Was the perfect little spot for a getaway and in THE best location. We walked or took the free tram everywhere and it was close to so many amazing restaurants and cafes, we got to try so many. Will definitely come back here to stay next time we are in Melbourne!

The place was exactly as described. We had some trouble finding the instructions but Tom was very responsive and helpful. As other reviews have said, the central location means that it’s a bit noisy overnight but we found that putting on the electric fan (provided) next to the bedroom window was great for overnight.
Great location - I noticed a bit of tram noise in the mornings, and party noise at night  as I am a really light sleeper I took my ear plugs and slept well.

A great value for money stay in the heart of Melbourne city.  Very basic apartment,  however the affordable price reflects this. Great location for exploring with access to public transport on your doorstep.
Great place in a perfect location. Just unfortunate it was noisy. I realise it’s out of their control due to the current works in the city. Otherwise a great little place.
perfect location for everything, can't fault the location. within reach of most things. great little place to stay
Tom’s place is convenient and central, as other reviews state it is a bit noisy, however that is expected with the construction of the metro tunnel next door & popular spot.
Would not stay here again. No a/c, very messy, noisy and dirty. Construction outside that was not informed about.
Perfect location - right next to the train station and tram stop. Tom had been friendly and responsive to our messages.

Tom try to do as much as they can to keep the place nice and clean. The apartment is old, hallway or the building needs refurbishment. Location is amazing, has lots of food and easy access to everywhere, especially free trams around the city. However, due to lots of road and city building works, therefore it will be very noisy. Near the Flinders street station, will be very noisy from drunk or general public hustling noise. Not recommended for sensitive noise people.

Great location and super great price! But there were cockroaches everywhere. They started coming out the first night and we killed 3-5 every time we went in the bathroom for the rest of our stay. They were mostly in the bathroom but later we found them in the kitchen and living room too. I understand that large cities often have cockroaches but this was pretty out of control.
I was very happy with the location and overall quality of the Airbnb, but was pretty disgusted by the shower drain being full of hair and a cockroach.

Jana place was so far the best Airbnb place. I came to Melbourne for work and did not know about anything and didn’t have any friends so I rent Airbnb before renting real accommodation. I was not expect much to Airbnb but Jana’s place was a full of surprising. She helped me everything and share her meal, also she took me around her house,shopping and inspection apartment too:), she treated me as their family member. House inside was sparkling clean and very modern, they have very big nice kitchen also bathroom. They even let me use their parking spot too. Their family is also supported me in many situation and they are so sweet. The Airbnb is more than the value. You never feel lonely. So I recommend everyone but especially people don’t  know about Melbourne. I am still keep in touch with her and already miss Jana’s family! Definitely stay again if I have a chance :) thank you very much for your support and kindness Jana.

Without a shadow of a doubt THE best place I have stayed in EVER. where do I start. The house is newly built with central cooling and heating. Top quality furniture and fixtures. Everything you might need is there and more. On top of that the family host is so hospitable I felt at home at all times. Thank you so much Jana mama for everything 😃. Now you have 2 "habibi" 😅
Had a great stay at Jana's place-many thanks for Jelena and Dennis for their hospitality while Jana was on holiday. Will book again if the opportunity arises!
I have stayed at Jon's house twice now and will continue to stay there. Jon is an amazing host, communication was great, and the house itself is lovely and in a great location.

The apartment is in a fantastic location, and is nice and tidy. Frank and Pam sent through easy to understand instructions and their communication was great. I would just suggest spending a little more time on the cleaning, especially in the bathroom as this was definitely in need of a deep clean.

We had fantastic stay at the apartment! It is very cosy, stylish and sparkling clean. What’s more is the convenient location where everything from supermarket, restaurants and transportations are all within walking distance. Will definitely recommend anyone who’s visiting Melbourne to stay here.
Comfy apartment and great location in the CBD. I had reservation issue with Airbnb but Frank and Pam were very helpful. We had a great stay in Melbourne.

Location was great, Frank and Pam were very responsive, the apartment was clean and very well decorated. The only issue was noises from construction site next to the apartment but it wasn’t host issue or anything, but if you plan to stay during week days you will hear noises from 6:30 AM while there are construction works going on around the area ( our last day was Monday then we couldn’t sleep after 6:30 AM). Overall very happy with the apartment and our stay there.

We loved everything about Frank’s place. The apartment was in pristine condition and extremely central location means it was easy to get to anywhere. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Melbourne.

This ranks as one of the best airbnb I've stayed in. The apartment was spotless and had everything we needed. Location was perfect - just across Southern Cross station and tram stop. Beds were super comfortable. The shower is quite small though - this might be problem for those with bigger builds but it wasn't a problem for me.

This is the best Airbnb I have ever stayed. The place looks exactly the same as (maybe more than) photos. It has more than enough facilities and more than enough beddings. Frank and Pam even helped to set up the sofa bed into a "bed" which makes no one feels left out. There is even welcoming milk and chocolate. I will choose to stay in the same place if I visit Melbourne again!

I met a friend in Melbourne and we stayed at this immaculate apartment! Comfy beds, good shower and super clean. Wonderful location to explore Melbourne’s restaurants, shops, and bars on foot, and a short stroll to a tram or train to go further out. Thank you Frank for your attention to detail, and the welcome chocolates! Would stay again. 😊

Property was clean and has all the amenities but the parking, lift and the corridor to the apartment was very smelly.
There was no outside city view.
Otherwise, stay was ok.

It was one of the best Airbnb I've stayed at. Spotless, all amenities available, including kids tableware and high chair, excellent location making it so convenient to go everywhere. Even though we didn't bring a car this time, the car park is a bonus and we will definitely book here again next time if available. Very good value for money. Thank you.

Frank and Pam were excellent hosts! They were flexible with my early flight and always timely with responses to my messages. The proximity to the train station is awesome I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Thank you for providing a wonderful apartment for our stay in Melbourne. Charlotte was very efficient and fast to answer queries and a pleasure to deal with.  The unit is spotlessly clean, quiet, good on street parking and has high quality equipment in the kitchen.  The two bedrooms are quiet and very comfortable with good quality linen and pillows. We can really recommend this unit to anybody wanting a peaceful and extremely comfortable unit to stay in.

My partner and I had booked for a 12 night stay. Within the first day we noticed the kitchen sink was broken and Netflix plus the normal channels on the TV weren't working. By day 5, the bathroom flooded unexpectedly which led us to an early check out ! I'm still waiting for my refund which is annoying 🙄
But besides that! the place was clean with an easy check in. Communication with the host was quick and easy with absolutely no issues. Location was perfect and close to everything you need.

This flat is a convenient place to stay for visiting local family members. It is really well equipped, which makes it easy to get settled and get on with enjoying a visit. I am happy to return here again.
Very nice stay very enjoyable. The room is clean and the kitchen is fully furnished. Feedback is prompt when there is a problem
Great location in Malvern, close to public transport and it’s a lovely area to walk around. The apartment had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.

Pros:
- communicative hosts
- well equipped kitchen
- good location with on street parking
Cons:
- older unit
- main bedroom door doesn't stay closed
- window in second bedroom is broken so insects come in

A fantastic stay in Melbourne with helpful instructions on check in. It was walking distance to attractions and the free tram. The apartment is as described and we felt at home for the weekend. We would stay again! Thanks to Frank & Pam for hosting us.

A great little apartment for our toddler and us to stay in. Clean and so very quiet - we could hardly hear the city noise! Frank communicated with us quickly when we had questions and the apartment had everything we needed for a 3 night stay. We’d stay again!

I had an amazing experience staying at Pam’s and Frank’s place. From the moment I arrived, everything was perfect. The apartment was exactly as described, clean, and very cozy. The decor added a lovely touch, making me feel right at home. The location was ideal—close to public transport and walking distance. They are both were fantastic hosts, always available for any questions and providing great local tips that made my trip even more special. I truly appreciated the thoughtful touches like fresh towels, toiletries. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Melbourne. Thank you Frank & Pam for making my trip memorable.

What a wonderful experience! Not only the apartment was so clean and comfortable, but also Mr Frank & Mrs Pan were very quick to respond and always ensure we had a great stay. The apartment is located in city centre and very easy to go anywhere. Very highly recommended and definitely book again for our next melbourne trip!
Thankyou very much:)

Frank and Pam were extremely friendly and prompt in their responses. Thank you for responding so quickly and accommodating to our last minute asks. We’re extremely grateful to have met such understanding hosts and their place is really clean and beautiful, exactly like the pics!
Hopefully their place is available the next time we visit coz we’d sure like to stay again!

Frank indeed a super nice host, with assistance from Pam. The most responsive and trustworthy host i met in abnb so far. The unit is super clean and beautiful. Small but full of everything that you need. Location is in city centre but quite peaceful. Great Thanks, Frank and Pam, we have a nice stay at your place!!

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The place was modern, spotless, beautifully decorated, and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. The host was incredibly welcoming and responsive. The location was perfect—close to everything but still peaceful. I’d highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay in the city.

I love frank's apartment... it wa so clean neat and perfect in everything. Frank and Pam are really nice and very helpfull.
Location is great .. so near to city tram. i will recommend everyone to try this place.. 5 stars for Frank and Pam. Thank You

A lovely stay in a really convenient Melbourne location. Trams and trains close, supermarket over the road, plenty of eating options around and great coffee around the corner. The apartment is very roomy and the carpark included a real bonus. We did a lot of walking as we enjoy the city sights. And thank you to another review we took slip ons for warm feet when inside. Frank is a very responsive host and answered all my questions very promptly. Thank you again.

Louise was amazing an responsive. Conveniently located, with many well known restaurants nearby (Eg Supernormal canteen). Spent our wedding night here, the window looking out towards the city is the perfect spot to take photo shoot. Would definitely come back

This place was just gorgeous. Full of natural light, spacious, clean and stylishly decorated. The beds were really comfy and it was a stones throw to everything you could want to do in and around st kilda/the city. Would highly recommend!
Beautiful place with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The highlight for us was the huge window in the living room! Louise is friendly and quick to respond.

We loved our stay in this apartment - it is sparkling clean and a great size. So close to transport and restaurants and the view of the Melbourne skyline is a gorgeous bonus. Great value for money - we were sorry to leave!

Fantastic apartment, well located, well equipped, very clean and neat, and the hosts were very communicative.
Would absolutely stay again!

Fantastic Airbnb. Has everything you could possibly need, was very clean and the communication from Louise was wonderful, she’s very attentive and helpful. Check in is super easy and the apartment itself is lovely, exactly as described.
Walking distance to Albert park for the GP and a few different tram lines as well and directly above a cafe.
Would definitely stay here again!

Great location, close to beach & the city. A warm, comfortable, renovated apartment inside a charming, historic building. Spectacular views of the Melbourne skyline.
Louise was a very accomodating, helpful host.
Fitzrovia Cafe located right next door, was a highlight of our visit to St Kilda with delicious treats & fresh daily market flowers.

Angpal's place is a stylish apartment conveniently located between a small shopping centre and the beautiful Maribyrnong river foreshore. The apartment is modern and well-furnished, and very clean. Though located near a through road, and close to public transport, the apartment is quiet and has a leafy outlook. There is ample parking space in the secure garage. Angpal is a respectful, helpful and communicative host.

it was clean and comfortable, very quiet and peaceful. There are shops and restaurants within a short walk and very good access to public transport. Angpal was very helpful and easily contactable. we enjoyed our stay

Louise was a great and friendly host and we really enjoyed our stay there in Mel. It is in a super nice suburb, convenient in transport. We were able to see such beautiful sunset around St Kilda. Highly recommend :)

Louise’s place was really cool, beautifully furnished and in a great location.
We really enjoyed our stay - so much nicer than a generic modern and tiny Melbourne apartment.
It was quiet and really spacious with a beautiful outlook over Albert Park towards to city.
Very funky little apartment in a great location. Easy access to transport. I enjoyed having the lake and parkland so close. Lovely views. Would definitely stay again.

We really enjoyed our stay in StKilda over the AFL Grand  Final weekend. We were not going to the game and wanted to avoid big crowds in the CBD. The apartment was pretty quiet despite being on a main road and was very clean and well presented. Lots of cafes and restaurants nearby and walking distance to the beach. Louise was a great host who provided thorough instructions and we really appreciated being given the option to check in early and out late with no guests either side of our stay. Thank you, Louise!

Fantastic apartment in St kilda. Super close to cafes and tram stops. Louise was super flexible with her check-in and even left little chocolates and books for my kids which they loved. Would recommend and stay again.

that area has really nice restaurants and good mart. and very close to tram.
the place itself was nice, clean and beautiful. and they have every appliances we needed.
I definitely want to book here again when I come back to Melbourne.
100% recommend!

The apartment was an amazing space, and spotlessly clean,in a cool and vibrant part of town close to the beach, with great places to eat and drink and an easy tram ride into town.  The owners were super friendly and couldn’t have been more helpful and accommodating would not hesitate to recommend or stay here next time I was in Melbourne

Our family had a wonderful stay at the apartment which had everything we needed, was in a great location, and had a beautiful view of the nearby park and city beyond. It was nicely furnished and cosy, making our time there very comfortable. Our children loved the books, games and colouring that was available and we really appreciated the care taken to cater for families. Louise was a great host with good communication, answering any questions I had promptly and supplying all the information needed to make our arrival and time at the apartment worry free. We'd love to stay again!

Thanks to Louise who has made this stay at her wonderful place so special for us! We spent Christmas as a family in her flat and she did everything to make us feel home and extremely welcoming! Louise even arranged for Christmas deco, gifts for our little ones, books and the best: a Christmas tree! :) we would definitely stay again and fully recommend her and this wonderful flat! THANKS AGAIN!❤️
Great place to stay with 3 generations. Each had our own room and huge main bedroom and bathroom.

Very cool pad in the heart of St Kilda, with some great coffee and food options just metres from the property.  We really enjoyed waking up to the picture view over Albert park to the CBD skyline.  Thanks Liouse for being a super responsive host and providing such a chic pad! cheers!

Lovely and friendly host!!
Tastefully furnished and clean apartment.
Comfortable and in a great location.
Louise went out of her way to accomodate and respond to our needs.
Really appreciated!
Thank you

We spend one night there and it was very good :-) the bathroom is clean, the room also and you can use the washing machine.
Thanks a lot for your accommodation!!

Awesome host, awesome location (train station, preston market, restaurant and big woolies all in 200 meter), nice place. Room was spacious and has an own watertap. sofabed is fine for few days, but for a long stay it isnt the most comfy. Overall we had a great time to discover Melbourne.

A rough gem of an art deco building hidden in full view, with a generous responsive host, who very kindly accommodated a rudely late booking at short notice. Much appreciated and the room though modestly furnished was clean and comfortable. Top of the beautiful stairwell was a great open living area and classic deco balcony which wouldv been lovely if i had had the time to spend enjoying it, Best of all proximity to die for, bustling diverse Preston produce market precinct is very much my hood and this retreat is right in the thick of it. When i cant stay in my own warehouse this will be my go to accommodation option. Right price, right place.

Overall had a great stay at Jt's with outstanding hospitality. The accommodation is located at walking distance to supermarkets, restaurants, public transports etc. Definitely would recommend this place if you're wanting to explore Preston, nearby suburbs or even the Melbourne CBD.
Amazing room with cute quirky anesthetic, functional washbasin in the room is an amazing idea. Host was super accommodating, kind and respectful! Would definitely recommend! :)

right near Preston markets, JT's place is fantastic. I stayed two weeks whilst studying a short course in Brunswick East. JT is friendly and welcoming. it was a great base for me. Safe and comfortable. so much fabulous food and wine bars close by.

Loved staying at JT's.  He was a very helpful, responsive, accomodating host -- and I felt comfortable staying there.  Loved the area -- (a) right by Preston market and a food strip with great international selections, value for money,  wonderful wonderful food! (b) walking distance to the train!  Plus bus stop too.

Great place to stay-so close to Preston market and restaurants galore.
JT is a great host-there if you need but invisible otherwise.
The room is a beautiful old high ceiling space tastefully and creatively decorated which makes it a bit more than just a stay.
Don't miss Lucchini cafe i High Street( just around the corner)which is an experience in itself.

Jt's place was great. Lots of great cafe, restaurants, and pub close by. The train station is also super close. Getting to the city is only half an hour or so. The unit itself is really big. The bed is clean and comfortable. The bathroom is also very clean. Jt is super helpful when you need it and also gives you lots of space in other times. I would stay here again.
Great location, great apartment. Super central, walk to Swan st and Bridge rd. This apartment was sunny, clean and tidy, and a good size for the two of us. A great Richmond option!

Building is a bit yucky but the apartment is great and a nice location right near the London Tavern. Excellent off street parking (and I have a big car) good heating, full kitchen. Tea and coffee provided but no milk. Would return for sure.
Great location, clear helpful instructions. Unit had everything we needed for 3 days, excellent suburban pub next door. We would stay again. Only a 10 minute walk to the MCG, go Lions!!!

Probably one of the best airbnb's I've stayed at. Great location, easy to get around. Parking was very very good and very secure. One of the few airbnbs that feels like a real home, and the place felt well designed and nicely renovated. Seriously had everything we needed and easy check-in and check-out process. Very quiet at night, even over NYE. Would definitely stay there again in future. Only thing I'd say is the pillows were quite firm and high, but this a minor point.

Beautiful and cosy place, close to everything we needed, professional and very approachable hosts, easy to communicate with, would recommend the place to others and would come again, really enjoyed our stay.

Charlottes place was a great find. The location was perfect for a quick walk to coffee shops, Yarra Park and the MCG.
The place was welcoming, while it was also tidy and comfortable.
Charlotte was very accommodating, ensuring that we had everything we needed for our stay.

We had an amazing stay, great location, close to restaurants and stadiums just a 10 min walk.  There is noise from the garden bar at the tavern next door specially on Friday nights. Didnt bother us at all as we were aware.  Close windows and all good!

Charlotte was amazingly responsive booking us when our previous accommodation was booked the night before we were due to land the day before a long weekend. She really helped us out ! She gave very clear instructions and the place was lovely. Great location and easy to get to the city via train. Great local eateries too.
Was  a great place to stay to attend the Australian Open. Pub three doors down has excellent food and a really good feel to it.

Highly recommended.
Very clean and modern.
Across the road from Craigieburn Plaza.
Will definitely be going back.
Hatice & Naeem

Spacious, clean three storied apartment ( 2 flights of stairs if that is an issue for you) across the road from Craigieburn Central for supplies. Very responsive host ( fixed an issue with smoke alarm promptly)
Very good value for money.

Great location for anyone looking to stay near Melbourne without worrying about getting into actual Melbourne. Just off the highway was easy to catch a  bus to the station and then direct to  Melbourne.
Great place to stay,felt like home.Quiet neighborhood and close to amenities.Host is very responsive.
At the beginning, I had a chat with the host and they were very helpful, especially when I requested to check in earlier. Also, the host was giving me reminders that make the process easy.

We had a great experience.
It was at a walkable distance to Craigieburn central which was main benefit to us. You could stroll around the park near by.
House was clean and had everything you needed.
Thank you to the Host.

Stylish and super clean. Split over 2 levels and on one of the coolest streets in Melbourne. CBD and Brunswick St are walkable or a quick tram or Uber. Host was really helpful when we needed to move dates due to covid.

Excellent spot! Close to fantastic venues and gardens and also easy public transport. Two story place with bedrooms/lounge upstairs and dining/kitchen/bathroom all downstairs. We stayed with two young kids and the courtyard was a safe spot for the toddler to run around. However not a super kid-friendly place (because of the lovely decor) - next time will come back without them!
Great location on Smith Street. The place is really well presented and had everything we needed for a Melbourne weekend away!
Great location.  Very good bedrooms.  Very good living area.  A great option for being in the heart of  Collingwood, or being close to Fitzroy or the city.  Highly recommended.
Beautiful place with reallly nice touches around the house. Alan is great at communicating and very responsive.

Alans accommodation offers a very comfortable stay and a convenient location close to Gertrude Street : for all it's attractions (yoga, cafes, etc), East Melbourne for the parks and Melbourne's CBD. The bonus here for us was the offer of a visitor's car parking permit which meant once arriving by road, we could leave the car and walk everywhere we wanted to visit.
We stayed two nights with our adult daughter who was visiting form interstate and we each found the beds super comfy and warm, the lounge bright and snug, and we were able to eat in on one night using the compact dining area supported by the well set up kitchen amenities.
Very appreciated!

I almost never have to say something negative about a home I actually like, but, they dont have heating in the downstairs part and its colder there than outside. Hopefully they will fix this.
Other than that, love Alan the host, the area, the privacy, its quiet, well decorated. I love to cook and the kitchen is basically a small chefs kitchen. Love the outdoor patio and extra bathroom out there. Great place but really needs heat downstairs, at least in the bathroom. But i would suggest getting heaters for the rest of the downstairs too.
The rooms upstairs have heaters and are amazing.
Again, i hate writing anything negative because everything else is great.

Great location and great communication and flexibility from Alan. Layout wasn’t quite what we expected but it worked. A steep staircase with bedrooms and lounge upstairs. Kitchen and bathroom downstairs. Travelling with toddler so not easiest for us. Thanks!

What a beautiful home in an exceptional location. We had such a wonderful experience staying here. The rooms were large and the beds were comfy. Getting into the scene was a short walk from the front entrance, and the location is really quite remarkable. Highly recommend.
Sean's hospitality is one of the best that I've experienced from an airbnb, the bed is really comfy and the location is just minutes away from public transport. It is of great value for money.
