The place is really clean. Also, if you are coming late or going out early, the location of the room is really convenient. We were able to park in front of his house, which was a plus. Also, there are good restaurants and shops in the neighborhood so we could just walk and buy stuff.
Great location, Friendly host. Comfortable in every aspect. Our little bub was with us and Sean was a very accomodating host. We have found a place to stay in Melbourne whenever we're there! :)
Another great stay with Sean. If I could give him a 6 of out 5 star rating I would.
Sean’s place is really comfortable, close to shops and cafes and he is a great host. Really recommend it
Nice room in quiet street with very friendly host. Perfect for people looking for accommodation in the northern end of the city.
Perfect location near transport and supermarket. Surrounded by beautiful parks. Bedroom is on the street-side so it can be noisy sometimes. It wasn't a problem for me.

Sean's place is in a fantastic location. The bedroom and bathroom were well presented and clean, with everything you might need.
The house and garden were lovely and we were pleasantly surprised by how quiet it was.
Sean made it easy for us to check ourselves in and was friendly and accommodating.
Would definitely stay again.
Me and my partner had a fantastic stay at Sean’s place. Awesome location and quiet area with everything you need close by. Will definitely stay again.
A very generous host who is easy to get along with. A quiet spot close to Fitzroy in a comfortable home.

Sean was a simple and humble host and tended to everything we needed during our stay. He has a beautiful and cosy house which felt like home away from home. Great location as well, close to the trams and prime Fitzroy. Would definitely come back to stay if possible.

Beautiful home in a beautiful area. Private room but house was empty for most of the time there so didn’t feel like I was intruding on the owners space all for an amazing price!
10/10 would recommend!

I stayed at Sean's after a very looong 10 hour drive. I arrived, took a shower, and zonked as soon as I could. Didn't get the chance to meet him in person but everything went seamlessly. Clean, easy, and gorgeous home. Highly recommend, great value.

The house is very nice and in a quiet area. But you can be in the city within 20 minutes by tram.
Sean was very helpful and nice.
I can highly recommend to stay at Sean‘s place!
Sean was a lovely host and his place provided us with the perfect spot to crash after our busy days.

I arrived at the end of a long day. Easy key access. The private room and bathroom downstairs within Sean’s home was clean and supplied all necessary linen and furniture. Sean was friendly, easy to chat to and helpful w information for local eateries. I walked through Edinburgh Gardens to Brunswick street for a bite. Sean’s home is in a quiet area. The bed is comfortable. I checked out at 9am and had a pleasant stay. Thanks Sean

Sean’s property is in a great location. It is within a short walking distance from transport, groceries, cafe, bars and gourmet food outlets.
Street parking was available near the property and we felt safe in the neighbourhood. It is also a short tram ride to the city. The bed was comfortable and the private bathroom was good. Sean was very pleasant and helpful.

Above and beyond our expectations! Our stay was perfect: gloriously peaceful; exquisitely clean; great location and parking; with so many excellent cafes and restaurants in walking distance, as well as a beautiful parkland. Sean's house is definitely top of our fave list for Melbourne!
Very relaxed Airbnb - we felt quite at home. Sean was helpful. Parking was easier than expected and it’s a quick tram ride into the city. Thank you.
Really lovely place to stay, Sean was super friendly and made us feel at home :) bed was really comfy & the shower was amazing ! Would recommend:)

Sean's room was immaculately clean and the offered private bathroom was an extra bonus. He was extremely hospitable. His house is 5-6 minutes walk from both trams and train, and just inside the electric bike zone ( :) ). I had a great time, will go back.

Great stay at Sean‘s place! Felt home from the first minute on! Sean is a great host, very helpful and friendly!!!
Place was clean and welcoming! Would definitely stay again!!!

This Airbnb is close to a tram into the city and also has easy street parking. The area has a friendly community feel - with lovely gardens just moments away. Sean is a relaxed and friendly host who is most helpful. We have now enjoyed a couple of stays.

Sean’s house is beautiful and he made us feel very at home! Had our own room and bathroom and were encouraged to treat the rest of the house like our own. The location is perfect, walking distance to shops and bars and easy access to the city centre. Would definitely recommend!

I enjoyed my stay, the room was very clean and the bed was very comfortable. The accomudation was very handy for tram just street. The host was friendly, and I would book this again without hesitation.
Sean is a friendly host and the room is comfy! It has everything we needed and the bed is soft! Absolutely good location and highly recommended to stay in Sean’s apartment!

I stayed here for 3 days. This a quiet and artistic neighborhood, and the accommodation that Sean provided is so clean and comfortable. Plus traffic here is also super convenient and near the city area. If I were to visit Melbourne next time, I’ll definitely settle here again!

Great place!
Superb location- close to trams, fantastic coffee shops, walkway and parks.
The home itself was very tidy and warm.
Sean was friendly and respectful of our space.
Plenty of street parking.
I’d definitely recommend and stay again.
Excellent option for accommodation in Melbourne. Very comfortable, supportive  environment, with warmth of a family home and as much privacy and separation as needed. I hope to stay again.
Had a lovely one night stay, booked last minute and Sean was very quick to respond to the request. The room was nice and clean and own bathroom was a huge plus!

Sean's place was idyllic for me. Cozy and comfortable bed, beautiful home in a tranquil area of Fitzroy North. Train station down around the corner. Smith St just up the road for many cool eateries. Sean is a great host, friendly and easy going. I would highly recommend his place.

Our second time staying at Sean’s place and hopefully not the last. Great location, private room, super clean and Sean is a very respectful and relaxed host. The room and bathroom is clean with nice towels and bedding.  The location is great, right near a tram into the city but also plenty to do nearby- cafes, restaurants and walking distance to other top Melbourne suburbs.

A repeat stay with a great host, beautiful accommodation in a perfect spot.
Thoroughly recommended.

The best place I have e stayed in Melbourne- lovely,clean quiet, renovated house with parking and close to cycle paths, parks and transport. Room, bed were great, access to own bathroom as well as shared kitchen. Sean’s place suited me perfectly.
What a great family home to stay in. Would recommend it to any family coming for a holiday or visit. Thank you Grace!

Grace Is very friendly and accommodating,  the house is nice and clean, very spacious and in a great location. Close to shops and other locations.  Highly recommend if you’re looking for a place to stay!

House was clean and tidy and everything we used worked without issue. Beds & linen clean and comfortable.
Home is situated in quiet side street to main road (Point Cook Road) and easy to get to and close to shopping centre.
Suited my families stay in Point Cook. All communitacation with Gace was relevant and quick.
Will stay again if house is available on my next trip to Point Cook. Thankyou
Cheers
Damien & family
Grace was an amazing host, accommodated our needs promptly, communication was fast and helpful. Would definitely stay again! Thank you grace

75 Tristania Drive is a spacious and family friendly home. The location is private and the neighbourhood is nice. Grace is very friendly and great to message, should you ever need any help or advice. I would definitely recommend Grace and her home.

Grace was a welcoming, friendly host- very easy to deal with & very responsive.
Her house was spacious & clean. Perfect for a 3 night stay. Our 2 small dogs enjoyed the well- maintained, enclosed back yard.
The property was located close to shops, dog friendly parks & sporting facilities.
We'll be back! :)

Nice house in a great peaceful location. Everything went well just the pots and pans were way too less according to the number of guests. We literally had to keep washing the dishes, mugs again and again to be able to use for 6 people. Half of the pans were rusty, very bad quality, super tough to clean. Heating, linen, size of the house and everything else fine but for someone who wants to cook can have a hard time cleaning the dishes. Also, there weren't any sugar, tea (except Chinese), coffee and milk available which is a must in any Airbnb. Just disappointed with these things.
The house was spacious and had all the amenities for the entire family. The outdoor area was also well maintained
A great private room, as described. Very close to public transport, shops and cafes. Private downstairs room in a townhouse. The door to the room doesn’t have a lock,  but I felt safe and secure :)

Kim's place is ideal for a solo traveller especially those who would like to have their own space. Kim was a great host, responded very quickly and was very accommodating to my needs/requests. Personally, I really appreciate the ensuite bathroom and the (working) desk in the guest room.  Kim also provided a TV and a fridge that can be a big plus for some people. Overall it was a great stay.  Thanks Kim !!!

Everything in the room was perfect the location is fabulous as well, Kim is a great person she is very flexible in check in and check out timing.
I recommend the place for anyone looking for privacy with great location

Kim’s place is conveniently located near public transport stops and amenities. It’s a great space for any solo traveler looking for a break from the hustle and bustle of the city! Adequate everyday supplies are provided (:

Everything was very good. The room and bathroom were very clean. It's nice to have a little courtyard connected to the room as well. Perhaps having some extra cutlery placed in the room permanently would help with having a simple breakfast/microwave meal, but Kim did accommodate for this when requested.
great location for public transport. Close to shops and cafes. as other reviews mention, bring some ear plugs for overnight. Enjoyed my stay here!

Kim kindly let me stay another 2 nights and check out really late as my flight was very late at night.
10/10, this place has everything you need, and Kim is a very good host :)

Did not actually check in. Got a full refund from AirBNB, after trying to book a room for a couple + pet. Accepted booking, said nothing for days, on day of checkin, informed us via PM that the pets would be an extra $60 a day, which basically bumped the price up 40% for a 14 day stay.
Totally unethical, requested full refund from AirBNB as this is against T&Cs to go around fair pricing. Also scummy, because pets should not need a daily rate, they aren't taking up any space or extra beds. An end of lease cleaning fee would be wholly appropriate. Tried to contact via phone and arrange a reasonable cleaning fee, no response.
Take note future renters.

An excellent place. I have stayed there for 4 weeks and loved it. Location is amazing, only a few minutes from the station, which is only a couple of stops from the city, and very close to shops, restaurants, parks, pharmacies, etc...The service is great and the place is kept clean and tidy. The apartment has everything you need from a fridge, washing machine, horserack, great bathroom, big TV, and a comfortable bedroom. Everyone is also very friendly and nice and check-in and check-out were easy and quick (Thanks Monica and Andreas).
Highly recommended.

The apartment I stayed in was quiet, cozy and in a great location.
The staff at SoYa were communicative, friendly and helpful. Room was cleaned for me once a week.
Would recommend for long term stays.
A very cozy place nearby amazing landscape. The amenities are all you need for a weekend getaway. Definitely coming back and the host is very kind and gave us a warm welcome.
Great weekend getaway for me, very quiet place while also being close to what you need and only a little away from the nice roads in the dandy’s.

Very clean, small,  but  very convenient place to get away  from the city and to relax. Perfect communication ! And don’t forget that this is a caravan, I think will be a little bit inconvenient for the big people. I stayed with 4 yo old daughter , she just fall in love with the place. Amazing small house with everything inside.
Great location, friendly and helpful host, cozy and comfy place to stay. Me and my partner loved to stay there! Recommend!!

This caravan is in a great spot over looking the valley to lilydale lake. It’s very private, incredibly clean, and has a good energy on entering. The host is lovely, and good to chat to. She left lots of considerate items like instant capachinos, flowers, and extra bedding and heating. A great place to stay.
Such a beautiful and accommodating host. Thanks Tlee for hosting us. Your campervan is amazing. ❤️
A cozy little caravan that meets all your needs. It was well situated got us to attend a wedding in the area. The host was very welcoming and friendly.

Its a perfect weekend get-away for anyone. We just wanted something short and sweet and just fews hours drive from our place in Melbourne. Infact what we got was small, sweet, cosy and a luxuriously customised caravan stay.
Welcoming and friendly host and easy check-in

It was really good stay, except for the part which we read from other reviews that if someone is taller then be mindful as the bed length is bit short, but other than that everything was wonderful and its highly recommend if you have never experienced a stay in caravan. Value for money.

A cozy luxury caravan. By no means wilderness. Equipped with everything you need. Looks good in the pictures, looks even better in person. Gorgeous lake and mountain surroundings. Friendly and communicative hosts.
Very quiet location. The van is very comfortable with lots of extra little touches. The bed was really comfortable. Great nights sleep
Tlee's place is as it appears in the photos.  It is a great location to explore some of the outer edges of Melbourne and head up into the Dandenong ranges on some day trips.
Everything is good. The is very friendly. You will have the unique experience to stay her house.

Tracey Lee was lovely to deal with. Accommodation was exactly as described. Nice & clean with all the amenities we needed for a 1 night stay, after we attended a wedding in the area. A simple breakfast of cereal, milk, bread, butter and jam supplied which was a nice surprise, and really appreciated.

As a caravan accomodation we cannot compare to a 5 star hotel.
But if you want something that is functional, comfortable and has full facilities at a low price then a really great option

I received a very warm welcome from Tracy when I arrived at the Little Lantern. The caravan is delightful and had everything I needed for my stay. The bed is super comfortable!
Thanks for having me, Tracy. I look forward to staying again next time I'm in the area.

We booked the house over the Easter long weekend and had a wonderful stay-in holiday.
Check-in was simple and Marc and Anna had added so many thoughtful touches for our arrival, including fresh flowers in the hall and things for breakfast. The house was spotless and cosy, with the aircon a welcomed addition with the couple of warm days we had during our stay.
There were also lots of other little touches that made it feel like you were staying in a home rather than just a house, such as extra throw rugs in the sitting areas and foot spa in the bathroom.
If I had to pick anything minor, it would be the bed - but only because we love a firm bed and the chapel’s is soft. But honestly still nice!
We went away for a writing retreat and the setting was such an inspiring place to write.
Thank you Marc and Anna for a lovely stay.

This was our third stay with Marc and Anna and our second in The Chapel. It’s a lovely place to stay - light, airy and very comfortable. It has a lovely big bathroom. Perfect for couples.
Marc and Anna are great hosts.
The gardens are delightful.

The Chapel was the most outstanding accommodation I have stayed in for a number of years.
The historic building was unique and interesting, situated in a quiet court. The apartment was beautifully fitted out with quality furnishings, comfortable fireside nook, great heating and every conceivable extra we needed. Lovely wide private verandah space looking out over well maintained gardens and lawn. Everything about the Chapel was relaxing and a pleasure to stay in.
I cannot recommend this accommodation enough and hope to return again.

The Chapel was such a fantastic stay! Looks even better then the photos and has everything you need for a weekend away. Such a cosy stay on a cold autumn weekend, would absolutely stay again when in the area.
Marc place was great and he was so accommodating with every request needed. Perfectly clean and a super nice area.

This place is a real gem situated in a beautiful neighbourhood within a walk of town. The place has been decorated with so much care, and we especially loved the lovely ambient lighting. It felt very special staying here, and it was a very cosy base to come back to in winter. Marc and Anna are super prompt with their communication.
Gorgeous old chapel with modern updates and old world charm. Bed was comfortable and the claw foot tub with bath salts was so luxurious. Definitely recommend.

Such a beautiful chapel oozing with history.  Lovely garden outlook and tastefully decorated.   We were so comfortable and relaxed and the little extra's were so appreciated, such a shampoo, an extra towel, fresh milk and lovely fruitbread for breakfast.  Thank you for a delightful stay.  Highly recommmeded

Would absolutely stay here again. Marc was incredibly helpful with our questions and requests.
House was beautiful, gardens were stunning and we will be back!

We had a lovely short getaway at Marc and Anna’s place. It was well presented with a slightly quirky style that we really appreciated. It is well set up for a short getaway, with a lovely bathroom (with bath) to relax in, and plenty of different zones to chill. The kitchen is well suited to a shorter trip, or people who plan to mainly eat out, as there is only a microwave, kettle, toaster, coffee maker, and electric frypan (plus a small fridge). But that wasn’t an issue for us at all.
We’d definitely come back, and can thoroughly recommend it to others.

Truly could not speak more highly,  of not only this beautiful five-star accommodation, but the wonderful hosts Marc & Anna. During a very challenging time for me, The Chapel was an absolute sanctuary! Bliss in a B&B :)

What a delight to stay in such a beautiful clean house also on arrival we were meet by Anna who was very friendly and helpful. Recommend to all who want a nice quiet and private place to stay. Thank you Marc and Anna. Elaine and Ralph
I always try and stay here or the host’s other accommodation “The Loft” next door. Even the little things are done well.

A very nice suburban neighborhood. The interior is very well looked after. This place has a private entrance, but is connected to other two accommodations, so sometimes you can hear other people’s footsteps or shower.
Lovely and clean and a good location. Dealing with the hosts was a pleasure also - got some good tips about local stores and wineries in the area. Recommend

Our stay at The Mechanics was very special. Communication with Austin was instant & checking in seamless. Loved the uniqueness & historical aspect of the property. The location, size of room, fresh & crisp decor & comfort of bed added to the experience & one of the best properties we have stayed in.
We are pretty fussy when it comes to cleanliness & The Mechanics was sparking clean!
Will certainly return & recommend :-) Thank you

I highly recommend Austin's place if you are looking for somewhere conveniently located, clean, and modern. Austin was quick to respond and easy to communicate with, which I was grateful for as I had booked last minute. My boyfriend and I loved Healesville and we appreciate Austin's hospitality :)

The studio was perfect for our trip. Just a short walk to the South Kensington station which took us quickly into the CBD. Jo and Mark had great communication and check in with Gertie was easy. The studio was well equipped and perfect for a weekend away.

We were greeted on arrival by the lovely Gertie who showed us around.  The upstairs unit was very well appointed  clean and very quiet.  The location was good with transport via train or bus to city if you don't want to drive.  Wouldn't hesitate to recommend or stay again.

A very comfortable and convenient place to stay. It had a very comfortable bed and a big bathroom. It is right around the corner from the shops and restaurants. I would definitely recommend it for anyone wishing to stay and explore the Yarra Valley.

Lovely room and excellent host. Clean and presented at a very high standard. Highly
Recommend!

I had a perfect stay. I arrived late after a wedding and the self-check-in instructions were easy to follow.
The accommodation was very cozy and had great facilities.
The location was far enough from the main road to private but close enough to wander down and explore Healsville in the morning.
Thank you Austin, we look forward to staying again in future.

The Hosts of this Apartment are one of the most sympathetic people I ever met. We stayed for Christmas Eve and they were so kind to us - allowed us to invite friends for Christmas dinner but not only this, they brought us 2 more chairs for that and told us we can also sit in the garage to have more space.
We loved it and can recommend this Airbnb to everyone, we appreciated the kindness and want to thank Jo, Mark and Gertie from the deepest of our hearts.

What a fabulous week we’ve just had at Jo and Mark’s. We felt immediately at home as we were welcomed at the very cosy, comfortable and quiet studio. The kitchen is really well equipped plus the basic provisions were a wonderful bonus. After a day on the train from Sydney we had the best night’s sleep in the very comfortable bed. The studio is very easy to get to from the city; the nearby train and bus stops made travelling around very easy. Highly recommended.

Our stay at Gertie, Jo & Marks place was wonderful. Great spot in a quiet area, with easy access to public transport. A good choice for travellers who want to stay in a peaceful spot away from the hustle and bustle of Melbourne CBD.
Gertie was a very accomodating host, and we would be happy to stay with her again.
Great place to stay. Host was amazing. collected me from airport. close to train to city. clean and tidy unit. bed super comfy. great shower with good hot water.
Stayed here for two weeks while working out of a studio on Dynon Road. Such an awesome area, and a cozy & clean space to come home to after every day of work, very homely. Loved my stay 👌🏽
Great location - right next to the main strip and most importantly - 10 minute walk to both four pillars and innocent bystander! Nice room for a weekend away!

Samuel's Air BnB is absolutely beautiful with everything you could possibly need. It truly feels like a home away from home with every detail being thought out. There was even a lovely set up for breakfast. I couldn't recommend Samuel's place enough
Great tiny home, pictures are very accurate. Perfect place for a little getaway, great location and easy to check in.

WOW what a cute little hideaway. Booked for 1 night due to a wedding nearby and it was perfect to get ready in and come back for a movie in bed while settling in for the night. Beautifully decorated, awesome amenities and nice and hidden off the street for extra safety. Loved it.

Beautiful & secluded, small & intimate; it was a beautiful lil getaway retreat, wifi was really bad though we had to hotspot through our phone but overall, beautiful lil cute resting place for Mum & Dad 😍
Quiet and peaceful location. Easy to find with clear directions provided. Communication was excellent. Nicely styled tiny house.
Very good. Small and cozy as described. It should be considered there is no kitchen or any sink, but otherwise, it was great. Shower was amazing :)

Lovely secluded location where we really switched off and relaxed. The place is small, but perfect for a couple and all you need for a few night away. The bathroom is stunning and the little kitchenette with complimentary breakfast topped it off. Thanks for a lovely long weekend!

Great place to stay. If you want peace and quiet, this is it.
Very comfy bed and cosy room.

Thank you so much for having us stay at late notice & we will stay again next time we need a base in Mornington Peninsula.
A gorgeous little stay & loved the bathroom design.
The view from 42 nd story is pretty amazing. You can see doclands, harbour and most of the city
Great hospitality and easy check in. Host was really nice and helped us with organising a late checkout!
Really nice views. Maybe a bit smaller than expected but worth it. The host is so helpful.
We had a great stay, Bocheng was quick to reapond to all of my queries while we were there. Location was great for us and the views were lovely. We would definately stay again. Thank you Bocheng
Lovely space, super clean, great location,  Bocheng was extremely helpful and friendly. Highly recommended.

Amazing view of the city, you can just see the Melbourne star between 2 buildings.
Bocheng was very accommodating with check in and check out.
Bathroom was a tad cramped but still very beautiful, clean and had all the amenities we needed.
Would definitely stay again!
Absolutely amazing place, beautiful views, host is always available if needed. Definitely recommend and would stay there again
Amazing views, super close to everything. Host was lovely and very accommodating. Would recommend highly and will definitely try to stay again.

The location of this stay is fantastic! The view from the living and bedroom areas are amazing, you’re up so high. The apartment smelled beautiful and everything was really clean and well presented.
I did have to ask for the check in and check out details which I would have preferred been sent to me earlier as I have been busy travelling, though the host was quite quick at responding. Definitely want to come back again!
Highly recommend Bocheng’s apartment. Super high up, great views and clean. Bocheng was easy to communicate with also, which made it even better!

Bocheng was a very good host who went above and beyond in terms of introducing the city to us and making arrangements according to our needs. Loved the apartment location and views - although it was slightly away from the city centre, there is a supermarket and bubble tea shop nearby, and the major amenities and attractions are within a comfortable walking distance, if not, accessible by tram or bus. All in all, we had a cozy stay and are grateful to Bocheng for his wonderful hospitality.
A great apartment in a great location. Bocheng was very accommodating and communicated well. Views were stunning and the price was more than worth it
Wonderful location, comfortable apartment & great views of the city. Bocheng was easy to communicate with & check in was an easy process. Would stay again.

The owner is very friendly and very nice people. The place itself is very nice, clean and amazing views. The place has gym, swimming pool, sauna and steam room  which is super convenient for the customers. Highly recommended
Great stay. Perfect location and views were stunning. Host was very responsive in communication. Easy check-in with clear instructions. Clean and very comfortable beds. Will stay again.
Bocheng was great to deal with. Quick and friendly communication prior / during and even after the stay.  the apartment was clean with great views.

Bocheng was a terrific host! He was very responsive and responded to every message within 15 minutes.
The apartment was very tidy and welcoming along with having great city views.
Bocheng was very flexible and understanding with check in and check out times.
I would recommend Bocheng and his apartment to anyone looking to stay in Southbank.

Bochengs place is lovely. Very high up with a magnificent view. Prime location for all Southbank has to offer & easy walking access to the CBD. There is a lovely pool to enjoy too. Bocheng is very helpful, friendly and quick to respond.
We loved it there and will be back next year for another show at ‘Jeff’s Shed’.

Immaculate little cottage with everything we needed for a two-night stay. Beds were comfortable, bathroom pristine and aircon efficient. Street parking plentiful and no problems with noise. Don’t neglect to pull down the blind, as well as draw the curtains in the front bedroom if you like to sleep past sunrise 😉

Excellent property in good location. Everything was in order, clean and tidy.
The host was prompt and great to deal with.

The house suited our needs perfectly and was just described. The beds were super comfortable, linen luxurious, kitchen very well provisioned, obvious focus on environmentally responsible items  and cleaning products.. all together a great stay with Carly being very helpful.

Carly has an amazing house, very cosy and comfortable. She was very flexible with check in and very helpful in giving me directions to the house. The location is good as there is a coles and Aldi nearby and the bus takes you straight into town.
Stayed 1 of the nights out of my 7 due to safety concerns about the property. Property needs to be fixed up abit more

The house is located in a quiet neighborhood in a peaceful suburb.  The house is clean inside and with all the necessary amenities.  Excellent for family travel staying with a car (hard to find a place in the city with free parking), only 10-15 minutes driving to get to the Melbourne center.  It’s in the west of Melbourne, so it’s easy to drive to the Great Ocean Road and Hanging Rock.  It’s a few minutes drive to a nearby mall with restaurants and supermarkets.  Another great feature: the house has an interior alarm system you can set up when you leave the house for the day.

Clean, comfortable and well situated. Great for a family of 3 or 2 couples. Warm, quiet and comfortable. We had a relaxing stay. Well appointed bathrooms. There's a few stairs so it's not for those with mobility issues, same goes for the bed. The bed base has a bookcase/shelf running around the sides that extends 10+cm beyond the mattress. Beware if you use the bathroom in the night!

We loved staying at Yvonne’s place. She was so welcoming from the first message. When we arrived she had left a colouring book and toy for my two young girls on there beds and they were absolutely thrilled! What a way to make them feel comfortable and welcome, Thankyou Yvonne!
The furniture and linen were all beautiful quality, we would not hesitate to stay here again.

This apartment was absolute 10/10, location was amazing and Yvonne was just great such great communication and we felt very at home.
Thanks very much 😊

We had the absolute best time staying at Yvonne's place. Great location, short walk to supermarket, trams, kids playspace just around the corner. We really apprecited the flexibility with checkin and loved her local recommendations! The apartment was so clean and was just like the photos! Pool and Spa were great after a day of walking around seeing the sights! We will definately stay again. Thank you Yvonne!!

As soon as we stepped in to the apartment we knew we were going to have an amazing stay. Yvonne had kindly left lots of snacks and breakfast items for us to get started. The apartment was absolutely spotlessly clean! Every possible item you could ever need was available. Yvonne had provided towels for use at the swimming pool and spa which were a real luxury we loved making use of. We will definitely stay at Yvonne's apartment the next time we visit Melbourne 😊

Thank you Yvonne for being such an awesome and helpful host!
Yvonne’s place was exactly as described. It was spotless and furnished very well. The beds and pillows were so comfortable which helped after a day of shopping!
Yvonne’s place is very convenient and is with in walking distance to most places like the city, rod laver arena, MCG and Flinders Train Station.
Would highly recommend Yvonne’s place and would definitely stay again when we are back in Melbourne!
Cheers,
Hien

Yvonne was a fabulous host, and made us feel very comfortable. The apartment was fantastic and we had everything we needed at our fingertips. I would highly recommend staying and will definitely be back.

Yvonne is the perfect host she received us in a very warm way sooo very kind she had all type of little things to eat and  it was equipped with all the basic things you need great coffee, all the basic things to cook great appliances.  and the place it's pristine clean. Everything that is there it’s good quality, not things that they didn't know where to put them. She really makes a point of making you feel at home. On the other hand, the location is perfect; full of calm and very near full of life so it's all what you need. Thank you so much Yvonne because we had an amazing time and your apartment it's the best one I've ever been.
Yvonne’s place was beautifully presented and had lots to do within a short distance. Loved our stay.

This is the second time we have stayed in Yvonne’s home and just like last time her home was immaculate! It is big, clean, modern, spacious and the perfect location! Close to the city, great restaurants and the DFO! All within walking distance.
When you arrive Yvonne is there to greet you and to show you around the apartment. She supplies a bunch of goodies and essential so you are not rushing out to buy them yourself!
You will not regret staying in this beautiful apartment!

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment in Southbank! The location was unbeatable—just a short walk to the Yarra River, Crown Casino, great restaurants, and public transport. The apartment itself was clean, modern, and exactly as described. The view from the balcony was a real highlight, especially at night with the city lights.
The host was incredibly responsive and made check-in seamless. Everything we needed was provided—from fresh towels and toiletries to a fully equipped kitchen. Yvonne also provided some essential groceries and snacks which was such a lovely touch. The building felt secure, and the amenities (like the gym and pool) were an added bonus.
We would definitely stay here again next time we’re in Melbourne. Highly recommended!

Beautiful apartment in convenient location.
Spotless in every aspect, great communication with very friendly owner

As soon as you enter this apartment complex, it's like a whole other world outside the city. The apartment itself is very well kept and has everything you need except for a washing machine but that's available within the complex and although a full kitchen is provided, if you don't feel like cooking, there is a cafe attached to the building that does breakfast and lunch which is very convenient.
My favourite things about this apartment though have got to be how close it is to the entrance of the building which makes it easy to find and just how comfortable the bed is. I would definitely stay here again.

The room was small but location good, and quiet. Unfortunately there were too many things broken or not working. Dust along all floor surfaces and appliances. The throw rug had stains on it. We were  given the wrong code for the lock box and were left standing outside in the rain until the cleaners came; cleaning the apartment half hour AFTER our check in time.  TV is very inconveniently placed, should be mounted on a wall.

We had the best time over the weekend. Everyone was super friendly and helpful with our checkin/check out and finding services we would require whilst in the city.
Beautiful spot and surprisingly quiet. Very central to everything which made it so easy to walk
Highly recommend and will definitely stay here again.

Great area. Did not appear to be a king size bed and was locked in room 2 times due to faulty lock. Also getting keys before and after to lockbox was very inconvenient. Did not care for how long it took to get responses. Other than that stay was OK.

A clean, tidy and modern apartment with everything we needed for a short stay. The host was responsive and provided detailed instructions so that check in and out was an stress-free process. The apartment was located very close to various forms of public transport. Thanks Guillaume!

Great host was lucky enough to meet Kate in person. would highly recommend staying here if you dont mind having takeaway for a couple of nights I wouldn't have anything bad to say about the place or host great experience thank you
Great little studio apartment. It was all I needed for my weekend stay. Close to supermarket and takeaway stores. Excellent bakery nearby.

This place was one of the most convenient spots I’ve stayed at. There’s literally a tram stop just across the road, and lots of good places nearby for supplies and food (didn’t have time to try them all).
Despite the abundance of shops, the area itself is quite relaxing. And nearby, there are a bunch of great green spaces. My only regret is that I didn’t have more time to chill, and explore.
Highly recommended.
Loved staying here. Very clean and tidy. Easy to get into the city since the tram stops right out the front.

Great place! Clean, looked like the photos, easy to get around by walking or trams, lots of amenities nearby, including the amazing Sydney Street, which was a nice 1 km walk away down quiet streets where there are tons of cool shops and restaurants. If you don't mind some street noise (this place is on a busy corner), and are looking for a relatively inexpensive place to stay while you visit, this is a great place for one or two people (couple). Kate was responsive, friendly, and easy to communicate with. Recommended!
this place is private, quiet and has a tram to the city directly out the front. This was such an easy booking, and had everything we needed.

Kate is such a gem. she communicated with me the whole time and made sure i was comfy.
place is right outside and next to the tram during the hours if the night but its nothing crazy.
Lovely balcony where you can sit and relax and cafe right next door. i would say that the flooring in all the apartments are sensitive so you can hear the neighbors movement upstairs.
But overall id say my stay was worth what i paid and Kate is a great host.
I had a wonderful stay at Kate's, very cozy and comfortable place to stay while in the city for work. Amazing price for what you get!
I felt so good and happy when I lived in the apartment. This is a good apartment for me.

If you're booking solo or couple, this apartment is perfect for you as it was for me. This place is spacious enough to feel comfortable. The photo's are accurate especially the beautiful outside view which also looks spectacular during night. The apartment is right across from Woolworths which is good for daily essentials. It's also close to the CBD, The Crown, Railway Station, and Trams - all are 5 to 10 minutes of walk.
Zhixin is a great host that responds asap and is happy to assist in any way!
I would definitely book this place again and recommend it towards others specifically solo or couples.

Great location, easy tram access to the city.... Was nice to be away from the hustle and bustle.
The unit we stayed in was very tired and dated and not what we really imagined from the pictures advertising, however bedding etc was clean.
Communication and check in/out was easy and pleasant! Great to have parking onsite for a small fee.

Marnie, is a wonderful host, always in communication with helpful information.
Her home was very comfortable, clean and easy to get around.
Location is fabulous easy walking distance to the beach, shops, bars and restaurants.
We will return.

Absolutely wonderful Airbnb host and location. The apartment was fantastic. It was exactly as described if not better. This is everything that one can ask for in Airbnb!!! Would highly highly recommend and would love to stay there again!

One of Airbnbs that I had a wonderful stay. The view is a big plus especially when you cannot go out much during this time. I hope I could stay longer. The place is clean and I had everting I needed during my stay.

We loved our stay in Melbourne. The apartment was clean and plenty of room for my husband, my son and I. The apartment had everything we needed including a washing machine and dryer. The amenities, pool/gym were excellent.
The view from the apartment of an evening was amazing!
The apartment is close to the Southern Cross Station and is in the free tram zone, this made getting around the city very accessible.
If you prefer to walk it’s not too far to walk into the city from the apartment. There was a Coles right across the road which was also extremely convenient.
The communication by Alex was excellent.
I would stay here again and recommend the apartment to anyone wanting a getaway in the city of Melbourne.
Great location and close to public transport! The apartment was very welcoming and comfortable with many little additions that added to the stay. Would definitely stay again.
Really nice apartment in awesome location with a carpark. So good. Great communication and easy check in too. Would definitely stay again.
Really enjoyed our stay with Alex, we were able to communicate with Alex at all times.  The view was excellent and was definitely the highlight of our stay.

There are 2 bathrooms , but only one with toilet roll. didn't realize it until it is to embarrassed.
Room facing west, with very nice sunset view. downside of that is the heat. Master bedroom (without air con) can be easily over 50 degree in a hot day. It was 35 in Melbourne while we stay). Aircon in sitting area is not powerful enough to cool it down after 2 hours. Highly recommend owner to install another one in Master bed.
you don't need a car, but we did hired one and get stuck in car park for almost 1 hour due to wrong key been given. Get questioned by security guards is also embarrassing.
overall, nice place to stay in a cooler days, if service can be improved will be even better.

Absolutely loved my stay. Great location and close to everything like public transport, food and activities! The place was spotless and easy to find/check in too. The view was amazing!! Alex and his team were very accomodating. Will definitely book this place again :)
Great place to stay. Incredible views and great location. Great for the kids with access to pools and outdoor space.

Alex’s place is as described. Really close to southern cross station so if you’re coming from the airport by skybus it’s right across the road. There are 3 tram stations within a few minutes walk. Alex and friends were really responsive and helpful in their instructions.

I recently stayed at this apartment in Melbourne, and overall, it was a fantastic experience. The apartment is exceptionally clean, well-maintained, and equipped with all the necessary appliances. The beds are incredibly comfortable, and we all had a great night's sleep.
The highlight of our stay was the great view from the apartment! The hosts were also super responsive and promptly answered any questions or requests I had.
There were a couple of minor drawbacks. The noise from outside at night was a bit of an issue, but closing the balcony door significantly reduced the disturbance. Another thing to note is the wait time for the lift. With only one lift serving the upper floors, there were times when it took a while to get up or down, though this is something beyond the host’s control.
Despite these small inconveniences, I would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a comfortable stay in Melbourne!
It was a perfect spot for us (married couple having a kid free weekend) - great location and view, close to everything but without the noise of being too central.

Absolutely great city stay! The location is perfect for those wanting to explore the city and is a walkable distance from attractions like the Melbourne Museum and Old Melbourne Gaol.
Great little apartment with all of the amenities needed for a comfortable stay.

Good place to stay with a good view. Little expensive and not as many condiments for general living as I expected for the price and period of stay. Think I was given 3 different contacts for key pick up and they were late, not really any hospitality or care with the booking or overall experience. Its not a bad place to stay for the convenience and the facilities . You would expect more for the price and some basic hospitality and or more condiments for daily use.
I had a wonderful time here! Loved that the host was extremely helpful and responsive to my texts, and I love the location of the airbnb that’s very close to a tram station and right across a park.

The room has a beautiful night view and is very refreshing. 🌃The layout of the house is reasonable, the area is suitable, the access control system guarantees security, and it is very suitable for visiting Melbourne. 😊The house is located in the center of the city, so it is very easy to get anywhere, and there are many modes of transportation to choose from🫰❤️. The host of the house gave us a warm reception and the online response was very timely and solved our problem. If you are visiting Melbourne, this is a good choice!👍🏻

I've stayed with Eduardo previously.
As always was polite, punctual and curtious with all information and instructions provided.
The location was clutter free and clean.
For the location this was an amazing deal with everything walkable for food and activities while still being private and quiet in your room.
Lots of space and an amazing view.

This is a beautiful apartment.  The only thing I hadn't realised is that it has no view on to the outside world (the courtyard is internal and the windows to the outside are opaque). I thought this might bother me at first but it didn't at all.  The apartment is beautifully furnished and decorated.  The area is fantastic - lots of excellent restaurants and cafes close by.
A gorgeous and spacious house with a nice backyard and a great location, Wayne's property is A+ for big groups!

Wayne is by far one of the best airbnb hosts I’ve ever encountered and I’ve stayed at many places before. His house is so clean, spacious and modern. Great location as well! I stayed at his last year and he was so understanding even though we locked ourselves out more than once. He replies super quickly and is a just a great guy to interact with. I would love to make it a yearly stay location. Definitely recommend this to everyone. I would give him more than 5 stars if I could.
Wonderful accomodation! Very comfortable, amazing communciation and beautiful artwork! It was a very comfortable space!

Beautiful place, and epic location, right in the heart of Collingwood. Does not look exactly as the photos, in real life it is much more lived in. If the house was cleaner it would have been a much more pleasant experience.
Amazing home! Nice and clean and perfect location. Highly Recommended. Will stay again! Thank you so much Justin was a great weekend very cosy and relaxing environment.
Absolutely incredible- in every way! We had the best stay. 100000/10, booking our next stay asap!!
This place was gorgeous and right in the middle of lively Collingwood. I would always recommend the place for exploring and experiencing Melbourne like a local. Thanks for the nice stay :)

Great location and great bars, shopping and restaurants
Excellent location
Really appreciated the culture within the apartment, artefacts, books and art.
Very spacious and hosts were incredibly communicative when we needed
We had a wonderful Christmas in Melbourne
Thank you

a great stay- unfortunately during my stay there was nearby construction and a chainsaw going off so it was quite noisy. However, Renee's retreat is just as advertised- peaceful, away from the Main Street but still still close by.
Lots of extra bedding and towels provided, and tea. Very enjoyable stay. Thank you Renee ~

Renee’s place was clean and comfortable.
We enjoyed having breakfast on the balcony looking up at the towering Mountain Ash trees with the birds who’d come to feed on the bird feeder.
Don’t rely on wifi connection however as it was patchy. It didn’t bother us as we didn’t really need it but if you were requiring a stable connection you may want to bring a dongle (often the case in the dandenongs more broadly).
If you’re a coffee person consider bringing coffee/ plunger with you as there was tea bags provided but no coffee. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Location and cabin was beautiful, a few minor issues during our stay such as the oven and spa jets not working but if those were in working order would certainly recommend this little getaway

We loved our stay and could’ve happily stayed for a month 😀 . The spaciousness,  lovely white linen,  the bookcase and beautiful art all made our stay very special.  Also, for such a central location it was extremely peaceful.  I would definitely stay in Justin’s place again.

This cultured loft in a renovated warehouse is a fabulous place to stay in a remarkably fun, trendy neighborhood where there are lots of great cafes, restaurants, bars, and shops, as well as an easy tram or bus ride into the center of the city or to other places in Melbourne. The inside of this accommodating property felt like an urban sanctuary for us, with its  soaring ceilings, great artwork collection, and shelves of books. We were so happy and so at home. The furnishings, and the design of the space were perfect for us. We had a wonderful time in Justin's home.

Was very clean and looked exactly like the photos. Only downside was the apartment complex can be very loud at times, and we were woken up to construction early in the morning. Otherwise the place was great

Justin’s place is incredibly convenient and served its purpose for our weekend. A slight deep clean wouldn’t go astray but the bookshelf and all the nic naks were incredible to look over. If we ever needed a space with a large living / common area I wouldn’t hesitate to book again!
Had a lovely stay, beautiful location and we were so appreciative that we could enjoy our time together with our 2 x whippets.

We absolutely loved our stay at this beautiful cottage in Olinda. It was cosy and private in a beautiful location. Renee was very accommodating  with check in/out. The kitchen was well equipped and Renee ensured the heating was on for our arrival! We will definitely be back!! Thank you Renee!
Cosy little cottage and had wild life come to great us at the door. Close to restaurants and activities.

Beautiful location and surrounds. Lovely little cosy cottage.  The only downfall was we didn't have firewood on the first night and didn't get a response regarding this, but it was rectified on the next night 😊

We had a lovely stay at Renee's place and had everything we needed for our 3 night stay.  It is located in a great spot on top of Mt Dandenong and surrounded by beautiful bush. Very tranquil and peaceful.
Great location. The retreat is really in the middle of the rainforest. We had a good time relaxing and getting cozy in front of the fire inside.
Renee's cottages are in the best environment for me and I have booked them before. I love the mountains and the big ferns and birds singing greeting me in the morning.
Majid is a lovely, helpful, accomodating man and his place is absolutely perfect. Highly recommend staying here.

It was a lovely stay at Majid & Sep’s studio. Everything was clean and comfy. The gardens around the studio and pool was beautiful too.
Majid and Sep were so lovely and friendly, offering help whenever we needed, but we still had all privacy.
Highly recommend!

The pool is definitely the highlight of this place. The room is neat and the beds were very very comfortable. The shower looked fancy and had a 10 minute limit every 2 hours. But since there’s no aircon in the studio, it got quite warm and stuffy even with the two fans on. There was also limited utensils and we had to go buy some soap and sponges to clean them. We were happy to do that though, and the hosts seemed nice :)
The place was nice and really silent in the night. It does get very hot and stuffy on a warm day. The kitchen was a bit too small and lacked some stuff which we bought.
Loved this place! Super secure and no contact check in was a bonus. The villa was super cosy and located in a quiet area near shops. Would definitely stay here again when I’m in Melbourne next.
great place, clean, modern, and still cozy, would definitely stay again. Majid also extened my check out a few hours, thanks again!

Majid's place is really lovely. Super clean. The bed is comfy (but on the firmer side if that is important to you). There's a 10 minute limit on the shower but it feels sooo nice (one of those big wide shower heads) so it's a great 10 minutes. Basic culterly, mini fridge, and microwave but no stove or kitchen sink so if you're going to cook you're limited. I stayed in cooler weather so didn't use the pool but it looked good too, however if you're shy it's worth noting that the pool is clearly in view from the host's home (the space you actually stay in feels very private though).
First Airbnb trip which I enjoyed, they are such great hosts, such an amazing place to stay at , place is very cute and cosy , highly recommend
the appartment had everything we needed for our short trip. the location was fantastic, 5 minutes walk to the train station and marvel stadium. great value, would love to come back and stay again.

Jess’s place is perfectly clean and well prepared one. It’s a lovely guest house near the Hopers Crossing station, it’s literally 5 mins walk distance if you’re a fast walker like I’m. We were traveling with the baby and had a flight late in the evening so we were a bit worrying about late checking but with Jess’s apartment it was not an issue at all.
After we arrived we found a cosy 2 bedroom guest house. It had very comfortable bedrooms and convenient kitchen/dinning area.
The place looks exactly the same like it was ok the picture and I can say with confidence that we greatly enjoyed every single minute staying there.
Undoubtedly, I would totally recommend to stay in the Jess’s guest house.

Another very comfortable stay in Jess' property.  One small maintenance issue arose and was dealt with promptly and with minimum fuss and no inconvenience to us.  Thanks Jess for being such a good hostess.

I've stay at Jess's property a lot this year and as time goes by it gets harder and harder to get a booking because so many people are now realizing how amazing her place is.
Cozy, clean and professional presented. Location is amazing and the bed is extremely comfortable.
I'd give this place 6 stars if the system would let me.

Jess was an absolute star! We had no issues apart from one thing that was a rare occasion and out of Jess’s control. There was a street power cut and Jess was nice enough to refund one night as my sister couldn’t stay for one night there. But the remainder of the stay was  amazing. Beautiful clean place and Jess was an awesome host, highly recommend :)
Jess was great to communicate all the needed info. The house was clean and was exactly as described. Great place to stay.

Great little place to stay. All facilities close by. Property had all facilities and clean.
Driving in and out of the place is a little difficult due to other vehicles parked off street.

I booked Jess's place for family members to stay at while here for our wedding. Jess was super helpful and quickly responded to all messages. The location was great, with off street parking and very close access to public transport. My parents were really happy with restaurants and supermarkets within walking distance. My family said they'd love to stay there again next time they visit us. 10/10
The apartment is on a busy road but still very quite on the inside! The parking is a bonus. The only downsides is the couch as it not comfortable.
Jess is an excellent host and the place is very well kept. It is close to station, all the restaurants and large retailers.

Home was ideal for what we needed this week.
Clean comfy and all amenities required. Priced to match

Had an incredible one week stay at Jess place.
Walking distance to train station, macs & other amenities. Short drive to Pacific Werribee as well.
Highly recommended place to stay. No regrets at all, comes with complimentary drinks & snacks.
Will definitely rerecommend family & friends. Cheers!

This was our first accommodation in Australia after moving here with family, and we were a bit nervous initially. However, Jess, as our host, made us feel right at home from the start. The accommodation was perfect for us in every way – cozy, conveniently located with plenty of shops nearby, and just a short walk to the train station. Everything about the stay was incredibly convenient.
Jess was an amazing host – always helpful, super responsive, and genuinely welcoming. We couldn't have asked for a better experience!

A wonderful stay! The place was spotless, well-equipped with everything we needed, and the instructions were clear and easy to follow. We felt very comfortable throughout our stay and would definitely recommend it to others!

Shauns place was absolutely perfect! It was clean, comfortable, in a fantastic position and made for a wonderful weekend away. The kitchen was perfectly stocked with everything we needed to cook and the living area was lovely to sit and relax with the fireplace warming us. We will definitely be back and 100% recommend for anyone looking for a cosy and comfortable place to stay!
The place is surrounded by nature and it was memorable stay overall. You can feed the birds that come and visit every morning.
Really good place to stay, communication is really well from the staff, really good access to public transport, will strongly recommend if anyone is looking for stay in Melb.

Great apartment for my work trip. It had all the amenities that I needed and is close to public transport and grocery store.
The building had facilities that I could have used if I had the time; pool, gym etc.
The hosts did a fine job communicating with me, and were very helpful when I may have had to extend my stay.
Would definitely stay here again.
The unit was dirty and needed a good clean. Visible stains on carpet and walls of unknown substance. Poorly presented unit we won’t be back.
Great location in Docklands with the tram right at the front door step, all the amenities you need for a stay while in Melbourne, included parking was a bonus

great stay check in service was great and communication from the stay and Co team was great. the apartment carpet was a bit marked but the rest of the apartment was clean and spacious. would recommend and I'll be back.
Great location and very responsive hosts. The place is perfect for couples wanting to stay at the city. Very convenient for public transport, also a few dining places and a supermarket nearby!

Difficult procedure to initially gaining entry keys to apartment.
Great location
Bedroom very hot as has no ceiling fan or air conditioner
Poor quality mattress with springs emerging
No guest compendium with apartment information

Great location with tram stop right outside, apartment was clean and perfect for what we needed. There was an initial mix up with the additional blow up mattress we requested but our host was very helpful and had the issue fixed in no time. Everyone we dealt with was lovely and would definitely go back.

I really loved this place.  I was in Melbourne on my own, so the location directly across from the tram was fantastic.  I felt very safe.  The apartment had a great layout, was clean and had good facilities.  I used the gym and the pool and loved having access.
Great place. Clean, comfortable, well equiped. Shower pressure was really poor however. Otherwise, a great stay. Lovely reception staff.
Was a great place to stay in the heart of melboune with an amazing city view. staff were friendly and helpful, the place was clean and set out nice.
Apartment was clean, quiet, warm, great view of Melb. Beds were comfortable. Kitchen had everything required. Washing machine/dryer very handy. Tram just down from entrance. Would recommend

Excellent location in walking distance from many of Brunswick’s best cafes and coffee shops. Short Uber to other outstanding neighborhoods for dining & entertainment. Stayed here for a business trip and it was well suited for a week long stay. The view of downtown was also epic from the 5th floor balcony. Would stay here again.

The apartment's facilities were poor and inadequate for the price. For example, there were no sharp kitchen knives, no coffee or tea pot, dishwashing liquid, toilet paper, coffee machine or kitchen roll. Both bedrooms had no reading lamps/bedside lamps. The lighting was bright and cold.

David’s house is lovely, just as described and also in a great location.
We loved sitting on the balcony, overlooking the lake and watching the world go by.
Excellent place. Clean and with everything that you need for a night. The free car park is a great benefit too

This Airbnb is not only amazing value for money, it is genuinely a perfect place to stay for a Melbourne city trip. The room was perfectly clean, and the bathroom/kitchenette was such a great add-on. I even had a view of the skyline from my room! The windows were very sound insulating too so practically none of the street noise made it up into the room. The parking spot was the cherry on top, especially being so close to the city!! Thanks Maddy

Maddy was good at communication, which we appreciated. The room is very small and it’s a double bed, not a queen as advertised. But it was very clean and in a great location, and so handy to have the tram right at the door. However getting in the carpark was complicated - the staff just didn’t pick up the phone and we were stranded for a while till another guest happened to let us in. I don’t recommend using the communal paid laundry - people hanging around to clearly steal clothes, so if you need to do washing it’s best to stand guard the whole time.
Thanks for the great one night stay, other than room being small, location was perfect. would be good to indicate building name. Thank you maddy!
Great location,friendly staff,and a great locked gate  carpark . It’s clean tidy and affordable. It’s small but it has everything you need and so close to the center of town.
Good basic accom with most amenities, in a central location. Note that laundry/dryer is a laundromat in the building (byo coins and laundry powder).

Exactly as advertised.
- If you're like me who is used to foam mattress, the spring mattress could be quite a wobbly change for you.
- The noise from the corridor and neighbour's door travels quite well into the room during active hours, but tolerable as we're out most of the day.
- I like the express checkout, used that option as reception is stuck with a guest.

Nice neat room, great location and facilities and security were good. We probably struck a bad Friday night, but loud noise from people and traffic in the lane outside the window kept us awake all night.

Amazing location with free parking in the middle of the city. It's simple and cheap and you won't be spending anytime inside except to shower and sleep. You'll have the whole of Melbourne at your fingertips!

This air BnB is located with the Arrow Hotel, which acts as a hotel but also has some rooms dedicated to Air BnB. We received good service from the reception staff, however, we did not receive the service you would expect from an air BnB host. The host was slow to respond and was not overly accomodating to our check in and out requests (We arrived at 5.30am and although I appreciate we will not be able to get access to the room at that time, I had emailed 2 weeks beforehand to see if we could access slightly earlier than the check out time stated as 2pm)
The place is in a great location
If you're looking for good value and good location and not fussed about the personal experience through air BnB, then this is a great place to stay

The apartment was in a good location for everything we needed to do, free parking was a plus for us, easy check in. The apartment itself is okay, clean, bed comfortable. The apartment is on the older side and a little easy to hear noise from outside but overall happy with the stay

This is a hotel. The room did not match the pictures. Kitchen was much smaller and closed off. The pictures indicated there was a full floor to ceiling window. There was only one small 3 ish by 2 ft length window.

Very comfortable, light and airy. Accurately represented in photos, and host was super responsive and gave great instructions re secure parking and the like. Super convenient for me- close to all the places I was visiting. I will be back.
For just staying short term, there is no problem at all. I mean it was small than I think, but everywhere is so clean.
A comfortable, clean studio with the amenities that we needed for our short stay. It was good to have the option of sitting outdoors.

Perfect little apartment, great location close to everything we needed for a quick  holiday in Melbourne. Apartment was super clean, check in was easy and communication was great. Tons of easy parking close by. Would definitely recommend.
Everything as expected for this stay. The building itself is one of the nicer ones in South Melbourne. Would stay again although the price point is quite high.

Such a great place to spend a holiday.
The kitchen is so furnished
The place is just so convenient 2 minutes walk to Crown Casino

We loved this cute little 2 bed for a week long stay/swimming competition. Warm and cosy, super convenient for both the city and MSAC (we intended using e-scooters but enjoyed the stroll down Clarendon Rd to MSAC so did that instead just about every time)
Everything was perfect no issues. No idea where the bldg rubbish chute is but we used the bins on the street outside so wasn’t a problem!

Nice apartment in a nice central neighborhood. Everything was really close and there is 2 supermarkets within 100m to the building. The apartment was clean and modern like in the pictures. Overall very good for what I payed.

The place was perfect for my family, it was an easy location, close to CBD, crown, and markets. I found that all my questions were answered in a short time, and the team assisted me every moment. I highly recommend the place, is a 5-star place.

We had a great stay overall — the location was excellent, and the apartment was spacious and comfortable. Everything was as described, and we thoroughly enjoyed our time there. The only minor issue was that a few surfaces, such as the TV cabinet, kitchen bench, and wardrobe, were a bit dusty on arrival. Otherwise, the place was clean and well-maintained. We’d happily stay again!
Clean and spacious apartment in a very central SY location. As long as you don’t mind a bit of road noise I would highly recommend.

Susan is such a great and accommodating host. She tries hard to make sure everything is taken care of, and is gracious and responsive. Beautiful apartment right in the heart of everything. The place is real clean, and the central AC is nice. There's nothing not to like!

As far as location goes, couldn’t be better! An older apartment but nice and cosy. It can get really noisy due to the proximity to Chapel St, but this didn’t bother us, especially with how comfortable the bed was.

will def stay again was only$ 13 for a uber to MCG
foods shop across the road perfect location

We would highly recommend this accommodation.  Our hosts have been very welcoming, friendly and making sure everything is okay during our stay.   The cleanliness of the accommodation is outstanding in all aspects.   Location is perfect and makes it easy to get around.  We will definitely be hoping to stay here again in the future.

I was unaware there was a narrow and steep staircase to access the bedrooms and bathroom which was very difficult for me. There are no pictures of them on the website and the only mention was under under safety and amenity which I thought applied to fire alarms etc.  I only found the comment after contacting Airbnb. As the stairs were an issue for me I decided I could not stay at the property and contacted the host explaining my reason for having to cancel the remainder  of my booking. I firmly believe that any accommodation description should state clearly that there  are stairs and preferably have a photo of them.

My son and I had an amazing stay in this fabulous Airbnb. The house is like a home away from home and Semih made us feel very welcome and gave us helpful hints about where to locate trams etc. His wife has ensured the home has lots of extra little touches and we loved the easter eggs. The location of the home is fantastic. It made getting to the city and Formula 1 at Albert Park effortless. We are looking forward to returning soon.
Thanks again for making our stay in Melbourne so wonderful.

Checking in was OK.   We made several  reservations for this trip.   Forgot if this one provided wifi.   Sent email (perhaps text too) but never got a response.  Absence of wifi was inconvenient.   Lighting was dim.   Shower head was bent.  Took long time for water to get warm.   Waste basket in the kitchen was too small .

Loved our stay at Larissa’s place. Was such a beautiful apartment. Easy check in and clear instructions. Everything was so clean and I loved the little details which made this place feel like a home. So close to the shops and public transport was a 3 minute walk. Will definitely stay again. Loved it!
Tidy and good location. One thing we would have liked to have known is that the hot water takes a very long time to work.

We loved our stay at Larissa’s apartment. The location was fantastic. The beds were great. And the shower was amazing.
There were 2 of us and the apartment was exactly what we expected. Thanks Larissa. We will definitely stay again if in Melbourne.
A very cozy apartment at the best location. I will choose this one my next trip to Melbourne if I got the chance. Thank you Larrisa for all your effort making this place so nice.

Larissa's place was the perfect location to get to the Royal Exhibition Building and the city. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The heater was fast to warm up the space and the beds were comfy.
Note to others: the shower will get hot if you wait a long time!

I had a fantastic stay. Everything was just as described and more. The location is great: right in the heart of the city, with Southern Cross Station just a short walk away, a grocery store conveniently located across the street, and access to the free tram zone right outside.
The apartment itself is incredibly spacious and well laid out. It has two bedrooms, each with its own bed, a full kitchen stocked with everything you might need (including glassware, a fridge, and a microwave), and even a desk and a private balcony. The apartment would also be great for two people, as there's plenty of room to spread out and relax individually if needed.
I would definitely recommend this place for anyone visiting Melbourne, whether solo or with a companion.
Ting was attentive, friendly and welcoming. The house was beautifully cleaned, styled nicely and had some very nice touches for the children. It's great.
Ting is an excellent communicator and accommodated and met all of myself and my friends needs. Amazing stay!

We had a lovely stay at Ting's place. The communication was very quick, and the place was very clean and homely. The whole stay was very easy, even when we decided to extend the stay. Thank you Ting for having us!
Great location, facilities and home. Such fast communication and easy to access home, everything was clean and all necessities were provided.
Lovely place for a family, very clean, easy check in and Ting was always very quick to respond to any queries! Will look forward to stay here on our next trip too!

The host response very promptly to my questions throughout the stay and the location is very convinience with nearest supermarket only less than 5 min drive.
The apartment was fully equipped includes a sheltered parking area in case of rain.
Plus, the host left us some snacks which is really appreciated especially after a long drive 😁

Ting’s place was lovely and cosy for our weekend stay. It was very clean and we really appreciated the extra effort that was taken to make us feel at home. We travel to the area yearly and will definitely be staying again.
Please be safe. The host has fraudulent behaviour. Please take photos of even the keys you grabbed or else she will blame from thing you are not responsible.

Clear instructions left all around the house, so that made set up and pack down really easy. Ting was delightful to speak to and easy to communicate and plan with.
The house was beautifully kept and hygienic. I really liked the soap dispensers in the shower too.
We had a great stay, comfortable and easy access, Ting was always quick to respond to any queries

The place is clean and cosy. Ting provided not only tea & coffee but snacks and milk too. We spent most of the days indoors. The place is 10 mins away from the The Pines and a street away to cafes & restaurants

close enough to everything, many close local shops & parks.
very clean house, communication great & in a timely matter. would definitely book here again.

Had very comfortable stay. Unit had all the required appliance and linen that one would need during the stay. host was reachable and quick to response.
Will stay again in this place in future if I travel to Melbourne

I was at this property with my family for the last two nights, I can say this was a nice, clean and family-friendly accommodation in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood. Close to shopping centre, this house has everything one needs during their stay.
Clean, cozy space with a fantastic host. Great location, and very helpful. Highly recommend staying here! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The location is perfect, right in the middle of the city. There are plenty of restaurants and shop around. The unit is average, there are cockroaches but we manage by spraying with anti insect each time we go out. The communication with the host is very limited. She never answer reply to my message.
Needs a good clean. It was dirty and smelt of moth balls . The whole check in process was awkward and the area felt like the slums

Incredible place, amazing location central to everything! (Just out of the free tram zone so be mindful of that). Quite location!
Host was Incredible and had amazing communication!

The owners of this property were extremely easy to communicate with throughout the reservation process, as well as the duration of our stay here! The property is also beautiful and clean and has all the necessities required for a short stay in Melbourne. The location is also very convenient.
We had a nice stay at Selina’s place, it’s just a few stops out of the free tram zone so with a short walk you won’t even have to get a myki if you’re planning on staying close to the cbd

This is an ideal place for a Melbourne visit. It is close to everything we wanted to see. Carpark was arranged in a separate building. It is modern and clean with a good view to the north.Highly recommended.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this airbnb! Communication with the owner was great, and the commute to popular destinations was quick! It was clean, tidy, and overall a great place to stay.

Great location, the property manager was very responsive. The only issue we found was the beds were very uncomfortable and the pool section was closed because of the holidays but they didn’t share that information before hand, but other than that everything was good.
Selina s place is great place to stay, clean and spacious, feel like home. You can find all the equipments and amenities, highly recommended!
Nice host  with  communicate quickly and solve problems soon. Next time I will also consider about this room when I come back Melb.

Good location, clean and tidy apartment. Just a few minor issues that would improve stay.  No full length mirror and no information regarding things to do in Melbourne or where supermarkets etc are.  We personally found the bed far to small for us (I didn’t read the listing properly so that’s my fault).   Overall was a pleasant stay

Great location in a newish building in Carlton. Tram stop right outside, walkable to the CBD, Victoria Market and the great restaurants in Lygon Street plus some lovely squares and parks nearby.
Clean and well equipped and great view. Sofa bed suitable for kids. Selina was a responsive host.
Excellent property I thoroughly recommend it.
Very convenient location as it next to a mall. Great view from the living room. We enjoyed our stay there.

A beautiful,spacious apartment with great views and in a great location .The facilities are fantastic and the location to shops and restaurants is a bonus . We had a fantastic stay and would highly recommend it . A big thank you to Alexandro and team
Excellent location with easy access to public transportation, shopping mall, and restaurants. The flat we were staying in was clean, tidy and  fabulous with a fascinating view. Highly recommended
Very satisfied with my stay, communication was fantastic, the view was even better than it looked in the photos, great experience.
Perfect location, super clean and great value for money. Daniel is super easy to deal with and got back to us super quickly. Would highly recommend this property.

Amazing apartment and location. The apartment is 5 stars and such good value compared to a hotel of the same quality. The location is amazing literally everything in Melb at your finger tips. We had a care and barely had to use it and the location so so centralised. The apartment has everything you need and the beds are extremely comfortable even the fold out couch. The pool is amazing it’s nice and warm for a Melb winter and not too busy. Highly recommend for anyone looking to stay in Melb.

Wow what a stay! From being in the perfect location with everything at your fingertips to the incredible views. Was also relieving having Daniel as an amazing host and knowing he was always just a message away if we needed anything and making sure we were comfortable and making our trip as seamless and stressles as possible. Thanks again Daniel, we will definitely be coming back in the future. Highly recommended 🙂

We stayed here for 9 days and it was one of the best airbnb experience we had.
Location is perfect, right outside of the station within a free tram zone
ocean/river view from the room is amazing.
