Well let’s talk about those donkeys!Strolling through the paddock and we turn around to see one running towards us, lucky I had recently watched Crocodile Dundee as I put out my hand and yelled stop as it got to within a metre of us. Had to back away and don’t turn your back on them! Ah the adventure.

We stayed at the tiny house for our little elopement, which was everything we needed. It was quiet, private, and just right for the two of us. Everything was clean, and its size made us realize how incredible life can be with just the essentials. We connected with nature and enjoyed all its sounds, from crickets and birds to the rustling of some trees.
Katherine was also very responsive and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. She supplied us with some recommendations of things to do in the area, and even left us some treats. If we're ever in town again, I would definitely stay here again.

A beautiful Easter break in this gorgeous little home was everything we’d hoped. From the tasty and very welcome goodies to the view, to the serenity - this was a treat. Thank you Katherine, you have a jewel in the valley. All the best :)
Katherine’s tiny home was the perfect place for our 2 night stay in the Yarra Valley. It was well equipped, comfortable, and not too far from local activities and restaurants. Thanks for having us!

Beautiful stay in our first tiny house. Katherine was prompt and was flexible and thoughtful in our arrival and check out. The compost toilet is tough to get used to, but the rest of the place was great, comfy, warm and well equipped, the bed was comfy and so relaxing looking out over the paddock and listening to the rain on the roof.

A beautiful weekend getaway that was personalised and a lovely intentional touch. The tiny house is private and an amazing view of the surrounding paddocks and hills from the open decking that you can relax on while sipping a glass of red looking out to the peaceful view.
We really enjoyed our stay and appreciated the personal touches. Thanks so much ☺️🌿

Was such a peaceful and comfortable space. A great experience for a couple wanting to get away to a gorgeous setting in a fun Tiny Home experience!
Perfect size for two and perfect place for those wanting to walk around the paddocks and see some cows and even a koala!!

Was a great stay at the Little Yarra Tiny House.
The location was amazing, and the hospitality provided by Katherine was amazing, making us feel welcome as soon as we stepped inside.
superb place not too far from town but amazing views and top place to chill and relax. great hosts

-Brilliant views
-Close to activities and Main street
-Take up your DVD's as the ones there are limited
-Maybe bring some of your own cooking equipment and crockery as the ones provided are limited as well as cleaning equipment.

Helen’s cottage is the perfect spot for exploring Healseville and the Yarra Valley. Such a cosy space and the view from the private balcony, as most other people have said in their reviews, is divine. Would definitely stay again!
The view is quite different at different times of the day, so it was great to be on the balcony and looking out the windows, we really were in the treetops!

Great base for visiting Healesville's attractions. amazing views and the electric blankets were a must on the chilly nights
Helen met us when we arrived and checkin was a breeze. recommended.

Helens place was comfortable and charming and the view of the hills was as lovely as promised. I had an issue with my car when there and Helen was very accommodating while i tried to arrange for it to be fixed
We enjoyed our stay at the cottage. It was spacious and clean, light-filled, and had beautiful outdoor areas and views. Close enough to town while also feeling secluded.

We had an amazing stay at Helen’s oasis. The view from the balcony was breathtaking, Helen was great at keeping in touch, met us and showed us around the home and then left us to enjoy our stay. Can’t wait to come back soon!
Helen's cottage was absolutely picture-esque and was a perfect place to spend the weekend. The cottage had everything we needed.

Incredible spot with everything you need in the space - views are indeed incredible.
Helen was lovely and generous throughout the stay and the space was perfectly private too.
It is in a perfect spot with numerous attractions within a 10 minute drive

We had a wonderful stay and wonderful view - as others say, the view really is so much more spectacular in person and close to town and well located for the area! We would just note that you can hear road noise during the day and evenings, however that comes with being on the highway!

Great views and location! Only disappointment is was that it wasn't advertised that you are right next door to the owners, their windows and outdoor space can directly look into the cottage. However, owners were respectful about our privacy and we barely saw them - just wasn't advertised.

A lovely cottage with absolutely stunning views! It suited us perfectly. It had everything we needed and while it was cosy there was more than enough room for 2 people. The proximity of the cottage to Helen's private house concerned me a little at first, but I needn't have worried, our stay felt very private. Helen was a wonderful host who was very friendly and responsive. She placed her bins with the house number at the entrance to the driveway to ensure we could find it and gave us a thorough tour on our arrival. Would definitely recommend staying here!

We stayed a week but wanted to stay longer. We particularly loved the balcony with the magnificent view and overlooking a beautiful garden (despite the noise from the road, which died away at night). We enjoyed several walks in local forest. Bird-spotting from the balcony included satin bowerbirds and gang gang cockatoos. The position is very handy to Healseville. Top spot.
It was a lovely place to stay comfortable with great views and quiet. Great private outdoor barbeque area. Close to town, only thing that would have made it more comfortable would be a bigger bed.

Don’t be fooled by a rather wild looking street front from the downstairs apartment. Climb the steps and step into a fully renovated haven!
The living spaces were nice and spacious, the bedrooms located away from each other adding privacy. Both bathrooms were very tastefully renovated. We loved the amazing oven!
Short walk to cafes and the beach, in a great position. Recommended.

A light airy large apartment with an amazing master bedroom & ensuite! Ideally located for the main streets & beaches of Elwood & St Kilda. 15 minutes to the tram which takes you into the city in 20 minutes.
We absolutely loved Charlotte’s place!! It was perfectly situated and very clean and comfortable. Beautiful natural light and very homely!! Thank you !!

This was an absolutely gorgeous upstairs apartment that was comfortable and stylish and we thoroughly enjoyed it. It is close to the city and close to public transportation and was a joy to come back to in the evening. The oven and stove are spectacular and very high end. The two beds were wonderfully comfortable. It was also just so nice to have a utility room with a full washer and dryer to clean our clothes before we flew home. This was the last Airbnb that we stayed in. It thoroughly relaxed us and was a wonderful end to our travels. Highly recommend!!!
-Caroline

The space is absolutely stunning! Nice, roomy and quiet!
I only wish the cutlery was clean and there was some coffee and herbal tea for the morning.
Charlotte's flat was a lovely place to stay in Elwood! We thoroughly enjoyed it, and such a quiet location, not far from the beach.
Great space for the kids and close to the beach. Beds were comfortable. Kitchen met all our needs and bathrooms were clean and well designed. The family enjoyed using both the bathtub and showers.

Loved our stay here. Was so spacious and loved every room's layout. Enjoy the area and scouting out all the cafes all around a 10min walk away. We had our  1 year old with us and just had to block the stairs down to the laundry but other than that, was perfect for our family.

Great place! Loved the locality, the cleanliness and the space. Would stay here again.
Really well managed and looked after.
Thank you

Charlotte's place was perfect for an 8 night stay while visiting family. Loved visiting various spots in the neighborhood I used to hang out in when I lived in Elwood many years ago!
Apartment was spotless and very comfortable.

Charlotte and her team made a great effort to offer a spacious, clean and bright apartment. There are easy to communicate with and also made it possible to extend our stay on short notice. The apartment was very clean and everything you need is provided. The surroundings are quite and it is only a short walk (approx. 15 min) to the beach. We definately can recommend the apartment and hopfully will be back.

Brian's appartment was absolutely beautiful and has amazing views. The appartment is in a central location that is close to trams and the casino which made it easy to travel around the city and explore Crown. Brian made the entire process super easy and was always quick to respond to any queries. We really appreciate him letting us have earlier check in and we will be back again for our next stay in Melbourne.

The place is in great location which gives you access to tram (just right in front of building) and the vibrant river walk of Melbourne which offers great resturants and cafes. The room is comfortable and has amazing view! Check-in and out was a breeze. Brian communicated well. Recommended!
This is a fantastic apartment and we really enjoyed our stay - Brian was really helpful with our reservation changes.
Perfect in every way. What a view. Right next to crown. High quality mattresses and pillows ensured a comfortable sleep which is sometimes hard to find. Will stay again. Great for couples

Amazing host, super quick to respond and went above and beyond for us as we were stressing to find somewhere to stay. Absolutely gorgeous location. Would 110% stay here again. Honestly one of the best places we have stayed at.

Great place to  stay if you're looking for something close  to the hustle and bustle of Southbank. A short walk to everywhere! The living room would be a little cosy if you had four people wanting to hang out there but size wise the rooms with the separate bathrooms are fantastic for two couples looking for somewhere great to stay. The views are to die for, a great way to experience Melbourne.  Brian was fantastic to communicate with! We would definitely stay again.
We had a great stay at Brian’s Apartment. Well looked after and cared for. Very clean and tidy

What a stunning apartment! That view alone was worth every cent. I lost a lot of sleep just staring out into the city lights. This accommodation was perfectly located close to Crown complex, with a tram stop outside the front door. My sister and I felt incredibly safe in this area on our own including walking back from the casino late at night. Brian was a wonderful host and responded to any questions I had instantly. I would not hesitate to book Brian's apartment again, wonderful in every way!
Brian is very accommodating and helped us out when things didn't go according to plan. Really loved place and great location.  Will definitely stay again!

Brian's apartment in Southbank is really wonderful. Not only the property has a great view and is within good proximity of main attractions, Brian is very responsive and equip the premise with all things we probably need and even more. He is very generous with supply of items like coffee capsules, tea, spices, etc. It is really a delight to stay at his apartment and is therefore highly recommended to stay, even for a family of 4 or 5 people.
Great stay at Jo’s place. Cute little cottage in a quiet street. Easy to walk down to the beach and tram lines nearby
Jo's place was fantastic. Close to all the places we needed to be near. Easy to find and easy check in. Would recommend.

Having never been to Australia before, I wanted a safe, private, comfortable space for three of my team members from the Philippines.  At the end of their stay, they all requested that I give the host Jo and her property a 5 star recommendation!

Nice place and good value for money. Loved the court yard which got sunlight all day. Good spot. Good feel house to chill out in.
Jo is nice and communicated promptly.
Thanks Jo
Great location, easy and lovely walk to the supermarkets and Bay Street in general. Suited my family needs for our week stay.
Thank you Jo -  our stay was perfect, great communication and the cottage was in a fantastic location and had everything we needed.

This accommodation has a great location. You don’t need your car whilst head as you can walk most places. The house itself has been newly renovated and is very stylish and clean. You won’t be disappointed when staying hear.

Very nice little place, very comfortable for the 5 of us. Beds excellent.super handy to South Melbourne, good coffee across road.  Tram runs past on bend and tracks very noisy, didn't bother us but some would find this like torture.
Brilliantly situated and sparkling clean. Comfy beds, all the mod cons and plenty of space. Easy communication with Charlotte should you need. A great local at the Water Rat Hotel.

This is a great place in a great location, a tram to the CBD almost at the front door and easy walk to cafes / restaurants and South Melbourne Market.  Great nearby parks and safe for kids too (as long as they're safe with the stairs).

The location of this unit was great! The beds were comfortable as well. The house was nicely decorated and it has most of the things we needed, but a bit cold for the duration of our stay, perhaps the thermostat wasn't working properly. I contacted the host about it and was hoping to get a space heater or sort, that would have been fantastic... But otherwise, it was a lovely stay!
An incredible home for a few nights stay in Melbourne. The beds were the most comfortable of any hotel or Airbnb that I have ever stayed in. Highly recommend.

We are very lucky to have found Charlotte's place to prepare for our wedding. It's exactly as described. Beautiful, peaceful and functional spaces. Lots of individual spaces and bathrooms. Cleanliness of the front yard and back can be better. Lounge area lacks natural light. But overall we are very glad and happy to have stayed!

A great experience and everyone thoroughly enjoyed their stay. Great place to relax as needed in between activities.
Thank you Charlotte
Enjoyable stay! Charlotte’s house is in a great location and a short tram ride to city and Southbank. Very well maintained and comfortable terrace home!

My family (husband and teenage daughters) and I stayed for 7 days. Lovely and clean and with all the amenities you need for your stay! We particularly loved the coffee machine, the heating and the wonderful showers.
The beds were amazingly comfortable also - some mornings we didn’t want to get out of them! A great experience.

Absolutely amazing city views!
Very clean and everything was great. Easy to follow check in information.
Could not fault Antony or his fabulous place.

The apartment was clean and tidy and Antony responded promptly to all messages and phone calls.
I strongly recommend advising Antony in advance (at least half hour) what time you are checking in and out so you are not delayed. I had to wait for a staff member to arrive when I checked in and out so was held up on both occasions. Apart from this, highly recommend this apartment. Great location, close to Vic market and fabulous view from 75th floor.

We really enjoyed our christmas at Stay Casa. Antony was a good host. The views are amazing. It is a beautiful apartment. Unfortunately the air conditioning wasn't working while we were there. This was the fault of the building and out of Antony's control. He took $50 off our bill and promptly went out and bought 5 tower fans to cool us down. The weather wasn't too hot so it was not a huge inconvenience.

We had a perfect 5 day stay with our friends from qld there was 10 of us we loved the amazing views!!!! Awesome function rooms to book out, quick responses always, a perfect fit for the 10 of us we had plenty of fun and just overall a spectacular accommodation, Antony is a great host.
Great spot to stay in Melbourne. Anthony is a great host. His communication was excellent. The place worked very well for 5 of us. Great having gym and pool at end of a hot day

Very nice place to stay. It located on the good location of Melboure, just cross the street to Victoria Market and still in the Free Tram Zone which is very convenient. Host comes with an excellent hospitality, quick reply and professional. Highly recommend to stay!!

Amazing view from apartment as it is located on the top of building. The apartment is clean and same as photos. Antony is a friendly and helpful host, our requests were replied immediately. Highly recommended if you are looking for a place for 6 people.
Great place to stay in - right in the middle of the city. And the host was amazing. Clear communication. And set up the place exactly how he told us he would. 5/5!

The views are breath taking and the apartment is very clean and stylish! The host was excellent at communicating, accommodating to small changes last minute and personally checked-us in and showed us how to use the complimentary parking system. I would definitely stay here again.

Thank you for an amazing stay. Your home is amazing. The views are absolutely incredible. The apartment is very clean and modern. It had everything we needed. The host is very quick respond to everything we asked and any help we needed was dealt with straight away. The home is everything we thought and more. It was Family friendly and even had a balcony where as parents we could spend some quiet time whilst the kids watched a movie in the evening. I have to say the lighting in the bathroom is so great for make up!! We had a fantastic time and loved the apartment. I wouldn't miss the opportunity to go back here!
Rebekah and Family

Fantastic apartment, very clean and spacious. With amazing views it was a great place to relax with a few friends. Its in walking distance to everything you will need and the hosts communication was very good, excellent value for money.

Stay Casa was amazing - views and more views. The place was sparkling clean, super stylish and had everything we needed. Communication with the host was outstanding.
Oh and did I say amazing views!!
The apartment is clean and modern. Amazing amazing location, very convenient! If you're looking for a nice apartment in the heart of CBD close to cafes, city, grocery etc - would recommend.
Fabulous experience staying with Antony. Worked with me to assist with early check in when needed. Fabulous communication. Would recommend

Stay Casa was fantastic. The view of Melbourne is spectacular. Position of the apartment was excellent- close to beautiful laneways, restaurants, attractions and shopping.  Apartment had everything we needed.Communication was excellent. Highly recommend.

Loved our stay at this Airbnb.
Loved the location and incredible views from 75th Floor.

Antony was a very responsive host. His replies to our questions was almost immediate - he must have his phone glued to his hands!
The apartment was as described and ideal for our 6 night stay. The rooms were cosy, but large enough with perhaps only the en-suite being on the slightly too small side.
The area was close to all of the main parts of town and Uber's had a convenient pick up spot 10m walk from the front door.

We were five adults,staying for one night.
Apartment was in great location.
Host was extremely helpful.
We had a car so host was really helpful re getting inside and parking
Two of the bedrooms were small with no bedside locker,but did have hanging space.
It was perfect size for 5people,didn’t see an iron or a hairdryer.
Kitchen equipment was not exhaustive,but with so many great bars and restaurants locally this is not really a big issue
Amazing view on the 75th floor. Apartment was clean, amenities were great! Located just <5mins walk to Queen Victoria Market, extremely convenient.
Host  was very responsive and prompt. Very accomodating and a great location. Can walk to most things around the city which is very convenient.

Place was in an awesome spot. Everything was super clean and the host was very responsive and even let us have a late check out which was much appreciated. Check in was easy and instructions were clear. We had 9 people which made it a tight fit but wasn’t really an issue as we didn’t spend much time there. Views were spectacular. If I was to be super critical, there was an iron but no ironing board and the showers were a bit disappointing. Overall very satisfied and would definitely stay here again.
Great place with great views, owner responded quickly and was helpful, also got a late check out which was great!
Great apartment to stay in! Heaps of restaurants just around the place. Very responsive and nice hosts!
The location is perfect, we can walk and use the free tram to all places we want to go. The communication is very good, the host kindly help us to throw the broken suitcase.
The location is perfect and the host is friendly. Very easy to locate the apartment. Just too pricey for us.

Wonderful, quiet, clean and attractive living space. Amazing access to everything you'll ever need - and only a short walk to the city proper! With a coffee shop, multiple supermarkets and bottle shops near by, easy walking access to everything you ever need, a flawless self check in, I couldn't recommend this place any more!

The apartment is even more attractive than the photos show.
Siobhan has thought of everything to ensure your stay is special.
The apartment is in a brilliant location with Pubs, restaurants , public transport and all amenities within a short walk.
The apartment had a really homely feel with everything you need included.
Would highly recommend a stay here.
Thanks Siobhan!

Great location, great host! A one minute walk to a supermarket, bottleshop, market, chemist, coffee, breakfast, pub! A ten minute stroll to the casino and niche shopping spots or 10 minutes drive to the CBD. The place is small, though this is not an issue for two people. It is very homely and private, and the building is secure. My mum and I loved staying here!

A lovely, clean apartment very close to South Melbourne Market and an easy walk into the centre of the city. Siobhan was very helpful and responsive and gave lots of recommendations. A great coffee shop underneath the apartment.
Lovely place in the heart of South Melbourne. We enjoyed our stay at Siobhan’s apartment.

We had a comfy and fun stay… The beds were so comfortable, and the special touches made it a lovely place to stay! Check in was very easy. We were so happy there was accessibility for a person with mobility constraints, and so great we could bring our family dog. The location is fantastic, being so close to everything, and so close to the city. We would highly recommend this property, and hope to be back again! Siobhan was easily contactable,  and very helpful 🤗

My husband, 6yo son, small dog and myself stayed at Siobhan’s place for a week before our recent interstate move.
The apartment is cute and cosy with everything you could need included. The beds were incredibly comfortable and the apartment was so quiet which meant for amazing sleeps for everyone. The location is super handy to all the local amenities, and we really felt at home.
I could have easily stayed longer and probably will when we’re back in Melbourne for holidays.
Siobhan was a great host. We really didn’t need her for anything during our stay as we are locals, but whenever I did have a question she was always quick to respond.
Siobhan is the perfect host. Quick response time and her apartment was in the perfect location and very appropriate for your dog. Would recommend!!

This apartment is in a great location in easy walking distance to everything in the CBD and South Melbourne. It’s comfortable and generously set up. Siobhan replied straight away to any questions. I highly recommend this apartment and will come back next time I travel to Melbourne
Our stay at Siobhan’s South Melbourne apartment was like a home away from home.  Spotlessly clean, warm, cosy and close to everything we wanted to see.  We look forward to  staying again.

The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Location was in a very convenient  location for what we needed. Very quiet at night which is always a plus for us. The host was available for any information and assistance. Close to shops and restaurants. A very pleasant stay.
Brilliant location, apt was very clean, easy walking into CBD and we would stay here again if visiting Melbourne

Siobahn and Danny were fantastic hosts... prompt communication, provided plenty of suggestions for things to do and places to visit, and even provided a couple of myki cards for guests to use to help get around.
The location is fantastic close to South Bank, the South Melbourne Market, and has plenty of options for dining, shopping and cafes within walking distance.
The apartment is quiet and comfortable, well appointed, and access to the courtyard is a bonus.
As stated in the listing, car parking is on the street and paid parking from 8am to 6pm which can become expensive (though parking in general in Melbourne is exorbitant). However, parking is free outside of the stated hours and there is apparently other free parking in the area.
A great apartment for a couple or small family.

Siobhan’s place was clean and comfortable. We had wet weather so weren’t able to use the outdoor area but it looked really nice and would be great in warm weather. The beds were really comfortable and the apartment had everything that you need. Good location, lots of good places to eat out and cute little café downstairs.

We stayed at Siobhan’s apartment over the F1 weekend & it was perfect. Location  made it easy to walk to the track & go to the city or casino at night. Lovely, cosy apartment, was perfect for our needs.

This apartment is in a top location with Aldi, Woolworths and the excellent South Melbourne markets an easy stroll. Trams run a short walk away, up and down Clarendon St. The South Wharf DFO and the Convention Centre are a 15 minute walk .
Siobhan was a responsive and very helpful host.

I was in town to watch the Australian open and Suzi’s location was very convenient to get to the venue. Suzi was very responsive prior to checkin and was very friendly when I met her in person. The apartment has great natural light and is a great space. Would definitely recommend

Very happy with my stay! Suz is so friendly and easy to chat with, she made me feel very comfortable in her home, it has everything you need and the room was cosy. Location was good walking distance from tram stations and not far from Albert park.  Loved the stay would definitely book again!!

A lovely and bright apartment in a quiet yet central location. I felt right at home and Suz was a wonderful host. Would highly recommend to any other solo female travellers looking for a cosy place to stay in Melbourne.

Thank you so much for your amazing hospitality, you both went above an beyond to make our stay enjoyable and relaxing. Everything in the one place, very clean and yummy food, Myself and my little family will definitely stay again. 😊😁

This accommodation is a very comfortable, detached 2 bedroom granny flat. The kitchen is fully equipped so you can cook your own meals. The living room is large and airconditioned, although there is no TV, and the bathroom and toilet are separate. A washing machine is also available. The bedrooms each have fans in them and the beds are comfortable. Mahbub is a very gracious host who provided us with a welcome drink and snacks and a farewell dinner. He also provided us with some basics for the kitchen – bread, butter, jam, milk, honey and other items.

This was our first trip to Melbourne and this space was exactly what we needed. Our host was exceptionally thoughtful and helpful.
Highly recommend.

Mahbub’s place is the perfect size and location for our stay in Melton. The grocery items were a great touch and everything we needed for our stay was provided. Looking forward to coming back and resuming the second part of our stay.
Lovely host.  Communication excellent.  Even bought over some food he had cooked for his family, which was lovely.
Great place. Great host. Communicative.  Reliable. Thank you. Love to stay here again. Thanks for the Easter eggs for my children. Paul

Mahbub, being a super host, took care of us really well. He made sure everything was  tidy up so we can have a good holiday. He was very supportive too. I would definitely recommend someone planning to live in Melton this place.

Exactly as it presents the place is very warm and comfortable, big kitchen and lounge.
Mahbub and his family greeted us with food and snacks, even during the middle of the stay. Lovely family and lovely place
Mahbub is very hospitable, responding to communications and even helps us getting breakfast groceries as we arrived late! Much appreciated and feeling very at home.
The owner is a very honest and honorable man who aims to treat his guests best. He provided us with dinner and soft drinks the first night of our arrival and accommodated all our requests.

I’ve stayed at Mahbub’s residence on 3 separate occasions. I’ve always been comfortable within my designated area at the back of the property. I look forward to staying when I’m next in town for work in the region

Great host, very attentive and friendly.
Granny Flat/Unit was behind main residence and was Private, Quiet, Safe. Very clean, provides Tea coffee milk and few other foods in freezer, condiments etc.
Had all we needed.

Mahbub was a very friendly and helpful host. The place was clean, comfortable, and perfectly suited to our needs. He was proactive and readily available whenever we needed assistance. To our surprise and delight, he even welcomed us with pizza — a thoughtful gesture that went far beyond our expectations!

Great 2 bedroom bungalow behind the main house in a quiet location. Easy to get to restaurants and shopping nearby. Mahbub is very friendly, helpful, a great host. Extremely clean property, makes for a great stay.
This accommodation was amazing and Candida was the perfect host. Perfect location, includes parking and walking distance from everything you need. We will definitely be back. Thanks Candida
Such a lovely home with an amazing roof top with amazing view, high end home with all facilities and everything you could think of!!

Candida is a lovely host. The property has everything you need and has a fantastic outdoor area overlooking the Yarra and the city. We would definitely look to stay at Candida’s place when returning to Melbourne.
Alex and Cassie are great hosts, I have always felt welcome and comfortable.  Happy to stay again in future!

If you’re looking for a home away from home this is the ideal place. The place exceeded our expectations & there were no faults with our stay. Fridge is basically full on arrival and all the amenities are at your disposal. Lovely patio and garden area to enjoy. There’s a welcome booklet with all the information you need & Anne lent us her Myki cards to use during our stay - about a 40 minute tram into the city but it’s a great ride with a few stops worth seeing on the way. Amazing value considering how great this place was! Thank you Anne for a perfect stay in Melbourne :)

Lovely quiet place near bushland. It doesn’t feel or sound like the middle of a big city. Public transport a bit painful on the weekends but great in all other ways. Anne very easy to communicate with. She makes access to house easy. I enjoyed my stay.

I loved my stay at Anne’s place - the apartment is beautiful and looks over her veggie garden, which she generously lets guests use herbs from. The neighbourhood is lovely, quiet and safe to walk around at night. Anne also goes above and beyond to make your stay comfortable - she provides a pantry of basic cooking supplies as well as delicious ingredients in the fridge for breakfast. Likewise, the bathroom is stocked with toiletries and basic medications and the bookshelf is full of interesting reads. A final bonus - great water pressure! When I next go to Melbourne I hope to stay here again :))

Anne’s place is just lovely.The studio is well set up and homey while the garden warms your heart.Lovely space to sit and relax.Anne also has the kitchen and the fridge well equipped.Would highly recommend.

A beautiful little oasis. Anne has left really thoughtful touches that makes your stay really comfortable. I would have been really happy to have stayed for a much longer time. Fantastic garden setting. Really recommend this place

Anne’s air bnb is really nice, spacious, comfortable bed, great amenities and a wonderful garden, Anne and her dog are very welcoming, would highly recommend Anne’s bnb to anyone looking for a relaxing stay!

Anne's place is surrounded by a wonderful Australian native garden and offers
all the comforts of home.
Relax and unwind in this peaceful environment and be inspired by the beauty.

Good cosy space in a good location and really good value for money. There were quite a few cob webs among other issues with cleanliness. But definitely amenable with a good spring clean. Loved the very friendly dog. The linen and bed were very comfortable. Added provisions were a bonus. Great communication with the host.
A beautiful place with peaceful surroundings outside.  I swear I could hear a stream in the bush behind the property.  I would certainly stay there again
I have stayed at this place twice and intend to stay again.  Everything is thoughtfully set up and the gardens out the back provide refreshment after a corporate trip.

A lovely little room is a beautiful, tranquil setting that we chose to stay in to be close to our family. Anne's communication was excellent and she added so many little thoughtful touches such as chocolates , fresh eggs, bread, butter, jam, milk etc..
Separate entrance via the side of the house with pin code entry. I'm not sure if it was pre-arranged but there was always a vacant parking spot on the street right out front. It was cold and rainy when we visited so we were not able to appreciate the garden or the outdoor seating area but heating worked well to keep us warm.
My only disappointment was listing stated washing machine and dryer (in building), however only option was for Anne to do our laundry for us.. .ended up not being an issue as we did it at our family's.

My partner and I had a tremendous stay in this cosy and homely bnb. there was everything we needed and more provided. the garden was immaculate and so full of beauty and charm. inside was so rustic and gorgeous.  just sad we missed out on making a fire outdoors this time because we ran out of time!
Such a beautiful and peaceful place! The bed is super comfortable. Great location close to everything but also I felt like I was in the country! Will definitely be back.

Location was so very peaceful, with the creek, walk tracks and so many birds, hard to comprehend that we were in a busy city suburb . Comfortable accommodation with many extras. We slept very well as it was so quiet and also dark. Definitely a sanctuary.

amazing, cozy place, perect for 2. The creek was a beautiful walk. and breakfast was lovely to have ready to cook as we had a late check in and a long day of travelling. The garden was the most beautiful I have seen in a while... I highly recommend this little place !

As always I loved my stay at Anne’s very special place.
Very homely and I appreciate the lovely snacks provided.
Thanks Anne.
Not my first visit - the place is perfect with lots of nice, thoughtful touches.  I particularly appreciate the breakfast provisions which save a trip to the shop if you're busy.

While close enough to enjoy all Melbourne has to offer Anne’s place was the perfect retreat at the end of each day.
Quiet, clean, cosy and comfortable - with everything you could possibly need (even a spare Myki card - THANK YOU!).

This place has real character, something that’s getting harder to find in a world of cookie-cutter, soulless rentals. The retro charm, the lush backyard that feels like a wild forest retreat, and the warm, personal touches all made it an excellent stay.
The bed and pillows were very comfortable, and while sound carries a little through the house (it’s an older home), I found it peaceful and still very private overall.
Olive the dog is friendly, sweet, and part of what makes the place feel so welcoming.
Anne is a very communicative host. And her location is perfect for me when I'm in Melbourne environs.

A lovely homely space in beautiful bush surroundings. Anne’s garden is gorgeous and right next to local bush land and creek, which attracts so many birds.
Very cosy and comfortable with an incredibly well stocked kitchen and bathroom with all needs anticipated. Lovely bread, eggs, jam and butter as well as pantry supplies enough to make a meal.
Anne was very responsive and helpful and has restored my faith in Airbnb by providing a welcoming, homey place.

ABSOLUTELY AMAZING.... can’t believe how clean  it was, the communication was absolutely amazing and it’s exactly what it is meant to be :) couldn’t have had a better stay ! The Onwer is so flexible with check in and was so lovely. Will be booking this place again for next time I stay !

great location short walk to most places and the free city circle tram stop is just outside the door. The inclusion of secure underground parking is a real bonus.
Edmond is a great host, very obliging and friendly. The provision of breakfast supplies was a welcomed surprise. Can be a little noisy at night due to road traffic but otherwise very comfortable. would recommend

Wonderful location (so close to the Queen Vic Markets!), clean & tidy place, Edmund & Farzaneh were very communicative, loved having parking in the CBD. Wasn’t affected by any noise outside as some other people have observed. Highly recommend.
Very stylish, bright and central apartment with thoughtful touches, close to transport, shops, cafes and restaurants. Short walk to Chinatown and CBD.
Such a nice loft, very cozy and very convenient in terms of traffic. Easy to check in.

You will love this loft. Perfect location with tram at your door. Great extras provided and the bed is like sleeping on a cloud. Hosts were amazing, great response to questions and very fast. We will be back.

Edmund and Farzaneh's modern Art Deco apartment had a blend of vintage charm and modern amenities, which made the stay memorable.
The location was another highlight—situated in the heart of Melbourne, it was conveniently close to great cafes, restaurants, and public transport.
Highly recommended for a stylish and comfortable stay in the heart of the city.

We really enjoyed staying in Ren Han's apartment. This is great location with amazing views and very useful. It is stylish and immaculately clean with a great bathroom and all the amenities you might need. 5 star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Great location and amazing view! Only problem we had was that the dryer didn’t work and we were stuck with wet towels. We communicated the problem though and new ones were brought over. Thank you!
My experience is good. Host replies quickly and is accommodating. Location is great for shopping trips. View is wonderful.
Fantastic location, very spacious and clean apartment. Great communication and directions prior to stay. Will definitely re book!
The unit is spacious and is a perfect location to explore Melbourne city on foot. There are countless places to eat and shop close by.

A very nice apartment complex with a very nice view of Melbourne city, in which the location was very close to everything. Good communication between the hosts and great value for money in terms of location, amenities and view.

A great priced and even better located apartment. Central to everything and easy to find. The apartment has great views, especially of the early morning hot air balloons across the city skyline.
I recommend this for couples, small groups or families.
Beautiful place with a stunning view of the city great location and the check in process was made so simple by ren

Though the hosts and location were wonderful, the cleanliness was subpar and the amenities seemed to be lacking. We had to buy our own coffee and extra blankets - tho there was an air conditioning/heater unit. The lights weren’t bright either so bad to rely heavily on natural sunlight which is fine, the bathroom was also not ideal. Other than that, location was A1, and the basics were there so if you’re not super fussed and you require simple needs, this would be good.

Super friendly and helpful hosts to begin with. Prompt response & the accommodation’s location and view is amazing. Had a really comfortable 10-days stay here and I’d totally recommend to anyone who is looking for somewhere that feels cozy and homey!

It has been a very nice and comfortable experience. The apartment truly lived up to our expectations. We were given clear insructions as to the rules and how to spend the time in Melbourne from what they've recommended us. It was very convenient to get around places from the apartment as well, and overall has been a perfect stay.
Good location for shopping, surrounded by shopping malls, Victoria Market, and some CBD tourist attractions within 10 minutes walk.
The location is great as it is in the CBD, but it was a bit noisy and dusty. Owner was very responsive. Overall rating is still recommended.

Had a great experience at Ren Han’s listing. His attention to detail was impeccable. The living space had a very cozy ambiance. Kitchen was well-equipped with everything we needed. The bedroom had plush bedding and a stunning view from window. Location wise, this listing was perfect, situated in the heart of Melbourne CBD.
Thank you, Ren Han and Melissa for an unforgettable stay!
Very happy with our stay! The place was perfect, very clean and exactly like it is described. Awesome location that makes getting around Melbourne very easy
Excellent venue and host, happy to recommend. Only problem we had was the aircon isn't exactly cool on hot days.

excellent location, walking distance to lots of food and transportation options. also because of the central location, it can be a little noisy at night, so just a heads-up before booking the place. tip: if there are more than 2 of you, take a taxi rather than the Skybus. the rooms are airy and bright, great view of the city. washing machine, dryer and dishwasher all work well. just a note that the shower situation is a high sided bathtub, may not be suitable for persons who are fall risks.

Dora is a generous and friendly host with wealth of local knowledge that she is happy to share. The loft is stylish, peaceful and located it a vibrant area with public transport   links to major venues such as Rod Laver. The little touches were appreciated. As was the option to bring our small dog if required. We had a really lovely break complete with that rare feeling you had glimpsed the culture/heart of a place in spite of a short stay. Thanks Dora.

Wow what a perfect spot to explore Melbourne. Firstly we were met by Dora who is so lovely and gave us some great local tips. The loft is beautiful and Dora has the nicest little touches around the loft including some amazing natural body products in the bathroom. The bed in super comfortable. You could not get a better location. Thank you for a perfect stay in Richmond Dora.
We will definitely be back.

Dora, and Dora’s Place, is amazing.
I stayed for two weeks and didn’t want to leave. Great location, great nearby coffee, great city. The loft is as gorgeous as the photos made it. And Dora was the ultimate host - helpful, with really good tips and really kind welcoming.
If you have a chance to stay here, you should. It’s amazing.

Thanks to Dora whom was a super host at ensuring we knew the easiest ways to & around the city. Let us come in early after taking the red eye from Perth. Very well thought out and many ammenities to make our stay home away from home. Also a massive shoutout to the design and interior decorating.
Doras place was incredible! A beautiful place in an incredible location. Dora personally met us and took us to the loft! Such an amazing trip.

Fabulous place in a great location. The loft is a quirky, homely space and is beautifully clean. It is in the heart of Richmond with trams into the city, cafes and shops a mere stones throw away, yet it is very quiet. There is a lovely communal courtyard, perfect place to sit and read.
Dora was very welcoming and helpful, giving us a quick tour of the area on arrival. Thank you for your hospitality Dora.

Dora's loft is an excellent place for those that are looking for something other than a regular hotel room. Great vibes, and great location. Tram stop right outside, food all around, and permit parking available. Dora was also very accommodating providing tips for our stay, hooking us up with local businesses, and many of our requests that did not need to be met. I'd definitely recommend anyone staying in Melbourne to check out Dora's place and we definitely will be coming back!

Really unique loft space in a converted factory with detailed introduction by host who had great local knowledge. Loved the local area, a plethora of cafes, bars, restaurants and great transport links around Melbourne.

Dora was a wonderful host, great at communicating and so helpful. The place was beautiful and full of light and plants - really cosy and comfortable. The location was fantastic full of great cafes and eclectic little shops. Really highly recommended!
Dora was so pleasant to deal with. The plants in the loft were so so nice made the place feel so cozy. Beautiful spot!! And close to everything.

unique, calming and welcoming space, loved the plants and natural light. Was also able to bring our little dog who also had a great time. Dora was incredibly welcoming and was able to show us the house and area at check-in. would stay again
Fantastic space in a great location. We truly felt on holiday in this little loft paradise. Easy walk to Richmond, Melbourne CBD and more. We will definitely be back!
Dora was fantastic! Everything was easy, the loft smelt very nice and was very clean. Very clever space with everything you could want! Highly recommend. Thanks Dora!
V comfortable. Stairs wouldbe trickyif you had a dicky leg!. Great location. Dora always available to help out
An amazing little retreat with an earthly, cosy feel! we felt like we were home away from home. Dora was an amazing host — friendly and very helpful! 🙂

Dora's loft is everything a person/couple would need for a nice getaway to Melbourne. The design including art and plants were the highlight of the place.The wifi and Google Chrome cast was very easy to use. And the area was great, especially after reading Dora's guidebook.
Would easily recommend to others.

Dora’s communication was phenomenal and her warm greeting upon arrival was an extra touch. The loft was true to its photos - very aesthetic and filled with beautiful plants and art pieces. The place was also surprisingly quiet for a Saturday night so we all slept well! Perfect location and very cool spot in Richmond. You won’t be disappointed w Dora’s loft.
Dora is such a great host and the loft is very neat, clean and beautifully decorated. Great location being so close to Melbourne city and the cafe/bars in Richmond.

Dora provides an easy, happy check in experience and lovely warm space in Melbourne.
Location was great and easy to get into the CBD

Everything was lovely and super clean. Dora was a lovely host and gave us some great ideas for our stay.
The house is amazing and area was really good as well.

Dora’s place was absolutely beautiful, it looked exactly like the photos and was in a great location! Dora was so responsive and helpful, from check-in to local recommendations. Would definitely come back and visit ☺️

Such an amazing stay at an inspiring and relaxed location. Thank you for your amazing hospitality. Our flights were changed 3 times and Dora was nothing short of accommodating despite all of our hiccups at the airport. The home was beautiful and such a well designed layout for a smaller unit. The location doesn’t feel like it’s lacking anything at all and is such an inviting space that anyone from any town could fly in and feel right at home. Couldn’t have any higher praises 🙌

Thanks Dora, very lovely loft , easy to access, supermarket is nearby, we enjoy the loft in Melbourne.
we will miss this place !

What a gem this find was.  Absolutely wonderful stay. Perfect location with restaurants and bars and Coles just a few minutes walk.  Gorgeous place with comfy bed, couch and so much space to spread out in a studio apartment. Love all the decore and so trendy and homely at the same time. Literally everything we could ask for and everything was on hand. One hundred perfect recommend this stay.
Thank you Dora for a lovely stay. It was such a beautiful space with so much greenery!!!

The perfect spot for our visit to Melbourne. Close to great restaurants, amenities and trams into town. Dora was a delightful host who welcomed us onto her home with warmth and generous information. The space was very peaceful & quiet given its proximity to the buzz of the Richmond area. Really comfy bed and all you could need to enjoy your stay. We would visit again and recommend to others.

It was lovely to stay at Dora’s beautiful apartment! The loft layout and the plants make it so unique and fun. Dora was really friendly and generous. Looking forward to coming back at some time in the future!

Really loved staying at Dora's place. It was very convenient, she met us on arrival to show us around and explain the entrance, the key system and all to do with the loft. The personal touches and meeting us was great. Such a terrific location, staying right near our son's residence. Walked everywhere, easy access to trams and CBD. Will be back soon.
Thank you Dora

Dora’s place was lovely, tidy and clean.
It was very easy to get around as the tram stopped just a couple blocks away.
Dora went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed and was very flexible with the check-in and check out times.
Thank you once again!

Dora's place was great! Even though your staying in her home you dont feel as though your in someones personal space.
Dora was lovely and very helpful and all her art is beautiful. I'd def recommend to friends+family!
Dora was such a lovely host and the place was perfect, even better than the pictures. Great location in Richmond, really contributed to us having a great weekend in Richmond. Thanks so much!!!
Dora is such a lovely and helpful host. We had a great stay at the loft. The location was easy and transport was accessible. Both the loft itself and the courtyard were so nice. Highly recommend!
Great location. Easy to get to the city centre. Host was helpful with any issues. Kitchen was well kept and breakfast and foods were readily available for us in the morning to be cooked ourselves.

Melanie is a lovely host. She did a fantastic job on preparing the house. House is shinning clean, tidy and comfortable to stay.
We had a group of 14 adults, and Melanie even kind enough to prepare some basic breakfast for us. We couldn't ask for anything more. Very lovely. We would highly recommend this awesome place for big groups.
The house is great, even better backyard and pool area in person. Perfect for our stay, would recommend!
Melanie was a great host, no problems encountered during our stay! Was super close to everything as well

Marie was very helpful in guiding me throughout the checkin process as well as any other queries I had. A very friendly host and it was great to be able to meet you in person before we checked out! A very easy going, friendly host. Thank you so much for everything!

Very Responsive owners! Personal and quick response to our queries on bbq and heater etc.
House was very big, nice and had everything we needed for our 5 nights stay. Especially we had young ones within my family. I will certainly stay back to Melanie’s home when I’m back at Glenn Iris. Thanks so much!!! We enjoyed our stay! :)
Large comfortable well appointed home located close to tram train and shops and motorway. Great heating system.

Melanie and Marie were very responsive to our messages, the house was neat and tidy, besides a few little bits left behind from previous tenants. Pool was excellent, and the amenities were fabulous. Perfect location for catching public transport as the tram stop was 1 minute away, and train stop was about 5 minutes away. They were quick to fix a slight issue in the beginning and were very apologetic. We would stay again!
Zoltan and Beata both are great host. My daughter and I both enjoyed the stay. The place is nice and clean and tidy. Good location too. Absolutely recommend :)
Perfect little cottage in the quaint town of Seville. Shaun’s place has everything you need for a great stay in the Yarra Valley. Great location and styled really nicely. Highly recommend.

We really enjoyed our stay here, very cute cottage in a lovely setting. Was sparkling clean and they had even set up the fire for us. Shaun was also very helpful with information on activities around the area

My stay at Shaun’s was so comfortable and he was so thoroughly helpful when I had to alter my booking more than once. The house was gorgeous, clean and to have the fire lit and a warm house on arrival was a delight. Can’t recommend Shaun more highly as a host.

Shaun really is a Superhost. His communication was prompt, informative and knowledgeable. We left thinking he couldn’t have been nicer. This cottage is sweet and very clean. My family and I loved the couple of days spent in the house as well as the views, exploring local wines and trail walks. The valley has amazing views throughout! With the shops and petrol station just down the road, everything you need is either a short walk or drive away. As we stayed at the end of winter, we most enjoyed the wood fire. We highly recommend starying here.

Great host, very attentive and thoughtful. Great airbnb - the place is easy to find and the checkin and checkout processes are super easy. It's close to the local supermarket and many wineries. The fireplace is a great touch and was a great experience.

Shaun was a fantastic and attentive host.  The property was in a fantastic central location. Was presented 5 star. He supplied everything and anything you would need for your stay. 5/5 stars

Would definitely recommend and we look forward to coming back one day! :)
We loved our stay! Beautiful cottage, very well stocked, very clean. We’d definitely stay here again.

Highly recommend.

The cottage is really lovely - clean, plenty of space, well equipped and close to walking/riding tracks. There was plenty of room for my two dogs as well. Shaun communicated promptly and was always friendly. Highly recommend. We loved our stay.
Easy check in and place was clean and well located within the Yarra Valley, ie short drives to places. Clean and well equiped place. Enjoyable stay.

This is the seventh time we have stayed at Shaun’s Cottage. Shaun has always been a fabulous host and on this particular occasion our visit was due to the passing of a family member and Shaun was extremely flexible with us as we needed to change our booking at the last minute and he even went as far as to offer condolences and leave beautiful flowers for us. Above and beyond as a host so thank you Shaun.

A great Airbnb, central to the Yarra Valley and Ranges and beautiful highland towns. Shaun was an outstanding and proactive communicator - everything we could wish for was provided. Thank you Shaun for opening your space to us. We really appreciated the fire, garden and outdoor seating area especially being city dwellers!

Really loved staying here.  The home is gorgeous and well maintained, with beautiful trees surrounding it. Wish we had spent more time relaxing at the home. Would definitely stay again!

Zoe & Danny’s place is delightful. The open fireplace, leather couches, lovely linen, open plan kitchen made for a fantastic home. The cottage was tucked away from the towns so it felt extra cosy.
My sister and I highly recommend this place for a wine & nature getaway
Cosy and rustic cottage that is comfortable and in a great location. I fun getaway - love the open fire!

Zoe and Danny’s place Tuena was fantastic.

We had a fantastic stay at Zoe and Danny's place! A beautiful home that felt warm, cozy and inviting. The gardens were spectacular and we loved taking in nature and listening to the birds from the deck.

Amazing place in such a beautiful location. Will definitely come back and recommend highly. All the extra touches were beautiful quality and we really appreciated the beautiful space. Thanks for having us.

Zoe & Dannys cottage is the Perfect getaway to relax in the middle of the nature. The house is really big and it’s offering everything you need. Zoe left us some little treats and the coffee machine is really nice.

Zoe and Dan's place is so beautiful - perfect location, great fireplace and really comfortable beds. We had such a great time, and their communication and flexibility made it so much better.
We'd highly recommend Zoe and Dan's place to anyone!

A gorgeous escape, so close to Melbourne. Such a serene part of the world with incredible views. The cottage is everything you could want, so cosy and visually pleasing. What a magic place! Beautiful rustic mud brick gem on a private block with such a peaceful easy vibe. Very comfy – beds, couches and all. Misty rainbow sunsets. Clouds rolling over the hills. Just magic. Zoe and Dan sorted out our post-lockdown blues, with their gorgeous cottage amidst a tranquil setting.The cosy fireplace by night, and fresh coffee enjoyed in the garden by morning, were exactly what the doctor ordered. This is the perfect location for a  weekend recharge!

We had a lovely stay at Zoe and Dan’s cottage. This is so well located. 20mins from everything Yarra Valley. Accommodation is just right for small group and view of the forest and connecting to nature is good for the soul

We had a lovely stay. The house is private with an outlook on to the hills beyond. Perfect for a couple of days out of town to read and relax.

We absolutely loved our stay here! The home has been decorated so beautifully and gives you such a feeling of warmth and home! It’s in a brilliant location, hidden in some very pretty and quiet streets. Cannot recommend this home more!

The house was exactly as advertised - spacious, clean and neat. It is well located - close to shops and transport. There was ample room for our two dogs. The kitchen is well appointed and the rooms are enormous.

This is a great family home in a lovely, peaceful green suburb.  The house is very comfortable and homely.  The area has lots of nice green spaces, with a big park less than 5 minute walk away.  It's a really quiet and friendly neighbourhood.  Would recommend, especially for long stays.  Out toddler slept so well in this house, it's great for families.
Spacious, stylish and clean home in a lovely family area. Hosts were wonderful. Would definitely recommend.
The house was perfect for a family of 5. It was very homely and provided an excellent location for us during our stay in Malvern

The whole house was very clean, very comfortable, offering relaxed easy living. The neighborhood is a self contained area of mainly pretty wooden houses. The railway is ten minutes walk away, the tram is about five and it's a twenty or so minute drive to the center of Melbourne but the train would be quicker and less hassle. Three really good restaurants within six or seven minutes plus a McDonalds.
All good!

I can just see a large family or a couple of families spending their holidays here, playing cricket in the huge backyard, after a day at the beach.  Room and space for everyone, including Fido.  Would highly recommend if you are looking for somewhere near the beach that can accommodate a large group.  Very close to Acland Street and other restaurants.  The tram to the city from Brighton Road, really convenient.  Communication is top notch; easy to check in and out.
Spacious old house. Lots of room and character. Easy walk to shops, transportation and the beach.

The apartment is clean, spacious and in a brilliant location. L’occitanne bathroom products were a nice touch. Well appointed with everything required.
Our two bedroom apartment however, backed on to the train line which is very close, the trains are frequent (which is convenient), but closed windows and air conditioning don’t block out the pedestrian gate alarm, the train and the trains horn.
Such a nice and tidy place, and walking distance to many places to eat and drink. Would definitely recommend and stay again for a night away

We stayed in a two bed two bath apartment, it was very spacious, great kitchen, comfy beds, big bathrooms. We went shopping on Church St, went to the beach. The underground parking was great. I would definitely stay again, great value for money- modern, large, great location

Great place to stay. I would stay again.
No response to my questions though.

Smart, sleek and perfect for a recreational or business stay. Located right opposite the Bay.Robert was a welcoming host at Quest apartments and looked after our needs . Liked the generous size of secure parking bays, comfy bed and compact kitchenette and clean mod fit out of apartments. Be aware you need to gain access via a side street not the main road address.  Close walking distance to great Church street shopping and restaurants . We have decided to return another time.
Great place, straight across from the beach & boardwalks. Room had everything you needed for an overnight stay
Great place to spend a few nights. It was peaceful and quiet, no issues, clean and tidy. Very friendly staff
The decoration of the apartment is nice and the place very modern. The location next to the beach is perfect. The carpet is a bit dirty but apart from this I would totally recommend.

We thoroughly enjoyed staying in this spacious and well-appointed apartment.
Being close to the beach meant we had access for walks and enjoying the environs.

The apartment is well appointed in a super fun neighbourhood, however I had to cut my stay short due to an overwhelming smell of cigarette smoke. It smelled like I was in a 70's Vegas hotel after a bender. Additionally, several details were missing and essential to a comfortable stay. The washer had run over soaking the carpeted floors, the windows were left open leaving mosquitos flying around, and none of the bedroom lamps had lightbulbs. If the host's can verify that the place has been deeply, professionally cleaned I could recommend it, but only then (and only maybe, depending on how sensitive you are.)
This is the second time we've stayed in this apartment, and it does not disappoint. So close to everything and a beautiful space!

Great location and pretty easy check in. Kitchen was dirty, messy cupboards, pretty gross looking pantry amenities, nothing in fridge, and toaster absolutely covered in crumbles. Bedrooms seemed fairly clean. Bathroom was okay, some stains. Building elevator and hallway had funny smell… good powerful air conditioner. Overall okay for a short stay if you just need somewhere to lay your head. Dont recommend for anything longer than a 3-4 days. Also didn’t respond our partial refund request when we had to change dates.
Only 1 key for 3 people was inconvienent. The pillows where old and need replacing,bath towels where thin. On the good side ,its in a good location.

Great long term stay here! We felt right at home , Justin and the team were always responsive and helpful! Location was great , short walk down to a high street full of restaurants, shops and cafes! Accommodation was comfortable, spacious and clean! Would definitely stay here again!
Had a lovely stay here! Very helpful staff and in a great location close to tram lines and cafes/restaurants. Would recommend staying here.

Perfect location in the free tram zone, easy to go anywhere and lots of shops around. Beautiful view from the common area and bedroom. The place is spotless, towels and shampoos are replaced everyday. The TV actually works. Will definitely come back
Not a bad spot. Just be aware that the photos might not reflect the room you end up staying in
Great place, amazing view and walking distance to anything in the CBD. Check in experience was extremely easy. Could not fault it, would book again :)

Conveniently located and in the free tram zone! Phoenix was very informative and extremely responsive to requests/queries. There is an option for secure parking also! Perfect for your trip to Melbourne without breaking the bank.

Location is excellent as it is very central and in close proximity to everything. Communication was prompt and effective. Unfortunately, there were dirty dishes in the dishwasher and the blanket had yellow stains. Towels were provided but there were no face towels which would have been a nice addition. The aircon vent was broken and would only point down making it difficult to warm up the room. The couch's armrest is broken and needs replacing/fixing.

Pretty smooth process.  Clean overall but if I had to nitpick - the gaps between the couch seats were not cleaned. I saw quite a bit of mosquitos on the ceiling but other than that, good experience overall.
Beautiful calm spot to take in the city, close to public transport and amenities and food (including lots of Asian supermarkets which was great!). Would stay again!
An amazing place to stay for the weekend with everything we needed, great location and an even better view! Would highly recommend this place to anyone!

Nick was a fantastic host making the check in experience easy and welcoming, check out was also very easy.
The view from the apartment was beautiful and the location was central to resturaunts, supermarkets and with DFO across the road and the best Asian grocery store inside the Coles complex this apartment is in a fantastic location.
The pool, gym and Sauna that can be accessed was fantastic.
Only improvements which is not negative feedback just room for improvement was the cleanliness of the apartment and the bed was very squeaky everytime my partner or I would move through the night we would be woken up.
Thankyou for a great weekend away Nick we appriciate you letting us stay in your apartment.
place was great exactly what we wanted except the bed and couch needs upgrading couch was like a rock and bed was so noisy and squeaking

Location was exceptional! Would definitely be back. The pool/gym/parking was a major factor for me, all pretty straight forward and safe. The apartment had an amazing View, quick Wifi and had a “ I am home “ type of feeling! Would 100% recommend them to anybody looking at staying around the CBD!

Great location and free parking.
Difficult to navigate from car park via multiple lift changes. Not ideal if you need to access your car often
Check in and check out should be made easier.
Awesome place with a super nice view! Harriet and Nick were solid with their service and always quick to respond whenever we had questions! Loved the space and we’ll definitely be coming back.

This apartment is in a fantastic location; the one issue we had was that the bed was quite difficult to sleep on and not as comfy as we would have liked; however, we really enjoyed our stay here and Nick was really helpful. Thank you so much for having us!
Wonderful apartment in the heart of Melbourne's CBD. Great check-in. will definitelystay again.
Good value and location. Close to free teams in town. Sofa bed was stained and there was an odd odor. However hosts were lovely and ammenities good
Fantastic location.. wonderful apartment with everything that was required. Nick was great with check in.. communication was spot on. Hopefully we will be back to stay again soon

Nice destination, nearby supermarket, tram and train station.
Very clear to introduce the house by Nick. He is very nice.

The place was very good but there was a few things we felt could be improved upon which was the person doing the meet and greet was ringing every 5 minutes to see where we were even though we said we would let him know when we were 15 minutes away. The couch and bed are dated and could do with replacement. The positives were that it was close to public transport and the space was functional for a 1br apartment. It had all facilities you would need. We enjoyed the view out over the Yarra river. The apartment was clean and tidy and even had wifi there. Close to coffee shops and cafes and restaraunts. Also close to tram stops to go to queen Victoria markets. And right across the road from the southern cross station. Public transport was a breeze. Would definitely stay here again

absolutely great value for money, views were stunning with floor to ceiling windows in the bedroom. Clean and modern with great sound isolation. Check-in was a bit tricky due to the central location but the hosts were very helpful in helping us out with instructions.

Fabulous location and good communication but the apartment is quite tired and needs a deep clean. The sofa is stained and broken, there is black mold in the bathroom, both the kitchen and bathroom floors were grimey and the dishwasher is broken however, the bedding and towels were clean! This place needs some TLC to bring it up to be better value for money and it wouldn't take much...
All great. Missed a bottle opener which would have been handy. Main bed was pretty uncomfortable but everything else was terrific.

We had a lovely stay here. Harriet and Nick were so responsive and accommodating to us. The location and view was so great and central. Amenities and the room itself was great. We will definitely be back!! Thank you

Martine’s place is great! Awesome location, very clean and comfortable, and Martine is a wonderful host! She makes sure you have everything you need and shares her veggies from her garden :) I highly recommend staying here!

Martine was an amazing host! She went above an beyond with her hospitality’s day was very bubbly and friendly! She made some lovely fresh bread and let’s you use her veggies! Would definitely recommend staying there if you are ever in Melbourne!

Absolutely beautiful, not only a homely and heartfelt stay,
but Martine is such warm company and felt like someone
I had known for years, we could have chatted for hours.
She made me feel very welcomed and at home, basically
felt like my own house and appreciate it so much, thank you.
Plus, she makes the most beautiful, soft sourdough bread
you will ever taste in your life.
Thank you again, for such a beautiful stay and experience.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Martine's place. She was humble, friendly and very welcoming. She's also a baker and was lucky enough to try her baguette. She was always up for a conversation and respected privacy as well. The place was very clean and tidy. The apartment is in a convenient location in Carlton Vic, a great spot to be out of the city, yet not too far away from visiting the area either and surrounding suburbs.

Martine’s place was amazing and so is Melbourne. Very special to have a place where as you walk you can hit up every cuisine imaginable. I wish I spent more time in Melbourne. Martine is also a gracious host who is personable and fun. Great place and host!
I recently moved to Melbourne and felt like this place was home away from home. Thank you for being super helpful and making me feel instantly settled into life in Melbourne.

Martine is a wonderful host, highly recommended! Her place is comfortable, clean, and quiet, and she's very friendly and welcoming. We had great chats, she gave me many local recommendations, and even shared her delicious homemade bread. The apartment is well located, near Fitzroy and easy to get into CBD (12 min on the tram), but still private and quiet at night. This is a truly great place for the solo traveler.

I wish my stay wasn't too short but Martine's place was so nice and cozy. It was spotless and comfortable. She was incredibly responsive and lovely to communicate with. Would love to stay here again when I am back in Melbourne!

I stayed only briefly to sleep at Martines. Her place was very clean and tidy and she was friendly and accomodating. I was however very cold in my room, there is no portable heater or vent in the room. Martine provided me with an extra blanket for sleeping and had turned the heating on in the house but I run very cold. The bed is not a regular sized bed in length, I am 5’3 and my feet partially hung off the end… I presume it would be a bit short for regular length people. The house rules include limiting showers to 4 minutes and I would have preferred a longer shower. Martine was friendly and helpful and the location was great for what I needed.

Martine is loving and caring person. She offer a lot good recommendations on food and places to go. This is my first time to Melbourne & travel alone, Martine make me feel like home and secured. I am so lucky that I am able to see her baking and taste the lovely bread. The place is very clean and I love her eco-friendly attitude. Highly recommended!

Martine’s place is in a great location with easy access to everything you need. Close to trams, shops and the Fitzroy and Carlton strips.
The place is very clean, with a large bathroom and the bedroom was comfortable. It is a very firm bed which I loved.
The walls and doors are quite thin. While Martine did everything to be quite quiet during my stay and it was fine for me as a solo traveller, couples may find this tricky. The apartment is close to everything but otherwise in a super quiet location which is rare for Melbourne!
The fresh bread was delicious and access to the apartment was easy. Thanks for having me.
Martine is very friendly, welcoming and helpful, communicates clearly and makes great sourdough, even for special occasions!

Martine is a fabulous host and I would surely book again on my next visit to Melbourne. Such a lovely atmosphere and the smell of fresh bread doesn’t hurt either! It’s like sharing a flat with an old friend. 😊👌
A nice and clean place to stay! Martine is a friendly host. Will visit back if come to Melbourne again!
Great affordable spot in a great part of the city. Martine is kind and easy to interact with. The sourdough bread is such a nice touch!
Martine was a brilliant host and her place was exactly what I needed after a huge journey from London. I can’t recommend her and her place enough if you’re stopping over in Melbourne for a few days.

Great place to stay - perfect location (15 mins to Melbourne Museum and, from there, a short stroll downtown), inviting flat with bright spacious bedroom, and very safe for solo traveller.  Marine is a lovely host - cheerful, chatty, and generous.  I would highly recommend this Airbnb.

Martine’s place was great. Easy access to tram to the city and walking distance to Fitzroy’s bars and restaurants. A perfect location. My host was very interested and informed about the local area and Melbourne. The apartment was very clean and comfortable with a nice relaxed feel.
Marty

I had a great stay at Martines place! The location was awesome, really close to the trams and buses for getting around Melbourne, and a short walk to the cool cafes and restaurants on Brunswick street.
The place itself was very clean and Martine was friendly and easy to get along with, and provided good tips for getting around or places to see, and she even baked delicious fresh sourdough!
Thanks again for a great stay!

Staying at Martine's place was a great experience. The apartment is in walking distance to many interesting places in Carlton and Fitzroy. It was spotlessly clean, located in a quiet area and had everything I needed. Unfortunately I missed out on meeting Martine personally but communication was very easy and helpful. You can tell she is a great and very friendly host. I will be back :)

My stay with Martine was absolutely fantastic. Her place was clean, cozy and super comfortable - I felt right at home. The location was also great, and walking distance to everything. I was lucky to get to meet Martine during my stay, she is really friendly and kind. She also treated me to her delicious homemade sourdough. Merci Martine, I hope to come back again soon!

Easy assessment to CBD with trams, okay neighborhood with local shops nearby. Room was clean - Host was away so use of kitchen was fine.
Overall an place to use for a day or two.
Great unit, easy to find, nice and clean and quiet. Martine very responsive and helpful. thanks 🙏

Martine was so warm and welcoming. Great suggestions for local eateries.
My bed was super comfy in a private room that met my needs on my work stay.

This time I stayed in Australia to get a license for work. I didn't have many opportunities to talk to my host, Ms. Martine, because we didn't have time to meet, but I was able to pass the exam and I'm very impressed with how good my stay was. I hope she will be my host again.
The room is quite large, has many closets and drawers. Feel comfortable with big couch and bed, also TV

This small unit is as pictured.  The lounge, kitchen and dining area are functional.  The bedrooms are very small, there is no shelving space for clothes so we just had to put them on the floor of the wardrobe.  The beds were very uncomfortable as the mattresses appeared very springy, saggy and cheap which led to many uncomfortable  nights.

Will definitely be staying here again. David was very helpful and responsive and the space was absolutely perfect. Beautiful inside and out with a gorgeous outdoor area that comfortably sat us spaciously.

Excellent flat with everything we needed. We were only two people in Melbourne for the weekend, but the flat could easily fit four. There was a lot of space and the kitchen is great. We felt very comfortable.
David is an excellent communicator and was always available for anything we needed.

We had a wonderful stay at David's apartment! The place was spotlessly clean, equipped with everything we needed and in a great location. David is an amazing host and really looks after his guests, especially with his communication :) Highly recommended!

David is a fantastic host.
He sent clear instructions for finding key & photos of the front of the building(this made it easier to find). Inside looked the same as the ad pictures, very clean & beds are comfy.
Location is perfect for going to the zoo, aquarium and DFO. Will definitely stay there again.

Great place
with a nice garden and outdoor area
lots of space
would stay again

We had a great time here, was very private and very close the shops. We loved the outdoor space and had good time in the sun out there. Also was super close to the city but just far enough out where it wasn't too busy.
Lovely, secure, comfortable apartment with a nice view over to the park.  Off street parking was much appreciated and communication with hosts was great.
