We also benefited from having fresh homemade bread 🍞, milk, juice and more! Totally happy and would recommend this place to anybody wanting to visit the Yarra Valley and Warburton.

Minimalist with all essentials. Very clean, great location. Located on 3rd floor with alley view. Can hear train, didn’t bother me much. Internet’s a bit slow but usable. All in all, good place to stay.

fantastic place to stay especially if staying on a budget. If looking to get around Melbourne, the Freetram zone is legit at your front door. To those saying "trains are loud", it's melbourne, you're gunna hear the trains if you stay in a hotel along Flinders ST...
It was really dirty apartment and you don't feel relax at all , paying minimum of 100 dollars per night expect so much better

Soap and shampoo provided  are small, complementary bottles so I recommend packing more if you are staying for a while. The heater is quite loud and the taps make a whining sound when water is being run. Location and check in process is very good though.

General cleanliness was not ideal. Very disappointed in this stay. Shower head was broken, aircon was leaking, fridge is broken, towels had stains on them, alarm went off in the middle of the night Friday night and did not stop for at least half an hour. Honestly want my money back.

Location and communication was great- the smell on the floor  and coming under the front door was off putting- like a rubbish tip 😔 this needs to be addressed before I could recommend to another visitor- I’m sure the landlord will look into this

Loved my stay here. Pretty centralised. Tram right in front of my stay. Allowed me to store my luggages till my next check in and even helped me with a maxi cab since I had more than 5 luggages. Very friendly and helpful front desk staffs.

The apartment was perfect. We loved being able to cook our own food and we had everything we needed to do so. The apartment itself is cosy, modern and clean. We highly appreciated the washer and dryer. Of the 21 places I have stayed in the past two months, this apartment was my favourite.

The location is beyond convenient. Just a short walk to/from Southern cross station which most would arrive at from the airport. Furthermore, the tram stop is right out the front of the apartment making it extremely easy to catch the free tram. It is also highly walkable with plenty of good eats in the vicinity.
The apartment was a good size for us two. The only downside was that the water pressure wasn’t very strong and it kept running low on hot water every so often. Apart from that, the reception staff are super friendly and very responsive with any of our requests.
Over all  it is all good. But the price is a little bit of expensive  side.

Good place to stay. Location was great. Staff extremely polite and helpful. Unfortunately we stayed on a 33°c day and had no air-conditioning at all due to maintenance issues, was not Ideal at all. No refund or change of room was offered only a fan.
The place is nearby everything that we need during this trip. I would highly recommend it to all my friends
Very clean and great communication from hosts. Could leave luggage secure after check out which was very handy.

Convenient to tram, train station and walkable range to CBD & even Southbank. Very satisfied with what we have paid. Very responsive to the request through F2F with reception or messages via Airbnb. Comfortable stay especially for long stay - we have everything we need, e.g. cooking, laundry. Extra point to the stunning view (Yarra river) at the rooftop gym :) No need to pay for lookout ticket.

Great host, convenient location right near the CBD. Swanston St and Bourke St Mall are just a few tram stops away. Had all the amenities we needed for a few nights’ couples stay in Melbourne. Thank you!

We had a great time staying at Canvas Apartment.
The reception was very friendly and helpful. We got an early check in which is great. We checked out early but then we mistakenly saw our flight details and had to come back again and the staff welcomed us to check in again and stay a little bit longer even tho the hotel was busy.
Place was clean and the amenities are complete.
Very close to the big station and tram was just across the street.
There is no bad experience at all so we really enjoyed our stay!

the place was convenient train stations and free trams and also quite spacious for two residents. The place was clean, and have refills of daily necessities. Would live here again if come to Melbourne again
great central location. easy check in and parking also available nearby for a fee. gym is also handy to have.
Nice to stay here for two months！good location and the view of rooftop gym is soooo beautiful！

I stayed for a month and it was pleasant. Clean and tidy, good location and a very responsive host. Downsides are that the bed is too soft, windows looked directly to a gym so I had to keep my blinds down most of the time and occasionally bad smell from laundry which seemed to be from stagnant water. Despite this would stay again

Pro: Just as described and just like the photos they posted.
Con: The neighbour is a bit noisy.
First night there was no hot water for few hours but after informed they got it fix and running in less than 3hrs.

Had a great stay at Canvas whilst I attended the Australian International Airshow! Easy self check-in, very responsive and proactive messaging, clean and comfortable apartment, and super close to Southern Cross Station and trams! Would definitely return!

This was a lovely stay. It was very convenient as there is a tram stop directly in front of it and lots of restaurants and cafes nearby along the river. The team was very responsive to my queries and I would recommend this place.

Amazing location right in the CBD of Melbourne and just around the corner from Southern Cross Station and the free tram line. Heaps to do (aquarium just up the street!) and heaps of restaurants and cafés everywhere around you. The space has everything you need for a longer stay with a kitchen and washing machine, Smart TV also means you can cast any of your streaming services and Spotify to. Manned reception made check in/out super easy and straightforward.

Good little apartment ok for one or couple who are out and about. Wouldn't suit someone needing space or spending most of their time in the apartment. Train noise obvious but weekends a bit less. It was fine for us for weekend stay.
Great location near public transport. Easy check in and check out - lots of help with any questions or concerns.

The host was very responsive throughout our whole trip and they even adjusted my booking just a few weeks ahead of my trip.
The place was cute and very convenient.

Very good value and a good location. Really helpful staff and good communication. The apartment was quite nice but be aware that it is very noisy from the nearby trains. Also a little bit shabby - some of the kitchen appliances were broken.

Great location to stay in, very accessible for trams in all directions and train station in easy walking distance. Plenty of grocery and convenience stores nearby, but for the major food attractions and activities are within a short transport trip away. The train line is very close however we had zero issues with any noise. It is also right near the river, very easy to go for a walk by the water.
The apartment was great for its size and has plenty of utensils for cooking for yourself. Host was responsive and ground floor reception was lovely.
Our stay at Canvas was ideal. It's a great location & perfect for a city visit. The tram stop is right out the front & it's the free tram so even better. The bed was super comfy. Will stay again.
Bathroom and toilet weren’t as clean as I would expect, but otherwise a comfortable place and very convenient location

This is our third time staying in the Canvas apartments. The apartment had everything we needed for a four night stay. Noise wasn't an issue, and there is a tram line in front of the block so getting around was easy. There were even some Easter eggs left as a little surprise. I'm sure we'll be back again.

Great location! Between the free trams and walking we could get everywhere we wanted to go.
Clean and tidy apartment with good view from the gym.
Would stay again.

Location was great, easy to walk to the popular areas with restaurants and bars.
Our room was clean.
Would recommend to anyone.

The Canvas apartment was spaceous and clean. It’s close to everything and all in all a good place to stay. The only thing was that the heater was not working so they brought up a different one, also the water in the showers was cool as well. Everything was pretty good but I was freezing, so that’s why they get a 4 star from me.

Was a really pleasant stay.
Located in a convenient spot for getting around the city, train and trams within walking distance.
Room was lovely and clean.
Great kitchen with all the utensils needed provided.
The bed was extremely comfortable and there was lots of storage space.
The only issue was with the windows open it was quite loud outside, but that is hard to prevent.
Had small problems sometimes using the elevator with the keycard swipe but nothing drastic.
Hosts were very friendly and messaged back quickly through AirBnB.
Overall a great stay and will most likely return in my next visit to Melbourne.
This is my second time staying here. Location wise it is very convenient, located inside the free tram zone

overall nice stay, street can be a bit loud as you’re close to a tram, beautiful place & amenities for a perfect stay with access to nearby train stations for travel. for the price i mean its alright :)

the place was clean and like the pictures. Staff were friendly and responsive. Was very loud due to the nearby train tracks. The mattress was quite soft.
very good location in CBD though.
worth the price.

Although this listing is in the cbd it’s a decent trek to any tourist, shopping or dining locations. The place was left undesirably by cleaners from previous visitors. Lounge was broken. Also a lot of noise from the street outside. Comfy bed though and amenities were decent.
Comfortable appartment in the middle of Docklands, right outside of a tram station and an easy ride away from the CBD and Flinders street. Bed is super comfy also!!

The apartment was in an excellent location near southern cross station and tram lines. The reception staff at Canvas were very friendly. I thought the room could have been a little cleaner and could be improved by supplying some cooking basics like oil, salt etc but otherwise it was great.
great place, even better location with a tram stop right outside the door and the train station a 5 mi ute walk. perfect size and clean and tidy

first time booking an Airbnb. receptionist where friendly. willing to help and visually show you how to use the keys.
perfect for date night in the city for a young couple. worth the price.
My only complaints,
Should have more Glasses. wasn't much to choose from besides wine & tall. and coffee mugs.
Also the ice tray was empty. when we arrived. I recommend letting the host know beforehand.
The host was amazing replying to message. very helpful. will definitely book in again in the future. 10/10

We had a great stay at The Canvas. Super spacious 1 bed flat right in the middle of CBD, with the free tram stop right outside. The apartment was lovely, clean and well equipped kitchen. Very easy communication with hosts and they accommodated us checking in early. Parking was easy to arrange and fairly reasonable for the location! Would definitely recommend for Melbourne.

I didn't expect a formal establishment (being Airbnb), but I was impressed at the professionalism of the service.
I loved the broad range of amenities, and the WiFi speed was the fastest and most reliable I've had in an accommodation (very important for me).
The location and cost simply couldn't have been better. I'm a fan.

Perfect place for a week stay, right near public transport and was within walking distances of most things. Everything was great aside from a weird smell in the bathroom when we checked in and the heater not working other than that it was great
Great location and easy to get around the city. The tram stop is right in front of this place. Will definitely stay here again when I am next in Melbourne.

It’s a great and convenient place as the tram station is just in front. It’s a serviced apartment and Airbnb combined. We had great stay here. Except one thing is the interior design is a bit weird. Lavabo is super small and a shelf is above your head when you are trying to wash your face, it may hit your head. But overall still good.

Great location, very close to the main bus station and has numerous tram stations around, including one right outside. The apartment is very clean, comfortable and provides all required amenities. Hosts are very responsive and provided all instructions for check in and out very clearly. Highly recommend.
Location is easily to find, conform as well as central location. Room is quite clean, beautiful.

Double booked our room with another party a few hours after we checked in, afterwards required both us and the other party to move to different rooms. Extremely inconvenient and poor safety, minimal sympathy/apologies from the staff. Initial support from front desk was lacklustre, unable to provide any recourse or solutions.
A few days later, received a call from management who were extremely apologetic. Very productive conversation, and glad to know that my concerns were heard, and we were able to come to a fair compensation amount very quickly. Huge props to their management team for following through.

Lovely room with an amazing view from the 27th floor across the Yarra. However the position is quite out of the way and tram access is quite limited. Very noisy location both internally and externally, bring your earplugs
It was a very cute room, perfect size for 2 but the bathroom sink was dirty and lowkey awkward to reach
A nice place to stay, perfect for the two of us. Close to everywhere in the city.
lovely place to stay! staff were super friendly and accommodating. a very reasonable price too, i will definitely be coming back!
My parents stayed 5 nights here, although there were trains beside, but it’s still quiet, and the location is great, easy for you to find!

Overall a really central location, however unfortunately this particular corner has got a lot of rubbish on the street. The stay was really comfortable, pretty basic and great for anyone who has the intention of going out and about for the duration of their trip (rather than staying in)
Lovely place to stay. Central to lots of things in the city and easy to find. Comfortable bed and spacious area to stay. Thanks for having us!

Thinking it was an apartment/hotel, we would’ve thought we would get fresh towels every day and other stuff but didn’t. Then the listing had said a queen bed and it was two singles out together so we were both sliding into the middle of the bed and feeling it spread apart so was a very uncomfy stay.

Great location, was right next to two tram stops and easily walkable from train stations. The whole place and our room was nice and clean, the workers were fantastic and helpful and everything in the room worked well. Would absolutely book again.

Great stay! Exactly as advertised. in heart of CBD with trams right by door and walking distances to most attractions. Excellent communication and easy check in/out. Has a basic gym on site included with stay. Yes can hear trains, but infrequently at night and unless a very light sleeper this shouldn't be an issue. Will definitely be returning when visiting Melbourne

It was a great place to stay and location. The front desk was friendly and we had no problems checking in or out. The room was clean and bed linen was crisp and fresh. We reported a bad smell in the communal corridor but that was attended to very quickly. Overall it was a great stay!
It was easy to find and very clean.  Great location but the trains are a bit noisy.

Perfect location with trams and southern cross train station walking distance (>5 minutes). Stayed here for the later part of my trip which was great for getting the sky bus to the airport. Will recommend to friends and family travelling to Melbourne

Canvas were extremely prompt and quite proactive with their communication, making our stay extremely stress free. You will definitely hear the sounds of the trains and trams leaving/arriving the station/stop right out the front from your room - however as a light sleeper myself, I was never really woken up by the noises myself and slept soundly every night. Love the convenience of having a 7-11 on the corner, being able to request and promptly receive extra amenities/requests, and a tram stop directly in front. I'd stay here again on my next stay!
Best place but bad environment as there was a lot of events happening around that area, such as people yelling and trains or car sounds.
Great location inside Canvas Hotel, perfect spot to get around Melbourne. Room was excellent,  everything you need and more
Good location, everything was close by. The accomodation match with the reality, and the staff use Airbnb chaf in order to response quickly to guest request.

Mould in bathroom shower
Cupboard door beside fridge was loose and couldn't be used.
A very convenient place if you want to stay in the CBD. Spacious for a couple with all amenities. Good place to stay worth your money.  A sure shot recommendation !!

The bed was very uncomfortable as there were two single mattresses on top of a double sized bed frame. Also the air conditioning was not working and would not heat up the unit. Not the best experience. Could be so much better

The room is spacious and comfy. I don’t even want to go out while staying in such a nice place. But the bed can be done better. There’s some dust flying around but it’s just a minor thing. In general, it is a really nice place to stay and staff are always helpful!
The location is convenient and can be reached on foot. The most important thing is that there is a luggage storage service

A great location for using the tram - the stop is just across the street - and about a 10 minute walk from the SkyBus terminal. The front desk staff were very helpful and stored our luggage too. The gym has amazing views. And the room was clean and had everything we needed.

Very good location as it’s very close to the train station (you do hear the trains pretty much constantly). Interior amenities were basic but has everything you need if you’re not spending too much time inside. The windows do look directly into other peoples apartments so we kept the blinds down most of the time.

Place is clean and new, close distance to groceries stores and take away. Parking on the street, is no a living room to watch tv (now is the fourth room panel walls) , the back yard the only place to seat outside the room.
Owners often around and offers you fruit or some food. Expect to have two pairs of thongs/sleepers/Hawaiians as you can't use any shoes been used outside. (they will offer you some sleepers to use inside)
Is a few safety cameras inside, just be mindful if you like privacy and dont want be monitored when in sharing areas.
I stayed as it was very close to my new job as it was temporary as I moved interstate.
Is no ceiling fan or aircon/heating in the room depending season of the year you stay in.
The hotel is good right in the city. One of the problem was it doesn’t mention which floor with view and which is not when you book it. You need to understand it from price.

Although the heater was playing up and making noise the staff were extremely helpful and provided a substitute portable heater and changed the bedding due to a very pulled and uncomfortable mattress protector. Thanks

I arrived in the morning and tried to put my luggage there. The lady at the reception was really friendly and she checked me in when she found out the room was available. The room is exactly the same as the picture on the website. It was a wonderful experience with Canvas!
This apartment was so convenient- literally right across from a tram line and 5 mins walk from Southern Cross Station. The bed was so comfortable! We would definitely stay again

I enjoyed my stay and it was helpful that it was a hotel because I wanted to store my luggage after I checked out because my flight was in the evening and they were able to hold it for me. Staff were responsive to questions on the app.
Neat apartment for a couple. Check in was a breeze and they also took care of our luggage before check in time which was kind. Super convenient location in the CBD of Melbourne.
Super clean and well designed. A perfect location to the train station, DFO and other popular shopping destinations.
Wonderful place to stay and just like the description. Train noises throughout the night/ day can be a loud but feels right at home in the city. Great place to stay.
Clean property in the free tram zone in Melbourne cbd. Had exactly what we needed for a 3-night stay!

The accommodation is conveniently located right in front of a tram stop serviced by a free tram, making transportation extremely convenient. We were able to enjoy a happy and relaxing trip in this truly modernly designed lodging. If you are traveling in Melbourne, I highly recommend this perfect accommodation.

It was better than I expected. I wish I knew that they also provided free slippers and replenishment of toiletries but it was on me because I didn’t ask. It was a really good location with a tram stop right outside and convenience stores nearby. If you are attending an event by the MCEC then this space is excellent. The staff were really friendly and professional. I would book here again when I come back to lovely Melbourne :)

I just loved my stay here- the view from my room was amazing, it captured some of Melbournes great high rise buildings and looked stunning all lit up in the evening. The staff were so helpful and accomodating. It was very clean, very easy to find and I felt like I had everything I need, right there. I will definitely be coming back again. Thank you so much 😊
Great location. Easy walking distance to train stations, casino & shops. Simple check-in process. Room had every thing we needed.

Location is great. No need car.
The tv cast won’t work from your device. We move 2 times, 1st because the fridge stopped working, 2nd because the window shade felt down and the heater won’t work :(
The gentleman in lobby is friendly, trying his best to solve issues
Very clean and comfortable. Hosts were very easy to communicate with and ensured we had everything we needed.

Staff were all very friendly and checked us in and out with ease. Parking is a shorter walk than it seems and there’s a good coffee shop on the way. Apartment was clean and had a really good view of the yarra river and buildings. Would stay here again
Very clean and comfortable. An easy check in. Quiet and warm. We noted how clean it was compared with other places we have stayed. Canva were friendly. Excellent value for money!

We were able to enjoy our stay after we were able to get into a suite. The first suite had a sign on the door saying it was being oxygenated. Staff only. Got upgraded only to find that upon entering, the suite was already occupied. Got downgraded again to another regular suite and it worked.
Once we got settled in, staff were responsive. Note: this is an apartment hotel and we only became aware of this on our arrival.
Also, know that you can ask for things like oil, foil, French press, etc. We weren’t aware of that until after we purchased a few of those items. All in all a good stay.

Great location, transport at door. Easy walk to river, casino and DFO shops.
Unfortunately they were doing road works overnight so a little noisy.

Would definitely stay again, good value.

Easy check-in and good location. Clean and comfortable apartment. Only concern was the TV had a different person’s name listed in the welcome notice, which made me wonder if I was in the correct apartment. When I mentioned to the reception they advised it can take a little while to update, however the name did not change during my 1 night stay.

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay!! Easy check in and follow up messages to ensure we had everything we needed. Clean apartment & perfect location with the tram right out the front. My only suggestion would be an upgrade on the bed as they were two single beds pushed together, it unfortunately meant we slumped into the gap. Apart from that I would definitely stay again & recommend :)
had a lovely stay! the room had great amenities and looked exactly like the pictures. we were able to keep luggage on site before and after check in / out. everyone was really helpful and kind :)

Honestly exceeded our expectations. For the price we paid, it was absolutely worth it. It was so clean and modern, and the view was so lovely to just stare at. We honestly felt right at home. Would totally recommend this place and even visit again!

Canvas was perfect for what I needed. It was centrally located, just a short walk from Bourke Street, China Town and lots of the sites. There's plenty of transport nearby - a number of tram stops, only a short walk/tram from Flinders Street Train Station and a short walk from Southern Cross Station. I also liked that as it was a flat rather than a hotel, I could save money by cooking at the flat - the only thing I would say was missing was a drying rack for the dishes, a better cutting board and a couple more knives (I didn't have a bread knife for example).

Located at a good place , although the apartment does get very noisy when the windows are open .
Found the studio apartment abit small for my liking but managable .
I had a great time staying here. The staff are friendly and very responsive. I would definitely stay here again for my next visit.

Super quality service. I left my shoes in the hotel after I checked out and only found out when I had travelled to a different state. I called Canvas, shortly after which the team located my shoes and mailed it to my home. Can’t expect anything better! All other services are done very well too. Highly recommended!

We chose this accommodation to spend NYE and we had an amazing experience. The accommodation has an incredible location, right in the heart of the CBD, which allowed us to enjoy the city by public transport. The staff is very friendly, the accommodation had everything we needed and it was spotless clean. I would highly recommend to my friends and I’m definitely coming back !

The flat was great. Had all the amenities and was really clean as well. The location is right in the heart of the cbd area, so everything is walkable. The tram station is right in front of the apartment. Definitely recommend.
Everything was good, just When I went to reception to do the check in, the lady couldnt't find my reservation until a guy help him explain her that I have 2 names and 2 surenames
As described. Great for our few days in Melbourne as first time visitors. Easy to find and convenient location

perfect apartment for a trip to Melbourne. Communication was very great and friendly, after hour check - in went smoothly and apartment was very spacious. Walkable Distance to all major attractions and great coffee spots 😊
Excellent location, very clean, very little noise and superb pillows and bed. The staff were friendly and most helpful.
Great little studio turned into 1 bedroom and clean comfortable place. Host was good to communicate with and answered all my questions. Walkable to amenities and check in easy. Would stay here again.

Amazing communication and responsiveness from the team! They were extremely lovely and friendly. It was very clean and presentable and i had a very comfortable sleep on the bed which is always a gamble when you’re not sleeping in your own bed. Perfect location if you're coming from and going to the skybus/airport. Thanks for a comfortable stay! ☺️
Stayed here for a trip with my friend and we loved it. Flexible check in and check out times!

Location was amazing albeit the background noise of a busy city, mainly the trams and trains surrounding it. The reception was perfect as well as the living space itself. Amenities were provided whenever required, and they were very responsive in the app chat. Very well worth the price, would recommend picking this place out.

great place to stay.
easy check in and checkout process.
loved the view from room

Great location - near southern cross & skybus stations so it was easy to get from/to airport. Also free tram zone bus stop is right opposite.
Apartment is big & has all amenities and appliances. Including washer & dryer. Place is similiar to hotel with reception & can place luggage after check out.
Super convenient location with very friendly staff to make you feel at home. Well set up apartments with everything you needed

It was a very pleasant stay. The room is clean and tidy, the bathroom is very clean too. They provide enough towels and I love that they have a strong heater and air conditioner. The place is quiet I can have a good rest. It is convenient as the tram station is just outside the hotel. I would definitely revisit.
Great place! Not much of a view as it looks directly into other apartments but convenient and clean.
Great accommodation in the heart of Melbourne. The location was as central as you could get, so it was a bit busier but the apartment was well soundproofed.

We were able to check in a little early when we arrived to drop off our bags after we got off at Southern Cross Station. The room was perfect for a night stay in the city. The bed was very comfortable and the unit was very clean. It was a great location - with a tram stop right out the front. This is my new 'go to' option for when I stay in Melbourne.
Fabulous apartment within close walking distance to most things. The tram stop right out the front made it super easy to get around! Loved my stay here, will be back !
Check in was easy and the room was nice and clean. Was close to where we needed to be so was the perfect spot!

Stayed here for a week and it was a perfect little spot for me and my partner. Great location , near the tram and station. Able to walk to most places without having to Uber. Also worth the price I paid to stay. Overall, accurate with the description and pictures provided.

Great place to stay, very communicative hosts and good walking distance from everything. Would come back definitely and highly recommend to others looking for a place to stay in Melbourne for good value. 👍

I had drama with my car and they were helpful and felixable with helping my son .
thanks for that.
Enloyed my stay, check in and out was simplecand easy, reception was super helpful and friendly. Room was perfect.

this stay with canvas was good, accomodation clean and looked like pictures, good location with a tram stop out front, had some issues with the third party car park but they were accomodating regarding it

A busy part of town but so handy to trams and major railway stations..... really easy to get to and head out, very quiet at night.
I really enjoyed it! IAN

Good service and easy check in, and a comfortable place to stay a few nights. Heater was quite loud but staff responsed to my concern promptly and offered a solution. Clean with all that is required for a short stay in Melbourne. Some distant tram noise but nothing too disruptive. Overall, this was a good experience & staff very helpful and welcoming.

Place was clean and the location was great, the view was amazing. Only thing that was an inconvenience was the parking location and the cost, the parking spot isn’t in the same building, so you have to constantly have to walk to a different building outside to get to the car park and for $30 a night didn’t seem worth it when another public carpark is next door that does it for cheaper I realised. While staying there for 2 nights, there was construction happening in front of the carpark, so it took us ages to get out of the carpark and was only told when we checked in and didn’t give us the chance to book another carpark space somewhere else, making us late on our second day stay to go somewhere out. They should have just communicate more when they knew there was going to be a big inconvenience to guests especially regarding parking.
It is a lovely place that I stayed. Everything is good and also it’s closed to the station. Very recommmend to stay again.

This Airbnb was located right near the trams which was extremely convenient. There were plenty of amenities in the room, and the size of the room was perfect for two. The bathroom sink was quite small, and the dishwasher seemed to be broken, but other than that the room was decent.
There was a false fire alarm that went off at 5am in the morning but other than that there were no disruptions. Would recommend for a short stay!

The place was so easy to navigate as the trams were outside the front. Staff were very helpful and attentive for us. The room was clean and ammenities were made available to us when needed and had the basic kitchen appliances.
Had a fantastic weekend thank you canvas team!
Our apartment was very clean and comfortable. We also had access to a gym on the top floor and a secure car park close by. We highly recommend this place and hope to visit again soon.

I wouldn’t say the place was perfect because it’s not what we expected. There were extremely loud noises around the neighbourhood, stains on the bedsheets and above all, the bed was ultimately uncomfortable. I couldn’t explain how unsatisfying that was throughout our whole experience there.
Clean apartment, check in and check out experience was super easy. They even let us keep our bags there after check out which was great while we explored the city during the day.

Accommodation: clean, organized, fully equipped, convenient and comfortable.
People: friendly, positive, supportive and proactive.
Location: easy to access to everything. It is great for someone who is new to the city.
Maybe it is a bit noisy for someone who likes to sleep in a quiet place like myself.

Great customer service along with many amenities supplied and in a good location in cbd, made things super convenient. The sink in the bathroom is a bit hard to use since the mirror portrudes outwards, might be hard to wash face/brush teeth without splashing water everywhere. Other than that, the room layout was well designed and spacious. The diswashers, laundry machines, fridge etc are well placed and hidden inside the different compartments which helps make the place look extremely tidy. Everything including the bedding were clean and spotless. With so many ameneties and facilities provided, along with the convenient location and excellent staff, this place is well worth the price!

The stay was amazing. Room was as pictured and staff were all very friendly and helpful. Carpark is nearby, definitely not the most convenient accommodation Carpark, but wouldn’t complain because it’s just a short 1-2mins walk away. Charges for Carpark was also reasonable (and allows for multiple entry and exit). Love that we were able to cook and wash our clothes at the accommodation. Bed was a tad too soft for my travel partner (but this is based on personal preference). Overall, a good stay. Will consider to come back again if we are visiting Melbourne again.

As soon as you open the door, there is always a garbage smell that does not stop, I'm not sure if it was my floor or other levels . Also the air conditioning does not work properly, it's either you are cold to death or hot to death. It is also very noisy.

Canvas was such a lovely place to stay! Reception was so helpful and let me pop my luggage in secure area until my room was ready (I arrived from NZ on a very early flight). The room felt homely, kitchen and bathroom had everything I required (tea/coffee/shower gel etc). Bed was quite soft, more than what I'm used to personally, but I slept so well regardless. As I popped over to Melbourne for PAX, the apartment was in a perfect location
Which was directly across the river from the convention centre. Close walk or free tram ride to Flinders Station or Southern Cross Station and the city centre. Everything you need is within a wee walk or tram away. I would recommend staying here :)

Bathroom door doesn’t close fully, washer/dryer broke leaving us with no dry clothing to wear. Manager apologetic and responsive however did not communicate with check out staff regarding reimbursement agreement which then led to more stress and time wasted upon checkout. We won’t be staying there again.
excellent location, right by a tram stop, easy walking distance to Flinders street station, regular check in via Airbnb to check we had everything we needed, would 100% stay again!

Communication was very poor and were incredibly inflexible with check in/out times. We arrived an hour after check in and they were still cleaning. Not enough towels. Overall a great location for the price.

With a bit of a rocky start due to not being able to access the keys to check in until about 4pm, we had a lovely stay in a beautiful apartment.
There is only one aircon in the main area so the bedrooms became a bit hot unless you kept the sliding doors open (which was noisy). There is no dryer so a portable clothes drier would have been great.
Fantastic location and views!

Miscommunication with the owner about check in and check out times. No clarity and no heads up given and check in process was delayed because owner left communication to last minute. The lounge room was tiny, couch for two people for a 3 bedder is abit ridiculous. Rooms and beds were nice and clean though.
Easy and fast check in. Location is great! Apartment was not that well cleaned though and not enough toilet rolls
Enjoyed the central location in Melbourne very much.  Easy access to public transport. The gym was of great value during a vacation.
Great location. Friendly staff. The unit could be cleaner but otherwise okay. Thanks for the stay!
Lovely place, very responsive and attentive staff. Some issues with noisy pipes, received a partial refund. seems it's better value to book directly through the website than Airbnb. I'd stay again

One of the rooms faces directly into the sun rising which can get quite hot if you’re staying on a hot day. Had issues with hair on pillows. Also the walls are paper thin with the neighbours so had a bit of a scare thinking someone was in the apartment with me when I thought I was alone. (Can hear neighbours sneeze). Otherwise a great location to stay.

The Canvas team were excellent with great communication. The apartment had all the amenities you need for a stay in Melbourne. Great city location that is within walking distance to cafes, restaurants, bars and tourist attractions. Would highly recommend for solo travellers and couples.
It’s very convenient to travel around Melbourne staying in the CBD. It was a nice apartment hotel with friendly staff.

Perfect spot to stay to easily access public transport (can hear the trains from inside the apartment just to be aware but was not overly loud or an issue for us).Walkable to many amazing restaurants (would recommend hardware lane for alleyway restaurants). Clean place with very friendly staff. Would highly recommend staying here.
My partner and I had a great time here and waking up early in the morning watching the sun come up from the balcony was amazing we would definitely recommend staying here

Was a perfect location and handy apartment close to the city for our short stay in Melbourne. Host was very accommodating for us to request a slightly earlier checkin and super responsive throughout our stay.
Only slightly annoying thing was having to collect the key from another location to check-in (about 4 mins walk away), and also that we only had 1 set of keys, which made it hard to do things separately as a group travelling together. The apartment is on level 51, so not good if you have fear of heights, but otherwise very good value for money and great place to stay.

Great location near to tram stops. Plenty of room for a group of 5 adults travelling together.
Would stay again.

Canvas’s is a lovely place to stay for a short trip to Melbourne. With the tram right at your door step, it’s super easy getting to all the places you want to visit… particularly if you’re going to the AO.

The stay was very nice, we paid around $400 for the 3 night stay. The apartment was clean, however there was a bit of mould at the back of the toilet seat and on the walls in the bathroom, but it didn’t phase us!
It’s in walking distance of lots of places, and has a tram stop right out side for convenience:)
I would probably come back here again

My partner and I had an incredible stay at this apartment! The location is unbeatable, with everything we needed just a short walk away. The space was spotless and well-maintained. Communication with the staff was excellent—they were responsive and friendly. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay!
We had a last minute change to our reservation and Canvas made this really easy for us. The apartment was gorgeous and right in the middle of the city. Highly recommend staying here!

Great place to stay, and extremely convenient. Our aircon wasn’t working and they found another room for us immediately. Top notch service despite the busy check in day. Extremely friendly and proactive staff. They also helped us store our bags on the day we checked out since our flight was only at night.

Stayed in 4 different places in Melbourne while we were travelling about. the only Airbnb was Canvas, it was our last stop. and i've to say it was the best stay out of all accomodations. would've done more nights with canvas from the beginning if not for the cleaning fees. but all in all loved the place, clean and modern and was even given a complimentary upgrade to an executive suite for a one night stay. amenities were all readily available too and a tram stop was right outside the hotel. however, there's also a train bridge nearby that's very noisy if you get close to it. didn't affect our stay though. would definitely not mind staying here again! host was also very responsive and checking in on us before we arrived to make sure the check in was seamless.

Really lovely apartment, exactly as described! We stayed for a week and had a really comfortable experience - we were able to cook and feel at home when we needed to as well!
People can see straight into the apartment through the windows but it didn’t bother us as we just kept the blinds shut when changing etc.
Really great location- couple of tram stops right opposite or round the corner from the place, the river and riverside restaurants are right opposite, and super walkable into the CBD and down to flinders station/federation square!
Really recommend😀

The staff were friendly and helpful. The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures. Convenient location approximately 5 min walk from Southern Cross railway station and trams etc. Great value for money and we intend on staying there again in the future.

The apartment was clean and well presented, the check in process was easy and straightforward though there were a few minor issues with the apartment such as the air conditioner unit was quite a bit noisy
Very good stay,  the listers were very responsive and accomodating. The place was clean and suitably located.
Prompt and friendly communication throughout the stay. Awesome location, easy walk to most places. Nice and clean with a great layout.

This was a great convenient location close to Southern Cross Station, easy access to other transport, clean, easy to access after hours when I arrived after reception had closed. Comfortable bed, good shower and everything I needed for my short stay. Would also use this place for a longer stay.

We arrived to be greeted by Scarlett, who made us feel so welcomed. They let us leave our luggage before checking in and after check out so we could enjoy Melbourne fully. It was a beautiful place with great views (thanks to an upgrade). I can highly recommend this place and it’s such great value for money. A tram stop outside within the free tram zone and walking distance to most places. Love, love, loved it!
great place to stay. very central to all the places I wanted to go. easy connect to the metro and airport
Great location! Easy check in. The apartment was modern, clean and had a great view of the city! Had everything we needed for a short stay in Melbourne.

Fantastic location. Budget friendly. Short walk or tram ride from Southern Cross Station.
Unfortunately the TV didn't work while we stayed but it wasn't too big of a deal. Would be happy to stay again.
Great location, friendly and helpful staff. They provided luggage holding for us after checkout which was very helpful. Highly recommended for a top Melbourne City stay.

Truly a wonderful place to stay.
Check in was a breeze and they happily stored my luggage for me until I could get into the room.
Location is fantastic. Free trams just down the road, also close to the train and bus stations or an easy 20 min walk into shopping and site seeing.
Apartment comes equipped with everything you could need for a short stay and they provide washing powder and lots of little packets of things!
Lovely warm place. It was wonderfully kept.
100% will be staying again. Fantastic.

very nice stay in the middle of Melbourne with lots of access to popular desintations
responsive hosts with clear instructions in the check in/out process
would stay again!

Excellent location and access to the free city tram, but place is not very well insulated so quite noisy -  can hear trams, trains, and sirens. Otherwise it was very warm and had lots of amenities, hosts are very friendly :)

We had a comfortable stay at The Canvas. The reception staff were friendly and accommodating to our requests. The room had all the basic necessities you needed (toiletries, kitchenware and laundry) . The location's very accessible to public transport. Our only concern was the stinky smell from the bathroom (drainage?) which doesn't seem to go away even when cleaned.

We visited Melbourne for 3 nights as a family of 5 adults and 2 small children.  Our group was split up two room next to each other on the same floor and found Canvas very accommodating to our requests and questions.  The check-in lady was most helpful and lovely.  Our room (2 adults) was spacious with lots of storage, a nice kitchen and a great bathroom.  The train noise was probably a little hindrance, but can tolerate it.  The mattress was very soft.

Great for the price.
Room was clean and fully stocked with all the toiletries/cooking utensils we could possibly need. Plus, the location right near the tram and train was very convenient.

I had a fantastic stay here!
The team was incredibly responsive and helpful, making everything so easy from start to finish. The place was clean and fresh, which made it super comfortable. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great location to be able to explore.

Great stay with Canvas, Greta location with the tram stop right outside.
Room was great, you get what you payed for.
Little bit noisy with the tram and train so close but didn’t bother me at all!
Was helpful that we were able to store our luggage before and after check in with no added charge.
Very easy and comfortable stay! Location was convenient, apartment was lovely and clean. Would stay again.

Super happy with our stay at The Canvas. I was so surprised at how easy check in was compared to other air bnb's. It was walking distance from all the places we needed to go on our trip including the train station. Also the host was very great at communication throughout our stay. Thank you for an easy, clean place to stay 🙏

Great location in the Melbourne CBD w access to easy public transport and walking distance to great cafes and restaurants in the CBD and common tourist spots. Parking was a bit annoying as there was no parking in the building and had to walk a few minutes but what can you do 🤷‍♀️ it was only annoying because our bags were heavy. Staff were lovely, very responsive and helpful. It was a great stay and would stay again!
This is the place to be when in Melbourne! Everything is beautiful. The canvas apartment is the perfect combination to your unforgettable and memorable stay in the city.
Grant's property is very hip and cool. Beautiful and nice interior. Great location. Grant is also attentive. Highly recommended.
Excellent location, well-appointed apartment but could be cleaner, needed to walk to nearby cafe to pick up keys (something to keep in-mind). Overall, it was good for our three-night stay.
Brilliant apartment! Located perfectly for exploring the city. Trams are easy from there into the city. Grant was great for check in and communicating. Perfect for a Melbourne city visit!
In a great location, easy check in and great value for money. lovely cosy apartment would 100% recommend
Good place for a couple of nights in Melbourne.  Great location, not far from lots of good cafes and restaurants.
Grant is a great host. The apartment was in an amazing location and made getting around incredibly easy. Highly recommend staying here.

Grants place is spectacular with stunning interiors. Grant is easy to communicate and he is very accommodative in terms of us not being able to get our key in time and he find the solution to our problem. The apartment is nice and clean with really good vibe. I think this is definitely a good weekend getaway kind of apartment for an individual or a couple.

Had forgotten my herbal teas, none available in unit. But great stay, perfect position for our party.
Thank you.
Very comfortable little apartment in a fabulous location. Had everything we needed for a lovely long weekend. Excellent food and coffee just around the corner. Hosts were super helpful.
Awesome place in an excellent location. Really well stocked kitchen, comfortable bed, and luxurious towels. Highly recommend and will be staying here again on my next visit!

Grant’s place was Amazing and cozy. Apartment really felt like home with all the amenities provided, giving us lesser worries. Apartment were also very clean and spotless. During check in, we found out that shower head was leaking & we contacted Grant. Grant was very quick to respond & even came down to the apartment to fix it. Shower head was quickly fixed thereafter. All cooking & eating utensils were also provided & so cooking & eating is very easy to do. The Apartment is also well look after with minimal to no damage seen. Bedroom is also very cozy, with comfy pillow & mattress making us having difficulties waking up the next morning. Apartment is in very good location with great amenities with Coles a walking distance from apartment. It is also situated around lots of nice cafes, including Grant’s amazing owned cafe, Arcadia.  Overall experience was great with very responsive owner & located around two different Tram lines. Would definitely come back & would recommed to friends!
Great apparent close to everything in Collingwood. Everything you need is here. Grant is a great host.
Had a nice stay at Grant’s place, easy to find, and good location. Close enough to the City but not too close to the crowds. Would recommend to others considering on stay in Fitzroy/Collingwood area.

Grant’s place was in an awesome location for people who did not have a car . Heaps of good restaurants & shops within walking distance & easy public transport. Comfortable, clean little place with a great little kitchen space if you wanted to eat in . Would definitely stay there again . Thank you
Great apartment in an awesome location. Grant is a thoughtful, helpful and fantastic host. Recommend to anyone! Thanks
Lovely apartment, clean, safe and quiet. Really well located. I'd definitely stay again. Grant is a great host.

Very nice very clean modern appartment.  Close to good cafes and I could walk to my conferences.  Very good feedback. A couple of bathroom fixtures had been damaged but although Grant offered to fix the main one during my stay I preferred to just leave it to be fixed after I had gone.

Overall I had a good stay. The apartment is quiet but in a great location, and has decent amenities. I think it would be really nice and cool in summer, unfortunately I didn’t get much sunlight in autumn and the place was quite dark. The apartment building itself is really nice and secure, with a great cafe downstairs.
On the surface it’s clean, however the oven had bits of food in it, and the towels had stains and bleach spots. It also just needs a deep clean to make it feel a bit fresher.
The apartment is described as “new”, which it didn’t feel like. For it to match that description it needs a deep clean, new paint job and patching up of chipped doors etc.
Key pick up at the convenience store is pretty easy as it is close by.

Great location. Grant is great at communicating .  It’s a bit of a fiddle to pick up the key . There was no toilet paper. Not enough pillows for the bed and an extra blanket would have been nice. Personally I think items like nappies, takeaway cutlery and food in the fridge should be removed before the next guest arrives. I don’t think anyone wants to use someone else’s left behinds. This apartment has great potential. Attention to detail is needed.
Grants place is in a fabulous part of Collingwood, in a very nice complex with lots of food and bar options nearby. The apartment is great and has everything you need for your stay.

We really enjoyed our stay, convenient location. Lots of restaurants in the area to choose from. The apartment was very nicely decorated and all we needed for our stay.
Thanks Grant.

Everything was perfect,
but the bed and pillows were quite uncomfortable.
Other than that, I loved everything.
Good place. Big room. Can be quite noisy as lot's of people stay in the same building and nearby roads can be noisy
Lovely place, great location. Can’t go wrong being next to Southern Cross station. The apartment is very well equipped with all you need for your stay.
Once you find it, the place is in the middle of great transportation depos and such a beautiful vista out the balcony.
Small but well-designed apartment with amazing views in a very convenient location. Harriet and Nick were very responsive to any issues and questions.
Great location and comfortable unit with a great view on/over Marvel stadium and beyond.. Very friendly hosts with clear /easy instructions for arrival/departure process. Would stay again.

This apartment was exactly as described. It was clean and tidy and offered amazing views of Melbourne, which is spectacular at night. We walked to a restaurant close by for an amazing dinner.
Harriet and Nick were extremely helpful and responded to any questions I had almost instantly.
I have no hesitation in recommending a stay here.
We loved it!

Great location, close to the tram station to commute and explore Melbourne. Southern Cross train station is just across, it is easy to catch the train to go to Melbourne suburbs as well as the V-Line to get to the other towns in Victoria. On top of that, easy access from and to the airport with Skybus running from the airport to Southern Cross station as well. In addition, a stable internet connection, a functioning air conditioner, and running hot water

Great little apartment which is perfect for a Melbourne city break. A very convenient location to use as a base for exploring Collingwood and Fitzroy. The heater works very well and makes the place nice a toasty on cold mornings! Nice shower and comfy bed.

Great location in Collingwood - perfect walking distance to all the best shops and restaurants around there and Fitzroy. The apartment (particularly the bedroom) is a little smaller than pictured so it could be tight if you’re staying for a longer amount of time. But for a weekend away with 1-2 people it’s perfect! All of the hosts we communicated with were helpful and instructions to check in/out were clear. They take pride in keeping the space super clean which I loved! We had a bit of a tricky time with heat as a cold front was passing through the city at the time but there is an A/C unit that the hosts helped us out with and doubles as a heater!! One last thing to note is that if you are sensitive with sound there is not a lot of insulation. The apartment building was quiet a majority of the time but you could hear neighbors above/ construction outside. All in all, lovely place and I would definitely stay again!!!

Justin’s place was perfect for our stay! The location was awesome, with both bus and tram stops right outside. The apartment was a generous side, with a lovely balcony! We would highly recommend Justin’s place for anyone wanting to stay in the Fitzroy/ Collingwood area.

This place was perfect for a short stay in Melbourne. The place is exactly as the pictures. The location was perfect, super close to Smith and Brunswick streets for all the restaurants and shops. Highly recommend and would stay again.
The place was in a perfect location, very central to public transport. Very clean, modern apartment with everything we needed for our 5 nights. Couldn’t be happier with our stay!

This place is an absolute gem! The location is unbeatable, just steps away from public transport that takes you directly into the city. It's surrounded by a fantastic selection of bars, cafes and restaurants. The convenience and vibe of Fitzroy truly make this place a stand out. Highly recommend staying here!

Apartment was in a great location in the heart of the action whilst also being quiet and private. Unfortunately it was not as homey as I hoped. The thick, hard pillows were uncomfortable and the toiletries were on par with a cheap motel. The host was very responsive and gave very clear instructions for check in/out.
Fantastic location! So close to cafes, restaurants and all the great shops in Fitzroy/Collingwood.  Tram line, only a minute way away. Will definitely return and stay here again.  Thanks Eduardo 😊
A hotel on Russel st. Good location. Sadly the hotel / building itself is a little worn out.

This was a great little apartment in the Mantra on Russell, well-situated close to Chinatown in Melbourne’s theatre district.  It was surprisingly quiet and we slept very well on the comfortable bed.  This apartment has a window rather than a door opening onto a balcony.  There’s enough space for a couple, with limited food preparation and eating spaces, but heaps of great dining options in the surrounding area.
We loved our stay, great position in the CBD around the corner from Chinatown and lots of eateries. Highly recommend can't wait to come back.

Extremely happy with my stay here!! I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful place in a prime location in the city! I was very impressed when I checked in and it immediately felt like home. The gym was well equipped also which was a nice surprise! I needed to extend my stay after a stressful day at the airport with flight cancellations and they were so kind and responsive to my request, and ensured I was able to check back in smoothly. They went above and beyond during my stay, and I will 100% choose this place the next time I come to Melbourne - thank you again Adji and team!! 😊

Couldn't be happier with the host and the effective communication for our visit as well as the location in relevance to what we wanted to do was unbelievable. Was really walking distance or a short tram ride to most things! Only part that I was not impressed with was the overall cleanliness of the room with the floor not being hoovered between guests as well as hairs found to be over the bed. We had a late check-in and this was the last thing we wanted when getting to the room. Bit of a disappointing way to start a stay!!

Good lock and leave accomodation in the centre of Melbourne. Easy to get around by walking/tram. Has the essential amenities. Excellent communication by host to check on my stay and answer any queries.
Warm hospitality made us feel having holiday home in Melbourne. very homey, nice interior making our trip extra luxurious. spotless clean and Fantastic city view!
Chian was incredibly accommodating to all of our special requests.  The apartment was clean and tidy.
Chian’s place was well appointed, loved the extra touches with snacks. Easy walk 1 block up the hill straight to a tram stop into the cbd. Lovely & quiet
The property was accurate to the description online.  The beds were comfy and bathrooms clean.  the dog bed, treats and bowls were a lovely touch..xo
This place was lovely! Extremely clean and perfect for 2 couples. Delightful quiet neighborhood that was easy to get to by car and a block walk to catch the tram to anywhere. Highly recommend

Lovely apartment. Everything is brand new and of very good quality. The place is well maintained and very cozy. We found everything we needed. Very good kids toys and books kept my child entertained . I wish we could stay longer. Highly recommended.

Cian's unit is in easy walking distance to southbank and Flinders Street station and super convenient for the ngv. The beds are wonderfully comfortable and the bathrooms excellent. The view over the city is fantastic. It's a Melbourne city unit so necessarily somewhat compact but Cian has managed to include most of what we needed for our short city stay including lots of very well cared for plants that really helped bring some nature into the city.

We had a great stay at The Jade House. It was beautiful, clean and very comfortable, we would stay again. Tan was very friendly and easy to communicate with, we highly recommend to anyone. Thank you so much.

This apartment has one of the best views of the water, across St Kilda and beyond. The apartment was well stocked with everything you'd need to settle in easily. Great communication from Zhi and co-host Ming. Also a comfortable 15 min walk to Southbank restaurants and shops - great place to stay for anyone looking for a more quiet neighbourhood while still having access to everything Melb has to offer.
Great apartment in a easy to access location with beautiful views! Great communication, simple check in. Will definitely stay again.

A very convenient location and well appointed apartment. Having a supermarket downstairs made it super convenient for groceries. A very short walk to the City and a spotless apartment made it a great short stay for us. Ming and Zhi was very good on the instructions for check-in and a very reasonable late check out policy made it a perfect place to stay in Melbourne.
The apartment is exactly as described/ advertised. Host is quick to response any queries. Highly recommended.
Comfortable apartment with awesome views, has everything you need in a handy location. Hosts where very helpful & quick with communication & directions, would definitely stay again.

View was first class. Location was close to everything. Clean and tidy.
Awesome value
We look forward to staying with you again

I would rate 100 stars if i can. The apartment is conveniently equipped with neccessary utilities as stated. The host is fantastic and responded promtly everytime I messaged. The view and the location is absolutely awesome. I would book again if i returned to Melbourne. Highly recommended !

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The apartment is on a very high floor (42nd), so the views are absolutely stunning, both during the day and at night. The location is perfect — close to shops, cafes, public transport, and all the main attractions, yet still peaceful and quiet.
The facilities are excellent and thoughtfully prepared; everything I needed was provided, from kitchen essentials to toiletries, making my stay very convenient. The apartment was also spotless upon arrival, which made me feel comfortable right away.
Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, well-equipped, and perfectly located stay with amazing views. I would definitely love to come back!
The apartment is in the perfect location, access to good cafes and shops, lovely walks and great accessibility to the city. The apartment is exactly as the pictures show and beautifully cleaned.

Amazing Location! Very helpful via dms and the carpark was wide enough for our car and secure !
Definitely will stay here again and recommend to friends and family
Thank you for making our stay amazing
Lee is very responsive . Recommended. The location is good and easy to get the tram to the cbd.

The host has been very responsive and proactive, always engaging with us warmly and kindly. The house, though not new, has a fantastic design and is very clean and tidy. The neighborhood is quiet, and transportation is convenient with a tram stop just downstairs.

We had some delays in travel meaning our check in was late, but the host was super responsive, friendly and accommodating. The apartment was exactly as described and would definitely stay here again in future. Thanks Bedspoke!
reasonably priced, good location, host is very supportive.   a free parking space on B3 level. It can be noisy because there's a main road near the balcony, but those soundproof windows are great.
Great communication, great car park for a bigger car, very responsive and helpful guest, very clean and will definitely book again as the location is awesome.

Amazing Apartment which is exactly depicted in the pictures with all the amenities needed for our stay (washer, dryer, hairdryer, toiletries, Netflix, Nespresso machine).
Extremely comfortable and
well-insulated with air conditioning and heating system.
Despite located in the central Melbourne, there was no noise from neighbours as the apartment is located on a very high floor.
I would never hesitate to recommend this amazing place.
Had a great nights stay, apartment was spotless and Lee was very accommodating. A great view of the city from the apartment and at a really reasonable price. Would highly recommend 👍

One of the nicest places we’ve stayed in. The view is amazing. You can see all of Melbourne’s key landmarks from your bedroom and the lounge. Walking distance from the Melbourne city. We could get to places very easily which made it less hassle during our stay. Loved it.
Fantastic view! The photos don't do it justice. Very clean and great location. Would love to stay again one day. Thanks!

I loved staying at Lee's apartment. The building was easy to access and the location between Melbourne University and the CBD was perfect for my needs. I could easily walk to the supermarket at the QV building and to many dinner and breakfast choices. Picking up and returning the keys was easy and Lee explained everything very clearly. The apartment was clean and well set up. The view from the many windows was absolutely spectacular. The apartment was very quiet at night, however when the wind was strong there was some noise around the windows, if you are a light sleeper. Lee was an excellent communicator and I have recommended this apartment to my friends. I felt very safe and welcome in the building. I would definitely stay here again.

The place & the host was awesome!
Just please make sure to arrange a parking for the guests. Otherwise it’s so difficult to find a parking around CBD.

Enjoyed our stay with great view and easy transportation !
easy check in and very neat and clean

This was such a beautiful place to stay! Views absolutely incredible. The apartment was tidy and had everything we needed. Lee was such a great host, and responded to all my queries. Highly recommend staying here, if you like heights!
Thanks guys! 😃

This apartment is exactly as it’s photos. Breathtaking views and in a very central location. Walking distance to Melbourne central, state library and Queen Victoria market. The apartment was fully equipped, clean and spacious. The sofa bed was really comfy as well! Thank you Lee for such a pleasant stay :)
My friends and I always return to Lee’s airbnbs when we want to be out of our own homes! The space is always cosy and Lee is amazing at accommodating us.

Our stay was incredible.
Our host was helpful and friendly. She went above and beyond for us.
We will definitely be back.

Easy communication and quick check in, instructions were well explained and collected keys from the supermarket downstairs. Fantastic views over the city and close to Victoria Markets for cafe breakfasts and supplies.

Amazing view from the 68th floor. Mostly everything was super clean in the apartment. The lifts were always quite busy and took some time getting up and down. And the car parking situation was confusing but we are very grateful to have a carpark included during our stay. Location is amazing!
Beautiful apartment, easy to get into. Ideally located near free trams for ease of exploring city.
Good place for big family, enough space for up to 7 people include the sofa bed, surrounding are Victoria Market, and Uni Mel. Nice location

The host was very friendly & responsive. Great room and perfect for family stay. Our family loves the environment with full equipped household item. New & modern room. Worth for stay. Jaw drop panaromic view from the unit glass window. Excellent unit to stay in! Easy access to CBD , nearby Queen’s Victoria Market. Truly recommended!

Beautiful and homey apartment! Woke up to really nice view of the sunrise with some hot air balloons passing by.
We were a group of 7 adults and 1 infant - the place accommodated all of us perfectly. The beds were comfy and the bathrooms were clean.
The location is great too - walking distance to the queen victoria market, state library, melbourne central station, tram stations and all the shops and restaurants. It is right in the middle of the city and happenings.
Thank you Lee for hosting us!
Was a great place! Super clean and homey and the views just take the cake! So so so stunning, will definitely be coming here again.

“Our stay at this incredible 68th-floor apartment was nothing short of spectacular! From the moment we arrived, we were blown away by the luxurious experience the host provided. The apartment was immaculately clean, beautifully designed, and equipped with top-tier amenities, including a pool, gym, and jacuzzi—perfect for relaxation.
The highlight was the breathtaking 270-degree view, offering a mesmerizing sunset that made every evening unforgettable. Another major plus was the hassle-free, complimentary all-day parking, which made our stay even more convenient.
Our host was exceptionally friendly, supportive, and went above and beyond to ensure we had a seamless experience. Their warm hospitality truly made us feel at home. We are incredibly grateful for such an amazing stay and would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a luxurious and memorable getaway!”

Owners were very quick with responses and were very informative and polite. Would definitely stay again, great location too, few minute walk to the Melbourne Central and the station.
Clean apartment, nice views and reception, thanks for having us.

The apartment has a spectacular view of the city! It's in a fantastic location, close to Queen Vic market, Lygon Street, Melbourne Central and all of the CBD. We loved being able to celebrate my nieces 15th birthday in a special way, staying in such an amazing apartment. I loved the little sunroom, sitting in there reading a book and looking at the view.
