Excellent - spotless place in a great neighborhood with perfect location. Kevin was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy. Highly recommend!"
This was a beautiful stay, thank you Kevin for all your efforts and making my stay as comfortable as possible!

Matthew’s apartment was absolutely gorgeous. Every eventuality was catered for. The views from the decking were spectacular. I was able to entertain my family with ease and comfort. I will definitely check to see if it available on my next visit to Melbourne

Mathew was super friendly and super responsive, couldn’t have asked for a better host and apartment!
Will definitely be back!!

My boyfriend and I had a lovely stay here. It’s quiet and clean and a huge bonus is having the shops just across the street!
Amenities are great, check in and out was a breeze, would definitely stay here again. :-)

We thoroughly enjoyed staying here. It was warm and cosy in a very cold Melbourne winter. This home is so close to every amenity you could want and with a tram just around the corner, you could get to the city so easily. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again!
This is a really great Airbnb. It’s super well organised, supplied, spacious, clean, central to northside exploration, and the heating is excellent. Highly recommend
I stayed for three weeks, and everything I needed for that stay was in place and in any easy to find location.

This is a spacious house in a great location, being within walking distance to Coles and the newly established East Brunswick Village with bars, restaurants and cinema. The tram stop for the 96 tram is just around the corner, with fast and frequent trams to the city and on to St Kilda Beach. The 506 bus stop is almost outside, taking you to Moonee Ponds or Westgarth. Lygon Street is a 5 minute walk with a large selection of bars and eating places (our favourite is Mr Wilkinson for its relaxing vibe and great pizzas).
Everything was accurately advertised and clearly communicated. Place was clean and had everything needed for a happy stay.
Convenient location, supermarket was right across the road. The apartment was within the free tram zone and getting around Melbourne city was easy and fuss free. Highly recommended:)
Great place. 2nd time I've stayed here and hope to do it again some day.

We had a great experience with Charlotte and staying at her property in Richmond! There was lots to do within walking distance and the apartment was spacious with all the amenities you would need.
We would happily stay again.

Charlotte was the perfect host who responded to a couple of my questions immediately and with answers. I appreciate that everything was perfectly as described, and that everything was very clean 🧼 Thank you for having us 🩷
Absolutely loved the apartment. Metres from Bridge Road but like a quiet oasis once inside. Really well appointed and close to the tennis.

Great apartment with good living, working space and a fantastic outdoor terrace that gets sun all day and where you can watch the early morning hot air balloons from. Transport into the city is just across the road or it's any easy 35 min walk into the city. Supermarket, cafes and restaurants all close by. Charlotte was an excellent host and quick to respond.

Monty was a lovely friendly host, very responsive in communication. Super quiet location, tram stop close by, lots of cafes and bar options. Styling was on point and comfortable. Would recommend to future guests.

We’d chosen Monty’s for its excellent proximity to our sons in Melbourne; and to host a Christmas event. My menu teetered on what was going to be in the kitchen, how much room there’d be for our group. In practice, we got SO much more: genuine hospitality (condiments in the fridge: imagine!), a well built and highly stylish home, perfectly comfortable for 3 on a superhot day, and lovely courtyard space for summer dinner. A gem to find Monty.

Loved this stay! The Airbnb was in a great location, right by the trams and close to cafes. The house itself looked amazing, stunning interiors and lots of space in and out. The blackout curtains, peaceful street and amazing shower were bonuses. Would love to come and stay here again.

Absolutely perfect! The place is exactly as in the photos, so clean and have character. All the furnitures are top notch especially the beds, really comfortable. The host is very responsive and very helpful. The place has everything you need to have a comfortable stay and you'll feel at home. The free tram is just right at the front of the lobby. Nothing fault this place and I enjoyed my stay a lot. Highly recommended!
Beautiful place and very easy to commute from with the tram station directly outside of the apartment. Would definitely stay again.

Angels place was ideal for our first trip to Melbourne. It was the perfect size for us. Docklands was beautiful, & peaceful, away from the hubbub of the city but with very easy access to the centre & with sufficient local amenities.
We made use of the pool & sauna, which were a bonus.
Would definitely stay again

My husband and I, along with our two teenage boys enjoyed staying at Ange’s place.  Being on the waterfront and to have a range of boats and yachts to see was unique and made walking along the quay interesting.  We cooked a few meals in the apartment and there was a full array of pots, pans and everything we needed.  The location was good and we walked to the large Victoria market and were able to take the free trams into the downtown of Melbourne.

We absolutely loved our stay at Rui’s property. It was such a lovely and warm experience staying in such a well-maintained and nice place. The property is cozy and clean, making us feel right at home. We would definitely want to stay here again in the future.
Thanks again for Rui’s friendly and responsive service.
We stayed whilst working locally in the area. Parking was easy and the place had everything we could have wanted. Thanks again

This is a little gem . The most beautiful place with absolutely stunning views and the perfect place to unwind , relax and lose yourself in the views
Fabulous host .

Nicole's place is a gem, my parents loved it. The beds are so comfy and we have everything we need in the house. Surprise chocolates too!. Kids had fun with board games. Walkable distance to shops. Overall serene place to spend time. Thank you Nicole.

great location, had a wonderful time with my family
good views from all the bedrooms and dining room
have all the basic amenities and even the neighbours are wonderful

Thank you Nicole for hosting us! We had the most beautiful experience! We loved the awesome views and the kids loved watching the birds! The place was spotless and beds extremely comfy! We'd recommend it anytime!!

Henri Views was perfect for our girls getaway in Warburton. The view is great, interiors were lovely and well set up and the location was perfect, just a quick walk to the river. Nicole has given guests everything they need for a wonderful stay. We will be back.

Nicole's place exceeded expectations.
it really was a home away from home, with thoughtful touches down to extra toilet paper, plenty of wood for the fire and some lovely chocolates. it was beautifully clean and the beds were very comfortable.
views were spectacular! our only complaint was we didn't stay longer!
thanks Nicole, we will be back

Was a stunning holiday home which catered well for 6 of us! There were things to do in and around the house for grandparents, mum/dad and the kids!! It had wonderful views, was very clean, cosy and comfortable. Sure to stay at Henri Views again when we revisit Warburton!

We had a very comfortable stay - Beds great, fire warm and lovely, heating in bedrooms quick and responsive. House was clean and easy to use.
Steep hill the only slight limitation for someone physically compromised - we had to use the car to go out.

This house was so comfortable and cozy, it was like a home away from home. The view from the house is picturesque and when you pair that up with a beautiful fireplace, it was divine.
We travelled with two small children and Nicole was super accommodating. She let us check in early, there were yummy chocolates when we arrived, and the beds were incredibly comfy.
Thank you for letting us stay in your beautiful home.

even though I missed my flight and was running around to find a place to book until the next morning , the stuff ok punthill were lovely 😂
would recommend booking with them as the place is convenient and beautiful. there's a 100 deposit fee which is cheap also and it was return instantly within 10 mins back into my card . thanks punthill

From the moment you walked in the door you were greeted, and the customer service was incredible throughout our stay. Every employee, was approachable & friendly. The rooms were spotless & had everything you needed - a credit to them, and unexpected given how affordable the hotel was. I will happily recommend & stay again soon.
Thanks for having me 😊

Thank you Zippi for being an amazing host. Highly recommended.They are very flexible and try to make us feel at home. Zippi helped me even with my sightseeing plans. The best I have ever stayed in Australia ❤️

They truly exceeded my expectations! The rooms are spotless and Aesthetically maintained, making every dollar spent well worth it. I was running a bit late for checkout but the host was incredibly accommodating and made the whole process smooth and stress-free.  I definitely will be returning soon. Amazing!

Hotel chain in name, but the facilities, the room, the decor, the appliances and the stay were all top notch. I think i would expect a 25% more expensive price for this room, with the only draw back being that there isn't much around it besides Sunshine Train station. The gym is new, the room was clean and tidy and i could rant about this stay. 5 stars!

Punthill Sunshine is clean and well-equipped and situated at a convenient location close to numerous restaurants and shopping centre. The room we stayed in had good sunlight, not too noisy despite being in front of the elevator, and the gym facilities were a bonus!
Beautiful place and really clean. helpful staff and perfect with 24hr check in. Price is a little high for the area but good amenities on site
Excellent inside the hotel. unsafe for street parking. my truck wAs broken in and all my tools gone. mirror was smashed
Such an amazing location in terms of train access. Sunshine has so many amazing local eateries too. A real gem of a place to stay, very affordable but feels luxurious. Highly recommend.

Overall a good experience. Initial room was dirty and smelt like cigarette. They upgraded out room to a different level and 1 bedroom instead of studio. Was clean and a great stay. Love the O&M range for personal care too.

Stay was good and clean.
But there was a problem with the water when I went and had to manage for at least 7hours without water.
I had a fantastic stay at this apartment! The place was exactly as described—clean, stylish, and well-equipped with everything I needed.
Clean and nice, forgot my shampoo and conditioner and their they supply was very nice and smelled good, do recommend and front desk staff is very friendly and welcoming

Thanks Sanjay for having my family and I. Was a pleasant stay and definitely was a home away from home. Thanks for communicating the parking expectations before accepting my booking. Would love to stay here again.
Great place, clean, easy to get to, Sanjay was easy to communicate with and very accommodating.

Great location (very central) and it’s a bit off the main streets, so noise wasn’t much of an issue.  Furniture was lovely and modern, however, it was lacking a few small things - it could do with some extra plates/bowls and chopping boards. It was just a bit hard to cook with limited essentials. Overall, it was great and we really enjoyed it and would still recommend.

Great apartment in the heart of the CBD. Easy walking distance to theatres, attractions, shops etc. and within the free tram zone. Very convenient location with a Woolworths, food court + more just seconds away. Check in and check out was seamless. Would definitely book again!

Beautiful apartment with great views. Fantastic communication and easy instructions to check in and out.
Look forward to staying again!

We loved our stay here in Melbourne! It’s so centrally located with great restaurants and lots to do just a short walk away. We felt very comfy and at home at this apartment and would definitely stay here again!

Great location downtown surrounded by restaurants with main streets not too far walk. about 10 min walk to meetup locations for different tour groups. easy access to tram & bus stops, like 15 min walk from Skybus stop. Safe building & location with beautiful sunset view ! Great shower pressure & washer with space to hang items. Place itself was as expected & good response from host.
Overall loved it and recommend if you're looking for a good spot downtown & close to Queen Victoria Market!
The place looked exactly like the photos. Beautiful view from the windows with lots of stores and restaurants nearby. Spencer’s Outlet and huge Coles store right across the street!

Charlotte & Rowena are great host!
Very responsive since our booking stage and caring. Follow up thoroughly prior check-in, stay through and even after my family check out.
The house is clean and tidy and easy instructions provided on check in process and also how to use the electronic appliance.
We will definitely come back should we visit Melbourne again and also recommend to our friends!

This is a truly exceptionable Airbnb. It has been artfully decorated and has every (high-quality) appliance you could possibly need. The location is incredibly central. Giang is a very responsive and helpful host. Staying here made our trip a joy. We look forward to returning. Thank you.

This is one of the finest Airbnb’s I’ve had the pleasure of staying. Check in and check out was seamless, great host, and top notch place with everything you need for a short or extended stay. It was immaculately clean, tastefully decorated and had the highest quality amenities. The apartment has an open floor plan and lots of windows that provide natural light with a nice view of a train station. I highly recommend this peaceful oasis as a great place to call home while in Melbourne. It’s in a bustling area with lots of wonderful restaurants, cafes, and shops. In the heart of CBD, this apartment offers a quiet sanctuary in an otherwise energetic city center. I’d love to stay here every time I’m in the area. Thanks Giang for providing such an incredible Airbnb experience!

This was the second time we stayed at Giang’s place in Melbourne, and it was worth returning.
Close to restaurants for when you want to relax, and has everything you need for basic food prep.
A great place to stay.

Great location as initially was hesitant to stay so central. Now really happy we did. Right across from the train station yet the room is in a private spot because you’re so high up with a great view. Could have stayed longer with everything available to us. Easy to find things close by and getting further out because of the tram. Comfy bed, bathroom essentials provided so didn’t need to pack any. Had a cosy feel to it and everything we needed :)

Alice’s property is good value for money - it’s not fancy, the bed and furniture isn’t super comfy, but the apartment is clean, has all the amenities you need and is in a fantastic location - super convenient for travel around and out of Melbourne. A good solid place to stay.

Location was great! Super convenient and walkable to everything we needed. The unit is located in a high rise with a secured entrance so we felt safe and were away from most of the noise of the city. We really appreciated the in unit washer.
Unit overall was a decent stay. Quite barebones and sparse, and could use some maintenance as some things were a bit rundown, but had the basic necessities.
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!”

Giang’s place truly encompasses the French vibe and it is so adorable. A very responsive host and helped me when there was anything that came up. I loved the location because everything in the CBD was walking distance. I would highly recommend this place!

Gian’s property would have to be one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed at in Melbourne. Exquisite apartment with everything you need for a very comfortable stay with top of the range appliances and superb fit out. Great location with Flinders Lane eateries and entertainment venues at your door step with Flinders Street Station a few hundred metres away for Tram & Train transport.
Contact and response was second to none, and the Car Lift reminded me so much of Europe where they are very common!!
I can so highly recommend this property for that SPECIAL stay with your loved one.
Thank you Gian for making my girlfriend’s birthday weekend an amazing one. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Fantastic spot and beautiful accommodation - and much larger than it looks online.  Also do make use of the car park - it is very easy to access and secure.

A perfect spot for a few days in Melbourne! The apartment decor is gorgeous! Felt like we were in Paris.
Would definitely like to stay there again.
What a beautiful place right in the city. We had a wonderful time. Everything was perfect. We will come back. Thank you
Very convenient place and everything was as described. Host was really friendly and communication was fantastic. Would 100% recommend to anyone.

Sam is good and very responsive host,  he reply my message only within minutes, i got an early check in and late check out without any extras fee, The place is clean and just across the southern cross,  there”s so many restaurant downstair near the apartemen. Sam”s place is a top notch ❤️

Great location in the heart of Melbourne :)
We stay only for a night. Sam the host was very responsive and helpful. I would say some amenities could be add to the place maybe nice shampoo/ bossy wash and a coffee machine would make the place feel a bit better. :)

Amazing place to stay. Very clean, plenty of room. Great hosts, very responsive and nothing was too difficult for them.
10/10 would recommend to everyone.

I had a fantastic stay! The place was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything super easy from check-in to check-out. I really
appreciated the thoughtful touches and attention to detail. Highly recommend this listing and would definitely stay again. Thanks for a great experience!

Really enjoyed our stay here! The place is neat, cozy, and super convenient—Southern Cross Station is just around the corner, so getting to and from the airport was stress-free. Lots of food nearby, and Higher Ground café is just a short walk. Check-in was straightforward and easy.

The best thing about Ayfer's place is the location - Ayfer is a responsive and friendly host and as an added and very thoughtful bonus she has equipped the kitchen with some essential food items which was totally above and beyond expectations - thank you!

Unit was comfortable and well appointed. Great location.
Areas for improvement- the door latch was broken and unable to lock from the inside.
Enjoyed the stay, thanks for your help Ayfer.

We loved our stay at Ayfer’s. It was comfortable for the two of us and an easy walk to the Main Street in Fitzroy. Ayfer was always responsive and incredibly helpful, and check in was a breeze. The bed was comfy and the living area and bathroom were spacious - everything was also very clean. We would definitely stay again and recommend Ayfer’s place to a friend! Thanks for everything, Ayfer :)

The experience was very well-organized, with an excellent check-in process. The space was impeccably clean and featured high-quality appliances. The host was exceptional—very responsive and accommodating. The location was fantastic, with easy access to public transportation and a wide range of dining options nearby. The parking was also a great convenience. I highly recommend this place!

Bedspoke's description of the property was accurate. It was uncluttered and simple.
The explanations on how to gain access were very well done and easy to follow.
I like the area, though I'd never stayed there before. We were very close to about 30 restaurants and a Woolworths and Aldi.
The amenities in the apartment with very clean and easy to work.
Communication with the owner was excellent and timely.
I would gladly stay here again.

We had a fantastic stay in this apartment! The location is excellent, with convenient access to the tram, making it super easy to get around and enjoy all the city offers. Plenty of great food spots are nearby, and we especially loved starting our mornings at the local coffee shop, Porgie’s! The neighbourhood has a welcoming vibe, and everything we needed was within reach. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable, well-located place to stay!
An absolutely gorgeous stay. Flower, the host is so welcoming, the place is stunning and includes above and beyond everything needed to be completely comfortable. Highly recommend

STUNNING STUNNING STUNNING

Don’t worry if you’ll miss anything, book it if you see this ad on. One of the most remarkable property you can ever book in for sure.
Will all stuff you need in a big architectural designed property and lots of space with an amazing host that will make you feel home. EXTREMELY RECOMMEND FOR STAYING HERE

What a stunning place with a beautiful host. Super clean and spacious, with every snack and amenity we could possibly need. The sunset from the roof was absolutely gorgeous! Would definitely go back. Thanks for having us, Flower!
Wonderfully kind and responsive hosts of an absolutely stunning place to stay near beach and shops. Highly recommend.

We had a great time staying at Donna’s! The apartment is super close to a supermarket and train station. Donna was very friendly, even kindly allowing us to extend our checkout time. The place looks just like the photos too.
For any future guests, you will need to bring all your own food for health/safety reasons. Thank you Donna!
I’ve had an amazing stay! Location cannot be better! Place is very clean, very spacious. Host is easy to talk to. Instructions are simple and clear. Would definitely come back.

The listing was wonderful. Everything was a pretty short walk away with great scenery as you walk into the CBD. Everything was clean and tidy when we arrived. Would definitely try to get this place again when i visit Melbourne in the future
Great location with great views from the accommodation and the host was prompt and very helpful. Highly recommended!
lovely apartment and host. great location. we had a bit of trouble with the lift. only one key was a bit annoying

We stayed at Kumo Homes for almost a week and we enjoyed every bit from entering the apartment. It was very neat and clean, fully equipped - we found the washing machine and TV the best amenities that made us feel like 'living in our home in Melbourne'.
The view was beautiful even on a raining day (would be great if there was umbrella provided with the room ;p) and the service & communication had been very pleasant during the entire process - very responsive and supportive! (we requested for parking prior to booking and the parking space / location was very good and convenient).
We really enjoyed our stay at Kumo Homes and thank you so much. :)

Place was great! Clean and nice view of CBD, great facilities and location right in the center. Only thing that is a little inconvenient is the parking is not in the same building, I needed to lug my heavy luggages across the street. Other than that, perfect accommodation for a vacation.

We'd gladly recommend this spacious 2B2B Airbnb with stunning views to anyone visiting Melbourne. The hosts were proactive, friendly, and consistently responsive. The check-in lockbox is conveniently located just around the corner and accessible 24/7. Plenty of local amenities nearby and several tram stations within walking distance make it even more convenient.

Very happy staying here with out 4 month old and friends. everything we needed. great location and surrounding restaurants and shopping. easy access with pram and provided a porta cot and set it up for us.
would definately stay again

I really enjoyed my stay at Kumo Homes. The apartment was spotless, cozy, and had everything I needed for a comfortable trip. The location was perfect — close to cafes, shops, and trams, yet quiet enough to relax.
Hailey was a gem of a host — super friendly, quick to reply, and made check-in/check-out so easy. Her thoughtful touches made the place feel extra welcoming.
Would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting Melbourne.

Right in the heart of the CBD - across the street from Mecca. Great amenities, amazing sunset & city views from every room of the apartment! Better for 2 adults rather than 4 due to the size. Keep in mind that there is only one pan and one pot to cook but who needs to cook when you have soooo many places to eat right around you to cater for every budget. Would highly recommend for a stay in the city. Hosts were fantastic and always checking in. Only downfall we found was that it says it had a dryer and we packed accordingly but there was none… which gave us a great excuse to go shopping at DFO South Warf my favourite place to go for specials!
Would definitely stay again.
The apartment was fantastic, clean, convenient and comfortable. The hosts were very responsive and helpful. We had a really enjoyable stay

Beautiful place to stay, with a very easy going, responsive host. Great location with many restaurants, bars, and pubs within walking distance. Also very easy to get public transport into the city. Definitely recommend.

Thank you Pemmy for sharing your beautiful terrace house with us.
We had a great time and loved the bespoke nature of your property.
The locationis second to none. We loved being able to walk downstairs to an amazing bakery. Cafe Jabelle would be close the best meal we have had in Melbourne which is in front of this propert and you are within walking distance to Lygon St.
The property has everything you need or could want and has been meticulously updated and styled.
The space feels luxurious and opulent with an abundant of natural light with modern kitchen and bathrooms. We really enjoyed the eat in kitchen and built in seating. The highchair was very useful and was like brand new.
Communicating with Pemmy was a breeze and we fully appreciated details like self check in and the carefully compiled user guide.
Thanks again for the happy memories and lovely place to stay.
We had a great time, it's on the best side of town with plenty to do day or night.
Great little apartment. Very clean and close to shops and cafes. The only downside was the noise outside which is not the owners fault. Other than that, we had a fantastic stay.
We had a great stay! Close to wonderful restaurants and cafes (Middle Southeast is the best cafe I've been to in Melbourne btw) would stay again!

Overall the stay was terribly basic. However there were a few issues:
- Toilet seat in ensuite bathroom was broken upon arrival, attempted fix by maintenance, was told seat was only useable with care
- Second key was requested prior to stay and was originally promised by host. A few days prior to stay was informed this was no longer possible which was very inconvenient
- No salt and pepper was available as reported on listing. Also no facial tissues available.
Other than that no other issues with stay or place

The stay was really good and the host was really responsive.
I enjoyed staying there with my parents for 2 weeks.
Very good stay experience, the landlord was very kind and gave us a lot of help, the house was very new and clean.
Brilliant location for a short stay in Melbourne, especially if you are using the Skybus from the airport or looking for excellent facilities (pool, gym etc)

Thank you Maggie for such a wonderful stay! Location is fantastic - directly opposite great shopping and a fully equipped Coles, buses directly outside and minutes walking distance to many different tram lines, and so many food options within a single block.
The unit was spotless and was easily able to accommodate 2 adults and 3 children. The amenities in the building were also fabulous - everyone in our family had something and felt immediately comfortable.
Maggie was a pleasure to deal with and was always able to respond quickly.
We loved our stay and would happily book again. Thank you. x
Nice apartment on 57th floor, easy to walk to southern cross station and lots of attractions in the CBD.

I asked for early checkin and the host was adamant to stick with the listed time of 3pm. I respect that and hung around the area to wait for it. but when the actual time is up they told me it was not ready and needed longer to clean... which I think is pretty double standards. I didn't realised only 1 air con was available in the living room and when I asked if there are fans for the bed rooms, I got a reply saying only the air con is available (it was 37 degrees the first night we got there), the air con was no where strong enough (barely cools the living room). The bed in the bedroom was quite narrow and we barely fit 2 people on it. The shower water pressure was not super good but it was decent. Also, half the apartment lifts were out of service which made it quite inconvenient to travel in and out.
Our stay was amazing. The views are amazing and the place was very organised and clean. The wifi barely worked though.

Good location near to town centre, pubs and restaurants and supermarkets.
Good sized flat, well equipped, wi fi fast, nice sunny spot, comfortable beds.
Taylor always responded promptly to my messages before I arrived and also on ant questions I had after arrival.
Would happily stay here again.

We had a great time staying here in Preston. It is a spacious house where my family and friends, a group of eight, stayed together. The house is beautiful, clean, modern, and every room has its own en-suite bathroom.
The kitchen is fully equipped, and most importantly, it’s conveniently located near Bell station.
Thank you to the host for being friendly, responding quickly, and providing helpful recommendations.
I highly recommend this accommodation for large groups. : )👍

We loved staying at your place again and were so happy to even find our suggestions implemented from the last time we stayed there. Thank you again and we do not hesitate to recommend this place for your stay in the SE suburbs of Melbourne!

This place was exactly what we needed.
In all honesty, we used the property pretty much to just sleep and shower through a hectic sporting tournament weekend but whilst we were there it was clean, comfortable and exactly what was needed. The main bedroom.. oh my that BED! Absolute heaven! I want that mattress! We booked for 6 and only my family stayed, but it was heaps of space, very comfortable and great price point.
Thanks again!
Our family had a great time staying here, house was nice and clean, secure parking - would stay again.

We had a wonderful stay at Evline’s lovely property—it was exactly as described: spacious, comfortable, and perfect for our needs. Evline was a fantastic host, welcoming and communicative throughout our stay. Our entire group thoroughly enjoyed our time there and would happily return. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great place to stay in Melbourne!

super convenient and easy to locate. tons of great restaurants nearby to choose from and the free tram is right down the block! felt like we had the entire place to ourselves, very comfortable and spacious. had all that we needed for our stay in Melbourne. Kavin was very kind and accomadating, responded quickly and had many recommendations for activities or food. would recommend and stay here again =)

Kavin was a great host and immediately offered many suggestions for visiting Melbourne. He was very proactive and checked multiple times if there was anything he could help me with.
The room was exactly as pictured. The location was great, making it easy to reach things in and around Melbourne CBD.

Our stay here was fantastic. The bed was very comfortable, it was quiet, we had a great view of the pool and the tram was right out the front making it very handy to get into the city. The apartment was spotless and had everything we needed.

Lovely place, perfect location right next to the district but still easy to get to the inner CBD, easy check in, parking is very close by and very easy to access, amazing pool & got a really good price for 4 nights over NYE period. Very good communication & very accomodating, let me check in earlier!
Highly recommend <3

We really enjoyed our stay. The location is excellent in a quiet and clean part of the city with convenient and free public transport out the front. The pool on the 7th floor was amazing and Haruka’s check in and out instructions were clear and easy. Will be recommending and would love to stay here every time I visit Melbourne! Thank you!

Had a wonderful stay at Haruka’s place. Bathroom was a bit squeezy but otherwise it was a nice place for the 2 of us who wanted to explore Melbourne CBD area. Multiple tram stations that are of walking distance, as well as close to a Woolsworth and quite a few restaurants too.

It was lovely staying here, very affordable and the rooms were clean and bright and well decorated. The location is great, it allows you to get the best out of Williamstown while also making getting into Melbourne CBD super easy. The hosts were responsive and friendly, would definitely book with them again!

The unit was clean, spacious and comfortable although being right next to a roundabout it was a little noisy.
It’s in a great neighbourhood with lots of eating options close by and a short walk to the waterfront.
Our family had a lovely and comfortable stay at Simone’s apartment . . it was well appointed and close to transport and located in a leafy and quiet street!

This place felt like home for our almost 2 week stay. Everyone in our party (ages 9-70) commented how well they slept in the comfortable beds. The location was perfect for getting around to all the other areas of Melbourne we visited. Any of our local family who saw the place talked about how gorgeous it was and how the neighborhood was so ideal. We felt very safe walking to various coffee shops and restaurants.

Our stay at Freya and Jony’s place was wonderful. They were extremely friendly and responsive to messages and anything we needed during the stay. The house is freshly renovated with everything you will need for a short or long term stay. The shower pressure is amazing!
Within a kilometre there is Coles, Aldi and Woolworths as well as some fantastic cafes and restaurants that are within walking distance. Doncaster Westfield is also less than 3kms down the road. There are some fantastic parks to take young children to within a 5 minute drive.
Overall a wonderful stay and great location!

Charlie is a great host - friendly, responsive, flexible check in and gave great recommendations in the area.
I’ve stayed in many BNBs and this one really ticks all the important boxes. Thanks Charlie!

The house was spotlessly clean, linen clean and fresh. Every detail was perfect, It felt like home, peaceful environment, plenty of space, looked exactly like the photos. we loved every bit of it. Well worth every cent and will definitely book again.

Very clean, comfortable, modern and stylish home.
Great hot water and heater for entire house as it was cold weather.

Lovely house and would love to stay again
Really nice place to stay, so handy with places to eat within walking distance too, nice view too.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Michelle and Jay’s Airbnb!

it was a very cozy & comfortable stay at Michelle & jay accommodation as it feel like home but very quiet neighbourhood ! transportation to footscary station was easy peasy!

Few wrinkles at checkin, but Young was an attentive host and all resolved. Good place, great location. Thank you.

Great stay, Docklands itself sadly still very sleepy and very little in the way of bars and restaurants, however a 5 minute tram ride and you are smack bang in the middle

Thank you so very much for a wonderful stay, we will definitely be back with our little pooch!
A  spacious granny flat with a comfortable bed and pillows. Felt well rested and safe in Deanne’s place. Perfect for our overnight stay 🙏

Thank you for being helpful by setting up the sofa bed and Mike for the lovely chat ..

Walking distance to some restaurants and also shopping place.

Deanne & Mike were very friendly & helpful.

My stay was amazing! Great amenities and the outside spa and pool was amazing! Timeless i would describe it 🫡 the owner was so accommodating and was super helpful during our stay. I would 100% stay again 🙏🏽 Thank you!

My partner and I had a wonderful stay at Gianna’s! It was a cutely furnished apartment with amenities that were of high quality and everything was well maintained! We will definitely recommend Gianna’s place to anyone looking for a place to stay in Melbourne 😊.
I had an amazing stay! It was really safe and loved having Tram so close to the apartment. It was easy to get around the city.

This is truly a special BnB, where the hosts go that little bit extra to make it a memorable holiday. The cottage and its surrounds are beautiful, with water features, zen garden, fire pit, spa, and more. Our toddler especially loved collecting fresh eggs each morning from the hen house. Deepika and Ravi and lovely and kind people, who made the stay even more special. For our little family and pup, it was a perfect long weekend, relaxing at the house, visiting local wineries, and catching some snow flurries up at Mt Donna Buang.

The airbnb is lovely, the location is quiet and safe. We love the open kitchen and the airbnb is very clean. We are happy to stay here again if we come to Melbourne next time!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The space was beautiful, spotless and perfectly located – we discovered some fantastic cafes nearby as well.
Ming was a great host, always prompt and helpful in responding to our queries. The private carpark was a huge bonus since we drove in from Adelaide and the parking instructions were very clear and easy to follow.
We also loved the convenience of having an Asian grocer and liquor store right next door to us which was perfect for stocking up on snacks during our stay.
We’d highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!

Our host was responsive and very easy to communicate with. The property was perfect for our needs with an awesome view.  Very central to the CBD we were only ever a short walk to all our activities with lots to do in between.  Most certainly would stay at this property again.

Such a beautiful spot overlooking Southern Cross Station and Marvel Stadium. The view at night was absolutely stunning! The place was nice and felt like home. The hosts were very responsive to my questions, and very helpful in returning an item I had left behind. I will definitely stay here again when I need to stay in the city!

Vshine was great to deal with all along the process which made it easier for us.
Was very responsive to questions that we had about the accommodation and facilities in the building.
Good location for access to many areas including transport, shopping and the CBD of Melbourne.
Would look to stay there again if the opportunity arose.

Absolutely an amazing place, beautiful and comfortable felt at home. worth the money.
Highly recommended and will definitely stay again
Kanu was lovely and her home and the room was very clean and comfortable. Would stay again if needing to be close to La Trobe University.

We had an amazing stay at Sam’s place! Everything was exactly as described, clean, and incredibly comfortable. My family enjoyed being there. We had a peaceful stay and felt safe and comfortable. Loved it. Would love to come again.

Clean and with a great view of the City. Location is superb as it’s close to Crown.
The place is absolutely amazing! The location is very convenient, the place is super clean and the view is simply lovely. Would 100% return. Wilsa was also a great and very helpful host for our stay!

Jake's place was a home away from home.  It was sparkling clean, well furnished and had all the creature comforts. Jake was always quick to reply to messages, friendly and helpful. We had such a lovely stay at Jake’s place. Everything was perfect, super clean, responsive host. It is a gorgeous, comfortable and practical apartment. Jake went above and beyond to make our stay five star. Absolutely nothing to fault and looking forward to staying again. Thanks so much!
Lovely spot to get abit away from the city, apartment was very clean and nicely furnished.

I would recommend Matthew’s apartment to anyone. The apartment looked exactly like the photos; however, it was even more beautiful in person. Additionally, it was a 20-minute tram ride to the Central Business District, which made exploring Melbourne convenient.

Great location in Hawthorn, easy for car or train or walk to Glenferrie. Highly recommend!

Our stay was fantastic. The apartment was very clean and super cozy. Check in and check out was easy and clear. Great location and great communication from Anna.

The location was very nice and could get everywhere by tram. Would definitely stay again!

A really great stay, so easy with the Tram stop right outside, awesome wine bar & restaurant right across the road. Very quiet and super light, warm and airy apartment with great energy & flow out to the view.

Fantastic stay in Footscray was just what we were looking for with our short stay just outside the city and so many places to eat close by with public transport at your finger tip. Close to the city.
